  15 # along with MantisBT.  If not, see <http://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
  16 
  17 /**
  18  * API Token API
  19  *
  20  * @package CoreAPI
  21  * @subpackage ApiTokenAPI
  22  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  23  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  24  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  25  *
  26  * @uses crypto_api.php
  27  */
  28 
  29 require_api( 'crypto_api.php' );
  30 
  31 /**
  32  * Checks if specified user can create API tokens.
  33  * @param integer|null $p_user_id User id or null for current logged in user.
  34  * @return bool true: can create tokens, false: otherwise.
  35  */
  36 function api_token_can_create( $p_user_id = null ) {
  37 	$t_user_id = is_null( $p_user_id ) ? auth_get_current_user_id() : $p_user_id;
  38 	return !user_is_protected( $t_user_id );
  39 }
  40 
  41 /**
  42  * Get token row given its id.
  43  * 
  44  * @param integer $p_token_id The id of the token
  45  * @return array|false The token row or false if not found.
  46  */
  47 function api_token_get( $p_token_id ) {
  48 	db_param_push();
  49 
  50 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {api_token} WHERE id=' . db_param();
  51 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_token_id ) );
  52 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
  53 
  54 	return $t_row;
  55 }
  56 
  57 /**
  58  * Create an API token
  59  *
  60  * @param string $p_token_name The name (description) identifying what the token is going to be used for.
  61  * @param integer $p_user_id The user id.
  62  * @param bool $p_return_id if true, returns an associate array with id and token.
  63  * @return string|array The plain token or array of id and token.
  64  * @access public
  65  */
  66 function api_token_create( $p_token_name, $p_user_id, $p_return_id = false ) {
  67 	if( is_blank( $p_token_name ) ) {
  68 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'api_token_name' ) );
  69 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
  70 	}
  71 
  72 	$t_token_name = trim( $p_token_name );
  73 	if( mb_strlen( $t_token_name ) > DB_FIELD_SIZE_API_TOKEN_NAME ) {
  74 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'api_token_name' ), DB_FIELD_SIZE_API_TOKEN_NAME );
  75 		trigger_error( ERROR_FIELD_TOO_LONG, ERROR );
  76 	}
  77 
  78 	api_token_name_ensure_unique( $t_token_name, $p_user_id );
  79 
  80 	$t_plain_token = crypto_generate_uri_safe_nonce( API_TOKEN_LENGTH );
  81 	$t_hash = api_token_hash( $t_plain_token );
  82 	$t_date_created = db_now();
  83 
  84 	db_param_push();
  85 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {api_token}
  86 					( user_id, name, hash, date_created )
  87 					VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
  88 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_user_id, (string)$t_token_name, $t_hash, $t_date_created ) );
  89 
  90 	if( $p_return_id ) {
  91 		$t_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'api_token' ) );
  92 		return array( 'id' => $t_id, 'token' => $t_plain_token );
  93 	}
  94 
  95 	return $t_plain_token;
  96 }
  97 
  98 /**
  99  * Calculate the hash for the token.
 100  * @param string $p_token The plain token.
 101  * @return string The one way hash for the token
 102  * @access public
 103  */
 104 function api_token_hash( $p_token ) {
 105 	return hash( 'sha256', $p_token );
 106 }
 107 
 108 /**
 109  * Checks that the specified token name is unique to the user.
 110  *
 111  * @param string $p_token_name The token name.
 112  * @param string $p_user_id    The user id.
 113  *
 114  * @return bool True if unique, False if token already exists
 115  */
 116 function api_token_name_is_unique( $p_token_name, $p_user_id ) {
 117 	db_param_push();
 118 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {api_token} WHERE user_id=' . db_param() . ' AND name=' . db_param();
 119 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_user_id, $p_token_name ) );
 120 
 121 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 122 
 123 	return $t_row === false;
 124 }
 125 
 126 /**
 127  * Ensure that the specified token name is unique to the user, otherwise,
 128  * prompt the user with an error.
 129  *
 130  * @param string $p_token_name The token name.
 131  * @param string $p_user_id The user id.
 132  */
 133 function api_token_name_ensure_unique( $p_token_name, $p_user_id ) {
 134 	if ( !api_token_name_is_unique( $p_token_name, $p_user_id ) ) {
 135 		error_parameters( $p_token_name );
 136 		trigger_error( ERROR_API_TOKEN_NAME_NOT_UNIQUE, ERROR );
 137 	}
 138 }
 139 
 140 /**
 141  * Get user information given an API token.
 142  *
 143  * @param string $p_token The plain token.
 144  * @return int|bool user id or false if no match found.
 145  * @access public
 146  */
 147 function api_token_get_user( $p_token ) {
 148 	# If the supplied token doesn't look like a valid one, then fail the check w/o doing db lookups.
 149 	# This is likely called from code that supports both tokens and passwords.
 150 	if( is_blank( $p_token ) || mb_strlen( $p_token ) != API_TOKEN_LENGTH ) {
 151 		return false;
 152 	}
 153 
 154 	$t_encrypted_token = api_token_hash( $p_token );
 155 
 156 	db_param_push();
 157 
 158 	# TODO: add an index on just the API token hash
 159 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {api_token} WHERE hash=' . db_param();
 160 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $t_encrypted_token ) );
 161 
 162 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 163 	if( $t_row ) {
 164 		api_token_touch( $t_row['id'] );
 165 		return $t_row['user_id'];
 166 	}
 167 
 168 	return false;
 169 }
 170 
 171 /**
 172  * Validate a plain token for the specified user.
 173  * @param string $p_username The user name.
 174  * @param string $p_token The plain token.
 175  * @return boolean true valid username and token, false otherwise.
 176  * @access public
 177  */
 178 function api_token_validate( $p_username, $p_token ) {
 179 	# If the supplied token doesn't look like a valid one, then fail the check w/o doing db lookups.
 180 	# This is likely called from code that supports both tokens and passwords.
 181 	if( is_blank( $p_token ) || mb_strlen( $p_token ) != API_TOKEN_LENGTH ) {
 182 		return false;
 183 	}
 184 
 185 	$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $p_username );
 186 
 187 	# If user is not found in the database, they don't have api tokens, we won't bother with worrying about
 188 	# auto-creation scenario here.
 189 	if( $t_user_id === false ) {
 190 		return false;
 191 	}
 192 
 193 	$t_encrypted_token = api_token_hash( $p_token );
 194 
 195 	db_param_push();
 196 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {api_token} WHERE user_id=' . db_param() . ' AND hash=' . db_param();
 197 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $t_user_id, $t_encrypted_token ) );
 198 
 199 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 200 	if( $t_row ) {
 201 		api_token_touch( $t_row['id'] );
 202 		return true;
 203 	}
 204 
 205 	return false;
 206 }
 207 
 208 /**
 209  * Get all API tokens associated with the specified user.
 210  * @param integer $p_user_id The user id.
 211  * @return array Array of API token rows for owned by the user, can be empty.
 212  * @access public
 213  */
 214 function api_token_get_all( $p_user_id ) {
 215 	db_param_push();
 216 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {api_token} WHERE user_id=' . db_param() . ' ORDER BY date_used DESC, date_created ASC';
 217 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_user_id ) );
 218 
 219 	$t_rows = array();
 220 	while ( ( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) !== false )
 221 	{
 222 		$t_rows[] = $t_row;
 223 	}
 224 
 225 	return $t_rows;
 226 }
 227 
 228 /**
 229  * Determines whether the specified token has ever been used.
 230  * @param array $p_token token to check
 231  * @return bool True if used
 232  * @access public
 233  */
 234 function api_token_is_used( array $p_token ) {
 235 	return (int)$p_token['date_used'] > 1;
 236 }
 237 
 238 /**
 239  * Updates the last used timestamp for the api token.
 240  *
 241  * @param integer $p_api_token_id The token id.
 242  * @return void
 243  * @access public
 244  */
 245 function api_token_touch( $p_api_token_id ) {
 246 	$t_date_used = db_now();
 247 
 248 	db_param_push();
 249 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {api_token} SET date_used=' . db_param() . ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
 250 
 251 	db_query( $t_query, array( $t_date_used, $p_api_token_id ) );
 252 }
 253 
 254 /**
 255  * Revokes the api token with the specified id
 256  * @param integer $p_api_token_id The API token id.
 257  * @param integer $p_user_id The user id.
 258  * @return void
 259  * @access public
 260  */
 261 function api_token_revoke( $p_api_token_id, $p_user_id ) {
 262 	db_param_push();
 263 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {api_token} WHERE id=' . db_param() . ' AND user_id = ' . db_param();
 264 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_api_token_id, $p_user_id ) );
 265 }
 266 
 267 /**
 268  * Revoke all api tokens for the specified user.
 269  *
 270  * @param integer $p_user_id The user id.
 271  * @return void
 272  * @access public
 273  */
 274 function api_token_revoke_all( $p_user_id ) {
 275 	db_param_push();
 276 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {api_token} WHERE user_id = ' . db_param();
 277 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_user_id ) );
 278 }

  17 /**
  18  * Authentication API
  19  *
  20  * @package CoreAPI
  21  * @subpackage AuthenticationAPI
  22  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  23  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  24  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  25  *
  26  * @uses access_api.php
  27  * @uses config_api.php
  28  * @uses constant_inc.php
  29  * @uses crypto_api.php
  30  * @uses current_user_api.php
  31  * @uses database_api.php
  32  * @uses error_api.php
  33  * @uses gpc_api.php
  34  * @uses helper_api.php
  35  * @uses html_api.php
  36  * @uses lang_api.php
  37  * @uses ldap_api.php
  38  * @uses print_api.php
  39  * @uses session_api.php
  40  * @uses string_api.php
  41  * @uses tokens_api.php
  42  * @uses user_api.php
  43  * @uses utility_api.php
  44  */
  45 
  46 use Mantis\Exceptions\ClientException;
  47 
  48 require_api( 'access_api.php' );
  49 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  50 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  51 require_api( 'crypto_api.php' );
  52 require_api( 'current_user_api.php' );
  53 require_api( 'database_api.php' );
  54 require_api( 'error_api.php' );
  55 require_api( 'gpc_api.php' );
  56 require_api( 'helper_api.php' );
  57 require_api( 'html_api.php' );
  58 require_api( 'lang_api.php' );
  59 require_api( 'ldap_api.php' );
  60 require_api( 'print_api.php' );
  61 require_api( 'session_api.php' );
  62 require_api( 'string_api.php' );
  63 require_api( 'tokens_api.php' );
  64 require_api( 'user_api.php' );
  65 require_api( 'utility_api.php' );
  66 
  67 # @global array $g_script_login_cookie
  68 $g_script_login_cookie = null;
  69 
  70 # @global array $g_cache_anonymous_user_cookie_string
  71 $g_cache_anonymous_user_cookie_string = null;
  72 
  73 # @global array $g_cache_cookie_valid
  74 $g_cache_cookie_valid = null;
  75 
  76 # @global int $g_cache_current_user_id
  77 $g_cache_current_user_id = NO_USER;
  78 
  79 /**
  80  * Gets set of flags for authentication for the specified user.
  81  *
  82  * @param int|null|bool $p_user_id  The user id or null for logged in user or
  83  *                                  NO_USER/false for user that doesn't exist
  84  *                                  in the system, that may be auto-provisioned.
  85  * @param string|null   $p_username The username or email
  86  *
  87  * @return AuthFlags The auth flags object to use.
  88  * @throws ClientException
  89  */
  90 function auth_flags( $p_user_id = null, $p_username = '' ) {
  91 	# If user id is null but username is set, let the plugin handle it per #27836
  92 	if ( is_null( $p_user_id ) || ( $p_user_id === false && is_null( $p_username ) ) ) {
  93 		# If user id is not provided and user is not authenticated return default flags.
  94 		# Otherwise, we can get into a loop as in #22740
  95 		# If user is false and username is null, display a more user-friendly error per #25061
  96 		if( !auth_is_user_authenticated() ) {
  97 			return new AuthFlags();
  98 		}
  99 
 100 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 101 	} else {
 102 		$t_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 103 	}
 104 
 105 	if( !$t_user_id && is_blank( $p_username ) ) {
 106 		# If user is not in db, must supply the name.
 107 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 108 	}
 109 
 110 	if( $t_user_id ) {
 111 		$t_username = user_get_username( $t_user_id );
 112 		$t_email = user_get_email( $t_user_id );
 113 	} else {
 114 		$t_username = $p_username;
 115 
 116 		# If the plugin cares about email, then it can check if user typed the email address
 117 		# as the username.
 118 		$t_email = '';
 119 	}
 120 
 121 	$t_event_arguments = array(
 122 		'user_id' => $t_user_id,
 123 		'username' => $t_username,
 124 		'email' => $t_email,
 125 	);
 126 
 127 	static $s_flags_cache = array();
 128 	if( !isset( $s_flags_cache[$t_user_id] ) ) {
 129 		$t_flags = event_signal( 'EVENT_AUTH_USER_FLAGS', array( $t_event_arguments ) );
 130 
 131 		# Don't cache in case of user not in db.
 132 		if( $t_user_id ) {
 133 			$s_flags_cache[$t_user_id] = $t_flags;
 134 		}
 135 	} else {
 136 		$t_flags = $s_flags_cache[$t_user_id];
 137 	}
 138 
 139 	if( is_null( $t_flags ) ) {

 207 /**

 209  *

 211  * @param bool $p_perm_login Use permanent login.
 212  *
 213  * @return int cookie lifetime or 0 for browser session.
 214  * @throws ClientException
 215  */
 216 function auth_session_expiry( $p_user_id, $p_perm_login ) {
 217 	$t_auth_flags = auth_flags( $p_user_id );
 218 	$t_perm_login = $p_perm_login;
 219 	if( !$t_auth_flags->getPermSessionEnabled() ) {
 220 		$t_perm_login = false;
 221 	}
 222 
 223 	if( $t_perm_login ) {
 224 		$t_lifetime = $t_auth_flags->getPermSessionLifetime();
 225 	} else {
 226 		$t_lifetime = $t_auth_flags->getSessionLifetime();
 227 	}
 228 
 229 	return $t_lifetime == 0 ? 0 : time() + $t_lifetime;
 230 }

 316 /**
 317  * Check that there is a user logged-in and authenticated.
 318  *
 319  * - If the user's account is disabled they will be logged out
 320  * - If there is no user logged in, redirect to the login page
 321  * - If parameter is given it is used as a URL to redirect to following
 322  *   successful login.  If none is given, the URL of the current page is used.
 323  *
 324  * @param string $p_return_page Page to redirect to following successful logon,
 325  *                              defaults to current page.
 326  *
 327  * @return void
 328  * @throws ClientException
 329  *
 330  * @access public
 331  */
 332 function auth_ensure_user_authenticated( $p_return_page = '' ) {
 333 	# if logged in
 334 	if( auth_is_user_authenticated() ) {
 335 		# check for access enabled
 336 		#  This also makes sure the cookie is valid
 337 		if( OFF == current_user_get_field( 'enabled' ) ) {
 338 			print_header_redirect( auth_logout_page() );
 339 		}
 340 	} else {
 341 		# not logged in
 342 		if( is_blank( $p_return_page ) ) {
 343 			if( !isset( $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ) ) {
 344 				$_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] = $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] . '?' . $_SERVER['QUERY_STRING'];
 345 			}
 346 			$p_return_page = $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'];
 347 		}
 348 		print_header_redirect( auth_login_page( [ 'return' => $p_return_page ] ) );
 349 	}
 350 }

 360 function auth_is_user_authenticated() {
 361 	global $g_cache_cookie_valid, $g_login_anonymous;
 362 	if( $g_cache_cookie_valid ) {
 363 		return $g_cache_cookie_valid;
 364 	}
 365 	$g_cache_cookie_valid = auth_is_cookie_valid( auth_get_current_user_cookie( $g_login_anonymous ) );
 366 	return $g_cache_cookie_valid;
 367 }

 369 /**
 370  * Prepare/override the username provided from logon form (if necessary).
 371  *
 372  * @todo when we rewrite authentication api for plugins, this should be merged
 373  *       with prepare_password and return some object
 374  *
 375  * @param string $p_username Username.
 376  *
 377  * @return string|null prepared username
 378  *
 379  * @access public
 380  */
 381 function auth_prepare_username( $p_username ) {
 382 	$t_username = null;
 383 
 384 	switch( config_get_global( 'login_method' ) ) {
 385 		case BASIC_AUTH:
 386 			if( isset( $_SERVER['REMOTE_USER'] ) ) {
 387 				$t_username = $_SERVER['REMOTE_USER'];
 388 			}
 389 			break;
 390 		case HTTP_AUTH:
 391 			if( !auth_http_is_logout_pending() ) {
 392 				if( isset( $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_USER'] ) ) {
 393 					$t_username = $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_USER'];
 394 				}
 395 			} else {
 396 				auth_http_set_logout_pending( false );
 397 				auth_http_prompt();
 398 			}
 399 			break;
 400 		default:
 401 			$t_username = $p_username;
 402 			break;
 403 	}
 404 
 405 	if( !is_null( $t_username ) ) {
 406 		$t_username = user_is_name_valid( $t_username ) ? $t_username : null;
 407 	}
 408 
 409 	return $t_username;
 410 }
 411 
 412 /**
 413  * prepare/override the password provided from logon form (if necessary).
 414  *
 415  * @todo when we rewrite authentication api for plugins, this should be merged
 416  *       with prepare_username and return some object
 417  *
 418  * @param string $p_password Password.
 419  *
 420  * @return string prepared password
 421  *
 422  * @access public
 423  */
 424 function auth_prepare_password( $p_password ) {
 425 	$f_password = $p_password;
 426 	switch( config_get_global( 'login_method' ) ) {
 427 		case BASIC_AUTH:
 428 			$f_password = $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_PW'];
 429 			break;
 430 		case HTTP_AUTH:
 431 			if( !auth_http_is_logout_pending() ) {
 432 
 433 				# this will never get hit - see auth_prepare_username
 434 				if( isset( $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_PW'] ) ) {
 435 					$f_password = $_SERVER['PHP_AUTH_PW'];
 436 				}
 437 			} else {
 438 				auth_http_set_logout_pending( false );
 439 				auth_http_prompt();
 440 
 441 				# calls exit
 442 				return null;
 443 			}
 444 			break;
 445 	}
 446 	return $f_password;
 447 }

 449 /**
 450  * Automatically create user after authentication.
 451  *
 452  * In the case where a user is attempting to authenticate but doesn't exist.
 453  * Check if the authentication provider supports auto-creation of users and
 454  * whether the password matches.
 455  *
 456  * @param string $p_username A prepared username.
 457  * @param string $p_password A prepared password.
 458  *
 459  * @return int|bool user id or false in case of failure.
 460  * @throws ClientException
 461  *
 462  * @access private
 463  */
 464 function auth_auto_create_user( $p_username, $p_password ) {
 465 	$t_login_method = config_get_global( 'login_method' );
 466 
 467 	if( $t_login_method == BASIC_AUTH ) {
 468 		$t_auto_create = true;
 469 	} else if( $t_login_method == LDAP && ldap_authenticate_by_username( $p_username, $p_password ) ) {
 470 		$t_auto_create = true;
 471 	} else {
 472 		$t_auto_create = false;
 473 	}
 474 
 475 	if( $t_auto_create ) {
 476 		# attempt to create the user
 477 		$t_cookie_string = user_create( $p_username, md5( $p_password ) );
 478 		if( $t_cookie_string === false ) {
 479 			# it didn't work
 480 			return false;
 481 		}
 482 
 483 		# ok, we created the user, get the row again
 484 		return user_get_id_by_name( $p_username );
 485 	}
 486 
 487 	return false;
 488 }
 489 
 490 /**
 491  * Retrieve user id from login name.
 492  *
 493  * Given a login username provided by the user via the web UI or our API,
 494  * get the user id.  The login username can be a username or an email address.
 495  * The email address will work as long there is a single enabled account with
 496  * such address and it is not blank.
 497  *
 498  * @param string $p_login_name The login name.
 499  *
 500  * @return integer|boolean user id or false.
 501  * @throws ClientException
 502  */
 503 function auth_get_user_id_from_login_name( $p_login_name ) {
 504 	$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $p_login_name );
 505 
 506 	# If user is not found by name, check by email as long as there is only
 507 	# a single match.
 508 	if( $t_user_id === false
 509 		&& !is_blank( $p_login_name )
 510 		&& config_get_global( 'email_login_enabled' )
 511 		&& email_is_valid( $p_login_name )
 512 	) {
 513 		$t_user_ids_by_email = user_get_enabled_ids_by_email( $p_login_name );
 514 		if ( count( $t_user_ids_by_email ) == 1 ) {
 515 			$t_user_id = $t_user_ids_by_email[0];
 516 		}
 517 	}
 518 
 519 	return $t_user_id;
 520 }
 521 
 522 /**
 523  * Attempt to login the user with the given password.
 524  *
 525  * - If the user fails validation, false is returned
 526  * - If the user passes validation, the cookies are set and true is returned.
 527  * - If $p_perm_login is true, the long-term cookie is created.
 528  *
 529  * @param string $p_username   A prepared username.
 530  * @param string $p_password   A prepared password.
 531  * @param bool   $p_perm_login Whether to create a long-term cookie.
 532  *
 533  * @return bool indicates if authentication was successful
 534  * @throws ClientException
 535  *
 536  * @access public
 537  */
 538 function auth_attempt_login( $p_username, $p_password, $p_perm_login = false ) {
 539 	$t_user_id = auth_get_user_id_from_login_name( $p_username );
 540 
 541 	if( $t_user_id === false ) {
 542 		$t_user_id = auth_auto_create_user( $p_username, $p_password );
 543 		if( $t_user_id === false ) {
 544 			return false;
 545 		}
 546 	}
 547 
 548 	# max. failed login attempts achieved...
 549 	if( !user_is_login_request_allowed( $t_user_id ) ) {
 550 		return false;
 551 	}
 552 
 553 	# check for anonymous login
 554 	if( !user_is_anonymous( $t_user_id ) ) {
 555 		# anonymous login didn't work, so check the password
 556 		if( !auth_does_password_match( $t_user_id, $p_password ) ) {
 557 			user_increment_failed_login_count( $t_user_id );
 558 			return false;
 559 		}
 560 	}
 561 
 562 	return auth_login_user( $t_user_id, $p_perm_login );
 563 }
 564 
 565 /**
 566  * Login the user with the specified id, if enabled.
 567  *
 568  * This is typically used by auth plugins.
 569  *
 570  * @param int $p_user_id     The user id.
 571  * @param bool $p_perm_login Whether to create a long-term cookie.
 572  *
 573  * @return bool true: success; false; otherwise.
 574  * @throws ClientException
 575  */
 576 function auth_login_user( $p_user_id, $p_perm_login = false ) {
 577 	# check for disabled account
 578 	if( !user_is_enabled( $p_user_id ) ) {
 579 		return false;
 580 	}
 581 
 582 	# ok, we're good to login now
 583 	# increment login count
 584 	user_increment_login_count( $p_user_id );
 585 
 586 	user_reset_failed_login_count_to_zero( $p_user_id );
 587 	user_reset_lost_password_in_progress_count_to_zero( $p_user_id );
 588 
 589 	# set the cookies
 590 	auth_set_cookies( $p_user_id, $p_perm_login );
 591 	auth_set_tokens( $p_user_id );
 592 
 593 	return true;
 594 }
 595 
 596 /**
 597  * Impersonates the specified user by logging in.
 598  *
 599  * @param int $p_user_id The user id.
 600  *
 601  * @return void
 602  * @throws ClientException
 603  */
 604 function auth_impersonate( $p_user_id ) {
 605 	auth_ensure_can_impersonate( $p_user_id );
 606 
 607 	auth_set_cookies( $p_user_id );
 608 	auth_set_tokens( $p_user_id );
 609 }

 611 /**
 612  * Check whether the logged in user can impersonate the specified user.
 613  *
 614  * @param int $p_user_id The user id to be impersonated.
 615  *
 616  * @return bool true: can impersonate, false: can't.
 617  * @throws ClientException
 618  */
 619 function auth_can_impersonate( $p_user_id ) {
 620 	if( !access_has_global_level( config_get_global( 'impersonate_user_threshold' ) ) ) {
 621 		return false;
 622 	}
 623 
 624 	# User can't impersonate themselves
 625 	if( $p_user_id == auth_get_current_user_id() ) {
 626 		return false;
 627 	}
 628 
 629 	if( !user_is_enabled( $p_user_id ) ) {
 630 		return false;
 631 	}
 632 
 633 	return true;
 634 }
 635 
 636 /**
 637  * Ensure that the logged in user can impersonate the specified user.
 638  *
 639  * If not, an error page will be generated.
 640  *
 641  * @param int $p_user_id The user id to be impersonated.
 642  *
 643  * @return void.
 644  * @throws ClientException
 645  */
 646 function auth_ensure_can_impersonate( $p_user_id ) {
 647 	if( !auth_can_impersonate( $p_user_id ) ) {
 648 		access_denied();
 649 	}
 650 }
 651 
 652 /**
 653  * Allows scripts to login using a login name or (login name + password).
 654  *
 655  * There are multiple scenarios where this is used:
 656  * - Anonymous login (blank username supplied).
 657  * - Anonymous login with anonymous username specified.
 658  * - Anonymous login with account not existing or disabled.
 659  * - Pre-authenticated user via some secret hash from email verify or rss feed,
 660  *   where username is specified but password is null.
 661  * - Standard authentication with username and password specified.
 662  *
 663  * @param string $p_username Username.
 664  * @param string $p_password Password.
 665  *
 666  * @return bool indicates if authentication was successful
 667  * @throws ClientException
 668  *
 669  * @access public
 670  */
 671 function auth_attempt_script_login( $p_username, $p_password = null ) {
 672 	global $g_script_login_cookie;
 673 
 674 	$t_username = $p_username;
 675 	$t_password = $p_password;
 676 
 677 	$t_anon_allowed = auth_anonymous_enabled();
 678 	if( $t_anon_allowed == ON ) {
 679 		$t_anonymous_account = auth_anonymous_account();
 680 	} else {
 681 		$t_anonymous_account = '';
 682 	}
 683 
 684 	# if no username supplied, then attempt to log in as anonymous user.
 685 	if( is_blank( $t_username ) || ( strcasecmp( $t_username, $t_anonymous_account ) == 0 ) ) {
 686 		if( $t_anon_allowed == OFF ) {
 687 			return false;
 688 		}
 689 
 690 		$t_username = $t_anonymous_account;
 691 
 692 		# do not use password validation.
 693 		$t_password = null;
 694 	}
 695 
 696 	$t_user_id = auth_get_user_id_from_login_name( $t_username );
 697 	if( $t_user_id === false ) {
 698 		$t_user_id = auth_auto_create_user( $t_username, $p_password );
 699 		if( $t_user_id === false ) {
 700 			return false;
 701 		}
 702 	}
 703 
 704 	$t_user = user_get_row( $t_user_id );
 705 
 706 	# check for disabled account
 707 	if( OFF == $t_user['enabled'] ) {
 708 		return false;
 709 	}
 710 
 711 	# validate password if supplied
 712 	if( null !== $t_password ) {
 713 		if( !auth_does_password_match( $t_user_id, $t_password ) ) {
 714 			return false;
 715 		}
 716 	}
 717 
 718 	# ok, we're good to login now
 719 	# With cases like RSS feeds and MantisConnect there is a login per operation, hence, there is no
 720 	# real significance of incrementing login count.
 721 	# increment login count
 722 	# user_increment_login_count( $t_user_id );
 723 	# set the cookies
 724 	$g_script_login_cookie = $t_user['cookie_string'];
 725 
 726 	# cache user id for future reference
 727 	current_user_set( $t_user_id );
 728 
 729 	return true;
 730 }
 731 
 732 /**
 733  * Logout the current user and remove any remaining cookies from their browser.
 734  *
 735  * @return void
 736  * @throws ClientException
 737  * @throws Exception
 738  *
 739  * @access public
 740  */
 741 function auth_logout() {
 742 	global $g_cache_current_user_id, $g_cache_cookie_valid;
 743 
 744 	if( !user_is_protected( $g_cache_current_user_id ) ) {
 745 		# Reset the user's cookie string
 746 		user_set_field(
 747 			$g_cache_current_user_id,
 748 			'cookie_string',
 749 			auth_generate_unique_cookie_string()
 750 		);
 751 	}
 752 
 753 	# clear cached userid
 754 	user_clear_cache( $g_cache_current_user_id );
 755 	current_user_set( NO_USER );
 756 	$g_cache_cookie_valid = null;
 757 
 758 	# clear cookies, if they were set
 759 	if( auth_clear_cookies() ) {
 760 		helper_clear_pref_cookies();
 761 	}
 762 
 763 	if( HTTP_AUTH == config_get_global( 'login_method' ) ) {
 764 		auth_http_set_logout_pending( true );
 765 	}
 766 
 767 	session_clean();
 768 }

 781 /**
 782  * Return the user's password maximum length for the current login method.
 783  *
 784  * @return int
 785  *
 786  * @access public
 787  */
 788 function auth_get_password_max_size() {
 789 	switch( config_get_global( 'login_method' ) ) {
 790 		# Max password size cannot be bigger than the database field
 791 		case PLAIN:
 792 		case BASIC_AUTH:
 793 		case HTTP_AUTH:
 794 			return DB_FIELD_SIZE_PASSWORD;
 795 
 796 		# All other cases, i.e. password is stored as a hash
 797 		default:
 798 			return PASSWORD_MAX_SIZE_BEFORE_HASH;
 799 	}
 800 }

 802 /**
 803  * Return true if the password for the user id given matches the given password.
 804  *
 805  * Takes the global login method into account.
 806  *
 807  * @param int    $p_user_id       User id to check password against.
 808  * @param string $p_test_password Password.
 809  *
 810  * @return bool indicating whether password matches given the user id
 811  * @throws ClientException
 812  *
 813  * @access public
 814  */
 815 function auth_does_password_match( $p_user_id, $p_test_password ) {
 816 	$t_configured_login_method = config_get_global( 'login_method' );
 817 
 818 	if( LDAP == $t_configured_login_method ) {
 819 		return ldap_authenticate( $p_user_id, $p_test_password );
 820 	}
 821 
 822 	if( !auth_can_use_standard_login( $p_user_id ) ) {
 823 		return false;
 824 	}
 825 
 826 	$t_password = user_get_field( $p_user_id, 'password' );
 827 	$t_login_methods = array(
 828 		MD5,
 829 		CRYPT,
 830 		PLAIN,
 831 		BASIC_AUTH,
 832 	);
 833 
 834 	foreach( $t_login_methods as $t_login_method ) {
 835 		# pass the stored password in as the salt
 836 		if( auth_process_plain_password( $p_test_password, $t_password, $t_login_method ) === $t_password ) {
 837 			# Do not support migration to PLAIN, since this would be a crazy thing to do.
 838 			# Also if we do, then a user will be able to login by providing the MD5 value
 839 			# that is copied from the database.  See #8467 for more details.
 840 			if( ( $t_configured_login_method != PLAIN && $t_login_method == PLAIN ) ||
 841 				( $t_configured_login_method != BASIC_AUTH && $t_login_method == BASIC_AUTH ) ) {
 842 				continue;
 843 			}
 844 
 845 			# Check for migration to another login method and test whether the password was encrypted
 846 			# with our previously insecure implementation of the CRYPT method
 847 			if( $t_login_method != $t_configured_login_method
 848 				|| ( CRYPT == $t_configured_login_method
 849 					&& mb_substr( $t_password, 0, 2 ) == mb_substr( $p_test_password, 0, 2 )
 850 				) 
 851 			) {
 852 				user_set_password( $p_user_id, $p_test_password, true );
 853 			}
 854 
 855 			return true;
 856 		}
 857 	}
 858 
 859 	return false;
 860 }
 861 
 862 /**
 863  * Encrypt and return the plain password given, as appropriate for the current
 864  * global login method.
 865  *
 866  * When generating a new password, no salt should be passed in.
 867  * When encrypting a password to compare to a stored password, the stored
 868  * password should be passed in as salt.  If the authentication method is CRYPT
 869  * then crypt() will extract the appropriate portion of the stored password as
 870  * its salt.
 871  *
 872  * @param string $p_password Password.
 873  * @param string $p_salt     Salt, defaults to null.
 874  * @param string $p_method   Logon method, defaults to null (use configuration login method).
 875  *
 876  * @return string processed password, maximum DB_FIELD_SIZE_PASSWORD chars in length
 877  *
 878  * @access public
 879  */
 880 function auth_process_plain_password( $p_password, $p_salt = null, $p_method = null ) {
 881 	$t_login_method = config_get_global( 'login_method' );
 882 	if( $p_method !== null ) {
 883 		$t_login_method = $p_method;
 884 	}
 885 
 886 	switch( $t_login_method ) {
 887 		case CRYPT:
 888 
 889 			# a null salt is the same as no salt, which causes a salt to be generated
 890 			# otherwise, use the salt given
 891 			$t_processed_password = crypt( $p_password, $p_salt );
 892 			break;
 893 		case MD5:
 894 			$t_processed_password = md5( $p_password );
 895 			break;
 896 		case BASIC_AUTH:
 897 		case PLAIN:
 898 		default:
 899 			$t_processed_password = $p_password;
 900 			break;
 901 	}
 902 
 903 	# cut this off to DB_FIELD_SIZE_PASSWORD characters which the largest possible string in the database
 904 	return mb_substr( $t_processed_password, 0, DB_FIELD_SIZE_PASSWORD );
 905 }
 906 
 907 /**
 908  * Generate a random 16 character password.
 909  *
 910  * @todo create memorable passwords?
 911  *
 912  * @return string 16 character random password
 913  * @throws Exception
 914  *
 915  * @access public
 916  */
 917 function auth_generate_random_password() {
 918 	return crypto_generate_uri_safe_nonce( 16 );
 919 }
 920 
 921 /**
 922  * Generate a confirmation code to validate password reset requests.
 923  *
 924  * @param int $p_user_id User ID to generate a confirmation code for.
 925  *
 926  * @return string Confirmation code (384bit) encoded according to the base64
 927  *                with URI safe alphabet approach described in RFC4648
 928  * @throws ClientException
 929  *
 930  * @access public
 931  */
 932 function auth_generate_confirm_hash( $p_user_id ) {
 933 	$t_password = user_get_field( $p_user_id, 'password' );
 934 	$t_last_visit = user_get_field( $p_user_id, 'last_visit' );
 935 
 936 	$t_confirm_hash_raw = hash( 'whirlpool', 'confirm_hash' . config_get_global( 'crypto_master_salt' ) . $t_password . $t_last_visit, true );
 937 	# Note: We truncate the last 8 bits from the hash output so that base64
 938 	# encoding can be performed without any trailing padding.
 939 	$t_confirm_hash_base64_encoded = base64_encode( substr( $t_confirm_hash_raw, 0, 63 ) );
 940 
 941 	return strtr( $t_confirm_hash_base64_encoded, '+/', '-_' );
 942 }

 944 /**
 945  * Set login cookies for the user.
 946  *
 947  * If $p_perm_login is true, a long-term cookie is created.
 948  *
 949  * @param int  $p_user_id    A user identifier.
 950  * @param bool $p_perm_login Indicates whether to generate a long-term cookie.
 951  *
 952  * @return void
 953  * @throws ClientException
 954  * @access public
 955  */
 956 function auth_set_cookies( $p_user_id, $p_perm_login = false ) {
 957 	$t_cookie_string = user_get_field( $p_user_id, 'cookie_string' );
 958 	$t_cookie_name = config_get_global( 'string_cookie' );
 959 	gpc_set_cookie( $t_cookie_name, $t_cookie_string, auth_session_expiry( $p_user_id, $p_perm_login ) );
 960 }

 962 /**
 963  * Clear login cookies, return true if they were cleared.
 964  *
 965  * @return bool indicating whether cookies were cleared
 966  *
 967  * @access public
 968  */
 969 function auth_clear_cookies() {
 970 	global $g_script_login_cookie, $g_cache_cookie_valid;
 971 
 972 	$t_cookies_cleared = false;
 973 	$g_cache_cookie_valid = null;
 974 
 975 	# clear cookie, if not logged in from script
 976 	if( $g_script_login_cookie == null ) {
 977 		$t_cookie_name = config_get_global( 'string_cookie' );
 978 		$t_cookie_path = config_get_global( 'cookie_path' );
 979 
 980 		gpc_clear_cookie( $t_cookie_name, $t_cookie_path );
 981 		$t_cookies_cleared = true;
 982 	} else {
 983 		$g_script_login_cookie = null;
 984 	}
 985 	return $t_cookies_cleared;
 986 }
 987 
 988 /**
 989  * Generate a unique random identifier for the login cookie.
 990  *
 991  * The generated string is base64-encoded with the URI-safe alphabet
 992  * approach described in RFC4648.
 993  *
 994  * @return string Random and unique 384bit cookie string.
 995  * @throws Exception (with PHP >= 8.2, actually \Random\RandomException)
 996  *
 997  * @access public
 998  */
 999 function auth_generate_unique_cookie_string() {
1000 	do {
1001 		$t_cookie_string = crypto_generate_uri_safe_nonce( 64 );
1002 	} while( !auth_is_cookie_string_unique( $t_cookie_string ) );
1003 
1004 	return $t_cookie_string;
1005 }
1006 
1007 /**
1008  * Determine whether a cookie string is unique.
1009  *
1010  * @param string $p_cookie_string Cookie string.
1011  *
1012  * @return bool True if the cookie string is unique, false otherwise.
1013  * @access public
1014  *
1015  * @throws ClientException
1016  */
1017 function auth_is_cookie_string_unique( $p_cookie_string ) {
1018 	return false === user_get_id_by_cookie( $p_cookie_string );
1019 }
1020 
1021 /**
1022  * Return the current user's login cookie string.
1023  *
1024  * Note that the cookie cached by a script login supersedes the cookie provided
1025  * by the browser. This shouldn't normally matter, except that the password
1026  * verification uses this routine to bypass the normal authentication, and can
1027  * get confused when a normal user logs in, then runs the verify script.
1028  * The act of fetching config variables may get the wrong userid.
1029  * If no user is logged in and anonymous login is enabled, returns cookie for
1030  * anonymous user, otherwise returns '' (an empty string)
1031  *
1032  * @param bool $p_login_anonymous Auto-login anonymous user.
1033  *
1034  * @return string current user login cookie string
1035  * @throws ClientException
1036  * @access public
1037  */
1038 function auth_get_current_user_cookie( $p_login_anonymous = true ) {
1039 	global $g_script_login_cookie, $g_cache_anonymous_user_cookie_string;
1040 
1041 	# if logging in via a script, return that cookie
1042 	if( $g_script_login_cookie !== null ) {
1043 		return $g_script_login_cookie;
1044 	}
1045 
1046 	# fetch user cookie
1047 	$t_cookie_name = config_get_global( 'string_cookie' );
1048 	$t_cookie = gpc_get_cookie( $t_cookie_name, '' );
1049 
1050 	# if cookie not found, and anonymous login enabled, use cookie of anonymous account.
1051 	if( is_blank( $t_cookie ) ) {
1052 		if( $p_login_anonymous && auth_anonymous_enabled() ) {
1053 			if( $g_cache_anonymous_user_cookie_string === null ) {
1054 				if( function_exists( 'db_is_connected' ) && db_is_connected() ) {
1055 					# get anonymous information if database is available
1056 					$t_row = user_get_row_by_name( auth_anonymous_account() );
1057 					if( $t_row ) {
1058 						$t_cookie = $t_row['cookie_string'];
1059 						$g_cache_anonymous_user_cookie_string = $t_cookie;
1060 						current_user_set( $t_row['id'] );
1061 					}
1062 				}
1063 			} else {
1064 				$t_cookie = $g_cache_anonymous_user_cookie_string;
1065 			}
1066 		}
1067 	}
1068 
1069 	return $t_cookie;
1070 }
1071 
1072 /**
1073  * Set authentication tokens for secure session.
1074  * @param integer $p_user_id User identifier.
1075  * @access public
1076  * @return void
1077  * @throws ClientException
1078  */
1079 function auth_set_tokens( $p_user_id ) {
1080 	$t_auth_token = token_get( TOKEN_AUTHENTICATED, $p_user_id );
1081 	if( null == $t_auth_token ) {
1082 		token_set( TOKEN_AUTHENTICATED, true, auth_reauthentication_expiry(), $p_user_id );
1083 	} else {
1084 		token_touch( $t_auth_token['id'], auth_reauthentication_expiry() );
1085 	}
1086 }
1087 
1088 /**
1089  * Checks if reauthentication is enabled.
1090  * @return bool true: enabled; false: otherwise.
1091  * @throws ClientException
1092  */
1093 function auth_reauthentication_enabled() {
1094 	$t_auth_flags = auth_flags();
1095 	return $t_auth_flags->getReauthenticationEnabled();
1096 }
1097 
1098 /**
1099  * Gets the reauthentication timeout/expiry.
1100  * @return integer The re-authentication expiry in seconds.
1101  * @throws ClientException
1102  */
1103 function auth_reauthentication_expiry() {
1104 	$t_auth_flags = auth_flags();
1105 	return $t_auth_flags->getReauthenticationLifetime();
1106 }
1107 
1108 /**
1109  * Check for authentication tokens, and redirect to login page for
1110  * re-authentication. Currently, if using BASIC or HTTP authentication methods,
1111  * or if logged in anonymously, this function will always "authenticate" the
1112  * user (do nothing).
1113  *
1114  * @return boolean
1115  * @access public
1116  * @throws ClientException
1117  */
1118 function auth_reauthenticate() {
1119 	$t_login_method = config_get_global( 'login_method' );
1120 	if( !auth_reauthentication_enabled() || BASIC_AUTH == $t_login_method || HTTP_AUTH == $t_login_method ) {
1121 		return true;
1122 	}
1123 
1124 	$t_auth_token = token_get( TOKEN_AUTHENTICATED );
1125 	if( null != $t_auth_token ) {
1126 		token_touch( $t_auth_token['id'], auth_reauthentication_expiry() );
1127 		return true;
1128 	} else {
1129 		$t_anon_account = auth_anonymous_account();
1130 		$t_anon_allowed = auth_anonymous_enabled();
1131 
1132 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1133 		$t_username = user_get_username( $t_user_id );
1134 
1135 		# check for anonymous login
1136 		if( ON == $t_anon_allowed && $t_anon_account == $t_username ) {
1137 			return true;
1138 		}
1139 
1140 		$t_query_params = [
1141 			'reauthenticate' => 1,
1142 			'username' => $t_username,
1143 			'return' => $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'],
1144 		];
1145 
1146 		# redirect to login page
1147 		return print_header_redirect( auth_credential_page( $t_query_params ) );
1148 	}
1149 }
1150 
1151 /**
1152  * Determines if the cookie string is valid.
1153  *
1154  * @param string $p_cookie_string Cookie string.
1155  * @return bool True if valid, false otherwise.
1156  * @access public
1157  *
1158  * @throws ClientException
1159  */
1160 function auth_is_cookie_valid( $p_cookie_string ) {
1161 	global $g_cache_current_user_id;
1162 
1163 	# fail if DB isn't accessible
1164 	if( !db_is_connected() ) {
1165 		return false;
1166 	}
1167 
1168 	# fail if cookie is blank
1169 	if( '' === $p_cookie_string ) {
1170 		return false;
1171 	}
1172 
1173 	# succeed if user has already been authenticated
1174 	if( NO_USER != $g_cache_current_user_id ) {
1175 		return true;
1176 	}
1177 
1178 	if( user_search_cache( 'cookie_string', $p_cookie_string ) ) {
1179 		return true;
1180 	}
1181 
1182 	# look up cookie in the database to see if it is valid
1183 	return false !== user_get_id_by_cookie( $p_cookie_string );
1184 }
1185 
1186 /**
1187  * Retrieve current user's Id.
1188  *
1189  * @return int user id
1190  * @throws ClientException
1191  * @access public
1192  */
1193 function auth_get_current_user_id() {
1194 	global $g_cache_current_user_id;
1195 
1196 	if( NO_USER != $g_cache_current_user_id ) {
1197 		return $g_cache_current_user_id;
1198 	}
1199 
1200 	$t_cookie_string = auth_get_current_user_cookie();
1201 
1202 	if( $t_result = user_search_cache( 'cookie_string', $t_cookie_string ) ) {
1203 		$t_user_id = (int)$t_result['id'];
1204 		current_user_set( $t_user_id );
1205 		return $t_user_id;
1206 	}
1207 
1208 	# TODO: error with an error saying they aren't logged in? Or redirect to the login page maybe?
1209 	/** @noinspection PhpUnhandledExceptionInspection */
1210 	$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_cookie( $t_cookie_string );
1211 
1212 	# The cookie was invalid. Clear the cookie (to allow people to log in again)
1213 	# and give them an Access Denied message.
1214 	if( $t_user_id === false ) {
1215 		auth_clear_cookies();
1216 		access_denied();
1217 		exit();
1218 	}
1219 
1220 	current_user_set( $t_user_id );
1221 
1222 	return $t_user_id;
1223 }
1224 
1225 /**
1226  * A method that looks up a user id given their cookie.
1227  *
1228  * @param string $p_cookie_string The cookie string to lookup
1229  * @return bool|int The user id or false if no user match found.
1230  * @access public
1231  *
1232  * @throws ClientException
1233  */
1234 function auth_user_id_from_cookie( $p_cookie_string ) {
1235 	return user_get_id_by_cookie( $p_cookie_string );
1236 }

1238 /**
1239  * Generate HTTP 401 Access Denied header and page for user,
1240  * prompting for BASIC authentication.
1241  *
1242  * @return void
1243  *
1244  * @access public
1245  */
1246 function auth_http_prompt() {
1247 	header( 'HTTP/1.0 401 Authorization Required' );
1248 	header( 'WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="' . lang_get( 'http_auth_realm' ) . '"' );
1249 	header( 'status: 401 Unauthorized' );
1250 
1251 	echo '<p class="center error-msg">' . error_string( ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED ) . '</p>';
1252 	print_link_button( 'main_page.php', lang_get( 'proceed' ) );
1253 
1254 	exit;
1255 }

1257 /**
1258  * Update Cookies to reflect pending logout.
1259  *
1260  * @param boolean $p_pending Whether pending.
1261  *
1262  * @return void
1263  *
1264  * @access public
1265  */
1266 function auth_http_set_logout_pending( $p_pending ) {
1267 	$t_cookie_name = config_get_global( 'logout_cookie' );
1268 
1269 	if( $p_pending ) {
1270 		gpc_set_cookie( $t_cookie_name, '1' );
1271 	} else {
1272 		$t_cookie_path = config_get_global( 'cookie_path' );
1273 		gpc_clear_cookie( $t_cookie_name, $t_cookie_path );
1274 	}
1275 }
1276 
1277 /**
1278  * Check cookie values to see if Logout is pending
1279  *
1280  * @return boolean
1281  * @access public
1282  */
1283 function auth_http_is_logout_pending() {
1284 	$t_cookie_name = config_get_global( 'logout_cookie' );
1285 	$t_cookie = gpc_get_cookie( $t_cookie_name, '' );
1286 
1287 	return( $t_cookie > '' );
1288 }

  81 /**
  82  * Bug Data Structure Definition
  83  *
  84  * @property int $id
  85  * @property int $project_id
  86  * @property int $reporter_id
  87  * @property int $handler_id
  88  * @property int $duplicate_id
  89  * @property int $priority
  90  * @property int $severity
  91  * @property int $reproducibility
  92  * @property int $status
  93  * @property int $resolution
  94  * @property int $projection
  95  * @property int $category_id
  96  * @property int $date_submitted
  97  * @property int $last_updated
  98  * @property int $eta
  99  * @property string $os
 100  * @property string $os_build
 101  * @property string $platform
 102  * @property string $version
 103  * @property string $fixed_in_version
 104  * @property string $target_version
 105  * @property string $build
 106  * @property int $view_state
 107  * @property string $summary
 108  * @property float $sponsorship_total
 109  * @property int $sticky
 110  * @property int $due_date
 111  * @property int $profile_id
 112  * @property int $bug_text_id
 113  * @property string $description
 114  * @property string $steps_to_reproduce
 115  * @property string $additional_information
 116  */
 117 #[AllowDynamicProperties]
 118 class BugData {
 119 	/**
 120 	 * Bug ID
 121 	 */
 122 	protected $id;
 123 
 124 	/**
 125 	 * Project ID
 126 	 */
 127 	protected $project_id = null;
 128 
 129 	/**
 130 	 * Reporter ID
 131 	 */
 132 	protected $reporter_id = 0;
 133 
 134 	/**
 135 	 * Bug Handler ID
 136 	 */
 137 	protected $handler_id = 0;
 138 
 139 	/**
 140 	 * Duplicate ID
 141 	 */
 142 	protected $duplicate_id = 0;
 143 
 144 	/**
 145 	 * Priority
 146 	 */
 147 	protected $priority = NORMAL;
 148 
 149 	/**
 150 	 * Severity
 151 	 */
 152 	protected $severity = MINOR;

 323 	/**
 324 	 * Overloaded Function handling property sets
 325 	 *
 326 	 * @param string $p_name  Property name.
 327 	 * @param string $p_value Value to set.
 328 	 *
 329 	 * @throws ClientException If due_date is not valid
 330 	 */
 331 	public function __set( $p_name, $p_value ) {
 332 		switch( $p_name ) {
 333 			# integer types
 334 			case 'id':
 335 			case 'project_id':
 336 			case 'reporter_id':
 337 			case 'handler_id':
 338 			case 'duplicate_id':
 339 			case 'priority':
 340 			case 'severity':
 341 			case 'reproducibility':
 342 			case 'status':
 343 			case 'resolution':
 344 			case 'eta':
 345 			case 'projection':
 346 			case 'category_id':
 347 			case 'bug_text_id':
 348 				$p_value = (int)$p_value;
 349 				break;
 350 			case 'target_version':
 351 				if( !$this->loading && $this->$p_name != $p_value ) {
 352 					# Only set target_version if user has access to do so
 353 					if( !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'roadmap_update_threshold' ) ) ) {
 354 						trigger_error( ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, ERROR );
 355 					}
 356 				}
 357 				break;
 358 			case 'due_date':
 359 				if( !is_numeric( $p_value ) ) {
 360 					$p_value = date_strtotime( $p_value );
 361 				}
 362 				break;
 363 			/** @noinspection PhpMissingBreakStatementInspection */
 364 			case 'summary':
 365 				# MySQL 4-bytes UTF-8 chars workaround #21101
 366 				$p_value = db_mysql_fix_utf8( $p_value );
 367 				# Fall through
 368 			case 'build':
 369 				if ( !$this->loading ) {
 370 					$p_value = trim( $p_value );
 371 				}
 372 				break;
 373 			case 'description':
 374 			case 'steps_to_reproduce':
 375 			case 'additional_information':
 376 				# MySQL 4-bytes UTF-8 chars workaround #21101
 377 				$p_value = db_mysql_fix_utf8( $p_value );
 378 				break;
 379 
 380 		}
 381 		$this->$p_name = $p_value;
 382 	}
 383 
 384 	/**
 385 	 * Overloaded Function handling property get
 386 	 *
 387 	 * @param string $p_name Property name.
 388 	 *
 389 	 * @return string|int|bool
 390 	 */
 391 	public function __get( $p_name ) {
 392 		if( $this->is_extended_field( $p_name ) ) {
 393 			$this->fetch_extended_info();
 394 		}
 395 		return $this->{$p_name};
 396 	}

 398 	/**
 399 	 * Overloaded Function handling property isset
 400 	 *
 401 	 * @param string $p_name Property name.
 402 	 *
 403 	 * @return bool
 404 	 */
 405 	public function __isset( $p_name ) {
 406 		return isset( $this->{$p_name} );
 407 	}

 409 	/**
 410 	 * Fast-load database row into the object.
 411 	 *
 412 	 * @param array $p_row Database result to load into a bug object.
 413 	 *
 414 	 * @throws ClientException If due_date is not valid
 415 	 */
 416 	public function loadrow( array $p_row ) {
 417 		$this->loading = true;
 418 
 419 		foreach( $p_row as $t_var => $t_val ) {
 420 			$this->__set( $t_var, $t_val );
 421 		}
 422 		$this->loading = false;
 423 	}

 425 	/**
 426 	 * Retrieves extended information for bug (e.g. bug description).
 427 	 *
 428 	 * @noinspection PhpDocMissingThrowsInspection
 429 	 */
 430 	private function fetch_extended_info() {
 431 		if( $this->description == '' ) {
 432 			/** @noinspection PhpUnhandledExceptionInspection */
 433 			$t_text = bug_text_cache_row( $this->id );
 434 
 435 			$this->description = $t_text['description'];
 436 			$this->steps_to_reproduce = $t_text['steps_to_reproduce'];
 437 			$this->additional_information = $t_text['additional_information'];
 438 		}
 439 	}

 441 	/**
 442 	 * Returns if the field is an extended field which needs fetch_extended_info()
 443 	 *
 444 	 * @param string $p_field_name Field Name.
 445 	 *
 446 	 * @return bool
 447 	 */
 448 	private function is_extended_field( $p_field_name ) {
 449 		switch( $p_field_name ) {
 450 			case 'description':
 451 			case 'steps_to_reproduce':
 452 			case 'additional_information':
 453 				return true;
 454 			default:
 455 				return false;
 456 		}
 457 	}

 459 	/**
 460 	 * Returns the number of bugnotes for the given bug_id.
 461 	 *
 462 	 * @return int Number of bugnotes
 463 	 */
 464 	private function bug_get_bugnote_count() {
 465 		if( !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'private_bugnote_threshold' ), $this->project_id ) ) {
 466 			$t_restriction = 'AND view_state=' . VS_PUBLIC;
 467 		} else {
 468 			$t_restriction = '';
 469 		}
 470 
 471 		db_param_push();
 472 		$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {bugnote}
 473 					  WHERE bug_id =' . db_param() . ' ' . $t_restriction;
 474 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $this->id ) );
 475 
 476 		return db_result( $t_result );
 477 	}

 479 	/**
 480 	 * Validate the bug object.
 481 	 *
 482 	 * Use before database insert/update. Triggers error on failure
 483 	 *
 484 	 * @param bool $p_update_extended Whether to validate extended fields.
 485 	 */
 486 	public function validate( $p_update_extended = true ) {
 487 		# Summary cannot be blank
 488 		if( is_blank( $this->summary ) ) {
 489 			error_parameters( lang_get( 'summary' ) );
 490 			trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 491 		}
 492 
 493 		if( $p_update_extended ) {
 494 			# Description field cannot be empty
 495 			if( is_blank( $this->description ) ) {
 496 				error_parameters( lang_get( 'description' ) );
 497 				trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 498 			}
 499 
 500 			helper_ensure_longtext_length_valid( $this->description, 'description' );
 501 			helper_ensure_longtext_length_valid( $this->steps_to_reproduce, 'steps_to_reproduce' );
 502 			helper_ensure_longtext_length_valid( $this->additional_information, 'additional_information' );
 503 		}
 504 
 505 		# Make sure a category is set
 506 		if( 0 == $this->category_id && !config_get( 'allow_no_category' ) ) {
 507 			error_parameters( lang_get( 'category' ) );
 508 			trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 509 		}
 510 
 511 		# Ensure that category id is a valid category
 512 		if( $this->category_id > 0 ) {
 513 			category_ensure_exists( $this->category_id );
 514 		}
 515 
 516 		if( !is_blank( $this->duplicate_id ) && ( $this->duplicate_id != 0 ) && ( $this->id == $this->duplicate_id ) ) {
 517 			trigger_error( ERROR_BUG_DUPLICATE_SELF, ERROR );
 518 			# never returns
 519 		}
 520 	}

 522 	/**
 523 	 * Insert a new bug into the database.
 524 	 *
 525 	 * @return int Identifier of the bug that was created
 526 	 * @throws ClientException If user submitting is a known spammer.
 527 	 */
 528 	public function create() {
 529 		$this->validate();
 530 
 531 		antispam_check();
 532 
 533 		# check due_date format
 534 		if( is_blank( $this->due_date ) ) {
 535 			$this->due_date = date_get_null();
 536 		}
 537 		# check date submitted and last modified
 538 		if( is_blank( $this->date_submitted ) ) {
 539 			$this->date_submitted = db_now();
 540 		}
 541 		if( is_blank( $this->last_updated ) ) {
 542 			$this->last_updated = db_now();
 543 		}
 544 
 545 		# Insert text information
 546 		db_param_push();
 547 		$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_text}
 548 					    ( description, steps_to_reproduce, additional_information )
 549 					  VALUES
 550 					    ( ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 551 		db_query( $t_query, array( $this->description, $this->steps_to_reproduce, $this->additional_information ) );
 552 
 553 		# Get the id of the text information we just inserted
 554 		# NOTE: this is guaranteed to be the correct one.
 555 		# The value LAST_INSERT_ID is stored on a per-connection basis.
 556 
 557 		$t_text_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'bug_text' ) );
 558 
 559 		# check to see if we want to assign this right off
 560 		$t_original_status = $this->status;
 561 
 562 		# if not assigned, check if it should auto-assigned.
 563 		if( 0 == $this->handler_id ) {
 564 			# If a default user is associated with the category and we know that
 565 			# the bug was not assigned to somebody, then assign it automatically.
 566 			db_param_push();
 567 			$t_query = 'SELECT user_id FROM {category} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 568 			$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $this->category_id ) );
 569 			$t_handler = db_result( $t_result );
 570 
 571 			if( $t_handler !== false && user_exists( $t_handler ) ) {
 572 				$this->handler_id = $t_handler;
 573 			}
 574 		}
 575 
 576 		# Check if bug was pre-assigned or auto-assigned.
 577 		$t_status = bug_get_status_for_assign( NO_USER, $this->handler_id, $this->status);
 578 
 579 		# Insert the rest of the data
 580 		db_param_push();
 581 		$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug}
 582 					    ( project_id,reporter_id, handler_id,duplicate_id,
 583 					      priority,severity, reproducibility,status,
 584 					      resolution,projection, category_id,date_submitted,
 585 					      last_updated,eta, bug_text_id,
 586 					      os, os_build,platform, version,build,
 587 					      profile_id, summary, view_state, sponsorship_total, sticky, fixed_in_version,
 588 					      target_version, due_date
 589 					    )
 590 					  VALUES
 591 					    ( ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
 592 					      ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
 593 					      ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
 594 					      ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
 595 					      ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
 596 					      ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
 597 					      ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 598 		db_query( $t_query, array( $this->project_id, $this->reporter_id, $this->handler_id, $this->duplicate_id, $this->priority, $this->severity, $this->reproducibility, $t_status, $this->resolution, $this->projection, $this->category_id, $this->date_submitted, $this->last_updated, $this->eta, $t_text_id, $this->os, $this->os_build, $this->platform, $this->version, $this->build, $this->profile_id, $this->summary, $this->view_state, $this->sponsorship_total, $this->sticky, $this->fixed_in_version, $this->target_version, $this->due_date ) );
 599 
 600 		$this->id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'bug' ) );
 601 
 602 		# log new bug
 603 		history_log_event_special( $this->id, NEW_BUG );
 604 
 605 		# log changes, if any (compare happens in history_log_event_direct)
 606 		history_log_event_direct( $this->id, 'status', $t_original_status, $t_status );
 607 		history_log_event_direct( $this->id, 'handler_id', 0, $this->handler_id );
 608 
 609 		return $this->id;
 610 	}

 612 	/**
 613 	 * Process mentions in the current issue.
 614 	 *
 615 	 * For example, after the issue is created.
 616 	 */
 617 	public function process_mentions() {
 618 		# Now that the issue is added process the @ mentions
 619 		$t_all_mentioned_user_ids = array();
 620 
 621 		$t_mentioned_user_ids = mention_get_users( $this->summary );
 622 		$t_all_mentioned_user_ids = array_merge( $t_all_mentioned_user_ids, $t_mentioned_user_ids );
 623 		
 624 		$t_mentioned_user_ids = mention_get_users( $this->description );
 625 		$t_all_mentioned_user_ids = array_merge( $t_all_mentioned_user_ids, $t_mentioned_user_ids );
 626 
 627 		if( !is_blank( $this->steps_to_reproduce ) ) {
 628 			$t_mentioned_user_ids = mention_get_users( $this->steps_to_reproduce );
 629 			$t_all_mentioned_user_ids = array_merge( $t_all_mentioned_user_ids, $t_mentioned_user_ids );
 630 		}
 631 
 632 		if( !is_blank( $this->additional_information ) ) {
 633 			$t_mentioned_user_ids = mention_get_users( $this->additional_information );
 634 			$t_all_mentioned_user_ids = array_merge( $t_all_mentioned_user_ids, $t_mentioned_user_ids );
 635 		}
 636 
 637 		$t_filtered_mentioned_user_ids = access_has_bug_level_filter(
 638 			config_get( 'view_bug_threshold' ),
 639 			$this->id,
 640 			$t_all_mentioned_user_ids );
 641 
 642 		$t_removed_mentions_user_ids = array_diff( $t_all_mentioned_user_ids, $t_filtered_mentioned_user_ids );
 643 
 644 		if( !empty( $t_all_mentioned_user_ids ) ) {
 645 			$t_mention_text = $this->description . "\n\n";
 646 
 647 			if( !is_blank( $this->steps_to_reproduce ) ) {
 648 				$t_mention_text .= lang_get( 'email_steps_to_reproduce' ) . "\n\n";
 649 				$t_mention_text .= $this->steps_to_reproduce . "\n\n";
 650 			}
 651 
 652 			if( !is_blank( $this->additional_information ) ) {
 653 				$t_mention_text .= lang_get( 'email_additional_information' ) . "\n\n";
 654 				$t_mention_text .= $this->additional_information . "\n\n";
 655 			}
 656 
 657 			mention_process_user_mentions(
 658 				$this->id,
 659 				$t_filtered_mentioned_user_ids,
 660 				$t_mention_text,
 661 				$t_removed_mentions_user_ids );
 662 		}
 663 	}

 665 	/**
 666 	 * Update a bug from the given data structure.
 667 	 *
 668 	 * Throws errors if the bug's data is not valid.
 669 	 * If the third parameter is true, also update the longer strings table.
 670 	 *
 671 	 * @param bool $p_update_extended Whether to update extended fields.
 672 	 * @param bool $p_bypass_mail     Whether to bypass sending email notifications.
 673 	 *
 674 	 * @return true
 675 	 * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
 676 	 */
 677 	public function update( $p_update_extended = false, $p_bypass_mail = false ) {
 678 		self::validate( $p_update_extended );
 679 
 680 		$c_bug_id = $this->id;
 681 
 682 		if( is_blank( $this->due_date ) ) {
 683 			$this->due_date = date_get_null();
 684 		}
 685 
 686 		$t_old_data = bug_get( $this->id, true );
 687 
 688 		# Update all fields
 689 		# Ignore date_submitted and last_updated, since they are pulled out as Unix
 690 		# timestamps which could confuse the history log. They shouldn't get updated
 691 		# like this anyway; if you really need to change them use bug_set_field().
 692 		db_param_push();
 693 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug}
 694 					SET project_id=' . db_param() . ', reporter_id=' . db_param() . ',
 695 						handler_id=' . db_param() . ', duplicate_id=' . db_param() . ',
 696 						priority=' . db_param() . ', severity=' . db_param() . ',
 697 						reproducibility=' . db_param() . ', status=' . db_param() . ',
 698 						resolution=' . db_param() . ', projection=' . db_param() . ',
 699 						category_id=' . db_param() . ', eta=' . db_param() . ',
 700 						os=' . db_param() . ', os_build=' . db_param() . ',
 701 						platform=' . db_param() . ', version=' . db_param() . ',
 702 						build=' . db_param() . ', fixed_in_version=' . db_param() . ',';
 703 
 704 		$t_fields = array(
 705 			$this->project_id, $this->reporter_id,
 706 			$this->handler_id, $this->duplicate_id,
 707 			$this->priority, $this->severity,
 708 			$this->reproducibility, $this->status,
 709 			$this->resolution, $this->projection,
 710 			$this->category_id, $this->eta,
 711 			$this->os, $this->os_build,
 712 			$this->platform, $this->version,
 713 			$this->build, $this->fixed_in_version,
 714 		);
 715 		$t_roadmap_updated = false;
 716 		if( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'roadmap_update_threshold' ) ) ) {
 717 			$t_query .= '
 718 						target_version=' . db_param() . ',';
 719 			$t_fields[] = $this->target_version;
 720 			$t_roadmap_updated = true;
 721 		}
 722 
 723 		$t_query .= '
 724 						view_state=' . db_param() . ',
 725 						summary=' . db_param() . ',
 726 						sponsorship_total=' . db_param() . ',
 727 						sticky=' . db_param() . ',
 728 						due_date=' . db_param() . '
 729 					WHERE id=' . db_param();
 730 		$t_fields[] = $this->view_state;
 731 		$t_fields[] = $this->summary;
 732 		$t_fields[] = $this->sponsorship_total;
 733 		$t_fields[] = (bool)$this->sticky;
 734 		$t_fields[] = $this->due_date;
 735 		$t_fields[] = $this->id;
 736 
 737 		db_query( $t_query, $t_fields );
 738 
 739 		bug_clear_cache( $this->id );
 740 
 741 		# log changes
 742 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'project_id', $t_old_data->project_id, $this->project_id );
 743 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'reporter_id', $t_old_data->reporter_id, $this->reporter_id );
 744 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'handler_id', $t_old_data->handler_id, $this->handler_id );
 745 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'priority', $t_old_data->priority, $this->priority );
 746 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'severity', $t_old_data->severity, $this->severity );
 747 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'reproducibility', $t_old_data->reproducibility, $this->reproducibility );
 748 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'status', $t_old_data->status, $this->status );
 749 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'resolution', $t_old_data->resolution, $this->resolution );
 750 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'projection', $t_old_data->projection, $this->projection );
 751 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'category', category_full_name( $t_old_data->category_id, false ), category_full_name( $this->category_id, false ) );
 752 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'eta', $t_old_data->eta, $this->eta );
 753 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'os', $t_old_data->os, $this->os );
 754 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'os_build', $t_old_data->os_build, $this->os_build );
 755 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'platform', $t_old_data->platform, $this->platform );
 756 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'version', $t_old_data->version, $this->version );
 757 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'build', $t_old_data->build, $this->build );
 758 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'fixed_in_version', $t_old_data->fixed_in_version, $this->fixed_in_version );
 759 		if( $t_roadmap_updated ) {
 760 			history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'target_version', $t_old_data->target_version, $this->target_version );
 761 		}
 762 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'view_state', $t_old_data->view_state, $this->view_state );
 763 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'summary', $t_old_data->summary, $this->summary );
 764 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'sponsorship_total', $t_old_data->sponsorship_total, $this->sponsorship_total );
 765 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'sticky', $t_old_data->sticky, $this->sticky );
 766 
 767 		history_log_event_direct( $c_bug_id, 'due_date',
 768 			( $t_old_data->due_date != date_get_null() ) ? $t_old_data->due_date : null,
 769 			( $this->due_date != date_get_null() ) ? $this->due_date : null
 770 		);
 771 
 772 		# Update extended info if requested
 773 		if( $p_update_extended ) {
 774 			$t_bug_text_id = bug_get_field( $c_bug_id, 'bug_text_id' );
 775 
 776 			db_param_push();
 777 			$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug_text}
 778 							SET description=' . db_param() . ',
 779 								steps_to_reproduce=' . db_param() . ',
 780 								additional_information=' . db_param() . '
 781 							WHERE id=' . db_param();
 782 			db_query( $t_query, array(
 783 				$this->description,
 784 				$this->steps_to_reproduce,
 785 				$this->additional_information,
 786 				$t_bug_text_id ) );
 787 
 788 			bug_text_clear_cache( $c_bug_id );
 789 
 790 			$t_current_user = auth_get_current_user_id();
 791 
 792 			if( $t_old_data->description != $this->description ) {
 793 				if( bug_revision_count( $c_bug_id, REV_DESCRIPTION ) < 1 ) {
 794 					bug_revision_add( $c_bug_id, $t_old_data->reporter_id, REV_DESCRIPTION, $t_old_data->description, 0, $t_old_data->date_submitted );
 795 				}
 796 				$t_revision_id = bug_revision_add( $c_bug_id, $t_current_user, REV_DESCRIPTION, $this->description );
 797 				history_log_event_special( $c_bug_id, DESCRIPTION_UPDATED, $t_revision_id );
 798 			}
 799 
 800 			if( $t_old_data->steps_to_reproduce != $this->steps_to_reproduce ) {
 801 				if( bug_revision_count( $c_bug_id, REV_STEPS_TO_REPRODUCE ) < 1 ) {
 802 					bug_revision_add( $c_bug_id, $t_old_data->reporter_id, REV_STEPS_TO_REPRODUCE, $t_old_data->steps_to_reproduce, 0, $t_old_data->date_submitted );
 803 				}
 804 				$t_revision_id = bug_revision_add( $c_bug_id, $t_current_user, REV_STEPS_TO_REPRODUCE, $this->steps_to_reproduce );
 805 				history_log_event_special( $c_bug_id, STEP_TO_REPRODUCE_UPDATED, $t_revision_id );
 806 			}
 807 
 808 			if( $t_old_data->additional_information != $this->additional_information ) {
 809 				if( bug_revision_count( $c_bug_id, REV_ADDITIONAL_INFO ) < 1 ) {
 810 					bug_revision_add( $c_bug_id, $t_old_data->reporter_id, REV_ADDITIONAL_INFO, $t_old_data->additional_information, 0, $t_old_data->date_submitted );
 811 				}
 812 				$t_revision_id = bug_revision_add( $c_bug_id, $t_current_user, REV_ADDITIONAL_INFO, $this->additional_information );
 813 				history_log_event_special( $c_bug_id, ADDITIONAL_INFO_UPDATED, $t_revision_id );
 814 			}
 815 		}
 816 
 817 		# Update the last update date
 818 		bug_update_date( $c_bug_id );
 819 
 820 		# allow bypass if user is sending mail separately
 821 		if( !$p_bypass_mail ) {
 822 			# If handler changes, send out owner change email
 823 			if( $t_old_data->handler_id != $this->handler_id ) {
 824 				email_owner_changed( $c_bug_id, $t_old_data->handler_id, $this->handler_id );
 825 				return true;
 826 			}
 827 
 828 			# status changed
 829 			if( $t_old_data->status != $this->status ) {
 830 				$t_status = MantisEnum::getLabel( config_get( 'status_enum_string' ), $this->status );
 831 				$t_status = str_replace( ' ', '_', $t_status );
 832 				email_bug_status_changed( $c_bug_id, $t_status );
 833 				return true;
 834 			}
 835 
 836 			# @todo handle priority change if it requires special handling
 837 			email_bug_updated( $c_bug_id );
 838 		}
 839 
 840 		return true;
 841 	}
 842 }

 844 $g_cache_bug = array();
 845 $g_cache_bug_text = array();
 846 $g_cache_bug_attachments = array();

 848 /**
 849  * Cache a database result-set containing full contents of bug_table row.
 850  *
 851  * $p_stats parameter is an optional array representing bugnote statistics.
 852  * This parameter can be "false" if the bug has no bugnotes, so the cache can
 853  * differentiate from a still not cached stats registry.
 854  *
 855  * @param array $p_bug_database_result Database row containing all columns
 856  *                                     from mantis_bug_table.
 857  * @param array|bool|null $p_stats     Optional: array representing bugnote statistics,
 858  *                                     or false to store empty cache value
 859  *
 860  * @return array returns an array representing the bug row if bug exists
 861  * @access public
 862  */
 863 function bug_cache_database_result( array $p_bug_database_result, $p_stats = null ) {
 864 	global $g_cache_bug;
 865 
 866 	if( isset( $g_cache_bug[(int)$p_bug_database_result['id']] ) ) {
 867 		if( !is_null($p_stats) ) {
 868 			# force store the bugnote statistics
 869 			return bug_add_to_cache( $p_bug_database_result, $p_stats );
 870 		} else {
 871 			return $g_cache_bug[(int)$p_bug_database_result['id']];
 872 		}
 873 	}
 874 
 875 	return bug_add_to_cache( $p_bug_database_result, $p_stats );
 876 }
 877 
 878 /**
 879  * Cache a bug row if necessary and return the cached copy.
 880  *
 881  * @param int  $p_bug_id         Identifier of bug to cache from mantis_bug_table.
 882  * @param bool $p_trigger_errors Set to true to trigger an error if the bug does not exist.
 883  *
 884  * @return array|false Array representing the bug row if the bug exists, false if it does not.
 885  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
 886  *
 887  * @access public
 888  */
 889 function bug_cache_row( $p_bug_id, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
 890 	global $g_cache_bug;
 891 
 892 	if( isset( $g_cache_bug[$p_bug_id] ) ) {
 893 		return $g_cache_bug[$p_bug_id];
 894 	}
 895 
 896 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
 897 
 898 	db_param_push();
 899 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 900 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bug_id ) );
 901 
 902 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 903 
 904 	if( !$t_row ) {
 905 		$g_cache_bug[$c_bug_id] = false;
 906 
 907 		if( $p_trigger_errors ) {
 908 			throw new ClientException( "Issue #$c_bug_id not found", ERROR_BUG_NOT_FOUND, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 909 		}
 910 
 911 		return false;
 912 	}
 913 
 914 	return bug_add_to_cache( $t_row );
 915 }
 916 
 917 /**
 918  * Cache a set of bugs.
 919  *
 920  * @param array $p_bug_id_array List of bug identifiers to cache.
 921  *
 922  * @access public
 923  */
 924 function bug_cache_array_rows( array $p_bug_id_array ) {
 925 	global $g_cache_bug;
 926 	$c_bug_id_array = array();
 927 
 928 	foreach( $p_bug_id_array as $t_bug_id ) {
 929 		if( !isset( $g_cache_bug[(int)$t_bug_id] ) ) {
 930 			$c_bug_id_array[] = (int)$t_bug_id;
 931 		}
 932 	}
 933 
 934 	if( empty( $c_bug_id_array ) ) {
 935 		return;
 936 	}
 937 
 938 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug} WHERE id IN (' . implode( ',', $c_bug_id_array ) . ')';
 939 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 940 
 941 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 942 		bug_add_to_cache( $t_row );
 943 	}
 944 }

 946 /**
 947  * Inject a bug into the bug cache.
 948  *
 949  * $p_stats parameter is an optional array representing bugnote statistics.
 950  * This parameter can be "false" if the bug has no bugnotes, so the cache can differentiate
 951  * from a still not cached stats registry.
 952  *
 953  * @param array $p_bug_row         A bug row to cache.
 954  * @param array|bool|null $p_stats Array of Bugnote stats to cache, false to
 955  *                                 store empty value, null to skip.
 956  *
 957  * @return array
 958  *
 959  * @access private
 960  */
 961 function bug_add_to_cache( array $p_bug_row, $p_stats = null ) {
 962 	global $g_cache_bug;
 963 
 964 	$g_cache_bug[(int)$p_bug_row['id']] = $p_bug_row;
 965 
 966 	if( !is_null( $p_stats ) ) {
 967 		$g_cache_bug[(int)$p_bug_row['id']]['_stats'] = $p_stats;
 968 	}
 969 
 970 	return $g_cache_bug[(int)$p_bug_row['id']];
 971 }

 982 function bug_clear_cache( $p_bug_id = null ) {

 994 /**
 995  * Cache a bug text row if necessary and return the cached copy.
 996  *
 997  * @param int $p_bug_id          Int bug id to retrieve text for.
 998  * @param bool $p_trigger_errors If the second parameter is true (default),
 999  *                               trigger an error if bug text not found.
1000  *
1001  * @return array|false Array of bug text data, false if not found.
1002  * @throws ClientException If bug text data not found
1003  *
1004  * @access public
1005  */
1006 function bug_text_cache_row( $p_bug_id, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
1007 	global $g_cache_bug_text;
1008 
1009 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1010 
1011 	if( isset( $g_cache_bug_text[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
1012 		return $g_cache_bug_text[$c_bug_id];
1013 	}
1014 
1015 	db_param_push();
1016 	$t_query = 'SELECT bt.* FROM {bug_text} bt, {bug} b
1017 				  WHERE b.id=' . db_param() . ' AND b.bug_text_id = bt.id';
1018 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bug_id ) );
1019 
1020 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
1021 
1022 	if( !$t_row ) {
1023 		$g_cache_bug_text[$c_bug_id] = false;
1024 
1025 		if( $p_trigger_errors ) {
1026 			throw new ClientException(
1027 				"Issue '$p_bug_id' not found",
1028 				ERROR_BUG_NOT_FOUND,
1029 				array( $p_bug_id ) );
1030 		}
1031 
1032 		return false;
1033 	}
1034 
1035 	$g_cache_bug_text[$c_bug_id] = $t_row;
1036 
1037 	return $t_row;
1038 }

1078 /**
1079  * Check if a bug exists.
1080  *
1081  * @param int $p_bug_id Int representing bug identifier.
1082  *
1083  * @return bool true if bug exists, false otherwise
1084  *
1085  * @access public
1086  * @noinspection PhpDocMissingThrowsInspection
1087  */
1088 function bug_exists( $p_bug_id ) {
1089 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1090 
1091 	# Check for invalid id values
1092 	if( $c_bug_id <= 0 || $c_bug_id > DB_MAX_INT ) {
1093 		return false;
1094 	}
1095 
1096 	# bug exists if bug_cache_row returns any value
1097 	/** @noinspection PhpUnhandledExceptionInspection */
1098 	if( bug_cache_row( $c_bug_id, false ) ) {
1099 		return true;
1100 	} else {
1101 		return false;
1102 	}
1103 }

1118 			ERROR_BUG_NOT_FOUND,
1119 			array( $p_bug_id ) );
1120 	}

1161 /**

1165  * current user access level < update_readonly_bug_threshold.

1169  * @return bool
1170  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.

1174 function bug_is_readonly( $p_bug_id ) {
1175 	$t_status = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'status' );
1176 	if( $t_status < config_get( 'bug_readonly_status_threshold', null, null, bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' ) ) ) {
1177 		return false;
1178 	}
1179 
1180 	if( access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'update_readonly_bug_threshold' ), $p_bug_id ) ) {
1181 		return false;
1182 	}
1183 
1184 	return true;

1197 function bug_is_resolved( $p_bug_id ) {

1217 /**
1218  * Return a bug's overdue warning level.
1219  *
1220  * Determines the level based on the difference between the bug's due date
1221  * and the current date/time, based on the defined delays
1222  * @see $g_due_date_warning_levels
1223  *
1224  * @param $p_bug_id
1225  *
1226  * @return int|false Warning level (0 = overdue), false if N/A.
1227  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
1228  */
1229 function bug_overdue_level( $p_bug_id ) {
1230 	if( bug_is_resolved( $p_bug_id ) ) {
1231 		return false;
1232 	}
1233 
1234 	$t_bug = bug_get( $p_bug_id );
1235 	$t_due_date = $t_bug->due_date;
1236 
1237 	if( date_is_null( $t_due_date ) ) {
1238 		return false;
1239 	}
1240 
1241 	$t_warning_levels = config_get( 'due_date_warning_levels', null, null, $t_bug->project_id );
1242 	if( !empty( $t_warning_levels ) && !is_array( $t_warning_levels ) ) {
1243 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC );
1244 	}
1245 
1246 	$t_now = db_now();
1247 	foreach( $t_warning_levels as $t_level => $t_delay ) {
1248 		if( $t_now > $t_due_date - $t_delay ) {
1249 			return $t_level;
1250 		}
1251 	}
1252 	return false;
1253 }
1254 
1255 /**
1256  * Check if a given bug is overdue.
1257  *
1258  * @param int $p_bug_id Int representing bug identifier.
1259  *
1260  * @return bool true if bug is overdue, false otherwise
1261  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
1262  *
1263  * @access public
1264  */
1265 function bug_is_overdue( $p_bug_id ) {
1266 	return bug_overdue_level( $p_bug_id ) === 0;
1267 }

1269 /**
1270  * Validate workflow state to see if bug can be moved to requested state.
1271  *
1272  * @param int $p_bug_status    Current bug status.
1273  * @param int $p_wanted_status New bug status.
1274  *
1275  * @return bool
1276  *
1277  * @access public
1278  */
1279 function bug_check_workflow( $p_bug_status, $p_wanted_status ) {
1280 	$t_status_enum_workflow = config_get( 'status_enum_workflow' );
1281 
1282 	if( count( $t_status_enum_workflow ) < 1 ) {
1283 		# workflow not defined, use default enum
1284 		return true;
1285 	}
1286 
1287 	if( $p_bug_status == $p_wanted_status ) {
1288 		# no change in state, allow the transition
1289 		return true;
1290 	}
1291 
1292 	# There should always be a possible next status, if not defined, then allow all.
1293 	if( !isset( $t_status_enum_workflow[$p_bug_status] ) ) {
1294 		return true;
1295 	}
1296 
1297 	# workflow defined - find allowed states
1298 	$t_allowed_states = $t_status_enum_workflow[$p_bug_status];
1299 
1300 	return MantisEnum::hasValue( $t_allowed_states, $p_wanted_status );
1301 }
