1303 /**
1304  * Copy a bug from one project to another.
1305  *
1306  * Also make copies of issue notes, attachments, history,
1307  * email notifications etc.
1308  *
1309  * @param int  $p_bug_id                A bug identifier.
1310  * @param int  $p_target_project_id     A target project identifier.
1311  * @param bool $p_copy_custom_fields    Whether to copy custom fields.
1312  * @param bool $p_copy_relationships    Whether to copy relationships.
1313  * @param bool $p_copy_history          Whether to copy history.
1314  * @param bool $p_copy_attachments      Whether to copy attachments.
1315  * @param bool $p_copy_bugnotes         Whether to copy bugnotes.
1316  * @param bool $p_copy_monitoring_users Whether to copy monitoring users.
1317  *
1318  * @return int New bug identifier
1319  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
1320  *
1321  * @access public
1322  */
1323 function bug_copy( $p_bug_id, $p_target_project_id = null, $p_copy_custom_fields = false, $p_copy_relationships = false, $p_copy_history = false, $p_copy_attachments = false, $p_copy_bugnotes = false, $p_copy_monitoring_users = false ) {
1324 
1325 	$t_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1326 	$t_target_project_id = (int)$p_target_project_id;
1327 
1328 	$t_bug_data = bug_get( $t_bug_id, true );
1329 
1330 	# retrieve the project id associated with the bug
1331 	if( ( $p_target_project_id == null ) || is_blank( $p_target_project_id ) ) {
1332 		$t_target_project_id = $t_bug_data->project_id;
1333 	}
1334 
1335 	$t_bug_data->project_id = $t_target_project_id;
1336 	$t_bug_data->reporter_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1337 	$t_bug_data->date_submitted = db_now();
1338 	$t_bug_data->last_updated = db_now();
1339 
1340 	$t_new_bug_id = $t_bug_data->create();
1341 
1342 	# MASC ATTENTION: IF THE SOURCE BUG HAS TO HANDLER THE bug_create FUNCTION CAN TRY TO AUTO-ASSIGN THE BUG
1343 	# WE FORCE HERE TO DUPLICATE THE SAME HANDLER OF THE SOURCE BUG
1344 	# @todo VB: Shouldn't we check if the handler in the source project is also a
1345 	#   handler in the destination project?
1346 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'handler_id', $t_bug_data->handler_id );
1347 
1348 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'duplicate_id', $t_bug_data->duplicate_id );
1349 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'status', $t_bug_data->status );
1350 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'resolution', $t_bug_data->resolution );
1351 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'projection', $t_bug_data->projection );
1352 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'eta', $t_bug_data->eta );
1353 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'fixed_in_version', $t_bug_data->fixed_in_version );
1354 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'target_version', $t_bug_data->target_version );
1355 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'sponsorship_total', 0 );
1356 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'sticky', 0 );
1357 	bug_set_field( $t_new_bug_id, 'due_date', $t_bug_data->due_date );
1358 
1359 	# COPY CUSTOM FIELDS
1360 	if( $p_copy_custom_fields ) {
1361 		db_param_push();
1362 		$t_query = 'SELECT field_id, bug_id, value, text FROM {custom_field_string} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
1363 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bug_id ) );
1364 
1365 		while( $t_bug_custom = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1366 			$c_field_id = (int)$t_bug_custom['field_id'];
1367 			$c_new_bug_id = $t_new_bug_id;
1368 			$c_value = $t_bug_custom['value'];
1369 			$c_text = $t_bug_custom['text'];
1370 
1371 			db_param_push();
1372 			$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {custom_field_string}
1373 						   ( field_id, bug_id, value, text )
1374 						   VALUES (' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ')';
1375 			db_query( $t_query, array( $c_field_id, $c_new_bug_id, $c_value, $c_text ) );
1376 		}
1377 	}
1378 
1379 	# Copy Relationships
1380 	if( $p_copy_relationships ) {
1381 		relationship_copy_all( $t_bug_id, $t_new_bug_id );
1382 	}
1383 
1384 	# Copy bugnotes
1385 	if( $p_copy_bugnotes ) {
1386 		db_param_push();
1387 		$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bugnote} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
1388 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bug_id ) );
1389 
1390 		while( $t_bug_note = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1391 			$t_bugnote_text_id = $t_bug_note['bugnote_text_id'];
1392 
1393 			db_param_push();
1394 			$t_query2 = 'SELECT * FROM {bugnote_text} WHERE id=' . db_param();
1395 			$t_result2 = db_query( $t_query2, array( $t_bugnote_text_id ) );
1396 
1397 			$t_bugnote_text_insert_id = -1;
1398 			if( $t_bugnote_text = db_fetch_array( $t_result2 ) ) {
1399 				db_param_push();
1400 				$t_query2 = 'INSERT INTO {bugnote_text}
1401 							   ( note )
1402 							   VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ' )';
1403 				db_query( $t_query2, array( $t_bugnote_text['note'] ) );
1404 				$t_bugnote_text_insert_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'bugnote_text' ) );
1405 			}
1406 
1407 			db_param_push();
1408 			$t_query2 = 'INSERT INTO {bugnote}
1409 						   ( bug_id, reporter_id, bugnote_text_id, view_state, date_submitted, last_modified )
1410 						   VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ',
1411 						   			' . db_param() . ',
1412 						   			' . db_param() . ',
1413 						   			' . db_param() . ',
1414 						   			' . db_param() . ',
1415 						   			' . db_param() . ')';
1416 			db_query( $t_query2, array( $t_new_bug_id, $t_bug_note['reporter_id'], $t_bugnote_text_insert_id, $t_bug_note['view_state'], $t_bug_note['date_submitted'], $t_bug_note['last_modified'] ) );
1417 		}
1418 	}
1419 
1420 	# Copy attachments
1421 	if( $p_copy_attachments ) {
1422 	    file_copy_attachments( $t_bug_id, $t_new_bug_id );
1423 	}
1424 
1425 	# Copy users monitoring bug
1426 	if( $p_copy_monitoring_users ) {
1427 		bug_monitor_copy( $t_bug_id, $t_new_bug_id );
1428 	}
1429 
1430 	# COPY HISTORY
1431 	history_delete( $t_new_bug_id );	# should history only be deleted inside the if statement below?
1432 	if( $p_copy_history ) {
1433 		# @todo problem with this code: the generated history trail is incorrect
1434 		#   because the note IDs are those of the original bug, not the copied ones
1435 		# @todo actually, does it even make sense to copy the history ?
1436 		db_param_push();
1437 		$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_history} WHERE bug_id = ' . db_param();
1438 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bug_id ) );
1439 
1440 		while( $t_bug_history = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1441 			db_param_push();
1442 			$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_history}
1443 						  ( user_id, bug_id, date_modified, field_name, old_value, new_value, type )
1444 						  VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
1445 						  		   ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',
1446 						  		   ' . db_param() . ' );';
1447 			db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bug_history['user_id'], $t_new_bug_id, $t_bug_history['date_modified'], $t_bug_history['field_name'], $t_bug_history['old_value'], $t_bug_history['new_value'], $t_bug_history['type'] ) );
1448 		}
1449 	} else {
1450 		# Create a "New Issue" history entry
1451 		history_log_event_special( $t_new_bug_id, NEW_BUG );
1452 	}
1453 
1454 	# Create history entries to reflect the copy operation
1455 	history_log_event_special( $t_new_bug_id, BUG_CREATED_FROM, '', $t_bug_id );
1456 	history_log_event_special( $t_bug_id, BUG_CLONED_TO, '', $t_new_bug_id );
1457 
1458 	return $t_new_bug_id;
1459 }

1461 /**
1462  * Moves an issue from a project to another.
1463  *
1464  * @todo Validate with sub-project / category inheritance scenarios.
1465  *
1466  * @param int $p_bug_id            The bug to be moved.
1467  * @param int $p_target_project_id The target project to move the bug to.
1468  *
1469  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
1470  *
1471  * @access public
1472  */
1473 function bug_move( $p_bug_id, $p_target_project_id ) {
1474 	# Attempt to move disk based attachments to new project file directory.
1475 	file_move_bug_attachments( $p_bug_id, $p_target_project_id );
1476 
1477 	# Move the issue to the new project.
1478 	bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id', $p_target_project_id );
1479 
1480 	# Update the category if needed
1481 	$t_category_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'category_id' );
1482 
1483 	# Bug has no category
1484 	if( $t_category_id == 0 ) {
1485 		# Category is required in target project, set it to default
1486 		if( ON != config_get( 'allow_no_category', null, null, $p_target_project_id ) ) {
1487 			bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'category_id', config_get( 'default_category_for_moves', null, null, $p_target_project_id ) );
1488 		}
1489 	} else {
1490 		# Check if the category is global, and if not attempt mapping it to the new project
1491 		$t_category_project_id = category_get_field( $t_category_id, 'project_id' );
1492 
1493 		if( $t_category_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS
1494 		  && !in_array( $t_category_project_id, project_hierarchy_inheritance( $p_target_project_id ) )
1495 		) {
1496 			# Map by name
1497 			$t_category_name = category_get_field( $t_category_id, 'name' );
1498 			$t_target_project_category_id = category_get_id_by_name( $t_category_name, $p_target_project_id, false );
1499 			if( $t_target_project_category_id === false ) {
1500 				# Use target project's default category for moves, since there is no match by name.
1501 				$t_target_project_category_id = config_get( 'default_category_for_moves', null, null, $p_target_project_id );
1502 			}
1503 			bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'category_id', $t_target_project_category_id );
1504 		}
1505 	}
1506 }

1508 /**
1509  * Delete a bug.
1510  *
1511  * Delete the bug record including all related data (bugtext, bugnote, etc).
1512  *
1513  * @param int $p_bug_id Int representing bug identifier.
1514  *
1515  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
1516  *
1517  * @access public
1518  */
1519 function bug_delete( $p_bug_id ) {
1520 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1521 
1522 	# call pre-deletion custom function
1523 	helper_call_custom_function( 'issue_delete_validate', array( $p_bug_id ) );
1524 
1525 	event_signal( 'EVENT_BUG_DELETED', array( $c_bug_id ) );
1526 
1527 	# log deletion of bug
1528 	history_log_event_special( $p_bug_id, BUG_DELETED, bug_format_id( $p_bug_id ) );
1529 
1530 	email_bug_deleted( $p_bug_id );
1531 	email_relationship_bug_deleted( $p_bug_id );
1532 
1533 	# Call post-deletion custom function.
1534 	# We do this here to allow the custom function to access the bug's details
1535 	# before they are deleted from the database given its id. The other option
1536 	# would be to move this to the end of the function and provide it with bug
1537 	# data rather than an id, but this would break backward compatibility.
1538 	helper_call_custom_function( 'issue_delete_notify', array( $p_bug_id ) );
1539 
1540 	# Unmonitor bug for all users
1541 	bug_unmonitor( $p_bug_id, null );
1542 
1543 	# Delete custom fields
1544 	custom_field_delete_all_values( $p_bug_id );
1545 
1546 	# Delete bugnotes
1547 	bugnote_delete_all( $p_bug_id );
1548 
1549 	# Delete all sponsorships
1550 	sponsorship_delete_all( $p_bug_id );
1551 
1552 	# Delete all relationships
1553 	relationship_delete_all( $p_bug_id );
1554 
1555 	# Delete files
1556 	file_delete_attachments( $p_bug_id );
1557 
1558 	# Detach tags
1559 	tag_bug_detach_all( $p_bug_id, false );
1560 
1561 	# Delete the bug history
1562 	history_delete( $p_bug_id );
1563 
1564 	# Delete bug info revisions
1565 	bug_revision_delete( $p_bug_id );
1566 
1567 	# Delete the bugnote text
1568 	$t_bug_text_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'bug_text_id' );
1569 
1570 	db_param_push();
1571 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_text} WHERE id=' . db_param();
1572 	db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bug_text_id ) );
1573 
1574 	# Delete the bug entry
1575 	db_param_push();
1576 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug} WHERE id=' . db_param();
1577 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bug_id ) );
1578 
1579 	bug_clear_cache_all( $p_bug_id );
1580 }

1582 /**
1583  * Delete all bugs associated with a project.
1584  *
1585  * @param int $p_project_id Int representing a project identifier.
1586  *
1587  * @access public
1588  * @noinspection PhpDocMissingThrowsInspection
1589  */
1590 function bug_delete_all( $p_project_id ) {
1591 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
1592 
1593 	db_param_push();
1594 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {bug} WHERE project_id=' . db_param();
1595 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_project_id ) );
1596 
1597 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1598 		/** @noinspection PhpUnhandledExceptionInspection */
1599 		bug_delete( $t_row['id'] );
1600 	}
1601 
1602 	# @todo should we check the return value of each bug_delete() and
1603 	#    return false if any of them return false? Presumable bug_delete()
1604 	#    will eventually trigger an error on failure so it won't matter...
1605 }

1754  * @access public

1756 function bug_get_newest_bugnote_timestamp( $p_bug_id ) {
1757 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1758 
1759 	db_param_push();
1760 	$t_query = 'SELECT last_modified FROM {bugnote} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param() . ' ORDER BY last_modified DESC';
1761 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bug_id ), 1 );
1762 	$t_row = db_result( $t_result );
1763

1771 /**
1772  * For a list of bug ids, returns an array of bugnote stats.
1773  *
1774  * If a bug has no visible bugnotes, returns "false" as the stats item for that bug id.
1775  *
1776  * @param array    $p_bugs_id List of bug identifiers.
1777  * @param int|null $p_user_id User for checking access levels. null defaults to current user
1778  *
1779  * @return array Array of bugnote stats
1780  *
1781  * @access public
1782  */
1783 function bug_get_bugnote_stats_array( array $p_bugs_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
1784 	if( empty( $p_bugs_id ) ) {
1785 		return array();
1786 	}
1787 
1788 	$t_id_array = array();
1789 	foreach( $p_bugs_id as $t_id ) {
1790 		$t_id_array[$t_id] = (int)$t_id;
1791 	}
1792 	if( db_is_mssql() ) {
1793 		# MSSQL is limited to 2100 parameters per query, see #24393
1794 		$t_chunks = array_chunk( $t_id_array, 2100, true );
1795 	} else {
1796 		$t_chunks = array( $t_id_array );
1797 	}
1798 
1799 	$t_user_id = $p_user_id ?? auth_get_current_user_id();
1800 
1801 	# We need to check for each bugnote if user has permissions to view in respective project.
1802 	# bugnotes are grouped by project_id and bug_id to save calls to config_get
1803 	$t_sql = 'SELECT n.id, n.bug_id, n.reporter_id, n.view_state, n.last_modified, n.date_submitted, b.project_id'
1804 		. ' FROM {bugnote} n JOIN {bug} b ON (n.bug_id = b.id)'
1805 		. ' WHERE %s'
1806 		. ' ORDER BY b.project_id, n.bug_id, n.last_modified';
1807 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
1808 	$t_query->sql( sprintf( $t_sql, $t_query->sql_in( 'n.bug_id', 'bug_ids' ) ) );
1809 
1810 	$t_counter = 0;
1811 	$t_stats = array();
1812 	foreach( $t_chunks as $t_chunk_ids ) {
1813 		$t_current_project_id = null;
1814 		$t_current_bug_id = null;
1815 
1816 		$t_query->bind( 'bug_ids', $t_chunk_ids );
1817 		$t_query->execute();
1818 		while( $t_query_row = $t_query->fetch() ) {
1819 			/**
1820 			 * Variables defined in the loop's first iteration
1821 			 * @var bool $t_private_bugnote_visible
1822 			 * @var int  $t_note_count
1823 			 * @var int  $t_last_submit_date
1824 			 */
1825 			$c_bug_id = (int)$t_query_row['bug_id'];
1826 			if( 0 == $t_counter || $t_current_project_id !== $t_query_row['project_id'] ) {
1827 				# evaluating a new project from the rowset
1828 				$t_current_project_id = $t_query_row['project_id'];
1829 				$t_user_access_level = access_get_project_level( $t_query_row['project_id'], $t_user_id );
1830 				$t_private_bugnote_visible = access_compare_level(
1831 					$t_user_access_level,
1832 					config_get( 'private_bugnote_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_query_row['project_id'] )
1833 				);
1834 			}
1835 			if( 0 == $t_counter || $t_current_bug_id !== $c_bug_id ) {
1836 				# evaluating a new bug from the rowset
1837 				$t_current_bug_id = $c_bug_id;
1838 				$t_note_count = 0;
1839 				$t_last_submit_date = 0;
1840 			}
1841 			$t_note_visible = $t_private_bugnote_visible
1842 				|| $t_query_row['reporter_id'] == $t_user_id
1843 				|| ( VS_PUBLIC == $t_query_row['view_state'] );
1844 			if( $t_note_visible ) {
1845 				# only count the bugnote if user has access
1846 				$t_stats[$c_bug_id]['bug_id'] = $c_bug_id;
1847 				$t_stats[$c_bug_id]['last_modified'] = $t_query_row['last_modified'];
1848 				$t_stats[$c_bug_id]['count'] = ++$t_note_count;
1849 				$t_stats[$c_bug_id]['last_modified_bugnote'] = $t_query_row['id'];
1850 				if( $t_query_row['date_submitted'] > $t_last_submit_date ) {
1851 					$t_last_submit_date = $t_query_row['date_submitted'];
1852 					$t_stats[$c_bug_id]['last_submitted_bugnote'] = $t_query_row['id'];
1853 				}
1854 				if( isset( $t_id_array[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
1855 					unset( $t_id_array[$c_bug_id] );
1856 				}
1857 			}
1858 			$t_counter++;
1859 		}
1860 	}
1861 
1862 	# The remaining bug ids, are those without visible notes. Save false as cached value
1863 	foreach( $t_id_array as $t_id ) {
1864 		$t_stats[$t_id] = false;
1865 	}
1866 	return $t_stats;
1867 }
1868 
1869 /**
1870  * Return the bug's bugnote statistics.
1871  *
1872  * - Timestamp for the bug's most recent bugnote
1873  * - Total bugnote count.
1874  *
1875  * @param int $p_bug_id Bug identifier.

1881 function bug_get_bugnote_stats( $p_bug_id ) {

1886 		return $g_cache_bug[$c_bug_id]['_stats'];
1887 	}
1888 	else {
1889 		$t_stats = bug_get_bugnote_stats_array( array( $p_bug_id ) );
1890 		return $t_stats[$p_bug_id];

1894 /**
1895  * Get array of attachments associated with the specified bug id.
1896  *
1897  * The array will be sorted in terms of date added (ASC).
1898  * The array will include the following fields:
1899  * id, title, diskfile, filename, filesize, file_type, date_added, user_id.
1900  *
1901  * @param int $p_bug_id Bug identifier.
1902  *
1903  * @return array array of results or empty array
1904  *
1905  * @access public
1906  */
1907 function bug_get_attachments( $p_bug_id ) {
1908 	$p_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1909 
1910 	global $g_cache_bug_attachments;
1911 	if( isset( $g_cache_bug_attachments[$p_bug_id] ) ) {
1912 		return $g_cache_bug_attachments[$p_bug_id];
1913 	}
1914 
1915 	db_param_push();
1916 
1917 	$t_query = 'SELECT id, title, diskfile, filename, filesize, file_type, date_added, user_id, bugnote_id
1918 		                FROM {bug_file}
1919 		                WHERE bug_id=' . db_param() . '
1920 		                ORDER BY date_added';
1921 	$t_db_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
1922 
1923 	$t_result = array();
1924 
1925 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_db_result ) ) {
1926 		$t_result[] = $t_row;
1927 	}
1928 
1929 	$g_cache_bug_attachments[$p_bug_id] = $t_result;
1930 
1931 	return $t_result;
1932 }

1934 /**
1935  * Set the value of a bug field.
1936  *
1937  * @param int             $p_bug_id     Bug identifier.
1938  * @param string          $p_field_name Pre-defined field name.
1939  * @param bool|int|string $p_value      Value to set.
1940  *
1941  * @return true
1942  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
1943  *
1944  * @access public
1945  */
1946 function bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, $p_field_name, $p_value ) {
1947 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1948 	$c_value = null;
1949 
1950 	switch( $p_field_name ) {
1951 		# integer
1952 		case 'project_id':
1953 		case 'reporter_id':
1954 		case 'handler_id':
1955 		case 'duplicate_id':
1956 		case 'priority':
1957 		case 'severity':
1958 		case 'reproducibility':
1959 		case 'status':
1960 		case 'resolution':
1961 		case 'projection':
1962 		case 'category_id':
1963 		case 'eta':
1964 		case 'view_state':
1965 		case 'profile_id':
1966 		case 'sponsorship_total':
1967 			$c_value = (int)$p_value;
1968 			break;
1969 
1970 		# boolean
1971 		case 'sticky':
1972 
1973 		# string
1974 		case 'os':
1975 		case 'os_build':
1976 		case 'platform':
1977 		case 'version':
1978 		case 'fixed_in_version':
1979 		case 'target_version':
1980 		case 'build':
1981 		case 'summary':
1982 			$c_value = $p_value;
1983 			break;
1984 
1985 		# dates
1986 		case 'last_updated':
1987 		case 'date_submitted':
1988 		case 'due_date':
1989 			if( !is_numeric( $p_value ) ) {
1990 				trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
1991 			}
1992 			$c_value = $p_value;
1993 			break;
1994 
1995 		default:
1996 			trigger_error( ERROR_DB_FIELD_NOT_FOUND, WARNING );
1997 			break;
1998 	}
1999 
2000 	$t_current_value = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, $p_field_name );
2001 
2002 	# return if status is already set
2003 	if( $c_value == $t_current_value ) {
2004 		return true;
2005 	}
2006 
2007 	# Update fields
2008 	db_param_push();
2009 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET ' . $p_field_name . '=' . db_param() . ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
2010 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_value, $c_bug_id ) );
2011 
2012 	# updated the last_updated date
2013 	if( $p_field_name != 'last_updated' ) {
2014 		bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
2015 	}
2016 
2017 	# log changes except for duplicate_id which is obsolete and should be removed in
2018 	# MantisBT 1.3.
2019 	switch( $p_field_name ) {
2020 		case 'duplicate_id':
2021 			break;
2022 
2023 		case 'category_id':
2024 			history_log_event_direct( $p_bug_id, 'category', category_full_name( $t_current_value, false ), category_full_name( $c_value, false ) );
2025 			break;
2026 
2027 		default:
2028 			history_log_event_direct( $p_bug_id, $p_field_name, $t_current_value, $c_value );
2029 	}
2030 
2031 	bug_clear_cache( $p_bug_id );
2032 
2033 	return true;
2034 }
2035 
2036 /**
2037  * Assign the bug to the given user.
2038  *
2039  * @param int    $p_bug_id          A bug identifier.
2040  * @param int    $p_user_id         A user identifier.
2041  * @param string $p_bugnote_text    The bugnote text.
2042  * @param bool   $p_bugnote_private Indicate whether bugnote is private.
2043  *
2044  * @return bool
2045  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
2046  *
2047  * @access public
2048  */
2049 function bug_assign( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id, $p_bugnote_text = '', $p_bugnote_private = false ) {
2050 	if( $p_user_id != NO_USER ) {
2051 		$t_bug_sponsored = config_get( 'enable_sponsorship' )
2052 			&& sponsorship_get_amount( sponsorship_get_all_ids( $p_bug_id ) ) > 0;
2053 		# The new handler is checked at project level
2054 		$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
2055 		if( !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'handle_bug_threshold' ), $t_project_id, $p_user_id ) ) {
2056 			trigger_error( ERROR_HANDLER_ACCESS_TOO_LOW, ERROR );
2057 		}
2058 		if( $t_bug_sponsored && !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'handle_sponsored_bugs_threshold' ), $t_project_id, $p_user_id ) ) {
2059 			trigger_error( ERROR_SPONSORSHIP_HANDLER_ACCESS_LEVEL_TOO_LOW, ERROR );
2060 		}
2061 	}
2062 
2063 	# extract current information into history variables
2064 	$h_status = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'status' );
2065 	$h_handler_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'handler_id' );
2066 
2067 	$t_ass_val = bug_get_status_for_assign( $h_handler_id, $p_user_id, $h_status );
2068 
2069 	if( ( $t_ass_val != $h_status ) || ( $p_user_id != $h_handler_id ) ) {
2070 
2071 		# get user id
2072 		db_param_push();
2073 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug}
2074 					  SET handler_id=' . db_param() . ', status=' . db_param() . '
2075 					  WHERE id=' . db_param();
2076 		db_query( $t_query, array( $p_user_id, $t_ass_val, $p_bug_id ) );
2077 
2078 		# log changes
2079 		history_log_event_direct( $p_bug_id, 'status', $h_status, $t_ass_val );
2080 		history_log_event_direct( $p_bug_id, 'handler_id', $h_handler_id, $p_user_id );
2081 
2082 		# Add bugnote if supplied ignore false return
2083 		if( !is_blank( $p_bugnote_text ) ) {
2084 			$t_bugnote_id = bugnote_add( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_text, 0, $p_bugnote_private, 0, '', null, false );
2085 			bugnote_process_mentions( $p_bug_id, $t_bugnote_id, $p_bugnote_text );
2086 		}
2087 
2088 		# updated the last_updated date
2089 		bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
2090 
2091 		bug_clear_cache( $p_bug_id );
2092 
2093 		# Send email for change of handler
2094 		email_owner_changed( $p_bug_id, $h_handler_id, $p_user_id );
2095 	}
2096 
2097 	return true;
2098 }
2099 
2100 /**

2103  * @param int     $p_bug_id          A bug identifier.
2104  * @param string  $p_bugnote_text    The bugnote text.
2105  * @param bool    $p_bugnote_private Whether the bugnote is private.

2108  * @return true

2111  * @access public
2112  */
2113 function bug_close( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_text = '', $p_bugnote_private = false, $p_time_tracking = '0:00' ) {
2114 	$p_bugnote_text = trim( $p_bugnote_text );
2115 
2116 	# Add bugnote if supplied ignore a false return
2117 	# Moved bugnote_add before bug_set_field calls in case time_tracking_no_note is off.
2118 	# Error condition stopped execution but status had already been changed
2119 	if( !is_blank( $p_bugnote_text ) || $p_time_tracking != '0:00' ) {
2120 		$t_bugnote_id = bugnote_add( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_text, $p_time_tracking, $p_bugnote_private, 0, '', null, false );
2121 		bugnote_process_mentions( $p_bug_id, $t_bugnote_id, $p_bugnote_text );
2122 	}
2123 
2124 	bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'status', config_get( 'bug_closed_status_threshold' ) );
2125 
2126 	email_close( $p_bug_id );
2127 	email_relationship_child_closed( $p_bug_id );
2128 
2129 	return true;
2130 }

2132 /**
2133  * Resolve the given bug.
2134  *
2135  * @param int    $p_bug_id           A bug identifier.
2136  * @param int    $p_resolution       Resolution status.
2137  * @param string $p_fixed_in_version Fixed in version.
2138  * @param string $p_bugnote_text     The bugnote text.
2139  * @param int    $p_duplicate_id     A duplicate identifier.
2140  * @param int    $p_handler_id       A handler identifier.
2141  * @param bool   $p_bugnote_private  Whether this is a private bugnote.
2142  * @param string $p_time_tracking    Time tracking value.
2143  *
2144  * @return bool
2145  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
2146  *
2147  * @access public
2148  */
2149 function bug_resolve( $p_bug_id, $p_resolution, $p_fixed_in_version = '', $p_bugnote_text = '', $p_duplicate_id = null, $p_handler_id = null, $p_bugnote_private = false, $p_time_tracking = '0:00' ) {
2150 	$c_resolution = (int)$p_resolution;
2151 	$p_bugnote_text = trim( $p_bugnote_text );
2152 
2153 	# Add bugnote if supplied
2154 	# Moved bugnote_add before bug_set_field calls in case time_tracking_no_note is off.
2155 	# Error condition stopped execution but status had already been changed
2156 	if( !is_blank( $p_bugnote_text ) || $p_time_tracking != '0:00' ) {
2157 		$t_bugnote_id = bugnote_add( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_text, $p_time_tracking, $p_bugnote_private, 0, '', null, false );
2158 		bugnote_process_mentions( $p_bug_id, $t_bugnote_id, $p_bugnote_text );
2159 	}
2160 
2161 	$t_duplicate = !is_blank( $p_duplicate_id ) && ( $p_duplicate_id != 0 );
2162 	if( $t_duplicate ) {
2163 		if( $p_bug_id == $p_duplicate_id ) {
2164 			trigger_error( ERROR_BUG_DUPLICATE_SELF, ERROR );
2165 
2166 			# never returns
2167 		}
2168 
2169 		# the related bug exists...
2170 		bug_ensure_exists( $p_duplicate_id );
2171 
2172 		relationship_upsert( $p_bug_id, $p_duplicate_id, BUG_DUPLICATE, /* email_for_source */ false );
2173 
2174 		# Copy list of users monitoring the duplicate bug to the original bug
2175 		$t_old_reporter_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'reporter_id' );
2176 		$t_old_handler_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'handler_id' );
2177 		if( user_exists( $t_old_reporter_id ) ) {
2178 			bug_monitor( $p_duplicate_id, $t_old_reporter_id );
2179 		}
2180 		if( user_exists( $t_old_handler_id ) ) {
2181 			bug_monitor( $p_duplicate_id, $t_old_handler_id );
2182 		}
2183 		bug_monitor_copy( $p_bug_id, $p_duplicate_id );
2184 
2185 		bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'duplicate_id', (int)$p_duplicate_id );
2186 	}
2187 
2188 	bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'status', config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold' ) );
2189 	bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'fixed_in_version', $p_fixed_in_version );
2190 	bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'resolution', $c_resolution );
2191 
2192 	# only set handler if specified explicitly or if bug was not assigned to a handler
2193 	if( null == $p_handler_id ) {
2194 		if( bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'handler_id' ) == 0 ) {
2195 			$p_handler_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
2196 			bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'handler_id', $p_handler_id );
2197 		}
2198 	} else {
2199 		bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'handler_id', $p_handler_id );
2200 	}
2201 
2202 	email_resolved( $p_bug_id );
2203 	email_relationship_child_resolved( $p_bug_id );
2204 
2205 	return true;
2206 }
2207 
2208 /**
2209  * Reopen the given bug.
2210  *
2211  * @param int     $p_bug_id          A bug identifier.
2212  * @param string  $p_bugnote_text    The bugnote text.

2221 function bug_reopen( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_text = '', $p_time_tracking = '0:00', $p_bugnote_private = false ) {

2223 
2224 	# Add bugnote if supplied
2225 	# Moved bugnote_add before bug_set_field calls in case time_tracking_no_note is off.
2226 	# Error condition stopped execution but status had already been changed
2227 	if( !is_blank( $p_bugnote_text ) || $p_time_tracking != '0:00' ) {
2228 		$t_bugnote_id = bugnote_add( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_text, $p_time_tracking, $p_bugnote_private, 0, '', null, false );

2259 /**
2260  * Enable monitoring of this bug for the user.
2261  *
2262  * @param int $p_bug_id  Bug identifier.
2263  * @param int $p_user_id User identifier.
2264  *
2265  * @return bool true if successful, false if unsuccessful
2266  *
2267  * @access public
2268  */
2269 function bug_monitor( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id ) {
2270 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
2271 	$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
2272 
2273 	# Make sure we aren't already monitoring this bug
2274 	if( user_is_monitoring_bug( $c_user_id, $c_bug_id ) ) {
2275 		return true;
2276 	}
2277 
2278 	# Don't let the anonymous user monitor bugs
2279 	if( user_is_anonymous( $c_user_id ) ) {
2280 		return false;
2281 	}
2282 
2283 	# Insert monitoring record
2284 	db_param_push();
2285 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_monitor} ( user_id, bug_id ) VALUES (' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
2286 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_user_id, $c_bug_id ) );
2287 
2288 	# log new monitoring action
2289 	history_log_event_special( $c_bug_id, BUG_MONITOR, $c_user_id );
2290 
2291 	# updated the last_updated date
2292 	bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
2293 
2294 	email_monitor_added( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id );
2295 
2296 	return true;
2297 }

2299 /**
2300  * Returns the list of users monitoring the specified bug.
2301  *
2302  * @param int $p_bug_id Bug identifier.
2303  *
2304  * @return array
2305  */
2306 function bug_get_monitors( $p_bug_id ) {
2307 	if( ! access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'show_monitor_list_threshold' ), $p_bug_id ) ) {
2308 		return array();
2309 	}
2310 
2311 	# get the bugnote data
2312 	db_param_push();
2313 	$t_query = 'SELECT user_id, enabled
2314 			FROM {bug_monitor} m, {user} u
2315 			WHERE m.bug_id=' . db_param() . ' AND m.user_id = u.id
2316 			ORDER BY u.realname, u.username';
2317 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
2318 
2319 	$t_users = array();
2320 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
2321 		$t_users[] = $t_row['user_id'];
2322 	}
2323 
2324 	user_cache_array_rows( $t_users );
2325 
2326 	return $t_users;
2327 }
2328 
2329 /**
2330  * Copy list of users monitoring a bug to the monitor list of a second bug.
2331  *
2332  * @param int $p_source_bug_id Source bug identifier.
2333  * @param int $p_dest_bug_id   Destination bug identifier.
2334  *
2335  * @access public
2336  */
2337 function bug_monitor_copy( $p_source_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id ) {
2338 	$c_source_bug_id = (int)$p_source_bug_id;
2339 	$c_dest_bug_id = (int)$p_dest_bug_id;
2340 
2341 	db_param_push();
2342 	$t_query = 'SELECT user_id FROM {bug_monitor} WHERE bug_id = ' . db_param();
2343 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_source_bug_id ) );
2344 
2345 	while( $t_bug_monitor = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
2346 		if( user_exists( $t_bug_monitor['user_id'] ) &&
2347 			!user_is_monitoring_bug( $t_bug_monitor['user_id'], $c_dest_bug_id ) ) {
2348 			db_param_push();
2349 			$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_monitor} ( user_id, bug_id )
2350 				VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
2351 			db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bug_monitor['user_id'], $c_dest_bug_id ) );
2352 			history_log_event_special( $c_dest_bug_id, BUG_MONITOR, $t_bug_monitor['user_id'] );
2353 		}
2354 	}
2355 }

2357 /**
2358  * Disable monitoring of this bug for the user.
2359  *
2360  * @param int      $p_bug_id  Bug identifier.
2361  * @param int|null $p_user_id User identifier, null for all users.
2362  *
2363  * @return true
2364  *
2365  * @access public
2366  */
2367 function bug_unmonitor( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id ) {
2368 	# Delete monitoring record
2369 	db_param_push();
2370 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_monitor} WHERE bug_id = ' . db_param();
2371 	$t_db_query_params[] = $p_bug_id;
2372 
2373 	if( $p_user_id !== null ) {
2374 		$t_query .= ' AND user_id = ' . db_param();
2375 		$t_db_query_params[] = $p_user_id;
2376 	}
2377 
2378 	db_query( $t_query, $t_db_query_params );
2379 
2380 	# log new un-monitor action
2381 	history_log_event_special( $p_bug_id, BUG_UNMONITOR, (int)$p_user_id );
2382 
2383 	# updated the last_updated date
2384 	bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
2385 
2386 	return true;
2387 }

2398 function bug_format_id( $p_bug_id ) {

2405 /**
2406  * Returns the resulting status for a bug after an assignment action is performed.
2407  *
2408  * If the option "auto_set_status_to_assigned" is enabled, the resulting status
2409  * is calculated based on current handler and status , and requested modifications.
2410  *
2411  * @param int $p_current_handler Current handler user id
2412  * @param int $p_new_handler     New handler user id
2413  * @param int $p_current_status  Current bug status
2414  * @param int $p_new_status      New bug status (as being part of a status change combined action)
2415  *
2416  * @return int Calculated status after assignment
2417  */
2418 function bug_get_status_for_assign( $p_current_handler, $p_new_handler, $p_current_status, $p_new_status = null ) {
2419 	if( null === $p_new_status ) {
2420 		$p_new_status = $p_current_status;
2421 	}
2422 	if( config_get( 'auto_set_status_to_assigned' ) ) {
2423 		$t_assigned_status = config_get( 'bug_assigned_status' );
2424 
2425 		if(		$p_current_handler == NO_USER &&
2426 				$p_new_handler != NO_USER &&
2427 				$p_new_status == $p_current_status &&
2428 				$p_new_status < $t_assigned_status &&
2429 				bug_check_workflow( $p_current_status, $t_assigned_status ) ) {
2430 
2431 			return $t_assigned_status;
2432 		}
2433 	}
2434 	return $p_new_status;
2435 }

2437 /**

2441  *
2442  * @return bool
2443  *

2446 function bug_clear_cache_all( $p_bug_id = null ) {
2447 	bug_clear_cache( $p_bug_id );
2448 	bug_text_clear_cache( $p_bug_id );
2449 	file_bug_attachment_count_clear_cache( $p_bug_id );
2450 	bugnote_clear_bug_cache( $p_bug_id );
2451 	tag_clear_cache_bug_tags( $p_bug_id );
2452 	custom_field_clear_cache_values( $p_bug_id );
2453 	bug_attachments_clear_cache( $p_bug_id );
2454 
2455 	$t_plugin_objects = columns_get_plugin_columns();
2456 	foreach( $t_plugin_objects as $t_plugin_column ) {
2457 		$t_plugin_column->clear_cache();
2458 	}

2462 /**
2463  * Populate the caches related to the selected columns.
2464  *
2465  * @param BugData[] $p_bugs         Array of BugData objects
2466  * @param array $p_selected_columns Array of columns to show
2467  */
2468 function bug_cache_columns_data( array $p_bugs, array $p_selected_columns ) {
2469 	$t_bug_ids = array();
2470 	$t_user_ids = array();
2471 	$t_project_ids = array();
2472 	$t_category_ids = array();
2473 	foreach( $p_bugs as $t_bug ) {
2474 		$t_bug_ids[] = (int)$t_bug->id;
2475 		$t_user_ids[] = (int)$t_bug->handler_id;
2476 		$t_user_ids[] = (int)$t_bug->reporter_id;
2477 		$t_project_ids[] = (int)$t_bug->project_id;
2478 		$t_category_ids[] = (int)$t_bug->category_id;
2479 	}
2480 	$t_user_ids = array_unique( $t_user_ids );
2481 	$t_project_ids = array_unique( $t_project_ids );
2482 	$t_category_ids = array_unique( $t_category_ids );
2483 
2484 	$t_custom_field_ids = array();
2485 	$t_users_cached = false;
2486 	foreach( $p_selected_columns as $t_column ) {
2487 
2488 		if( column_is_plugin_column( $t_column ) ) {
2489 			$plugin_objects = columns_get_plugin_columns();
2490 			$plugin_objects[$t_column]->cache( $p_bugs );
2491 			continue;
2492 		}
2493 
2494 		if( column_is_custom_field( $t_column ) ) {
2495 			$t_cf_name = column_get_custom_field_name( $t_column );
2496 			$t_cf_id = custom_field_get_id_from_name( $t_cf_name );
2497 			if( $t_cf_id ) {
2498 				$t_custom_field_ids[] = $t_cf_id;
2499 				continue;
2500 			}
2501 		}
2502 
2503 		switch( $t_column ) {
2504 			case 'attachment_count':
2505 				file_bug_attachment_count_cache( $t_bug_ids );
2506 				break;
2507 			case 'handler_id':
2508 			case 'reporter_id':
2509 			case 'status':
2510 				if( !$t_users_cached ) {
2511 					user_cache_array_rows( $t_user_ids );
2512 					$t_users_cached = true;
2513 				}
2514 				break;
2515 			case 'project_id':
2516 				project_cache_array_rows( $t_project_ids );
2517 				break;
2518 			case 'category_id':
2519 				category_cache_array_rows( $t_category_ids );
2520 				break;
2521 			case 'tags':
2522 				tag_cache_bug_tag_rows( $t_bug_ids );
2523 				break;
2524 		}
2525 	}
2526 
2527 	if( !empty( $t_custom_field_ids ) ) {
2528 		custom_field_cache_values( $t_bug_ids, $t_custom_field_ids );
2529 	}
2530 }

  43 /**
  44  * Initialise bug action group api
  45  * @param string $p_action Custom action to run.
  46  * @return void
  47  */
  48 function bug_group_action_init( $p_action ) {
  49 	$t_valid_actions = bug_group_action_get_commands( current_user_get_accessible_projects() );
  50 	$t_action = strtoupper( $p_action );
  51 
  52 	if( !isset( $t_valid_actions[$t_action] ) &&
  53 		!isset( $t_valid_actions['EXT_' . $t_action] )
  54 		) {
  55 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
  56 	}
  57 
  58 	$t_include_file = config_get_global( 'absolute_path' ) . 'bug_actiongroup_' . $p_action . '_inc.php';
  59 	if( !file_exists( $t_include_file ) ) {
  60 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
  61 	} else {
  62 		require_once( $t_include_file );
  63 	}
  64 }

 105 /**

 109  *
 110  * @return void

 112 function bug_group_action_print_results( array $p_failed_ids ) {
 113 	$t_format = "<tr>"
 114 		. "\n\t" . '<td width="50%%">%s' . lang_get( 'word_separator' ) . '%s</td>'
 115 		. "\n\t" . '<td>%s</td>'
 116 		. "\n</tr>\n";
 117 	$t_label = lang_get( 'label' );
 118 
 119 	echo '<div><br />', PHP_EOL;

 121 	echo '<table class="table table-bordered table-condensed table-striped">', PHP_EOL;
 122 
 123 	foreach( $p_failed_ids as $t_id => $t_reason ) {
 124 		printf( $t_format,
 125 			sprintf( $t_label, string_get_bug_view_link( $t_id ) ),
 126 			string_display_line( bug_get_field( $t_id, 'summary' ) ),
 127 			$t_reason
 128 		);
 129 	}
 130 	echo '</table>', PHP_EOL;
 131 	echo '</div>', PHP_EOL;
 132 
 133 	print_link_button( 'view_all_bug_page.php', lang_get( 'proceed' ) );
 134 	echo '</div>', PHP_EOL;

 202 /**
 203  * Get a list of bug group actions available to the current user for one or
 204  * more projects.
 205  *
 206  * @param array $p_project_ids An array containing one or more project IDs.
 207  *
 208  * @return array
 209  */
 210 function bug_group_action_get_commands( array $p_project_ids = [] ) {
 211 	if( empty( $p_project_ids ) ) {
 212 		$p_project_ids = array( ALL_PROJECTS );
 213 	}
 214 
 215 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 216 
 217 	$t_commands = array();
 218 	version_cache_array_rows( $p_project_ids );
 219 	foreach( $p_project_ids as $t_project_id ) {
 220 
 221 		$t_update_bug_allowed = access_has_project_level( config_get( 'update_bug_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id );
 222 		$t_update_bug_status_allowed = access_has_project_level( config_get( 'update_bug_status_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id );
 223 
 224 		if( !isset( $t_commands['MOVE'] ) &&
 225 			user_has_more_than_one_project( $t_user_id ) &&
 226 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'move_bug_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 227 			$t_commands['MOVE'] = lang_get( 'move' );
 228 		}
 229 
 230 		if( !isset( $t_commands['COPY'] ) &&
 231 			access_has_any_project_level( 'report_bug_threshold' ) ) {
 232 			$t_commands['COPY'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_copy' );
 233 		}
 234 
 235 		if( !isset( $t_commands['ASSIGN'] ) &&
 236 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'update_bug_assign_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 237 			$t_commands['ASSIGN'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_assign' );
 238 		}
 239 
 240 		if( !isset( $t_commands['RESOLVE'] ) && $t_update_bug_status_allowed &&
 241 			access_has_project_level( access_get_status_threshold( config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 242 			$t_commands['RESOLVE'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_resolve' );
 243 		}
 244 
 245 		if( !isset( $t_commands['CLOSE'] ) && $t_update_bug_status_allowed &&
 246 			( access_has_project_level( access_get_status_threshold( config_get( 'bug_closed_status_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ||
 247 				access_has_project_level( config_get( 'allow_reporter_close', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) ) {
 248 			$t_commands['CLOSE'] = lang_get( 'close' );
 249 		}
 250 
 251 		if( !isset( $t_commands['UP_STATUS'] ) && $t_update_bug_status_allowed ) {
 252 			$t_commands['UP_STATUS'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_status' );
 253 		}
 254 
 255 		if( !isset( $t_commands['EXT_ADD_NOTE'] ) &&
 256 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'add_bugnote_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 257 			$t_commands['EXT_ADD_NOTE'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_add_note' );
 258 		}
 259 
 260 		if( !isset( $t_commands['EXT_ATTACH_TAGS'] ) &&
 261 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'tag_attach_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 262 			$t_commands['EXT_ATTACH_TAGS'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_attach_tags' );
 263 		}
 264 
 265 		if( !isset( $t_commands['SET_STICKY'] ) &&
 266 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'set_bug_sticky_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 267 			$t_commands['SET_STICKY'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_set_sticky' );
 268 		}
 269 
 270 		if( !isset( $t_commands['UP_PRIOR'] ) && $t_update_bug_allowed ) {
 271 			$t_commands['UP_PRIOR'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_priority' );
 272 		}
 273 
 274 		if( !isset( $t_commands['EXT_UPDATE_SEVERITY'] ) && $t_update_bug_allowed ) {
 275 			$t_commands['EXT_UPDATE_SEVERITY'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_severity' );
 276 		}
 277 
 278 		if( !isset( $t_commands['UP_CATEGORY'] ) && $t_update_bug_allowed ) {
 279 			$t_commands['UP_CATEGORY'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_category' );
 280 		}
 281 
 282 		if( !isset( $t_commands['VIEW_STATUS'] ) &&
 283 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'change_view_status_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 284 			$t_commands['VIEW_STATUS'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_view_status' );
 285 		}
 286 
 287 		if( !isset( $t_commands['EXT_UPDATE_PRODUCT_BUILD'] ) &&
 288 			config_get( 'enable_product_build', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ) == ON &&
 289 			$t_update_bug_allowed ) {
 290 			$t_commands['EXT_UPDATE_PRODUCT_BUILD'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_product_build' );
 291 		}
 292 
 293 		if( !isset( $t_commands['UP_DUE_DATE'] ) &&
 294 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'due_date_update_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 295 			$t_commands['UP_DUE_DATE'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_due_date' );
 296 		}
 297 
 298 		if( !isset( $t_commands['UP_PRODUCT_VERSION'] ) &&
 299 			version_should_show_product_version( $t_project_id ) && $t_update_bug_allowed ) {
 300 			$t_commands['UP_PRODUCT_VERSION'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_product_version' );
 301 		}
 302 
 303 		if( !isset( $t_commands['UP_FIXED_IN_VERSION'] ) &&
 304 			version_should_show_product_version( $t_project_id ) && $t_update_bug_allowed ) {
 305 			$t_commands['UP_FIXED_IN_VERSION'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_fixed_in_version' );
 306 		}
 307 
 308 		if( !isset( $t_commands['UP_TARGET_VERSION'] ) &&
 309 			version_should_show_product_version( $t_project_id ) &&
 310 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'roadmap_update_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 311 			$t_commands['UP_TARGET_VERSION'] = lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_target_version' );
 312 		}
 313 
 314 		if ( $t_update_bug_allowed ) {
 315 			$t_custom_field_ids = custom_field_get_linked_ids( $t_project_id );
 316 			foreach( $t_custom_field_ids as $t_custom_field_id ) {
 317 				if( custom_field_has_write_access_to_project( $t_custom_field_id, $t_project_id ) ) {
 318 					$t_custom_field_def = custom_field_get_definition( $t_custom_field_id );
 319 					$t_command_id = 'custom_field_' . $t_custom_field_id;
 320 					$t_command_caption = sprintf( lang_get( 'actiongroup_menu_update_field' ), lang_get_defaulted( $t_custom_field_def['name'] ) );
 321 					$t_commands[$t_command_id] = string_display_line( $t_command_caption );
 322 				}
 323 			}
 324 		}
 325 
 326 		if( !isset( $t_commands['DELETE'] ) &&
 327 			access_has_project_level( config_get( 'delete_bug_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 328 			$t_commands['DELETE'] = lang_get( 'delete' );
 329 		}
 330 
 331 	}
 332 
 333 	$t_custom_group_actions = config_get( 'custom_group_actions' );
 334 
 335 	foreach( $t_custom_group_actions as $t_custom_group_action ) {
 336 		# use label if provided to get the localized text, otherwise fallback to action name.
 337 		if( isset( $t_custom_group_action['label'] ) ) {
 338 			$t_commands[$t_custom_group_action['action']] = lang_get_defaulted( $t_custom_group_action['label'] );
 339 		} else {
 340 			$t_commands[$t_custom_group_action['action']] = lang_get_defaulted( $t_custom_group_action['action'] );
 341 		}
 342 	}
 343 
 344 	return $t_commands;
 345 }

  17 /**

  29 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );

  32 /**
  33  * Add a new revision to a bug history.
  34  * @param integer $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
  35  * @param integer $p_user_id    User ID.
  36  * @param integer $p_type       Revision Type.
  37  * @param string  $p_value      Value.
  38  * @param integer $p_bugnote_id A Bugnote ID.
  39  * @param integer $p_timestamp  Integer Timestamp.
  40  * @return int|null Revision ID
  41  */
  42 function bug_revision_add( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id, $p_type, $p_value, $p_bugnote_id = 0, $p_timestamp = null ) {
  43 	if( $p_type <= REV_ANY ) {
  44 		return null;
  45 	}
  46 
  47 	$t_last = bug_revision_last( $p_bug_id, $p_type );
  48 
  49 	# Don't save a revision twice if nothing has changed
  50 	if( !is_null( $t_last ) &&
  51 		$p_value == $t_last['value'] ) {
  52 
  53 		return $t_last['id'];
  54 	}
  55 
  56 	if( $p_timestamp === null ) {
  57 		$t_timestamp = db_now();
  58 	} else {
  59 		$t_timestamp = $p_timestamp;
  60 	}
  61 
  62 	db_param_push();
  63 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_revision} (
  64 			bug_id, bugnote_id, user_id,
  65 			timestamp, type, value
  66 		) VALUES ( ' .
  67 			db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' .
  68 			db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
  69 	db_query( $t_query, array(
  70 			$p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_id, $p_user_id,
  71 			$t_timestamp, $p_type, $p_value ) );
  72 
  73 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'bug_revision' ) );
  74 }
  75 
  76 /**
  77  * Check if a bug revision exists
  78  * @param integer $p_revision_id A bug revision identifier.
  79  * @return boolean Whether or not the bug revision exists
  80  */
  81 function bug_revision_exists( $p_revision_id ) {
  82 	db_param_push();
  83 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {bug_revision} WHERE id=' . db_param();
  84 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_revision_id ) );
  85 
  86 	if( !db_result( $t_result ) ) {
  87 		return false;
  88 	}
  89 
  90 	return true;
  91 }

  93 /**
  94  * Get a row of data for a given revision ID.
  95  * @param integer $p_revision_id A bug revision identifier.
  96  * @return array Revision data row

  98 function bug_revision_get( $p_revision_id ) {

 100 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_revision} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 101 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_revision_id ) );

 103 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 104 	if( !$t_row ) {
 105 		trigger_error( ERROR_BUG_REVISION_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 106 	}
 107 
 108 	return $t_row;
 109 }

 111 /**
 112  * Get the name of the type of a bug revision.
 113  * @param integer $p_revision_type_id A bug revision type ID (see constant_inc.php for possible values).
 114  * @return string Name of the type of the bug revision
 115  */
 116 function bug_revision_get_type_name( $p_revision_type_id ) {
 117 	$t_type_name = '';
 118 	switch( $p_revision_type_id ) {
 119 		case REV_DESCRIPTION:
 120 			$t_type_name = lang_get( 'description' );
 121 			break;
 122 		case REV_STEPS_TO_REPRODUCE:
 123 			$t_type_name = lang_get( 'steps_to_reproduce' );
 124 			break;
 125 		case REV_ADDITIONAL_INFO:
 126 			$t_type_name = lang_get( 'additional_information' );
 127 			break;
 128 		case REV_BUGNOTE:
 129 			$t_type_name = lang_get( 'bugnote' );
 130 			break;
 131 	}
 132 	return $t_type_name;
 133 }

 135 /**
 136  * Remove one or more bug revisions from the bug history.
 137  * @param integer $p_revision_id A bug revision identifier, or array of revision identifiers.
 138  * @return void
 139  */
 140 function bug_revision_drop( $p_revision_id ) {
 141 	db_param_push();
 142 
 143 	if( is_array( $p_revision_id ) ) {
 144 		$t_revisions = array();
 145 		$t_first = true;
 146 		$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_revision} WHERE id IN ( ';
 147 
 148 		# TODO: Fetch bug revisions in one query (and cache them)
 149 		foreach( $p_revision_id as $t_rev_id ) {
 150 			$t_query .= ( $t_first ? db_param() : ', ' . db_param() );
 151 			$t_revisions[$t_rev_id] = bug_revision_get( $t_rev_id );
 152 		}
 153 
 154 		$t_query .= ' )';
 155 		db_query( $t_query, $p_revision_id );
 156 		foreach( $p_revision_id as $t_rev_id ) {
 157 			if( $t_revisions[$t_rev_id]['type'] == REV_BUGNOTE ) {
 158 				history_log_event_special( $t_revisions[$t_rev_id]['bug_id'], BUGNOTE_REVISION_DROPPED, bugnote_format_id( $t_rev_id ), $t_revisions[$t_rev_id]['bugnote_id'] );
 159 			} else {
 160 				history_log_event_special( $t_revisions[$t_rev_id]['bug_id'], BUG_REVISION_DROPPED, bugnote_format_id( $t_rev_id ), $t_revisions[$t_rev_id]['type'] );
 161 			}
 162 		}
 163 	} else {
 164 		$t_revision = bug_revision_get( $p_revision_id );
 165 		$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_revision} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 166 		db_query( $t_query, array( $p_revision_id ) );
 167 		if( $t_revision['type'] == REV_BUGNOTE ) {
 168 			history_log_event_special( $t_revision['bug_id'], BUGNOTE_REVISION_DROPPED, bugnote_format_id( $p_revision_id ), $t_revision['bugnote_id'] );
 169 		} else {
 170 			history_log_event_special( $t_revision['bug_id'], BUG_REVISION_DROPPED, bugnote_format_id( $p_revision_id ), $t_revision['type'] );
 171 		}
 172 	}
 173 }

 175 /**
 176  * Retrieve a count of revisions to the bug's information.
 177  * @param integer $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
 178  * @param integer $p_type       Revision Type (optional).
 179  * @param integer $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier (optional).
 180  * @return array|null Array of Revision rows
 181  */
 182 function bug_revision_count( $p_bug_id, $p_type = REV_ANY, $p_bugnote_id = 0 ) {
 183 	db_param_push();
 184 	$t_params = array( $p_bug_id );
 185 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(id) FROM {bug_revision} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 186 
 187 	if( REV_ANY < $p_type ) {
 188 		$t_query .= ' AND type=' . db_param();
 189 		$t_params[] = $p_type;
 190 	}
 191 
 192 	if( $p_bugnote_id > 0 ) {
 193 		$t_query .= ' AND bugnote_id=' . db_param();
 194 		$t_params[] = $p_bugnote_id;
 195 	} else {
 196 		$t_query .= ' AND bugnote_id=0';
 197 	}
 198 
 199 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 200 
 201 	return db_result( $t_result );
 202 }

 204 /**
 205  * Delete all revision history for a bug.
 206  * @param integer $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
 207  * @param integer $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier (optional).
 208  * @return void
 209  */
 210 function bug_revision_delete( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_id = 0 ) {
 211 	db_param_push();
 212 	if( $p_bugnote_id < 1 ) {
 213 		$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_revision} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 214 		db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 215 	} else {
 216 		$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_revision} WHERE bugnote_id=' . db_param();
 217 		db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bugnote_id ) );
 218 	}
 219 }

 221 /**
 222  * Retrieve the last change to the bug's information.
 223  * @param integer $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
 224  * @param integer $p_type       Revision Type (optional).
 225  * @param integer $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier (optional).
 226  * @return null|array Revision row
 227  */
 228 function bug_revision_last( $p_bug_id, $p_type = REV_ANY, $p_bugnote_id = 0 ) {
 229 	db_param_push();
 230 	$t_params = array( $p_bug_id );
 231 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_revision} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 232 
 233 	if( REV_ANY < $p_type ) {
 234 		$t_query .= ' AND type=' . db_param();
 235 		$t_params[] = $p_type;
 236 	}
 237 
 238 	if( $p_bugnote_id > 0 ) {
 239 		$t_query .= ' AND bugnote_id=' . db_param();
 240 		$t_params[] = $p_bugnote_id;
 241 	} else {
 242 		$t_query .= ' AND bugnote_id=0';
 243 	}
 244 
 245 	$t_query .= ' ORDER BY timestamp DESC';
 246 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params, 1 );
 247 
 248 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 249 	if( $t_row ) {
 250 		return $t_row;
 251 	} else {
 252 		return null;
 253 	}
 254 }

 256 /**
 257  * Retrieve a full list of changes to the bug's information.
 258  * @param integer $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
 259  * @param integer $p_type       Revision Type.
 260  * @param integer $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier.
 261  * @return array/null Array of Revision rows

 263 function bug_revision_list( $p_bug_id, $p_type = REV_ANY, $p_bugnote_id = 0 ) {
 264 	db_param_push();
 265 	$t_params = array( $p_bug_id );
 266 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_revision} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 267 
 268 	if( REV_ANY < $p_type ) {
 269 		$t_query .= ' AND type=' . db_param();
 270 		$t_params[] = $p_type;
 271 	}
 272 
 273 	if( $p_bugnote_id > 0 ) {
 274 		$t_query .= ' AND bugnote_id=' . db_param();
 275 		$t_params[] = $p_bugnote_id;
 276 	} else {
 277 		$t_query .= ' AND bugnote_id=0';
 278 	}
 279 
 280 	$t_query .= ' ORDER BY id DESC';

 282 
 283 	$t_revisions = array();
 284 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 285 		$t_revisions[$t_row['id']] = $t_row;

 288 	return $t_revisions;

  67 # Cache of bugnotes arrays related to a bug, indexed by bug_id.
  68 # Each item is an array of BugnoteData objects
  69 $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id = array();
  70 
  71 # Cache of BugnoteData objects, indexed by bugnote id
  72 $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id = array();
  73 
  74 /**
  75  * Bugnote Data Structure Definition
  76  */
  77 class BugnoteData {
  78 	/**
  79 	 * Bugnote ID
  80 	 */
  81 	public $id;
  82 
  83 	/**
  84 	 * Bug ID
  85 	 */
  86 	public $bug_id;
  87 
  88 	/**
  89 	 * Reporter ID
  90 	 */
  91 	public $reporter_id;
  92 
  93 	/**
  94 	 * Note text
  95 	 */
  96 	public $note;
  97 
  98 	/**
  99 	 * View State
 100 	 */
 101 	public $view_state;
 102 
 103 	/**
 104 	 * Date submitted
 105 	 */
 106 	public $date_submitted;
 107 
 108 	/**
 109 	 * Last Modified
 110 	 */
 111 	public $last_modified;
 112 
 113 	/**
 114 	 * Bugnote type
 115 	 */
 116 	public $note_type;
 117 
 118 	/**
 119 	 * Used for storing list of recipients for a reminder truncated to
 120 	 * field length.
 121 	 */
 122 	public $note_attr;
 123 
 124 	/**
 125 	 * Time tracking information
 126 	 */
 127 	public $time_tracking;
 128 
 129 	/**
 130 	 * Bugnote Text id
 131 	 */
 132 	public $bugnote_text_id;
 133 }

 135 /**
 136  * Check if a bugnote with the given ID exists.
 137  *
 138  * @param int $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier.
 139  *
 140  * @return bool True if the bugnote exists, false otherwise.
 141  *
 142  * @access public
 143  */
 144 function bugnote_exists( $p_bugnote_id ) {
 145 	$c_bugnote_id = (int)$p_bugnote_id;
 146 
 147 	global $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id;
 148 	if( isset( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[$c_bugnote_id] ) ) {
 149 		return true;
 150 	}
 151 
 152 	# Check for invalid id values
 153 	if( $c_bugnote_id <= 0 || $c_bugnote_id > DB_MAX_INT ) {
 154 		return false;
 155 	}
 156 
 157 	db_param_push();
 158 	$t_query = 'SELECT b.*, t.note
 159 				FROM {bugnote} b
 160 				LEFT JOIN {bugnote_text} t ON b.bugnote_text_id = t.id
 161 				WHERE b.id = ' . db_param();
 162 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bugnote_id ) );
 163 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 164 
 165 	if( $t_row === false ) {
 166 		return false;
 167 	}
 168 
 169 	$t_bugnote = bugnote_row_to_object( $t_row );
 170 	bugnote_cache( $t_bugnote );
 171 	return true;
 172 }
 173 
 174 /**
 175  * Caches the provided bugnote object.
 176  *
 177  * @param BugnoteData $p_bugnote The bugnote object.
 178  * @return void
 179  */
 180 function bugnote_cache( BugnoteData $p_bugnote ) {
 181 	global $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id;
 182 
 183 	$g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[(int)$p_bugnote->id] = $p_bugnote;
 184 }

 186 /**
 187  * Check if a bugnote with the given ID exists.
 188  *
 189  * @param int $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier.
 190  *
 191  * @return void
 192  * @throws ClientException if bugnote does not exist
 193  *
 194  * @access public
 195  */
 196 function bugnote_ensure_exists( $p_bugnote_id ) {
 197 	if( !bugnote_exists( $p_bugnote_id ) ) {
 198 		throw new ClientException(
 199 			"Issue note #$p_bugnote_id not found",
 200 			ERROR_BUGNOTE_NOT_FOUND,
 201 			array( $p_bugnote_id ) );
 202 	}
 203 }

 216 function bugnote_is_user_reporter( $p_bugnote_id, $p_user_id ) {

 220 /**
 221  * Add a bugnote to a bug.
 222  *
 223  * @param int    $p_bug_id          A bug identifier.
 224  * @param string $p_bugnote_text    The bugnote text to add.
 225  * @param string $p_time_tracking   Time tracking value - hh:mm string.
 226  * @param bool   $p_private         Whether bugnote is private.
 227  * @param int    $p_type            The bugnote type.
 228  * @param string $p_attr            Bugnote Attribute.
 229  * @param int    $p_user_id         A user identifier.
 230  * @param bool   $p_send_email      Whether to generate email.
 231  * @param int    $p_date_submitted  Date submitted (defaults to now()).
 232  * @param int    $p_last_modified   Last modification date (defaults to now()).
 233  * @param bool   $p_skip_bug_update Skip bug last modification update (useful when importing bugs/bugnotes).
 234  * @param bool   $p_log_history     Log changes to bugnote history (defaults to true).
 235  * @param bool   $p_trigger_event   Trigger extensibility event.
 236  *
 237  * @return int ID of the new bugnote
 238  * @throws ClientException
 239  *
 240  * @access public
 241  */
 242 function bugnote_add( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_text, $p_time_tracking = '0:00', $p_private = false, $p_type = BUGNOTE, $p_attr = '', $p_user_id = null, $p_send_email = true, $p_date_submitted = 0, $p_last_modified = 0, $p_skip_bug_update = false, $p_log_history = true, $p_trigger_event = true ) {
 243 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
 244 	$c_time_tracking = helper_duration_to_minutes( $p_time_tracking );
 245 	$c_type = (int)$p_type;
 246 	$c_date_submitted = $p_date_submitted <= 0 ? db_now() : (int)$p_date_submitted;
 247 	$c_last_modified = $p_last_modified <= 0 ? db_now() : (int)$p_last_modified;
 248 
 249 	antispam_check();
 250 
 251 	if( REMINDER !== $p_type ) {
 252 		# Check if this is a time-tracking note
 253 		$t_time_tracking_enabled = config_get( 'time_tracking_enabled' );
 254 		if( ON == $t_time_tracking_enabled && $c_time_tracking > 0 ) {
 255 			$t_time_tracking_without_note = config_get( 'time_tracking_without_note' );
 256 			if( is_blank( $p_bugnote_text ) && OFF == $t_time_tracking_without_note ) {
 257 				throw new ClientException(
 258 					'Time tracking not allowed with empty note',
 259 					ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD,
 260 					array( lang_get( 'bugnote' ) ) );
 261 			}
 262 
 263 			$c_type = TIME_TRACKING;
 264 		}
 265 	}
 266 
 267 	# Event integration
 268 	$t_bugnote_text = event_signal( 'EVENT_BUGNOTE_DATA', $p_bugnote_text, $c_bug_id );
 269 
 270 	helper_ensure_longtext_length_valid( $t_bugnote_text, 'bugnote' );
 271 
 272 	# MySQL 4-bytes UTF-8 chars workaround #21101
 273 	$t_bugnote_text = db_mysql_fix_utf8( $t_bugnote_text );
 274 
 275 	# insert bugnote text
 276 	db_param_push();
 277 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bugnote_text} ( note ) VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ' )';
 278 	db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bugnote_text ) );
 279 
 280 	# retrieve bugnote text id number
 281 	$t_bugnote_text_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'bugnote_text' ) );
 282 
 283 	# get user information
 284 	if( $p_user_id === null ) {
 285 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 286 	}
 287 
 288 	# Check for private bugnotes.
 289 	if( $p_private && access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'set_view_status_threshold' ), $p_bug_id, $p_user_id ) ) {
 290 		$t_view_state = VS_PRIVATE;
 291 	} else {
 292 		$t_view_state = VS_PUBLIC;
 293 	}
 294 
 295 	# insert bugnote info
 296 	db_param_push();
 297 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bugnote}
 298 			(bug_id, reporter_id, bugnote_text_id, view_state, date_submitted, last_modified, note_type, note_attr, time_tracking)
 299 		VALUES ('
 300 		. db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', '
 301 		. db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', '
 302 		. db_param() . ' )';
 303 	$t_params = array(
 304 		$c_bug_id, $p_user_id, $t_bugnote_text_id, $t_view_state,
 305 		$c_date_submitted, $c_last_modified, $c_type, $p_attr,
 306 		$c_time_tracking );
 307 	db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 308 
 309 	# get bugnote id
 310 	$t_bugnote_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'bugnote' ) );
 311 
 312 	# update bug last updated
 313 	if( !$p_skip_bug_update ) {
 314 		bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
 315 	}
 316 
 317 	# log new bug
 318 	if( $p_log_history ) {
 319 		history_log_event_special( $p_bug_id, BUGNOTE_ADDED, bugnote_format_id( $t_bugnote_id ) );
 320 	}
 321 
 322 	# Event integration
 323 	if( $p_trigger_event ) {
 324 		event_signal( 'EVENT_BUGNOTE_ADD', array( $p_bug_id, $t_bugnote_id, array() ) );
 325 	}
 326 
 327 	# only send email if the text is not blank, otherwise, it is just recording of time without a comment.
 328 	if( $p_send_email && !is_blank( $t_bugnote_text ) ) {
 329 		email_bugnote_add( $t_bugnote_id );
 330 	}
 331 
 332 	return $t_bugnote_id;
 333 }
 334 
 335 /**
 336  * Process mentions in bugnote, typically after its added.
 337  *
 338  * @param int    $p_bug_id       The bug id
 339  * @param int    $p_bugnote_id   The bugnote id
 340  * @param string $p_bugnote_text The bugnote text
 341  *
 342  * @return array User ids that received mentioned emails.
 343  * @access public
 344  */
 345 function bugnote_process_mentions( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_id, $p_bugnote_text ) {
 346 	# Process the mentions that have access to the issue note
 347 	$t_mentioned_user_ids = mention_get_users( $p_bugnote_text );
 348 	$t_filtered_mentioned_user_ids = access_has_bugnote_level_filter(
 349 		config_get( 'view_bug_threshold' ),
 350 		$p_bugnote_id,
 351 		$t_mentioned_user_ids );
 352 
 353 	$t_removed_mentions_user_ids = array_diff( $t_mentioned_user_ids, $t_filtered_mentioned_user_ids );
 354 
 355 	return mention_process_user_mentions(
 356 		$p_bug_id,
 357 		$t_filtered_mentioned_user_ids,
 358 		$p_bugnote_text,
 359 		$t_removed_mentions_user_ids );
 360 }

 362 /**
 363  * Delete a bugnote.
 364  *
 365  * @param int $p_bugnote_id A bug note identifier.
 366  *
 367  * @return bool
 368  * @throws ClientException
 369  *
 370  * @access public
 371  */
 372 function bugnote_delete( $p_bugnote_id ) {
 373 	$t_bug_id = bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'bug_id' );
 374 	$t_bugnote_text_id = bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'bugnote_text_id' );
 375 
 376 	# Remove the bugnote
 377 	db_param_push();
 378 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bugnote} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 379 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bugnote_id ) );
 380 
 381 	# Remove the bugnote text
 382 	db_param_push();
 383 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bugnote_text} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 384 	db_query( $t_query, array( $t_bugnote_text_id ) );
 385 
 386 	# Update the last_updated date
 387 	bug_update_date( $t_bug_id );
 388 
 389 	# log deletion of bug
 390 	history_log_event_special( $t_bug_id, BUGNOTE_DELETED, bugnote_format_id( $p_bugnote_id ) );
 391 
 392 	# Delete attachments linked to bugnote in the db (i.e. bugnote_id is set)
 393 	file_delete_bugnote_attachments( $t_bug_id, $p_bugnote_id );
 394 
 395 	# Event integration
 396 	event_signal( 'EVENT_BUGNOTE_DELETED', array( $t_bug_id, $p_bugnote_id ) );
 397 
 398 	return true;
 399 }

 409 function bugnote_delete_all( $p_bug_id ) {

 482 /**
 483  * List the bugnotes for the given bug that are visible by the specified user.
 484  *
 485  * Bugnotes are sorted by date_submitted according to 'bugnote_order'
 486  * configuration setting.
 487  *
 488  * @param int $p_bug_id             A bug identifier.
 489  * @param int $p_user_bugnote_order Sort order.
 490  * @param int $p_user_bugnote_limit Number of bugnotes to display to user.
 491  * @param int $p_user_id            A user identifier.
 492  *
 493  * @return BugnoteData[] Bugnotes with raw values from the database
 494  * @throws ClientException
 495  *
 496  * @access public
 497  */
 498 function bugnote_get_all_visible_bugnotes( $p_bug_id, $p_user_bugnote_order, $p_user_bugnote_limit, $p_user_id = null ) {
 499 	if( $p_user_id === null ) {
 500 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 501 	} else {
 502 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id;
 503 	}
 504 
 505 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 506 	$t_user_access_level = user_get_access_level( $t_user_id, $t_project_id );
 507 
 508 	$t_all_bugnotes = bugnote_get_all_bugnotes( $p_bug_id );
 509 
 510 	$t_private_bugnote_visible = access_compare_level( $t_user_access_level, config_get( 'private_bugnote_threshold' ) );
 511 	$t_time_tracking_visible = access_compare_level( $t_user_access_level, config_get( 'time_tracking_view_threshold' ) );
 512 
 513 	$t_bugnotes = array();
 514 	$t_bugnote_count = count( $t_all_bugnotes );
 515 	$t_bugnote_limit = $p_user_bugnote_limit > 0 ? $p_user_bugnote_limit : $t_bugnote_count;
 516 	$t_bugnotes_found = 0;
 517 
 518 	# build a list of the latest bugnotes that the user can see
 519 	for( $i = 0; ( $i < $t_bugnote_count ) && ( $t_bugnotes_found < $t_bugnote_limit ); $i++ ) {
 520 		$t_bugnote = array_pop( $t_all_bugnotes );
 521 
 522 		if( $t_private_bugnote_visible || $t_bugnote->reporter_id == $t_user_id || ( VS_PUBLIC == $t_bugnote->view_state ) ) {
 523 			# If the access level specified is not enough to see time tracking information
 524 			# then reset it to 0.
 525 			if( !$t_time_tracking_visible ) {
 526 				$t_bugnote->time_tracking = 0;
 527 			}
 528 
 529 			$t_bugnotes[$t_bugnotes_found++] = $t_bugnote;
 530 		}
 531 	}
 532 
 533 	# reverse the list for users with ascending view preferences
 534 	if( 'ASC' == $p_user_bugnote_order ) {
 535 		$t_bugnotes = array_reverse( $t_bugnotes );
 536 	}
 537 
 538 	return $t_bugnotes;
 539 }
 540 
 541 /**
 542  * Build a string that captures all the notes visible to the logged-in user
 543  * along with their metadata.
 544  *
 545  * The string will contain information about each note including reporter,
 546  * timestamp, time tracking, view state. This will result in multi-line string
 547  * with "\n" as the line separator.
 548  *
 549  * @param int $p_bug_id             A bug identifier.
 550  * @param int $p_user_bugnote_order Sort order.
 551  * @param int $p_user_bugnote_limit Number of bugnotes to display to user.
 552  * @param int $p_user_id            A user identifier.
 553  *
 554  * @return string The string containing all visible notes.
 555  * @throws ClientException
 556  * @access public
 557  */
 558 function bugnote_get_all_visible_as_string( $p_bug_id, $p_user_bugnote_order, $p_user_bugnote_limit, $p_user_id = null ) {
 559 	$t_notes = bugnote_get_all_visible_bugnotes( $p_bug_id, $p_user_bugnote_order, $p_user_bugnote_limit, $p_user_id );
 560 	$t_date_format = config_get( 'normal_date_format' );
 561 	$t_show_time_tracking = access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'time_tracking_view_threshold' ), $p_bug_id );
 562 
 563 	$t_output = '';
 564 
 565 	foreach( $t_notes as $t_note ) {
 566 		$t_note_string = '@' . user_get_name( $t_note->reporter_id );
 567 		if ( $t_note->view_state != VS_PUBLIC ) {
 568 			$t_note_string .= ' (' . lang_get( 'private' ) . ')';
 569 		}
 570 
 571 		$t_note_string .= ' ' . date( $t_date_format, $t_note->date_submitted );
 572 
 573 		if ( $t_show_time_tracking && $t_note->note_type == TIME_TRACKING ) {
 574 			$t_time_tracking_hhmm = db_minutes_to_hhmm( $t_note->time_tracking );
 575 			$t_note_string .= ' ' . lang_get( 'time_tracking_time_spent' ) . ' ' . $t_time_tracking_hhmm;
 576 		}
 577 
 578 		$t_note_string .= "\n" . $t_note->note . "\n";
 579 
 580 		if ( !empty( $t_output ) ) {
 581 			# Use a marker that doesn't confuse Markdown parser.
 582 			# `---` or `===` would mark previous line as a header.
 583 			$t_output .= "=-=\n";
 584 		}
 585 
 586 		$t_output .= $t_note_string;
 587 	}
 588 
 589 	return $t_output;
 590 }

 592 /**
 593  * Converts a bugnote database row to a bugnote object.
 594  *
 595  * @param array $p_row The bugnote row (including bugnote_text note)
 596  *
 597  * @return BugnoteData The bugnote object.
 598  * @access private
 599  */
 600 function bugnote_row_to_object( array $p_row ) {
 601 	$t_bugnote = new BugnoteData;
 602 
 603 	$t_bugnote->id = $p_row['id'];
 604 	$t_bugnote->bug_id = (int)$p_row['bug_id'];
 605 	$t_bugnote->bugnote_text_id = (int)$p_row['bugnote_text_id'];
 606 	$t_bugnote->note = $p_row['note'];
 607 	$t_bugnote->view_state = (int)$p_row['view_state'];
 608 	$t_bugnote->reporter_id = (int)$p_row['reporter_id'];
 609 	$t_bugnote->date_submitted = (int)$p_row['date_submitted'];
 610 	$t_bugnote->last_modified = (int)$p_row['last_modified'];
 611 	$t_bugnote->note_type = (int)$p_row['note_type'];
 612 	$t_bugnote->note_attr = $p_row['note_attr'];
 613 	$t_bugnote->time_tracking = (int)$p_row['time_tracking'];
 614 
 615 	# Handle old bugnotes before setting type to time tracking
 616 	if ( $t_bugnote->time_tracking != 0 ) {
 617 		$t_bugnote->note_type = TIME_TRACKING;
 618 	}
 619 
 620 	return $t_bugnote;
 621 }
 622 
 623 /**
 624  * Build the bugnotes array for the given bug_id.
 625  *
 626  * The data is not filtered by VIEW_STATE !!
 627  *
 628  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
 629  *
 630  * @return BugnoteData[] Bugnotes with raw values from the database
 631  *
 632  * @access public
 633  */
 634 function bugnote_get_all_bugnotes( $p_bug_id ) {
 635 	global $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id;
 636 
 637 	# the cache should be aware of the sorting order
 638 	if( !isset( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id[(int)$p_bug_id] ) ) {
 639 		# Now sorting by submit date and id (#11742). The date_submitted
 640 		# column is currently not indexed, but that does not seem to affect
 641 		# performance in a measurable way
 642 		db_param_push();
 643 		$t_query = 'SELECT b.*, t.note
 644 			          	FROM      {bugnote} b
 645 			          	LEFT JOIN {bugnote_text} t ON b.bugnote_text_id = t.id
 646 						WHERE b.bug_id=' . db_param() . '
 647 						ORDER BY b.date_submitted ASC, b.id ASC';
 648 		$t_bugnotes = array();
 649 
 650 		# BUILD bugnotes array
 651 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 652 
 653 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 654 			$t_bugnote = bugnote_row_to_object( $t_row );
 655 			$t_bugnotes[] = $t_bugnote;
 656 			bugnote_cache( $t_bugnote );
 657 		}
 658 
 659 		$g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id[(int)$p_bug_id] = $t_bugnotes;
 660 	}
 661 
 662 	return $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id[(int)$p_bug_id];
 663 }
 664 
 665 /**
 666  * Gets the bugnote object given its id.
 667  *
 668  * @param int $p_bugnote_id The bugnote id.
 669  *
 670  * @return BugnoteData|void The bugnote object.
 671  * @throws ClientException
 672  */
 673 function bugnote_get( $p_bugnote_id ) {
 674 	# If bugnote exists but not in cache, it will be added to cache.
 675 	# If bugnote doesn't exist, this will trigger an error.
 676 	bugnote_ensure_exists( $p_bugnote_id );
 677 
 678 	global $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id;
 679 
 680 	# Return the object from the cache, fetched above.
 681 	if( isset( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[(int)$p_bugnote_id] ) ) {
 682 		return $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[(int)$p_bugnote_id];
 683 	}
 684 
 685 	# if we reached here something is wrong, trigger an error.
 686 	trigger_error( ERROR_BUGNOTE_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 687 }

 694  *

 697  * @access public
 698  */
 699 function bugnote_set_time_tracking( $p_bugnote_id, $p_time_tracking ) {

 701 
 702 	db_param_push();

 715  */
 716 function bugnote_date_update( $p_bugnote_id ) {

 722 /**
 723  * Set the bugnote text.
 724  *
 725  * @param int    $p_bugnote_id   A bugnote identifier.
 726  * @param string $p_bugnote_text The bugnote text to set.
 727  *
 728  * @return bool
 729  * @throws ClientException
 730  *
 731  * @access public
 732  */
 733 function bugnote_set_text( $p_bugnote_id, $p_bugnote_text ) {
 734 	$t_old_text = bugnote_get_text( $p_bugnote_id );
 735 
 736 	if( $t_old_text == $p_bugnote_text ) {
 737 		return true;
 738 	}
 739 	helper_ensure_longtext_length_valid( $p_bugnote_text, 'bugnote' );
 740 
 741 	# MySQL 4-bytes UTF-8 chars workaround #21101
 742 	$p_bugnote_text = db_mysql_fix_utf8( $p_bugnote_text );
 743 
 744 	$t_bug_id = bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'bug_id' );
 745 	$t_bugnote_text_id = bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'bugnote_text_id' );
 746 
 747 	# insert an 'original' revision if needed
 748 	if( bug_revision_count( $t_bug_id, REV_BUGNOTE, $p_bugnote_id ) < 1 ) {
 749 		$t_user_id = bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'reporter_id' );
 750 		$t_timestamp = bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'last_modified' );
 751 		bug_revision_add( $t_bug_id, $t_user_id, REV_BUGNOTE, $t_old_text, $p_bugnote_id, $t_timestamp );
 752 	}
 753 
 754 	db_param_push();
 755 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bugnote_text} SET note=' . db_param() . ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
 756 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bugnote_text, $t_bugnote_text_id ) );
 757 
 758 	# updated the last_updated date
 759 	bugnote_date_update( $p_bugnote_id );
 760 	bug_update_date( $t_bug_id );
 761 
 762 	# insert a new revision
 763 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 764 	$t_revision_id = bug_revision_add( $t_bug_id, $t_user_id, REV_BUGNOTE, $p_bugnote_text, $p_bugnote_id );
 765 
 766 	# log new bugnote
 767 	history_log_event_special( $t_bug_id, BUGNOTE_UPDATED, bugnote_format_id( $p_bugnote_id ), $t_revision_id );
 768 
 769 	return true;
 770 }
 771 
 772 /**
 773  * Set the view state of the bugnote.
 774  *
 775  * @param int  $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier.
 776  * @param bool $p_private    Whether bugnote should be set to private status.
 777  *
 778  * @return bool
 779  * @throws ClientException
 780  *
 781  * @access public
 782  */
 783 function bugnote_set_view_state( $p_bugnote_id, $p_private ) {
 784 	$t_bug_id = bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'bug_id' );
 785 
 786 	if( $p_private ) {
 787 		$t_view_state = VS_PRIVATE;
 788 	} else {
 789 		$t_view_state = VS_PUBLIC;
 790 	}
 791 
 792 	db_param_push();
 793 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bugnote} SET view_state=' . db_param() . ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
 794 	db_query( $t_query, array( $t_view_state, $p_bugnote_id ) );
 795 
 796 	history_log_event_special( $t_bug_id, BUGNOTE_STATE_CHANGED, $t_view_state, bugnote_format_id( $p_bugnote_id ) );
 797 
 798 	return true;
 799 }

 801 /**
 802  * Pad the bugnote id with the appropriate number of leading zeros for printing.
 803  *
 804  * @param int $p_bugnote_id A bugnote identifier.
 805  * @return string
 806  *
 807  * @access public
 808  */
 809 function bugnote_format_id( $p_bugnote_id ) {
 810 	$t_padding = config_get( 'display_bugnote_padding' );
 811 
 812 	return sprintf( '%0' . (int)$t_padding . 'd', $p_bugnote_id );
 813 }

 815 /**
 816  * Returns an array of bugnote stats.
 817  *
 818  * @param int    $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
 819  * @param string $p_from   Starting date (yyyy-mm-dd) inclusive, ignored if blank.
 820  * @param string $p_to     Ending date (yyyy-mm-dd) inclusive, ignored if blank.
 821  *
 822  * @return array array of bugnote stats
 823  *
 824  * @access public
 825  */
 826 function bugnote_stats_get_events_array( $p_bug_id, $p_from, $p_to ) {
 827 	$c_to = strtotime( $p_to ) + SECONDS_PER_DAY - 1;
 828 	$c_from = strtotime( $p_from );
 829 
 830 	if( !is_blank( $c_from ) ) {
 831 		$t_from_where = ' AND bn.date_submitted >= ' . $c_from;
 832 	} else {
 833 		$t_from_where = '';
 834 	}
 835 
 836 	if( !is_blank( $c_to ) ) {
 837 		$t_to_where = ' AND bn.date_submitted <= ' . $c_to;
 838 	} else {
 839 		$t_to_where = '';
 840 	}
 841 
 842 	$t_results = array();
 843 
 844 	db_param_push();
 845 	$t_query = 'SELECT u.id AS user_id, username, realname, SUM(time_tracking) AS sum_time_tracking
 846 				FROM {user} u, {bugnote} bn
 847 				WHERE u.id = bn.reporter_id 
 848 				AND bn.time_tracking != 0 
 849 				AND bn.bug_id = ' . db_param()
 850 		. $t_from_where
 851 		. $t_to_where . ' 
 852 				GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.realname';
 853 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 854 
 855 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 856 		$t_row['name'] = user_get_name_from_row( $t_row );
 857 		$t_results[(int)$t_row['user_id']] = $t_row;
 858 	}
 859 
 860 	return $t_results;
 861 }
