 863 /**
 864  * Clear a bugnote from the cache or all bug notes if no bugnote id specified.
 865  *
 866  * @param int $p_bugnote_id Identifier to clear (optional).
 867  *
 868  * @return bool
 869  *
 870  * @access public
 871  */
 872 function bugnote_clear_cache( $p_bugnote_id = null ) {
 873 	global $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id, $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id;
 874 
 875 	if( null === $p_bugnote_id ) {
 876 		$g_cache_bugnotes_by_id = array();
 877 		$g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id = array();
 878 	} else {
 879 		$p_bugnote_id = (int)$p_bugnote_id;
 880 		if( isset( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[$p_bugnote_id] ) ) {
 881 			$t_note_obj = $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[$p_bugnote_id];
 882 			unset($g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[$p_bugnote_id]);
 883 
 884 			# Clear the bug-level cache for the bugnote's parent bug
 885 			bugnote_clear_bug_cache( $t_note_obj->bug_id );
 886 		}
 887 	}
 888 
 889 	return true;
 890 }
 891 
 892 /**
 893  * Clear the bugnotes related to a bug, or all bugs if no bug id specified.
 894  *
 895  * @param int $p_bug_id Identifier to clear (optional).
 896  *
 897  * @return bool
 898  *
 899  * @access public
 900  */
 901 function bugnote_clear_bug_cache( $p_bug_id = null ) {
 902 	global $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id, $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id;
 903 
 904 	if( null === $p_bug_id ) {
 905 		$g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id = array();
 906 		$g_cache_bugnotes_by_id = array();
 907 	} else {
 908 		if( isset( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id[(int)$p_bug_id] ) ) {
 909 			foreach( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id[(int)$p_bug_id] as $t_note_obj ) {
 910 				unset( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_id[(int)$t_note_obj->id] );
 911 			}
 912 			unset( $g_cache_bugnotes_by_bug_id[(int)$p_bug_id] );
 913 		}
 914 	}
 915 
 916 	return true;
 917 }

  51 # Category data cache (to prevent excessive db queries)
  52 $g_category_cache = array();

  54 /**
  55  * Check whether the category exists globally.
  56  *
  57  * @param integer $p_category_id A Category identifier.
  58  * @return boolean Return true if the category exists, false otherwise
  59  * @access public
  60  */
  61 function category_exists( $p_category_id ) {
  62 	$t_category_row = category_get_row( $p_category_id, /* error_if_not_exists */ false );
  63 	return $t_category_row !== false;
  64 }
  65 
  66 /**
  67  * Trigger an error if category does not exist globally.
  68  *
  69  * @param integer $p_category_id A Category identifier.
  70  * @return void
  71  * @access public
  72  */
  73 function category_ensure_exists( $p_category_id ) {
  74 	if( !category_exists( $p_category_id ) ) {
  75 		trigger_error( ERROR_CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
  76 	}
  77 }
  78 
  79 /**
  80  * Check whether the category exists within the project hierarchy.
  81  *
  82  * @param int $p_category_id Category identifier.
  83  * @param int $p_project_id  Project identifier.
  84  *
  85  * @return bool True if the category exists, false otherwise.
  86  */
  87 function category_exists_in_project( $p_category_id, $p_project_id ) {
  88 	if( $p_category_id == 0
  89 		&& config_get( 'allow_no_category', null, null, $p_project_id )
  90 	) {
  91 		return true;
  92 	}
  93 	$t_categories = array_column( category_get_all_rows( $p_project_id ), 'id' );
  94 	return in_array( $p_category_id, $t_categories );
  95 }
  96 
  97 /**
  98  * Trigger an error if the category does not exist within the project hierarchy.
  99  *
 100  * @param int $p_category_id Category identifier.
 101  * @param int $p_project_id  Project identifier.
 102  *
 103  * @throws ClientException
 104  */
 105 function category_ensure_exists_in_project( $p_category_id, $p_project_id ) {
 106 	if( !category_exists_in_project( $p_category_id, $p_project_id ) ) {
 107 		throw new ClientException(
 108 			"Category '$p_category_id' not available in project '$p_project_id'.",
 109 			ERROR_CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND_FOR_PROJECT,
 110 			array( $p_category_id, $p_project_id )
 111 		);
 112 	}

 115 /**
 116  * Check whether the category is unique within a project
 117  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 118  * @param string  $p_name       Project name.
 119  * @return boolean Returns true if the category is unique, false otherwise
 120  * @access public
 121  */
 122 function category_is_unique( $p_project_id, $p_name ) {
 123 	db_param_push();
 124 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {category}
 125 					WHERE project_id=' . db_param() . ' AND ' . db_helper_like( 'name' );
 126 	$t_count = db_result( db_query( $t_query, array( $p_project_id, $p_name ) ) );
 127 
 128 	if( 0 < $t_count ) {
 129 		return false;
 130 	} else {
 131 		return true;
 132 	}
 133 }

 136  * Check whether the category is unique within a project

 143 function category_ensure_unique( $p_project_id, $p_name ) {

 149 /**
 150  * Checks whether the category can be deleted.
 151  * It is not allowed to delete a category if it is defined as 'default for moves'
 152  * @see $g_default_category_for_moves
 153  * @param integer $p_category_id Category identifier.
 154  * @return boolean True if category can be deleted, false otherwise
 155  * @access public
 156  */
 157 function category_can_remove( $p_category_id ) {
 158 	$t_default_category_id = config_get( 'default_category_for_moves', null, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS );
 159 
 160 	return $p_category_id != $t_default_category_id
 161 		&& !config_is_defined( 'default_category_for_moves', $p_category_id );
 162 }

 164 /**
 165  * Trigger an error if the category cannot be deleted.

 170 function category_ensure_can_remove( $p_category_id ) {

 177 /**
 178  * Add a new category to the project
 179  * @param integer $p_project_id Project identifier.
 180  * @param string  $p_name       Category Name.
 181  * @return integer Category ID
 182  * @access public
 183  */
 184 function category_add( $p_project_id, $p_name ) {
 185 	if( is_blank( $p_name ) ) {
 186 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'category' ) );
 187 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 188 	}
 189 
 190 	category_ensure_unique( $p_project_id, $p_name );
 191 
 192 	db_param_push();
 193 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {category} ( project_id, name )
 194 				  VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
 195 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_project_id, $p_name ) );
 196 
 197 	# db_query() errors on failure so:
 198 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'category' ) );
 199 }

 201 /**
 202  * Update the name and user associated with the category.
 203  *
 204  * @param int      $p_category_id Category identifier.
 205  * @param string   $p_name        Category Name.
 206  * @param int      $p_assigned_to User ID that category is assigned to.
 207  * @param int|null $p_status      Optional category status (see CATEGORY_STATUS_* constants)
 208  *                                or null to leave status unchanged.
 209  *
 210  * @return void
 211  * @access public
 212  */
 213 function category_update( $p_category_id, $p_name, $p_assigned_to, $p_status = null ) {
 214 	if( is_blank( $p_name ) ) {
 215 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'category' ) );
 216 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 217 	}
 218 
 219 	$t_old_category = category_get_row( $p_category_id );
 220 	$t_project_id = (int)$t_old_category['project_id'];
 221 
 222 	# Ensure target user exists and is allowed to handle bugs
 223 	if( $p_assigned_to != NO_USER ) {
 224 		if( user_exists( $p_assigned_to ) ) {
 225 			$t_handle_bugs = config_get( 'handle_bug_threshold' );
 226 			if( !access_has_project_level( $t_handle_bugs, $t_project_id, $p_assigned_to ) ) {
 227 				trigger_error( ERROR_USER_DOES_NOT_HAVE_REQ_ACCESS, ERROR );
 228 			}
 229 		} else {
 230 			error_parameters( $p_assigned_to );
 231 			trigger_error( ERROR_USER_BY_ID_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 232 		}
 233 	}
 234 
 235 	# Disabling category is not authorized if it is used as default
 236 	$t_default_category_id = config_get_global( 'default_category_for_moves', null );
 237 	if( $p_category_id == $t_default_category_id
 238 		|| config_is_defined( 'default_category_for_moves', $p_category_id )
 239 	) {
 240 		error_parameters( $t_old_category['name'] );
 241 		trigger_error( ERROR_CATEGORY_CANNOT_UPDATE_DEFAULT, ERROR );
 242 	}
 243 
 244 	# Keep existing status
 245 	if( $p_status === null ) {
 246 		$p_status = $t_old_category['status'];
 247 	}
 248 
 249 	db_param_push();
 250 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {category} SET name=' . db_param() . ', user_id=' . db_param() . ', status=' . db_param() .'
 251 				  WHERE id=' . db_param();
 252 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_name, $p_assigned_to , $p_status, $p_category_id ) );
 253 
 254 	# Add bug history entries if we update the category's name
 255 	if( $t_old_category['name'] != $p_name ) {
 256 		db_param_push();
 257 		$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {bug} WHERE category_id=' . db_param();
 258 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_category_id ) );
 259 
 260 		while( $t_bug_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 261 			history_log_event_direct( $t_bug_row['id'], 'category', $t_old_category['name'], $p_name );
 262 		}
 263 	}
 264 }
 265 
 266 /**
 267  * Remove a category from the project
 268  * @param integer $p_category_id     Category identifier.
 269  * @param integer $p_new_category_id New category id (to replace existing category).
 270  * @return void
 271  * @access public
 272  */
 273 function category_remove( $p_category_id, $p_new_category_id = 0 ) {
 274 	$t_category_row = category_get_row( $p_category_id );
 275 
 276 	category_ensure_exists( $p_category_id );
 277 	category_ensure_can_remove( $p_category_id );
 278 	if( 0 != $p_new_category_id ) {
 279 		category_ensure_exists( $p_new_category_id );
 280 	}
 281 
 282 	db_param_push();
 283 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {category} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 284 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_category_id ) );
 285 
 286 	# update bug history entries
 287 	db_param_push();
 288 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {bug} WHERE category_id=' . db_param();
 289 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_category_id ) );
 290 
 291 	while( $t_bug_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 292 		history_log_event_direct( $t_bug_row['id'], 'category', $t_category_row['name'], category_full_name( $p_new_category_id, false ) );
 293 	}
 294 
 295 	# update bug data
 296 	db_param_push();
 297 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET category_id=' . db_param() . ' WHERE category_id=' . db_param();
 298 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_new_category_id, $p_category_id ) );
 299 }
 300 
 301 /**
 302  * Remove all categories associated with a project.
 303  * This will skip processing of categories that can't be deleted.
 304  * @param integer $p_project_id      A Project identifier.
 305  * @param integer $p_new_category_id New category id (to replace existing category).
 306  * @return boolean
 307  * @access public
 308  */
 309 function category_remove_all( $p_project_id, $p_new_category_id = 0 ) {
 310 	project_ensure_exists( $p_project_id );
 311 	if( 0 != $p_new_category_id ) {
 312 		category_ensure_exists( $p_new_category_id );
 313 	}
 314 
 315 	# cache category names
 316 	category_get_all_rows( $p_project_id );
 317 
 318 	# get a list of affected categories
 319 	db_param_push();
 320 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {category} WHERE project_id=' . db_param();
 321 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_project_id ) );
 322 
 323 	$t_category_ids = array();
 324 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 325 		# Don't add category to the list if it can't be deleted
 326 		if( !category_can_remove( $t_row['id'] ) ) {
 327 			continue;
 328 		}
 329 		$t_category_ids[] = $t_row['id'];
 330 	}
 331 
 332 	# Handle projects with no categories
 333 	if( count( $t_category_ids ) < 1 ) {
 334 		return true;
 335 	}
 336 
 337 	$t_category_ids = implode( ',', $t_category_ids );
 338 
 339 	# update bug history entries
 340 	$t_query = 'SELECT id, category_id FROM {bug} WHERE category_id IN ( ' . $t_category_ids . ' )';
 341 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 342 
 343 	while( $t_bug_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 344 		history_log_event_direct( $t_bug_row['id'], 'category', category_full_name( $t_bug_row['category_id'], false ), category_full_name( $p_new_category_id, false ) );
 345 	}
 346 
 347 	# update bug data
 348 	db_param_push();
 349 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET category_id=' . db_param() . ' WHERE category_id IN ( ' . $t_category_ids . ' )';
 350 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_new_category_id ) );
 351 
 352 	# delete categories
 353 	db_param_push();
 354 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {category} WHERE project_id=' . db_param();
 355 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_project_id ) );
 356 
 357 	return true;
 358 }
 359 
 360 /**
 361  * Return the definition row for the category
 362  * @param integer $p_category_id Category identifier.
 363  * @param boolean $p_error_if_not_exists true: error if not exists, otherwise return false.
 364  * @return array|false An array containing category details.
 365  * @access public
 366  */
 367 function category_get_row( $p_category_id, $p_error_if_not_exists = true ) {
 368 	global $g_category_cache;
 369 
 370 	$p_category_id = (int)$p_category_id;
 371 
 372 	if( isset( $g_category_cache[$p_category_id] ) ) {
 373 		return $g_category_cache[$p_category_id];
 374 	}
 375 
 376 	db_param_push();
 377 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {category} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 378 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_category_id ) );
 379 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 380 	if( !$t_row ) {
 381 		if( $p_error_if_not_exists ) {
 382 			trigger_error( ERROR_CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 383 		} else {
 384 			return false;
 385 		}
 386 	}
 387 
 388 	$g_category_cache[$p_category_id] = $t_row;
 389 	return $t_row;
 390 }
 391 
 392 /**
 393  * Sort categories based on what project they're in.
 394  *
 395  * Call beforehand with a single parameter to set a 'preferred' project.
 396  *
 397  * @param int|array $p_category1 Id of preferred project or array containing category details.
 398  * @param array|null $p_category2 Array containing category details.
 399  *
 400  * @return int|null An integer representing sort order.
 401  * @access public
 402  */
 403 function category_sort_rows_by_project( $p_category1, ?array $p_category2 = null ) {
 404 	static $s_project_id = null;
 405 	if( is_null( $p_category2 ) ) {
 406 		# Set a target project
 407 		$s_project_id = $p_category1;
 408 		return null;
 409 	}
 410 
 411 	if( !is_null( $s_project_id ) ) {
 412 		if( $p_category1['project_id'] == $s_project_id && $p_category2['project_id'] != $s_project_id ) {
 413 			return -1;
 414 		}
 415 		if( $p_category1['project_id'] != $s_project_id && $p_category2['project_id'] == $s_project_id ) {
 416 			return 1;
 417 		}
 418 	}
 419 
 420 	$t_proj_cmp = strcasecmp( (string)$p_category1['project_name'], (string)$p_category2['project_name'] );
 421 	if( $t_proj_cmp != 0 ) {
 422 		return $t_proj_cmp;
 423 	}
 424 
 425 	return strcasecmp( (string)$p_category1['name'], (string)$p_category2['name'] );
 426 }
 427 
 428 $g_cache_category_project = null;
 429 
 430 /**
 431  * Cache categories from multiple projects
 432  * @param array $p_project_id_array Array of project identifiers.
 433  * @return void
 434  */
 435 function category_cache_array_rows_by_project( array $p_project_id_array ) {
 436 	global $g_category_cache, $g_cache_category_project;
 437 
 438 	$c_project_id_array = array();
 439 
 440 	foreach( $p_project_id_array as $t_project_id ) {
 441 		if( !isset( $g_cache_category_project[(int)$t_project_id] ) ) {
 442 			$c_project_id_array[] = (int)$t_project_id;
 443 			$g_cache_category_project[(int)$t_project_id] = array();
 444 		}
 445 	}
 446 
 447 	if( empty( $c_project_id_array ) ) {
 448 		return;
 449 	}
 450 
 451 	$t_query = 'SELECT c.*, p.name AS project_name FROM {category} c
 452 				LEFT JOIN {project} p
 453 					ON c.project_id=p.id
 454 				WHERE project_id IN ( ' . implode( ', ', $c_project_id_array ) . ' )
 455 				ORDER BY c.name ';
 456 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 457 
 458 	$t_rows = array();
 459 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 460 		$g_category_cache[(int)$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
 461 
 462 		$t_rows[(int)$t_row['project_id']][] = $t_row['id'];
 463 	}
 464 
 465 	foreach( $t_rows as $t_project_id => $t_row ) {
 466 		$g_cache_category_project[(int)$t_project_id] = $t_row;
 467 	}
 468 }

 470 /**
 471  *	Get a distinct array of categories accessible to the current user for
 472  *	the specified projects.  If no project is specified, use the current project.
 473  *	If the current project is ALL_PROJECTS get all categories for all accessible projects.
 474  *	For all cases, get global categories and subproject categories according to configured inheritance settings.
 475  *	@param integer|null $p_project_id A specific project or null.
 476  *	@return array A unique array of category names
 477  */
 478 function category_get_filter_list( $p_project_id = null ) {
 479 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
 480 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 481 	} else {
 482 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id;
 483 	}
 484 
 485 	if( $t_project_id == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 486 		$t_project_ids = current_user_get_accessible_projects();
 487 	} else {
 488 		$t_project_ids = array( $t_project_id );
 489 	}
 490 
 491 	$t_subproject_ids = array();
 492 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_project_id ) {
 493 		$t_subproject_ids = array_merge( $t_subproject_ids, current_user_get_all_accessible_subprojects( $t_project_id ) );
 494 	}
 495 
 496 	$t_project_ids = array_merge( $t_project_ids, $t_subproject_ids );
 497 
 498 	$t_categories = array();
 499 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 500 		$t_categories = array_merge( $t_categories, category_get_all_rows( $t_id ) );
 501 	}
 502 
 503 	$t_unique = array();
 504 	foreach( $t_categories as $t_category ) {
 505 		if( !in_array( $t_category['name'], $t_unique ) ) {
 506 			$t_unique[] = $t_category['name'];
 507 		}
 508 	}
 509 
 510 	return $t_unique;
 511 }
 512 
 513 /**
 514  * Return all categories for the specified project id.
 515  *
 516  * Obeys project hierarchies and such.
 517  *
 518  * @param int  $p_project_id      A Project identifier.
 519  * @param bool $p_inherit         Indicates whether to inherit categories from parent projects,
 520  *                                or null to use configuration default.
 521  * @param bool $p_sort_by_project Whether to sort by project.
 522  * @param bool $p_enabled_only    False to select all categories or True for just the active ones.
 523  *
 524  * @return array array of categories
 525  * @access public
 526  */
 527 function category_get_all_rows( $p_project_id, $p_inherit = null, $p_sort_by_project = false, $p_enabled_only = false ) {
 528 	global $g_category_cache, $g_cache_category_project;
 529 
 530 	if( isset( $g_cache_category_project[(int)$p_project_id] ) ) {
 531 		$t_categories = array();
 532 		if( !empty( $g_cache_category_project[(int)$p_project_id]) ) {
 533 			foreach( $g_cache_category_project[(int)$p_project_id] as $t_id ) {
 534 				$t_categories[] = category_get_row( $t_id );
 535 			}
 536 
 537 			if( $p_sort_by_project ) {
 538 				category_sort_rows_by_project( $p_project_id );
 539 				usort( $t_categories, 'category_sort_rows_by_project' );
 540 
 541 				# TODO: passing null may be a bug here
 542 				category_sort_rows_by_project( null );
 543 			}
 544 		}
 545 		return $t_categories;
 546 	}
 547 
 548 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 549 
 550 	if( $c_project_id == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 551 		$t_inherit = false;
 552 	} else {
 553 		if( $p_inherit === null ) {
 554 			$t_inherit = config_get( 'subprojects_inherit_categories' );
 555 		} else {
 556 			$t_inherit = $p_inherit;
 557 		}
 558 	}
 559 
 560 	if( $t_inherit ) {
 561 		$t_project_ids = project_hierarchy_inheritance( $p_project_id );
 562 		$t_project_where = ' project_id IN ( ' . implode( ', ', $t_project_ids ) . ' ) ';
 563 	} else {
 564 		$t_project_where = ' project_id=' . $p_project_id . ' ';
 565 	}
 566 
 567 	if( $p_enabled_only ) {
 568 		$t_project_where .= ' and c.status = ' . CATEGORY_STATUS_ENABLED;
 569 	}
 570 	
 571 	$t_query = 'SELECT c.*, p.name AS project_name FROM {category} c
 572 				LEFT JOIN {project} p
 573 					ON c.project_id=p.id
 574 				WHERE ' . $t_project_where . ' ORDER BY c.name';
 575 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 576 	$t_rows = array();
 577 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 578 		$t_rows[] = $t_row;
 579 		$g_category_cache[(int)$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
 580 	}
 581 
 582 	if( $p_sort_by_project ) {
 583 		category_sort_rows_by_project( $p_project_id );
 584 		usort( $t_rows, 'category_sort_rows_by_project' );
 585 
 586 		# TODO: passing null may be a bug here
 587 		category_sort_rows_by_project( null );
 588 	}
 589 
 590 	return $t_rows;
 591 }
 592 
 593 /**
 594  * Cache an set of category ids
 595  * @param array $p_cat_id_array Array of category identifiers.
 596  * @return void
 597  * @access public
 598  */
 599 function category_cache_array_rows( array $p_cat_id_array ) {
 600 	global $g_category_cache;
 601 	$c_cat_id_array = array();
 602 
 603 	foreach( $p_cat_id_array as $t_cat_id ) {
 604 		if( !isset( $g_category_cache[(int)$t_cat_id] ) ) {
 605 			$c_cat_id_array[] = (int)$t_cat_id;
 606 		}
 607 	}
 608 
 609 	if( empty( $c_cat_id_array ) ) {
 610 		return;
 611 	}
 612 
 613 	$t_query = 'SELECT c.*, p.name AS project_name FROM {category} c
 614 				LEFT JOIN {project} p
 615 					ON c.project_id=p.id
 616 				WHERE c.id IN (' . implode( ',', $c_cat_id_array ) . ')';
 617 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 618 
 619 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 620 		$g_category_cache[(int)$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
 621 	}
 622 }

 624 /**
 625  * Given a category id and a field name, this function returns the field value.
 626  * An error will be triggered for a non-existent category id or category id = 0.
 627  * @param integer $p_category_id A category identifier.
 628  * @param string  $p_field_name  Field name.
 629  * @return string field value
 630  * @access public
 631  */
 632 function category_get_field( $p_category_id, $p_field_name ) {
 633 	$t_row = category_get_row( $p_category_id );
 634 	return $t_row[$p_field_name];
 635 }

 637 /**
 638  * Given a category id, this function returns the category name.
 639  * An error will be triggered for a non-existent category id or category id = 0.
 640  * @param integer $p_category_id A category identifier.
 641  * @return string category name
 642  * @access public
 643  */
 644 function category_get_name( $p_category_id ) {
 645 	return category_get_field( $p_category_id, 'name' );
 646 }

 648 /**
 649  * Given a category name and project, this function returns the category id.
 650  * An error will be triggered if the specified project does not have a
 651  * category with that name.
 652  * @param string  $p_category_name  Category name to retrieve.
 653  * @param integer $p_project_id     A project identifier.
 654  * @param boolean $p_trigger_errors Whether to trigger error on failure.
 655  * @return boolean
 656  * @access public
 657  */
 658 function category_get_id_by_name( $p_category_name, $p_project_id, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
 659 	$t_project_name = project_get_name( $p_project_id );
 660 
 661 	db_param_push();
 662 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {category} WHERE name=' . db_param() . ' AND project_id=' . db_param();
 663 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_category_name, (int)$p_project_id ) );
 664 	$t_id = db_result( $t_result );
 665 	if( $t_id === false ) {
 666 		if( $p_trigger_errors ) {
 667 			error_parameters( $p_category_name, $t_project_name );
 668 			trigger_error( ERROR_CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND_FOR_PROJECT, ERROR );
 669 		} else {
 670 			return false;
 671 		}
 672 	}
 673 
 674 	return $t_id;
 675 }
 676 
 677 /**
 678  * Retrieves category name (including project name if required)
 679  * @param string  $p_category_id     Category identifier.
 680  * @param boolean $p_show_project    Show project details.
 681  * @param integer $p_current_project Current project id override.
 682  * @return string category full name
 683  * @access public
 684  */
 685 function category_full_name( $p_category_id, $p_show_project = true, $p_current_project = null ) {
 686 	if( 0 == $p_category_id ) {
 687 		# No Category
 688 		return lang_get( 'no_category' );
 689 	} else if( !category_exists( $p_category_id ) ) {
 690 		return '@' . $p_category_id . '@';
 691 	} else {
 692 		$t_row = category_get_row( $p_category_id );
 693 		$t_project_id = $t_row['project_id'];
 694 
 695 		$t_current_project = is_null( $p_current_project ) ? helper_get_current_project() : $p_current_project;
 696 
 697 		if( $p_show_project && $t_project_id != $t_current_project ) {
 698 			return '[' . project_get_name( $t_project_id ) . '] ' . $t_row['name'];
 699 		}
 700 
 701 		return $t_row['name'];
 702 	}
 703 }
 704 
 705 /**
 706  * Check category can be deleted 
 707  * @param string $p_category_id Category identifier.
 708  * @return boolean Return true if the category valid for delete, otherwise false
 709  * @access public
 710  */
 711 function category_can_delete( $p_category_id ) {
 712 	db_param_push();
 713 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(id) FROM {bug} WHERE category_id=' . db_param();
 714 	$t_bug_count = db_result( db_query( $t_query, array( $p_category_id ) ) );
 715 	return $t_bug_count == 0;
 716 }
 717 
 718 /**
 719  * Ensure category can be deleted, otherwise raise an error.
 720  * @param string $p_category_id Category identifier.
 721  * @return void
 722  * @access public
 723  */
 724 function category_ensure_can_delete( $p_category_id ) {
 725 	if( !category_can_delete( $p_category_id ) ) {
 726 		$t_category_name = category_get_name( $p_category_id );
 727 		error_parameters( $t_category_name );
 728 		trigger_error( ERROR_CATEGORY_CANNOT_DELETE_HAS_ISSUES, ERROR );
 729 	}
 730 }
 731 
 732 /**
 733  * Check if category is enabled.
 734  *
 735  * Category 0 (no category) is always considered as enabled.
 736  *
 737  * @param int $p_category_id Category identifier.
 738  *
 739  * @return bool True if enabled, false otherwise
 740  */
 741 function category_is_enabled( $p_category_id ) {
 742 	return $p_category_id == 0
 743 		|| category_get_field( $p_category_id, 'status' ) == CATEGORY_STATUS_ENABLED;
 744 }

 292 /**
 293  * Translates the default date value into a timestamp.
 294  *
 295  * Default date can be any supported Date format
 296  * {@see https://www.php.net/manual/en/datetime.formats.php}.
 297  * The legacy style with format wrapped in curly bracket (e.g. {tomorrow}) is
 298  * still supported for backwards compatibility.
 299  *
 300  * @param string $p_value The default date string.
 301  *
 302  * @return int Calculated default date's timestamp, or 0 if format is invalid.
 303  */
 304 function cfdef_prepare_date_default( $p_value ) {
 305 	if( is_blank( $p_value ) ) {
 306 		return 0;
 307 	}
 308 
 309 	$t_value = trim( $p_value );
 310 
 311 	# Allow legacy "{xxx}" format for dynamic dates
 312 	if( preg_match( '/^{(.*)}$/', $t_value, $t_matches ) ) {
 313 		$t_value = $t_matches[1];
 314 	}
 315 
 316 	# Check default date format and calculate actual date
 317 	try {
 318 		$t_date = new DateTimeImmutable( $t_value );
 319 	}
 320 	catch( Exception $e ) {
 321 		return 0;
 322 	}
 323 
 324 	return $t_date->getTimestamp();
 325 }

 359 /**
 360  * print_custom_field_input
 361  * @param array $p_field_def          Custom field definition.
 362  * @param mixed $p_custom_field_value Custom field value.
 363  * @param string $p_required          The "required" attribute to add to the field
 364  * @return void
 365  */
 366 function cfdef_input_list( array $p_field_def, $p_custom_field_value, $p_required = '' ) {
 367 	$t_values = explode( '|', custom_field_prepare_possible_values( $p_field_def['possible_values'] ) );
 368 	$t_list_size = $t_possible_values_count = count( $t_values );
 369 
 370 	if( $t_possible_values_count > 5 ) {
 371 		$t_list_size = 5;
 372 	}
 373 
 374 	if( $p_field_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_ENUM ) {
 375 		$t_list_size = 0;	# for enums the size is 0
 376 	}
 377 
 378 	if( $p_field_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_MULTILIST ) {
 379 		echo '<select ' . helper_get_tab_index() . ' id="custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'] . '" name="custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'] . '[]" size="' . $t_list_size . '" multiple="multiple"' . $p_required .'>';
 380 	} else {
 381 		echo '<select ' . helper_get_tab_index() . ' id="custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'] . '" name="custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'] . '" size="' . $t_list_size . '"' . $p_required .'>';
 382 	}
 383 
 384 	$t_selected_values = explode( '|', $p_custom_field_value );
 385 	foreach( $t_values as $t_option ) {
 386 		if( in_array( $t_option, $t_selected_values, true ) ) {
 387 			echo '<option value="' . string_attribute( $t_option ) . '" selected="selected"> ' . string_display_line( $t_option ) . '</option>';
 388 		} else {
 389 			echo '<option value="' . string_attribute( $t_option ) . '">' . string_display_line( $t_option ) . '</option>';
 390 		}
 391 	}
 392 	echo '</select>';
 393 }

 395 /**
 396  * print_custom_field_input
 397  * @param array $p_field_def          Custom field definition.
 398  * @param mixed $p_custom_field_value Custom field value.
 399  * @param string $p_required          (Unused) The "required" attribute to add to the field
 400  * @return void
 401  *
 402  * @noinspection PhpUnusedParameterInspection
 403  */
 404 function cfdef_input_checkbox( array $p_field_def, $p_custom_field_value, $p_required = '' ) {
 405 	$t_values = explode( '|', custom_field_prepare_possible_values( $p_field_def['possible_values'] ) );
 406 	$t_checked_values = explode( '|', $p_custom_field_value ?? '' );
 407 	for( $i = 0; $i < count( $t_values ); $i++ ) {
 408 		$t_input_id = 'custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'] . '_value_' . $i;
 409 		$t_input_name = 'custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'] . '[]';
 410 		echo '<label for="' . $t_input_id . '">' . "\n";
 411 		echo '<input class="ace" id="' . $t_input_id . '" '
 412 			. helper_get_tab_index()
 413 			. ' type="checkbox" name="' . $t_input_name
 414 			. '" value="' . string_attribute( $t_values[$i] ) . '"';
 415 		check_checked( $t_checked_values, $t_values[$i] );
 416 		echo " />\n";
 417 		echo '<span class="lbl">&#160;' . string_display_line( $t_values[$i] ) . '</label>' . "\n";
 418 		echo '</label>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;' . "\n";
 419 	}
 420 }

 422 /**
 423  * print_custom_field_input
 424  * @param array $p_field_def          Custom field definition.
 425  * @param mixed $p_custom_field_value Custom field value.
 426  * @param string $p_required          The "required" attribute to add to the field
 427  * @return void
 428  */
 429 function cfdef_input_radio( array $p_field_def, $p_custom_field_value, $p_required = '' ) {
 430 	$t_values = explode( '|', custom_field_prepare_possible_values( $p_field_def['possible_values'] ) );
 431 
 432 	$t_len = strlen( $p_custom_field_value );
 433 	if( $t_len >= 2 && ( $p_custom_field_value[0] == '|' ) && ( $p_custom_field_value[$t_len-1] == '|' ) ) {
 434 		$t_checked_value = substr( $p_custom_field_value, 1, $t_len - 2 );
 435 	} else {
 436 		$t_checked_value = $p_custom_field_value;
 437 	}
 438 
 439 	for( $i = 0; $i < count( $t_values ); $i++ ) {
 440 		$t_input_id = 'custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'] . '_value_' . $i;
 441 		$t_input_name = 'custom_field_' . $p_field_def['id'];
 442 		echo '<label for="' . $t_input_id . '">';
 443 		echo '<input class="ace" id="' . $t_input_id . '" ' . helper_get_tab_index() . ' type="radio" name="' . $t_input_name . '" value="' . string_attribute( $t_values[$i] ) . '"' . $p_required;
 444 		check_checked( $t_checked_value, $t_values[$i] );
 445 		echo " />\n";
 446 		echo '<span class="lbl">&#160;' . string_display_line( $t_values[$i] ) . '</span>' . "\n";
 447 		echo '</label>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;' . "\n";
 448 	}
 449 }

 451 /**
 452  * print_custom_field_input
 453  * @param array $p_field_def          Custom field definition.
 454  * @param mixed $p_custom_field_value Custom field value.
 455  * @param string $p_required          The "required" attribute to add to the field
 456  * @return void
 457  */
 458 function cfdef_input_textbox( array $p_field_def, $p_custom_field_value, $p_required = '' ) {
 459 	echo '<input ', helper_get_tab_index(), ' type="text" id="custom_field_', $p_field_def['id']
 460 			, '" name="custom_field_', $p_field_def['id'], '" ', $p_required;
 461 	if( $p_field_def['length_max'] > 0 ) {
 462 		echo ' maxlength="' . $p_field_def['length_max'] . '"'
 463 				, ' size="' .  min( 80, $p_field_def['length_max'] ) . '"';
 464 	} else {
 465 		echo ' maxlength="255" size="80"';
 466 	}
 467 	if( !empty( $p_field_def['valid_regexp'] ) ) {
 468 		# the custom field regex is evaluated with preg_match and looks for a partial match in the string
 469 		# however, the html property is matched for the whole string.
 470 		# unless we have explicit start and end tokens, adapt the html regex to allow a substring match.
 471 		$t_cf_regex = $p_field_def['valid_regexp'];
 472 		if( substr( $t_cf_regex, 0, 1 ) != '^' ) {
 473 			$t_cf_regex = '.*' . $t_cf_regex;
 474 		}
 475 		if( substr( $t_cf_regex, -1 ) != '$' ) {
 476 			$t_cf_regex .= '.*';
 477 		}
 478 		echo ' pattern="' . string_attribute( $t_cf_regex ) . '"';
 479 	}
 480 	echo ' value="' . string_attribute( $p_custom_field_value ) .'" />';
 481 }

 483 /**
 484  * print_custom_field_input

 492 			, '" name="custom_field_', $p_field_def['id'], '"', $p_required;
 493 	echo ' maxlength="',
 494 		$p_field_def['length_max'] > 0
 495 			? $p_field_def['length_max']
 496 			: config_get_global( 'max_textarea_length' ),
 497 		'"';
 498 	echo ' cols="70" rows="8">', $p_custom_field_value, '</textarea>';
 499 }

 538 /**
 539  * Prepare possible values for option list
 540  * @param array $p_field_def Custom field definition.
 541  * @return array|boolean
 542  */
 543 function cfdef_prepare_list_distinct_values( array $p_field_def ) {
 544 	db_param_push();
 545 	$t_query = 'SELECT possible_values FROM {custom_field} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 546 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_def['id'] ) );
 547 
 548 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 549 	if( !$t_row ) {
 550 		return false;
 551 	}
 552 
 553 	$t_possible_values = custom_field_prepare_possible_values( $t_row['possible_values'] );
 554 	$t_values_arr = explode( '|', $t_possible_values );
 555 	$t_return_arr = array();
 556 
 557 	foreach( $t_values_arr as $t_option ) {
 558 		array_push( $t_return_arr, $t_option );
 559 	}
 560 	return $t_return_arr;
 561 }

  35 /**

  41 	 * @var bool|null
  42 	 */

  45 	/**

  47 	 * @var string|null

  51 	/**

  53 	 * a plugin page.
  54 	 *
  55 	 * @see $credentials_page
  56 	 * @see $logout_page
  57 	 * @var string|null

  59 	private $login_page = null;

  64 	 * an auth plugin provided page that re-directs to an IDP.
  65 	 *
  66 	 * @see $login_page
  67 	 * @see $logout_page
  68 	 * @var string|null

  72 	/**
  73 	 * The logout page to use instead of the standard MantisBT logout page.  This can be
  74 	 * a plugin page.
  75 	 *
  76 	 * @see $credentials_page
  77 	 * @see $login_page
  78 	 * @see $logout_redirect_page
  79 	 * @var string|null
  80 	 */
  81 	private $logout_page = null;

  83 	/**
  84 	 * The page to redirect to after successful logout.  This can be a plugin page.  Such
  85 	 * page can display content directly to redirect to a MantisBT page to a remote page.
  86 	 *
  87 	 * @see $logout_page
  88 	 * @var string|null
  89 	 */
  90 	private $logout_redirect_page = null;
  91 
  92 	/**
  93 	 * The login session lifetime in seconds or 0 for browser session.
  94 	 * @var int|null
  95 	 */
  96 	private $session_lifetime = null;
  97 
  98 	/**
  99 	 * Indicates whether 'remember me' option is allowed.
 100 	 * @see $perm_session_lifetime

 103 	private $perm_session_enabled = null;

 105 	/**

 110 	private $perm_session_lifetime = null;

 114 	 * user profile is enabled.

 118 	private $reauthentication_enabled = null;

 125 	 */
 126 	private $reauthentication_expiry = null;

 128 	/**

 131 	function __construct() {
 132 	}

 134 	/**

 153 			return lang_get( 'no_password_change' );

 214 	/**

 220 	 * @see setCredentialsPage()

 222 	function getCredentialsPage( $p_query_string ) {
 223 		$t_page = is_null( $this->credentials_page ) ? AUTH_PAGE_CREDENTIAL : $this->credentials_page;
 224 		return helper_url_combine( $t_page, $p_query_string );
 225 	}

 227 	/**

 263 	 * redirect to.  It must be a page that is provided by MantisBT core or a plugin.

 271 		}

 274 	}

 276 	/**

  30 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  31 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  32 require_api( 'database_api.php' );
  33 require_api( 'logging_api.php' );

  36 /**
  37  * Database Query abstraction class.
  38  *
  39  * Allows building a query and fetching data, providing compatible functionality
  40  * for all supported databases. Hides the underlaying details from the ADOdb layer.
  41  *
  42  * Supports inline parameters with ":label" syntax, and anonymous parameters
  43  * through the param() method.
  44  * Supports binding arrays which will be later expanded to individual parameters.
  45  *
  46  * The internal processing steps for query string are:
  47  * 1) $query_string: stores the user input string, containing parameter tokens for all
  48  *   supported formats:
  49  *     - ":{string}" For labeled parameters. Bound values are stored in $query_bind_array
  50  *     - "${int}" For anonymous parameters. Bound values are stored in $query_autobind_array
  51  *     - "${string}{int}" For special constructs, eg: $in0 for late binding IN clauses
  52  * 2) $expanded_query_string: stores the query string after expansion of special constructs
  53  *   into standard "${int}" parameters
  54  * 3) $db_query_string: stores the query string after all parameters have been renamed,
  55  *   reordered and converted to the specific database parameter syntax expected by ADOdb.
  56  *   Binded values are stored in $db_param_array
  57  *
  58  * The steps for query string processing are performed by:
  59  * - process_expand_params(): converts query string (1) into (2)
  60  * - process_bind_params(): converts query string(2) into (3)
  61  * - process_sql_syntax(): modifies query string (3) performing some general and database
  62  *   specific modifications.
  63  *
  64  * Execution of the query is supported by:
  65  * - db_execute(): performs the low level, actual execution from ADOdb
  66  * - execute(): performs all query processing steps and then calls db_execute().
  67  */
  68 
  69 class DbQuery {
  70 
  71 	/**
  72 	 * Stores the user input for query string.
  73 	 * @var string
  74 	 */
  75 	protected $query_string;
  76 
  77 	/**
  78 	 * Stores the query string with "late binding" placeholders expanded into final
  79 	 * sql syntax and parameters.
  80 	 * @var string
  81 	 */
  82 	protected $expanded_query_string = null;
  83 
  84 	/**
  85 	 * Array of values binded to labeled parameters, indexed by label names.
  86 	 * @var array
  87 	 */
  88 	protected $query_bind_array;
  89 
  90 	/**
  91 	 * Array of values binded to anonymous parameters, indexed by numerical index.
  92 	 * @var array
  93 	 */
  94 	protected $query_autobind_array = array();
  95 
  96 	/**
  97 	 * Counter for assigning numerical indexes to anonymous parameters.
  98 	 * @var integer
  99 	 */
 100 	protected $query_autobind_count = 0;
 101 
 102 	/**
 103 	 * Stores the final query string to be passed to ADOdb.
 104 	 * @var string
 105 	 */
 106 	protected $db_query_string;
 107 
 108 	/**
 109 	 * Array of values for parameters included in the final query string for ADOdb,
 110 	 * indexed as needed for the ADOdb driver
 111 	 * @var array
 112 	 */
 113 	protected $db_param_array;
 114 
 115 	/**
 116 	 * Stores the adodb result set for the query after it has been executed, or false if the query failed.
 117 	 * @var  IteratorAggregate|boolean
 118 	 */
 119 	protected $db_result = null;
 120 
 121 	/**
 122 	 * Stores execution time of the query (microseconds).
 123 	 * @var integer
 124 	 */
 125 	protected $db_query_time = null;
 126 
 127 	/**
 128 	 * Stores the latest fetched array fromthe result set.
 129 	 * @var array
 130 	 */
 131 	protected $current_row = null;
 132 
 133 	/**
 134 	 * Stores row limit value for query execution.
 135 	 * Number of rows to be returned from the query result
 136 	 * Use -1 to disable this option.
 137 	 * @var integer
 138 	 */
 139 	protected $select_limit = -1;
 140 
 141 	/**
 142 	 * Stores the offset value for query execution.
 143 	 * The resultset starts at this position from the query result
 144 	 * Use -1 to disable this option.
 145 	 * @var integer
 146 	 */
 147 	protected $select_offset = -1;
 148 
 149 	/**
 150 	 * Array to manage late binding for IN constructs
 151 	 * @var array
 152 	 */
 153 	protected $late_binding_in_clause = array();
 154 
 155 	protected static $oracle_in_limit = 1000; # this could be a constant
 156 
 157 
 158 	/**
 159 	 * Construct a new query object.
 160 	 *
 161 	 * Optional parameters are the query string, and an array of values to be
 162 	 * bound to labeled parameters.
 163 	 *
 164 	 * @param string $p_query_string Query string
 165 	 * @param array $p_bind_array    Bind values
 166 	 *
 167 	 * @return void
 168 	 */
 169 	public function __construct( string $p_query_string = '', array $p_bind_array = [] ) {
 170 		$this->query_string = $p_query_string;
 171 		$this->query_bind_array = $p_bind_array;
 172 	}
 173 
 174 	/**
 175 	 * Set or replaces current query string
 176 	 * @param string $p_query_string	Query string
 177 	 * @return void
 178 	 */
 179 	public function sql( $p_query_string ) {
 180 		$this->query_string = $p_query_string;
 181 	}
 182 
 183 	/**
 184 	 * Append to current query string
 185 	 * @param string $p_query_string	Query string
 186 	 * @return void
 187 	 */
 188 	public function append_sql( $p_query_string ) {
 189 		$this->query_string .= $p_query_string;
 190 	}
 191 
 192 	/**
 193 	 * Creates a string containing a parameter that can be appended to the query string
 194 	 * The provided value is binded to the parameter and stored for use at execution time
 195 	 * The parameters created by this method are anonymous parameters, so they can't be
 196 	 * accessed later to have values modified or rebinded.
 197 	 * The format of the token created is: "$n", where "n" is an incremental integer
 198 	 * @param mixed $p_value	Value to bind for this parameter
 199 	 * @return string			Token string
 200 	 */
 201 	public function param( $p_value ) {
 202 		$t_new_id = $this->query_autobind_count++;
 203 		$this->query_autobind_array[$t_new_id] = $p_value;
 204 		$t_par = '$' . $t_new_id;
 205 		return $t_par;
 206 	}
 207 
 208 	/**
 209 	 * Sets the "limit" value. This value is used for all subsequent query executions
 210 	 * Use -1 to disable this option
 211 	 * @param integer $p_limit	Number of rows to limit
 212 	 * @return void
 213 	 */
 214 	public function set_limit( $p_limit = -1 ) {
 215 		$this->select_limit = $p_limit;
 216 	}
 217 
 218 	/**
 219 	 * Sets the "offset" value. This value is used for all subsequent query executions
 220 	 * Use -1 to disable this option
 221 	 * @param integer $p_offset	Number of rows to offset
 222 	 * @return void
 223 	 */
 224 	public function set_offset( $p_offset = -1 ) {
 225 		$this->select_offset = $p_offset;
 226 	}
 227 
 228 	/**
 229 	 * Executes the query, performing all preprocess and binding steps.
 230 	 *
 231 	 * A bind array can be provided, which will be added to current bindings.
 232 	 * If specified, limit and offset options will affect this execution only.
 233 	 *
 234 	 * @param array $p_bind_array Array for binding values
 235 	 * @param int   $p_limit      Limit value
 236 	 * @param int   $p_offset     Offset value
 237 	 *
 238 	 * @return IteratorAggregate|boolean ADOdb result set or false if the query failed.
 239 	 */
 240 	public function execute( array $p_bind_array = [], $p_limit = null, $p_offset = null ) {
 241 		# For backwards compatibility with legacy code still relying on DB API,
 242 		# we need to save the parameters count before binding otherwise it will
 243 		# be reset after query execution, which will cause issues on RDBMS with
 244 		# numbered params (e.g. PostgreSQL).
 245 		db_param_push();
 246 
 247 		# bind values if provided
 248 		if( !empty( $p_bind_array ) ) {
 249 			$this->bind_values( $p_bind_array );
 250 		}
 251 
 252 		# preprocess parameters
 253 		$this->process_expand_params();
 254 		$this->process_bind_params();
 255 		$this->process_sql_syntax();
 256 
 257 		$t_result = $this->db_execute($p_limit, $p_offset);
 258 		db_param_pop();
 259 		return $t_result;
 260 	}
 261 
 262 	/**
 263 	 * Call ADOdb execution of sql string.
 264 	 * At this point all preprocessing and value binding has been performed.
 265 	 * @param integer $p_limit	Limit value
 266 	 * @param integer $p_offset	Offset value
 267 	 * @return IteratorAggregate|boolean ADOdb result set or false if the query failed.
 268 	 */
 269 	protected function db_execute( $p_limit = null, $p_offset = null ) {
 270 		global $g_db;
 271 
 272 		# get limit and offset
 273 		if( null !== $p_limit ) {
 274 			$t_limit = $p_limit;
 275 		} else {
 276 			$t_limit = $this->select_limit;
 277 		}
 278 		if( null !== $p_offset ) {
 279 			$t_offset = $p_offset;
 280 		} else {
 281 			$t_offset = $this->select_offset;
 282 		}
 283 
 284 		$t_start = microtime( true );
 285 
 286 		if( ( $t_limit != -1 ) || ( $t_offset != -1 ) ) {
 287 			$this->db_result = $g_db->SelectLimit( $this->db_query_string, $t_limit, $t_offset, $this->db_param_array );
 288 		} else {
 289 			$this->db_result = $g_db->Execute( $this->db_query_string, $this->db_param_array );
 290 		}
 291 
 292 		$this->db_query_time = number_format( microtime( true ) - $t_start, 4 );
 293 
 294 		$this->log_query();
 295 
 296 		if( !$this->db_result ) {
 297 			db_error( $this->db_query_string );
 298 			trigger_error( ERROR_DB_QUERY_FAILED, ERROR );
 299 			$this->db_result = false;
 300 		}
 301 		$this->current_row = null;
 302 		return $this->db_result;
 303 	}
 304 
 305 	/**
 306 	 * Logs data from latest execution
 307 	 * @return void
 308 	 */
 309 	protected function log_query() {
 310 		global $g_db_log_queries, $g_queries_array;
 311 		if( ON == $g_db_log_queries ) {
 312 			$t_query_text = db_format_query_log_msg( $this->db_query_string, $this->db_param_array );
 313 			log_event( LOG_DATABASE, array( $t_query_text, $this->db_query_time ) );
 314 		} else {
 315 			# If not logging the queries the actual text is not needed
 316 			$t_query_text = '';
 317 		}
 318 		array_push( $g_queries_array, array( $t_query_text, $this->db_query_time ) );
 319 	}
 320 
 321 	/**
 322 	 * Bind values for labeled parameters.
 323 	 * An array indexed by label names must be provided.
 324 	 * @param array $p_values_array	Array of values
 325 	 * @return void
 326 	 */
 327 	public function bind_values( array $p_values_array ) {
 328 		$this->query_bind_array = $p_values_array + $this->query_bind_array;
 329 	}
 330 
 331 	/**
 332 	 * Binds values to a labeled parameters
 333 	 * When using:
 334 	 * bind(string, value) binds one value to one parameter
 335 	 * bind(array) is an alias for method "bind_values(array)"
 336 	 * @param mixed $p_label_or_values	A labeled parameter name, or array for value bindings
 337 	 * @param mixed $p_value			A value to bind
 338 	 * @return void
 339 	 */
 340 	public function bind( $p_label_or_values, $p_value = null ) {
 341 		if( is_array( $p_label_or_values ) ) {
 342 			# is a values array
 343 			$this->bind_values( $p_label_or_values );
 344 		} else {
 345 			# is a label string
 346 			$this->query_bind_array[$p_label_or_values] = $p_value;
 347 		}
 348 	}
 349 
 350 	/**
 351 	 * Performs some specific preprocessing on sql string
 352 	 * - replace table names from abbreviated syntax
 353 	 * - replaces boolean values to fix some db driver inconsistencies
 354 	 * - process oracle syntax fixes for compatibility
 355 	 * @return void
 356 	 */
 357 	protected function process_sql_syntax() {
 358 		global $g_db;
 359 
 360 		static $s_prefix;
 361 		static $s_suffix;
 362 		if( $s_prefix === null ) {
 363 			# Determine table prefix and suffixes including trailing and leading '_'
 364 			$s_prefix = trim( config_get_global( 'db_table_prefix' ) );
 365 			$s_suffix = trim( config_get_global( 'db_table_suffix' ) );
 366 
 367 			if( !empty( $s_prefix ) && '_' != substr( $s_prefix, -1 ) ) {
 368 				$s_prefix .= '_';
 369 			}
 370 			if( !empty( $s_suffix ) && '_' != substr( $s_suffix, 0, 1 ) ) {
 371 				$s_suffix = '_' . $s_suffix;
 372 			}
 373 		}
 374 
 375 		$this->db_query_string = strtr( $this->db_query_string,
 376 			array( '{' => $s_prefix, '}' => $s_suffix )
 377 			);
 378 
 379 		# check parameters for special treatment of boolean types
 380 		# use the native values provided by the ADOdb driver
 381 		foreach( $this->db_param_array as $t_key => $t_value ) {
 382 			if( $t_value === false ) {
 383 				$this->db_param_array[$t_key] = $g_db->false;
 384 			} elseif( $t_value === true ) {
 385 				$this->db_param_array[$t_key] = $g_db->true;
 386 			}
 387 		}
 388 
 389 		if( db_is_oracle() ) {
 390 			$this->process_sql_syntax_oracle();
 391 		}
 392 	}
 393 
 394 	/**
 395 	 * Process current query string converting all internal parameter placeholders
 396 	 * to final ADOdb parameter syntax.
 397 	 * Will convert all labeled ":xxx", and anonymous "$n" parameters, and build
 398 	 * a values array suitable for ADOdb.
 399 	 * @param integer $p_counter_start
 400 	 * @return integer	Number of parameters created
 401 	 */
 402 	protected function process_bind_params( $p_counter_start = 0) {
 403 		global $g_db;
 404 
 405 		# shortcut, if no values are binded, skip parameter replacement
 406 		if( empty( $this->query_autobind_array ) && empty( $this->query_bind_array ) ) {
 407 			$this->db_query_string = $this->query_string;
 408 			$this->db_param_array = array();
 409 		}
 410 
 411 		$t_query_string = $this->expanded_query_string;
 412 
 413 		$t_new_query = '';
 414 		$t_new_binds = array();
 415 		$t_par_index = $p_counter_start;
 416 		$t_par_count = 0;
 417 		$t_parts = preg_split( '/(:[a-z0-9_]+)|(\$[0-9]+)/mi', $t_query_string, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY | PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE );
 418 		foreach( $t_parts as $t_part ) {
 419 
 420 			$t_first = substr( $t_part, 0, 1 );
 421 
 422 			if( $t_first === '$' || $t_first === ':' ) {
 423 
 424 				$t_label = substr( $t_part, 1 );
 425 				switch( $t_first ) {
 426 					case '$':
 427 						$t_value = $this->query_autobind_array[(int)$t_label];
 428 						break;
 429 					case ':':
 430 						$t_value = $this->query_bind_array[$t_label];
 431 						break;
 432 				}
 433 
 434 				if( is_array( $t_value ) ) {
 435 					$t_params_for_array = array();
 436 					foreach( $t_value as $t_array_item ) {
 437 						$t_params_for_array[] = $g_db->Param( $t_par_index );
 438 						$t_new_binds[$t_par_index] = $t_array_item;
 439 						$t_par_count++;
 440 						$t_par_index++;
 441 					}
 442 					$t_new_query .= '(' . implode( ',', $t_params_for_array ) . ')';
 443 				} elseif( $t_value instanceof DbQuery ) {
 444 					# preprocess subquery object
 445 					$t_value->process_expand_params();
 446 					$t_sub_params = $t_value->process_bind_params( $t_par_index );
 447 					$t_par_index += $t_sub_params;
 448 					$t_par_count += $t_sub_params;
 449 					# append subquery
 450 					$t_new_binds = $t_new_binds + $t_value->db_param_array;
 451 					$t_new_query .= '(' . $t_value->db_query_string . ')';
 452 				} else {
 453 					$t_new_query .= $g_db->Param( $t_par_index );
 454 					$t_new_binds[$t_par_index] = $t_value;
 455 					$t_par_count++;
 456 					$t_par_index++;
 457 				}
 458 
 459 				continue;
 460 			}
 461 
 462 			# default
 463 			$t_new_query .= $t_part;
 464 		}
 465 
 466 		$this->db_query_string = $t_new_query;
 467 		$this->db_param_array = $t_new_binds;
 468 
 469 		return $t_par_count;
 470 	}
 471 
 472 	/**
 473 	 * Builds an alternative IN expression to work around Oracle limits.
 474 	 * (X, field) IN ( (X,V1), (X,V2), ... ) where X is a constant value
 475 	 * is equivalent to: field IN (V1,V2,..)
 476 	 * @param string $p_alias
 477 	 * @param array $p_values
 478 	 * @return string
 479 	 */
 480 	protected function helper_in_oracle_fix( $p_alias, array $p_values ) {
 481 		$t_in_tuples = array();
 482 		foreach( $p_values as $t_value ) {
 483 			$t_in_tuples[] = '(1,' . $this->param( $t_value ) . ')';
 484 		}
 485 		$t_sql = '(1,' . $p_alias . ') IN (' . implode( ',', $t_in_tuples ) . ')';
 486 		return $t_sql;
 487 	}
 488 
 489 	/**
 490 	 * Process query string to expand late binding constructs
 491 	 * @return void
 492 	 */
 493 	protected function process_expand_params() {
 494 		# original query_string should not be modified to allow for rebinding
 495 		$this->expanded_query_string = $this->query_string;
 496 
 497 		if( !empty( $this->late_binding_in_clause ) ) {
 498 			$this->process_expand_params_in();
 499 		}
 500 	}
 501 
 502 	/**
 503 	 * Process query string to expand late binding constructs for IN clauses
 504 	 * @return void
 505 	 */
 506 	protected function process_expand_params_in() {
 507 		$t_new_query = '';
 508 		$t_parts = preg_split( '/(\$in[0-9]+)/m', $this->expanded_query_string, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY | PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE );
 509 		foreach( $t_parts as $t_part ) {
 510 			$t_is_token = substr( $t_part, 0, 3 ) === '$in';
 511 			if( $t_is_token ) {
 512 				$t_index = (int)substr( $t_part, 3 );
 513 				$t_label =  $this->late_binding_in_clause[$t_index]['label'];
 514 				$t_alias =  $this->late_binding_in_clause[$t_index]['alias'];
 515 				$t_values = $this->query_bind_array[$t_label];
 516 				if( count( $t_values ) > self::$oracle_in_limit ) {
 517 					$t_new_query .= $this->helper_in_oracle_fix( $t_alias, $t_values );
 518 				} elseif( count( $t_values ) == 1 ) {
 519 					$t_new_query .= $t_alias . ' = ' . $this->param( reset( $t_values ) );
 520 				} else {
 521 					$t_new_query .= $t_alias . ' IN ' . $this->param( $t_values );
 522 				}
 523 				continue;
 524 			}
 525 
 526 			$t_new_query .= $t_part;
 527 		}
 528 		$this->expanded_query_string = $t_new_query;
 529 	}
 530 
 531 	/**
 532 	 * Creates a string construction for an IN expression, providing:
 533 	 * - alias: is the name of the column as a valid identifier in the final sql query
 534 	 * - a label, or an array of values
 535 	 * If a label is provided, the values must be binded as separate calls to binding methods.
 536 	 *
 537 	 * The returned string would replace the sql part for: "alias IN (x,x,x)"
 538 	 *
 539 	 * To work around Oracle limit of 1000 elements in IN clauses, using a label
 540 	 * is recommended in situations that this number may be reached.
 541 	 * This construct will then automatically deal with a compatible syntax fix.
 542 	 * Using a label in this scenario is needed because the fix must be implemented
 543 	 * with a late binding of the array at execution time (this also allows correctly
 544 	 * rebinding the elements for the IN clause)
 545 	 *
 546 	 * @param string $p_alias			A valid sql column identifier
 547 	 * @param mixed $p_label_or_values	Label or values array
 548 	 * @return string	Constructed string to be added to query
 549 	 */
 550 	public function sql_in( $p_alias, $p_label_or_values ) {
 551 		if( is_array( $p_label_or_values ) ) {
 552 			if( db_is_oracle() && count( $p_label_or_values ) > self::$oracle_in_limit ) {
 553 				$t_sql = $this->helper_in_oracle_fix( $p_alias, $p_label_or_values );
 554 			} elseif( count( $p_label_or_values ) == 1 ) {
 555 				$t_sql = $p_alias . ' = ' . $this->param( reset( $p_label_or_values ) );
 556 			} else {
 557 				$t_sql = $p_alias . ' IN ' . $this->param( $p_label_or_values );
 558 			}
 559 		} else {
 560 			# is a label
 561 			# create placeholder for late binding
 562 			$t_new_index = count( $this->late_binding_in_clause );
 563 			$this->late_binding_in_clause[$t_new_index] = array();
 564 			$this->late_binding_in_clause[$t_new_index]['alias'] = $p_alias;
 565 			$this->late_binding_in_clause[$t_new_index]['label'] = $p_label_or_values;
 566 			$t_sql = '$in' . $t_new_index;
 567 		}
 568 
 569 		return $t_sql;
 570 	}
 571 
 572 	protected function process_sql_syntax_oracle() {
 573 		# Remove "AS" keyword, because not supported with table aliasing
 574 		# - Do not remove text literal within "'" quotes
 575 		# - Will remove all "AS", except when it's part of a "CAST(x AS y)" expression
 576 		#   To do so, we will assume that the "AS" following a "CAST", is safe to be kept.
 577 		#   Using a counter for "CAST" appearances to allow nesting: CAST(CAST(x AS y) AS z)
 578 
 579 		$t_query = $this->db_query_string;
 580 
 581 		# split the string by the relevant delimiters. The delimiters will be part of the split array
 582 		$t_parts = preg_split("/(')|( AS )|(CAST\s*\()/mi", $t_query, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY | PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE);
 583 		$t_is_literal = false;
 584 		$t_cast = 0;
 585 		$t_new_query = '';
 586 		foreach( $t_parts as $t_part ) {
 587 			# if quotes, switch literal flag
 588 			if( $t_part == '\'' ) {
 589 				$t_is_literal = !$t_is_literal;
 590 				$t_new_query .= $t_part;
 591 				continue;
 592 			}
 593 			# if this part is litereal, do not change
 594 			if( $t_is_literal ) {
 595 				$t_new_query .= $t_part;
 596 				continue;
 597 			} else {
 598 				# if there is "CAST" delimiter, flag the counter
 599 				if( preg_match( '/^CAST\s*\($/i', $t_part ) ) {
 600 					$t_cast++;
 601 					$t_new_query .= $t_part;
 602 					continue;
 603 				}
 604 				# if there is "AS"
 605 				if( strcasecmp( $t_part, ' AS ' ) == 0 ) {
 606 					# if there's a previous CAST, keep the AS
 607 					if( $t_cast > 0 ) {
 608 						$t_cast--;
 609 						$t_new_query .= $t_part;
 610 					} else {
 611 						# otherwise, remove the " AS ", replace by a space
 612 						$t_new_query .= ' ';
 613 					}
 614 					continue;
 615 				}
 616 				$t_new_query .= $t_part;
 617 				continue;
 618 			}
 619 		}
 620 		$t_query = $t_new_query;
 621 
 622 		# Remove null bind variables in insert statements for default values support
 623 		if( is_array( $this->db_param_array ) ) {
 624 			preg_match( '/^[\s\n\r]*insert[\s\n\r]+(into){0,1}[\s\n\r]+(?P<table>[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*\([\s\n\r]*[\s\n\r]*(?P<fields>[a-z0-9_,\s\n\r]+)[\s\n\r]*\)[\s\n\r]*values[\s\n\r]*\([\s\n\r]*(?P<values>[:a-z0-9_,\s\n\r]+)\)/i', $t_query, $t_matches );
 625 
 626 			if( isset( $t_matches['values'] ) ) { #if statement is a INSERT INTO ... (...) VALUES(...)
 627 				# iterates non-empty bind variables
 628 				$i = 0;
 629 				$t_fields_left = $t_matches['fields'];
 630 				$t_values_left = $t_matches['values'];
 631 
 632 				//for( $t_arr_index = 0; $t_arr_index < count( $this->db_param_array ); $t_arr_index++ ) {
 633 				foreach( $this->db_param_array as $t_arr_index => $t_arr_value ) {
 634 					# inserting fieldname search
 635 					if( preg_match( '/^[\s\n\r]*([a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*,{0,1}([\d\D]*)\z/i', $t_fields_left, $t_fieldmatch ) ) {
 636 						$t_fields_left = $t_fieldmatch[2];
 637 						$t_fields_arr[$i] = $t_fieldmatch[1];
 638 					}
 639 					# inserting bindvar name search
 640 					if( preg_match( '/^[\s\n\r]*(:[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*,{0,1}([\d\D]*)\z/i', $t_values_left, $t_valuematch ) ) {
 641 						$t_values_left = $t_valuematch[2];
 642 						$t_values_arr[$i] = $t_valuematch[1];
 643 					}
 644 					# skip unsetting if bind array value not empty
 645 					//if( $this->db_param_array[$t_arr_index] !== '' ) {
 646 					if( $t_arr_value !== '' ) {
 647 						$i++;
 648 					} else {
 649 						unset( $t_fields_arr[$i] );
 650 						unset( $t_values_arr[$i] );
 651 						unset( $this->db_param_array[$t_arr_index] );
 652 						/*
 653 						$t_arr_index--;
 654 						# Shift array and unset bind array element
 655 						for( $n = $i + 1; $n < count( $this->db_param_array ); $n++ ) {
 656 							$this->db_param_array[$n-1] = $this->db_param_array[$n];
 657 						}
 658 						unset( $t_fields_arr[$i] );
 659 						unset( $t_values_arr[$i] );
 660 						unset( $this->db_param_array[count( $this->db_param_array ) - 1] );
 661 						 */
 662 					}
 663 				}
 664 
 665 				# Combine statement from arrays
 666 				$t_query = 'INSERT INTO ' . $t_matches['table'] . ' (' . implode( ',', $t_fields_arr ) . ')'
 667 					. ' VALUES (' . implode( ',', $t_values_arr ) . ')';
 668 				/*
 669 				$t_query = 'INSERT INTO ' . $t_matches['table'] . ' (' . $t_fields_arr[0];
 670 				for( $i = 1; $i < count( $this->db_param_array ); $i++ ) {
 671 					$t_query = $t_query . ', ' . $t_fields_arr[$i];
 672 				}
 673 				$t_query = $t_query . ') values (' . $t_values_arr[0];
 674 				for( $i = 1; $i < count( $this->db_param_array ); $i++ ) {
 675 					$t_query = $t_query . ', ' . $t_values_arr[$i];
 676 				}
 677 				$t_query = $t_query . ')';
 678 				 */
 679 			} else {
 680 				# if input statement is NOT a INSERT INTO (...) VALUES(...)
 681 
 682 				# "IS NULL" adoptation here
 683 				$t_set_where_template_str = substr( md5( uniqid( rand(), true ) ), 0, 50 );
 684 				$t_removed_set_where = '';
 685 
 686 				# Find and remove temporarily "SET var1=:bind1, var2=:bind2 WHERE" part
 687 				preg_match( '/^(?P<before_set_where>.*)(?P<set_where>[\s\n\r]*set[\s\n\r]+[\s\n\ra-z0-9_\.=,:\']+)(?P<after_set_where>where[\d\D]*)$/i', $t_query, $t_matches );
 688 				$t_set_where_stmt = isset( $t_matches['after_set_where'] );
 689 
 690 				if( $t_set_where_stmt ) {
 691 					$t_removed_set_where = $t_matches['set_where'];
 692 					# Now work with statement without "SET ... WHERE" part
 693 					$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_set_where'] . $t_set_where_template_str . $t_matches['after_set_where'];
 694 				} else {
 695 					$t_templated_query = $t_query;
 696 				}
 697 
 698 				# Replace "var1=''" by "var1 IS NULL"
 699 				while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_empty_literal>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r(]+([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*=[\s\n\r]*\'\'(?P<after_empty_literal>[\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_templated_query, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
 700 					$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_empty_literal'] . ' IS NULL ' . $t_matches['after_empty_literal'];
 701 				}
 702 				# Replace "var1!=''" and "var1<>''" by "var1 IS NOT NULL"
 703 				while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_empty_literal>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r(]+([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*(![\s\n\r]*=|<[\s\n\r]*>)[\s\n\r]*\'\'(?P<after_empty_literal>[\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_templated_query, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
 704 					$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_empty_literal'] . ' IS NOT NULL ' . $t_matches['after_empty_literal'];
 705 				}
 706 
 707 				$t_query = $t_templated_query;
 708 				# Process input bind variable array to replace "WHERE fld=:12"
 709 				# by "WHERE fld IS NULL" if :12 is empty
 710 				while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_var>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r(]+)(?P<var_name>([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)(?P<dividers>[\s\n\r]*=[\s\n\r]*:)(?P<bind_name>[0-9]+)(?P<after_var>[\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_templated_query, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
 711 					$t_bind_num = $t_matches['bind_name'];
 712 
 713 					$t_search_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . $t_matches['dividers'] . $t_matches['bind_name'] . $t_matches['after_var'];
 714 					$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . '=:' . $t_matches['bind_name']. $t_matches['after_var'];
 715 
 716 					if( $this->db_param_array[$t_bind_num] === '' ) {
 717 						unset( $this->db_param_array[$t_bind_num] );
 718 						/*
 719 						for( $n = $t_bind_num + 1; $n < count( $this->db_param_array ); $n++ ) {
 720 							$this->db_param_array[$n - 1] = $this->db_param_array[$n];
 721 						}
 722 						unset( $this->db_param_array[count( $this->db_param_array ) - 1] );
 723 						 */
 724 						$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . ' IS NULL ' . $t_matches['after_var'];
 725 					}
 726 					$t_query = str_replace( $t_search_substr, $t_replace_substr, $t_query );
 727 
 728 					$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['after_var'];
 729 				}
 730 
 731 				if( $t_set_where_stmt ) {
 732 					# Put temporarily removed "SET ... WHERE" part back
 733 					$t_query = str_replace( $t_set_where_template_str, $t_removed_set_where, $t_query );
 734 					# Find and remove temporary "SET var1=:bind1, var2=:bind2 WHERE" part again
 735 					preg_match( '/^(?P<before_set_where>.*)(?P<set_where>[\s\n\r]*set[\s\n\r]+[\s\n\ra-z0-9_\.=,:\']+)(?P<after_set_where>where[\d\D]*)$/i', $t_query, $t_matches );
 736 					$t_removed_set_where = $t_matches['set_where'];
 737 					$t_query = $t_matches['before_set_where'] . $t_set_where_template_str . $t_matches['after_set_where'];
 738 
 739 					#Replace "SET fld1=:1" to "SET fld1=DEFAULT" if bind array value is empty
 740 					$t_removed_set_where_parsing = $t_removed_set_where;
 741 
 742 					while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_var>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r,]+)(?P<var_name>([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)(?P<dividers>[\s\n\r]*=[\s\n\r]*:)(?P<bind_name>[0-9]+)(?P<after_var>[,\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_removed_set_where_parsing, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
 743 						$t_bind_num = $t_matches['bind_name'];
 744 						$t_search_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . $t_matches['dividers'] . $t_matches['bind_name'] ;
 745 						$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . $t_matches['dividers'] . $t_matches['bind_name'] ;
 746 
 747 						if( $this->db_param_array[$t_bind_num] === '' ) {
 748 							unset( $this->db_param_array[$t_bind_num] );
 749 							/*
 750 							for( $n = $t_bind_num + 1; $n < count( $this->db_param_array ); $n++ ) {
 751 								$this->db_param_array[$n - 1] = $this->db_param_array[$n];
 752 							}
 753 							unset( $this->db_param_array[count( $this->db_param_array ) - 1] );
 754 							 */
 755 							$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . '=DEFAULT ';
 756 						}
 757 						$t_removed_set_where = str_replace( $t_search_substr, $t_replace_substr, $t_removed_set_where );
 758 						$t_removed_set_where_parsing = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['after_var'];
 759 					}
 760 					$t_query = str_replace( $t_set_where_template_str, $t_removed_set_where, $t_query );
 761 				}
 762 			}
 763 		}
 764 
 765 		$this->db_query_string = $t_query;
 766 	}
 767 
 768 	/**
 769 	 * Compatibility method to support execution of legacy query syntax through db_query().
 770 	 *
 771 	 * @param string $p_query     Query string
 772 	 * @param array  $p_params    Values array for parameters
 773 	 * @param int    $p_limit     Query limit
 774 	 * @param int    $p_offset    Query offset
 775 	 * @param bool   $p_pop_param Set to false to leave the parameters on the stack
 776 	 *
 777 	 * @return IteratorAggregate|false ADOdb result set or false if the query failed
 778 	 */
 779 	public static function compat_db_query( string $p_query, array $p_params = [], int $p_limit = -1, int $p_offset = -1, bool $p_pop_param = true ) {
 780 		global $g_db_param;
 781 
 782 		$t_query = new DbQuery();
 783 		$t_query->db_query_string = $p_query;
 784 		$t_query->db_param_array = $p_params;
 785 
 786 		$t_query->process_sql_syntax();
 787 
 788 		# Pushing params to safeguard the ADOdb parameter count (required for pgsql)
 789 		$g_db_param->push();
 790 
 791 		$t_query->db_execute( $p_limit, $p_offset );
 792 
 793 		# Restore ADOdb parameter count
 794 		$g_db_param->pop();
 795 
 796 		if( $p_pop_param && !empty( $p_params ) ) {
 797 			$g_db_param->pop();
 798 		}
 799 
 800 		return $t_query->db_result;
 801 	}
 802 
 803 	/**
 804 	 * Returns next row of values from current resultset, or false if empty or
 805 	 * the pointer has reached the end.
 806 	 * This method will execute current query if it hasn't been executed yet.
 807 	 * @return array|boolean	Next row from result
 808 	 */
 809 	public function fetch() {
 810 		if( null === $this->db_result ) {
 811 			$this->execute();
 812 		}
 813 		if( !$this->db_result ) {
 814 			return false;
 815 		}
 816 		$this->current_row = db_fetch_array( $this->db_result );
 817 		return $this->current_row;
 818 	}
 819 
 820 	/**
 821 	 * Returns all rows as an array
 822 	 * @return array|boolean	Array with all rows from the result, false if result is empty.
 823 	 */
 824 	public function fetch_all() {
 825 		if( null === $this->db_result ) {
 826 			$this->execute();
 827 		}
 828 		if( !$this->db_result ) {
 829 			return false;
 830 		}
 831 		$t_all_rows = array();
 832 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $this->db_result ) ) {
 833 			$t_all_rows[] = $t_row;
 834 		}
 835 		return $t_all_rows;
 836 	}
 837 
 838 	/**
 839 	 * Returns one value from current row from resultset
 840 	 * Provided parameter can be a name of the column referenced in the query,
 841 	 * or a numerical index (zero-based)
 842 	 * Without column parameters,first column value will be returned.
 843 	 *
 844 	 * Current row is the latest one fetched, if none was fetched previously, an
 845 	 * automatic fetch() is performed for first row
 846 	 *
 847 	 * @param integer|string $p_index_or_name	Column name or numeric index
 848 	 * @return string|boolean	Value, or false if end of result or index is not valid
 849 	 */
 850 	public function value( $p_index_or_name = 0) {
 851 		if( !$this->current_row ) {
 852 			$this->fetch();
 853 		}
 854 		if( is_numeric( $p_index_or_name ) ) {
 855 			if( $this->current_row && count( $this->current_row ) > $p_index_or_name ) {
 856 				# get the element at that numerical position
 857 				$t_keys = array_keys( $this->current_row );
 858 				$t_value = $this->current_row[$t_keys[$p_index_or_name]];
 859 			} else {
 860 				$t_value = false;
 861 			}
 862 		} else {
 863 			if( isset( $this->current_row[$p_index_or_name] ) ) {
 864 				# get the value by column name
 865 				$t_value = $this->current_row[$p_index_or_name];
 866 			} else {
 867 				$t_value = false;
 868 			}
 869 		}
 870 		return $t_value;
 871 	}
 872 
 873 	/**
 874 	 * Alias for value()
 875 	 * @param integer|string $p_index_or_name	Column name or numeric index
 876 	 */
 877 	public function field( $p_index_or_name = 0) {
 878 		return $this->value( $p_index_or_name );
 879 	}
 880 
 881 	/**
 882 	 * Creates a string construction for a case-insensitive LIKE expression
 883 	 * This is an alias for sql_like() with the force_ci parameter set to true.
 884 	 * @param string $p_alias		A valid sql column identifier
 885 	 * @param string $p_pattern		Pattern string
 886 	 * @param string $p_escape		Escape character
 887 	 * @return string	Constructed string to be added to query
 888 	 */
 889 	public function sql_ilike( $p_alias, $p_pattern, $p_escape = null ) {
 890 		return $this->sql_like( $p_alias, $p_pattern, $p_escape, true );
 891 	}
 892 
 893 	/**
 894 	 * Creates a string construction for a LIKE expression, providing:
 895 	 * - alias: is the name of the column as a valid identifier in the final sql query
 896 	 * - value: is the string used as pattern for the like expression.
 897 	 * - escape: optionally, a character used as escape character in the pattern string
 898 	 * Optionally, the expression can be forced to be case insensitive, otherwise the default
 899 	 * behaviour from the database is used.
 900 	 *
 901 	 * The returned string would replace the sql part for: "alias LIKE 'xxx'"
 902 	 *
 903 	 * For portability reasons, the supported wildcards are '%' and '_'. Other special tokens
 904 	 * are automatically escaped:
 905 	 * - [] syntax in mssql are treated as literal characters.
 906 	 * - \ as default escape char in mysql is treated as a literal character.
 907 	 * Note that the pattern string uses c-style escaping, so a "\" character must be written as "\\"
 908 	 *
 909 	 * The pattern string must be prepared by the caller, with proper wildcards and character escaping.
 910 	 *
 911 	 * @param string $p_alias		A valid sql column identifier
 912 	 * @param string $p_pattern		Pattern string
 913 	 * @param string $p_escape		Escape character
 914 	 * @param boolean $p_force_ci	If true, force a case-insensitive expression
 915 	 * @return string	Constructed string to be added to query
 916 	 */
 917 	public function sql_like( $p_alias, $p_pattern, $p_escape = null, $p_force_ci = false ) {
 918 		# for mssql replace "[" as this is a special non portable token
 919 		if( db_is_mssql() && strpos( $p_pattern, '[' ) !== false ) {
 920 			if( null === $p_escape = null ) {
 921 				$p_escape = '\\';
 922 			}
 923 			$p_pattern = str_replace( '[', $p_escape . '[', $p_pattern );
 924 		}
 925 
 926 		# for mysql replace "\\" if this char is nor already a explicit escape char
 927 		# because mysql uses \ as default escape char if ESCAPE caluse is not used
 928 		if( db_is_mysql() && $p_escape != '\\' && strpos( $p_pattern, '\\' ) !== false ) {
 929 			if( null === $p_escape = null ) {
 930 					$p_escape = '\\';
 931 			}
 932 			$p_pattern = str_replace( '\\', $p_escape . '\\', $p_pattern );
 933 		}
 934 
 935 		$t_expr = $p_alias;
 936 		$t_operator = 'LIKE';
 937 		$t_pattern = $p_pattern;
 938 
 939 		# Here we assume that by default:
 940 		# mysql, mssql: have case-insensitive collations
 941 		# pgsql, oracle: have case-sensitive collations
 942 		# Otherwise, a more complicated discovery should be implemented.
 943 		if( $p_force_ci ) {
 944 			global $g_db_functional_type;
 945 			switch( $g_db_functional_type ) {
 946 				case DB_TYPE_PGSQL:
 947 					$t_operator = 'ILIKE';
 948 					break;
 949 				case DB_TYPE_ORACLE:
 950 					$t_expr = 'upper(' . $t_expr . ')';
 951 					$t_pattern = strtoupper( $t_pattern );
 952 					break;
 953 			}
 954 		}
 955 
 956 		$t_sql = $t_expr . ' ' . $t_operator . ' ' . $this->param( $t_pattern );
 957 		if( null !== $p_escape ) {
 958 			$t_sql .= ' ESCAPE ' . $this->param( $p_escape );
 959 		}
 960 		return $t_sql;
 961 	}
 962 }

  40 		);
  41 	}

  48 	 * @return string plain text
  49 	 */
  50 	function text( $p_event, $p_string, $p_multiline = true ) {

  52 	}

   1 <?php
   2 # MantisBT - A PHP based bugtracking system
   3 
   4 # MantisBT is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
   5 # it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
   6 # the Free Software Foundation, either version 2 of the License, or
