  15 # along with MantisBT.  If not, see <http://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
  16 
  17 /**
  18  * Mantis Plugin Handling
  19  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  20  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  21  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  22  * @package MantisBT
  23  * @subpackage classes
  24  */
  25 
  26 /**
  27  * Base class that implements basic plugin functionality
  28  * and integration with MantisBT. See the Mantis wiki for
  29  * more information.
  30  */
  31 abstract class MantisPlugin {
  32 	/**
  33 	 * Constants indicating the Plugin's validity status
  34 	 *
  35 	 * - VALID - Plugin is valid
  36 	 * - INVALID - Generic invalid status
  37 	 * - INCOMPLETE_DEFINITION - The plugin's definition is incomplete
  38 	 *   (i.e. required properties 'name' or 'version' are missing)
  39 	 * - MISSING_BASE_CLASS - Plugin directory exists but does not contain a
  40 	 *   matching Class
  41 	 * - MISSING_PLUGIN - The plugin has been installed, but its source code
  42 	 *   is no longer available in plugin_path directory
  43 	 *
  44 	 * @see MantisPlugin::$status
  45 	 */
  46 	const STATUS_VALID = 0;
  47 	const STATUS_INVALID = 1;
  48 	const STATUS_INCOMPLETE_DEFINITION = 2;
  49 	const STATUS_MISSING_BASE_CLASS = 3;
  50 	const STATUS_MISSING_PLUGIN = 4;
  51 	const STATUS_MISSING_EVENTS = 5;
  52 
  53 	/**
  54 	 * Plugin Basename
  55 	 */
  56 	public $basename = null;
  57 
  58 	/**
  59 	 * name - Your plugin's full name. Required value.
  60 	 */
  61 	public $name = null;
  62 
  63 	/**
  64 	 * description - A full description of your plugin.
  65 	 */
  66 	public $description	= null;
  67 
  68 	/**
  69 	 * page - The name of a plugin page for further information and administration.
  70 	 */
  71 	public $page = null;
  72 
  73 	/**
  74 	 * version - Your plugin's version string. Required value.
  75 	 */
  76 	public $version = null;
  77 
  78 	/**
  79 	 * requires - An array of key/value pairs of basename/version plugin dependencies.
  80 	 * Prefixing a version with '<' will allow your plugin to specify a maximum version (non-inclusive) for a dependency.
  81 	 */
  82 	public $requires = null;
  83 
  84 	/**
  85 	 * An array of key/value pairs of basename/version  plugin dependencies (soft dependency)
  86 	 */
  87 	public $uses = null;
  88 
  89 	/**
  90 	 * author - Your name, or an array of names.
  91 	 */
  92 	public $author = null;
  93 
  94 	/**
  95 	 * contact - An email address where you can be contacted.
  96 	 */
  97 	public $contact = null;
  98 
  99 	/**
 100 	 * url - A web address for your plugin.
 101 	 */
 102 	public $url = null;
 103 
 104 	/**
 105 	 * Plugin's validity status
 106 	 * @var int $status
 107 	 */
 108 	public $status = self::STATUS_VALID;
 109 
 110 	/**
 111 	 * Explanation of the reason why the plugin is not valid
 112 	 * @var string $status_message
 113 	 */
 114 	public $status_message = '';
 115 
 116 	/**
 117 	 * this function registers your plugin - must set at least name and version
 118 	 * @return void
 119 	 */
 120 	abstract public function register();
 121 
 122 	/**
 123 	 * this function allows your plugin to set itself up, include any
 124 	 * necessary API's, declare or hook events, etc.
 125 	 * Alternatively, your plugin can hook the EVENT_PLUGIN_INIT event
 126 	 * that will be called after all plugins have been initialized.
 127 	 * @return bool
 128 	 */
 129 	public function init() {
 130 		return true;
 131 	}
 132 
 133 	/**
 134 	 * This function allows plugins to add new error messages for Mantis usage
 135 	 *
 136 	 * @return array The error_name=>error_message list to add
 137 	 */
 138 	public function errors() {
 139 		return array();
 140 	}
 141 
 142 	/**
 143 	 * return an array of default configuration name/value pairs
 144 	 * @return array
 145 	 */
 146 	public function config() {
 147 		return array();
 148 	}
 149 
 150 	/**
 151 	 * This function allows you to declare a new event, or a set of events that the plugin will
 152 	 * trigger. This function returns an associative array with event names as the key and the event
 153 	 * type as the value.
 154 	 *
 155 	 * For example, to add an event "foo" to our Example plugin that does not expect a return value
 156 	 * (an "execute" event type), and another event 'bar' that expects a single value that gets
 157 	 * modified by each hooked function (a "chain" event type):
 158 	 *
 159 	 * <code>
 160 	 * class ExamplePlugin extends MantisPlugin {
 161 	 * ...
 162 	 * function events() {
 163 	 *   return array(
 164 	 *       'EVENT_EXAMPLE_FOO' => EVENT_TYPE_EXECUTE,
 165 	 *       'EVENT_EXAMPLE_BAR' => EVENT_TYPE_CHAIN,
 166 	 *   );
 167 	 *  }
 168 	 * }
 169 	 * </code>
 170 	 *
 171 	 * When the Example plugin is loaded, the event system in MantisBT will add these two events to
 172 	 * its list of events, and will then allow other plugins or functions to hook them. Naming the
 173 	 * events "EVENT_PLUGINNAME_EVENTNAME" is not necessary, but is considered best practice to
 174 	 * avoid conflicts between plugins.
 175 	 * @return array
 176 	 */
 177 	public function events() {
 178 		return array();
 179 	}
 180 
 181 	/**
 182 	 * Hooking other events (or events from your own plugin) is almost identical to declaring them.
 183 	 * Instead of passing an event type as the value, your plugin must pass the name of a class
 184 	 * method on your plugin that will be called when the event is triggered. For our Example
 185 	 * plugin, we'll create a foo() and bar() method on our plugin class, and hook them to the
 186 	 * events we declared earlier.
 187 	 *
 188 	 * <code>
 189 	 * class ExamplePlugin extends MantisPlugin {
 190 	 * 		...
 191 	 * 		function hooks() {
 192 	 *   	return array(
 193 	 *    	 	'EVENT_EXAMPLE_FOO' => 'foo',
 194 	 *       	'EVENT_EXAMPLE_BAR' => 'bar',
 195 	 *   	);
 196 	 * 	}
 197 	 * 	function foo( $p_event ) {
 198 	 *  	...
 199 	 * 	}
 200 	 * 	function bar( $p_event, $p_chained_param ) {
 201 	 *  	...
 202 	 *   	return $p_chained_param;
 203 	 * 	}
 204 	 * }
 205 	 * </code>
 206 	 * Note that both hooked methods need to accept the $p_event parameter, as that contains the
 207 	 * event name triggering the method (for cases where you may want a method hooked to multiple
 208 	 * events).
 209 	 * The bar() * method also accepts and returns the chained parameter in order to match the
 210 	 * expectations of the "bar" event.
 211 	 * @return array
 212 	 */
 213 	public function hooks() {
 214 		return array();
 215 	}
 216 
 217 	/**
 218 	 * Array of Database Schema changes for the plugin
 219 	 *
 220 	 * For example, the following code example would try and perform 4 schema updates:
 221 	 * 1. create a user table with a user id column.
 222 	 * 2. add an additional column called 'count'.
 223 	 * 3. Updates the existing database data by adding 1 to count
 224 	 * 4. Tries to create a unique index on the column userid
 225 	 *
 226 	 * <code>
 227 	 * function schema() {
 228 	 *	return array(
 229 	 *		array( 'CreateTableSQL', array( plugin_table( 'user' ), "
 230 	 *	 		user_id		I		NOTNULL UNSIGNED PRIMARY",
 231 	 *			array('mysql' => 'ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8', 'pgsql' => 'WITHOUT OIDS')));
 232 	 *		array( 'AddColumnSQL', array( plugin_table( 'user' ), "
 233 	 *			count	I		NOTNULL UNSIGNED DEFAULT '0' " ) ),
 234 	 *		array( 'UpdateSQL', array( plugin_table( 'user' ), " SET count=count+1" ) ),
 235 	 *		array( 'CreateIndexSQL',
 236 	 *         array( 'idx_<plugin>_userid', plugin_table('user'), 'userid', array('UNIQUE'))),
 237 	 *  );
 238 	 * }
 239 	 * </code>
 240 	 * @return array
 241 	 */
 242 	public function schema() {
 243 		return array();
 244 	}
 245 
 246 	/**
 247 	  * Perform pre-installation operations
 248 	  *
 249 	  * This method is called before installing the given plugin.
 250 	  * It can be used to add pre-install checks on external requirements
 251 	  *
 252 	  * @return bool true if install can proceed
 253 	  */
 254 	public function install() {
 255 		return true;
 256 	}
 257 
 258 	/**
 259 	 * This callback is executed after the normal schema upgrade process has executed.
 260 	 * This gives your plugin the chance to convert or normalize data after an upgrade
 261 	 *
 262 	 * @todo It is possible to call php functions from within the schema upgrade itself, so really needed?
 263 	 *
 264 	 * @param integer $p_schema Schema Version ID.
 265 	 * @return boolean
 266 	 */
 267 	public function upgrade( $p_schema ) {
 268 		return true;
 269 	}
 270 
 271 	/**
 272 	 * This callback is executed after the normal uninstallation process, and should
 273 	 * handle such operations as reverting database schemas, removing unnecessary data,
 274 	 * etc. This callback should be used only if Mantis would break when this plugin
 275 	 * is uninstalled without any other actions taken, as users may not want to lose
 276 	 * data, or be able to re-install the plugin later.
 277 	 * @return void
 278 	 */
 279 	public function uninstall() {
 280 	}
 281 
 282 	### Core plugin functionality ###
 283 
 284 	/**
 285 	 * Constructor
 286 	 *
 287 	 * @param string $p_basename Plugin Basename.
 288 	 */
 289 	final public function __construct( $p_basename ) {
 290 		$this->basename = $p_basename;
 291 		$this->register();
 292 	}
 293 
 294 	/**
 295 	 * Initialisation
 296 	 * @return bool
 297 	 */
 298 	final public function __init() {
 299 		plugin_config_defaults( $this->config() );
 300 		event_declare_many( $this->events() );
 301 		if( !plugin_event_hook_many( $this->hooks() ) ) {
 302 			return false;
 303 		}
 304 
 305 		# Backwards-compatibility - return true if no return value
 306 		return $this->init() ?? true;
 307 	}
 308 
 309 	/**
 310 	 * Check the plugin's validity status.
 311 	 *
 312 	 * A plugin is considered valid if:
 313 	 * - its base name is set {@see self::$name}
 314 	 * - it has a version number {@see self::$version}
 315 	 *
 316 	 * @return bool True if the plugin is valid.
 317 	 */
 318 	public function isValid() {
 319 		return $this->name !== null && $this->version !== null;
 320 	}
 321 
 322 	/**
 323 	 * Creates an InvalidPlugin object from the current plugin.
 324 	 *
 325 	 * Invalid Plugin objects are used by manage_plugin_page.php to present
 326 	 * relevant information about the invalid plugin to the administrator so
 327 	 * they can take appropriate action to fix the problem.
 328 	 *
 329 	 * By default, it returns an InvalidDefinitionPlugin object.
 330 	 *
 331 	 * @return InvalidPlugin
 332 	 */
 333 	public function getInvalidPlugin() {
 334 		$t_plugin = new InvalidDefinitionPlugin( $this->basename );
 335 		$t_plugin->setInvalidPlugin( $this );
 336 
 337 		return $t_plugin;
 338 	}
 339 }

  46 # @global string $g_current_collapse_section
  47 $g_current_collapse_section = null;
  48 
  49 # @global bool $g_open_collapse_section
  50 $g_open_collapse_section = false;
  51 
  52 
  53 # @global string $g_collapse_cache_token
  54 $g_collapse_cache_token = null;
  55 
  56 /**
  57  * Marks the beginning of a collapse block's open phase.
  58  * This will be visible if the block is expanded or javascript is disabled.
  59  * @param string $p_name      Collapse block name.
  60  * @param string $p_section   Collapse block section.
  61  * @param string $p_css_class CSS class to apply to the div (defaults to none).
  62  * @return void
  63  */
  64 function collapse_open( $p_name, $p_section = '', $p_css_class = '' ) {
  65 	global $g_current_collapse_section, $g_open_collapse_section;
  66 
  67 	$t_block = ( is_blank( $p_section ) ? $p_name : $p_section . '_' . $p_name );
  68 	$t_display = is_collapsed( $t_block );
  69 
  70 	# make sure no other collapse section is started
  71 	if( $g_current_collapse_section !== null ) {
  72 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
  73 	}
  74 
  75 	if( $t_display ) {
  76 		$p_css_class .= ' collapse-open noprint';
  77 	} else {
  78 		$p_css_class .= ' collapse-closed noprint';
  79 	}
  80 
  81 	$g_open_collapse_section = true;
  82 	$g_current_collapse_section = $t_block;
  83 
  84 	$t_div_id = $t_block . '_open';
  85 	echo "\n" . '<div id="' . $t_div_id . '" class="' . $p_css_class . '">';
  86 }
  87 
  88 /**
  89  * Marks the end of a collapse block's open phase and the beginning
  90  * of the closed phase.
  91  * This will be visible if the block is collapsed and javascript is enabled.
  92  * @param string $p_name    Collapse block name.
  93  * @param string $p_section Collapse block section.
  94  * @param string $p_css_class CSS class to apply to the div (defaults to none).
  95  * @return void
  96  */
  97 function collapse_closed( $p_name, $p_section = '', $p_css_class = '' ) {
  98 	global $g_current_collapse_section, $g_open_collapse_section;
  99 
 100 	$t_block = ( is_blank( $p_section ) ? $p_name : $p_section . '_' . $p_name );
 101 	$t_display = !is_collapsed( $t_block );
 102 
 103 	# Make sure a section is opened, and it is the same section.
 104 	if( $t_block !== $g_current_collapse_section ) {
 105 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 106 	}
 107 
 108 	echo '</div>';
 109 
 110 	$g_open_collapse_section = false;
 111 
 112 	$t_div_id = $t_block . '_closed';
 113 	$p_css_class .= $t_display ? ' collapse-open' : ' collapse-closed';
 114 	echo "\n" . '<div id="', $t_div_id,
 115 		'" class="collapse-section-closed ' . $p_css_class . '">';
 116 }
 117 
 118 /**
 119  * Marks the location where a down/up-arrow icon is placed in output
 120  * for the user to toggle the collapse block status.
 121  * This should appear in both the open and closed phase of a block.
 122  * @param string $p_name    Collapse block name.
 123  * @return void
 124  */
 125 function collapse_icon( $p_name ) {
 126 	global $g_open_collapse_section;
 127 
 128 	if( $g_open_collapse_section === true ) {
 129 		$t_icon = 'fa-chevron-up';
 130 		$t_alt = '-';
 131 		$t_id = $p_name . '_open_link';
 132 	} else {
 133 		$t_icon = 'fa-chevron-down';
 134 		$t_alt = '+';
 135 		$t_id = $p_name. '_closed_link';
 136 	}
 137 
 138 	echo '&nbsp;&nbsp;<a id="', $t_id, '" class="collapse-link noprint">';
 139 	print_icon( $t_icon, 'bigger-120', $t_alt);
 140 	echo '</a>';
 141 }
 142 
 143 /**
 144  * Marks the end of a collapse block's closed phase.
 145  * @param string $p_name    Collapse block name.
 146  * @param string $p_section Collapse block section.
 147  * @return void
 148  */
 149 function collapse_end( $p_name, $p_section = '' ) {
 150 	global $g_current_collapse_section, $g_open_collapse_section;
 151 
 152 	$t_block = ( is_blank( $p_section ) ? $p_name : $p_section . '_' . $p_name );
 153 	is_collapsed( $t_block );
 154 
 155 	# Make sure a section is opened, and it is the same section.
 156 	if( $t_block !== $g_current_collapse_section ) {
 157 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 158 	}
 159 
 160 	echo '</div>';
 161 
 162 	$g_open_collapse_section = false;
 163 	$g_current_collapse_section = null;
 164 }
 165 
 166 /**
 167  * Determine if a block should be collapsed by default.
 168  * @param string $p_block Collapse block.
 169  * @return boolean
 170  */
 171 function is_collapsed( $p_block ) {
 172 	global $g_collapse_cache_token;
 173 
 174 	if( !isset( $g_collapse_cache_token[$p_block] ) ) {
 175 		return false;
 176 	}
 177 
 178 	return( true == $g_collapse_cache_token[$p_block] );
 179 }
 180 
 181 /**
 182  * Cache collapse state data for the current user.
 183  *
 184  * If there is a logged-in user, first retrieve collapse data from the Token.
 185  * If the collapse cookie has been set, grab the changes and update the token;
 186  * otherwise just touch it.
 187  *
 188  * For anonymous/no logged-in user, just load data from the cookie; this allows
 189  * persisting collapse state for the Anonymous user.
 190  *
 191  * @return void
 192  * @throws ClientException
 193  */
 194 function collapse_cache_token() {
 195 	global $g_collapse_cache_token;
 196 
 197 	if( isset( $g_collapse_cache_token ) ) {
 198 		return;
 199 	}
 200 
 201 	# Filters section collapsed by default (see #17830)
 202 	$g_collapse_cache_token = ['filter' => true];
 203 
 204 	# Get collapse data from Token for logged-in user
 205 	$t_is_logged_in = auth_is_user_authenticated() && !current_user_is_anonymous();
 206 	if( $t_is_logged_in ) {
 207 		$t_token = token_get( TOKEN_COLLAPSE );
 208 		if( $t_token !== null ) {
 209 			$g_collapse_cache_token = json_decode( $t_token['value'], true );
 210 		}
 211 	}
 212 
 213 	# Update cache with data from cookie
 214 	$t_collapse_cookie = config_get_global( 'collapse_settings_cookie' );
 215 	$t_cookie = gpc_get_cookie( $t_collapse_cookie, '' );
 216 	$t_update = false;
 217 
 218 	if( false !== $t_cookie && !is_blank( $t_cookie ) ) {
 219 		$t_data = explode( '|', $t_cookie );
 220 
 221 		foreach( $t_data as $t_pair ) {
 222 			$t_pair = explode( ':', $t_pair );
 223 
 224 			if( false !== $t_pair && count( $t_pair ) == 2 ) {
 225 				$g_collapse_cache_token[$t_pair[0]] = (bool)$t_pair[1];
 226 				$t_update = true;
 227 			}
 228 		}
 229 
 230 		# Update token and clear cookie if logged-in user
 231 		if( $t_is_logged_in ) {
 232 			if( $t_update ) {
 233 				$t_value = json_encode( $g_collapse_cache_token );
 234 				token_set( TOKEN_COLLAPSE, $t_value, TOKEN_EXPIRY_COLLAPSE );
 235 			} elseif( $t_token && token_exists( $t_token['id'] ) ) {
 236 				token_touch( $t_token['id'] );
 237 			}
 238 
 239 			gpc_clear_cookie( $t_collapse_cookie );
 240 		}
 241 	}
 242 }

  66 /**
  67  * Filters an array of columns based on configuration options.  The filtering can remove
  68  * columns whose features are disabled.
  69  *
  70  * @param array $p_columns The columns proposed for display.
  71  * @return array The columns array after removing the disabled features.
  72  */
  73 function columns_filter_disabled( array $p_columns ) {
  74 	$t_columns = array();
  75 	$t_enable_profiles = null;
  76 	$t_enable_due_date = null;
  77 
  78 	foreach ( $p_columns as $t_column ) {
  79 		switch( $t_column ) {
  80 			case 'os':
  81 			case 'os_build':
  82 			case 'platform':
  83 				if( $t_enable_profiles == null ) {
  84 					$t_enable_profiles = config_get( 'enable_profiles' ) == ON;
  85 				}
  86 				if( ! $t_enable_profiles ) {
  87 					continue 2;
  88 				}
  89 				break;
  90 
  91 			case 'due_date':
  92 			case 'overdue':
  93 				if ( $t_enable_due_date == null ) {
  94 					$t_enable_due_date = access_has_project_level( config_get( 'due_date_view_threshold' ) );
  95 				}
  96 				if( ! $t_enable_due_date ) {
  97 					continue 2;
  98 				}
  99 				break;
 100 
 101 			case 'eta':
 102 				if( config_get( 'enable_eta' ) == OFF ) {
 103 					continue 2;
 104 				}
 105 				break;
 106 
 107 			case 'projection':
 108 				if( config_get( 'enable_projection' ) == OFF ) {
 109 					continue 2;
 110 				}
 111 				break;
 112 
 113 			case 'build':
 114 				if( config_get( 'enable_product_build' ) == OFF ) {
 115 					continue 2;
 116 				}
 117 				break;
 118 
 119 			case 'sponsorship_total':
 120 				if( config_get( 'enable_sponsorship' ) == OFF ) {
 121 					continue 2;
 122 				}
 123 				break;
 124 
 125 				default:
 126 				# don't filter
 127 				break;
 128 		}
 129 		$t_columns[] = $t_column;
 130 	} # continued 2
 131 
 132 	return $t_columns;
 133 }

 135 /**
 136  * Get a list of standard columns.
 137  * @param boolean $p_enabled_columns_only Default true, if false returns all columns regardless of configuration settings.
 138  * @return array of column names
 139  */
 140 function columns_get_standard( $p_enabled_columns_only = true ) {
 141 	$t_reflection = new ReflectionClass( 'BugData' );
 142 	$t_columns = $t_reflection->getDefaultProperties();
 143 
 144 	$t_columns['selection'] = null;
 145 	$t_columns['edit'] = null;
 146 	$t_columns['notes'] = null;
 147 	$t_columns['tags'] = null;
 148 
 149 	# Overdue icon column (icons appears if an issue is beyond due_date)
 150 	$t_columns['overdue'] = null;
 151 
 152 	# The following fields are used internally and don't make sense as columns
 153 	unset( $t_columns['_stats'] );
 154 	unset( $t_columns['profile_id'] );
 155 	unset( $t_columns['sticky'] );
 156 	unset( $t_columns['loading'] );
 157 
 158 	# legacy field
 159 	unset( $t_columns['duplicate_id'] );
 160 
 161 	$t_column_names = array_keys( $t_columns );
 162 
 163 	if( $p_enabled_columns_only ) {
 164 		$t_column_names = columns_filter_disabled( $t_column_names );
 165 	}
 166 
 167 	return $t_column_names;
 168 }

 170 /**
 171  * Allow plugins to define a set of class-based columns, and register/load
 172  * them here to be used by columns_api.
 173  * @return array Mapping of column name to column object
 174  */
 175 function columns_get_plugin_columns() {
 176 	static $s_column_array = null;
 177 
 178 	if( is_null( $s_column_array ) ) {
 179 		$s_column_array = array();
 180 
 181 		$t_all_plugin_columns = event_signal( 'EVENT_FILTER_COLUMNS' );
 182 		foreach( $t_all_plugin_columns as $t_plugin => $t_plugin_columns ) {
 183 			foreach( $t_plugin_columns as $t_callback => $t_plugin_column_array ) {
 184 				if( is_array( $t_plugin_column_array ) ) {
 185 					foreach( $t_plugin_column_array as $t_column_item ) {
 186 						if( is_object( $t_column_item ) && $t_column_item instanceof MantisColumn ) {
 187 							$t_column_object = $t_column_item;
 188 						} elseif( class_exists( $t_column_item ) && is_subclass_of( $t_column_item, 'MantisColumn' ) ) {
 189 							$t_column_object = new $t_column_item();
 190 						} else {
 191 							continue;
 192 						}
 193 						$t_column_name = mb_strtolower( $t_plugin . '_' . $t_column_object->column );
 194 						$s_column_array[$t_column_name] = $t_column_object;
 195 					}
 196 				}
 197 			}
 198 		}
 199 	}
 200 
 201 	return $s_column_array;
 202 }

 204 /**
 205  * Get all columns for existing custom_fields
 206  * @return array Array of column names
 207  */
 208 function columns_get_custom_fields() {
 209 	static $t_col_names = null;
 210 	if( isset( $t_col_names ) ) {
 211 		return $t_col_names;
 212 	}
 213 
 214 	$t_all_cfids = custom_field_get_ids();
 215 	$t_col_names = array();
 216 	foreach( $t_all_cfids as $t_id ) {
 217 		$t_col_names[] = column_get_custom_field_column_name( $t_id );
 218 	}
 219 	return $t_col_names;
 220 }

 222 /**
 223  * Get all columns active for the current system.
 224  * This includes standard, custom fields, and plugin columns.
 225  * Columns for disabled modules are removed from this list, according to system
 226  * configuration.
 227  *
 228  * This function cannot check on current user/project, so it can be used by core
 229  * in potential unlogged-in scenarios.
 230  * @return array Array of column names
 231  */
 232 function columns_get_all_active_columns() {
 233 	$t_columns = array_merge(
 234 			columns_get_standard(),
 235 			array_keys( columns_get_plugin_columns() ),
 236 			columns_get_custom_fields()
 237 			);
 238 	return columns_filter_disabled( $t_columns );
 239 }

 241 /**
 242  * Returns true if the specified $p_column is a plugin column.
 243  * @param string $p_column A column name.
 244  * @return boolean
 245  */
 246 function column_is_plugin_column( $p_column ) {
 247 	$t_plugin_columns = columns_get_plugin_columns();
 248 	return isset( $t_plugin_columns[$p_column] );
 249 }

 251 /**
 252  * Get all accessible columns for the current project / current user.
 253  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 254  * @return array array of columns
 255  * @access public
 256  */
 257 function columns_get_all( $p_project_id = null ) {
 258 	$t_columns = columns_get_standard();
 259 
 260 	# add plugin columns
 261 	$t_columns = array_merge( $t_columns, array_keys( columns_get_plugin_columns() ) );
 262 
 263 	# Add project custom fields to the array.  Only add the ones for which the current user has at least read access.
 264 	if( $p_project_id === null ) {
 265 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 266 	} else {
 267 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id;
 268 	}
 269 	# Get custom fields from this project and sub-projects
 270 	$t_projects = user_get_all_accessible_projects( null, $t_project_id );
 271 	$t_related_custom_field_ids = custom_field_get_linked_ids( $t_projects );
 272 	foreach( $t_related_custom_field_ids as $t_id ) {
 273 		$t_cfdef = custom_field_get_definition( $t_id );
 274 		$t_projects_to_check = array_intersect( $t_projects, custom_field_get_project_ids( $t_id ) );
 275 		if( access_has_any_project_level( (int)$t_cfdef['access_level_r'], $t_projects_to_check ) ) {
 276 			$t_columns[] = column_get_custom_field_column_name( $t_id );
 277 		}
 278 	}
 279 
 280 	return $t_columns;
 281 }

 283 /**
 284  * Checks if the specified column is an extended column.  Extended columns are native columns that are
 285  * associated with the issue but are saved in mantis_bug_text_table.
 286  * @param string $p_column The column name.
 287  * @return boolean true for extended; false otherwise.
 288  * @access public
 289  */
 290 function column_is_extended( $p_column ) {
 291 	switch( $p_column ) {
 292 		case 'description':
 293 		case 'steps_to_reproduce':
 294 		case 'additional_information':
 295 			return true;
 296 		default:
 297 			return false;
 298 	}
 299 }

 301 /**
 302  * Checks if the specified column is a custom field column.
 303  * @param string $p_column The column name.
 304  * @return boolean True if its a custom field column
 305  */
 306 function column_is_custom_field( $p_column ) {
 307 	$t_cf_columns = columns_get_custom_fields();
 308 	return in_array( $p_column, $t_cf_columns );
 309 }

 311 /**
 312  * Checks if the specified column can be sorted
 313  * @param string $p_column The column name.
 314  * @return boolean True if the column can be sorted
 315  */
 316 function column_is_sortable( $p_column ) {
 317 
 318 	# custom fields are always sortable
 319 	if( column_is_custom_field( $p_column ) ) {
 320 		return true;
 321 	}
 322 
 323 	# plugin fields contains a 'sortable' property
 324 	if( column_is_plugin_column( $p_column ) ) {
 325 		$t_plugin_columns = columns_get_plugin_columns();
 326 		$t_plugin_obj = $t_plugin_columns[$p_column];
 327 		return $t_plugin_obj->sortable;
 328 	}
 329 
 330 	#standard fields: define exceptions here
 331 	switch( $p_column ) {
 332 		case 'selection':
 333 		case 'edit':
 334 		case 'bugnotes_count':
 335 		case 'attachment_count':
 336 		case 'tags':
 337 		case 'additional_information':
 338 		case 'description':
 339 		case 'notes':
 340 		case 'steps_to_reproduce':
 341 			return false;
 342 	}
 343 
 344 	# after all exceptions, return true as default
 345 	return true;
 346 }

 348 /**
 349  * Given a column name from the array of columns to be included in a view, this method checks if
 350  * the column is a custom column and if so returns its name.  Note that for custom fields, then
 351  * provided names will have the "custom_" prefix, where the returned ones won't have the prefix.
 352  *
 353  * @param string $p_column Column name.
 354  * @return string The custom field column name or null if the specific column is not a custom field or invalid column.
 355  * @access public
 356  */
 357 function column_get_custom_field_name( $p_column ) {
 358 	if( strncmp( $p_column, 'custom_', 7 ) === 0 ) {
 359 		return mb_substr( $p_column, 7 );
 360 	}
 361 
 362 	return null;
 363 }
 364 
 365 /**
 366  * Returns the name of a column corresponding to a custom field, providing the id as parameter.
 367  *
 368  * @param integer $p_cf_id	Custom field id
 369  * @return string	The column name
 370  */
 371 function column_get_custom_field_column_name( $p_cf_id ) {
 372 	$t_def = custom_field_get_definition( $p_cf_id );
 373 	if( $t_def ) {
 374 		return 'custom_' . $t_def['name'];
 375 	} else {
 376 		return null;
 377 	}
 378 }

 380 /**
 381  * Converts a string of comma separate column names to an array.
 382  *
 383  * @param string $p_string Comma separate column name (not case sensitive).
 384  * @return array The array with all column names lower case.
 385  * @access public
 386  */
 387 function columns_string_to_array( $p_string ) {
 388 	$t_columns = explode( ',', $p_string );
 389 	$t_count = count( $t_columns );
 390 
 391 	for( $i = 0; $i < $t_count; $i++ ) {
 392 		$t_columns[$i] = trim( $t_columns[$i] );
 393 	}
 394 
 395 	return $t_columns;
 396 }

 398 /**
 399  * Gets the localized title for the specified column.  The column can be native or custom.
 400  * The custom fields must contain the 'custom_' prefix.
 401  *
 402  * @param string $p_column The column name.
 403  * @return string The column localized name.
 404  * @access public
 405  */
 406 function column_get_title( $p_column ) {
 407 	$t_custom_field = column_get_custom_field_name( $p_column );
 408 	if( $t_custom_field !== null ) {
 409 		$t_field_id = custom_field_get_id_from_name( $t_custom_field );
 410 
 411 		if( $t_field_id === false ) {
 412 			$t_custom_field = '@' . $t_custom_field . '@';
 413 		} else {
 414 			$t_def = custom_field_get_definition( $t_field_id );
 415 			$t_custom_field = lang_get_defaulted( $t_def['name'] );
 416 		}
 417 
 418 		return $t_custom_field;
 419 	}
 420 
 421 	$t_plugin_columns = columns_get_plugin_columns();
 422 	if( isset( $t_plugin_columns[$p_column] ) ) {
 423 		$t_column_object = $t_plugin_columns[$p_column];
 424 		return $t_column_object->title;
 425 	}
 426 
 427 	switch( $p_column ) {
 428 		case 'attachment_count':
 429 			return lang_get( 'attachments' );
 430 		case 'bugnotes_count':
 431 			return '#';
 432 		case 'category_id':
 433 			return lang_get( 'category' );
 434 		case 'edit':
 435 			return '';
 436 		case 'handler_id':
 437 			return lang_get( 'assigned_to' );
 438 		case 'last_updated':
 439 			return lang_get( 'updated' );
 440 		case 'os_build':
 441 			return lang_get( 'os_build' );
 442 		case 'project_id':
 443 			return lang_get( 'email_project' );
 444 		case 'reporter_id':
 445 			return lang_get( 'reporter' );
 446 		case 'selection':
 447 			return '';
 448 		case 'sponsorship_total':
 449 			return sponsorship_get_currency();
 450 		case 'version':
 451 			return lang_get( 'product_version' );
 452 		case 'view_state':
 453 			return lang_get( 'view_status' );
 454 		default:
 455 			return lang_get_defaulted( $p_column );
 456 	}
 457 }

 459 /**
 460  * Checks an array of columns for duplicate or invalid fields.
 461  *
 462  * @param string $p_field_name          The logic name of the array being validated.  Used when triggering errors.
 463  * @param array  $p_columns_to_validate The array of columns to validate.
 464  * @param array  $p_columns_all         The list of all valid columns.
 465  * @return boolean
 466  * @access public
 467  */
 468 function columns_ensure_valid( $p_field_name, array $p_columns_to_validate, array $p_columns_all ) {
 469 	$t_columns_all_lower = array_map( 'mb_strtolower', $p_columns_all );
 470 
 471 	# Check for invalid fields
 472 	foreach( $p_columns_to_validate as $t_column ) {
 473 		if( !in_array( mb_strtolower( $t_column ), $t_columns_all_lower ) ) {
 474 			error_parameters( $p_field_name, $t_column );
 475 			trigger_error( ERROR_COLUMNS_INVALID, ERROR );
 476 			return false;
 477 		}
 478 	}
 479 
 480 	# Check for duplicate fields
 481 	$t_columns_no_duplicates = array();
 482 	foreach( $p_columns_to_validate as $t_column ) {
 483 		$t_column_lower = mb_strtolower( $t_column );
 484 		if( in_array( $t_column, $t_columns_no_duplicates ) ) {
 485 			error_parameters( $p_field_name, $t_column );
 486 			trigger_error( ERROR_COLUMNS_DUPLICATE, ERROR );
 487 		} else {
 488 			$t_columns_no_duplicates[] = $t_column_lower;
 489 		}
 490 	}
 491 
 492 	return true;
 493 }
 494 
 495 /**
 496  * Validates an array of column names and removes ones that are not valid.  The validation
 497  * is not case sensitive.
 498  *
 499  * @param array $p_columns     The array of column names to be validated.
 500  * @param array $p_columns_all The array of all valid column names.
 501  * @return array The array of valid column names found in $p_columns.
 502  * @access public
 503  */
 504 function columns_remove_invalid( array $p_columns, array $p_columns_all ) {
 505 	$t_columns_all_lower = array_values( array_map( 'mb_strtolower', $p_columns_all ) );
 506 	$t_columns = array();
 507 
 508 	foreach( $p_columns as $t_column ) {
 509 		if( in_array( mb_strtolower( $t_column ), $t_columns_all_lower ) ) {
 510 			$t_columns[] = $t_column;
 511 		}
 512 	}
 513 
 514 	return $t_columns;
 515 }

1083 /**
1084  * Print table data for column selection
1085  *
1086  * @param BugData $p_bug            BugData object.
1087  * @param integer $p_columns_target See COLUMNS_TARGET_* in constant_inc.php.
1088  * @return void
1089  * @access public
1090  */
1091 function print_column_selection( BugData $p_bug, $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE ) {
1092 	global $g_checkboxes_exist;
1093 
1094 	echo '<td class="column-selection">';
1095 	if( COLUMNS_TARGET_PRINT_PAGE == $p_columns_target ||
1096 		# check report_bug_threshold for the actions "copy" or "move" into any other project
1097 		access_has_any_project_level( 'report_bug_threshold' ) ||
1098 		# !TODO: check if any other projects actually exist for the bug to be moved to
1099 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'move_bug_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1100 		# !TODO: factor in $g_auto_set_status_to_assigned == ON
1101 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'update_bug_assign_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1102 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'update_bug_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1103 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'delete_bug_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1104 		# !TODO: check to see if the bug actually has any different selectable workflow states
1105 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'update_bug_status_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1106 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'set_bug_sticky_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1107 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'change_view_status_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1108 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'add_bugnote_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1109 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'tag_attach_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ||
1110 		access_has_project_level( config_get( 'roadmap_update_threshold', null, null, $p_bug->project_id ), $p_bug->project_id ) ) {
1111 		$g_checkboxes_exist = true;
1112 		echo '<div class="checkbox no-padding no-margin"><label>';
1113 		printf( '<input type="checkbox" name="bug_arr[]" value="%d" class="ace" />', $p_bug->id );
1114 		echo '<span class="lbl"></span>';
1115 		echo '</label></div>';
1116 	} else {
1117 		echo '&#160;';
1118 	}
1119 	echo '</td>';
1120 }

1239  *
1240  * @param BugData $p_bug            BugData object.
1241  * @param integer $p_columns_target See COLUMNS_TARGET_* in constant_inc.php.
1242  * @return void
1243  * @access public
1244  */
1245 function print_column_bugnotes_count( BugData $p_bug, $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE ) {
1246 	global $g_filter;
1247 
1248 	# grab the bugnote count
1249 	$t_bugnote_stats = bug_get_bugnote_stats( $p_bug->id );
1250 	if( is_array( $t_bugnote_stats ) ) {
1251 		$t_bugnote_count = $t_bugnote_stats['count'];
1252 		$t_bugnote_updated = $t_bugnote_stats['last_modified'];
1253 	} else {
1254 		$t_bugnote_count = 0;
1255 	}
1256 
1257 	echo '<td class="column-bugnotes-count">';
1258 	if( $t_bugnote_count > 0 ) {
1259 		$t_show_in_bold = $t_bugnote_updated > strtotime( '-' . $g_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIGHLIGHT_CHANGED] . ' hours' );
1260 		if( $t_show_in_bold ) {
1261 			echo '<span class="bold">';
1262 		}
1263 		print_link( string_get_bug_view_url( $p_bug->id ) . '&nbn=' . $t_bugnote_count . '#bugnotes', $t_bugnote_count );
1264 		if( $t_show_in_bold ) {
1265 			echo '</span>';
1266 		}
1267 	} else {
1268 		echo '&#160;';
1269 	}
1270 
1271 	echo '</td>';
1272 }

1406 	# choose color based on status

1408 	echo '<td class="column-status">';

1411 	printf( ' <span title="%s">%s</span>',
1412 		get_enum_element( 'resolution', $p_bug->resolution, $t_current_user, $p_bug->project_id ),
1413 		get_enum_element( 'status', $p_bug->status, $t_current_user, $p_bug->project_id )
1414 	);
1415 
1416 	# print handler user next to status
1417 	if( $p_bug->handler_id > 0
1418 			&& ON == config_get( 'show_assigned_names', null, $t_current_user, $p_bug->project_id )
1419 			&& access_can_see_handler_for_bug( $p_bug ) ) {

1658 	} else {

1671  * @return void

1675

1677 
1678 	if( access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'due_date_view_threshold' ), $p_bug->id ) &&
1679 		!date_is_null( $p_bug->due_date )
1680 	) {
1681 		$t_level = bug_overdue_level( $p_bug->id );
1682 		if( $t_level === 0 ) {
1683 			$t_icon = 'fa-times-circle-o';
1684 			$t_overdue_text_hover = sprintf(
1685 				lang_get( 'overdue_since' ),
1686 				date( config_get( 'short_date_format' ), $p_bug->due_date )
1687 			);
1688 		} else {
1689 			$t_icon = $t_level === false ? 'fa-info-circle' : 'fa-warning';
1690 
1691 			$t_duration = $p_bug->due_date - db_now();
1692 			if( $t_duration <= SECONDS_PER_DAY ) {
1693 				$t_overdue_text_hover = lang_get( 'overdue_one_day' );
1694 			} else {
1695 				$t_overdue_text_hover = sprintf(
1696 					lang_get( 'overdue_days' ),
1697 					ceil( $t_duration / SECONDS_PER_DAY )
1698 				);
1699 			}
1700 		}
1701 		print_icon( $t_icon, '', string_display_line( $t_overdue_text_hover ) );
1702 	} else {
1703 		echo '&#160;';
1704 	}
1705 
1706 	echo '</td>';
1707 }

  15 # along with MantisBT.  If not, see <http://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
  16 
  17 /**
  18  * Compression API
  19  *
  20  * @package CoreAPI
  21  * @subpackage CompressionAPI
  22  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  23  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  24  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  25  *
  26  * @uses constant_inc.php
  27  * @uses utility_api.php
  28  */
  29 
  30 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  31 require_api( 'utility_api.php' );
  32 
  33 # Starts the buffering/compression (only if the compression option is ON)
  34 # This variable is used internally.  It is not used for configuration
  35 # @global bool $g_compression_started
  36 $g_compression_started = false;
  37 
  38 /**
  39  * Check if compression handler (ob_gzhandler) should be enabled.
  40  *
  41  * Note: this should not be used as an indicator of whether output received by a
  42  * client will be compressed, only whether an output handler is used to compress
  43  * output.
  44  *
  45  * @return boolean
  46  * @access public
  47  */
  48 function compress_handler_is_enabled() {
  49 	global $g_compress_html;
  50 
  51 	# indicates compression should be disabled for a page.
  52 	# Note: php.ini may still enable zlib.output_compression. It may be possible
  53 	# to turn this off through the use of ini_set within that specific page.
  54 	if( defined( 'COMPRESSION_DISABLED' ) ) {
  55 		return false;
  56 	}
  57 
  58 	# Do not use config_get() here so only dependency is on constant_inc.php in this module
  59 	# We only actively compress html if global configuration compress_html is set.
  60 	if( OFF == $g_compress_html ) {
  61 		return false;
  62 	}
  63 
  64 	# both compression handlers require zlib module to be loaded
  65 	if( !extension_loaded( 'zlib' ) ) {
  66 		return false;
  67 	}
  68 
  69 	if( ini_get( 'zlib.output_compression' ) ) {
  70 		# zlib output compression is already enabled - we can't load the gzip output handler
  71 		return false;
  72 	}
  73 
  74 	# It's possible to set zlib.output_compression via ini_set.
  75 	# This method is preferred over ob_gzhandler, and effectively starts output buffering.
  76 	if( ini_get( 'output_handler' ) == '' && function_exists( 'ini_set' ) ) {
  77 		ini_set( 'zlib.output_compression', true );
  78 		# do it transparently
  79 		return false;
  80 	}
  81 
  82 	# if php.ini does not already use ob_gzhandler by default, return true.
  83 	return ( 'ob_gzhandler' != ini_get( 'output_handler' ) );
  84 }
  85 
  86 /**
  87  * Start compression handler if required
  88  * @return void
  89  * @access public
  90  */
  91 function compress_start_handler() {
  92 	# Don't start compression for CLI or when expressly disabled
  93 	if( php_sapi_name() == 'cli'  || defined( 'COMPRESSION_DISABLED' ) ) {
  94 		return;
  95 	}
  96 
  97 	# Do not start compress handler if we got any output so far, as this
  98 	# denotes that an error has occurred. Enabling compression in this case
  99 	# will likely cause a Content Encoding Error when displaying the page.
 100 	if( ob_get_length() ) {
 101 		return;
 102 	}
 103 
 104 	if( compress_handler_is_enabled() ) {
 105 		# Before doing anything else, start output buffering so we don't prevent
 106 		# headers from being sent if there's a blank line in an included file
 107 		ob_start( 'compress_handler' );
 108 	} else if( ini_get_bool( 'zlib.output_compression' ) == true ) {
 109 		# @TODO is this really needed ? We already start buffering in core.php
 110 		ob_start();
 111 	}
 112 }
 113 
 114 /**
 115  * Output Buffering handler.
 116  *
 117  * Either compresses the buffer or just returns it as-is, depending on the
 118  * return value of compress_handler_is_enabled()
 119  *
 120  * @param string  $p_buffer Buffer.
 121  * @param integer $p_mode   Mode.
 122  * @return string
 123  * @access public
 124  */
 125 function compress_handler( $p_buffer, $p_mode ) {
 126 	global $g_compression_started;
 127 	if( $g_compression_started && compress_handler_is_enabled() ) {
 128 		/**
 129 		 * @noinspection PhpComposerExtensionStubsInspection
 130 		 *               compress_handler_is_enabled() returns false if zlib
 131 		 *               extension is not available.
 132 		 */
 133 		return ob_gzhandler( $p_buffer, $p_mode );
 134 	} else {
 135 		return $p_buffer;
 136 	}
 137 }
 138 
 139 /**
 140  * Enable output buffering with compression.
 141  * @return void
 142  * @access public
 143  */
 144 function compress_enable() {
 145 	global $g_compression_started;
 146 
 147 	$g_compression_started = true;
 148 }
 149 
 150 /**
 151  * Disable output buffering with compression.
 152  * @return void
 153  * @access public
 154  */
 155 function compress_disable() {
 156 	global $g_compression_started;
 157 
 158 	$g_compression_started = false;
 159 }

  40 
  41 # cache for config variables
  42 $g_cache_config = array();
  43 $g_cache_config_eval = array();
  44 $g_cache_config_access = array();
  45 $g_cache_bypass_lookup = array();
  46 $g_cache_filled = false;
  47 
  48 # cache environment to speed up lookups
  49 $g_cache_db_table_exists = false;

  51 $g_cache_config_user = null;
  52 $g_cache_config_project = null;
  53 
  54 /**
  55  * Retrieves the value of a config option
  56  *  This function will return one of (in order of preference):
  57  *    1. value from cache
  58  *    2. value from database
  59  *     looks for specified config_id + current user + current project.
  60  *     if not found, config_id + current user + all_project
  61  *     if not found, config_id + default user + current project
  62  *     if not found, config_id + default user + all_project.
  63  *    3.use GLOBAL[config_id]
  64  *
  65  * @param string  $p_option  The configuration option to retrieve.
  66  * @param string  $p_default The default value to use if not set.
  67  * @param integer $p_user    A user identifier.
  68  * @param integer $p_project A project identifier.
  69  * @return mixed
  70  */
  71 function config_get( $p_option, $p_default = null, $p_user = null, $p_project = null ) {
  72 	global $g_cache_config, $g_cache_db_table_exists, $g_cache_filled;
  73 	global $g_cache_config_user, $g_cache_config_project, $g_project_override;
  74 
  75 	if( config_can_set_in_database( $p_option ) ) {
  76 		if( $g_project_override !== null && $p_project === null ) {
  77 			$p_project = $g_project_override;
  78 		}
  79 		# @@ debug @@ if( ! db_is_connected() ) { echo "no db "; }
  80 		# @@ debug @@ echo "lu table=" . ( db_table_exists( $t_config_table ) ? "yes " : "no " );
  81 		if( !$g_cache_db_table_exists ) {
  82 			$g_cache_db_table_exists = ( true === db_is_connected() ) && db_table_exists( db_get_table( 'config' ) );
  83 		}
  84 
  85 		if( $g_cache_db_table_exists ) {
  86 			# @@ debug @@ echo " lu db $p_option ";
  87 			# @@ debug @@ error_print_stack_trace();
  88 			# prepare the user's list
  89 			$t_users = array();
  90 			if( null === $p_user ) {
  91 				if( !isset( $g_cache_config_user ) ) {
  92 					$t_users[] = auth_is_user_authenticated() ? auth_get_current_user_id() : ALL_USERS;
  93 					if( !in_array( ALL_USERS, $t_users ) ) {
  94 						$t_users[] = ALL_USERS;
  95 					}
  96 					$g_cache_config_user = $t_users;
  97 				} else {
  98 					$t_users = $g_cache_config_user;
  99 				}
 100 			} else {
 101 				$t_users[] = $p_user;
 102 				if( !in_array( ALL_USERS, $t_users ) ) {
 103 					$t_users[] = ALL_USERS;
 104 				}
 105 			}
 106 
 107 			# prepare the projects list
 108 			$t_projects = array();
 109 			if( ( null === $p_project ) ) {
 110 				if( !isset( $g_cache_config_project ) ) {
 111 					$t_projects[] = auth_is_user_authenticated() ? helper_get_current_project() : ALL_PROJECTS;
 112 					if( !in_array( ALL_PROJECTS, $t_projects ) ) {
 113 						$t_projects[] = ALL_PROJECTS;
 114 					}
 115 					$g_cache_config_project = $t_projects;
 116 				} else {
 117 					$t_projects = $g_cache_config_project;
 118 				}
 119 			} else {
 120 				$t_projects[] = $p_project;
 121 				if( !in_array( ALL_PROJECTS, $t_projects ) ) {
 122 					$t_projects[] = ALL_PROJECTS;
 123 				}
 124 			}
 125 
 126 			# @@ debug @@ echo 'pr= '; var_dump($t_projects);
 127 			# @@ debug @@ echo 'u= '; var_dump($t_users);
 128 			if( !$g_cache_filled ) {
 129 				config_cache_all();
 130 				$g_cache_filled = true;
 131 			}
 132 
 133 			if( isset( $g_cache_config[$p_option] ) ) {
 134 				$t_found = false;
 135 				$t_value = '';
 136 
 137 				foreach( $t_users as $t_user ) {
 138 					foreach( $t_projects as $t_project ) {
 139 						if( isset( $g_cache_config[$p_option][$t_user][$t_project] ) ) {
 140 							$t_value = $g_cache_config[$p_option][$t_user][$t_project];
 141 							$t_found = true;
 142 							# @@ debug @@ echo "clu found u=$t_user, p=$t_project, v=$t_value ";
 143 							break 2;
 144 						}
 145 					}
 146 				}
 147 
 148 				if( $t_found ) {
 149 					list( $t_type, $t_raw_value ) = explode( ';', $t_value, 2 );
 150 
 151 					switch( $t_type ) {
 152 						case CONFIG_TYPE_FLOAT:
 153 							return (float)$t_raw_value;
 154 						case CONFIG_TYPE_INT:
 155 							return (int)$t_raw_value;
 156 						case CONFIG_TYPE_COMPLEX:
 157 							return json_decode( $t_raw_value, true );
 158 						case CONFIG_TYPE_STRING:
 159 						default:
 160 							return config_eval( $t_raw_value );
 161 					}
 162 				}
 163 			}
 164 		}
 165 	}
 166 	return config_get_global( $p_option, $p_default );
 167 }
 168 
 169 /**
 170  * force config variable from a global to avoid recursion
 171  *
 172  * @param string $p_option  Configuration option to retrieve.
 173  * @param string $p_default Default value if not set.
 174  * @return mixed
 175  */
 176 function config_get_global( $p_option, $p_default = null ) {
 177 	global $g_cache_config_eval;
 178 
 179 	$t_var_name = 'g_' . $p_option;
 180 	if( isset( $GLOBALS[$t_var_name] ) ) {
 181 		if( !isset( $g_cache_config_eval[$t_var_name] ) ) {
 182 			$t_value = config_eval( $GLOBALS[$t_var_name], true );
 183 			$g_cache_config_eval[$t_var_name] = $t_value;
 184 		} else {
 185 			$t_value = $g_cache_config_eval[$t_var_name];
 186 		}
 187 		return $t_value;
 188 	} else {
 189 		# unless we were allowing for the option not to exist by passing
 190 		#  a default, trigger a WARNING
 191 		if( null === $p_default ) {
 192 			error_parameters( $p_option );
 193 			trigger_error( ERROR_CONFIG_OPT_NOT_FOUND, WARNING );
 194 		}
 195 		return $p_default;
 196 	}
 197 }
 198 
 199 /**
 200  * Retrieves the access level needed to change a configuration value
 201  *
 202  * @param string  $p_option  Configuration option.
 203  * @param integer $p_user    A user identifier.
 204  * @param integer $p_project A project identifier.
 205  * @return integer
 206  */
 207 function config_get_access( $p_option, $p_user = null, $p_project = null ) {
 208 	global $g_cache_config, $g_cache_config_access, $g_cache_filled;
 209 
 210 	if( !$g_cache_filled ) {
 211 		config_get( $p_option, -1, $p_user, $p_project );
 212 	}
 213 
 214 	# prepare the user's list
 215 	$t_users = array();
 216 	if( ( null === $p_user ) && ( auth_is_user_authenticated() ) ) {
 217 		$t_users[] = auth_get_current_user_id();
 218 	} else if( !in_array( $p_user, $t_users ) ) {
 219 		$t_users[] = $p_user;
 220 	}
 221 	$t_users[] = ALL_USERS;
 222 
 223 	# prepare the projects list
 224 	$t_projects = array();
 225 	if( ( null === $p_project ) && ( auth_is_user_authenticated() ) ) {
 226 		$t_selected_project = helper_get_current_project();
 227 		$t_projects[] = $t_selected_project;
 228 		if( ALL_PROJECTS <> $t_selected_project ) {
 229 			$t_projects[] = ALL_PROJECTS;
 230 		}
 231 	} else if( !in_array( $p_project, $t_projects ) ) {
 232 		$t_projects[] = $p_project;
 233 	}
 234 
 235 	if( isset( $g_cache_config[$p_option] ) ) {
 236 		foreach( $t_users as $t_user ) {
 237 			foreach( $t_projects as $t_project ) {
 238 				if( isset( $g_cache_config[$p_option][$t_user][$t_project] ) ) {
 239 					return $g_cache_config_access[$p_option][$t_user][$t_project];
 240 				}
 241 			}
 242 		}
 243 	}
 244 
 245 	return config_get_global( 'admin_site_threshold' );
 246 }
 247 
 248 /**
 249  * Checks if the specified configuration option exists as an override in the
 250  * database.
 251  *
 252  * @param string $p_option  Configuration option.
 253  * @param int    $p_user    A user identifier.
 254  * @param int    $p_project A project identifier.
 255  *
 256  * @return bool True if the option exists, false otherwise.
 257  *
 258  * @since 2.28.0
 259  */
 260 
 261 function config_is_set_in_database( $p_option, $p_user = null, $p_project = null ) {
 262 	global $g_cache_config, $g_cache_filled;
 263 
 264 	if( !$g_cache_filled ) {
 265 		config_get( $p_option, -1, $p_user, $p_project );
 266 	}
 267 
 268 	# prepare the user's list
 269 	$t_users = array( ALL_USERS );
 270 	if( ( null === $p_user ) && ( auth_is_user_authenticated() ) ) {
 271 		$t_users[] = auth_get_current_user_id();
 272 	}
 273 	else {
 274 		if( !in_array( $p_user, $t_users ) ) {
 275 			$t_users[] = $p_user;
 276 		}
 277 	}
 278 	$t_users[] = ALL_USERS;
 279 
 280 	# prepare the projects list
 281 	$t_projects = array( ALL_PROJECTS );
 282 	if( ( null === $p_project ) && ( auth_is_user_authenticated() ) ) {
 283 		$t_selected_project = helper_get_current_project();
 284 		if( ALL_PROJECTS <> $t_selected_project ) {
 285 			$t_projects[] = $t_selected_project;
 286 		}
 287 	}
 288 	else {
 289 		if( !in_array( $p_project, $t_projects ) ) {
 290 			$t_projects[] = $p_project;
 291 		}
 292 	}
 293 
 294 	foreach( $t_users as $t_user ) {
 295 		foreach( $t_projects as $t_project ) {
 296 			if( isset( $g_cache_config[$p_option][$t_user][$t_project] ) ) {
 297 				return true;
 298 			}
 299 		}
 300 	}
 301 
 302 	return false;
 303 }

 305 /**
 306  * Checks if the specified configuration option exists anywhere.
 307  *
 308  * Returns true if either a value in the database or a default defined in a
 309  * global variable can be found.
 310  *
 311  * @param string $p_option  Configuration option.
 312  * @param int    $p_user    A user identifier.
 313  * @param int    $p_project A project identifier.
 314  *
 315  * @return bool True if the option exists, false otherwise.
 316  */
 317 function config_is_set( $p_option, $p_user = null, $p_project = null ) {
 318 	return config_is_set_in_database( $p_option, $p_user, $p_project )
 319 		|| isset( $GLOBALS['g_' . $p_option] );
 320 }

 322 /**
 323  * Sets the value of the given configuration option to the given value
 324  * If the configuration option does not exist, an ERROR is triggered
 325  *
 326  * @param string  $p_option  Configuration option name.
 327  * @param string|array  $p_value   Configuration option value.
 328  * @param integer $p_user    A user identifier. Defaults to NO_USER.
 329  * @param integer $p_project A project identifier. Defaults to ALL_PROJECTS.
 330  * @param integer $p_access  Access level. Defaults to DEFAULT_ACCESS_LEVEL.
 331  * @return boolean
 332  */
 333 function config_set( $p_option, $p_value, $p_user = NO_USER, $p_project = ALL_PROJECTS, $p_access = DEFAULT_ACCESS_LEVEL ) {
 334 	if( $p_access == DEFAULT_ACCESS_LEVEL ) {
 335 		$p_access = config_get_global( 'admin_site_threshold' );
 336 	}
 337 	if( is_array( $p_value ) || is_object( $p_value ) ) {
 338 		$t_type = CONFIG_TYPE_COMPLEX;
 339 		$c_value = json_encode( $p_value );
 340 	} else if( is_float( $p_value ) ) {
 341 		$t_type = CONFIG_TYPE_FLOAT;
 342 		$c_value = (float)$p_value;
 343 	} else if( is_int( $p_value ) || is_numeric( $p_value ) ) {
 344 		$t_type = CONFIG_TYPE_INT;
 345 		$c_value = (int)$p_value;
 346 	} else {
 347 		$t_type = CONFIG_TYPE_STRING;
 348 		$c_value = $p_value;
 349 	}
 350 
 351 	if( config_can_set_in_database( $p_option ) ) {
 352 		# before we set in the database, ensure that the user and project id exist
 353 		if( $p_project !== ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 354 			project_ensure_exists( $p_project );
 355 		}
 356 		if( $p_user !== NO_USER ) {
 357 			user_ensure_exists( $p_user );
 358 		}
 359 
 360 		db_param_push();
 361 		$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) from {config}
 362 				WHERE config_id = ' . db_param() . ' AND
 363 					project_id = ' . db_param() . ' AND
 364 					user_id = ' . db_param();
 365 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_option, (int)$p_project, (int)$p_user ) );
 366 
 367 		db_param_push();
 368 		if( 0 < db_result( $t_result ) ) {
 369 			$t_set_query = 'UPDATE {config}
 370 					SET value=' . db_param() . ', type=' . db_param() . ', access_reqd=' . db_param() . '
 371 					WHERE config_id = ' . db_param() . ' AND
 372 						project_id = ' . db_param() . ' AND
 373 						user_id = ' . db_param();
 374 			$t_params = array(
 375 				(string)$c_value,
 376 				$t_type,
 377 				(int)$p_access,
 378 				$p_option,
 379 				(int)$p_project,
 380 				(int)$p_user,
 381 			);
 382 		} else {
 383 			$t_set_query = 'INSERT INTO {config}
 384 					( value, type, access_reqd, config_id, project_id, user_id )
 385 					VALUES
 386 					(' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ' )';
 387 			$t_params = array(
 388 				(string)$c_value,
 389 				$t_type,
 390 				(int)$p_access,
 391 				$p_option,
 392 				(int)$p_project,
 393 				(int)$p_user,
 394 			);
 395 		}
 396 
 397 		db_query( $t_set_query, $t_params );
 398 	}
 399 
 400 	config_set_cache( $p_option, $c_value, $t_type, $p_user, $p_project, $p_access );
 401 
 402 	return true;
 403 }
 404 
 405 /**
 406  * Sets the value of the given configuration option in the global namespace.
 407  * Does *not* persist the value between sessions. If override set to
 408  * false, then the value will only be set if not already existent.
 409  *
 410  * @param string  $p_option   Configuration option.
 411  * @param string  $p_value    Configuration value.
 412  * @param boolean $p_override Override existing value if already set.
 413  * @return boolean
 414  */
 415 function config_set_global( $p_option, $p_value, $p_override = true ) {
 416 	global $g_cache_config_eval;
 417 
 418 	if( $p_override || !isset( $GLOBALS['g_' . $p_option] ) ) {
 419 		$GLOBALS['g_' . $p_option] = $p_value;
 420 		unset( $g_cache_config_eval['g_' . $p_option] );
 421 	}
 422 
 423 	return true;

 426 /**
 427  * Sets the value of the given configuration option to the given value
 428  *  If the configuration option does not exist, an ERROR is triggered
 429  *
 430  * @param string  $p_option  Configuration option.
 431  * @param string  $p_value   Configuration value.
 432  * @param integer $p_type    Type.
 433  * @param integer $p_user    A user identifier.
 434  * @param integer $p_project A project identifier.
 435  * @param integer $p_access  Access level.
 436  * @return boolean
 437  */
 438 function config_set_cache( $p_option, $p_value, $p_type, $p_user = NO_USER, $p_project = ALL_PROJECTS, $p_access = DEFAULT_ACCESS_LEVEL ) {
 439 	global $g_cache_config, $g_cache_config_access;

 451 /**
 452  * Checks if the specific configuration option can be set in the database, otherwise it can only be set
 453  * in the configuration file (config_inc.php / config_defaults_inc.php).
 454  *
 455  * @param string $p_option Configuration option.
 456  * @return boolean
 457  */
 458 function config_can_set_in_database( $p_option ) {
 459 	global $g_cache_bypass_lookup, $g_global_settings;
 460 
 461 	if( isset( $g_cache_bypass_lookup[$p_option] ) ) {
 462 		return !$g_cache_bypass_lookup[$p_option];
 463 	}
 464 
 465 	# bypass table lookup for certain options
 466 	$t_bypass_lookup = in_array( $p_option, $g_global_settings, true );
 467 
 468 	$g_cache_bypass_lookup[$p_option] = $t_bypass_lookup;
 469 
 470 	return !$t_bypass_lookup;
 471 }

 489  *

 491  */
 492 function config_delete( $p_option, $p_user = ALL_USERS, $p_project = ALL_PROJECTS ) {

 500 				WHERE config_id = ' . db_param() . ' AND

 507 }

 544  * @@@ to be used sparingly

 546  * @param string  $p_option  Configuration option.
 547  * @param integer $p_user    A user identifier.
 548  * @param integer $p_project A project identifier.
 549  * @return void

 551 function config_flush_cache( $p_option = '', $p_user = ALL_USERS, $p_project = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 552 	global $g_cache_filled;
 553 
 554 	if( '' !== $p_option ) {

 558 	} else {

 563 	}

 566 /**
 567  * Checks if an obsolete configuration variable is still in use.  If so, an error
 568  * will be generated and the script will exit.
 569  *
 570  * @param string $p_var     Old configuration option.
 571  * @param string $p_replace New configuration option.
 572  * @return void
 573  */
 574 function config_obsolete( $p_var, $p_replace = '' ) {
 575 	global $g_cache_config;
 576 
 577 	# @@@ we could trigger a WARNING here, once we have errors that can
 578 	#     have extra data plugged into them (we need to give the old and
 579 	#     new config option names in the warning text)
 580 
 581 	if( config_is_set( $p_var ) ) {
 582 		$t_description = 'The configuration option <em>' . $p_var . '</em> is now obsolete';
 583 		$t_info = '';
 584 
 585 		# Check if set in the database
 586 		if( is_array( $g_cache_config ) && array_key_exists( $p_var, $g_cache_config ) ) {
 587 			$t_info .= 'it is currently defined in ';
 588 			if( isset( $GLOBALS['g_' . $p_var] ) ) {
 589 				$t_info .= 'config_inc.php, as well as in ';
 590 			}
 591 			$t_info .= 'the database configuration for: <ul>';
 592 
 593 			foreach( $g_cache_config[$p_var] as $t_user_id => $t_user ) {
 594 				$t_info .= '<li>'
 595 					. ( ( $t_user_id == 0 ) ? lang_get( 'all_users' ) : user_get_name( $t_user_id ) )
 596 					. ': ';
 597 				foreach ( $t_user as $t_project_id => $t_project ) {
 598 					$t_info .= project_get_name( $t_project_id ) . ', ';
 599 				}
 600 				$t_info = rtrim( $t_info, ', ' ) . '</li>';
 601 			}
 602 			$t_info .= '</ul>';
 603 		}
 604 
 605 		# Replacement defined
 606 		if( is_array( $p_replace ) ) {
 607 			$t_info .= 'please see the following options: <ul>';
 608 			foreach( $p_replace as $t_option ) {
 609 				$t_info .= '<li>' . $t_option . '</li>';
 610 			}
 611 			$t_info .= '</ul>';
 612 		} else if( !is_blank( $p_replace ) ) {
 613 			$t_info .= 'please use ' . $p_replace . ' instead.';
 614 		}
 615 
 616 		check_print_test_warn_row( $t_description, false, $t_info );
 617 	}
 618 }
 619 
 620 /**
 621  * Checks if an obsolete environment variable is set.
 622  * If so, an error will be generated and the script will exit.
 623  *
 624  * @param string $p_env_variable     Old variable.
 625  * @param string $p_new_env_variable New variable.
 626  * @return void
 627  */
 628 function env_obsolete( $p_env_variable, $p_new_env_variable ) {
 629 	$t_env = getenv( $p_env_variable );
 630 	if( $t_env ) {
 631 		$t_description = 'Environment variable <em>' . $p_env_variable . '</em> is obsolete.';
 632 		$t_info = 'please use ' . $p_new_env_variable . ' instead.';
 633 		check_print_test_warn_row( $t_description, false, $t_info );
 634 	}
 635 }

 637 /**
 638  * Check for recursion in defining configuration variables.
 639  *
 640  * If there is a %text% in the returned value, re-evaluate the "text" part and
 641  * replace the string. It is possible to escape the '%' with backslash when
 642  * evaluation is not wanted, e.g. '\%test\%'.
 643  *
 644  * @param string  $p_value  Configuration variable to evaluate.
 645  * @param boolean $p_global If true, gets %text% as a global configuration, defaults to false.
 646  *
 647  * @return string
 648  */
 649 function config_eval( $p_value, $p_global = false ) {
 650 	$t_value = $p_value;
 651 	if( !empty( $t_value ) && is_string( $t_value ) && !is_numeric( $t_value ) ) {
 652 		$t_count = preg_match_all(
 653 			'/(?:^|[^\\\\])(%([^%]+)%)/U',
 654 			$t_value,
 655 			$t_matches,
 656 			PREG_SET_ORDER
 657 		);
 658 
 659 		if( $t_count > 0 ) {
 660 			foreach( $t_matches as $t_match ) {
 661 				list(, $t_match_with_delimiters, $t_config ) = $t_match;
 662 
 663 				# Make sure the config actually exists before retrieving it
 664 				if( !isset( $GLOBALS['g_' . $t_config ] ) ) {
 665 					continue;
 666 				}
 667 
 668 				if( $p_global ) {
 669 					$t_repl = config_get_global( $t_config );
 670 				} else {
 671 					$t_repl = config_get( $t_config );
 672 				}
 673 
 674 				# Handle the simple case where there is no need to do string replace.
 675 				# This will resolve the case where the $t_repl value is of non-string
 676 				# type, e.g. array of access levels.
 677 				if( $t_count == 1 && $p_value == $t_match_with_delimiters ) {
 678 					$t_value = $t_repl;
 679 					break;
 680 				}
 681 
 682 				$t_value = str_replace( $t_match_with_delimiters, $t_repl, $t_value );
 683 			}
 684 		}
 685 
 686 		# Remove escaped '%'
 687 		$t_value = str_replace( '\\%', '%', $t_value );
 688 	}
 689 	return $t_value;
 690 }
 691 
 692 /**
 693  * Check if a configuration is private.
 694  * Private options must not be exposed to users or web services.
 695  *
 696  * @param string $p_config_var Configuration option.
 697  * @return boolean True if private
 698  */
 699 function config_is_private( $p_config_var ) {
 700 	global $g_public_config_names;
 701 
 702 	return !in_array( $p_config_var, $g_public_config_names, true );
 703 }
 704 
 705 /**
 706  * Check if a configuration is defined in the database with the given value.
 707  *
 708  * @param string  $p_option  The configuration option to retrieve.
 709  * @param string  $p_value   Value to check for (defaults to null = any value).
 710  * @return boolean True if option is defined
 711  */
 712 function config_is_defined( $p_option, $p_value = null ) {
 713 	global $g_cache_filled, $g_cache_config;
 714 
 715 	if( !$g_cache_filled ) {
 716 		config_get( $p_option, -1 );
 717 	}
 718 
 719 	if( !isset( $g_cache_config[$p_option] ) ) {
 720 		# Option is not in cache
 721 		return false;
 722 	} elseif( $p_value === null ) {
 723 		# We're not checking any specific value
 724 		return true;
 725 	}
 726 
 727 	# Check the cache for specified value
 728 	foreach( $g_cache_config[$p_option] as $t_project ) {
 729 		foreach( $t_project as $t_opt ) {
 730 			list( , $t_value ) = explode( ';', $t_opt );
 731 			if( $t_value == $p_value ) {
 732 				return true;
 733 			}
 734 		}
 735 	}
 736 
 737 	# Value not found in cache
 738 	return false;
 739 }
 740 
 741 /**
 742  * Loads the contents of config table into cache
 743  * @return void
 744  */
 745 function config_cache_all() {
 746 	global $g_cache_config, $g_cache_config_access;
 747 
 748 	$t_config_rows = array();
 749 
 750 	# With oracle database, ADOdb maps column type "L" to clob.
 751 	# Because reading clobs is significantly slower, cast them to varchar for faster query execution
 752 	# Standard max size for varchar is 4000 bytes, so a safe limit is used as 1000 charancters
 753 	# for multibyte strings (up to 4 bytes per char)
 754 	if( db_is_oracle() ) {
 755 		$t_query = 'SELECT config_id, user_id, project_id, type, CAST(value AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS value, access_reqd'
 756 				. ' FROM {config}'
 757 				. ' WHERE dbms_lob.getlength(value)<=1000';
 758 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 759 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 760 			$t_config_rows[] = $t_row;
 761 		}
 762 		$t_query = 'SELECT config_id, user_id, project_id, type,  value, access_reqd'
 763 				. ' FROM {config}'
 764 				. ' WHERE dbms_lob.getlength(value)>1000';
 765 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 766 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 767 			$t_config_rows[] = $t_row;
 768 		}
 769 	} else {
 770 		$t_query = 'SELECT config_id, user_id, project_id, type,  value, access_reqd FROM {config}';
 771 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 772 		while( false <> ( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) ) {
 773 			$t_config_rows[] = $t_row;
 774 		}
 775 	}
 776 
 777 	foreach( $t_config_rows as $t_row ) {
 778 		$t_config = $t_row['config_id'];
 779 		$t_user = $t_row['user_id'];
 780 		$t_project = $t_row['project_id'];
 781 		$g_cache_config[$t_config][$t_user][$t_project] = $t_row['type'] . ';' . $t_row['value'];
 782 		$g_cache_config_access[$t_config][$t_user][$t_project] = $t_row['access_reqd'];
 783 	}
 784 }
 785 
 786 /**
 787  * Display a given config value appropriately
 788  * @param integer $p_type        Configuration type id.
 789  * @param mixed   $p_value       Configuration value.
 790  * @param boolean $p_for_display Whether to pass the value via string attribute for web browser display.
 791  * @return string
 792  */
 793 function config_get_value_as_string( $p_type, $p_value, $p_for_display = true ) {
 794 	$t_corrupted = false;
 795 
 796 	switch( $p_type ) {
 797 		case CONFIG_TYPE_DEFAULT:
 798 			return '';
 799 		case CONFIG_TYPE_FLOAT:
 800 			return (string)(float)$p_value;
 801 		case CONFIG_TYPE_INT:
 802 			return (string)(int)$p_value;
 803 		case CONFIG_TYPE_STRING:
 804 			$t_value = string_html_specialchars( config_eval( $p_value ) );
 805 			if( $p_for_display ) {
 806 				$t_value = '<p id="adm-config-value">\'' . string_nl2br( $t_value ) . '\'</p>';
 807 			}
 808 			return $t_value;
 809 		case CONFIG_TYPE_COMPLEX:
 810 			$t_value = @json_decode( $p_value, true );
 811 			if( $t_value === false ) {
 812 				$t_corrupted = true;
 813 			}
 814 			break;
 815 		default:
 816 			$t_value = config_eval( $p_value );
 817 			break;
 818 	}
 819 
 820 	if( $t_corrupted ) {
 821 		$t_output = $p_for_display ? lang_get( 'configuration_corrupted' ) : '';
 822 	} else {
 823 		$t_output = var_export( $t_value, true );
 824 	}
 825 
 826 	if( $p_for_display ) {
 827 		return '<pre id="adm-config-value">' . string_attribute( $t_output ) . '</pre>';
 828 	} else {
 829 		return string_attribute( $t_output );
 830 	}
 831 }
 832 
 833 function config_get_types() {
 834 	return array(
 835 		CONFIG_TYPE_DEFAULT => 'default',
 836 		CONFIG_TYPE_INT     => 'integer',
 837 		CONFIG_TYPE_FLOAT   => 'float',
 838 		CONFIG_TYPE_COMPLEX => 'complex',
 839 		CONFIG_TYPE_STRING  => 'string',
 840 		);
 841 }
 842 
 843 /**
 844  * returns the configuration type for a given configuration type id
 845  * @param integer $p_type Configuration type identifier to check.
 846  * @return string configuration type
 847  */
 848 function config_get_type_string( $p_type ) {
 849 	$t_config_types = config_get_types();
 850 	if( array_key_exists( $p_type, $t_config_types ) ) {
 851 		return $t_config_types[$p_type];
 852 	} else {
 853 		return $t_config_types[CONFIG_TYPE_DEFAULT];
 854 	}
 855 }

  16 
  17 /**
  18  * Crypto API
  19  *
  20  * @package CoreAPI
  21  * @subpackage CryptoAPI
  22  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  23  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  24  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  25  *
  26  * @uses config_api.php
  27  * @uses constant_inc.php
  28  * @uses error_api.php
  29  */
  30 
  31 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  32 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  33 require_api( 'error_api.php' );
  34 
  35 /**
  36  * Initialize the CryptoAPI subsystem.
  37  *
  38  * This function checks whether the master salt is specified correctly within
  39  * the configuration. If not, a fatal error is produced to protect against
  40  * invalid configuration impacting the security of the MantisBT installation.
  41  *
  42  * @return void
  43  */
  44 function crypto_init() {
  45 	if( !defined( 'MANTIS_MAINTENANCE_MODE' ) ) {
  46 		if( strlen( config_get_global( 'crypto_master_salt' ) ) < 16 ) {
  47 			trigger_error( ERROR_CRYPTO_MASTER_SALT_INVALID, ERROR );
  48 		}
  49 	}
  50 }
  51 
  52 /**
  53  * Generate a random string (raw binary output) for cryptographic purposes such
  54  * as nonces, IVs, default passwords, etc.
  55  *
  56  * This function will attempt to generate strong randomness but can optionally
  57  * be used to generate weaker randomness if less security is needed or a strong
  58  * source of randomness isn't available. The use of weak randomness for
  59  * cryptographic purposes is strongly discouraged because it contains low
  60  * entropy and is predictable.
  61  *
  62  * @param int $p_bytes                     Number of bytes of randomness required.
  63  * @param bool $p_require_strong_generator Whether a weak source of randomness
  64  *                                         can be used by this function (unused,
  65  *                                         kept for backwards compatibility).
  66  *
  67  * @return string|null Raw binary string containing the requested number of bytes
  68  *                     of random output or null if the output couldn't be created.
  69  * @throws Exception (with PHP >= 8.2, actually \Random\RandomException)
  70  *
  71  * @deprecated 2.26.0 random_bytes() should be used in preference to this function
  72  * @noinspection PhpUnusedParameterInspection
  73  */
  74 function crypto_generate_random_string( $p_bytes, $p_require_strong_generator = true ) {
  75 	error_parameters( __FUNCTION__ . '()', 'random_bytes()' );
  76 	trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
  77 	return random_bytes( $p_bytes );
  78 }
  79 
  80 /**
  81  * Generate a strong random string (raw binary output) for cryptographic
  82  * purposes such as nonces, IVs, default passwords, etc.
  83  *
  84  * If a strong source of randomness is not available, this function will fail
  85  * and produce an error. Strong randomness is different from weak randomness in
  86  * that a strong randomness generator doesn't produce predictable output and has
  87  * much higher entropy. Where randomness is being used for cryptographic
  88  * purposes, a strong source of randomness should always be used.
  89  *
  90  * @param int $p_bytes Number of bytes of strong randomness required.
  91  *
  92  * @return string Raw binary string containing the requested number of bytes of random output
  93  * @throws Exception (with PHP >= 8.2, actually \Random\RandomException)
  94  *
  95  * @deprecated 2.26.0 random_bytes() should be used in preference to this function
  96  */
  97 function crypto_generate_strong_random_string( $p_bytes ) {
  98 	error_parameters( __FUNCTION__ . '()', 'random_bytes()' );
  99 	trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
 100 	return random_bytes( $p_bytes );
 101 }
 102 
 103 /**
 104  * Generate a nonce encoded using the base64 with URI safe alphabet approach
 105  * described in RFC4648.
 106  *
 107  * Note that the minimum length is rounded up to the next number with a factor
 108  * of 4 so that padding is never added to the end of the base64 output. This
 109  * means the '=' padding character is never present in the output.
 110  *
 111  * Due to the reduced character set of base64 encoding, the actual amount of
 112  * entropy produced by this function for a given output string length is 3/4
 113  * (0.75) of the raw unencoded output produced with the
 114  * {@see crypto_generate_strong_random_string()} function.
 115  *
 116  * @param int $p_minimum_length Minimum number of characters required for the nonce.
 117  *
 118  * @return string Nonce encoded according to the base64 with URI safe alphabet
 119  *                approach described in RFC4648
 120  * @throws Exception (with PHP >= 8.2, actually \Random\RandomException)
 121  */
 122 function crypto_generate_uri_safe_nonce( $p_minimum_length ) {
 123 	$t_length_mod4 = $p_minimum_length % 4;
 124 	$t_adjusted_length = $p_minimum_length + 4 - ($t_length_mod4 ?: 4);
 125 	$t_raw_bytes_required = ( $t_adjusted_length / 4 ) * 3;
 126 	$t_base64_encoded = base64_encode( random_bytes( $t_raw_bytes_required ) );
 127 
 128 	# Note: no need to translate trailing = padding characters because our
 129 	# length rounding ensures that padding is never required.
 130 	return strtr( $t_base64_encoded, '+/', '-_' );
 131 }

  48  * @param integer $p_user_id Id to set as current user
  49  * @return integer Old current user id
  50  * @access public
  51  */
  52 function current_user_set( $p_user_id ) {
  53 	global $g_cache_current_user_id;
  54 	global $g_cache_current_user_pref;
  55 
  56 	$t_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
  57 
  58 	if( $t_user_id == $g_cache_current_user_id ) {
  59 		return $t_user_id;
  60 	}
  61 
  62 	$t_old_current = $g_cache_current_user_id;
  63 	$g_cache_current_user_id = $t_user_id;
  64 
  65 	# Clear current user preferences cache
  66 	$g_cache_current_user_pref = array();
  67 
  68 	return $t_old_current;
  69 }

 230 /**
 231  * Returns the issue filter for the current user, which is retrieved by
 232  * evaluating these steps:
 233  * 1) Reads gpc vars for a token id, which means to load a temporary filter
 234  * 2) Otherwise, get the filter saved as current, for the user, project 
 235  *
 236  * @param integer $p_project_id Project id to get the user's filter from, if needed.
 237  * @return array	A filter array
 238  * @access public
 239  */
 240 function current_user_get_bug_filter( $p_project_id = null ) {
 241 	$f_tmp_key = gpc_get_string( 'filter', null );
 242 
 243 	if( null !== $f_tmp_key ) {
 244 		$t_filter = filter_temporary_get( $f_tmp_key, null );
 245 		# if filter doesn't exist or can't be loaded, return a default filter (doesn't throw error)
 246 		if( null === $t_filter ) {
 247 			$t_filter = filter_get_default();
 248 		}
 249 	} else {
 250 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 251 		$t_filter = user_get_bug_filter( $t_user_id, $p_project_id );
 252 	}
 253 
 254 	return $t_filter;
 255 }

 266 /**
 267  * Checks if the user has only one, or none, visible project and modify his
 268  * current and default project to be coherent.
 269  * - If current project is ALL_PROJECTS, sets the the visible project as current.
 270  * - If default project is ALL_PROJECTS, sets the visible project as his default
 271  *   project for future sessions.
 272  * - If default project is not the visible one, modify it to be that project,
 273  *   or ALL_PROJECTS if the user has no accessible projects.
 274  *
 275  * These changes only apply to users who can't use the project selection.
 276  *
 277  * @return void
 278  */
 279 function current_user_modify_single_project_default() {
 280 	# The user must not be able to use the project selector
 281 	if( layout_navbar_can_show_projects_menu() ) {
 282 		return;
 283 	}
 284 	# The user must have one, or none, projects
 285 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 286 	if( user_has_more_than_one_project( $t_user_id ) ) {
 287 		return;
 288 	}
 289 	$t_default = user_pref_get_pref( $t_user_id, 'default_project' );
 290 	$t_current = helper_get_current_project();
 291 	$t_projects = user_get_all_accessible_projects( $t_user_id );
 292 	$t_count = count( $t_projects );
 293 
 294 	if( 0 == $t_count ) {
 295 		$t_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS;
 296 	} else {
 297 		$t_project_id = reset( $t_projects );
 298 	}
 299 
 300 	if( $t_project_id != $t_current ) {
 301 		helper_set_current_project( $t_project_id );
 302 	}
 303 	if( $t_project_id != $t_default ) {
 304 		user_pref_set_pref( $t_user_id, 'default_project', (int)$t_project_id, ALL_PROJECTS, false /* skip protected check */ );
 305 	}
 306 }

  89 # cache of custom field definitions, indexed by field id: array( id => array of properties )
  90 $g_cache_custom_field = array();
  91 # cache of all custom fields, array of ids
  92 $g_cache_cf_list = null;
  93 # cache of field ids linked to a project, indexed by project id: array( pr_id => array(field ids) )
  94 $g_cache_cf_linked = array();
  95 # cache of mapping of custom field names to field id: array( 'name' => id )
  96 $g_cache_name_to_id_map = array();
  97 
  98 # Values are indexed by [ bug_id, field_id ]
  99 # a non existent value will have a cached value of null
 100 $g_cache_cf_bug_values = array();
