 102 /**
 103  * Cache a custom field row if necessary and return the cached copy.
 104  *
 105  * If the second parameter is true (default), trigger an error
 106  * if the field can't be found.  If the second parameter is
 107  * false, return false if the field can't be found.
 108  *
 109  * @param int $p_field_id        Custom field id.
 110  * @param bool $p_trigger_errors Indicates whether to trigger an error if the field is not found.
 111  *
 112  * @return array|false array representing custom field
 113  *
 114  * @access public
 115  */
 116 function custom_field_cache_row( $p_field_id, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
 117 	global $g_cache_custom_field;
 118 
 119 	$c_field_id = (int)$p_field_id;
 120 	if( !isset( $g_cache_custom_field[$c_field_id] ) ) {
 121 		custom_field_cache_array_rows( array( $c_field_id ) );
 122 	}
 123 
 124 	# the cached index exist, even when not found
 125 	$t_cf_row = $g_cache_custom_field[$c_field_id];
 126 	if( !$t_cf_row ) {
 127 		if( $p_trigger_errors ) {
 128 			error_parameters( 'Custom ' . $p_field_id );
 129 			trigger_error( ERROR_CUSTOM_FIELD_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 130 		} else {
 131 			return false;
 132 		}
 133 	}
 134 	return $t_cf_row;
 135 }
 136 
 137 /**
 138  * Cache custom fields contained within an array of field id's.
 139  *
 140  * @param array $p_cf_id_array Array of custom field ids;
 141  *                             if empty, all fields will be cached.
 142  *
 143  * @return void
 144  *
 145  * @access public
 146  */
 147 function custom_field_cache_array_rows( array $p_cf_id_array = [] ): void {
 148 	global $g_cache_custom_field, $g_cache_name_to_id_map;
 149 
 150 	$c_cf_id_array = array();
 151 	$t_cache_all = empty( $p_cf_id_array );
 152 
 153 	# cache main data
 154 	if( $t_cache_all ) {
 155 		$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {custom_field}';
 156 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 157 	} else {
 158 		foreach( $p_cf_id_array as $t_cf_id ) {
 159 			$c_id = (int)$t_cf_id;
 160 			if( !isset( $g_cache_custom_field[$c_id] ) ) {
 161 				$c_cf_id_array[$c_id] = $c_id;
 162 			}
 163 		}
 164 		if( empty( $c_cf_id_array ) ) {
 165 			return;
 166 		}
 167 		db_param_push();
 168 		$t_params = array();
 169 		$t_in_clause_dbparams = array();
 170 		foreach( $c_cf_id_array as $t_id) {
 171 			$t_in_clause_dbparams[] = db_param();
 172 			$t_params[] = $t_id;
 173 		}
 174 		$t_where_id_in = ' IN (' . implode( ',', $t_in_clause_dbparams ) . ')';
 175 		$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {custom_field} WHERE id' . $t_where_id_in;
 176 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 177 	}
 178 
 179 	$t_ids_not_found = $c_cf_id_array;
 180 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 181 		$c_id = (int)$t_row['id'];
 182 		$c_name = mb_strtolower($t_row['name']);
 183 		$g_cache_custom_field[$c_id] = $t_row;
 184 		$g_cache_name_to_id_map[$c_name] = $c_id;
 185 		$g_cache_custom_field[$c_id]['linked_projects'] = array();
 186 		unset( $t_ids_not_found[$c_id] );
 187 	}
 188 
 189 	# cache linked projects
 190 	if( $t_cache_all ) {
 191 		$t_query = 'SELECT field_id, project_id FROM {custom_field_project}';
 192 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 193 	} else {
 194 		db_param_push();
 195 		# reuse previous db_params and $t_params array, since the query is structurally the same
 196 		$t_query = 'SELECT field_id, project_id FROM {custom_field_project} WHERE field_id' . $t_where_id_in;
 197 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 198 	}
 199 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 200 		$g_cache_custom_field[(int)$t_row['field_id']]['linked_projects'][] = (int)$t_row['project_id'];
 201 	}
 202 
 203 	# set the remaining ids as not found
 204 	foreach( $t_ids_not_found as $t_id) {
 205 		$g_cache_custom_field[$t_id] = false;
 206 	}
 207 }
 208 
 209 /**
 210  * Load in cache values of custom fields, for given bugs and field ids.
 211  *
 212  * When a value for a given bug and field does not exist, fill the cached value as null.
 213  *
 214  * @global array $g_cache_cf_bug_values
 215  * @param array $p_bug_id_array
 216  * @param array $p_field_id_array
 217  *
 218  * @return void
 219  */
 220 function custom_field_cache_values( array $p_bug_id_array, array $p_field_id_array ) {
 221 	global $g_cache_cf_bug_values;
 222 
 223 	if( empty( $p_field_id_array ) ) {
 224 		return;
 225 	}
 226 
 227 	# clean fields ids
 228 	$t_fields_to_search = array();
 229 	$f_cf_defs = array();
 230 	foreach( $p_field_id_array as $t_field_id ) {
 231 		$c_field_id = (int)$t_field_id;
 232 		$t_fields_to_search[$c_field_id] = $c_field_id;
 233 		$f_cf_defs[$c_field_id] = custom_field_get_definition( $c_field_id );
 234 	}
 235 
 236 	# get bugs to fetch
 237 	$t_bugs_to_search = array();
 238 	foreach( $p_bug_id_array as $t_bug_id ) {
 239 		$c_bug_id = (int)$t_bug_id;
 240 		if( !isset( $g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
 241 			$t_bugs_to_search[] = $c_bug_id;
 242 		} else {
 243 			$t_diff = array_diff( $t_fields_to_search, array_keys( $g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id] ) );
 244 			if( !empty( $t_diff ) ) {
 245 				$t_bugs_to_search[] = $c_bug_id;
 246 			}
 247 		}
 248 	}
 249 	if( empty( $t_bugs_to_search ) ) {
 250 		return;
 251 	}
 252 
 253 	db_param_push();
 254 	$t_params= array();
 255 	$t_query = 'SELECT B.id AS bug_id, CF.id AS field_id, CFS.value, CFS.text FROM {bug} B'
 256 			. ' LEFT OUTER JOIN {custom_field} CF ON 1 = 1'
 257 			. ' LEFT OUTER JOIN {custom_field_string} CFS ON ( B.id = CFS.bug_id AND CF.id = CFS.field_id )';
 258 	$t_bug_in_params = array();
 259 	foreach( $t_bugs_to_search as $t_bug_id ) {
 260 		$t_bug_in_params[] = db_param();
 261 		$t_params[] = $t_bug_id;
 262 	}
 263 	$t_query .= ' WHERE B.id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_bug_in_params ) . ')';
 264 	$t_field_in_params = array();
 265 	foreach( $t_fields_to_search as $t_field_id ) {
 266 		$t_field_in_params[] = db_param();
 267 		$t_params[] = $t_field_id;
 268 	}
 269 	$t_query .= ' AND CF.id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_field_in_params ) . ')';
 270 
 271 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 272 
 273 	# By having the left outer joins, non existent values are fetched as nulls,
 274 	# and can be stored in cache to mark them as not-found
 275 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 276 		$c_bug_id = (int)$t_row['bug_id'];
 277 		# create a bug index if necessary
 278 		if( !isset( $g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
 279 			$g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id] = array();
 280 		}
 281 
 282 		$c_field_id = (int)$t_row['field_id'];
 283 		$t_value_column = ( $f_cf_defs[$c_field_id]['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA ? 'text' : 'value' );
 284 		$t_value = $t_row[$t_value_column];
 285 		if( null !== $t_value ) {
 286 			$t_value = custom_field_database_to_value( $t_value, $f_cf_defs[$c_field_id]['type'] );
 287 		}
 288 
 289 		# non-existent will be stored as null
 290 		$g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id][$c_field_id] = $t_value;
 291 	}
 292 }
 293 
 294 /**
 295  * Clear the custom field values cache (or just the given bug id if specified).
 296  *
 297  * @global array $g_cache_cf_bug_values
 298  * @param int $p_bug_id	Bug id
 299  *
 300  * @return void
 301  */
 302 function custom_field_clear_cache_values( $p_bug_id = null ) {
 303 	global $g_cache_cf_bug_values;
 304 
 305 	if( null === $p_bug_id ) {
 306 		$g_cache_cf_bug_values = array();
 307 	} else {
 308 		if( isset( $g_cache_cf_bug_values[(int)$p_bug_id] ) ) {
 309 			unset( $g_cache_cf_bug_values[(int)$p_bug_id] );
 310 		}
 311 	}
 312 }

 314 /**
 315  * Clear the custom field cache (or just the given id if specified).
 316  *
 317  * @param int $p_field_id Custom field id.
 318  *
 319  * @return void
 320  *
 321  * @access public
 322  */
 323 function custom_field_clear_cache( $p_field_id = null ) {
 324 	global $g_cache_custom_field, $g_cached_custom_field_lists;
 325 
 326 	$g_cached_custom_field_lists = null;
 327 
 328 	if( null === $p_field_id ) {
 329 		$g_cache_custom_field = array();

 337 /**
 338  * Check to see whether the field is included in the given project.
 339  *
 340  * @param int $p_field_id   Custom field id.
 341  * @param int $p_project_id Project id.
 342  *
 343  * @return bool True if the field is included, false otherwise
 344  *
 345  * @access public
 346  */
 347 function custom_field_is_linked( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) {
 348 	global $g_cache_cf_linked;
 349 
 350 	if( isset( $g_cache_cf_linked[$p_project_id] ) ) {
 351 		if( in_array( $p_field_id, $g_cache_cf_linked[$p_project_id] ) ) {
 352 			return true;
 353 		}
 354 		return false;
 355 	}
 356 
 357 	# figure out if this bug_id/field_id combination exists
 358 	db_param_push();
 359 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {custom_field_project}
 360 				WHERE field_id=' . db_param() . ' AND project_id=' . db_param();
 361 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) );
 362 	$t_count = db_result( $t_result );
 363 
 364 	if( $t_count > 0 ) {
 365 		return true;
 366 	} else {
 367 		return false;
 368 	}
 369 }

 419 /**
 420  * Check to see whether the name is unique.
 421  *
 422  * If an id is specified, then the corresponding record is excluded from the
 423  * uniqueness test.
 424  *
 425  * @param string $p_name         Custom field name.
 426  * @param int $p_custom_field_id Custom field identifier.
 427  *
 428  * @return bool False if a field with the name already exists, true otherwise.
 429  *
 430  * @access public
 431  */
 432 function custom_field_is_name_unique( $p_name, $p_custom_field_id = null ) {
 433 	db_param_push();
 434 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {custom_field} WHERE name=' . db_param();
 435 	if( $p_custom_field_id !== null ) {
 436 		$t_query .= ' AND (id <> ' . db_param() . ')';
 437 	}
 438 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, ( ($p_custom_field_id !== null) ? array( $p_name, $p_custom_field_id ) : array( $p_name ) ) );
 439 	$t_count = db_result( $t_result );
 440 
 441 	if( $t_count > 0 ) {
 442 		return false;
 443 	} else {
 444 		return true;
 445 	}
 446 }

 559 /**
 560  * Create a new custom field with the name $p_name.
 561  *
 562  * The definition's fields are set to default values and can be changed later.
 563  *
 564  * @param string $p_name Custom field name.
 565  *
 566  * @return int Id of the new custom field.
 567  *
 568  * @access public
 569  */
 570 function custom_field_create( $p_name ) {
 571 	$c_name = trim( $p_name );
 572 
 573 	if( is_blank( $c_name ) ) {
 574 		error_parameters( 'name' );
 575 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 576 	}
 577 
 578 	custom_field_ensure_name_unique( $c_name );
 579 
 580 	db_param_push();
 581 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {custom_field} ( name, possible_values )
 582 				  VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 583 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_name, '' ) );
 584 
 585 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'custom_field' ) );
 586 }

 588 /**
 589  * Update the field definition.
 590  *
 591  * @param int   $p_field_id  Custom field identifier.
 592  * @param array $p_def_array Custom field definition.
 593  *
 594  * @return bool True on success, false on failure
 595  * @throws ClientException
 596  *
 597  * @access public
 598  */
 599 function custom_field_update( $p_field_id, array $p_def_array ) {
 600 	/**
 601 	 * @var string     $v_name
 602 	 * @var int        $v_type
 603 	 * @var string|int $v_default_value
 604 	 * @var int        $v_access_level_r
 605 	 * @var int        $v_access_level_rw
 606 	 * @var int        $v_length_min
 607 	 * @var int        $v_length_max
 608 	 */
 609 	extract( $p_def_array, EXTR_PREFIX_ALL, 'v');
 610 
 611 	if( is_blank( $v_name ) ) {
 612 		error_parameters( 'name' );
 613 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 614 	} elseif( mb_strpos( $v_name, ',' ) ) {
 615 		# Commas are not allowed in CF name, it causes issues with columns
 616 		# selection (see #26665)
 617 		error_parameters( $v_name );
 618 		trigger_error( ERROR_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME_INVALID, ERROR );
 619 	}
 620 
 621 	if( is_blank( $v_name ) ) {
 622 		error_parameters( 'name' );
 623 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 624 	}
 625 
 626 	# Default value length is limited by underlying DB field
 627 	# (and max_textarea_length, for textarea fields).
 628 	if( $v_type == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA ) {
 629 		$t_max_textarea_length = config_get_global( 'max_textarea_length' );
 630 		$t_max_length = min( DB_FIELD_SIZE_CF_DEFAULT_VALUE, $t_max_textarea_length );
 631 	} else {
 632 		$t_max_length = DB_FIELD_SIZE_CF_DEFAULT_VALUE;
 633 	}
 634 	if( strlen( $v_default_value ) > $t_max_length ) {
 635 		throw new ClientException(
 636 			"Default value must be $t_max_length characters or less.",
 637 			ERROR_FIELD_TOO_LONG,
 638 			[lang_get( 'custom_field_default_value' ), $t_max_length]
 639 		);
 640 	}
 641 
 642 	if( $v_access_level_rw < $v_access_level_r ) {
 643 		error_parameters(
 644 			lang_get( 'custom_field_access_level_r' ) . ', ' .
 645 			lang_get( 'custom_field_access_level_rw' ) );
 646 		trigger_error( ERROR_CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_PROPERTY, ERROR );
 647 	}
 648 
 649 	if( $v_length_min < 0
 650 		|| ( $v_length_max != 0 && $v_length_min > $v_length_max )
 651 	) {
 652 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'custom_field_length_min' ) . ', ' . lang_get( 'custom_field_length_max' ) );
 653 		trigger_error( ERROR_CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_PROPERTY, ERROR );
 654 	}
 655 
 656 	# Ensure max length for textarea fields is not more than allowed
 657 	if( $v_type == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA ) {
 658 		if( $v_length_max > $t_max_textarea_length ) {
 659 			throw new ClientException(
 660 				'Maximum Length must be ' . $t_max_textarea_length . ' or less.',
 661 				ERROR_FIELD_TOO_LONG,
 662 				[lang_get( 'custom_field_length_max' ), $t_max_textarea_length]
 663 			);
 664 		}
 665 	}
 666 
 667 	if( !custom_field_is_name_unique( $v_name, $p_field_id ) ) {
 668 		trigger_error( ERROR_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME_NOT_UNIQUE, ERROR );
 669 	}
 670 
 671 
 672 	# Validate default date format
 673 	if( $v_type == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE && $v_default_value && !is_numeric( $v_default_value ) ) {
 674 		# Allow legacy "{xxx}" format for dynamic dates
 675 		# @TODO this backwards-compatibility feature should be removed in a future release
 676 		if( preg_match( '/^{(.*)}$/', $v_default_value, $t_matches ) ) {
 677 			error_parameters( $v_default_value, $t_matches[1] );
 678 			trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
 679 			$v_default_value = $t_matches[1];
 680 		}
 681 
 682 		# Check default date format and calculate actual date
 683 		try {
 684 			new DateTimeImmutable( $v_default_value );
 685 		}
 686 		catch( Exception $e ) {
 687 			error_parameters( lang_get( 'custom_field_default_value' ) );
 688 			trigger_error( ERROR_CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_PROPERTY, ERROR );
 689 		}
 690 	}
 691 
 692 	db_param_push();
 693 
 694 	# Build fields update statement
 695 	$t_update = '';
 696 	foreach( $p_def_array as $t_field => $t_value ) {
 697 		switch( $t_field ) {
 698 			case 'name':
 699 			case 'possible_values':
 700 			case 'default_value':
 701 			case 'valid_regexp':
 702 				# Possible values doesn't apply to textarea fields
 703 				if( $v_type == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA && $t_field == 'possible_values' ) {
 704 					$t_value = '';
 705 				}
 706 
 707 				$t_update .= $t_field . '=' . db_param() . ', ';
 708 				$t_params[] = (string)$t_value;
 709 				break;
 710 			case 'type':
 711 			case 'access_level_r':
 712 			case 'access_level_rw':
 713 			case 'length_min':
 714 			case 'length_max':
 715 				$t_update .= $t_field  . '=' . db_param() . ', ';
 716 				$t_params[] = (int)$t_value;
 717 				break;
 718 			case 'filter_by':
 719 			case 'display_report':
 720 			case 'display_update':
 721 			case 'display_resolved':
 722 			case 'display_closed':
 723 			case 'require_report':
 724 			case 'require_update':
 725 			case 'require_resolved':
 726 			case 'require_closed':
 727 				$t_update .= $t_field . '=' . db_param() . ', ';
 728 				$t_params[] = (bool)$t_value;
 729 				break;
 730 		}
 731 	}
 732 
 733 	# If there are fields to update, execute SQL
 734 	if( $t_update !== '' ) {
 735 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {custom_field} SET ' . rtrim( $t_update, ', ' ) . ' WHERE id = ' . db_param();
 736 		$t_params[] = $p_field_id;
 737 		db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 738 
 739 		custom_field_clear_cache( $p_field_id );
 740 
 741 		return true;
 742 	}
 743 
 744 	# Reset the parameter count manually since the query was not executed
 745 	db_param_pop();
 746 
 747 	return false;
 748 }

 750 /**
 751  * Add a custom field to a project.
 752  *
 753  * @param int $p_field_id   Custom field identifier.
 754  * @param int $p_project_id Project identifier.
 755  *
 756  * @return bool True on success, false on failure or if already added
 757  * @throws ClientException if project does not exist
 758  *
 759  * @access public
 760  */
 761 function custom_field_link( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) {
 762 	custom_field_ensure_exists( $p_field_id );
 763 	project_ensure_exists( $p_project_id );
 764 
 765 	if( custom_field_is_linked( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) ) {
 766 		return false;
 767 	}
 768 
 769 	db_param_push();
 770 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {custom_field_project} ( field_id, project_id )
 771 				  VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ')';
 772 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) );
 773 
 774 	return true;
 775 }

 777 /**

 781  * case where a bug is moved to another project that has the field, or the
 782  * field is linked again to the project.

 784  * @param int $p_field_id   Custom field identifier.
 785  * @param int $p_project_id Project identifier.

 789  * @access public
 790  */
 791 function custom_field_unlink( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) {
 792 	db_param_push();
 793 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {custom_field_project}
 794 				  WHERE field_id = ' . db_param() . ' AND project_id = ' . db_param();
 795 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) );
 796 }

 803  * @return void
 804  *
 805  * @access public
 806  */
 807 function custom_field_destroy( $p_field_id ) {

 809 	db_param_push();
 810 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {custom_field_string} WHERE field_id=' . db_param();
 811 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id ) );
 812 
 813 	# delete all project associations
 814 	db_param_push();
 815 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {custom_field_project} WHERE field_id=' . db_param();
 816 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id ) );
 817 
 818 	# delete the definition
 819 	db_param_push();
 820 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {custom_field} WHERE id=' .  db_param();
 821 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id ) );
 822 
 823 	custom_field_clear_cache( $p_field_id );
 824 	custom_field_clear_cache_values();
 825 }

 863 /**
 864  * Get the id of the custom field with the specified name.
 865  *
 866  * Custom field name lookup is case insensitive. Returns false if no custom
 867  * field is found with the specified name.
 868  *
 869  * @param string $p_field_name Custom field name.
 870  *
 871  * @return int|false custom field id
 872  *
 873  * @access public
 874  */
 875 function custom_field_get_id_from_name( $p_field_name ) {
 876 	global $g_cache_name_to_id_map;
 877 
 878 	if( is_blank( $p_field_name ) ) {
 879 		return false;
 880 	}
 881 
 882 	$p_field_name = mb_strtolower($p_field_name);
 883 	if( !isset( $g_cache_name_to_id_map[$p_field_name] ) ) {
 884 		# Build cache of lowercase custom fields names to id
 885 		if( !$g_cache_name_to_id_map ) {
 886 			$t_query = new DbQuery( "SELECT id, name FROM {custom_field}" );
 887 			foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 888 				$t_name = mb_strtolower($t_row['name']);
 889 				$g_cache_name_to_id_map[$t_name] = $t_row['id'];
 890 			}
 891 		}
 892 	}
 893 
 894 	return $g_cache_name_to_id_map[$p_field_name] ?? false;
 895 }
 896 
 897 /**
 898  * Return an array of ids of custom fields bound to the specified project.
 899  *
 900  * The ids will be sorted based on the sequence number associated with the binding.
 901  *
 902  * @param int|array $p_project_id A project identifier, or array of project ids
 903  *
 904  * @return array Array of custom field ids
 905  * @throws ClientException
 906  *
 907  * @access public
 908  */
 909 function custom_field_get_linked_ids( $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 910 	global $g_cache_cf_linked;
 911 
 912 	if( !is_array( $p_project_id ) && isset( $g_cache_cf_linked[$p_project_id] ) ) {
 913 		return $g_cache_cf_linked[$p_project_id];
 914 	}
 915 
 916 	if( ALL_PROJECTS == $p_project_id ) {
 917 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 918 		# Select all projects accessible by the user
 919 		$t_project_ids = user_get_all_accessible_projects( $t_user_id );
 920 	} elseif( !is_array( $p_project_id ) ) {
 921 		$t_project_ids = array( $p_project_id );
 922 	} else {
 923 		$t_project_ids = $p_project_id;
 924 	}
 925 
 926 	$t_field_ids = array();
 927 	$t_uncached_projects = array();
 928 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_pr_id ) {
 929 		$c_pr_id = (int)$t_pr_id;
 930 		if( isset( $g_cache_cf_linked[$c_pr_id] ) ) {
 931 			$t_field_ids = array_merge( $t_field_ids, $g_cache_cf_linked[$c_pr_id] );
 932 		} else {
 933 			$t_uncached_projects[$c_pr_id] = $c_pr_id;
 934 		}
 935 	}
 936 
 937 	if( !empty( $t_uncached_projects) ) {
 938 		db_param_push();
 939 		$t_params = array();
 940 		$t_project_clause = 'IN (';
 941 		foreach( $t_uncached_projects as $t_project ) {
 942 			$t_project_clause .= db_param() . ',';
 943 			$t_params[] = $t_project;
 944 		}
 945 		$t_project_clause = rtrim( $t_project_clause, ',' ) . ')';
 946 		$t_query = 'SELECT CFP.project_id, CF.id FROM {custom_field} CF '
 947 				. ' JOIN {custom_field_project} CFP ON CFP.field_id = CF.id'
 948 				. ' WHERE CFP.project_id ' . $t_project_clause
 949 				. '	ORDER BY sequence ASC, name ASC';
 950 
 951 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 952 
 953 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 954 			$t_project_id = (int)$t_row['project_id'];
 955 			if( !isset( $g_cache_cf_linked[$t_project_id] ) ) {
 956 				$g_cache_cf_linked[$t_project_id] = array();
 957 			}
 958 			$g_cache_cf_linked[$t_project_id][] = (int)$t_row['id'];
 959 			$t_field_ids[] = (int)$t_row['id'];
 960 			unset( $t_uncached_projects[$t_project_id] );
 961 		}
 962 
 963 		# save empty array for those projects that don't appear in the results
 964 		if( !empty( $t_uncached_projects ) ) {
 965 			foreach( $t_uncached_projects as $t_pr_id ) {
 966 				$g_cache_cf_linked[$t_pr_id] = array();
 967 			}
 968 		}
 969 	}
 970 
 971 	$t_field_ids = array_unique( $t_field_ids );
 972 	# If original query was for ALL_PROJECTS, save as cached values too
 973 	if( ALL_PROJECTS == $p_project_id ) {
 974 		$g_cache_cf_linked[ALL_PROJECTS] = $t_field_ids;
 975 	}
 976 
 977 	return $t_field_ids;
 978 }

1066 /**
1067  * Get the value of a custom field for the given bug.
1068  *
1069  * @todo return values are unclear... should we error when access is denied
1070  *       and provide an api to check whether it will be?
1071  *
1072  * @param int $p_field_id Custom field id.
1073  * @param int $p_bug_id   A bug identifier.
1074  *
1075  * @return mixed: value is defined, null: no value is defined, false: read access is denied
1076  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist
1077  *
1078  * @access public
1079  */
1080 function custom_field_get_value( $p_field_id, $p_bug_id ) {
1081 	global $g_cache_cf_bug_values;
1082 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1083 	$c_field_id = (int)$p_field_id;
1084 
1085 	custom_field_cache_row( $c_field_id );
1086 
1087 	# first check permissions
1088 	if( !custom_field_has_read_access( $c_field_id, $c_bug_id, auth_get_current_user_id() ) ) {
1089 		return false;
1090 	}
1091 
1092 	# A null value means a cached non existent value. It must be checked with care.
1093 	if( !isset( $g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id] )
1094 			|| !array_key_exists( $c_field_id, $g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
1095 		custom_field_cache_values( array( $c_bug_id ), array( $c_field_id ) );
1096 	}
1097 
1098 	return $g_cache_cf_bug_values[$c_bug_id][$c_field_id];
1099 }

1101 /**

1103  *
1104  * Array keys are custom field names. Array is sorted by custom field sequence number;
1105  * Array items are arrays with the next keys:
1106  * 'type', 'value', 'access_level_r'
1107  *
1108  * @param int $p_bug_id            A bug identifier.
1109  * @param int $p_user_access_level Access level.
1110  *
1111  * @return array
1112  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist
1113  *
1114  * @access public
1115  */
1116 function custom_field_get_linked_fields( $p_bug_id, $p_user_access_level ) {
1117 	$t_custom_fields = custom_field_get_all_linked_fields( $p_bug_id );
1118 
1119 	# removing restricted fields
1120 	foreach( $t_custom_fields as $t_custom_field_name => $t_custom_field_data ) {
1121 		if( $p_user_access_level < $t_custom_field_data['access_level_r'] ) {
1122 			unset( $t_custom_fields[$t_custom_field_name] );
1123 		}
1124 	}
1125 	return $t_custom_fields;
1126 }

1128 /**
1129  * Gets the custom fields array for the given bug. Array keys are custom field names.
1130  *
1131  * Array is sorted by custom field sequence number; Array items are arrays with the next keys:
1132  * 'type', 'value', 'access_level_r'
1133  *
1134  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
1135  *
1136  * @return array
1137  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist
1138  *
1139  * @access public
1140  */
1141 function custom_field_get_all_linked_fields( $p_bug_id ) {
1142 	global $g_cached_custom_field_lists;
1143 
1144 	if( !is_array( $g_cached_custom_field_lists ) ) {
1145 		$g_cached_custom_field_lists = array();
1146 	}
1147 
1148 	# is the list in cache ?
1149 	if( !array_key_exists( $p_bug_id, $g_cached_custom_field_lists ) ) {
1150 		$c_project_id = (int)( bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' ) );
1151 
1152 		db_param_push();
1153 		$t_query = 'SELECT f.name, f.type, f.access_level_r, f.default_value, s.value, s.text
1154 			FROM {custom_field_project} p
1155 				INNER JOIN {custom_field} f ON f.id = p.field_id
1156 				LEFT JOIN {custom_field_string} s
1157 					ON s.field_id = p.field_id AND s.bug_id = ' . db_param() . '
1158 			WHERE p.project_id = ' . db_param() . '
1159 			ORDER BY p.sequence ASC, f.name ASC';
1160 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id, $c_project_id) );
1161 
1162 		$t_custom_fields = array();
1163 
1164 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1165 			$t_value_column = ( $t_row['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA ? 'text' : 'value' );
1166 			if( is_null( $t_row[$t_value_column] ) ) {
1167 				$t_value = $t_row['default_value'];
1168 			} else {
1169 				$t_value = custom_field_database_to_value( $t_row[$t_value_column], $t_row['type'] );
1170 			}
1171 
1172 			$t_custom_fields[$t_row['name']] = array(
1173 				'type' => $t_row['type'],
1174 				'value' => $t_value,
1175 				'access_level_r' => $t_row['access_level_r'],
1176 			);
1177 		}
1178 
1179 		$g_cached_custom_field_lists[$p_bug_id] = $t_custom_fields;
1180 	}
1181 
1182 	return $g_cached_custom_field_lists[$p_bug_id];
1183 }

1190  *

1195 function custom_field_get_sequence( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) {
1196 	$p_field_id = (int)$p_field_id;

1198 
1199 	db_param_push();
1200 	$t_query = 'SELECT sequence
1201 				  FROM {custom_field_project}
1202 				  WHERE field_id=' . db_param() . ' AND
1203 						project_id=' . db_param();
1204 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id, $p_project_id ), 1 );
1205

1207

1215 /**
1216  * Validate a custom field's value.
1217  *
1218  * Does not require a bug to exist and does not actually set the value.
1219  *
1220  * @param int    $p_field_id Custom field identifier.
1221  * @param string $p_value    Custom field value.
1222  *
1223  * @return bool
1224  *
1225  * @access public
1226  */
1227 function custom_field_validate( $p_field_id, $p_value ) {
1228 	$t_row = custom_field_get_definition( $p_field_id );
1229 
1230 	$t_type = $t_row['type'];
1231 	$t_valid_regexp = $t_row['valid_regexp'];
1232 	$t_length_min = $t_row['length_min'];
1233 	$t_length_max = $t_row['length_max'];
1234 
1235 	$t_valid = true;
1236 	$t_length = mb_strlen( $p_value );
1237 	switch( $t_type ) {
1238 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_STRING:
1239 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA:
1240 			# Empty fields are valid
1241 			if( $t_length == 0 ) {
1242 				break;
1243 			}
1244 			# Regular expression string validation
1245 			if( !is_blank( $t_valid_regexp ) ) {
1246 				$t_valid &= preg_match( '/' . $t_valid_regexp . '/', $p_value );
1247 			}
1248 			# Check the length of the string
1249 			$t_valid &= ( 0 == $t_length_min ) || ( $t_length >= $t_length_min );
1250 			$t_valid &= ( 0 == $t_length_max ) || ( $t_length <= $t_length_max );
1251 			if( $t_type == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA ) {
1252 				$t_valid &= $t_length <= config_get_global( 'max_textarea_length' );
1253 			}
1254 			break;
1255 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_NUMERIC:
1256 			# Empty fields are valid
1257 			if( $t_length == 0 ) {
1258 				break;
1259 			}
1260 
1261 			# is_numeric() accepts floats, so also check that it is a whole integer
1262 			$t_valid &= is_numeric( $p_value ) && (int)$p_value == (float)$p_value;
1263 
1264 			# Check the length of the number
1265 			$t_valid &= ( 0 == $t_length_min ) || ( $t_length >= $t_length_min );
1266 			$t_valid &= ( 0 == $t_length_max ) || ( $t_length <= $t_length_max );
1267 
1268 			break;
1269 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT:
1270 			# Empty fields are valid
1271 			if( $t_length == 0 ) {
1272 				break;
1273 			}
1274 			# Allow both integer and float numbers
1275 			$t_valid &= is_numeric( $p_value ) || is_float( $p_value );
1276 
1277 			# Check the length of the number
1278 			$t_valid &= ( 0 == $t_length_min ) || ( $t_length >= $t_length_min );
1279 			$t_valid &= ( 0 == $t_length_max ) || ( $t_length <= $t_length_max );
1280 
1281 			break;
1282 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE:
1283 			# gpc_get_cf for date returns the value from strtotime
1284 			# For 32 bit systems, supported range will be 13 Dec 1901 20:45:54 UTC to 19 Jan 2038 03:14:07 UTC
1285 			$t_valid &= $p_value !== false;
1286 			break;
1287 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_CHECKBOX:
1288 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_MULTILIST:
1289 			# Checkbox fields can hold a null value (when no checkboxes are ticked)
1290 			if( $p_value === '' ) {
1291 				break;
1292 			}
1293 			# If checkbox field value is not null then we need to validate it
1294 			$t_values = explode( '|', $p_value );
1295 			$t_possible_values = custom_field_prepare_possible_values( $t_row['possible_values'] );
1296 			$t_possible_values = explode( '|', $t_possible_values );
1297 			$t_invalid_values = array_diff( $t_values, $t_possible_values );
1298 			$t_valid &= ( count( $t_invalid_values ) == 0 );
1299 			break;
1300 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_ENUM:
1301 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_LIST:
1302 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_RADIO:
1303 			# List fields can be empty (when they are not shown on the
1304 			# form, or shown with no default values and never clicked)
1305 			if( is_blank( $p_value ) ) {
1306 				break;
1307 			}
1308 
1309 			# If list field value is not empty then we need to validate it
1310 			$t_possible_values = custom_field_prepare_possible_values( $t_row['possible_values'] );
1311 			$t_values_arr = explode( '|', $t_possible_values );
1312 			$t_valid &= in_array( $p_value, $t_values_arr );
1313 			break;
1314 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_EMAIL:
1315 			if( $p_value !== '' ) {
1316 				$t_valid &= email_is_valid( $p_value );
1317 			}
1318 			break;
1319 		default:
1320 			break;
1321 	}
1322 	return (bool)$t_valid;
1323 }
1324 
1325 /**
1326  * $p_possible_values: possible values to be pre-processed.
1327  *
1328  * If it has enumeration values, it will be left as is.
1329  * If it has a method, it will be replaced by the list.
1330  *
1331  * @param string $p_possible_values Possible values for custom field.
1332  *
1333  * @return string|array
1334  *
1335  * @access public
1336  */
1337 function custom_field_prepare_possible_values( $p_possible_values ) {
1338 	if( !is_blank( $p_possible_values ) && ( $p_possible_values[0] == '=' ) ) {
1339 		return helper_call_custom_function( 'enum_' . mb_substr( $p_possible_values, 1 ), array() );
1340 	}
1341 
1342 	return $p_possible_values;
1343 }
1344 
1345 /**
1346  * Get All Possible Values for a Field.
1347  *
1348  * Optionally, a subset of projects can be specified to get values only appearing in those.
1349  * The values are always those visible to the user, based on view permissions.
1350  *
1351  * @param array     $p_field_def   Custom field definition.
1352  * @param int|array $p_project_id  Project identifier, or array of project ids.
1353  *
1354  * @return bool|array
1355  *
1356  * @access public
1357  */
1358 function custom_field_distinct_values( array $p_field_def, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
1359 	global $g_custom_field_type_definition;
1360 	$t_return_arr = array();
1361 
1362 	# If an enumeration type, we get all possible values, not just used values
1363 	if( isset( $g_custom_field_type_definition[$p_field_def['type']]['#function_return_distinct_values'] ) ) {
1364 		return call_user_func( $g_custom_field_type_definition[$p_field_def['type']]['#function_return_distinct_values'], $p_field_def );
1365 	} else {
1366 		# Get the existing values for the custom field.
1367 		# Only values that are viewable by the user should be retrieved, so we must account for:
1368 		# - View issue permissions: if the issue is private or public
1369 		# - Project level permissions: if a private project is accessible directly, or indirectly
1370 		# - Limit view issues for reporters: if the option is enabled.
1371 		# - Custom field definition for viewing threshold
1372 		# Viewable issues can be resolved by using a filter, which already accounts for those restrictions
1373 		# So here we only need to additionally check for custom field view threshold on each project.
1374 
1375 		# Build a project list where custom fields are viewable by the user.
1376 		if( ALL_PROJECTS == $p_project_id ) {
1377 			$t_project_ids = user_get_all_accessible_projects();
1378 		} elseif( is_array( $p_project_id ) ) {
1379 			$t_project_ids = $p_project_id;
1380 		} else {
1381 			$t_project_ids = array( $p_project_id );
1382 		}
1383 		$t_projects_can_view = access_project_array_filter( (int)$p_field_def['access_level_r'], $t_project_ids );
1384 		if( empty( $t_projects_can_view ) ) {
1385 			return false;
1386 		}
1387 
1388 		# Build a subquery for issues based on a filter
1389 		$t_filter = array(
1390 			FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS => array( META_FILTER_NONE ),
1391 			FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID => $t_projects_can_view,
1392 			'_view_type' => FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED,
1393 		);
1394 		$t_filter = filter_ensure_valid_filter( $t_filter );
1395 
1396 		$t_filter_subquery = new BugFilterQuery( $t_filter, BugFilterQuery::QUERY_TYPE_IDS );
1397 
1398 		# which types need special type cast
1399 		switch( $p_field_def['type'] ) {
1400 				case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT:
1401 					# mysql can't cast to float, use alternative syntax
1402 					$t_select_expr = db_is_mysql() ? 'cfst.value+0.0' : 'CAST(NULLIF(cfst.value,\'\') AS FLOAT)';
1403 					break;
1404 				case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE:
1405 				case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_NUMERIC:
1406 					$t_select_expr = 'CAST(NULLIF(cfst.value,\'\') AS DECIMAL)';
1407 					break;
1408 				default: # no cast needed
1409 					$t_select_expr = 'cfst.value';
1410 		}
1411 
1412 		$t_sql = 'SELECT DISTINCT ' . $t_select_expr . ' AS cast_value'
1413 			. ' FROM {custom_field_string} cfst'
1414 			. ' WHERE cfst.field_id = :cfid AND cfst.bug_id IN :filter'
1415 			. ' ORDER BY cast_value';
1416 		$t_query = new DbQuery( $t_sql );
1417 		$t_query->bind( array( 'filter' => $t_filter_subquery, 'cfid' => (int)$p_field_def['id'] ) );
1418 
1419 		while( $t_query->fetch() ) {
1420 			$t_val = $t_query->field( 'cast_value' );
1421 			if( !is_blank( trim( $t_val ) ) ) {
1422 				$t_return_arr[] = $t_val;
1423 			}
1424 		}
1425 
1426 		if( empty( $t_return_arr ) ) {
1427 			return false;
1428 		}
1429 	}
1430 	return $t_return_arr;
1431 }
1432 
1433 /**
1434  * Convert the value to save it into the database, depending on the type.
1435  *
1436  * @param bool|int|string $p_value Custom field value.
1437  * @param int                $p_type  Custom field type.
1438  *
1439  * @return bool|int|string Value for database storage.
1440  *
1441  * @access public
1442  */
1443 function custom_field_value_to_database( $p_value, $p_type ) {
1444 	global $g_custom_field_type_definition;
1445 
1446 	$t_value = $p_value;
1447 
1448 	if( isset( $g_custom_field_type_definition[$p_type]['#function_value_to_database'] ) ) {
1449 		$t_value = call_user_func( $g_custom_field_type_definition[$p_type]['#function_value_to_database'], $p_value );
1450 	}
1451 
1452 	return $t_value === null ? '' : $t_value;
1453 }

1495 /**
1496  * Set the value of a custom field for a given bug.
1497  *
1498  * @param int   $p_field_id   Custom field identifier.
1499  * @param int   $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
1500  * @param mixed $p_value      New custom field value.
1501  * @param bool  $p_log_insert Create history logs for new values.
1502  *
1503  * @return bool True on success, false on failure
1504  *
1505  * @access public
1506  */
1507 function custom_field_set_value( $p_field_id, $p_bug_id, $p_value, $p_log_insert = true ) {
1508 	custom_field_ensure_exists( $p_field_id );
1509 
1510 	if( !custom_field_validate( $p_field_id, $p_value ) ) {
1511 		return false;
1512 	}
1513 
1514 	$t_name = custom_field_get_field( $p_field_id, 'name' );
1515 	$t_type = custom_field_get_field( $p_field_id, 'type' );
1516 
1517 	$t_value_field = ( $t_type == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA ) ? 'text' : 'value';
1518 	$t_value = custom_field_value_to_database( $p_value, $t_type );
1519 
1520 	# Determine whether an existing value needs to be updated or a new value inserted
1521 	db_param_push();
1522 	$t_query = 'SELECT ' . $t_value_field . '
1523 				  FROM {custom_field_string}
1524 				  WHERE field_id=' . db_param() . ' AND
1525 				  		bug_id=' . db_param();
1526 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_field_id, $p_bug_id ) );
1527 
1528 	db_param_push();
1529 	if( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1530 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {custom_field_string}
1531 					  SET ' . $t_value_field . '=' . db_param() . '
1532 					  WHERE field_id=' . db_param() . ' AND
1533 					  		bug_id=' . db_param();
1534 		$t_params = array(
1535 			$t_value,
1536 			(int)$p_field_id,
1537 			(int)$p_bug_id,
1538 		);
1539 		db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
1540 
1541 		history_log_event_direct( $p_bug_id, $t_name, custom_field_database_to_value( $t_row[$t_value_field], $t_type ), $t_value );
1542 	} else {
1543 		$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {custom_field_string}
1544 						( field_id, bug_id, ' . $t_value_field . ' )
1545 					  VALUES
1546 						( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ')';
1547 		$t_params = array(
1548 			(int)$p_field_id,
1549 			(int)$p_bug_id,
1550 			$t_value,
1551 		);
1552 		db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
1553 		# Don't log history events for new bug reports or on other special occasions
1554 		if( $p_log_insert ) {
1555 			history_log_event_direct( $p_bug_id, $t_name, '', $t_value );
1556 		}
1557 	}
1558 
1559 	custom_field_clear_cache_values( $p_bug_id );
1560 
1561 	# db_query() errors on failure so:
1562 	return true;
1563 }
1564 
1565 /**
1566  * Sets the custom field's sequence number for the specified project.
1567  *
1568  * @param int $p_field_id   A custom field identifier.
1569  * @param int $p_project_id A Project identifier.
1570  * @param int $p_sequence   Sequence order.

1576 function custom_field_set_sequence( $p_field_id, $p_project_id, $p_sequence ) {
1577 	db_param_push();
1578 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {custom_field_project}
1579 				  SET sequence=' . db_param() . '
1580 				  WHERE field_id=' . db_param() . ' AND
1581 				  		project_id=' . db_param();
1582 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_sequence, $p_field_id, $p_project_id ) );
1583 
1584 	custom_field_clear_cache( $p_field_id );
1585 
1586 	return true;

1589 /**
1590  * Print an input field.
1591  *
1592  * $p_bug_id    contains the bug
1593  * NOTE: This probably belongs in the print_api.php
1594  *
1595  * @param array $p_field_def Custom field definition (including its field id).
1596  * @param int   $p_bug_id    Id of the bug this field belongs to. If not specified,
1597  *                           it will default to 0 and thus belong to a new
1598  *                           (i.e. non-existent) bug.
1599  * @param bool  $p_required  True if the field is required for form submission.
1600  *
1601  * @return void
1602  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist
1603  *
1604  * @access public
1605  */
1606 function print_custom_field_input( array $p_field_def, $p_bug_id = null, $p_required = false ) {
1607 	if( null === $p_bug_id ) {
1608 		$t_custom_field_value = custom_field_default_to_value( $p_field_def['default_value'], $p_field_def['type'] );
1609 	} else {
1610 		$t_custom_field_value = custom_field_get_value( $p_field_def['id'], $p_bug_id );
1611 		# If the custom field value is undefined, and either the field cannot hold a null value
1612 		# or the field is a date and is required, then use the default value instead
1613 		if( $t_custom_field_value === null &&
1614 			( $p_field_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_ENUM ||
1615 				$p_field_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_LIST ||
1616 				$p_field_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_MULTILIST ||
1617 				$p_field_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_RADIO ||
1618 				( $p_field_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE &&
1619 				  $p_required ) ) ) {
1620 			$t_custom_field_value = custom_field_default_to_value( $p_field_def['default_value'], $p_field_def['type'] );
1621 		}
1622 	}
1623 
1624 	global $g_custom_field_type_definition;
1625 	if( isset( $g_custom_field_type_definition[$p_field_def['type']]['#function_print_input'] ) ) {
1626 		call_user_func( $g_custom_field_type_definition[$p_field_def['type']]['#function_print_input'], $p_field_def,
1627 			$t_custom_field_value, $p_required ? ' required ' : '' );
1628 		print_hidden_input( custom_field_presence_field_name( $p_field_def['id'] ), '1' );
1629 	} else {
1630 		trigger_error( ERROR_CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_DEFINITION, ERROR );
1631 	}
1632 }

1634 /**
1635  * Returns a valid CSS identifier for the given custom field.
1636  *
1637  * The string is built based on the custom field's name, replacing any potentially
1638  * unsupported character(s) by dashes `-` to ensure its validity. The resulting
1639  * identifier can be used as part of a custom CSS class.
1640  *
1641  * @param string $p_custom_field_name The custom field's name
1642  *
1643  * @return string The CSS identifier
1644  */
1645 function custom_field_css_name( $p_custom_field_name ) {
1646     return 'custom-' . preg_replace( '/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/', '-', $p_custom_field_name );
1647 }

1751  *
1752  * @return bool True, if non-empty values exist
1753  */
1754 function custom_field_has_data( $p_field_id ) {
1755 	db_param_push();
1756 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {custom_field_string}'
1757 			. ' WHERE field_id=' . db_param()
1758 			. ' AND value<>\'\'';
1759 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_field_id ) );
1760 	$t_count = db_result( $t_result );
1761 
1762 	return $t_count > 0;

  63 /**
  64  * Custom Function API
  65  * Checks the provided bug and determines whether it should be included in the changelog or not.
  66  * returns true: to include, false: to exclude.
  67  *
  68  * @param integer $p_issue_id Issue id.
  69  * @return boolean
  70  */
  71 function custom_function_default_changelog_include_issue( $p_issue_id ) {
  72 	$t_issue = bug_get( $p_issue_id );
  73 
  74 	return( ( $t_issue->resolution >= config_get( 'bug_resolution_fixed_threshold' ) &&
  75 		$t_issue->resolution < config_get( 'bug_resolution_not_fixed_threshold' ) &&
  76 		$t_issue->status >= config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold' ) ) );
  77 }
  78 
  79 /**
  80  * Prints one entry in the changelog.
  81  *
  82  * @param integer $p_issue_id    Issue id.
  83  * @param integer $p_issue_level Issue level.
  84  * @return void
  85  */
  86 function custom_function_default_changelog_print_issue( $p_issue_id, $p_issue_level = 0 ) {
  87 	static $s_status;
  88 
  89 	$t_bug = bug_get( $p_issue_id );
  90 	$t_current_user = auth_get_current_user_id();
  91 
  92 	if( $t_bug->category_id ) {
  93 		$t_category_name = category_get_name( $t_bug->category_id );
  94 	} else {
  95 		$t_category_name = '';
  96 	}
  97 
  98 	$t_category = is_blank( $t_category_name ) ? '' : '<strong>[' . string_display_line( $t_category_name ) . ']</strong> ';
  99 
 100 	if( !isset( $s_status[$t_bug->status] ) ) {
 101 		$s_status[$t_bug->status] = get_enum_element( 'status', $t_bug->status, $t_current_user, $t_bug->project_id );
 102 	}
 103 
 104 	# choose color based on status
 105 	$t_status_css = html_get_status_css_fg( $t_bug->status, $t_current_user, $t_bug->project_id );
 106 	$t_status_title = string_attribute( get_enum_element( 'status', bug_get_field( $t_bug->id, 'status' ), $t_bug->project_id ) );
 107 
 108 	echo utf8_str_pad( '', $p_issue_level * 36, '&#160;' );
 109 	print_icon( 'fa-square', 'fa-status-box ' . $t_status_css, $t_status_title );
 110 	echo ' ' . string_get_bug_view_link( $p_issue_id, false );
 111 	echo ': <span class="label label-light">', $t_category, '</span> ' , string_display_line_links( $t_bug->summary );
 112 	if( $t_bug->handler_id > 0
 113 			&& ON == config_get( 'show_assigned_names', null, $t_current_user, $t_bug->project_id )
 114 			&& access_can_see_handler_for_bug( $t_bug ) ) {
 115 		echo ' (', prepare_user_name( $t_bug->handler_id ), ')';
 116 	}
 117 }

 158 	if( !isset( $s_status[$t_bug->status] ) ) {

 161

 177 /**
 178  * format the bug summary.
 179  *
 180  * @param integer $p_issue_id Issue id.
 181  * @param integer $p_context  Context SUMMARY_CAPTION | SUMMARY_FIELD | SUMMARY_EMAIL.
 182  * @return string
 183  */
 184 function custom_function_default_format_issue_summary( $p_issue_id, $p_context = 0 ) {
 185 	switch( $p_context ) {
 186 		case SUMMARY_CAPTION:
 187 			$t_string = bug_format_id( $p_issue_id ) . ': ' . string_attribute( bug_get_field( $p_issue_id, 'summary' ) );
 188 			break;
 189 		case SUMMARY_FIELD:
 190 			$t_string = bug_format_id( $p_issue_id ) . ': ' . string_display_line_links( bug_get_field( $p_issue_id, 'summary' ) );
 191 			break;
 192 		case SUMMARY_EMAIL:
 193 			$t_string = bug_format_id( $p_issue_id ) . ': ' . string_attribute( bug_get_field( $p_issue_id, 'summary' ) );
 194 			break;
 195 		default:
 196 			$t_string = string_attribute( bug_get_field( $p_issue_id, 'summary' ) );
 197 			break;
 198 	}
 199 	return $t_string;
 200 }

 286 /**
 287  * returns an array of the column names to be displayed.
 288  * The column names to use are those of the field names in the bug table.
 289  * In addition, you can use the following:
 290  * - "selection" for selection checkboxes.
 291  * - "edit" for icon to open the edit page.
 292  * - "custom_xxxx" were xxxx is the name of the custom field that is valid for the
 293  *   current project.  In case of "All Projects, the field will be empty where it is
 294  *   not applicable.
 295  *
 296  * @param integer $p_columns_target See COLUMNS_TARGET_* in constant_inc.php.
 297  * @param integer $p_user_id        The user id or null for current logged in user.
 298  * @return array
 299  */
 300 function custom_function_default_get_columns_to_view( $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE, $p_user_id = null ) {
 301 	$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 302 
 303 	if( $p_columns_target == COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE ) {
 304 		$t_columns = config_get( 'csv_columns', '', $p_user_id, $t_project_id );
 305 	} else if( $p_columns_target == COLUMNS_TARGET_EXCEL_PAGE ) {
 306 		$t_columns = config_get( 'excel_columns', '', $p_user_id, $t_project_id );
 307 	} else if( $p_columns_target == COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE ) {
 308 		$t_columns = config_get( 'view_issues_page_columns', '', $p_user_id, $t_project_id );
 309 	} else {
 310 		$t_columns = config_get( 'print_issues_page_columns', '', $p_user_id, $t_project_id );
 311 	}
 312 
 313 	$t_columns = columns_remove_invalid( $t_columns, columns_get_all( $t_project_id ) );
 314 
 315 	return $t_columns;
 316 }

 318 /**
 319  * Print the title of a column given its name.
 320  *
 321  * @global string $t_sort           (deprecated) main sort column in use from filter
 322  * @global string $t_dir            (deprecated) main sort dir in use from filter
 323  * @param string  $p_column         Custom_xxx for custom field xxx, or otherwise field name as in bug table.
 324  * @param integer $p_columns_target See COLUMNS_TARGET_* in constant_inc.php.
 325  * @param array $p_sort_properties  Array of filter sortin gproeprties, in the format returned from filter_get_visible_sort_properties_array()
 326  *
 327  * @return void
 328  */
 329 function custom_function_default_print_column_title( $p_column, $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE, array $p_sort_properties = [] ) {
 330 	global $t_sort, $t_dir;
 331 
 332 	# if no sort properties are provided, resort to deprecated golbal vars, to keep compatibility
 333 	if( empty( $p_sort_properties ) ) {
 334 		$t_main_sort_column = $t_sort;
 335 		$t_main_sort_dir = $t_dir;
 336 	} else {
 337 		# we use only the first ordered column
 338 		$t_main_sort_column = reset( $p_sort_properties[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME] );
 339 		$t_main_sort_dir = reset( $p_sort_properties[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION] );
 340 	}
 341 
 342 	$t_custom_field = column_get_custom_field_name( $p_column );
 343 	if( $t_custom_field !== null ) {
 344 		if( COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE != $p_columns_target ) {
 345 			echo '<th class="column-' . custom_field_css_name( $t_custom_field ) . '">';
 346 		}
 347 
 348 		$t_field_id = custom_field_get_id_from_name( $t_custom_field );
 349 		if( $t_field_id === false ) {
 350 			echo '@', $t_custom_field, '@';
 351 		} else {
 352 			$t_def = custom_field_get_definition( $t_field_id );
 353 			$t_custom_field = lang_get_defaulted( $t_def['name'] );
 354 
 355 			if( COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE != $p_columns_target ) {
 356 				print_view_bug_sort_link( $t_custom_field, $p_column, $t_main_sort_column, $t_main_sort_dir, $p_columns_target );
 357 				if( $p_column == $t_main_sort_column ) {
 358 					print_sort_icon( $t_main_sort_dir, $t_main_sort_column, $p_column );
 359 				}
 360 			} else {
 361 				echo $t_custom_field;
 362 			}
 363 		}
 364 
 365 		if( COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE != $p_columns_target ) {
 366 			echo '</th>';
 367 		}
 368 	} else {
 369 		$t_plugin_columns = columns_get_plugin_columns();
 370 
 371 		$t_function = 'print_column_title_' . $p_column;
 372 		if( function_exists( $t_function ) ) {
 373 			$t_function( $t_main_sort_column, $t_main_sort_dir, $p_columns_target );
 374 
 375 		} else if( isset( $t_plugin_columns[$p_column] ) ) {
 376 			$t_column_object = $t_plugin_columns[$p_column];
 377 			print_column_title_plugin( $p_column, $t_column_object, $t_main_sort_column, $t_main_sort_dir, $p_columns_target );
 378 
 379 		} else {
 380 			echo '<th>';
 381 			print_view_bug_sort_link( column_get_title( $p_column ), $p_column, $t_main_sort_column, $t_main_sort_dir, $p_columns_target );
 382 			print_sort_icon( $t_main_sort_dir, $t_main_sort_column, $p_column );
 383 			echo '</th>';
 384 		}
 385 	}
 386 }

 388 /**
 389  * Print the value of the custom field (if the field is applicable to the project of
 390  * the specified issue and the current user has read access to it.
 391  * see custom_function_default_print_column_title() for rules about column names.
 392  * @param string  $p_column         Name of field to show in the column.
 393  * @param BugData $p_bug            Bug object.
 394  * @param integer $p_columns_target See COLUMNS_TARGET_* in constant_inc.php.
 395  * @return void
 396  */
 397 function custom_function_default_print_column_value( $p_column, BugData $p_bug, $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE ) {
 398 	if( COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE == $p_columns_target ) {
 399 		$t_column_start = '';
 400 		$t_column_end = '';
 401 		$t_column_empty = '';
 402 	} else {
 403 		$t_column_start = '<td class="column-%s">';
 404 		$t_column_end = '</td>';
 405 		$t_column_empty = '&#160;';
 406 	}
 407 
 408 	$t_custom_field = column_get_custom_field_name( $p_column );
 409 	if( $t_custom_field !== null ) {
 410 		$t_class = custom_field_css_name( $t_custom_field );
 411 		$t_field_id = custom_field_get_id_from_name( $t_custom_field );
 412 
 413 		if( $t_field_id === false ) {
 414 			$t_value = '@' . $t_custom_field . '@';
 415 			$t_is_linked = false;
 416 		} else {
 417 			$t_issue_id = $p_bug->id;
 418 			$t_project_id = $p_bug->project_id;
 419 			$t_is_linked = custom_field_is_linked( $t_field_id, $t_project_id );
 420 
 421 			if( $t_is_linked ) {
 422 				$t_value = false;
 423 				$t_def = custom_field_get_definition( $t_field_id );
 424 
 425 				# Build a map of CF types to corresponding label
 426 				static $s_cf_types;
 427 				if( $s_cf_types === null ) {
 428 					$s_cf_types = MantisEnum::getAssocArrayIndexedByValues(
 429 						config_get( 'custom_field_type_enum_string' )
 430 					);
 431 					# Make sure the type's label is a valid CSS identifier
 432 					array_walk( $s_cf_types,
 433 						function( &$t_val ) {
 434 							$t_val = preg_replace( '/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/', '-', $t_val );
 435 						}
 436 					);
 437 				}
 438 				# Add CF type CSS class
 439 				$t_class .= ' cftype-' . $s_cf_types[$t_def['type']];
 440 			} else {
 441 				# field is not linked to project
 442 				$t_value = $t_column_empty;
 443 			}
 444 		}
 445 
 446 		printf( $t_column_start, $t_class );
 447 		if( $t_is_linked ) {
 448 			/** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
 449 			print_custom_field_value( $t_def, $t_field_id, $t_issue_id );
 450 		} else {
 451 			echo $t_value;
 452 		}
 453 		echo $t_column_end;
 454 	} else {
 455 		$t_plugin_columns = columns_get_plugin_columns();
 456 
 457 		if( $p_columns_target != COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE ) {
 458 			$t_function = 'print_column_' . $p_column;
 459 		} else {
 460 			$t_function = 'csv_format_' . $p_column;
 461 		}
 462 
 463 		if( function_exists( $t_function ) ) {
 464 			if( $p_columns_target != COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE ) {
 465 				$t_function( $p_bug, $p_columns_target );
 466 			} else {
 467 				$t_function( $p_bug );
 468 			}
 469 
 470 		} else if( isset( $t_plugin_columns[$p_column] ) ) {
 471 			$t_column_object = $t_plugin_columns[$p_column];
 472 			print_column_plugin( $t_column_object, $p_bug, $p_columns_target );
 473 
 474 		} else {
 475 			printf( $t_column_start, $p_column );
 476 			if( isset( $p_bug->$p_column ) ) {
 477 				echo string_display_line( $p_bug->$p_column ) . $t_column_end;
 478 			} else {
 479 				echo '@' . $p_column . '@' . $t_column_end;
 480 			}
 481 		}
 482 	}
 483 }

 485 /**
 486  * Construct an enumeration for all versions for the current project.
 487  * The enumeration will be empty if current project is ALL PROJECTS.
 488  * Enumerations format is: "abc|lmn|xyz"
 489  * To use this in a custom field type "=versions" in the possible values field.
 490  * @return string
 491  */
 492 function custom_function_default_enum_versions() {
 493 	$t_versions = version_get_all_rows( helper_get_current_project() );
 494 
 495 	$t_enum = array();
 496 	foreach( $t_versions as $t_version ) {
 497 		$t_enum[] = $t_version['version'];
 498 	}
 499 
 500 	$t_possible_values = implode( '|', $t_enum );
 501 
 502 	return $t_possible_values;
 503 }

  26  * @uses config_api.php

  28  * @uses error_api.php
  29  * @uses logging_api.php
  30  * @uses utility_api.php
  31  * @uses adodb/adodb.inc.php

  34 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  35 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  36 require_api( 'error_api.php' );
  37 require_api( 'logging_api.php' );

  40 /**
  41  * Main database connection.
  42  * @var ADOConnection $g_db
  43  */
  44 $g_db = false;
  45 
  46 # An array in which all executed queries are stored.  This is used for profiling
  47 # @global array $g_queries_array
  48 $g_queries_array = array();
  49 
  50 # Stores whether a database connection was successfully opened.
  51 # @global bool $g_db_connected
  52 $g_db_connected = false;
  53 
  54 # Store whether to log queries ( used for show_queries_count/query list)
  55 # @global bool $g_db_log_queries
  56 $g_db_log_queries = ( 0 != ( config_get_global( 'log_level' ) & LOG_DATABASE ) );
  57 
  58 # set adodb to associative fetch mode with lowercase column names
  59 # @global bool $ADODB_FETCH_MODE
  60 global $ADODB_FETCH_MODE;
  61 $ADODB_FETCH_MODE = ADODB_FETCH_ASSOC;
  62 define( 'ADODB_ASSOC_CASE', ADODB_ASSOC_CASE_LOWER );
  63 
  64 # Stores the functional database type based on db driver
  65 $g_db_functional_type = db_get_type( config_get_global( 'db_type' ) );
  66 
  67 /**
  68  * Mantis Database Parameters Count class
  69  * Stores the current parameter count, provides method to generate parameters
  70  * and a simple stack mechanism to enable the caller to build multiple queries
  71  * concurrently on RDBMS using positional parameters (e.g. PostgreSQL)
  72  */
  73 class MantisDbParam {
  74 	/**
  75 	 * Current parameter count
  76 	 */
  77 	public $count = 0;
  78 
  79 	/**
  80 	 * Parameter count stack
  81 	 */
  82 	private $stack = array();
  83 
  84 	/**
  85 	 * Generate a string to insert a parameter into a database query string
  86 	 * @return string 'wildcard' matching a parameter in correct ordered format for the current database.
  87 	 */
  88 	public function assign() {
  89 		global $g_db;
  90 		return $g_db->Param( $this->count++ );
  91 	}
  92 
  93 	/**
  94 	 * Pushes current parameter count onto stack and resets its value to 0
  95 	 * @return void
  96 	 */
  97 	public function push() {
  98 		$this->stack[] = $this->count;
  99 		$this->count = 0;
 100 	}
 101 
 102 	/**
 103 	 * Pops the previous value of param count from the stack
 104 	 * This function is called by {@see db_query()} and should not need
 105 	 * to be executed directly
 106 	 * @return void
 107 	 */
 108 	public function pop() {
 109 		global $g_db;
 110 
 111 		$this->count = (int)array_pop( $this->stack );
 112 		if( db_is_pgsql() ) {
 113 			# Manually reset the ADOdb param number to the value we just popped
 114 			$g_db->_pnum = $this->count;
 115 		}
 116 	}
 117 }

 119 # Tracks the query parameter count
 120 # @global object $g_db_param
 121 $g_db_param = new MantisDbParam();

 123 /**
 124  * Open a connection to the database.
 125  * @param string  $p_dsn           Database connection string ( specified instead of other params).
 126  * @param string  $p_hostname      Database server hostname.
 127  * @param string  $p_username      Database server username.
 128  * @param string  $p_password      Database server password.
 129  * @param string  $p_database_name Database name.
 130  * @param boolean $p_pconnect      Use a Persistent connection to database.
 131  * @return boolean indicating if the connection was successful
 132  */
 133 function db_connect( $p_dsn, $p_hostname = null, $p_username = null, $p_password = null, $p_database_name = null, $p_pconnect = false ) {
 134 	global $g_db_connected, $g_db, $g_db_functional_type;
 135 	$t_db_type = config_get_global( 'db_type' );
 136 	$g_db_functional_type = db_get_type( $t_db_type );
 137 
 138 	if( $g_db_functional_type == DB_TYPE_UNDEFINED ) {
 139 		error_parameters( 0, 'Database type is not supported by MantisBT, check $g_db_type in config_inc.php' );
 140 		trigger_error( ERROR_DB_CONNECT_FAILED, ERROR );
 141 	}
 142 
 143 	if( !db_check_database_support( $t_db_type ) ) {
 144 		error_parameters( 0, 'PHP Support for database is not enabled' );
 145 		trigger_error( ERROR_DB_CONNECT_FAILED, ERROR );
 146 	}
 147 
 148 	if( empty( $p_dsn ) ) {
 149 		$g_db = ADONewConnection( $t_db_type );
 150 
 151 		if( $p_pconnect ) {
 152 			$t_result = $g_db->PConnect( $p_hostname, $p_username, $p_password, $p_database_name );
 153 		} else {
 154 			$t_result = $g_db->Connect( $p_hostname, $p_username, $p_password, $p_database_name );
 155 		}
 156 	} else {
 157 		$g_db = ADONewConnection( $p_dsn );
 158 		$t_result = $g_db->IsConnected();
 159 	}
 160 
 161 	if( $t_result ) {
 162 		# For MySQL, the charset for the connection needs to be specified.
 163 		if( db_is_mysql() ) {
 164 			# @todo Is there a way to translate any charset name to MySQL format? e.g. remote the dashes?
 165 			# @todo Is this needed for other databases?
 166 			db_query( 'SET NAMES UTF8' );
 167 		}
 168 	} else {
 169 		db_error();
 170 		trigger_error( ERROR_DB_CONNECT_FAILED, ERROR );
 171 		return false;
 172 	}
 173 
 174 	$g_db_connected = true;
 175 
 176 	return true;
 177 }
 178 
 179 /**
 180  * Returns whether a connection to the database exists
 181  * @global $g_db_connected stores database connection state
 182  * @return boolean indicating if the a database connection has been made

 190 /**
 191  * Returns whether php support for a database is enabled
 192  * @param string $p_db_type Database type.
 193  * @return boolean indicating if php current supports the given database type
 194  */
 195 function db_check_database_support( $p_db_type ) {
 196 	switch( $p_db_type ) {
 197 		case 'mysqli':
 198 			$t_support = function_exists( 'mysqli_connect' );
 199 			break;
 200 		case 'pgsql':
 201 			$t_support = function_exists( 'pg_connect' );
 202 			break;
 203 		case 'mssqlnative':
 204 			$t_support = function_exists( 'sqlsrv_connect' );
 205 			break;
 206 		case 'oci8':
 207 			$t_support = function_exists( 'OCILogon' );
 208 			break;
 209 		case 'odbc_mssql':
 210 			$t_support = function_exists( 'odbc_connect' );
 211 			break;
 212 		default:
 213 			$t_support = false;
 214 	}
 215 	return $t_support;
 216 }

 316 function db_query( string $p_query, array $p_params = [], int $p_limit = -1, int $p_offset = -1, bool $p_pop_param = true ) {
 317 	# Use DbQuery class to execute the query
 318 	return DbQuery::compat_db_query( $p_query, $p_params, $p_limit, $p_offset, $p_pop_param );

 373 /**
 374  * Retrieve the next row returned from a specific database query
 375  * @param IteratorAggregate &$p_result Database Query Record Set to retrieve next result for.
 376  * @return array|false Database result or false if
 377  */
 378 function db_fetch_array( IteratorAggregate &$p_result ) {
 379 	global $g_db_functional_type;
 380 
 381 	if( $p_result->EOF ) {
 382 		return false;
 383 	}
 384 
 385 	# Retrieve the fields from the recordset
 386 	$t_row = $p_result->fields;
 387 
 388 	# Additional handling for specific RDBMS
 389 	switch( $g_db_functional_type ) {
 390 
 391 		case DB_TYPE_PGSQL:
 392 			# pgsql's boolean fields are stored as 't' or 'f' and must be converted
 393 			static $s_current_result = null, $s_convert_needed;
 394 
 395 			if( $s_current_result != $p_result ) {
 396 				# Processing a new query
 397 				$s_current_result = $p_result;
 398 				$s_convert_needed = false;
 399 			} elseif( !$s_convert_needed ) {
 400 				# No conversion needed, return the row as-is
 401 				$p_result->MoveNext();
 402 				return $t_row;
 403 			}
 404 
 405 			foreach( $p_result->FieldTypesArray() as $t_field ) {
 406 				switch( $t_field->type ) {
 407 					case 'bool':
 408 						switch( $t_row[$t_field->name] ) {
 409 							case 'f':
 410 								$t_row[$t_field->name] = false;
 411 								break;
 412 							case 't':
 413 								$t_row[$t_field->name] = true;
 414 								break;
 415 						}
 416 						$s_convert_needed = true;
 417 						break;
 418 				}
 419 			}
 420 			break;
 421 
 422 		case DB_TYPE_ORACLE:
 423 			# oci8 returns null values for empty strings, convert them back
 424 			foreach( $t_row as &$t_value ) {
 425 				if( !isset( $t_value ) ) {
 426 					$t_value = '';
 427 				}
 428 			}
 429 			break;
 430 	}
 431 
 432 	$p_result->MoveNext();
 433 	return $t_row;
 434 }
 435 
 436 /**
 437  * Retrieve a specific field from a database query result
 438  * @param boolean|IteratorAggregate $p_result		Database Query Record Set to retrieve the field from.
 439  * @param integer                   $p_row_index	Row to retrieve, zero-based (optional).
 440  * @param integer                   $p_col_index	Column to retrieve, zero-based (optional).
 441  * @return mixed Database result
 442  */
 443 function db_result( $p_result, $p_row_index = 0, $p_col_index = 0 ) {
 444 	if( $p_result && ( db_num_rows( $p_result ) > 0 ) ) {
 445 		$p_result->Move( $p_row_index );
 446 		$t_row = db_fetch_array( $p_result );
 447 
 448 		# Make the array numerically indexed. This is required to retrieve the
 449 		# column ($p_index2), since we use ADODB_FETCH_ASSOC fetch mode.
 450 		$t_result = array_values( $t_row );
 451 
 452 		return $t_result[$p_col_index];
 453 	}
 454 
 455 	return false;
 456 }

 458 /**
 459  * Return the last inserted ID after a insert statement.
 460  * Warning: this function must be used immediately after the insert statement
 461  *
 462  * This relies on ADOdb to get the entity id when this functionality is available
 463  * for the specific driver, and it makes sense in our model.
 464  * Natively supported:
 465  * - mysqli, using: mysqli_insert_id(connection).
 466  * - mssqlnative, using SCOPE_IDENTITY().
 467  * Not natively supported:
 468  * - pgsql, oracle, using the underlying sequence for the table.
 469  *
 470  * Since the table is needed for those drivers where a sequence is used, the
 471  * $p_table parameter is mandatory to ensure portability.
 472  * Warning: $p_table is not expected to be a different table than the one used
 473  * for the previous insert. Note that it's not even used by some drivers.
 474  *
 475  * @param string $p_table A valid database table name.
 476  * @param string $p_field A valid field name (default 'id').
 477  * @return integer last successful insert id
 478  */
 479 function db_insert_id( $p_table, $p_field = 'id' ) {
 480 	global $g_db, $g_db_functional_type;
 481 
 482 	switch( $g_db_functional_type ) {
 483 			case DB_TYPE_ORACLE:
 484 				$t_query = 'SELECT seq_' . $p_table . '.CURRVAL FROM DUAL';
 485 				break;
 486 			case DB_TYPE_PGSQL:
 487 				$t_query = 'SELECT currval(\'' . $p_table . '_' . $p_field . '_seq\')';
 488 				break;
 489 			default:
 490 				return $g_db->Insert_ID();
 491 	}
 492 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 493 	return (int)db_result( $t_result );
 494 }

 496 /**
 497  * Check if the specified table exists.
 498  * @param string $p_table_name A valid database table name.
 499  * @return boolean indicating whether the table exists
 500  */
 501 function db_table_exists( $p_table_name ) {
 502 	if( is_blank( $p_table_name ) ) {
 503 		return false;
 504 	}
 505 
 506 	$t_tables = db_get_table_list();
 507 	if( !is_array( $t_tables ) ) {
 508 		return false;
 509 	}
 510 
 511 	# Can't use in_array() since it is case sensitive
 512 	$t_table_name = mb_strtolower( $p_table_name );
 513 	foreach( $t_tables as $t_current_table ) {
 514 		if( mb_strtolower( $t_current_table ) == $t_table_name ) {
 515 			return true;
 516 		}
 517 	}
 518 
 519 	return false;
 520 }
 521 
 522 /**
 523  * Check if the specified table index exists.
 524  * @param string $p_table_name A valid database table name.
 525  * @param string $p_index_name A valid database index name.
 526  * @return boolean indicating whether the index exists
 527  */
 528 function db_index_exists( $p_table_name, $p_index_name ) {
 529 	global $g_db;
 530 
 531 	if( is_blank( $p_index_name ) || is_blank( $p_table_name ) ) {
 532 		return false;
 533 	}
 534 
 535 	$t_indexes = $g_db->MetaIndexes( $p_table_name );
 536 	if( $t_indexes === false ) {
 537 		# no index found
 538 		return false;
 539 	}
 540 
 541 	if( !empty( $t_indexes ) ) {
 542 		# Can't use in_array() since it is case sensitive
 543 		$t_index_name = mb_strtolower( $p_index_name );
 544 		foreach( $t_indexes as $t_current_index_name => $t_current_index_obj ) {
 545 			if( mb_strtolower( $t_current_index_name ) == $t_index_name ) {
 546 				return true;
 547 			}
 548 		}
 549 	}
 550 	return false;
 551 }

 553 /**
 554  * Check if the specified field exists in a given table
 555  * @param string $p_field_name A database field name.
 556  * @param string $p_table_name A valid database table name.
 557  * @return boolean indicating whether the field exists
 558  */
 559 function db_field_exists( $p_field_name, $p_table_name ) {
 560 	$t_columns = db_field_names( $p_table_name );
 561 
 562 	# ADOdb oci8 driver works with uppercase column names, and as of 5.19 does
 563 	# not provide a way to force them to lowercase
 564 	if( db_is_oracle() ) {
 565 		$p_field_name = strtoupper( $p_field_name );
 566 	}
 567 
 568 	return in_array( $p_field_name, $t_columns );
 569 }

 630 /**
 631  * Prepare a binary string before DB insertion
 632  * Use of this function is required for some DB types, to properly encode
 633  * BLOB fields prior to calling db_query()
 634  * @param string $p_string Raw binary data.
 635  * @return string prepared database query string
 636  */
 637 function db_prepare_binary_string( $p_string ) {
 638 	global $g_db;
 639 	$t_db_type = config_get_global( 'db_type' );
 640 
 641 	switch( $t_db_type ) {
 642 		case 'odbc_mssql':
 643 			$t_content = unpack( 'H*hex', $p_string );
 644 			return '0x' . $t_content['hex'];
 645 		case 'pgsql':
 646 			return $g_db->BlobEncode( $p_string );
 647 		case 'mssqlnative':
 648 		case 'oci8':
 649 			# Fall through, mssqlnative, oci8 store raw data in BLOB
 650 		default:
 651 			return $p_string;
 652 	}
 653 }

 710 /**
 711  * A helper function that generates a case-sensitive or case-insensitive like phrase based on the current db type.
 712  * The field name and value are assumed to be safe to insert in a query (i.e. already cleaned).
 713  * @param string  $p_field_name     The name of the field to filter on.
 714  * @param boolean $p_case_sensitive True: case sensitive, false: case insensitive.
 715  * @return string returns (field LIKE 'value') OR (field ILIKE 'value')
 716  */
 717 function db_helper_like( $p_field_name, $p_case_sensitive = false ) {
 718 	$t_like_keyword = ' LIKE ';
 719 
 720 	if( $p_case_sensitive === false ) {
 721 		if( db_is_pgsql() ) {
 722 			$t_like_keyword = ' ILIKE ';
 723 		}
 724 	}
 725 
 726 	return '(' . $p_field_name . $t_like_keyword . db_param() . ')';
 727 }

 729 /**
 730  * Compare two dates against a certain number of days
 731  * 'val_or_col' parameters will be used "as is" in the query component,
 732  * allowing use of a column name. To compare against a specific date,
 733  * it is recommended to pass db_param() instead of a date constant.
 734  * @param string  $p_val_or_col_1 Value or Column to compare.
 735  * @param string  $p_operator     SQL comparison operator.
 736  * @param string  $p_val_or_col_2 Value or Column to compare.
 737  * @param integer $p_num_secs     Number of seconds to compare against
 738  * @return string Database query component to compare dates
 739  * @todo Check if there is a way to do that using ADODB rather than implementing it here.
 740  */
 741 function db_helper_compare_time( $p_val_or_col_1, $p_operator, $p_val_or_col_2, $p_num_secs ) {
 742 	if( $p_num_secs == 0 ) {
 743 		return "($p_val_or_col_1 $p_operator $p_val_or_col_2)";
 744 	} elseif( $p_num_secs > 0 ) {
 745 		return "($p_val_or_col_1 $p_operator $p_val_or_col_2 + $p_num_secs)";
 746 	} else {
 747 		# Invert comparison to avoid issues with unsigned integers on MySQL
 748 		return "($p_val_or_col_1 - $p_num_secs $p_operator $p_val_or_col_2)";
 749 	}
 750 }

 762 /**
 763  * count unique queries
 764  * @return integer
 765  */
 766 function db_count_unique_queries() {
 767 	global $g_queries_array;
 768 
 769 	$t_unique_queries = 0;
 770 	$t_shown_queries = array();
 771 	foreach( $g_queries_array as $t_val_array ) {
 772 		if( !in_array( $t_val_array[0], $t_shown_queries ) ) {
 773 			$t_unique_queries++;
 774 			array_push( $t_shown_queries, $t_val_array[0] );
 775 		}
 776 	}
 777 	return $t_unique_queries;
 778 }

 780 /**
 781  * get total time for queries
 782  * @return integer
 783  */
 784 function db_time_queries() {
 785 	global $g_queries_array;
 786 	$t_count = count( $g_queries_array );
 787 	$t_total = 0;
 788 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_count;$i++ ) {
 789 		$t_total += $g_queries_array[$i][1];
 790 	}
 791 	return $t_total;
 792 }

 794 /**
 795  * get database table name
 796  *
 797  * @param string $p_name Can either be specified as 'XXX' (e.g. 'bug'), or
 798  *                       using the legacy style 'mantis_XXX_table'; in the
 799  *                       latter case, a deprecation warning will be issued.
 800  * @return string containing full database table name (with prefix and suffix)
 801  */
 802 function db_get_table( $p_name ) {
 803 	if( preg_match( '/^mantis_(.*)_table$/', $p_name, $t_matches ) ) {
 804 		$t_table = $t_matches[1];
 805 		error_parameters(
 806 			__FUNCTION__ . "( '$p_name' )",
 807 			__FUNCTION__ . "( '$t_table' )"
 808 		);
 809 		trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
 810 	} else {
 811 		$t_table = $p_name;
 812 	}
 813 
 814 	# Determine table prefix including trailing '_'
 815 	$t_prefix = trim( config_get_global( 'db_table_prefix' ) );
 816 	if( !empty( $t_prefix ) && '_' != substr( $t_prefix, -1 ) ) {
 817 		$t_prefix .= '_';
 818 	}
 819 	# Determine table suffix including leading '_'
 820 	$t_suffix = trim( config_get_global( 'db_table_suffix' ) );
 821 	if( !empty( $t_suffix ) && '_' != substr( $t_suffix, 0, 1 ) ) {
 822 		$t_suffix = '_' . $t_suffix;
 823 	}
 824 
 825 	# Physical table name
 826 	$t_table = $t_prefix . $t_table . $t_suffix;
 827 	db_check_identifier_size( $t_table );
 828 	return $t_table;
 829 }

 832  * get list database tables

 835 function db_get_table_list() {
 836 	global $g_db;
 837 
 838 	$t_tables = $g_db->MetaTables( 'TABLE' );
 839 	return $t_tables;
