 842 /**
 843  * Updates a BLOB column
 844  *
 845  * This function is only needed for oci8; it will do nothing and return
 846  * false if used with another RDBMS.
 847  *
 848  * @param string $p_table  Table name.
 849  * @param string $p_column The BLOB column to update.
 850  * @param string $p_val    Data to store into the BLOB.
 851  * @param string $p_where  Where clause to identify which record to update
 852  *                         if null, defaults to the last record inserted in $p_table.
 853  * @return boolean
 854  */
 855 function db_update_blob( $p_table, $p_column, $p_val, $p_where = null ) {
 856 	global $g_db, $g_db_log_queries, $g_queries_array;
 857 
 858 	if( !db_is_oracle() ) {
 859 		return false;
 860 	}
 861 
 862 	if( null == $p_where ) {
 863 		$p_where = 'id=' . db_insert_id( $p_table );
 864 	}
 865 
 866 	if( ON == $g_db_log_queries ) {
 867 		$t_start = microtime( true );
 868 
 869 		$t_backtrace = debug_backtrace();
 870 		$t_caller = basename( $t_backtrace[0]['file'] );
 871 		$t_caller .= ':' . $t_backtrace[0]['line'];
 872 
 873 		# Is this called from another function?
 874 		if( isset( $t_backtrace[1] ) ) {
 875 			$t_caller .= ' ' . $t_backtrace[1]['function'] . '()';
 876 		} else {
 877 			# or from a script directly?
 878 			$t_caller .= ' ' . $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'];
 879 		}
 880 	}
 881 
 882 	$t_result = $g_db->UpdateBlob( $p_table, $p_column, $p_val, $p_where );
 883 
 884 	if( $g_db_log_queries ) {
 885 		$t_elapsed = number_format( microtime( true ) - $t_start, 4 );
 886 		$t_log_data = array(
 887 			'Update BLOB in ' . $p_table . '.' . $p_column . ' where ' . $p_where,
 888 			$t_elapsed,
 889 			$t_caller
 890 		);
 891 		log_event( LOG_DATABASE, var_export( $t_log_data, true ) );
 892 		array_push( $g_queries_array, $t_log_data );
 893 	}
 894 
 895 	if( !$t_result ) {
 896 		db_error();
 897 		trigger_error( ERROR_DB_QUERY_FAILED, ERROR );
 898 		return false;
 899 	}
 900 
 901 	return $t_result;
 902 }
 903 
 904 /**
 905  * Sorts bind variable numbers and puts them in sequential order
 906  * e.g. input:  "... WHERE F1=:12 and F2=:97 ",
 907  *      output: "... WHERE F1=:0 and F2=:1 ".
 908  * Used in db_oracle_adapt_query_syntax().
 909  * @param string $p_query Query string to sort.
 910  * @return string Query string with sorted bind variable numbers.
 911  */
 912 function db_oracle_order_binds_sequentially( $p_query ) {
 913 	$t_new_query= '';
 914 	$t_is_odd = true;
 915 	$t_after_quote = false;
 916 	$t_iter = 0;
 917 
 918 	# Divide statement to skip processing string literals
 919 	$t_p_query_arr = explode( '\'', $p_query );
 920 	foreach( $t_p_query_arr as $t_p_query_part ) {
 921 		if( $t_new_query != '' ) {
 922 			$t_new_query .= '\'';
 923 		}
 924 		if( $t_is_odd ) {
 925 			# Divide to process all bindvars
 926 			$t_p_query_subpart_arr = explode( ':', $t_p_query_part );
 927 			if( count( $t_p_query_subpart_arr ) > 1 ) {
 928 				foreach( $t_p_query_subpart_arr as $t_p_query_subpart ) {
 929 					if( ( !$t_after_quote ) && ( $t_new_query != '' ) ) {
 930 						$t_new_query .= ':' . preg_replace( '/^(\d+?)/U', strval( $t_iter ), $t_p_query_subpart );
 931 						$t_iter++;
 932 					} else {
 933 						$t_new_query .= $t_p_query_subpart;
 934 					}
 935 					$t_after_quote = false;
 936 				}
 937 			} else {
 938 				$t_new_query .= $t_p_query_part;
 939 			}
 940 			$t_is_odd = false;
 941 		} else {
 942 			$t_after_quote = true;
 943 			$t_new_query .= $t_p_query_part;
 944 			$t_is_odd = true;
 945 		}
 946 	}
 947 	return $t_new_query;
 948 }
 949 
 950 /**
 951  * Adapt input query string and bindvars array to Oracle DB syntax:
 952  *
 953  * 1. Change bind vars id's to sequence beginning with 0
 954  *    (calls db_oracle_order_binds_sequentially() )
 955  * 2. Remove "AS" keyword, because it is not supported with table aliasing
 956  * 3. Remove null bind variables in insert statements for default values support
 957  * 4. Replace "tab.column=:bind" to "tab.column IS NULL" when :bind is empty string
 958  * 5. Replace "SET tab.column=:bind" to "SET tab.column=DEFAULT" when :bind is empty string
 959  *
 960  * @param string  $p_query  Query string to sort.
 961  * @param array  &$p_params Array of parameters matching $p_query, function sorts array keys.
 962  *
 963  * @return string Query string with sorted bind variable numbers.
 964  */
 965 function db_oracle_adapt_query_syntax( $p_query, array &$p_params = [] ) {
 966 	# Remove "AS" keyword, because not supported with table aliasing
 967 	# - Do not remove text literal within "'" quotes
 968 	# - Will remove all "AS", except when it's part of a "CAST(x AS y)" expression
 969 	#   To do so, we will assume that the "AS" following a "CAST", is safe to be kept.
 970 	#   Using a counter for "CAST" appearances to allow nesting: CAST(CAST(x AS y) AS z)
 971 
 972 	# split the string by the relevant delimiters. The delimiters will be part of the split array
 973 	$t_parts = preg_split("/(')|( AS )|(CAST\s*\()/mi", $p_query, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY | PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE);
 974 	$t_is_literal = false;
 975 	$t_cast = 0;
 976 	$t_query = '';
 977 	foreach( $t_parts as $t_part ) {
 978 		# if quotes, switch literal flag
 979 		if( $t_part == '\'' ) {
 980 			$t_is_literal = !$t_is_literal;
 981 			$t_query .= $t_part;
 982 			continue;
 983 		}
 984 		# if this part is litereal, do not change
 985 		if( $t_is_literal ) {
 986 			$t_query .= $t_part;
 987 			continue;
 988 		} else {
 989 			# if there is "CAST" delimiter, flag the counter
 990 			if( preg_match( '/^CAST\s*\($/i', $t_part ) ) {
 991 				$t_cast++;
 992 				$t_query .= $t_part;
 993 				continue;
 994 			}
 995 			# if there is "AS"
 996 			if( strcasecmp( $t_part, ' AS ' ) == 0 ) {
 997 				# if there's a previous CAST, keep the AS
 998 				if( $t_cast > 0 ) {
 999 					$t_cast--;
1000 					$t_query .= $t_part;
1001 				} else {
1002 					# otherwise, remove the " AS ", replace by a space
1003 					$t_query .= ' ';
1004 				}
1005 				continue;
1006 			}
1007 			$t_query .= $t_part;
1008 			continue;
1009 		}
1010 	}
1011 	$p_query = $t_query;
1012 
1013 	# Remove null bind variables in insert statements for default values support
1014 	if( is_array( $p_params ) ) {
1015 		preg_match( '/^[\s\n\r]*insert[\s\n\r]+(into){0,1}[\s\n\r]+(?P<table>[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*\([\s\n\r]*[\s\n\r]*(?P<fields>[a-z0-9_,\s\n\r]+)[\s\n\r]*\)[\s\n\r]*values[\s\n\r]*\([\s\n\r]*(?P<values>[:a-z0-9_,\s\n\r]+)\)/i', $p_query, $t_matches );
1016 
1017 		if( isset( $t_matches['values'] ) ) { #if statement is a INSERT INTO ... (...) VALUES(...)
1018 			# iterates non-empty bind variables
1019 			$i = 0;
1020 			$t_fields_left = $t_matches['fields'];
1021 			$t_values_left = $t_matches['values'];
1022 
1023 			for( $t_arr_index = 0; $t_arr_index < count( $p_params ); $t_arr_index++ ) {
1024 				# inserting fieldname search
1025 				if( preg_match( '/^[\s\n\r]*([a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*,{0,1}([\d\D]*)\z/i', $t_fields_left, $t_fieldmatch ) ) {
1026 					$t_fields_left = $t_fieldmatch[2];
1027 					$t_fields_arr[$i] = $t_fieldmatch[1];
1028 				}
1029 				# inserting bindvar name search
1030 				if( preg_match( '/^[\s\n\r]*(:[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*,{0,1}([\d\D]*)\z/i', $t_values_left, $t_valuematch ) ) {
1031 					$t_values_left = $t_valuematch[2];
1032 					$t_values_arr[$i] = $t_valuematch[1];
1033 				}
1034 				# skip unsetting if bind array value not empty
1035 				if( $p_params[$t_arr_index] !== '' ) {
1036 					$i++;
1037 				} else {
1038 					$t_arr_index--;
1039 					# Shift array and unset bind array element
1040 					for( $n = $i + 1; $n < count( $p_params ); $n++ ) {
1041 						$p_params[$n-1] = $p_params[$n];
1042 					}
1043 					unset( $t_fields_arr[$i] );
1044 					unset( $t_values_arr[$i] );
1045 					unset( $p_params[count( $p_params ) - 1] );
1046 				}
1047 			}
1048 
1049 			# Combine statement from arrays
1050 			$p_query = 'INSERT INTO ' . $t_matches['table'] . ' (' . $t_fields_arr[0];
1051 			for( $i = 1; $i < count( $p_params ); $i++ ) {
1052 				$p_query = $p_query . ', ' . $t_fields_arr[$i];
1053 			}
1054 			$p_query = $p_query . ') values (' . $t_values_arr[0];
1055 			for( $i = 1; $i < count( $p_params ); $i++ ) {
1056 				$p_query = $p_query . ', ' . $t_values_arr[$i];
1057 			}
1058 			$p_query = $p_query . ')';
1059 		} else {
1060 			# if input statement is NOT a INSERT INTO (...) VALUES(...)
1061 
1062 			# "IS NULL" adoptation here
1063 			$t_set_where_template_str = substr( md5( uniqid( rand(), true ) ), 0, 50 );
1064 			$t_removed_set_where = '';
1065 
1066 			# Need to order parameter array element correctly
1067 			$p_query = db_oracle_order_binds_sequentially( $p_query );
1068 
1069 			# Find and remove temporarily "SET var1=:bind1, var2=:bind2 WHERE" part
1070 			preg_match( '/^(?P<before_set_where>.*)(?P<set_where>[\s\n\r]*set[\s\n\r]+[\s\n\ra-z0-9_\.=,:\']+)(?P<after_set_where>where[\d\D]*)$/i', $p_query, $t_matches );
1071 			$t_set_where_stmt = isset( $t_matches['after_set_where'] );
1072 
1073 			if( $t_set_where_stmt ) {
1074 				$t_removed_set_where = $t_matches['set_where'];
1075 				# Now work with statement without "SET ... WHERE" part
1076 				$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_set_where'] . $t_set_where_template_str . $t_matches['after_set_where'];
1077 			} else {
1078 				$t_templated_query = $p_query;
1079 			}
1080 
1081 			# Replace "var1=''" by "var1 IS NULL"
1082 			while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_empty_literal>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r(]+([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*=[\s\n\r]*\'\'(?P<after_empty_literal>[\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_templated_query, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
1083 				$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_empty_literal'] . ' IS NULL ' . $t_matches['after_empty_literal'];
1084 			}
1085 			# Replace "var1!=''" and "var1<>''" by "var1 IS NOT NULL"
1086 			while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_empty_literal>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r(]+([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)[\s\n\r]*(![\s\n\r]*=|<[\s\n\r]*>)[\s\n\r]*\'\'(?P<after_empty_literal>[\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_templated_query, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
1087 				$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_empty_literal'] . ' IS NOT NULL ' . $t_matches['after_empty_literal'];
1088 			}
1089 
1090 			$p_query = $t_templated_query;
1091 			# Process input bind variable array to replace "WHERE fld=:12"
1092 			# by "WHERE fld IS NULL" if :12 is empty
1093 			while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_var>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r(]+)(?P<var_name>([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)(?P<dividers>[\s\n\r]*=[\s\n\r]*:)(?P<bind_name>[0-9]+)(?P<after_var>[\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_templated_query, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
1094 				$t_bind_num = $t_matches['bind_name'];
1095 
1096 				$t_search_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . $t_matches['dividers'] . $t_matches['bind_name'] . $t_matches['after_var'];
1097 				$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . '=:' . $t_matches['bind_name']. $t_matches['after_var'];
1098 
1099 				if( $p_params[$t_bind_num] === '' ) {
1100 					for( $n = $t_bind_num + 1; $n < count( $p_params ); $n++ ) {
1101 						$p_params[$n - 1] = $p_params[$n];
1102 					}
1103 					unset( $p_params[count( $p_params ) - 1] );
1104 					$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . ' IS NULL ' . $t_matches['after_var'];
1105 				}
1106 				$p_query = str_replace( $t_search_substr, $t_replace_substr, $p_query );
1107 
1108 				$t_templated_query = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['after_var'];
1109 			}
1110 
1111 			if( $t_set_where_stmt ) {
1112 				# Put temporarily removed "SET ... WHERE" part back
1113 				$p_query = str_replace( $t_set_where_template_str, $t_removed_set_where, $p_query );
1114 				# Need to order parameter array element correctly
1115 				$p_query = db_oracle_order_binds_sequentially( $p_query );
1116 				# Find and remove temporary "SET var1=:bind1, var2=:bind2 WHERE" part again
1117 				preg_match( '/^(?P<before_set_where>.*)(?P<set_where>[\s\n\r]*set[\s\n\r]+[\s\n\ra-z0-9_\.=,:\']+)(?P<after_set_where>where[\d\D]*)$/i', $p_query, $t_matches );
1118 				$t_removed_set_where = $t_matches['set_where'];
1119 				$p_query = $t_matches['before_set_where'] . $t_set_where_template_str . $t_matches['after_set_where'];
1120 
1121 				#Replace "SET fld1=:1" to "SET fld1=DEFAULT" if bind array value is empty
1122 				$t_removed_set_where_parsing = $t_removed_set_where;
1123 
1124 				while( preg_match( '/^(?P<before_var>[\d\D]*[\s\n\r,]+)(?P<var_name>([a-z0-9_]*[\s\n\r]*\.){0,1}[\s\n\r]*[a-z0-9_]+)(?P<dividers>[\s\n\r]*=[\s\n\r]*:)(?P<bind_name>[0-9]+)(?P<after_var>[,\s\n\r]*[\d\D]*\z)/i', $t_removed_set_where_parsing, $t_matches ) > 0 ) {
1125 					$t_bind_num = $t_matches['bind_name'];
1126 					$t_search_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . $t_matches['dividers'] . $t_matches['bind_name'] ;
1127 					$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . $t_matches['dividers'] . $t_matches['bind_name'] ;
1128 
1129 					if( $p_params[$t_bind_num] === '' ) {
1130 						for( $n = $t_bind_num + 1; $n < count( $p_params ); $n++ ) {
1131 							$p_params[$n - 1] = $p_params[$n];
1132 						}
1133 						unset( $p_params[count( $p_params ) - 1] );
1134 						$t_replace_substr = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['var_name'] . '=DEFAULT ';
1135 					}
1136 					$t_removed_set_where = str_replace( $t_search_substr, $t_replace_substr, $t_removed_set_where );
1137 					$t_removed_set_where_parsing = $t_matches['before_var'] . $t_matches['after_var'];
1138 				}
1139 				$p_query = str_replace( $t_set_where_template_str, $t_removed_set_where, $p_query );
1140 			}
1141 		}
1142 	}
1143 	$p_query = db_oracle_order_binds_sequentially( $p_query );
1144 	return $p_query;
1145 }
1146 
1147 /**
1148  * Replace 4-byte UTF-8 chars.
1149  *
1150  * This is a workaround to avoid data getting truncated on MySQL databases
1151  * using native utf8 encoding, which only supports 3 bytes chars (see #20431).
1152  *
1153  * @param string $p_string
1154  * @return string
1155  */
1156 function db_mysql_fix_utf8( $p_string ) {
1157 	if( !db_is_mysql() ) {
1158 		return $p_string;
1159 	}
1160 	return preg_replace(
1161 		# 4-byte UTF8 chars always start with bytes 0xF0-0xF7 (0b11110xxx)
1162 		'/[\xF0-\xF7].../s',
1163 		# replace with U+FFFD to avoid potential Unicode XSS attacks,
1164 		# see http://unicode.org/reports/tr36/#Deletion_of_Noncharacters
1165 		"\xEF\xBF\xBD",
1166 		(string)$p_string
1167 	);
1168 }

1170 /**
1171  * Creates an empty record set, compatible with db_query() result
1172  * This object can be used when a query can't be performed, or is not needed,
1173  * and still want to return an empty result as a transparent return value.
1174  * @return \ADORecordSet_empty
1175  */
1176 function db_empty_result() {
1177 	return new ADORecordSet_empty();
1178 }
1179 
1180 /**
1181  * Process a query string by replacing token parameters by their bound values
1182  * @param string $p_query     Query string
1183  * @param array $p_arr_parms  Parameter array
1184  * @return string             Processed query string
1185  */
1186 function db_format_query_log_msg( $p_query, array $p_arr_parms ) {
1187 	global $g_db, $g_db_functional_type;
1188 
1189 	$t_lastoffset = 0;
1190 	$i = 0;
1191 	if( !empty( $p_arr_parms ) ) {
1192 		# For mysql, tokens are '?', and parameters are bound sequentially
1193 		# For pgsql, tokens are '$number', and parameters are bound by the denoted
1194 		# index (1-based) in the parameter array
1195 		# For oracle, tokens are ':string', but mantis rewrites them as sequentially
1196 		# ordered, so they behave like mysql. See db_oracle_order_binds_sequentially()
1197 		$t_regex = '/(?<token>\?|\$|:)(?<index>[0-9]*)/';
1198 		while( preg_match( $t_regex , $p_query, $t_matches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, $t_lastoffset ) ) {
1199 			$t_match_param = $t_matches[0];
1200 			# Realign the offset returned by preg_match as it is byte-based,
1201 			# which causes issues with UTF-8 characters in the query string
1202 			# (e.g. from custom fields names)
1203 			$t_utf8_offset = mb_strlen( substr( $p_query, 0, $t_match_param[1] ), mb_internal_encoding() );
1204 			if( $i <= count( $p_arr_parms ) ) {
1205 				switch( $g_db_functional_type ) {
1206 					case DB_TYPE_PGSQL:
1207 						# For pgsql, the bound value is indexed by the parameter name (1-based)
1208 						$t_index = (int)$t_matches['index'][0];
1209 						$t_value = $p_arr_parms[$t_index-1];
1210 						break;
1211 					case DB_TYPE_ORACLE:
1212 						# For oracle, the value is indexed by the label
1213 						$t_index = $t_matches['index'][0];
1214 						$t_value = $p_arr_parms[$t_index];
1215 						break;
1216 					default:
1217 						# otherwise, the value is positional
1218 						$t_value = $p_arr_parms[$i];
1219 				}
1220 				if( is_null( $t_value ) ) {
1221 					$t_replace = 'NULL';
1222 				} else if( is_string( $t_value ) ) {
1223 					$t_replace = "'" . $t_value . "'";
1224 				} else if( is_integer( $t_value ) || is_float( $t_value ) ) {
1225 					$t_replace = (float)$t_value;
1226 				} else if( is_bool( $t_value ) ) {
1227 					# use the actual literal from db driver
1228 					$t_replace = $t_value ? $g_db->true : $g_db->false;
1229 				} else {
1230 					# Could not find a supported type for this parameter value.
1231 					# Skip this token, so replacing it with itself.
1232 					$t_replace = $t_match_param[0];
1233 				}
1234 				$p_query = mb_substr( $p_query, 0, $t_utf8_offset )
1235 					. $t_replace
1236 					. mb_substr( $p_query, $t_utf8_offset + mb_strlen( $t_match_param[0] ) );
1237 				$t_lastoffset = $t_match_param[1] + strlen( $t_replace ) + 1;
1238 			} else {
1239 				$t_lastoffset = $t_match_param[1] + 1;
1240 			}
1241 			$i++;
1242 		}
1243 	}
1244 	return $p_query;
1245 }
1246 
1247 /**
1248  * Returns true if a specific capability is suported in the current database server,
1249  * false otherwise.
1250  *
1251  * @param integer $p_capability   See DB_CAPABILITY_* constants
1252  * @return boolean    True if the capability is supported, false otherwise.
1253  */
1254 function db_has_capability( $p_capability ) {
1255 	static $s_cache = array();
1256 	if( !isset( $s_cache[$p_capability] ) ) {
1257 		$s_cache[$p_capability] = db_test_capability( $p_capability );
1258 	}
1259 	return $s_cache[$p_capability];
1260 }
1261 
1262 /**
1263  * Tests if a specific capability is suported in the current database server.
1264  *
1265  * @param integer $p_capability   See DB_CAPABILITY_* constants
1266  * @return boolean    True if the capability is supported, false otherwise.
1267  */
1268 function db_test_capability( $p_capability ) {
1269 	global $g_db, $g_db_functional_type;
1270 	$t_server_info = $g_db->ServerInfo();
1271 
1272 	switch( $p_capability ) {
1273 		case DB_CAPABILITY_WINDOW_FUNCTIONS:
1274 			switch( $g_db_functional_type ) {
1275 				case DB_TYPE_ORACLE: # since 8i
1276 				case DB_TYPE_PGSQL: # since 8.4
1277 				case DB_TYPE_MSSQL: # since 2008
1278 					return true;
1279 				case DB_TYPE_MYSQL:
1280 					# mysql, since 8.0.2
1281 					if( version_compare( $t_server_info['version'], '8.0.2', '>=' )
1282 							&& false !== stripos( $t_server_info['description'], 'mysql' ) ) {
1283 						return true;
1284 					}
1285 					# mariaDB, since 10.2
1286 					if( version_compare( $t_server_info['version'], '10.2', '>=' )
1287 							&& false !== stripos( $t_server_info['description'], 'mariadb' ) ) {
1288 						return true;
1289 					}
1290 					# if server info cant provide enough information to identify the type,
1291 					# default to "not supported"
1292 			}
1293 	}
1294 
1295 	# if nothing was found, return false
1296 	return false;
1297 }

  47 $g_cache_timezone = array();

  49 /**
  50  * checks if date is null
  51  * @param integer $p_date Date.
  52  * @return boolean
  53  * @access public
  54  */
  55 function date_is_null( $p_date ) {
  56 	return $p_date == date_get_null();
  57 }
  58 
  59 /**
  60  * gets null date
  61  * @return integer
  62  * @access public
  63  */
  64 function date_get_null() {
  65 	return 1;

  69 /**
  70  * Converts a datetime string to a Unix timestamp.
  71  *
  72  * @param string $p_date_string Date string.
  73  *
  74  * @return int|null Unix timestamp, null when $p_date_string is blank.
  75  *
  76  * @throws ClientException When given string cannot be converted to Date.
  77  */
  78 function date_string_to_timestamp( string $p_date_string ): ?int {
  79 	if( is_blank( $p_date_string ) ) {
  80 		return null;
  81 	}
  82 
  83 	# @TODO if we ever decide to require strict ISO-8601 date formatting in the
  84 	#       future, this should be enforced here.
  85 
  86 	try {
  87 		$t_dt = new DateTimeImmutable( $p_date_string );
  88 	}
  89 	catch( Exception $e ) {
  90 		throw new ClientException(
  91 			"Invalid date format '$p_date_string'",
  92 			ERROR_INVALID_DATE_FORMAT,
  93 			array( $p_date_string ),
  94 			$e
  95 		);
  96 	}
  97 	return $t_dt->getTimestamp();
  98 }
  99 
 100 /**
 101  * Converts a timestamp to an ISO-8601 formatted date.
 102  *
 103  * @param int|null $p_timestamp Unix Timestamp.
 104  *
 105  * @return string|null ISO-8601 formatted date.
 106  */
 107 function date_timestamp_to_iso8601( ?int $p_timestamp ): ?string {
 108 	if( $p_timestamp == null || date_is_null( $p_timestamp ) ) {
 109 		return null;
 110 	}
 111 
 112 	return date( 'c', (int)$p_timestamp );
 113 }
 114 
 115 
 116 /**
 117  * Gets Unix timestamp from a date string.
 118  *
 119  * First tries to convert the given date string using the configured Normal
 120  * date format {@see $g_normal_date_format}, and if that does not work
 121  * fallback to PHP's Supported Date and Time Formats
 122  * {@link https://php.net/manual/en/datetime.formats.php}.
 123  *
 124  * @param string $p_date_string A valid date/time string
 125  *
 126  * @return int a timestamp on success, null date when $p_date_string is blank
 127  *
 128  * @throws ClientException When given string cannot be converted to Date
 129  * @access public
 130  */
 131 function date_strtotime( $p_date_string ) {
 132 	if( is_blank( $p_date_string ) ) {
 133 		return date_get_null();
 134 	}
 135 
 136 	$t_format = config_get( 'normal_date_format' );
 137 	$t_dt = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat( $t_format, $p_date_string );
 138 	if( $t_dt !== false ) {
 139 		return $t_dt->getTimestamp();
 140 	}
 141 
 142 	# date is not in expected format, try with default formats
 143 	return date_string_to_timestamp( $p_date_string );
 144 }
 145 
 146 /**
 147  * set new timezone
 148  * @param string $p_timezone PHP timezone to set.
 149  * @return void
 150  * @access public
 151  */
 152 function date_set_timezone( $p_timezone ) {
 153 	global $g_cache_timezone;
 154 
 155 	array_push( $g_cache_timezone, date_default_timezone_get() );
 156 
 157 	if( !date_default_timezone_set( $p_timezone ) ) {
 158 		# unable to set timezone
 159 		trigger_error( ERROR_UPDATING_TIMEZONE, WARNING );
 160 	}
 161 }
 162 
 163 /**
 164  * restore previous timezone
 165  * @return void
 166  * @access public
 167  */
 168 function date_restore_timezone() {
 169 	global $g_cache_timezone;
 170 
 171 	$t_timezone = array_pop( $g_cache_timezone );
 172 
 173 	if( $t_timezone === null ) {
 174 		return;
 175 	}
 176 
 177 	if( !date_default_timezone_set( $t_timezone ) ) {
 178 		# unable to set timezone
 179 		trigger_error( ERROR_UPDATING_TIMEZONE, WARNING );
 180 	}
 181 }

 183 /**
 184  * Print html option tags for month in a select list - in user's language
 185  * @param integer $p_month Integer representing month of the year.
 186  * @return void
 187  * @access public
 188  */
 189 function print_month_option_list( $p_month = 0 ) {
 190 	for( $i = 1;$i <= 12;$i++ ) {
 191 		$t_month_name = date( 'F', mktime( 0, 0, 0, $i, 1, 2000 ) );
 192 		if( $i == $p_month ) {
 193 			echo '<option value="' . $i . '" selected="selected">' . lang_get( 'month_' . strtolower( $t_month_name ) ) . '</option>';
 194 		} else {
 195 			echo '<option value="' . $i . '">' . lang_get( 'month_' . strtolower( $t_month_name ) ) . '</option>';
 196 		}
 197 	}
 198 }

 252 /**
 253  * Print html option tags for year in a select list
 254  * @param integer $p_year  Current Year.
 255  * @param integer $p_start First Year to display.
 256  * @param integer $p_end   Last Year to display.
 257  * @return void
 258  * @access public
 259  */
 260 function print_year_range_option_list( $p_year = 0, $p_start = 0, $p_end = 0 ) {
 261 	$t_current = date( 'Y' );
 262 	$t_forward_years = config_get( 'forward_year_count' );
 263 
 264 	$t_start_year = $p_start;
 265 	if( $t_start_year == 0 ) {
 266 		$t_backward_years = config_get( 'backward_year_count' );
 267 		$t_start_year = $t_current - $t_backward_years;
 268 	}
 269 
 270 	if( ( $p_year < $t_start_year ) && ( $p_year != 0 ) ) {
 271 		$t_start_year = $p_year;
 272 	}
 273 
 274 	$t_end_year = $p_end;
 275 	if( $t_end_year == 0 ) {
 276 		$t_end_year = $t_current + $t_forward_years;
 277 	}
 278 	if( $p_year > $t_end_year ) {
 279 		$t_end_year = $p_year + $t_forward_years;
 280 	}
 281 
 282 	for( $i = $t_start_year;$i <= $t_end_year;$i++ ) {
 283 		if( $i == $p_year ) {
 284 			echo '<option value="' . $i . '" selected="selected">' . $i . '</option>';
 285 		} else {
 286 			echo '<option value="' . $i . '">' . $i . '</option>';
 287 		}
 288 	}
 289 }

 291 /**
 292  * Print <select> tag for selecting a date
 293  * @param string  $p_name            Name for html select field attribute.
 294  * @param string  $p_format          Date format e.g. YmD.
 295  * @param integer $p_date            Integer timestamp representing date.
 296  * @param boolean $p_default_disable Whether date selector is disabled.
 297  * @param boolean $p_allow_blank     Whether blank/null date is allowed.
 298  * @param integer $p_year_start      First year to display in drop down.
 299  * @param integer $p_year_end        Last year to display in drop down.
 300  * @param string  $p_input_css       CSS classes to use with input fields
 301  * @param string  $p_required        The "required" attribute to add to the field
 302  * @return void
 303  * @access public
 304  */
 305 function print_date_selection_set( $p_name, $p_format, $p_date = 0, $p_default_disable = false, $p_allow_blank = false, $p_year_start = 0, $p_year_end = 0, $p_input_css = 'input-sm', $p_required = '' ) {
 306 	$t_chars = preg_split( '//', $p_format, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
 307 	if( $p_date != 0 ) {
 308 		$t_date = preg_split( '/-/', date( 'Y-m-d', $p_date ), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
 309 	} else {
 310 		$t_date = array( 0, 0, 0, );
 311 	}
 312 
 313 	$t_disable = '';
 314 	if( $p_default_disable == true ) {
 315 		$t_disable = ' disabled="disabled"';
 316 	}
 317 	$t_blank_line = '';
 318 	if( $p_allow_blank == true ) {
 319 		$t_blank_line = '<option value="0"></option>';
 320 	}
 321 
 322 	foreach( $t_chars as $t_char ) {
 323 		if( strcmp( $t_char, 'M' ) == 0 ) {
 324 			echo '<select class="' . $p_input_css . '" ' . helper_get_tab_index() . ' name="' . $p_name . '_month"' . $t_disable . $p_required . '>';
 325 			echo $t_blank_line;
 326 			print_month_option_list( $t_date[1] );
 327 			echo '</select>' . "\n";
 328 		}
 329 		if( strcmp( $t_char, 'm' ) == 0 ) {
 330 			echo '<select class="' . $p_input_css . '" ' . helper_get_tab_index() . ' name="' . $p_name . '_month"' . $t_disable . $p_required . '>';
 331 			echo $t_blank_line;
 332 			print_month_option_list( $t_date[1] );
 333 			echo '</select>' . "\n";
 334 		}
 335 		if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'D' ) == 0 ) {
 336 			echo '<select class="' . $p_input_css . '" ' . helper_get_tab_index() . ' name="' . $p_name . '_day"' . $t_disable . $p_required . '>';
 337 			echo $t_blank_line;
 338 			print_day_option_list( $t_date[2] );
 339 			echo '</select>' . "\n";
 340 		}
 341 		if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'Y' ) == 0 ) {
 342 			echo '<select class="' . $p_input_css . '" ' .  helper_get_tab_index() . ' name="' . $p_name . '_year"' . $t_disable . $p_required . '>';
 343 			echo $t_blank_line;
 344 			print_year_range_option_list( $t_date[0], $p_year_start, $p_year_end );
 345 			echo '</select>' . "\n";
 346 		}
 347 	}
 348 }

  82 # PHPMailer is needed for email address validation independent of the provider used
  83 # to send the emails.
  84 use PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer;
  85 
  86 use Mantis\Exceptions\ClientException;
  87 use VBoctor\Email\DisposableEmailChecker;
  88 
  89 /**
  90  * Indicates how generated emails will be processed by the shutdown function
  91  * at the end of the current request's execution; this is a binary flag:
  92  * - EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_SKIP       Initial state: do nothing (no generated emails)
  93  * - EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_GENERATED  Emails will be sent, unless $g_email_send_using_cronjob is ON
  94  * - EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_FORCE      All queued emails will be sent regardless of cronjob settings
  95  * @see email_shutdown_function()
  96  * @global $g_email_shutdown_processing
  97  */
  98 $g_email_shutdown_processing = EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_SKIP;
  99 
 100 /**
 101  * Regex for valid email addresses.
 102  *
 103  * @see string_insert_hrefs()
 104  * This pattern is consistent with email addresses validation logic
 105  * @see $g_validate_email
 106  * Uses the standard HTML5 pattern defined in
 107  * {@link https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#valid-e-mail-address}
 108  * Note: the original regex from the spec has been modified to
 109  * - escape the '/' in the first character class definition
 110  * - remove the '^' and '$' anchors to allow matching anywhere in a string
 111  * - add a limit of 64 chars on local part to avoid timeouts on very long texts with false matches.
 112  *
 113  * @return string
 114  */
 115 function email_regex_simple() {
 116 	return "/[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+\/=?^_`{|}~-]{1,64}@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*/";
 117 }
 118 
 119 /**
 120  * Check to see that the format is valid and that the mx record exists.
 121  *
 122  * @param string $p_email An email address.
 123  *
 124  * @return boolean
 125  */
 126 function email_is_valid( $p_email ) {
 127 	$t_validate_email = config_get_global( 'validate_email' );
 128 
 129 	# if we don't validate then just accept
 130 	# If blank email is allowed or current user is admin, then accept blank emails which are useful for
 131 	# accounts that should never receive email notifications (e.g. anonymous account)
 132 	if( OFF == $t_validate_email ||
 133 		ON == config_get_global( 'use_ldap_email' ) ||
 134 		( is_blank( $p_email ) && ( ON == config_get( 'allow_blank_email' ) || current_user_is_administrator() ) )
 135 	) {
 136 		return true;
 137 	}
 138 
 139 	# E-mail validation method
 140 	# Note: PHPMailer offers alternative validation methods.
 141 	# It was decided in PR 172 (https://github.com/mantisbt/mantisbt/pull/172)
 142 	# to just default to HTML5 without over-complicating things for end users
 143 	# by offering a potentially confusing choice between the different methods.
 144 	# Refer to PHPMailer documentation for ValidateAddress method for details.
 145 	# @link https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/blob/v5.2.9/class.phpmailer.php#L863
 146 	$t_method = 'html5';
 147 
 148 	# check email address is a valid format
 149 	log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, "Validating address '$p_email' with method '$t_method'" );
 150 	if( PHPMailer::validateAddress( $p_email, $t_method ) ) {
 151 		$t_domain = substr( $p_email, strpos( $p_email, '@' ) + 1 );
 152 
 153 		# see if we're limited to a set of known domains
 154 		$t_limit_email_domains = config_get( 'limit_email_domains' );
 155 		if( !empty( $t_limit_email_domains ) ) {
 156 			foreach( $t_limit_email_domains as $t_email_domain ) {
 157 				if( 0 == strcasecmp( $t_email_domain, $t_domain ) ) {
 158 					return true; # no need to check mx record details (below) if we've explicitly allowed the domain
 159 				}
 160 			}
 161 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL, "failed - not in limited domains list '$t_limit_email_domains'" );
 162 			return false;
 163 		}
 164 
 165 		if( ON == config_get( 'check_mx_record' ) ) {
 166 			$t_mx = array();
 167 
 168 			# Check for valid mx records
 169 			if( getmxrr( $t_domain, $t_mx ) ) {
 170 				return true;
 171 			} else {
 172 				$t_host = $t_domain . '.';
 173 
 174 				# for no mx record... try dns check
 175 				if( checkdnsrr( $t_host, 'ANY' ) ) {
 176 					return true;
 177 				}
 178 				log_event( LOG_EMAIL, "failed - mx/dns record check" );
 179 			}
 180 		} else {
 181 			# Email format was valid but didn't check for valid mx records
 182 			return true;
 183 		}
 184 	} else {
 185 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, "failed - invalid address" );
 186 	}
 187 
 188 	# Everything failed.  The email is invalid
 189 	return false;
 190 }

 236 /**
 237  * Get the value associated with the specific action and flag.
 238  *
 239  * For example, you can get the value associated with notifying "admin"
 240  * on action "new", i.e. notify administrators on new bugs which can be
 241  * ON or OFF.
 242  *
 243  * @param string $p_action Action.
 244  * @param string $p_flag   Flag.
 245  *
 246  * @return integer 1 - enabled, 0 - disabled.
 247  */
 248 function email_notify_flag( $p_action, $p_flag ) {
 249 	# If flag is specified for the specific event, use that.
 250 	$t_notify_flags = config_get( 'notify_flags' );
 251 	if( isset( $t_notify_flags[$p_action][$p_flag] ) ) {
 252 		return $t_notify_flags[$p_action][$p_flag];
 253 	}
 254 
 255 	# If not, then use the default if specified in database or global.
 256 	# Note that web UI may not support or specify all flags (e.g. explicit),
 257 	# hence, if config is retrieved from database it may not have the flag.
 258 	$t_default_notify_flags = config_get( 'default_notify_flags' );
 259 	if( isset( $t_default_notify_flags[$p_flag] ) ) {
 260 		return $t_default_notify_flags[$p_flag];
 261 	}
 262 
 263 	# If the flag is not specified so far, then force using global config which
 264 	# should have all flags specified.
 265 	$t_global_default_notify_flags = config_get_global( 'default_notify_flags' );
 266 	if( isset( $t_global_default_notify_flags[$p_flag] ) ) {
 267 		return $t_global_default_notify_flags[$p_flag];
 268 	}
 269 
 270 	return OFF;
 271 }

 273 /**
 274  * Collect valid email recipients for email notification.
 275  *
 276  * @todo yarick123: email_collect_recipients(...) will be completely rewritten to provide additional information such as language, user access,..
 277  * @todo yarick123:sort recipients list by language to reduce switches between different languages
 278  *
 279  * @param int    $p_bug_id                  A bug identifier.
 280  * @param string $p_notify_type             Notification type.
 281  * @param array  $p_extra_user_ids_to_email Array of additional email addresses to notify.
 282  * @param int    $p_bugnote_id              The bugnote id in case of bugnote, otherwise null.
 283  *
 284  * @return array
 285  * @throws ClientException
 286  */
 287 function email_collect_recipients( $p_bug_id, $p_notify_type, array $p_extra_user_ids_to_email = array(), $p_bugnote_id = null ) {
 288 	$t_recipients = array();
 289 
 290 	# add explicitly specified users
 291 	$t_explicit_enabled = ( ON == email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'explicit' ) );
 292 	foreach ( $p_extra_user_ids_to_email as $t_user_id ) {
 293 		if ( $t_explicit_enabled ) {
 294 			$t_recipients[$t_user_id] = true;
 295 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, add @U%d (explicitly specified)', $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 296 		} else {
 297 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, skip @U%d (explicit disabled)', $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 298 		}
 299 	}
 300 
 301 	# add Reporter
 302 	$t_reporter_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'reporter_id' );
 303 	if( ON == email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'reporter' ) ) {
 304 		$t_recipients[$t_reporter_id] = true;
 305 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, add @U%d (reporter)', $p_bug_id, $t_reporter_id );
 306 	} else {
 307 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, skip @U%d (reporter disabled)', $p_bug_id, $t_reporter_id );
 308 	}
 309 
 310 	# add Handler
 311 	$t_handler_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'handler_id' );
 312 	if( $t_handler_id > 0 ) {
 313 		if( ON == email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'handler' ) ) {
 314 			$t_recipients[$t_handler_id] = true;
 315 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, add @U%d (handler)', $p_bug_id, $t_handler_id );
 316 		} else {
 317 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, skip @U%d (handler disabled)', $p_bug_id, $t_handler_id );
 318 		}
 319 	}
 320 
 321 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 322 
 323 	# add users monitoring the bug
 324 	$t_monitoring_enabled = ON == email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'monitor' );
 325 	db_param_push();
 326 	$t_query = 'SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM {bug_monitor} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 327 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 328 
 329 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 330 		$t_user_id = $t_row['user_id'];
 331 		if ( $t_monitoring_enabled ) {
 332 			$t_recipients[$t_user_id] = true;
 333 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, add @U%d (monitoring)', $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 334 		} else {
 335 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, skip @U%d (monitoring disabled)', $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 336 		}
 337 	}
 338 
 339 	# add Category Owner
 340 	if( ON == email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'category' ) ) {
 341 		$t_category_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'category_id' );
 342 
 343 		if( $t_category_id > 0 ) {
 344 			$t_category_assigned_to = category_get_field( $t_category_id, 'user_id' );
 345 
 346 			if( $t_category_assigned_to > 0 ) {
 347 				$t_recipients[$t_category_assigned_to] = true;
 348 				log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, sprintf( 'Issue = #%d, add Category Owner = @U%d', $p_bug_id, $t_category_assigned_to ) );
 349 			}
 350 		}
 351 	}
 352 
 353 	# add users who contributed bugnotes
 354 	$t_notes_enabled = ( ON == email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'bugnotes' ) );
 355 	db_param_push();
 356 	$t_query = 'SELECT DISTINCT reporter_id FROM {bugnote} WHERE bug_id = ' . db_param();
 357 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 358 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 359 		$t_user_id = $t_row['reporter_id'];
 360 		if ( $t_notes_enabled ) {
 361 			$t_recipients[$t_user_id] = true;
 362 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, add @U%d (note author)', $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 363 		} else {
 364 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, skip @U%d (note author disabled)', $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 365 		}
 366 	}
 367 
 368 	# add project users who meet the thresholds
 369 	$t_bug_is_private = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'view_state' ) == VS_PRIVATE;
 370 	$t_threshold_min = email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'threshold_min' );
 371 	$t_threshold_max = email_notify_flag( $p_notify_type, 'threshold_max' );
 372 	$t_threshold_users = project_get_all_user_rows( $t_project_id, $t_threshold_min );
 373 	foreach( $t_threshold_users as $t_user ) {
 374 		if( $t_user['access_level'] <= $t_threshold_max ) {
 375 			if( !$t_bug_is_private || access_compare_level( $t_user['access_level'], config_get( 'private_bug_threshold' ) ) ) {
 376 				$t_recipients[$t_user['id']] = true;
 377 				log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, add @U%d (based on access level)', $p_bug_id, $t_user['id'] );
 378 			}
 379 		}
 380 	}
 381 
 382 	# add users as specified by plugins
 383 	$t_recipients_include_data = event_signal( 'EVENT_NOTIFY_USER_INCLUDE', array( $p_bug_id, $p_notify_type ) );
 384 	foreach( $t_recipients_include_data as $t_plugin => $t_recipients_include_data2 ) {
 385 		foreach( $t_recipients_include_data2 as $t_recipients_included ) {
 386 			# only handle if we get an array from the callback
 387 			if( is_array( $t_recipients_included ) ) {
 388 				foreach( $t_recipients_included as $t_user_id ) {
 389 					$t_recipients[$t_user_id] = true;
 390 					log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, add @U%d (by %s plugin)', $p_bug_id, $t_user_id, $t_plugin );
 391 				}
 392 			}
 393 		}
 394 	}
 395 
 396 	# FIXME: the value of $p_notify_type could at this stage be either a status
 397 	# or a built-in actions such as 'owner and 'sponsor'. We have absolutely no
 398 	# idea whether 'new' is indicating a new bug has been filed, or if the
 399 	# status of an existing bug has been changed to 'new'. Therefore it is best
 400 	# to just assume built-in actions have precedence over status changes.
 401 	switch( $p_notify_type ) {
 402 		case 'new':
 403 		case 'feedback': # This isn't really a built-in action (delete me!)
 404 		case 'reopened':
 405 		case 'resolved':
 406 		case 'closed':
 407 		case 'bugnote':
 408 			$t_pref_field = 'email_on_' . $p_notify_type;
 409 			if( !$p_bugnote_id ) {
 410 				$p_bugnote_id = bugnote_get_latest_id( $p_bug_id );
 411 			}
 412 			break;
 413 		case 'owner':
 414 			# The email_on_assigned notification type is now effectively
 415 			# email_on_change_of_handler.
 416 			$t_pref_field = 'email_on_assigned';
 417 			break;
 418 		case 'deleted':
 419 		case 'updated':
 420 		case 'sponsor':
 421 		case 'relation':
 422 		case 'monitor':
 423 		case 'priority': # This is never used, but exists in the database!
 424 			# Issue #19459 these notification actions are not actually implemented
 425 			# in the database and therefore aren't adjustable on a per-user
 426 			# basis! The exception is 'monitor' that makes no sense being a
 427 			# customisable per-user preference.
 428 		default:
 429 			# Anything not built-in is probably going to be a status
 430 			$t_pref_field = 'email_on_status';
 431 			break;
 432 	}
 433 
 434 	# @TODO we could optimize by modifying user_cache() to take an array
 435 	#  of user ids so we could pull them all in.  We'll see if it's necessary
 436 	$t_final_recipients = array();
 437 
 438 	$t_bug = bug_get( $p_bug_id );
 439 	$t_user_ids = array_keys( $t_recipients );
 440 	user_cache_array_rows( $t_user_ids );
 441 	user_pref_cache_array_rows( $t_user_ids );
 442 	user_pref_cache_array_rows( $t_user_ids, $t_bug->project_id );
 443 
 444 	# Check whether users should receive the emails
 445 	# and put email address to $t_recipients[user_id]
 446 	foreach( $t_recipients as $t_id => $t_ignore ) {
 447 		# Possibly eliminate the current user
 448 		if( ( auth_get_current_user_id() == $t_id ) && ( OFF == config_get( 'email_receive_own' ) ) ) {
 449 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, drop @U%d (own action)', $p_bug_id, $t_id );
 450 			continue;
 451 		}
 452 
 453 		# Eliminate users who don't exist anymore or who are disabled
 454 		if( !user_exists( $t_id ) || !user_is_enabled( $t_id ) ) {
 455 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, drop @U%d (user disabled)', $p_bug_id, $t_id );
 456 			continue;
 457 		}
 458 
 459 		# Exclude users who have this notification type turned off
 460 		if( $t_pref_field ) {
 461 			$t_notify = user_pref_get_pref( $t_id, $t_pref_field );
 462 			if( OFF == $t_notify ) {
 463 				log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, drop @U%d (pref %s off)', $p_bug_id, $t_id, $t_pref_field );
 464 				continue;
 465 			} else {
 466 				# Users can define the severity of an issue before they are emailed for
 467 				# each type of notification
 468 				$t_min_sev_pref_field = $t_pref_field . '_min_severity';
 469 				$t_min_sev_notify = user_pref_get_pref( $t_id, $t_min_sev_pref_field );
 470 				$t_bug_severity = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'severity' );
 471 
 472 				if( $t_bug_severity < $t_min_sev_notify ) {
 473 					log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, drop @U%d (pref threshold)', $p_bug_id, $t_id );
 474 					continue;
 475 				}
 476 			}
 477 		}
 478 
 479 		# exclude users who don't have at least viewer access to the bug,
 480 		# or who can't see bugnotes if the last update included a bugnote
 481 		$t_view_bug_threshold = config_get( 'view_bug_threshold', null, $t_id, $t_bug->project_id );
 482 		if(   !access_has_bug_level( $t_view_bug_threshold, $p_bug_id, $t_id )
 483 		   || (   $p_bugnote_id
 484 			   && !access_has_bugnote_level( $t_view_bug_threshold, $p_bugnote_id, $t_id )
 485 			  )
 486 		) {
 487 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, drop @U%d (access level)', $p_bug_id, $t_id );
 488 			continue;
 489 		}
 490 
 491 		# check to exclude users as specified by plugins
 492 		$t_recipient_exclude_data = event_signal( 'EVENT_NOTIFY_USER_EXCLUDE', array( $p_bug_id, $p_notify_type, $t_id ) );
 493 		$t_exclude = false;
 494 		foreach( $t_recipient_exclude_data as $t_plugin => $t_recipient_exclude_data2 ) {
 495 			foreach( $t_recipient_exclude_data2 as $t_recipient_excluded ) {
 496 				# exclude if any plugin returns true (excludes the user)
 497 				if( $t_recipient_excluded ) {
 498 					$t_exclude = true;
 499 					log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, drop @U%d (by %s plugin)', $p_bug_id, $t_id, $t_plugin );
 500 				}
 501 			}
 502 		}
 503 
 504 		# user was excluded by a plugin
 505 		if( $t_exclude ) {
 506 			continue;
 507 		}
 508 
 509 		# Finally, let's get their emails, if they've set one
 510 		$t_email = user_get_email( $t_id );
 511 		if( is_blank( $t_email ) ) {
 512 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, drop @U%d (no email address)', $p_bug_id, $t_id );
 513 		} else {
 514 			# @TODO we could check the emails for validity again but I think it would be too slow
 515 			$t_final_recipients[$t_id] = $t_email;
 516 		}
 517 	}
 518 
 519 	return $t_final_recipients;
 520 }
 521 
 522 /**
 523  * Send an email notification to a user when their information is changed by another user.
 524  *
 525  * @param int   $p_user_id  The user id of the user whose information was changed.
 526  * @param array $p_old_user The user's information before the change.
 527  * @param array $p_new_user The user's information after the change.
 528  *
 529  * @return void
 530  */
 531 function email_user_changed( $p_user_id, $p_old_user, $p_new_user ) {
 532 	if( config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) == OFF ) {
 533 		return;
 534 	}
 535 
 536 	lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $p_user_id ) );
 537 	$t_changes = '';
 538 
 539 	if( strcmp( $p_new_user['username'], $p_old_user['username'] ) ) {
 540 		$t_changes .= lang_get( 'username_label' ) . ' ' . $p_old_user['username'] . ' => ' . $p_new_user['username'] . "\n";
 541 	}
 542 
 543 	if( strcmp( $p_old_user['realname'], $p_new_user['realname'] ) ) {
 544 		$t_changes .= lang_get( 'realname_label' ) . ' ' . $p_old_user['realname'] . ' => ' . $p_new_user['realname'] . "\n";
 545 	}
 546 
 547 	if( strcmp( $p_old_user['email'], $p_new_user['email'] ) ) {
 548 		$t_changes .= lang_get( 'email_label' ) . ' ' . $p_old_user['email'] . ' => ' . $p_new_user['email'] . "\n";
 549 	}
 550 
 551 	if( $p_old_user['access_level'] !== $p_new_user['access_level'] ) {
 552 		$t_old_access_string = get_enum_element( 'access_levels', $p_old_user['access_level'] );
 553 		$t_new_access_string = get_enum_element( 'access_levels', $p_new_user['access_level'] );
 554 		$t_changes .= lang_get( 'access_level_label' ) . ' ' . $t_old_access_string . ' => ' . $t_new_access_string . "\n\n";
 555 	}
 556 
 557 	if( !empty( $t_changes ) ) {
 558 		$t_subject = '[' . config_get( 'window_title' ) . '] ' . lang_get( 'email_user_updated_subject' );
 559 		$t_updated_msg = lang_get( 'email_user_updated_msg' );
 560 		$t_message = $t_updated_msg . "\n\n" . config_get_global( 'path' ) . 'account_page.php' . "\n\n" . $t_changes;
 561 
 562 		if( null === email_store( $p_new_user['email'], $t_subject, $t_message ) ) {
 563 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Notification was NOT sent to ' . $p_new_user['username'] );
 564 		} else {
 565 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Account update notification sent to ' . $p_new_user['username'] . ' (' . $p_new_user['email'] . ')' );
 566 			if( config_get( 'email_send_using_cronjob' ) == OFF ) {
 567 				email_send_all();
 568 			}
 569 		}
 570 	}
 571 
 572 	lang_pop();
 573 }
 574 
 575 /**
 576  * Send password to user.
 577  *
 578  * @param int    $p_user_id      A valid user identifier.
 579  * @param string $p_confirm_hash Confirmation hash.
 580  * @param string $p_admin_name   Administrator name.
 581  *
 582  * @return void
 583  * @throws ClientException
 584  */
 585 function email_signup( $p_user_id, $p_confirm_hash, $p_admin_name = '' ) {
 586 	if( ( OFF == config_get( 'send_reset_password' ) ) || ( OFF == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) ) {
 587 		return;
 588 	}
 589 
 590 	#	@@@ thraxisp - removed to address #6084 - user won't have any settings yet,
 591 	#  use same language as display for the email
 592 	#  lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $p_user_id ) );
 593 	# retrieve the username and email
 594 	$t_username = user_get_username( $p_user_id );
 595 	$t_email = user_get_email( $p_user_id );
 596 
 597 	# Build Welcome Message
 598 	$t_subject = '[' . config_get( 'window_title' ) . '] ' . lang_get( 'new_account_subject' );
 599 
 600 	if( !empty( $p_admin_name ) ) {
 601 		$t_intro_text = sprintf( lang_get( 'new_account_greeting_admincreated' ), $p_admin_name, $t_username );
 602 	} else {
 603 		$t_intro_text = sprintf( lang_get( 'new_account_greeting' ), $t_username );
 604 	}
 605 
 606 	$t_message = $t_intro_text . "\n\n" . string_get_confirm_hash_url( $p_user_id, $p_confirm_hash ) . "\n\n" . lang_get( 'new_account_message' ) . "\n\n" . lang_get( 'new_account_do_not_reply' );
 607 
 608 	# Send signup email regardless of mail notification pref
 609 	# or else users won't be able to sign up
 610 	if( !is_blank( $t_email ) ) {
 611 		email_store( $t_email, $t_subject, $t_message, [], true );
 612 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Signup Email = %s, Hash = %s, User = @U%d', $t_email, $p_confirm_hash, $p_user_id );
 613 	}
 614 
 615 	# lang_pop(); # see above
 616 }
 617 
 618 /**
 619  * Send confirm_hash URL to let user reset their password.
 620  *
 621  * @param int    $p_user_id        A valid user identifier.
 622  * @param string $p_confirm_hash   Confirmation hash.
 623  * @param bool   $p_reset_by_admin True if password was reset by admin,
 624  *                                 False (default) for user request (lost password)
 625  *
 626  * @return void
 627  * @throws ClientException
 628  */
 629 function email_send_confirm_hash_url( $p_user_id, $p_confirm_hash, $p_reset_by_admin = false ) {
 630 	if( OFF == config_get( 'send_reset_password' ) ) {
 631 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'Password reset email notifications disabled.' );
 632 		return;
 633 	}
 634 	if( OFF == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) {
 635 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'email notifications disabled.' );
 636 		return;
 637 	}
 638 	if( !user_is_enabled( $p_user_id ) ) {
 639 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Password reset for user @U%d not sent, user is disabled', $p_user_id );
 640 		return;
 641 	}
 642 	lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $p_user_id ) );
 643 
 644 	# retrieve the username and email
 645 	$t_username = user_get_username( $p_user_id );
 646 	$t_email = user_get_email( $p_user_id );
 647 	$t_ip_addr = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? lang_get( 'unknown' );
 648 
 649 	$t_subject = '[' . config_get( 'window_title' ) . '] ' . lang_get( 'lost_password_subject' );
 650 
 651 	if( $p_reset_by_admin ) {
 652 		$t_message = lang_get( 'reset_request_admin_msg' );
 653 	} else {
 654 		$t_message = lang_get( 'reset_request_msg' );
 655 	}
 656 	$t_message .= "\n\n"
 657 		. string_get_confirm_hash_url( $p_user_id, $p_confirm_hash ) . "\n\n"
 658 		. lang_get( 'new_account_username' ) . ' ' . $t_username . "\n"
 659 		. lang_get( 'new_account_IP' ) . ' ' . $t_ip_addr . "\n\n"
 660 		. lang_get( 'new_account_do_not_reply' );
 661 
 662 	# Send password reset regardless of mail notification preferences
 663 	# or else users won't be able to receive their reset passwords
 664 	if( !is_blank( $t_email ) ) {
 665 		email_store( $t_email, $t_subject, $t_message, [], true );
 666 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Password reset for user @U%d sent to %s', $p_user_id, $t_email );
 667 	} else {
 668 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Password reset for user @U%d not sent, email is empty', $p_user_id );
 669 	}
 670 
 671 	lang_pop();
 672 }

 691 	lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $p_user_id ) );

 770  *                                           and included at the top of the email message.
 771  * @param array  $p_header_optional_params   Optional Parameters for $p_message_id
 772  *                                           (default none).
 773  * @param array   $p_extra_user_ids_to_email Array of additional users to email.
 774  *
 775  * @return void
 776  * @throws ClientException
 777  */
 778 function email_generic( $p_bug_id, $p_notify_type, $p_message_id = null, array $p_header_optional_params = [], array $p_extra_user_ids_to_email = array() ) {
 779 	# @todo yarick123: email_collect_recipients(...) will be completely rewritten to provide additional information such as language, user access,..
 780 	# @todo yarick123:sort recipients list by language to reduce switches between different languages
 781 	$t_recipients = email_collect_recipients( $p_bug_id, $p_notify_type, $p_extra_user_ids_to_email );

 785 /**
 786  * Sends a generic email to the specific set of recipients.
 787  *
 788  * @param int     $p_bug_id                 A bug identifier
 789  * @param string  $p_notify_type            Notification type
 790  * @param array   $p_recipients             Array of recipients (key: user id, value: email address)
 791  * @param int     $p_message_id             Message identifier
 792  * @param array   $p_header_optional_params Optional Parameters (default none)
 793  *
 794  * @return void
 795  * @throws ClientException
 796  */
 797 function email_generic_to_recipients( int $p_bug_id, string $p_notify_type, array $p_recipients, $p_message_id = null, array $p_header_optional_params = [] ) {
 798 	if( empty( $p_recipients ) ) {
 799 		return;
 800 	}
 801 
 802 	if( OFF == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) {
 803 		return;
 804 	}
 805 
 806 	ignore_user_abort( true );
 807 
 808 	bugnote_get_all_bugnotes( $p_bug_id );
 809 
 810 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 811 
 812 	# send email to every recipient
 813 	foreach( $p_recipients as $t_user_id => $t_user_email ) {
 814 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'Issue = #%d, Type = %s, Msg = \'%s\', User = @U%d, Email = \'%s\'.', $p_bug_id, $p_notify_type, $p_message_id, $t_user_id, $t_user_email );
 815 
 816 		# load (push) user language here as build_visible_bug_data assumes current language
 817 		lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $t_user_id, $t_project_id ) );
 818 
 819 		$t_visible_bug_data = email_build_visible_bug_data( $t_user_id, $p_bug_id, $p_message_id );
 820 		email_bug_info_to_one_user( $t_visible_bug_data, $p_message_id, $t_user_id, $p_header_optional_params );
 821 
 822 		lang_pop();
 823 	}
 824 }

 848 /**
 849  * Send notices when a relationship is ADDED.
 850  *
 851  * @param int  $p_bug_id           A bug identifier.
 852  * @param int  $p_related_bug_id   Related bug identifier.
 853  * @param int  $p_rel_type         Relationship type.
 854  * @param bool $p_email_for_source Should an email be triggered for source issue?
 855  *
 856  * @return void
 857  * @throws ClientException
 858  */
 859 function email_relationship_added( $p_bug_id, $p_related_bug_id, $p_rel_type, $p_email_for_source ) {
 860 	global $g_relationships;
 861 
 862 	if( !isset( $g_relationships[$p_rel_type] ) ) {
 863 		trigger_error( ERROR_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 864 	}
 865 
 866 	$t_rev_rel_type = relationship_get_complementary_type( $p_rel_type );
 867 	if( !isset( $g_relationships[$t_rev_rel_type] ) ) {
 868 		trigger_error( ERROR_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 869 	}
 870 
 871 	log_event(
 872 		LOG_EMAIL,
 873 		'Issue #%d relationship added to issue #%d (relationship type %s)',
 874 		$p_bug_id,
 875 		$p_related_bug_id,
 876 		$g_relationships[$p_rel_type]['#description'] );
 877 
 878 	# Source issue email notification. Should use the specified relationship message
 879 	if( $p_email_for_source ) {
 880 		$t_message_id = $g_relationships[$p_rel_type]['#notify_added'];
 881 		email_relationship_send( $p_bug_id, $p_related_bug_id, $t_message_id );
 882 	}
 883 
 884 	# Destination issue email notification. Should use the relationship reverse message
 885 	$t_message_id = $g_relationships[$t_rev_rel_type]['#notify_added'];
 886 	email_relationship_send( $p_related_bug_id, $p_bug_id, $t_message_id );
 887 }

 889 /**
 890  * Filter recipients to remove ones that don't have access to the specified bug.
 891  *
 892  * @param int   $p_bug_id     The bug id
 893  * @param array $p_recipients The recipients array (key: id, value: email)
 894  *
 895  * @return array The filtered list of recipients in same format
 896  *
 897  * @access private
 898  */
 899 function email_filter_recipients_for_bug( $p_bug_id, array $p_recipients ) {
 900 	$t_view_bug_threshold = config_get( 'view_bug_threshold' );
 901 
 902 	return array_filter( $p_recipients,
 903 		function( $t_recipient_id ) use ( $t_view_bug_threshold, $p_bug_id ) {
 904 			return access_has_bug_level( $t_view_bug_threshold, $p_bug_id, $t_recipient_id );
 905 		},
 906 		ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY
 907 	);
 908 }

 910 /**
 911  * Helper function to collect recipients and send relationship notifications.
 912  *
 913  * @param int    $p_bug_id
 914  * @param int    $p_related_bug_id
 915  * @param string $p_message_id
 916  *
 917  * @access private
 918  * @throws ClientException
 919  */
 920 function email_relationship_send( int $p_bug_id, int $p_related_bug_id, $p_message_id ) {
 921 	$t_recipients = email_collect_recipients( $p_bug_id, 'relation' );
 922 
 923 	# Recipient has to have access to both bugs to get the notification.
 924 	$t_recipients = email_filter_recipients_for_bug( $p_bug_id, $t_recipients );
 925 	$t_recipients = email_filter_recipients_for_bug( $p_related_bug_id, $t_recipients );
 926 
 927 	$t_opt = [ bug_format_id( $p_related_bug_id ) ];
 928 
 929 	email_generic_to_recipients( $p_bug_id, 'relation', $t_recipients, $p_message_id, $t_opt );
 930 }

 932 /**
 933  * Send notices when a relationship is DELETED.
 934  *
 935  * @param int $p_bug_id                  A bug identifier.
 936  * @param int $p_related_bug_id          Related bug identifier.
 937  * @param int $p_rel_type                Relationship type.
 938  * @param int $p_skip_email_for_issue_id Skip email for specified issue, otherwise 0.
 939  *
 940  * @return void
 941  * @throws ClientException
 942  */
 943 function email_relationship_deleted( $p_bug_id, $p_related_bug_id, $p_rel_type, $p_skip_email_for_issue_id = 0 ) {
 944 	global $g_relationships;
 945 	if( !isset( $g_relationships[$p_rel_type] ) ) {
 946 		trigger_error( ERROR_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 947 	}
 948 
 949 	$t_rev_rel_type = relationship_get_complementary_type( $p_rel_type );
 950 	if( !isset( $g_relationships[$t_rev_rel_type] ) ) {
 951 		trigger_error( ERROR_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 952 	}
 953 
 954 	log_event(
 955 		LOG_EMAIL,
 956 		'Issue #%d relationship to issue #%d (relationship type %s) deleted.',
 957 		$p_bug_id,
 958 		$p_related_bug_id,
 959 		$g_relationships[$p_rel_type]['#description'] );
 960 
 961 	# Source issue email notification. Should use the specified relationship message
 962 	if( $p_bug_id != $p_skip_email_for_issue_id ) {
 963 		$t_message_id = $g_relationships[$p_rel_type]['#notify_deleted'];
 964 		email_relationship_send( $p_bug_id, $p_related_bug_id, $t_message_id );
 965 	}
 966 
 967 	# Destination issue email notification. Should use the relationship reverse message
 968 	if( $p_bug_id != $p_related_bug_id && bug_exists( $p_related_bug_id) ) {
 969 		$t_message_id = $g_relationships[$t_rev_rel_type]['#notify_deleted'];
 970 		email_relationship_send( $p_related_bug_id, $p_bug_id, $t_message_id );
 971 	}
 972 }

 974 /**
 975  * Email related issues when a bug is deleted.
 976  *
 977  * This should be called before the bug is deleted.
 978  *
 979  * @param int $p_bug_id The id of the bug to be deleted.
 980  *
 981  * @return void
 982  * @throws ClientException
 983  */
 984 function email_relationship_bug_deleted( $p_bug_id ) {
 985 	$t_ignore = false;
 986 	$t_relationships = relationship_get_all( $p_bug_id, $t_ignore );
 987 	if( empty( $t_relationships ) ) {
 988 		return;
 989 	}
 990 
 991 	log_event( LOG_EMAIL, sprintf( 'Issue #%d has been deleted, sending notifications to related issues', $p_bug_id ) );
 992 
 993 	foreach( $t_relationships as $t_relationship ) {
 994 		$t_related_bug_id = $p_bug_id == $t_relationship->src_bug_id ?
 995 			$t_relationship->dest_bug_id : $t_relationship->src_bug_id;
 996 
 997 		$t_opt = array();
 998 		$t_opt[] = bug_format_id( $p_bug_id );
 999 		email_generic( $t_related_bug_id, 'handler', 'email_notification_title_for_action_related_issue_deleted', $t_opt );
1000 	}
1001 }

1004  * Send notices to all the handlers of the parent bugs when a child bug is RESOLVED.

1009  * @throws ClientException
1010  */
1011 function email_relationship_child_resolved( $p_bug_id ) {

1013 }

1015 /**
1016  * Send notices to all the handlers of the parent bugs when a child bug is CLOSED.
1017  *
1018  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
1019  *
1020  * @return void
1021  * @throws ClientException
1022  */
1023 function email_relationship_child_closed( $p_bug_id ) {
1024 	email_relationship_child_resolved_closed( $p_bug_id, 'email_notification_title_for_action_relationship_child_closed' );
1025 }

1027 /**
1028  * Send notices to all the handlers of the parent bugs still open when a child bug is resolved/closed.
1029  *
1030  * @param int $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
1031  * @param int $p_message_id A message identifier.
1032  *
1033  * @return void
1034  * @throws ClientException
1035  */
1036 function email_relationship_child_resolved_closed( $p_bug_id, $p_message_id ) {
1037 	# retrieve all the relationships in which the bug is the destination bug
1038 	$t_relationship = relationship_get_all_dest( $p_bug_id );
1039 	$t_relationship_count = count( $t_relationship );
1040 	if( $t_relationship_count == 0 ) {
1041 		# no parent bug found
1042 		return;
1043 	}
1044 
1045 	if( $p_message_id == 'email_notification_title_for_action_relationship_child_closed' ) {
1046 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, sprintf( 'Issue #%d child issue closed', $p_bug_id ) );
1047 	} else {
1048 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, sprintf( 'Issue #%d child issue resolved', $p_bug_id ) );
1049 	}
1050 
1051 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_relationship_count;$i++ ) {
1052 		if( $t_relationship[$i]->type == BUG_DEPENDANT ) {
1053 			$t_src_bug_id = $t_relationship[$i]->src_bug_id;
1054 			$t_status = bug_get_field( $t_src_bug_id, 'status' );
1055 			if( $t_status < config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold' ) ) {
1056 
1057 				# sent the notification just for parent bugs not resolved/closed
1058 				$t_opt = array();
1059 				$t_opt[] = bug_format_id( $p_bug_id );
1060 				email_generic( $t_src_bug_id, 'handler', $p_message_id, $t_opt );
1061 			}
1062 		}
1063 	}
1064 }

1123  * @return void

1125  */

1127 	log_event( LOG_EMAIL, sprintf( 'Issue #%d updated', $p_bug_id ) );
1128 	email_generic( $p_bug_id, 'updated', 'email_notification_title_for_action_bug_updated' );
1129 }

1143 /**
1144  * Send notices when a new bugnote.
1145  *
1146  * @param int   $p_bugnote_id       The bugnote id.
1147  * @param array $p_files            The array of file information (keys: name, size)
1148  * @param array $p_exclude_user_ids The id of users to exclude.
1149  *
1150  * @return void
1151  * @throws ClientException
1152  */
1153 function email_bugnote_add( $p_bugnote_id, $p_files = array(), $p_exclude_user_ids = array() ) {
1154 	if( OFF == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) {
1155 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'email notifications disabled.' );
1156 		return;
1157 	}
1158 
1159 	ignore_user_abort( true );
1160 
1161 	$t_bugnote = bugnote_get( $p_bugnote_id );
1162 
1163 	log_event( LOG_EMAIL, sprintf( 'Note ~%d added to issue #%d', $p_bugnote_id, $t_bugnote->bug_id ) );
1164 
1165 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $t_bugnote->bug_id, 'project_id' );
1166 	$t_date_submitted = bug_get_field( $t_bugnote->bug_id, 'date_submitted' );
1167 	$t_separator = config_get( 'email_separator2' );
1168 	$t_time_tracking_access_threshold = config_get( 'time_tracking_view_threshold' );
1169 	$t_view_attachments_threshold = config_get( 'view_attachments_threshold' );
1170 	$t_message_id = 'email_notification_title_for_action_bugnote_submitted';
1171 
1172 	$t_subject = email_build_subject( $t_bugnote->bug_id );
1173 
1174 	$t_recipients = email_collect_recipients( $t_bugnote->bug_id, 'bugnote', /* extra_user_ids */ array(), $p_bugnote_id );
1175 	$t_recipients_verbose = array();
1176 
1177 	# send email to every recipient
1178 	foreach( $t_recipients as $t_user_id => $t_user_email ) {
1179 		if( in_array( $t_user_id, $p_exclude_user_ids ) ) {
1180 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT, 'Issue = #%d, Note = ~%d, Type = %s, Msg = \'%s\', User = @U%d excluded, Email = \'%s\'.',
1181 				$t_bugnote->bug_id, $p_bugnote_id, 'bugnote', 'email_notification_title_for_action_bugnote_submitted', $t_user_id, $t_user_email );
1182 			continue;
1183 		}
1184 
1185 		# Load this here per user to allow overriding this per user, or even per user per project
1186 		if( config_get( 'email_notifications_verbose', /* default */ null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ) == ON ) {
1187 			$t_recipients_verbose[$t_user_id] = $t_user_email;
1188 			continue;
1189 		}
1190 
1191 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'Issue = #%d, Note = ~%d, Type = %s, Msg = \'%s\', User = @U%d, Email = \'%s\'.',
1192 			$t_bugnote->bug_id, $p_bugnote_id, 'bugnote', $t_message_id, $t_user_id, $t_user_email );
1193 
1194 		# load (push) user language
1195 		lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $t_user_id, $t_project_id ) );
1196 
1197 		$t_message = lang_get( 'email_notification_title_for_action_bugnote_submitted' ) . "\n\n";
1198 
1199 		$t_show_time_tracking = access_has_bug_level( $t_time_tracking_access_threshold, $t_bugnote->bug_id, $t_user_id );
1200 		$t_formatted_note = email_format_bugnote( $t_bugnote, $t_project_id, $t_show_time_tracking, $t_separator );
1201 		$t_message .= trim( $t_formatted_note ) . "\n";
1202 		$t_message .= $t_separator . "\n";
1203 
1204 		# Files attached
1205 		if( count( $p_files ) > 0 &&
1206 			access_has_bug_level( $t_view_attachments_threshold, $t_bugnote->bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
1207 			$t_message .= lang_get( 'bugnote_attached_files' ) . "\n";
1208 
1209 			foreach( $p_files as $t_file ) {
1210 				$t_message .= '- ' . $t_file['name'] . ' (' . number_format( $t_file['size'] ) .
1211 					' ' . lang_get( 'bytes' ) . ")\n";
1212 			}
1213 
1214 			$t_message .= $t_separator . "\n";
1215 		}
1216 
1217 		$t_contents = $t_message . "\n";
1218 
1219 		$t_mail_headers = [
1220 			'In-Reply-To' => email_generate_bug_md5( $t_bugnote->bug_id, $t_date_submitted )
1221 		];
1222 
1223 		email_store( $t_user_email, $t_subject, $t_contents, $t_mail_headers );
1224 
1225 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'queued bugnote email for note ~' . $p_bugnote_id .
1226 			' issue #' . $t_bugnote->bug_id . ' by U' . $t_user_id );
1227 
1228 		lang_pop();
1229 	}
1230 
1231 	# Send emails out for users that select verbose notifications
1232 	email_generic_to_recipients(
1233 		$t_bugnote->bug_id,
1234 		'bugnote',
1235 		$t_recipients_verbose,
1236 		$t_message_id
1237 	);
1238 }

1279 /**

1283  * @param int $p_prev_handler_id
1284  * @param int $p_new_handler_id
1285  *
1286  * @return void
1287  * @throws ClientException
1288  */
1289 function email_owner_changed($p_bug_id, $p_prev_handler_id, $p_new_handler_id ) {
1290 	if ( $p_prev_handler_id == 0 && $p_new_handler_id != 0 ) {
1291 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, sprintf( 'Issue #%d assigned to user @U%d.', $p_bug_id, $p_new_handler_id ) );
1292 	} else if ( $p_prev_handler_id != 0 && $p_new_handler_id == 0 ) {
1293 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL, sprintf( 'Issue #%d is no longer assigned to @U%d.', $p_bug_id, $p_prev_handler_id ) );
1294 	} else {
1295 		log_event(
1296 			LOG_EMAIL,
1297 			sprintf(
1298 				'Issue #%d is assigned to @U%d instead of @U%d.',
1299 				$p_bug_id,
1300 				$p_new_handler_id,
1301 				$p_prev_handler_id )
1302 		);
1303 	}
1304 
1305 	$t_message_id = $p_new_handler_id == NO_USER ?
1306 			'email_notification_title_for_action_bug_unassigned' :
1307 			'email_notification_title_for_action_bug_assigned';
1308 
1309 	$t_extra_user_ids_to_email = array();
1310 	if ( $p_prev_handler_id !== NO_USER && $p_prev_handler_id != $p_new_handler_id ) {
1311 		if ( email_notify_flag( 'owner', 'handler' ) == ON ) {
1312 			$t_extra_user_ids_to_email[] = $p_prev_handler_id;
1313 		}
1314 	}
1315 
1316 	email_generic( $p_bug_id, 'owner', $t_message_id, /* headers */ [], $t_extra_user_ids_to_email );
1317 }
