1346 /**
1347  * Store email in queue for sending.
1348  *
1349  * @param string $p_recipient Email recipient address.
1350  * @param string $p_subject   Subject of email message.
1351  * @param string $p_message   Body text of email message.
1352  * @param array  $p_headers   Array of additional headers to send with the email.
1353  * @param bool   $p_force     True to force sending of emails in shutdown function,
1354  *                            even when using cronjob
1355  * @param array  $p_cc        Array of cc recipients.
1356  * @param array  $p_bcc       Array of bcc recipients.
1357  *
1358  * @return integer|null
1359  */
1360 function email_store( string $p_recipient, string $p_subject, string $p_message, array $p_headers = [], $p_force = false, $p_cc = [], $p_bcc = [] ) {
1361 	global $g_email_shutdown_processing;
1362 
1363 	$t_recipient = trim( $p_recipient );
1364 	$t_subject = string_email( trim( $p_subject ) );
1365 	$t_message = string_email_links( trim( $p_message ) );
1366 
1367 	# short-circuit if no recipient is defined, or email disabled
1368 	# note that this may cause signup messages not to be sent
1369 	if( is_blank( $p_recipient ) || ( OFF == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) ) {
1370 		return null;
1371 	}
1372 
1373 	$t_email_data = new EmailData;
1374 
1375 	$t_email_data->email = $t_recipient;
1376 	$t_email_data->subject = $t_subject;
1377 	$t_email_data->body = $t_message;
1378 	$t_email_data->metadata = array();
1379 	$t_email_data->metadata['headers'] = $p_headers;
1380 	$t_email_data->metadata['cc'] = $p_cc;
1381 	$t_email_data->metadata['bcc'] = $p_bcc;
1382 
1383 	# Urgent = 1, Not Urgent = 5, Disable = 0
1384 	$t_email_data->metadata['charset'] = 'utf-8';
1385 	$t_email_id = email_queue_add( $t_email_data );
1386 
1387 	# Set the email processing flag for the shutdown function
1388 	$g_email_shutdown_processing |= EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_GENERATED;
1389 	if( $p_force ) {
1390 		$g_email_shutdown_processing |= EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_FORCE;
1391 	}
1392 
1393 	return $t_email_id;
1394 }
1395 
1396 /**
1397  * This function sends all the emails that are stored in the queue.
1398  *
1399  * It will be called
1400  * - immediately after queueing messages in case of synchronous emails
1401  * - from a cronjob in case of asynchronous emails
1402  * If a failure occurs, then the function exits.
1403  *
1404  * @param bool $p_delete_on_failure Indicates whether to remove email from queue on failure (default false).
1405  *
1406  * @return void
1407  *
1408  * @todo In case of synchronous email sending, we may get a race condition where two requests send the same email.
1409  */
1410 function email_send_all( $p_delete_on_failure = false ) : void {
1411 	$t_ids = email_queue_get_ids();
1412 
1413 	log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'Processing e-mail queue (' . count( $t_ids ) . ' messages)' );
1414 
1415 	foreach( $t_ids as $t_id ) {
1416 		$t_email_data = email_queue_get( $t_id );
1417 		$t_start = microtime( true );
1418 
1419 		# check if email was not found.  This can happen if another request picks up the email first and sends it.
1420 		if( $t_email_data === false ) {
1421 			$t_email_sent = true;
1422 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'Message $t_id has already been sent' );
1423 		} else {
1424 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'Sending message ' . $t_id );
1425 			$t_email_sent = email_send( $t_email_data );
1426 		}
1427 
1428 		if( !$t_email_sent ) {
1429 			# Delete emails that were submitted more than N days ago
1430 			$t_submitted = (int)$t_email_data->submitted;
1431 			$t_delete_after_in_days = (int)config_get_global( 'email_retry_in_days' );
1432 			$t_retry_cutoff = time() - ( $t_delete_after_in_days * 24 * 60 * 60 );
1433 			if( $p_delete_on_failure || $t_submitted < $t_retry_cutoff ) {
1434 				$t_reason = $p_delete_on_failure ? 'delete on failure' : 'retry expired';
1435 				email_queue_delete( $t_email_data->email_id, $t_reason );
1436 			}
1437 
1438 			# If unable to place the email in the email server queue and more
1439 			# than 5 seconds have elapsed, then we assume that the server
1440 			# connection is down, hence no point to continue trying with the
1441 			# rest of the emails.
1442 			if( microtime( true ) - $t_start > 5 ) {
1443 				log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Server not responding for 5 seconds, aborting' );
1444 				break;
1445 			}
1446 		}
1447 	}
1448 }
1449 
1450 /**
1451  * This function sends an email message based on the supplied email data.
1452  *
1453  * @param EmailData $p_email_data Email Data object representing the email to send.
1454  *
1455  * @return boolean
1456  */
1457 function email_send( EmailData $p_email_data ) : bool {
1458 	$t_msg = new EmailMessage();
1459 
1460 	$t_recipient = trim( $p_email_data->email );
1461 	$t_body = string_email_links( trim( $p_email_data->body ) );
1462 	$t_debug_email = config_get_global( 'debug_email' );
1463 	if( !empty( $t_debug_email ) ) {
1464 		$t_body = 'To: ' . $t_recipient . "\n\n" . $t_body;
1465 		$t_recipient = $t_debug_email;
1466 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, "Using debug email '$t_debug_email'" );
1467 	}
1468 
1469 	$t_body = make_lf_crlf( $t_body );
1470 
1471 	# @@@ should this be the current language (for the recipient) or the default one (for the user running the command) (thraxisp)
1472 	$t_lang = config_get_global( 'default_language' );
1473 	if( 'auto' == $t_lang ) {
1474 		$t_lang = config_get_global( 'fallback_language' );
1475 	}
1476 
1477 	$t_msg->to = [ $t_recipient ];
1478 	$t_msg->subject = string_email( trim( $p_email_data->subject ) );
1479 	$t_msg->text = $t_body;
1480 	$t_msg->lang = $t_lang;
1481 
1482 	$t_msg->cc = [];
1483 	if( isset( $p_email_data->metadata['cc'] ) && $p_email_data->metadata['cc'] ) {
1484 		foreach( $p_email_data->metadata['cc'] as $cc ) {
1485 			$t_msg->cc[] = trim( $cc );
1486 		}
1487 	}
1488 
1489 	$t_msg->bcc = [];
1490 	if( isset( $p_email_data->metadata['bcc'] ) && $p_email_data->metadata['bcc'] ) {
1491 		foreach( $p_email_data->metadata['bcc'] as $bcc ) {
1492 			$t_msg->bcc[] = trim( $bcc );
1493 		}
1494 	}
1495 
1496 	$t_hostname = $p_email_data->metadata['hostname'] ?? '';
1497 
1498 	if( empty( $t_hostname ) ) {
1499 		if( isset( $_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] ) ) {
1500 			$t_hostname = $_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'];
1501 		} else {
1502 			$t_address = explode( '@', config_get( 'from_email' ) );
1503 			if( isset( $t_address[1] ) ) {
1504 				$t_hostname = $t_address[1];
1505 			}
1506 		}
1507 	}
1508 
1509 	$t_msg->hostname = $t_hostname;
1510 
1511 	$t_msg->charset = $p_email_data->metadata['charset'];
1512 
1513 	# Expected Headers
1514 	# - Auto-Submitted
1515 	# - X-Auto-Response-Suppress
1516 	# - Message-ID
1517 	# - In-Reply-To
1518 	# - ... possibly other custom headers
1519 
1520 	$t_headers = [
1521 		'Auto-Submitted' => 'auto-generated',
1522 		'X-Auto-Response-Suppress' => 'All',
1523 	];
1524 
1525 	if( isset( $p_email_data->metadata['headers'] ) && is_array( $p_email_data->metadata['headers'] ) ) {
1526 		$t_headers = array_merge( $t_headers, $p_email_data->metadata['headers'] );
1527 	}
1528 
1529 	$t_msg->headers = [];
1530 	foreach( $t_headers as $t_key => $t_value ) {
1531 		switch( strtolower( $t_key ) ) {
1532 			case 'message-id':
1533 				# Note: hostname can never be blank here as we set metadata['hostname']
1534 				# in email_store() where mail gets queued.
1535 				if( !strchr( $t_value, '@' ) && !is_blank( $t_msg->hostname ) ) {
1536 					$t_value = $t_value . '@' . $t_msg->hostname;
1537 				}
1538 
1539 				$t_value = '<' . $t_value . '>';
1540 				break;
1541 			case 'in-reply-to':
1542 				if( !preg_match( '/<.+@.+>/m', $t_value ) ) {
1543 					$t_value = '<' . $t_value . '@' . $t_msg->hostname . '>';
1544 				}
1545 				break;
1546 		}
1547 
1548 		$t_msg->headers[$t_key] = $t_value;
1549 	}
1550 
1551 	try {
1552 		$t_sender = email_create_provider();
1553 		$t_success = $t_sender->send( $t_msg );
1554 
1555 		# if email is sent successfully, then delete it from the queue
1556 		if( $t_success && $p_email_data->email_id > 0 ) {
1557 			email_queue_delete( $p_email_data->email_id );
1558 		}
1559 	} catch ( Exception $e ) {
1560 		$t_success = false;
1561 	}
1562 
1563 	return $t_success;
1564 }
1565 
1566 /**
1567  * Create Email Send Provider object.
1568  *
1569  * @return EmailSender The email sender instance to use.
1570  * @throws Exception If configured provider can't be found.
1571  */
1572 function email_create_provider() : EmailSender {
1573 	/** @var EmailSender $s_provider */
1574 	static $s_provider = null;
1575 
1576 	if( is_null( $s_provider ) ) {
1577 		$s_provider = event_signal( 'EVENT_EMAIL_CREATE_SEND_PROVIDER', [] );
1578 
1579 		if( is_null( $s_provider ) ) {
1580 			require_once __DIR__ . '/classes/EmailSenderPhpMailer.class.php';
1581 			$s_provider = new EmailSenderPhpMailer();
1582 		}
1583 	}
1584 
1585 	return $s_provider;
1586 }
1587 
1588 /**
1589  * Formats the subject correctly.
1590  *
1591  * We include the project name, bug id, and summary.
1592  *
1593  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
1594  *
1595  * @return string
1596  * @throws ClientException
1597  */
1598 function email_build_subject( $p_bug_id ) {
1599 	# grab the project name
1600 	$p_project_name = project_get_field( bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' ), 'name' );
1601 
1602 	# grab the subject (summary)
1603 	$p_subject = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'summary' );
1604 
1605 	# pad the bug id with zeros
1606 	$t_bug_id = bug_format_id( $p_bug_id );
1607 
1608 	# build standard subject string
1609 	$t_email_subject = '[' . $p_project_name . ' ' . $t_bug_id . ']: ' . $p_subject;
1610 
1611 	# update subject as defined by plugins
1612 	return event_signal( 'EVENT_DISPLAY_EMAIL_BUILD_SUBJECT', $t_email_subject, array( $p_bug_id ) );
1613 }
1614 
1615 /**
1616  * Clean up LF to CRLF.
1617  *
1618  * @param string $p_string String to convert line feeds on.
1619  *
1620  * @return string
1621  */
1622 function make_lf_crlf( $p_string ) {
1623 	$t_string = str_replace( "\n", "\r\n", $p_string );
1624 	return str_replace( "\r\r\n", "\r\n", $t_string );
1625 }
1626 
1627 /**
1628  * Send a bug reminder to the given user(s).
1629  *
1630  * @param int|array $p_recipients User id or list of user ids array to send reminder to.
1631  * @param int       $p_bug_id     Issue for which the reminder is sent.
1632  * @param string    $p_message    Optional message to add to the e-mail.
1633  *
1634  * @return array List of users ids to whom the reminder e-mail was actually sent
1635  * @throws ClientException
1636  */
1637 function email_bug_reminder( $p_recipients, $p_bug_id, $p_message ) {
1638 	if( OFF == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) {
1639 		return array();
1640 	}
1641 
1642 	if( !is_array( $p_recipients ) ) {
1643 		$p_recipients = array(
1644 			$p_recipients,
1645 		);
1646 	}
1647 
1648 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
1649 	$t_sender_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1650 	$t_sender = user_get_name( $t_sender_id );
1651 
1652 	$t_subject = email_build_subject( $p_bug_id );
1653 	$t_date = date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ) );
1654 
1655 	$t_result = array();
1656 	foreach( $p_recipients as $t_recipient ) {
1657 		lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $t_recipient, $t_project_id ) );
1658 
1659 		$t_email = user_get_email( $t_recipient );
1660 
1661 		if( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'show_user_email_threshold' ), $t_project_id, $t_recipient ) ) {
1662 			$t_sender_email = ' <' . user_get_email( $t_sender_id ) . '>';
1663 		} else {
1664 			$t_sender_email = '';
1665 		}
1666 		$t_header = "\n" . lang_get( 'on_date' ) . ' ' . $t_date . ', ' . $t_sender . ' ' . $t_sender_email . lang_get( 'sent_you_this_reminder_about' ) . ': ' . "\n\n";
1667 		$t_contents = $t_header . string_get_bug_view_url_with_fqdn( $p_bug_id ) . " \n\n" . $p_message;
1668 
1669 		$t_id = email_store( $t_email, $t_subject, $t_contents );
1670 		if( $t_id !== null ) {
1671 			$t_result[] = $t_recipient;
1672 		}
1673 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'queued reminder email ' . $t_id . ' for U' . $t_recipient );
1674 
1675 		lang_pop();
1676 	}
1677 
1678 	return $t_result;
1679 }
1680 
1681 /**
1682  * Send a notification to users that were mentioned in an issue.
1683  *
1684  * @param int    $p_bug_id                   Issue for which the reminder is sent.
1685  * @param array  $p_mention_user_ids         User id or list of user ids array.
1686  * @param string $p_message                  Optional message to add to the e-mail.
1687  * @param array  $p_removed_mention_user_ids The users that were removed due to lack of access.
1688  *
1689  * @return array        List of users ids to whom the mentioned e-mail were actually sent
1690  * @throws ClientException
1691  */
1692 function email_user_mention( $p_bug_id, $p_mention_user_ids, $p_message, $p_removed_mention_user_ids = array() ) {
1693 	if( OFF == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) {
1694 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'email notifications disabled.' );
1695 		return array();
1696 	}
1697 
1698 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
1699 	$t_sender_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1700 	$t_sender = user_get_name( $t_sender_id );
1701 
1702 	$t_subject = email_build_subject( $p_bug_id );
1703 	$t_date = date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ) );
1704 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1705 	$t_users_processed = array();
1706 
1707 	foreach( $p_removed_mention_user_ids as $t_removed_mention_user_id ) {
1708 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'skipped mention email for U' . $t_removed_mention_user_id . ' (no access to issue or note).' );
1709 	}
1710 
1711 	$t_result = array();
1712 	foreach( $p_mention_user_ids as $t_mention_user_id ) {
1713 		# Don't trigger mention emails for self mentions
1714 		if( $t_mention_user_id == $t_user_id ) {
1715 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'skipped mention email for U' . $t_mention_user_id . ' (self-mention).' );
1716 			continue;
1717 		}
1718 
1719 		# Don't process a user more than once
1720 		if( isset( $t_users_processed[$t_mention_user_id] ) ) {
1721 			continue;
1722 		}
1723 
1724 		$t_users_processed[$t_mention_user_id] = true;
1725 
1726 		# Don't email mention notifications to disabled users.
1727 		if( !user_is_enabled( $t_mention_user_id ) ) {
1728 			continue;
1729 		}
1730 
1731 		lang_push( user_pref_get_language( $t_mention_user_id, $t_project_id ) );
1732 
1733 		$t_email = user_get_email( $t_mention_user_id );
1734 
1735 		if( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'show_user_email_threshold' ), $t_project_id, $t_mention_user_id ) ) {
1736 			$t_sender_email = ' <' . user_get_email( $t_sender_id ) . '> ';
1737 		} else {
1738 			$t_sender_email = '';
1739 		}
1740 
1741 		$t_complete_subject = sprintf( lang_get( 'mentioned_in' ), $t_subject );
1742 		$t_header = "\n" . lang_get( 'on_date' ) . ' ' . $t_date . ', ' . $t_sender . ' ' . $t_sender_email . lang_get( 'mentioned_you' ) . "\n\n";
1743 		$t_contents = $t_header . string_get_bug_view_url_with_fqdn( $p_bug_id ) . " \n\n" . $p_message;
1744 
1745 		$t_id = email_store( $t_email, $t_complete_subject, $t_contents );
1746 		if( $t_id !== null ) {
1747 			$t_result[] = $t_mention_user_id;
1748 		}
1749 
1750 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, 'queued mention email ' . $t_id . ' for U' . $t_mention_user_id );
1751 
1752 		lang_pop();
1753 	}
1754 
1755 	return $t_result;
1756 }
1757 
1758 /**
1759  * Send bug info to given user.
1760  *
1761  * @param array      $p_visible_bug_data       Array of bug data information.
1762  * @param string     $p_message_id             A message identifier.
1763  * @param int        $p_user_id                A valid user identifier.
1764  * @param array|null $p_header_optional_params Array of additional email headers.
1765  *
1766  * @return void
1767  * @throws ClientException
1768  */
1769 function email_bug_info_to_one_user( array $p_visible_bug_data, string $p_message_id, int $p_user_id, array $p_header_optional_params = [] ) {
1770 	$t_user_email = user_get_email( $p_user_id );
1771 
1772 	# check whether email should be sent
1773 	# @@@ can be email field empty? if yes - then it should be handled here
1774 	if( ON !== config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) || is_blank( $t_user_email ) ) {
1775 		return;
1776 	}
1777 
1778 	# build subject
1779 	$t_subject = email_build_subject( $p_visible_bug_data['email_bug'] );
1780 
1781 	# build message
1782 	$t_message = lang_get_defaulted( $p_message_id );
1783 
1784 	if( $p_header_optional_params ) {
1785 		$t_message = vsprintf( $t_message, $p_header_optional_params );
1786 	}
1787 
1788 	if( ( $t_message !== null ) && ( !is_blank( $t_message ) ) ) {
1789 		$t_message .= " \n";
1790 	}
1791 
1792 	$t_message .= email_format_bug_message( $p_visible_bug_data );
1793 
1794 	# build headers
1795 	$t_bug_id = $p_visible_bug_data['email_bug'];
1796 	$t_message_md5 = email_generate_bug_md5( $t_bug_id, $p_visible_bug_data['email_date_submitted'] );
1797 	$t_mail_headers = array(
1798 		'keywords' => $p_visible_bug_data['set_category'],
1799 	);
1800 	if( $p_message_id == 'email_notification_title_for_action_bug_submitted' ) {
1801 		$t_mail_headers['Message-ID'] = $t_message_md5;
1802 	} else {
1803 		$t_mail_headers['In-Reply-To'] = $t_message_md5;
1804 	}
1805 
1806 	# send mail
1807 	email_store( $t_user_email, $t_subject, $t_message, $t_mail_headers );
1808 }
1809 
1810 /**
1811  * Generates a formatted note to be used in email notifications.
1812  *
1813  * @param BugnoteData $p_bugnote              The bugnote object.
1814  * @param int         $p_project_id           The project id
1815  * @param bool        $p_show_time_tracking   True to show time tracking, false otherwise.
1816  * @param string      $p_horizontal_separator The horizontal line separator to use.
1817  * @param string      $p_date_format          The date format to use.
1818  *
1819  * @return string The formatted note.
1820  */
1821 function email_format_bugnote( $p_bugnote, $p_project_id, $p_show_time_tracking, $p_horizontal_separator, $p_date_format = null ) {
1822 	$t_date_format = ( $p_date_format === null ) ? config_get( 'normal_date_format' ) : $p_date_format;
1823 
1824 	$t_last_modified = date( $t_date_format, $p_bugnote->last_modified );
1825 
1826 	$t_formatted_bugnote_id = bugnote_format_id( $p_bugnote->id );
1827 	$t_bugnote_link = string_process_bugnote_link( config_get( 'bugnote_link_tag' ) . $p_bugnote->id, false, false, true );
1828 
1829 	if( $p_show_time_tracking && $p_bugnote->time_tracking > 0 ) {
1830 		$t_time_tracking = ' ' . lang_get( 'time_tracking' ) . ' ' . db_minutes_to_hhmm( $p_bugnote->time_tracking ) . "\n";
1831 	} else {
1832 		$t_time_tracking = '';
1833 	}
1834 
1835 	if( user_exists( $p_bugnote->reporter_id ) ) {
1836 		$t_access_level = access_get_project_level( $p_project_id, $p_bugnote->reporter_id );
1837 		$t_access_level_string = ' (' . access_level_get_string( $t_access_level ) . ')';
1838 	} else {
1839 		$t_access_level_string = '';
1840 	}
1841 
1842 	$t_private = ( $p_bugnote->view_state == VS_PUBLIC ) ? '' : ' (' . lang_get( 'private' ) . ')';
1843 
1844 	$t_string = ' (' . $t_formatted_bugnote_id . ') ' . user_get_name( $p_bugnote->reporter_id ) .
1845 		$t_access_level_string . ' - ' . $t_last_modified . $t_private . "\n" .
1846 		$t_time_tracking . ' ' . $t_bugnote_link;
1847 
1848 	$t_message  = $p_horizontal_separator . " \n";
1849 	$t_message .= $t_string . " \n";
1850 	$t_message .= $p_horizontal_separator . " \n";
1851 	$t_message .= $p_bugnote->note . " \n";
1852 
1853 	return $t_message;
1854 }
1855 
1856 /**
1857  * Build the bug info part of the message.
1858  *
1859  * @param array $p_visible_bug_data Bug data array to format.
1860  *
1861  * @return string
1862  */
1863 function email_format_bug_message( array $p_visible_bug_data ) {
1864 	$t_normal_date_format = config_get( 'normal_date_format' );
1865 	$t_complete_date_format = config_get( 'complete_date_format' );
1866 
1867 	$t_email_separator1 = config_get( 'email_separator1' );
1868 	$t_email_separator2 = config_get( 'email_separator2' );
1869 	$t_email_padding_length = config_get( 'email_padding_length' );
1870 
1871 	$p_visible_bug_data['email_date_submitted'] = date( $t_complete_date_format, $p_visible_bug_data['email_date_submitted'] );
1872 	$p_visible_bug_data['email_last_modified'] = date( $t_complete_date_format, $p_visible_bug_data['email_last_modified'] );
1873 
1874 	$t_message = $t_email_separator1 . " \n";
1875 
1876 	if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data['email_bug_view_url'] ) ) {
1877 		$t_message .= $p_visible_bug_data['email_bug_view_url'] . " \n";
1878 		$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n";
1879 	}
1880 
1881 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_reporter' );
1882 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_handler' );
1883 	$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n";
1884 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_project' );
1885 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_bug' );
1886 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_category' );
1887 
1888 	if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data['email_tag'] ) ) {
1889 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_tag' );
1890 	}
1891 
1892 	if ( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_reproducibility' ] ) ) {
1893 		$p_visible_bug_data['email_reproducibility'] = get_enum_element( 'reproducibility', $p_visible_bug_data['email_reproducibility'] );
1894 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_reproducibility' );
1895 	}
1896 		
1897 	if ( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_severity' ] ) ) {
1898 		$p_visible_bug_data['email_severity'] = get_enum_element( 'severity', $p_visible_bug_data['email_severity'] );
1899 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_severity' );
1900 	}
1901 
1902 	if ( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_priority' ] ) ) {
1903 		$p_visible_bug_data['email_priority'] = get_enum_element( 'priority', $p_visible_bug_data['email_priority'] );
1904 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_priority' );
1905 	}
1906 
1907 	if ( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_status' ] ) ) {
1908 		$t_status = $p_visible_bug_data['email_status'];
1909 		$p_visible_bug_data['email_status'] = get_enum_element( 'status', $t_status );	
1910 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_status' );
1911 	}
1912 
1913 	if ( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_target_version' ] ) ) {	
1914 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_target_version' );
1915 	}
1916 
1917 	# custom fields formatting
1918 	foreach( $p_visible_bug_data['custom_fields'] as $t_custom_field_name => $t_custom_field_data ) {
1919 		$t_message .= utf8_str_pad( lang_get_defaulted( $t_custom_field_name ) . ': ', $t_email_padding_length );
1920 		$t_message .= string_custom_field_value_for_email( $t_custom_field_data['value'], $t_custom_field_data['type'] );
1921 		$t_message .= " \n";
1922 	}
1923 
1924 	# end foreach custom field
1925 
1926 	if( isset( $t_status ) && config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold' ) <= $t_status ) {
1927 		
1928 		if ( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_resolution' ] ) ) {
1929 			$p_visible_bug_data['email_resolution'] = get_enum_element( 'resolution', $p_visible_bug_data['email_resolution'] );
1930 			$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_resolution' );
1931 		}
1932 			
1933 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_fixed_in_version' );
1934 	}
1935 	$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n";
1936 
1937 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_date_submitted' );
1938 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_last_modified' );
1939 
1940 	if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data['email_due_date'] ) ) {
1941 		$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_due_date' );
1942 	}
1943 
1944 	$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n";
1945 
1946 	$t_message .= email_format_attribute( $p_visible_bug_data, 'email_summary' );
1947 
1948 	$t_message .= lang_get( 'email_description' ) . ": \n" . $p_visible_bug_data['email_description'] . "\n";
1949 
1950 	if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_steps_to_reproduce' ] ) && !is_blank( $p_visible_bug_data['email_steps_to_reproduce'] ) ) {
1951 		$t_message .= "\n" . lang_get( 'email_steps_to_reproduce' ) . ": \n" . $p_visible_bug_data['email_steps_to_reproduce'] . "\n";
1952 	}
1953 
1954 	if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data[ 'email_additional_information' ] ) && !is_blank( $p_visible_bug_data['email_additional_information'] ) ) {
1955 		$t_message .= "\n" . lang_get( 'email_additional_information' ) . ": \n" . $p_visible_bug_data['email_additional_information'] . "\n";
1956 	}
1957 
1958 	if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data['relations'] ) ) {
1959 		if( $p_visible_bug_data['relations'] != '' ) {
1960 			$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . "\n" . utf8_str_pad( lang_get( 'bug_relationships' ), 20 ) . utf8_str_pad( lang_get( 'id' ), 8 ) . lang_get( 'summary' ) . "\n" . $t_email_separator2 . "\n" . $p_visible_bug_data['relations'];
1961 		}
1962 	}
1963 
1964 	# Sponsorship
1965 	if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data['sponsorship_total'] ) && ( $p_visible_bug_data['sponsorship_total'] > 0 ) ) {
1966 		$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n";
1967 		$t_message .= sprintf( lang_get( 'total_sponsorship_amount' ), sponsorship_format_amount( $p_visible_bug_data['sponsorship_total'] ) ) . "\n\n";
1968 
1969 		if( isset( $p_visible_bug_data['sponsorships'] ) ) {
1970 			foreach( $p_visible_bug_data['sponsorships'] as $t_sponsorship ) {
1971 				$t_date_added = date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ), $t_sponsorship->date_submitted );
1972 
1973 				$t_message .= $t_date_added . ': ';
1974 				$t_message .= user_get_name( $t_sponsorship->user_id );
1975 				$t_message .= ' (' . sponsorship_format_amount( $t_sponsorship->amount ) . ')' . " \n";
1976 			}
1977 		}
1978 	}
1979 
1980 	$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n\n";
1981 
1982 	# format bugnotes
1983 	foreach( $p_visible_bug_data['bugnotes'] as $t_bugnote ) {
1984 		# Show time tracking is always true, since data has already been filtered out when creating the bug visible data.
1985 		$t_message .= email_format_bugnote( $t_bugnote, $p_visible_bug_data['email_project_id'],
1986 				/* show_time_tracking */ true,  $t_email_separator2, $t_normal_date_format ) . "\n";
1987 	}
1988 
1989 	# format history
1990 	if( array_key_exists( 'history', $p_visible_bug_data ) ) {
1991 		$t_message .= lang_get( 'bug_history' ) . " \n";
1992 		$t_message .= utf8_str_pad( lang_get( 'date_modified' ), 17 ) . utf8_str_pad( lang_get( 'username' ), 15 ) . utf8_str_pad( lang_get( 'field' ), 25 ) . utf8_str_pad( lang_get( 'change' ), 20 ) . " \n";
1993 
1994 		$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n";
1995 
1996 		foreach( $p_visible_bug_data['history'] as $t_raw_history_item ) {
1997 			$t_localized_item = history_localize_item(
1998 				$t_raw_history_item['bug_id'],
1999 				$t_raw_history_item['field'],
2000 				$t_raw_history_item['type'],
2001 				$t_raw_history_item['old_value'],
2002 				$t_raw_history_item['new_value'],
2003 				false
2004 			);
2005 
2006 			$t_message .= utf8_str_pad( date( $t_normal_date_format, $t_raw_history_item['date'] ), 17 ) . utf8_str_pad( $t_raw_history_item['username'], 15 ) . utf8_str_pad( $t_localized_item['note'], 25 ) . utf8_str_pad( $t_localized_item['change'], 20 ) . "\n";
2007 		}
2008 		$t_message .= $t_email_separator1 . " \n\n";
2009 	}
2010 
2011 	return $t_message;
2012 }
2013 
2014 /**
2015  * Format email attribute for display.
2016  *
2017  * If $p_visible_bug_data contains specified attribute the function
2018  * returns concatenated translated attribute name and original
2019  * attribute value. Else return empty string.
2020  *
2021  * @param array  $p_visible_bug_data Visible Bug Data array.
2022  * @param string $p_attribute_id     Attribute ID.
2023  *
2024  * @return string
2025  */
2026 function email_format_attribute( array $p_visible_bug_data, $p_attribute_id ) {
2027 	if( array_key_exists( $p_attribute_id, $p_visible_bug_data ) ) {
2028 		return utf8_str_pad( lang_get( $p_attribute_id ) . ': ', config_get( 'email_padding_length' ) )
2029 			. $p_visible_bug_data[$p_attribute_id] . "\n";
2030 	}
2031 	return '';
2032 }

2034 /**
2035  * Build the bug raw data visible for specified user to be translated and sent by email to the user
2036  *
2037  * Filter the bug data according to user access level.
2038  * @see email_format_bug_message()
2039  *
2040  * @param int    $p_user_id    A user identifier.
2041  * @param int    $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
2042  * @param string $p_message_id A message identifier.
2043  *
2044  * @return array Bug data
2045  * @throws ClientException
2046  */
2047 function email_build_visible_bug_data( $p_user_id, $p_bug_id, $p_message_id ) {
2048 	# Override current user with user to construct bug data for.
2049 	# This is to make sure that APIs that check against current user (e.g. relationship) work correctly.
2050 	$t_current_user_id = current_user_set( $p_user_id );
2051 
2052 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
2053 	$t_user_access_level = user_get_access_level( $p_user_id, $t_project_id );
2054 	$t_user_bugnote_order = user_pref_get_pref( $p_user_id, 'bugnote_order' );
2055 	$t_user_bugnote_limit = user_pref_get_pref( $p_user_id, 'email_bugnote_limit' );
2056 
2057 	$t_row = bug_get_extended_row( $p_bug_id );
2058 	$t_bug_data = array();
2059 
2060 	$t_bug_view_fields = config_get( 'bug_view_page_fields', null, $p_user_id, $t_row['project_id'] );
2061 
2062 	$t_bug_data['email_bug'] = $p_bug_id;
2063 
2064 	if( $p_message_id !== 'email_notification_title_for_action_bug_deleted' ) {
2065 		$t_bug_data['email_bug_view_url'] = string_get_bug_view_url_with_fqdn( $p_bug_id );
2066 	}
2067 
2068 	if( access_compare_level( $t_user_access_level, config_get( 'view_handler_threshold' ) ) ) {
2069 		if( 0 != $t_row['handler_id'] ) {
2070 			$t_bug_data['email_handler'] = user_get_name( $t_row['handler_id'] );
2071 		} else {
2072 			$t_bug_data['email_handler'] = '';
2073 		}
2074 	}
2075 
2076 	$t_bug_data['email_reporter'] = user_get_name( $t_row['reporter_id'] );
2077 	$t_bug_data['email_project_id'] = $t_row['project_id'];
2078 	$t_bug_data['email_project'] = project_get_field( $t_row['project_id'], 'name' );
2079 
2080 	$t_category_name = category_full_name( $t_row['category_id'], false );
2081 	$t_bug_data['email_category'] = $t_category_name;
2082 
2083 	$t_tag_rows = tag_bug_get_attached( $p_bug_id );
2084 	if( in_array( 'tags', $t_bug_view_fields ) && !empty( $t_tag_rows ) && access_compare_level( $t_user_access_level, config_get( 'tag_view_threshold' ) ) ) {
2085 		$t_bug_data['email_tag'] = '';
2086 
2087 		foreach( $t_tag_rows as $t_tag ) {
2088 			$t_bug_data['email_tag'] .= $t_tag['name'] . ', ';
2089 		}
2090 
2091 		$t_bug_data['email_tag'] = trim( $t_bug_data['email_tag'], ', ' );
2092 	}
2093 
2094 	$t_bug_data['email_date_submitted'] = $t_row['date_submitted'];
2095 	$t_bug_data['email_last_modified'] = $t_row['last_updated'];
2096 
2097 	if( !date_is_null( $t_row['due_date'] ) && access_compare_level( $t_user_access_level, config_get( 'due_date_view_threshold' ) ) ) {
2098 		$t_bug_data['email_due_date'] = date( config_get( 'short_date_format' ), $t_row['due_date'] );
2099 	}
2100 
2101 	if ( in_array( 'status', $t_bug_view_fields ) ) {	
2102 		$t_bug_data['email_status'] = $t_row['status'];
2103 	}
2104 	
2105 	if ( in_array( 'severity', $t_bug_view_fields ) ) {	
2106 		$t_bug_data['email_severity'] = $t_row['severity'];
2107 	}
2108 	
2109 	if ( in_array( 'priority', $t_bug_view_fields ) ) {	
2110 		$t_bug_data['email_priority'] = $t_row['priority'];
2111 	}
2112 
2113 	if ( in_array( 'reproducibility', $t_bug_view_fields ) ) {
2114 		$t_bug_data['email_reproducibility'] = $t_row['reproducibility'];
2115 	}
2116 	
2117 	if ( in_array( 'resolution', $t_bug_view_fields ) ) {	
2118 		$t_bug_data['email_resolution'] = $t_row['resolution'];
2119 	}
2120 		
2121 	$t_bug_data['email_fixed_in_version'] = $t_row['fixed_in_version'];
2122 
2123 	if( in_array( 'target_version', $t_bug_view_fields ) && !is_blank( $t_row['target_version'] ) && access_compare_level( $t_user_access_level, config_get( 'roadmap_view_threshold' ) ) ) {
2124 		$t_bug_data['email_target_version'] = $t_row['target_version'];
2125 	}
2126 
2127 	$t_bug_data['email_summary'] = $t_row['summary'];
2128 	$t_bug_data['email_description'] = $t_row['description'];
2129 
2130 	if( in_array( 'additional_info', $t_bug_view_fields ) ) {
2131 		$t_bug_data['email_additional_information'] = $t_row['additional_information'];
2132 	}
2133 	
2134 	if ( in_array( 'steps_to_reproduce', $t_bug_view_fields ) ) {
2135 		$t_bug_data['email_steps_to_reproduce'] = $t_row['steps_to_reproduce'];
2136 	}
2137 
2138 	$t_bug_data['set_category'] = '[' . $t_bug_data['email_project'] . '] ' . $t_category_name;
2139 
2140 	$t_bug_data['custom_fields'] = custom_field_get_linked_fields( $p_bug_id, $t_user_access_level );
2141 	$t_bug_data['bugnotes'] = bugnote_get_all_visible_bugnotes( $p_bug_id, $t_user_bugnote_order, $t_user_bugnote_limit, $p_user_id );
2142 
2143 	# put history data
2144 	if( ( ON == config_get( 'history_default_visible' ) ) && access_compare_level( $t_user_access_level, config_get( 'view_history_threshold' ) ) ) {
2145 		$t_bug_data['history'] = history_get_raw_events_array( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id );
2146 	}
2147 
2148 	# Sponsorship Information
2149 	if( ( config_get( 'enable_sponsorship' ) == ON ) && ( access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'view_sponsorship_total_threshold' ), $p_bug_id, $p_user_id ) ) ) {
2150 		$t_sponsorship_ids = sponsorship_get_all_ids( $p_bug_id );
2151 		$t_bug_data['sponsorship_total'] = sponsorship_get_amount( $t_sponsorship_ids );
2152 
2153 		if( access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'view_sponsorship_details_threshold' ), $p_bug_id, $p_user_id ) ) {
2154 			$t_bug_data['sponsorships'] = array();
2155 			foreach( $t_sponsorship_ids as $t_id ) {
2156 				$t_bug_data['sponsorships'][] = sponsorship_get( $t_id );
2157 			}
2158 		}
2159 	}
2160 
2161 	$t_bug_data['relations'] = email_relationship_get_summary_text( $p_bug_id );
2162 
2163 	current_user_set( $t_current_user_id );
2164 
2165 	return $t_bug_data;
2166 }

2168 /**
2169  * Return formatted string with all the details on the requested relationship.
2170  *
2171  * @param int                 $p_bug_id       A bug identifier.
2172  * @param BugRelationshipData $p_relationship A bug relationship object.
2173  *
2174  * @return string
2175  * @throws ClientException
2176  */
2177 function email_relationship_get_details( $p_bug_id, BugRelationshipData $p_relationship ) {
2178 	$t_summary_wrap_at = mb_strlen( config_get( 'email_separator2' ) ) - 28;
2179 
2180 	if( $p_bug_id == $p_relationship->src_bug_id ) {
2181 		# root bug is in the source side, related bug in the destination side
2182 		$t_related_project_id = $p_relationship->dest_bug_id;
2183 		$t_related_bug_id = $p_relationship->dest_bug_id;
2184 		$t_relationship_descr = relationship_get_description_src_side( $p_relationship->type );
2185 	} else {
2186 		# root bug is in the dest side, related bug in the source side
2187 		$t_related_project_id = $p_relationship->src_bug_id;
2188 		$t_related_bug_id = $p_relationship->src_bug_id;
2189 		$t_relationship_descr = relationship_get_description_dest_side( $p_relationship->type );
2190 	}
2191 
2192 	# related bug not existing...
2193 	if( !bug_exists( $t_related_bug_id ) ) {
2194 		return '';
2195 	}
2196 
2197 	# user can access to the related bug at least as a viewer
2198 	if( !access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'view_bug_threshold', null, null, $t_related_project_id ), $t_related_bug_id ) ) {
2199 		return '';
2200 	}
2201 
2202 	# get the information from the related bug and prepare the link
2203 	$t_bug = bug_get( $t_related_bug_id );
2204 
2205 	$t_relationship_info_text = utf8_str_pad( $t_relationship_descr, 20 );
2206 	$t_relationship_info_text .= utf8_str_pad( bug_format_id( $t_related_bug_id ), 8 );
2207 
2208 	# add summary
2209 	if( mb_strlen( $t_bug->summary ) <= $t_summary_wrap_at ) {
2210 		$t_relationship_info_text .= string_email_links( $t_bug->summary );
2211 	} else {
2212 		$t_relationship_info_text .= mb_substr( string_email_links( $t_bug->summary ), 0, $t_summary_wrap_at - 3 ) . '...';
2213 	}
2214 
2215 	$t_relationship_info_text .= "\n";
2216 
2217 	return $t_relationship_info_text;
2218 }
2219 
2220 /**
2221  * Get ALL the RELATIONSHIPS OF A SPECIFIC BUG in text format.
2222  *
2223  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
2224  *
2225  * @return string
2226  * @throws ClientException
2227  */
2228 function email_relationship_get_summary_text( $p_bug_id ) {
2229 	# A variable that will be set by the following call to indicate if relationships belong
2230 	# to multiple projects.
2231 	$t_show_project = false;
2232 
2233 	$t_relationship_all = relationship_get_all( $p_bug_id, $t_show_project );
2234 	$t_relationship_all_count = count( $t_relationship_all );
2235 
2236 	# prepare the relationships table
2237 	$t_summary = '';
2238 	for( $i = 0; $i < $t_relationship_all_count; $i++ ) {
2239 		$t_summary .= email_relationship_get_details( $p_bug_id, $t_relationship_all[$i] );
2240 	}
2241 
2242 	return $t_summary;
2243 }
2244 
2245 /**
2246  * The email sending shutdown function.
2247  *
2248  * Will send any queued emails, except when $g_email_send_using_cronjob = ON.
2249  * If $g_email_shutdown_processing EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_FORCE flag is set, emails
2250  * will be sent regardless of cronjob setting.
2251  *
2252  * @return void
2253  */
2254 function email_shutdown_function() {
2255 	global $g_email_shutdown_processing;
2256 
2257 	# Nothing to do if
2258 	# - no emails have been generated in the current request
2259 	# - system is configured to use cron job (unless processing is forced)
2260 	if(    $g_email_shutdown_processing == EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_SKIP
2261 		|| (   !( $g_email_shutdown_processing & EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_FORCE )
2262 			&& config_get( 'email_send_using_cronjob' )
2263 		   )
2264 	) {
2265 		return;
2266 	}
2267 
2268 	$t_msg ='Shutdown function called for ' . $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'];
2269 	if( $g_email_shutdown_processing & EMAIL_SHUTDOWN_FORCE ) {
2270 		$t_msg .= ' (email processing forced)';
2271 	}
2272 
2273 	log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, $t_msg );
2274 
2275 	if( $g_email_shutdown_processing ) {
2276 		if( function_exists( 'fastcgi_finish_request' ) ) {
2277 			fastcgi_finish_request();
2278 		}
2279 
2280 		try {
2281 			email_send_all();
2282 		} catch( Exception $e ) {
2283 			log_event( LOG_EMAIL, 'Error sending emails on shutdown: ' . $e->getMessage() );
2284 		}
2285 	}
2286 }
2287 
2288 /**
2289  * Get the list of supported email actions.
2290  *
2291  * @return array List of actions
2292  */
2293 function email_get_actions() {
2294 	$t_actions = array( 'updated', 'owner', 'reopened', 'deleted', 'bugnote', 'relation', 'monitor' );
2295 
2296 	if( config_get( 'enable_sponsorship' ) == ON ) {
2297 		$t_actions[] = 'sponsor';
2298 	}
2299 
2300 	$t_statuses = MantisEnum::getAssocArrayIndexedByValues( config_get( 'status_enum_string' ) );
2301 	ksort( $t_statuses );
2302 
2303 	foreach( $t_statuses as $t_label ) {
2304 		$t_actions[] = $t_label;
2305 	}
2306 
2307 	return $t_actions;
2308 }

  39 /**
  40  * EmailData Structure Definition
  41  */
  42 class EmailData {
  43 	/**
  44 	 * Email address
  45 	 */
  46 	public $email = '';
  47 
  48 	/**
  49 	 * Subject text
  50 	 *
  51 	 * @var string
  52 	 */
  53 	public $subject = '';
  54 
  55 	/**
  56 	 * Body text
  57 	 *
  58 	 * @var string
  59 	 */
  60 	public $body = '';
  61 
  62 	/**
  63 	 * Meta Data array
  64 	 *
  65 	 * @var array
  66 	 */
  67 	public $metadata = array(
  68 		'headers' => array(),
  69 		'cc' => array(),
  70 		'bcc' => array(),
  71 	);
  72 
  73 	/**
  74 	 * Email ID
  75 	 *
  76 	 * @var int
  77 	 */
  78 	public $email_id = 0;
  79 
  80 	/**
  81 	 * Submitted
  82 	 *
  83 	 * @var string
  84 	 */
  85 	public $submitted = '';

  88 /**
  89  * Return a copy of the bug structure with all the instvars prepared for database insertion
  90  * @param EmailData $p_email_data Email Data structure to store.
  91  * @return EmailData
  92  */
  93 function email_queue_prepare_db( EmailData $p_email_data ) {
  94 	$p_email_data->email_id = (int)$p_email_data->email_id;
  95 
  96 	return $p_email_data;
  97 }

  99 /**
 100  * Add to email queue
 101  * @param EmailData $p_email_data Email Data structure.
 102  * @return integer
 103  */
 104 function email_queue_add( EmailData $p_email_data ) {
 105 	$t_email_data = email_queue_prepare_db( $p_email_data );
 106 
 107 	# email cannot be blank
 108 	if( is_blank( $t_email_data->email ) ) {
 109 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'email' ) );
 110 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 111 	}
 112 
 113 	# subject cannot be blank
 114 	if( is_blank( $t_email_data->subject ) ) {
 115 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'subject' ) );
 116 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 117 	}
 118 
 119 	# body cannot be blank
 120 	if( is_blank( $t_email_data->body ) ) {
 121 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'body' ) );
 122 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 123 	}
 124 
 125 	$c_email = $t_email_data->email;
 126 	# MySQL 4-bytes UTF-8 chars workaround #21101
 127 	$c_subject = db_mysql_fix_utf8( $t_email_data->subject );
 128 	$c_body = db_mysql_fix_utf8( $t_email_data->body );
 129 	$c_metadata = serialize( $t_email_data->metadata );
 130 
 131 	db_param_push();
 132 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {email}
 133 				    ( email, subject, body, submitted, metadata)
 134 				  VALUES
 135 				    (' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 136 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_email, $c_subject, $c_body, db_now(), $c_metadata ) );
 137 	$t_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'email' ), 'email_id' );
 138 
 139 	log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, sprintf( 'message %d queued', $t_id ) );
 140 
 141 	return $t_id;
 142 }
 143 
 144 /**
 145  * Convert email db row to EmailData object
 146  * @param array|false $p_row Database result row to convert.
 147  * @return boolean|EmailData
 148  */
 149 function email_queue_row_to_object( $p_row ) {
 150 	# typically this function takes as an input the result of db_fetch_array() which can be false.
 151 	if( $p_row === false ) {
 152 		return false;
 153 	}
 154 
 155 	$t_row = $p_row;
 156 	$t_row['metadata'] = unserialize( $t_row['metadata'] );
 157 
 158 	$t_email_data = new EmailData;
 159 
 160 	$t_row_keys = array_keys( $t_row );
 161 	$t_vars = get_object_vars( $t_email_data );
 162 
 163 	# Check each variable in the class
 164 	foreach( $t_vars as $t_var => $t_value ) {
 165 		# If we got a field from the DB with the same name
 166 		if( in_array( $t_var, $t_row_keys, true ) ) {
 167 			# Store that value in the object
 168 			$t_email_data->$t_var = $t_row[$t_var];
 169 		}
 170 	}
 171 
 172 	return $t_email_data;
 173 }
 174 
 175 /**
 176  * Get Corresponding EmailData object
 177  * @param integer $p_email_id An email identifier.
 178  * @return boolean|EmailData
 179  */
 180 function email_queue_get( $p_email_id ) {
 181 	db_param_push();
 182 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {email} WHERE email_id=' . db_param();
 183 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_email_id ) );
 184 
 185 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 186 
 187 	return email_queue_row_to_object( $t_row );
 188 }
 189 
 190 /**
 191  * Delete entry from email queue
 192  * @param integer $p_email_id Email queue identifier.
 193  * @param string $p_reason The reason for deletion.
 194  * @return void
 195  */
 196 function email_queue_delete( $p_email_id, $p_reason = '' ) {
 197 	db_param_push();
 198 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {email} WHERE email_id=' . db_param();
 199 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_email_id ) );
 200 
 201 	if( is_blank( $p_reason ) ) {
 202 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, sprintf( 'message %d deleted from queue', $p_email_id ) );
 203 	} else {
 204 		log_event( LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE, sprintf( 'message %d deleted from queue. reason: %s', $p_email_id, $p_reason ) ); 
 205 	}
 206 }
 207 
 208 /**
 209  * Get array of email queue id's
 210  * @return array
 211  */
 212 function email_queue_get_ids() {
 213 	$t_query = 'SELECT email_id FROM {email} ORDER BY email_id ASC';
 214 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 215 
 216 	$t_ids = array();
 217 	while( ( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) !== false ) {
 218 		$t_ids[] = $t_row['email_id'];
 219 	}
 220 
 221 	return $t_ids;
 222 }

  46 /**

  53  * @see error_log_delayed(), error_print_delayed()

  56 $g_error_delay_reporting = true;

  68 # Make sure we always capture User-defined errors regardless of ini settings

  71 
  72 global $g_bypass_error_handler;

  83 /**
  84  * Unhandled exception handler

  86  * @param MantisException|Exception|Error $p_exception The exception to handle
  87  * @return void
  88  */
  89 function error_exception_handler( $p_exception ) {
  90 	global $g_exception;
  91 
  92 	# As per PHP documentation, null may be received to reset handler to default state.
  93 	if( $p_exception === null ) {
  94 		$g_exception = null;
  95 		return;
  96 	}
  97 
  98 	$g_exception = $p_exception;
  99 
 100 	if( is_a( $p_exception, 'Mantis\Exceptions\MantisException' ) ) {
 101 		$t_params = $p_exception->getParams();
 102 		if( !empty( $t_params ) ) {
 103 			call_user_func_array( 'error_parameters', $t_params );
 104 		}
 105 
 106 		trigger_error( $p_exception->getCode(), ERROR );
 107 
 108 		# It is not expected to get here, but just in case!
 109 		return;
 110 	}
 111 
 112 	# trigger a generic error
 113 	trigger_error( ERROR_PHP, ERROR );
 114 }
 115 
 116 /**
 117  * Get error stack based on last exception
 118  *
 119  * @param Exception|null $p_exception The exception to print stack trace for.
 120  *                                    Null will check last seen exception.
 121  * @return array The stack trace as an array
 122  */
 123 function error_stack_trace( $p_exception = null ) {
 124 	if( $p_exception === null ) {
 125 		global $g_exception;
 126 		$p_exception = $g_exception;
 127 	}
 128 
 129 	if ( $p_exception === null ) {
 130 		# The reported stack trace should begin with the function call where the
 131 		# error was triggered, so we remove the internal error handler calls
 132 		# (this function, its parent and the error handler itself).
 133 		$t_stack = array_slice( debug_backtrace(), 3 );
 134 	} else {
 135 		$t_stack = $p_exception->getTrace();
 136 	}
 137 
 138 	return $t_stack;
 139 }
 140 
 141 /**
 142  * Default error handler.
 143  *
 144  * This handler will not receive E_ERROR, E_PARSE, E_CORE_*, or E_COMPILE_* errors.
 145  *
 146  * @param int        $p_type  Contains the level of the error raised, as an integer.
 147  * @param int|string $p_error For Mantis internal errors (i.e. of type E_USER_*),
 148  *                            contains the error number (see ERROR_* constants);
 149  *                            otherwise (system errors), the error message as a string.
 150  * @param string     $p_file  Contains the filename that the error was raised in, as a string.
 151  * @param int        $p_line  Contains the line number the error was raised at, as an integer.
 152  *
 153  * @return void
 154  * @throws ClientException
 155  *
 156  * @internal
 157  * @uses lang_api.php
 158  * @uses config_api.php
 159  * @uses compress_api.php
 160  * @uses database_api.php (optional)
 161  * @uses html_api.php (optional)
 162  */
 163 function error_handler( $p_type, $p_error, $p_file, $p_line ) {
 164 	global $g_error_parameters, $g_error_handled, $g_error_proceed_url;
 165 	global $g_error_send_page_header;
 166 
 167 	# check if errors were disabled with @ somewhere in this call chain
 168 	if( !( error_reporting() & $p_type ) ) {
 169 		return;
 170 	}
 171 
 172 	$t_lang_pushed = false;
 173 
 174 	$t_db_connected = false;
 175 	if( function_exists( 'db_is_connected' ) ) {
 176 		if( db_is_connected() ) {
 177 			$t_db_connected = true;
 178 		}
 179 	}
 180 	$t_html_api = false;
 181 	if( function_exists( 'html_end' ) ) {
 182 		$t_html_api = true;
 183 	}
 184 
 185 	# flush any language overrides to return to user's natural default
 186 	if( $t_db_connected ) {
 187 		lang_push( lang_get_default() );
 188 		$t_lang_pushed = true;
 189 	}
 190 
 191 	$t_method_array = config_get_global( 'display_errors' );
 192 	$t_method = $t_method_array[$p_type] ?? $t_method_array[E_ALL] ?? 'none';
 193 
 194 	$t_show_detailed_errors = config_get_global( 'show_detailed_errors' ) == ON;
 195 
 196 	# Force errors to use HALT method.
 197 	if( $p_type == E_USER_ERROR || $p_type == E_ERROR || $p_type == E_RECOVERABLE_ERROR ) {
 198 		$t_method = DISPLAY_ERROR_HALT;
 199 	}
 200 
 201 	# Special handling for missing language strings, as we do not want to
 202 	# display information about lang_get() call; instead, we need details
 203 	# about the actual location of the missing string.
 204 	if( $p_error == ERROR_LANG_STRING_NOT_FOUND ) {
 205 		# Loop through the call stack, until we find the first call to
 206 		# lang_get() outside of lang API.
 207 		foreach( error_stack_trace() as $t_error ) {
 208 			/**
 209 			 * @var string $v_file
 210 			 * @var string $v_line
 211 			 * @var string $v_function
 212 			 */
 213 			extract( $t_error, EXTR_PREFIX_ALL, 'v' );
 214 			if( basename( $v_file ) != 'lang_api.php' && $v_function == 'lang_get' ) {
 215 				$p_file = $v_file;
 216 				$p_line = $v_line;
 217 				break;
 218 			}
 219 		}
 220 	}
 221 
 222 	# build an appropriate error string
 223 	$t_error_location = 'in \'' . $p_file .'\' line ' . $p_line;
 224 	$t_error_description = '\'' . $p_error . '\' ' . $t_error_location;
 225 
 226 	# PHP 8.4 compatibility, deprecation of E_STRICT constant
 227 	# Treat such errors as E_NOTICE
 228 	if( PHP_VERSION_ID < 80000 && $p_type == E_STRICT ) {
 229 		$p_type = E_NOTICE;
 230 	}
 231 
 232 	switch( $p_type ) {
 233 		case E_WARNING:
 234 			$t_error_type = 'SYSTEM WARNING';
 235 			break;
 236 		case E_NOTICE:
 237 			$t_error_type = 'SYSTEM NOTICE';
 238 			break;
 239 		case E_RECOVERABLE_ERROR:
 240 			# This should generally be considered fatal (like E_ERROR)
 241 			$t_error_type = 'SYSTEM ERROR';
 242 			break;
 243 		case E_DEPRECATED:
 244 			$t_error_type = 'DEPRECATED';
 245 			break;
 246 		case E_USER_ERROR:
 247 			if( $p_error == ERROR_PHP ) {
 248 				$t_error_type = 'INTERNAL APPLICATION ERROR';
 249 
 250 				global $g_exception;
 251 				$t_error_description = $g_exception->getMessage();
 252 				$t_error_to_log = $t_error_description . "\n" . error_stack_trace_as_string();
 253 				error_log( $t_error_to_log );
 254 
 255 				# If show detailed errors is OFF hide PHP exceptions since they sometimes
 256 				# include file path.
 257 				if( !$t_show_detailed_errors ) {
 258 					$t_error_description = '';
 259 				}
 260 			} else {
 261 				$t_error_type = 'APPLICATION ERROR #' . $p_error;
 262 				$t_error_description = error_string( $p_error );
 263 			}
 264 			break;
 265 		case E_USER_WARNING:
 266 			$t_error_type = 'APPLICATION WARNING #' . $p_error;
 267 			$t_error_description = error_string( $p_error ) . ' (' . $t_error_location . ')';
 268 			break;
 269 		case E_USER_NOTICE:
 270 			# used for debugging
 271 			$t_error_type = 'DEBUG';
 272 			break;
 273 		case E_USER_DEPRECATED:
 274 			# Get details about the error, to facilitate debugging with a more
 275 			# useful message including filename and line number.
 276 			$t_stack = error_stack_trace();
 277 			$t_caller = $t_stack[0];
 278 
 279 			$t_error_type = 'WARNING';
 280 			$t_error_description =  error_string( $p_error )
 281 				. ' (in ' . $t_caller['file']
 282 				. ' line ' . $t_caller['line'] . ')';
 283 
 284 			error_delay_reporting();
 285 			break;
 286 		default:
 287 			# shouldn't happen, just display the error just in case
 288 			$t_error_type = 'UNHANDLED ERROR TYPE (' .
 289 				'<a href="https://www.php.net/errorfunc.constants">' . $p_type. '</a>)';
 290 			$t_error_description = $p_error . ' (' . $t_error_location . ')';
 291 	}
 292 
 293 	if( php_sapi_name() == 'cli' ) {
 294 		if( DISPLAY_ERROR_NONE != $t_method ) {
 295 			echo $t_error_type . ': ' . $t_error_description . "\n";
 296 
 297 			if( $t_show_detailed_errors ) {
 298 				echo "\n";
 299 				error_print_stack_trace();
 300 			}
 301 		}
 302 		if( DISPLAY_ERROR_HALT == $t_method ) {
 303 			exit(1);
 304 		}
 305 	} else {
 306 		$t_error_description = nl2br( $t_error_description );
 307 
 308 		switch( $t_method ) {
 309 			case DISPLAY_ERROR_HALT:
 310 				# disable any further event callbacks
 311 				if( function_exists( 'event_clear_callbacks' ) ) {
 312 					event_clear_callbacks();
 313 				}
 314 
 315 				$t_oblen = ob_get_length();
 316 				if( $t_oblen > 0 ) {
 317 					$t_old_contents = ob_get_contents();
 318 					if( !error_handled() ) {
 319 						# Retrieve the previously output header
 320 						if( false !== preg_match_all( '|^(.*)(</head>.*$)|is', $t_old_contents, $t_result ) &&
 321 							isset( $t_result[1] ) && isset( $t_result[1][0] ) ) {
 322 							$t_old_headers = $t_result[1][0];
 323 							unset( $t_old_contents );
 324 						}
 325 					}
 326 				}
 327 
 328 				# We need to ensure compression is off - otherwise the compression headers are output.
 329 				compress_disable();
 330 
 331 				# then clean the buffer, leaving output buffering on.
 332 				if( $t_oblen > 0 ) {
 333 					ob_clean();
 334 				}
 335 
 336 
 337 				# If HTML error output was disabled, set the HTTP response code and stop
 338 				if( defined( 'DISABLE_INLINE_ERROR_REPORTING' ) ) {
 339 					if( DISABLE_INLINE_ERROR_REPORTING == 'text' ) {
 340 						# Send error message as response body
 341 						header( 'Content-Type: text/plain' );
 342 						echo $t_error_description;
 343 					}
 344 					http_response_code( error_map_mantis_error_to_http_code( $p_error ) );
 345 					exit(1);
 346 				}
 347 
 348 				# don't send the page header information if it has already been sent
 349 				if( $g_error_send_page_header ) {
 350 					if( $t_html_api ) {
 351 						layout_page_header();
 352 						if( $p_error != ERROR_DB_QUERY_FAILED && $t_db_connected ) {
 353 							if( auth_is_user_authenticated() ) {
 354 								layout_page_begin();
 355 							} else {
 356 								# The simpler layout to avoid the possible endless redirect loop
 357 								layout_admin_page_begin();
 358 							}
 359 						}
 360 					} else {
 361 						layout_page_header( $t_error_type );
 362 					}
 363 				} else {
 364 					# Output the previously sent headers, if defined
 365 					if( isset( $t_old_headers ) ) {
 366 						echo $t_old_headers, "\n";
 367 						layout_page_header_end();
 368 						layout_page_begin();
 369 					}
 370 				}
 371 
 372 				echo '<div class="col-md-12 col-xs-12">';
 373 				echo '<div class="space-20"></div>', "\n";
 374 				echo '<div class="alert alert-danger">', "\n";
 375 
 376 				echo '<p class="bold">' . $t_error_type . '</p>', "\n";
 377 				echo '<p>', $t_error_description, '</p>', "\n";
 378 
 379 				echo '<div class="error-info">';
 380 				if( null === $g_error_proceed_url ) {
 381 					echo lang_get( 'error_no_proceed' );
 382 				} else {
 383 					echo '<a href="', $g_error_proceed_url, '">', lang_get( 'proceed' ), '</a>';
 384 				}
 385 				echo '</div>', "\n";
 386 
 387 				if( $t_show_detailed_errors ) {
 388 					error_print_details( $p_file, $p_line );
 389 					error_print_stack_trace();
 390 				}
 391 				echo '</div></div>';
 392 
 393 				if( isset( $t_old_contents ) ) {
 394 					echo '<div class="col-md-12 col-xs-12">';
 395 					echo '<div class="space-20"></div>';
 396 					echo '<div class="alert alert-warning">';
 397 					echo '<div class="warning">Previous non-fatal errors occurred.  Page contents follow.</div>';
 398 					echo '<p>';
 399 					echo $t_old_contents;
 400 					echo '</p></div></div>';
 401 				}
 402 
 403 				if( $t_html_api ) {
 404 					if( $p_error != ERROR_DB_QUERY_FAILED && $t_db_connected ) {
 405 						if( auth_is_user_authenticated() ) {
 406 							layout_page_end();
 407 						} else {
 408 							layout_admin_page_end();
 409 						}
 410 					} else {
 411 						layout_body_javascript();
 412 						html_body_end();
 413 						html_end();
 414 					}
 415 				} else {
 416 					echo '</body></html>', "\n";
 417 				}
 418 
 419 				# Return proper HTTP status code for error
 420 				http_response_code( error_map_mantis_error_to_http_code( $p_error ) );
 421 				exit(1);
 422 
 423 			case DISPLAY_ERROR_INLINE:
 424 				if( !defined( 'DISABLE_INLINE_ERROR_REPORTING' ) ) {
 425 					global $g_error_delay_reporting;
 426 					if( $g_error_delay_reporting ) {
 427 						error_log_delayed( $t_error_type . ': ' . $t_error_description );
 428 					} else {
 429 						echo '<div class="alert alert-warning">', $t_error_type, ': ', $t_error_description, '</div>';
 430 					}
 431 				}
 432 				$g_error_handled = true;
 433 				break;
 434 
 435 			default:
 436 				# do nothing - note we treat this as we've not handled an error, so any redirects go through.
 437 		}
 438 	}
 439 
 440 	if( $t_lang_pushed ) {
 441 		lang_pop();
 442 	}
 443 
 444 	$g_error_parameters = array();
 445 	$g_error_proceed_url = null;
 446 }

 449 /**
 450  * Error handler to convert PHP errors to Exceptions.
 451  *
 452  * This is used to temporarily override the default error handler, when it is
 453  * required to catch a PHP error (e.g. when unserializing data in install
 454  * helper functions).
 455  *
 456  * @param int    $p_type    Level of the error raised.
 457  * @param string $p_error   Error message.
 458  * @param string $p_file    Filename that the error was raised in.
 459  * @param int    $p_line    Line number the error was raised at.
 460  *
 461  * @throws ErrorException
 462  */
 463 function error_convert_to_exception( $p_type, $p_error, $p_file, $p_line ) {
 464 	throw new ErrorException( $p_error, 0, $p_type, $p_file, $p_line );
 465 }
 466 
 467 /**
 468  * Instruct the error handler to delay display of inline warnings.
 469  *
 470  * This should be called prior to trigger_error() when required, e.g. when
 471  * a warning could be triggered before the page layout has been sent.
 472  *
 473  * @param bool $p_delay If true (default), inline warnings will be logged and
 474  *                      display at the end of the page instead of being printed
 475  *                      immediately.
 476  *
 477  * @return void
 478  */
 479 function error_delay_reporting( bool $p_delay = true) {
 480 	global $g_error_delay_reporting;
 481 	$g_error_delay_reporting = $p_delay;
 482 }
 483 
 484 /**
 485  * Enqueues an error message for later display.
 486  *
 487  * @see error_print_delayed()
 488  *
 489  * @param string $p_message Error message
 490  *
 491  * @return void
 492  */
 493 function error_log_delayed( $p_message ) {
 494 	global $g_errors_delayed;
 495 	$g_errors_delayed[] = $p_message;
 496 }
 497 
 498 /**
 499  * Prints messages from the delayed errors queue.
 500  *
 501  * The error handler enqueues deprecation warnings that would be printed inline,
 502  * to avoid display issues when they are triggered within html tags. Only unique
 503  * messages are printed.
 504  *
 505  * @return void
 506  */
 507 function error_print_delayed() {
 508 	global $g_errors_delayed;
 509 
 510 	if( !empty( $g_errors_delayed ) ) {
 511 		echo '<div class="space-10 clearfix"></div>', "\n";
 512 		echo '<div id="delayed-errors" class="alert alert-warning">';
 513 		foreach( array_unique( $g_errors_delayed ) as $t_error ) {
 514 			echo "\n" . '<div class="error-inline">', $t_error, '</div>';
 515 		}
 516 		echo "\n" . '</div>';
 517 
 518 		$g_errors_delayed = array();
 519 	}
 520 
 521 	# Make sure any subsequent inline errors are displayed
 522 	error_delay_reporting( false );
 523 }

 533 function error_print_details( $p_file, $p_line ) {

 542 				</span>

 546 			</li>

 553 /**
 554  * Get the stack trace as a string that can be logged or echoed to CLI output.
 555  *
 556  * @param Exception|null $p_exception The exception to print stack trace for.
 557  *                                    Null will check last seen exception.
 558  *
 559  * @return string multi-line printout of stack trace.
 560  */
 561 function error_stack_trace_as_string( $p_exception = null ) {
 562 	$t_stack = error_stack_trace( $p_exception );
 563 	$t_output = '';
 564 
 565 	foreach( $t_stack as $t_frame ) {
 566 		$t_output .= ( $t_frame['file'] ?? '-' ) . ': ' .
 567 			( $t_frame['line'] ?? '-' ) . ': ' .
 568 			( $t_frame['class'] ?? '-' ) . ' - ' .
 569 			( $t_frame['type'] ?? '-' ) . ' - ' .
 570 			( $t_frame['function'] ?? '-' );
 571 
 572 		$t_args = array();
 573 		if( !empty( $t_frame['args'] ) ) {
 574 			foreach( $t_frame['args'] as $t_value ) {
 575 				$t_args[] = error_build_parameter_string( $t_value );
 576 			}
 577 
 578 			$t_output .= '( ' . implode( ', ', $t_args ) . " )\n";
 579 		} else {
 580 			$t_output .= "()\n";
 581 		}
 582 	}
 583 
 584 	return $t_output;
 585 }
 586 
 587 /**
 588  * Print out a stack trace.
 589  *
 590  * @param Exception|null $p_exception The exception to print stack trace for.
 591  *                                    Null will check last seen exception.
 592  */
 593 function error_print_stack_trace( $p_exception = null ) {
 594 	if( php_sapi_name() == 'cli' ) {
 595 		echo error_stack_trace_as_string( $p_exception );
 596 		return;
 597 	}
 598 ?>
 599 	<h3>Stack trace</h3>
 600 		<div class="table-responsive">
 601 			<table class="table table-bordered table-striped table-condensed">
 602 				<tr>
 603 					<th>#</th>
 604 					<th>Filename</th>
 605 					<th>Line</th>
 606 					<th>Class</th>
 607 					<th>Type</th>
 608 					<th>Function</th>
 609 					<th>Args</th>
 610 				</tr>
 611 <?php
 612 	$t_stack = error_stack_trace( $p_exception );
 613 
 614 	foreach( $t_stack as $t_id => $t_frame ) {
 615 		if( !empty( $t_frame['args'] ) ) {
 616 			$t_args = array();
 617 			foreach( $t_frame['args'] as $t_value ) {
 618 				$t_args[] = error_build_parameter_string( $t_value );
 619 			}
 620 		} else {
 621 			$t_args = array('-');
 622 		}
 623 
 624 		printf(
 625 			"<tr>\n" . str_repeat( "<td>%s</td>\n", 7 ) . "</tr>\n",
 626 			$t_id,
 627 			isset( $t_frame['file'] ) ? htmlentities( $t_frame['file'], ENT_COMPAT, 'UTF-8' ) : '-',
 628 			$t_frame['line'] ?? '-',
 629 			$t_frame['class'] ?? '-',
 630 			$t_frame['type'] ?? '-',
 631 			$t_frame['function'] ?? '-',
 632 			htmlentities( implode( ', ', $t_args ), ENT_COMPAT, 'UTF-8' )
 633 		);
 634 
 635 	}
 636 	echo '</table>', '</div>';
 637 }
 638 
 639 /**
 640  * Build a string describing the parameters to a function.
 641  *
 642  * @param string|array|object $p_param    Parameter.
 643  * @param bool                $p_showtype Default true.
 644  * @param int                 $p_depth    Default 0.
 645  *
 646  * @return string
 647  */
 648 function error_build_parameter_string( $p_param, $p_showtype = true, $p_depth = 0 ) {
 649 	if( $p_depth++ > 10 ) {
 650 		return '<strong>***Nesting Level Too Deep***</strong>';
 651 	}
 652 
 653 	if( is_array( $p_param ) ) {
 654 		$t_results = array();
 655 
 656 		foreach( $p_param as $t_key => $t_value ) {
 657 			$t_results[] = '[' . error_build_parameter_string( $t_key, false, $p_depth ) . '] => ' . error_build_parameter_string( $t_value, false, $p_depth );
 658 		}
 659 
 660 		return '<array> { ' . implode( ', ', $t_results ) . ' }';
 661 	} else if( is_object( $p_param ) ) {
 662 		$t_results = array();
 663 
 664 		$t_class_name = get_class( $p_param );
 665 		$t_inst_vars = get_object_vars( $p_param );
 666 
 667 		foreach( $t_inst_vars as $t_name => $t_value ) {
 668 			$t_results[] = '[' . $t_name . '] => ' . error_build_parameter_string( $t_value, false, $p_depth );
 669 		}
 670 
 671 		return '<Object><' . $t_class_name . '> ( ' . implode( ', ', $t_results ) . ' )';
 672 	} else {
 673 		if( $p_showtype ) {
 674 			return '<' . gettype( $p_param ) . '>' . var_export( $p_param, true );
 675 		} else {
 676 			return var_export( $p_param, true );
 677 		}
 678 	}
 679 }
 680 
 681 /**
 682  * Return an error string (in the current language) for the given error.
 683  *
 684  * @param int $p_error Error string to localize.
 685  *
 686  * @return string
 687  * @access public
 688  */
 689 function error_string( $p_error ) {
 690 	global $g_error_parameters;
 691 
 692 	$t_lang = null;
 693 	$t_error = '';
 694 	while( true ) {
 695 		$t_err_msg = lang_get( 'MANTIS_ERROR', $t_lang );
 696 		if( array_key_exists( $p_error, $t_err_msg ) ) {
 697 			$t_error = $t_err_msg[$p_error];
 698 			break;
 699 		} elseif( is_null( $t_lang ) ) {
 700 			# Error string not found, fall back to English
 701 			$t_lang = 'english';
 702 		} else {
 703 			# Error string not found
 704 			$t_error = lang_get( 'missing_error_string' );
 705 			# Prepend the error number
 706 			array_unshift( $g_error_parameters, $p_error );
 707 			break;
 708 		}
 709 	}
 710 
 711 	# Special handling for generic error type
 712 	# Append detailed error information if a parameter has been provided.
 713 	if( $p_error == ERROR_GENERIC && $g_error_parameters ) {
 714 		$t_error .= PHP_EOL . error_string( ERROR_GENERIC_DETAILS );
 715 		$g_error_parameters = [];
 716 	}
 717 
 718 	# Prepare error parameters for display
 719 	$t_parameters = $g_error_parameters;
 720 	foreach( $t_parameters as &$t_value ) {
 721 		# Logic copied from string_html_specialchars(), to enable output of
 722 		# error messages even if core is not fully initialized.
 723 		# Modified to allow <br> tags
 724 		$t_value = preg_replace(
 725 			[ '/&amp;(#[0-9]+|[a-z]+);/i', '|&lt;(br)\s*/?&gt;|i' ],
 726 			[ '&$1;', '<&$1>' ],
 727 			@htmlspecialchars( $t_value, ENT_COMPAT, 'UTF-8' )
 728 		);
 729 	}
 730 
 731 	# We pad the parameter array to make sure that we don't get errors in
 732 	# case the caller didn't provide enough for the error string.
 733 	$t_parameters = array_pad( $t_parameters, 10, '' );
 734 
 735 	return vsprintf( $t_error, $t_parameters );
 736 }
 737 
 738 /**
 739  * Check if we have handled an error during this page.
 740  *
 741  * @return bool True if an error has been handled, false otherwise
 742  */
 743 function error_handled() {
 744 	global $g_error_handled;
 745 
 746 	return( true == $g_error_handled );
 747 }

  34 require_api( 'events_inc.php' );
  35 require_api( 'plugin_api.php' );

  37 # @global array $g_event_cache
  38 $g_event_cache = array();
  39 
  40 /**
  41  * Determine if a given event has been declared
  42  * @param string $p_name Event name
  43  * @return bool True if the even has been declared
  44  */
  45 function event_is_declared( $p_name ) {
  46 	global $g_event_cache;
  47 
  48 	return isset( $g_event_cache[$p_name] );
  49 }
  50 
  51 /**
  52  * Declare an event of a given type.
  53  * Will do nothing if event already exists.
  54  * @param string  $p_name Event name.
  55  * @param integer $p_type Event type.
  56  * @access public
  57  * @return void
  58  */
  59 function event_declare( $p_name, $p_type = EVENT_TYPE_DEFAULT ) {
  60 	global $g_event_cache;
  61 
  62 	if( !event_is_declared( $p_name ) ) {
  63 		$g_event_cache[$p_name] = array(
  64 			'type' => $p_type,
  65 			'callbacks' => array(),
  66 		);
  67 	}
  68 }
  69 
  70 /**
  71  * Convenience function to declare multiple events.
  72  * @param array $p_events Events.
  73  * @access public
  74  * @return void
  75  */
  76 function event_declare_many( array $p_events ) {
  77 	foreach( $p_events as $t_name => $t_type ) {
  78 		event_declare( $t_name, $t_type );
  79 	}
  80 }
  81 
  82 /**
  83  * Hook a callback function to a given event.
  84  *
  85  * A plugin's basename must be specified for proper handling of plugin callbacks.
  86  *
  87  * If the Event being hooked does not exist, a WARNING is triggered and the
  88  * function returns false.
  89  *
  90  * @param string         $p_name     Event name.
  91  * @param string         $p_callback Callback function.
  92  * @param integer|string $p_plugin   Plugin basename.
  93  *
  94  * @return bool True if the hook is successful, false otherwise.
  95  * @access public
  96  */
  97 function event_hook( $p_name, $p_callback, $p_plugin = 0 ) {
  98 	global $g_event_cache;
  99 
 100 	if( !event_is_declared( $p_name ) ) {
 101 		error_delay_reporting();
 102 		error_parameters( $p_name );
 103 		trigger_error( ERROR_EVENT_UNDECLARED, WARNING );
 104 		return false;
 105 	}
 106 
 107 	$g_event_cache[$p_name]['callbacks'][$p_plugin][] = $p_callback;
 108 	return true;
 109 }
 110 
 111 /**
 112  * Hook multiple callback functions to multiple events.
 113  * @param array          $p_hooks  Event name/callback pairs.
 114  * @param integer|string $p_plugin Plugin basename.
 115  * @access public
 116  * @return void
 117  */
 118 function event_hook_many( array $p_hooks, $p_plugin = 0 ) {
 119 	foreach( $p_hooks as $t_name => $t_callbacks ) {
 120 		if( !is_array( $t_callbacks ) ) {
 121 			event_hook( $t_name, $t_callbacks, $p_plugin );
 122 			continue;
 123 		}
 124 
 125 		foreach( $t_callbacks as $t_callback ) {
 126 			event_hook( $t_name, $t_callback, $p_plugin );
 127 		}
 128 	}
 129 }
 130 
 131 /**
 132  * In the case of errors that halt execution, it is useful to
 133  * clear the list of event callbacks so that no other callbacks
 134  * are executed while the error message is being displayed.
 135  * @return void
 136  */
 137 function event_clear_callbacks() {
 138 	global $g_event_cache;
 139 
 140 	foreach( $g_event_cache as $t_name => $t_event_info ) {
 141 		$g_event_cache[$t_name]['callbacks'] = array();
 142 	}
 143 }
 144 
 145 /**
 146  * Signal an event to execute and handle callbacks as necessary.
 147  * @param string  $p_name           Event name.
 148  * @param mixed   $p_params         Event parameters.
 149  * @param mixed   $p_params_dynamic Event parameters Dynamic.
 150  * @param integer $p_type           Event type override.
 151  * @return mixed Null if event undeclared, appropriate return value otherwise
 152  * @access public
 153  */
 154 function event_signal( $p_name, $p_params = null, $p_params_dynamic = null, $p_type = null ) {
 155 	global $g_event_cache;
 156 
 157 	if( !event_is_declared( $p_name ) ) {
 158 		error_parameters( $p_name );
 159 		trigger_error( ERROR_EVENT_UNDECLARED, WARNING );
 160 		return null;
 161 	}
 162 
 163 	if( is_null( $p_type ) ) {
 164 		$t_type = $g_event_cache[$p_name]['type'];
 165 	} else {
 166 		$t_type = $p_type;
 167 	}
 168 	$t_callbacks = $g_event_cache[$p_name]['callbacks'];
 169 
 170 	switch( $t_type ) {
 171 		case EVENT_TYPE_EXECUTE:
 172 			event_type_execute( $p_name, $t_callbacks, $p_params );
 173 			return null;
 174 		case EVENT_TYPE_OUTPUT:
 175 			event_type_output( $p_name, $t_callbacks, $p_params );
 176 			return null;
 177 		case EVENT_TYPE_CHAIN:
 178 			if( !is_array( $p_params_dynamic ) ) {
 179 				$p_params_dynamic = array(
 180 					$p_params_dynamic,
 181 				);
 182 			}
 183 			return event_type_chain( $p_name, $t_callbacks, $p_params, $p_params_dynamic );
 184 		case EVENT_TYPE_FIRST:
 185 			return event_type_first( $p_name, $t_callbacks, $p_params );
 186 		default:
 187 			return event_type_default( $p_name, $t_callbacks, $p_params );
 188 	}
 189 }
 190 
 191 /**
 192  * Executes a plugin's callback function for a given event.
 193  * @param string $p_event    Event name.
 194  * @param string $p_callback Callback name.
 195  * @param string $p_plugin   Plugin basename.
 196  * @param mixed  $p_params   Parameters for event callback.
 197  * @return mixed null if callback not found, value from callback otherwise
 198  * @access public
 199  */
 200 function event_callback( $p_event, $p_callback, $p_plugin, $p_params = null ) {
 201 	$t_value = null;
 202 	if( !is_array( $p_params ) ) {
 203 		$p_params = array(
 204 			$p_params,
 205 		);
 206 	}
 207 
 208 	if( $p_plugin !== 0 ) {
 209 		global $g_plugin_cache;
 210 
 211 		plugin_push_current( $p_plugin );
 212 
 213 		if( method_exists( $g_plugin_cache[$p_plugin], $p_callback ) ) {
 214 			$t_value = call_user_func_array( array( $g_plugin_cache[$p_plugin], $p_callback ), array_merge( array( $p_event ), $p_params ) );
 215 		}
 216 
 217 		plugin_pop_current();
 218 	} else {
 219 		if( function_exists( $p_callback ) ) {
 220 			$t_value = call_user_func_array( $p_callback, array_merge( array( $p_event ), $p_params ) );
 221 		}
 222 	}
 223 
 224 	return $t_value;
 225 }
 226 
 227 /**
 228  * Process an execute event type.
 229  * All callbacks will be called with parameters, and their
 230  * return values will be ignored.
 231  * @param string $p_event     Event name.
 232  * @param array  $p_callbacks Array of callback function/plugin base name key/value pairs.
 233  * @param array  $p_params    Callback parameters.
 234  * @return void
 235  * @access public
 236  */
 237 function event_type_execute( $p_event, array $p_callbacks, $p_params = null ) {
 238 	foreach( $p_callbacks as $t_plugin => $t_callbacks ) {
 239 		foreach( $t_callbacks as $t_callback ) {
 240 			event_callback( $p_event, $t_callback, $t_plugin, $p_params );
 241 		}
 242 	}
 243 }
 244 
 245 /**
 246  * Process an output event type.
 247  * All callbacks will be called with the given parameters, and their
 248  * return values will be echoed to the client, separated by a given string.
 249  * If there are no callbacks, then nothing will be sent as output.
 250  * @param string $p_event     Event name.
 251  * @param array  $p_callbacks Array of callback function/plugin base name key/value pairs.
 252  * @param mixed  $p_params    Parameters to event callback (array, or single object)
 253  * @param mixed  $p_format    Output separator (if single string) or indexed array of pre, mid, and post strings.
 254  * @access public
 255  * @return void
 256  */
 257 function event_type_output( $p_event, array $p_callbacks, $p_params = null, $p_format = '' ) {
 258 	$t_prefix = '';
 259 	$t_separator = '';
 260 	$t_postfix = '';
 261 
 262 	if( is_array( $p_format ) ) {
 263 		switch( count( $p_format ) ) {
 264 			case 3:
 265 				$t_postfix = $p_format[2];
 266 			case 2:
 267 				$t_separator = $p_format[1];
 268 			case 1:
 269 				$t_prefix = $p_format[0];
 270 		}
 271 	} else {
 272 		$t_separator = $p_format;
 273 	}
 274 
 275 	$t_output = array();
 276 	foreach( $p_callbacks as $t_plugin => $t_callbacks ) {
 277 		foreach( $t_callbacks as $t_callback ) {
 278 			$t_output[] = event_callback( $p_event, $t_callback, $t_plugin, $p_params );
 279 		}
 280 	}
 281 	if( count( $p_callbacks ) > 0 ) {
 282 		echo $t_prefix, implode( $t_separator, $t_output ), $t_postfix;
 283 	}
 284 }
 285 
 286 /**
 287  * Process a chained event type.
 288  * The first callback with be called with the given input.  All following
 289  * callbacks will be called with the previous's output as its input.  The
 290  * final callback's return value will be returned to the event origin.
 291  * @param string $p_event     Event name.
 292  * @param array  $p_callbacks Array of callback function/plugin basename key/value pairs.
 293  * @param mixed  $p_input     Input data.
 294  * @param array  $p_params    Parameters.
 295  * @return mixed Output data
 296  * @access public
 297  */
 298 function event_type_chain( $p_event, array $p_callbacks, $p_input, $p_params = null ) {
 299 	$t_output = $p_input;
 300 
 301 	foreach( $p_callbacks as $t_plugin => $t_callbacks ) {
 302 		foreach( $t_callbacks as $t_callback ) {
 303 			if( !is_array( $t_output ) ) {
 304 				$t_output = array(
 305 					$t_output,
 306 				);
 307 			}
 308 
 309 			$t_params = array_merge( $t_output, $p_params );
 310 			$t_output = event_callback( $p_event, $t_callback, $t_plugin, $t_params );
 311 		}
 312 	}
 313 	return $t_output;
 314 }
 315 
 316 /**
 317  * Process a first-return event.
 318  * Callbacks will be called with the given parameters until a callback
 319  * returns a non-null value; at this point, no other callbacks will be
 320  * processed, and the return value be passed back to the event origin.
 321  * @param string $p_event     Event name.
 322  * @param array  $p_callbacks Array of callback function/plugin basename key/value pairs.
 323  * @param mixed  $p_params    Parameters passed to callbacks.
 324  * @return mixed|null The first non-null callback result, or null otherwise
 325  * @access public
 326  */
 327 function event_type_first( $p_event, array $p_callbacks, $p_params ) {
 328 	$t_output = null;
 329 
 330 	foreach( $p_callbacks as $t_plugin => $t_callbacks ) {
 331 		foreach( $t_callbacks as $t_callback ) {
 332 			$t_output = event_callback( $p_event, $t_callback, $t_plugin, $p_params );
 333 
 334 			if( !is_null( $t_output ) ) {
 335 				return $t_output;
 336 			}
 337 		}
 338 	}
 339 
 340 	return null;
 341 }
 342 
 343 /**
 344  * Process a default event type.
 345  * All callbacks will be called with the given data parameters.  The
 346  * return value of each callback will be appended to an array with the callback's
 347  * basename as the key.  This array will then be returned to the event origin.
 348  * @param string $p_event     Event name.
 349  * @param array  $p_callbacks Array of callback function/plugin basename key/value pairs.
 350  * @param mixed  $p_data      Data.
 351  * @return array Array of callback/return key/value pairs
 352  * @access public
 353  */
 354 function event_type_default( $p_event, array $p_callbacks, $p_data ) {
 355 	$t_output = array();
 356 	foreach( $p_callbacks as $t_plugin => $t_callbacks ) {
 357 		foreach( $t_callbacks as $t_callback ) {
 358 			$t_output[$t_plugin][$t_callback] = event_callback( $p_event, $t_callback, $t_plugin, $p_data );
 359 		}
 360 	}
 361 	return $t_output;
 362 }

  58 $g_cache_file_count = array();

  60 /**
  61  * Attached specified files to issue.
  62  *
  63  * @param int   $p_bug_id     The bug id.
  64  * @param array $p_files      The array of files, if null, then do nothing.
  65  * @param int   $p_bugnote_id The bugnote id, or 0 if issue attachments.
  66  *
  67  * @return array Array of file info arrays.
  68  * @throws ClientException
  69  * @throws ServiceException
  70  */
  71 function file_attach_files( $p_bug_id, $p_files, $p_bugnote_id = 0 ) {
  72 	if( $p_files === null || count( $p_files ) == 0 ) {
  73 		return array();
  74 	}
  75 
  76 	$t_file_infos = array();
  77 	foreach( $p_files as $t_file ) {
  78 		if( !empty( $t_file['name'] ) ) {
  79 			# $p_bug_id, array $p_file, $p_table = 'bug', $p_title = '', $p_desc = '', $p_user_id = null, $p_date_added = 0, $p_skip_bug_update = false, $p_bugnote_id = 0
  80 			$t_file_infos[] = file_add(
  81 				$p_bug_id,
  82 				$t_file,
  83 				'bug',
  84 				'', /* title */
  85 				'', /* desc */
  86 				null, /* user_id */
  87 				0, /* date_added */
  88 				0, /* skip_bug_update */
  89 				$p_bugnote_id );
  90 		}
  91 	}
  92 
  93 	return $t_file_infos;
  94 }
