  96 /**
  97  * Gets the filename without the bug id prefix.
  98  *
  99  * @param string $p_filename Filename.
 100  *
 101  * @return string
 102  */
 103 function file_get_display_name( $p_filename ) {
 104 	# Check if it's a project document filename (doc-0000000-filename)
 105 	# or a bug attachment filename (0000000-filename)
 106 	# for newer filenames, the filename in schema is correct.
 107 	# This is important to handle filenames with '-'s properly
 108 	$t_doc_match = '/^' . config_get( 'document_files_prefix' ) . '-\d{7}-/';
 109 	$t_name = preg_split( $t_doc_match, $p_filename );
 110 	if( isset( $t_name[1] ) ) {
 111 		return $t_name[1];
 112 	} else {
 113 		$t_bug_match = '/^\d{7}-/';
 114 		$t_name = preg_split( $t_bug_match, $p_filename );
 115 		return $t_name[1] ?? $p_filename;
 116 	}
 117 }

 119 /**
 120  * Fills the cache with the attachment count from a list of bugs.
 121  *
 122  * If the bug doesn't have attachments, cache its value as 0.
 123  *
 124  * @global array $g_cache_file_count
 125  * @param array $p_bug_ids Array of bug ids
 126  *
 127  * @return void
 128  */
 129 function file_bug_attachment_count_cache( array $p_bug_ids ) {
 130 	global $g_cache_file_count;
 131 
 132 	if( empty( $p_bug_ids ) ) {
 133 		return;
 134 	}
 135 
 136 	$t_ids_to_search = array();
 137 	foreach( $p_bug_ids as $t_id ) {
 138 		$c_id = (int)$t_id;
 139 		$t_ids_to_search[$c_id] = $c_id;
 140 	}
 141 
 142 	db_param_push();
 143 	$t_params = array();
 144 	$t_in_values = array();
 145 	foreach( $t_ids_to_search as $t_id ) {
 146 		$t_params[] = (int)$t_id;
 147 		$t_in_values[] = db_param();
 148 	}
 149 
 150 	$t_query = 'SELECT B.id AS bug_id, COUNT(F.bug_id) AS attachments'
 151 			. ' FROM {bug} B JOIN {bug_file} F ON ( B.id = F.bug_id )'
 152 			. ' WHERE B.id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_in_values ) . ')'
 153 			. ' GROUP BY B.id';
 154 
 155 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 156 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 157 		$c_bug_id = (int)$t_row['bug_id'];
 158 		$g_cache_file_count[$c_bug_id] = (int)$t_row['attachments'];
 159 		unset( $t_ids_to_search[$c_bug_id] );
 160 	}
 161 
 162 	# set bugs without result to 0
 163 	foreach( $t_ids_to_search as $t_id ) {
 164 		$g_cache_file_count[$t_id] = 0;
 165 	}
 166 }

 168 /**
 169  * Check the number of attachments a bug has (if any).
 170  *
 171  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
 172  *
 173  * @return int
 174  */
 175 function file_bug_attachment_count( $p_bug_id ) {
 176 	global $g_cache_file_count;
 177 
 178 	# If it's not in cache, load the value
 179 	if( !isset( $g_cache_file_count[$p_bug_id] ) ) {
 180 		file_bug_attachment_count_cache( array( (int)$p_bug_id ) );
 181 	}
 182 
 183 	return $g_cache_file_count[$p_bug_id];
 184 }

 186 /**
 187  * Clear a bug from the cache or all bugs if no bug id specified.
 188  *
 189  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier to clear (optional).
 190  *
 191  * @return bool
 192  * @access public
 193  */
 194 function file_bug_attachment_count_clear_cache( $p_bug_id = null ) {
 195 	global $g_cache_file_count;
 196 
 197 	if( null === $p_bug_id ) {
 198 		$g_cache_file_count = array();
 199 	} else {
 200 		unset( $g_cache_file_count[(int)$p_bug_id] );
 201 	}
 202 
 203 	return true;
 204 }

 217 		return false;

 221 /**
 222  * Check if the current user can view or download attachments.
 223  *
 224  * Generic call used by
 225  * - {@see file_can_view_bug_attachments()}
 226  * - {@see file_can_view_bugnote_attachments}
 227  * - {@see file_can_download_bug_attachments()}
 228  * - {@see file_can_download_bugnote_attachments}
 229  *
 230  * @param string   $p_action           'view' or 'download'
 231  * @param int      $p_bug_id           A bug identifier
 232  * @param int      $p_uploader_user_id The user who uploaded the attachment
 233  * @param int|null $p_bugnote_id       If specified, will check at bugnote level
 234  *
 235  * @return bool
 236  * @throws ClientException
 237  *
 238  * @internal Should not be used outside of File API.
 239  */
 240 function file_can_view_or_download( $p_action, $p_bug_id, $p_uploader_user_id, $p_bugnote_id = null ) {
 241 	switch( $p_action ) {
 242 		case 'view':
 243 			$t_threshold_global = 'view_attachments_threshold';
 244 			$t_threshold_own = 'allow_view_own_attachments';
 245 			break;
 246 		case 'download':
 247 			$t_threshold_global = 'download_attachments_threshold';
 248 			$t_threshold_own = 'allow_download_own_attachments';
 249 			break;
 250 		default:
 251 			trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 252 			return false;
 253 	}
 254 
 255 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 256 	$t_access_global = config_get( $t_threshold_global,null, null, $t_project_id );
 257 
 258 	if( $p_bugnote_id === null ) {
 259 		$t_can_access = access_has_bug_level( $t_access_global, $p_bug_id );
 260 	} else {
 261 		$t_can_access = access_has_bugnote_level( $t_access_global, $p_bugnote_id );
 262 	}
 263 	if( $t_can_access ) {
 264 		return true;
 265 	}
 266 
 267 	$t_uploaded_by_me = auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_uploader_user_id;
 268 	$t_view_own = config_get( $t_threshold_own, null, null, $t_project_id );
 269 	return $t_uploaded_by_me && $t_view_own;
 270 }

 358 /**
 359  * Get icon corresponding to the specified filename.
 360  *
 361  * @param string $p_display_filename Filename.
 362  *
 363  * @return array Associative array with "url" and "alt" text.
 364  */
 365 function file_get_icon_url( $p_display_filename ) {
 366 	$t_file_type_icons = config_get_global( 'file_type_icons' );
 367 
 368 	$t_ext = mb_strtolower( pathinfo( $p_display_filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION ) );
 369 	if( is_blank( $t_ext ) || !isset( $t_file_type_icons[$t_ext] ) ) {
 370 		$t_ext = '?';
 371 	}
 372 
 373 	return array(
 374 		'url' => $t_file_type_icons[$t_ext],
 375 		'alt' => $t_ext == '?' ? lang_get( 'unknown' ) : $t_ext
 376 	);
 377 }

 379 /**
 380  * Combines a path and a file name making sure that the separator exists.
 381  *
 382  * @param string $p_path     The path.
 383  * @param string $p_filename The file name.
 384  *
 385  * @return string The combined full path.
 386  */
 387 function file_path_combine( $p_path, $p_filename ) {
 388 	$t_path = rtrim( $p_path, '/\\' ) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
 389 
 390 	$t_path .= $p_filename;
 391 
 392 	return $t_path;
 393 }
 394 
 395 /**
 396  * Normalizes the disk file path.
 397  *
 398  * Based on the following algorithm:
 399  * 1. If disk file exists, then return as is.
 400  * 2. If not, and a project path is available, then check with that, if exists return it.
 401  * 3. If not, then use default upload path, then check with that, if exists return it.
 402  * 4. If disk file does not include a path, then return expected path based on project path or default path.
 403  * 5. Otherwise return as is.
 404  *
 405  * @param string  $p_diskfile   The disk file (full path or just filename).
 406  * @param int $p_project_id The project id - shouldn't be 0 (ALL_PROJECTS).
 407  *
 408  * @return string The normalized full path.
 409  */
 410 function file_normalize_attachment_path( $p_diskfile, $p_project_id ) {
 411 	if( file_exists( $p_diskfile ) ) {
 412 		return $p_diskfile;
 413 	}
 414 
 415 	$t_basename = basename( $p_diskfile );
 416 
 417 	$t_expected_file_path = '';
 418 
 419 	if( $p_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 420 		$t_path = project_get_field( $p_project_id, 'file_path' );
 421 		if( !is_blank( $t_path ) ) {
 422 			$t_diskfile = file_path_combine( $t_path, $t_basename );
 423 
 424 			if( file_exists( $t_diskfile ) ) {
 425 				return $t_diskfile;
 426 			}
 427 
 428 			# if we don't find the file, then this is the path we want to return.
 429 			$t_expected_file_path = $t_diskfile;
 430 		}
 431 	}
 432 
 433 	$t_path = config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder' );
 434 	if( !is_blank( $t_path ) ) {
 435 		$t_diskfile = file_path_combine( $t_path, $t_basename );
 436 
 437 		if( file_exists( $t_diskfile ) ) {
 438 			return $t_diskfile;
 439 		}
 440 
 441 		# if the expected path not set to project directory, then set it to default directory.
 442 		if( is_blank( $t_expected_file_path ) ) {
 443 			$t_expected_file_path = $t_diskfile;
 444 		}
 445 	}
 446 
 447 	# if diskfile doesn't include a path, then use the expected filename.
 448 	if( ( strstr( $p_diskfile, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR ) === false ||
 449 	       strstr( $p_diskfile, '\\' ) === false ) &&
 450 	     !is_blank( $t_expected_file_path ) ) {
 451 	    return $t_expected_file_path;
 452 	}
 453 
 454 	# otherwise return as is.
 455 	return $p_diskfile;
 456 }

 458 /**
 459  * Gets an array of attachments that are visible to the currently logged in user.
 460  *
 461  * Each element of the array contains the following:
 462  * - display_name - The attachment display name (i.e. file name dot extension)
 463  * - size - The attachment size in bytes.
 464  * - date_added - The date where the attachment was added.
 465  * - can_download - true: logged in user has access to download the attachment, false: otherwise.
 466  * - diskfile - The name of the file on disk.  Typically this is a hash without an extension.
 467  * - download_url - The download URL for the attachment (only set if can_download is true).
 468  * - exists - Applicable for DISK attachments.  true: file exists, otherwise false.
 469  * - can_delete - The logged in user can delete the attachments.
 470  * - preview - true: the attachment should be previewable, otherwise false.
 471  * - type - Can be "image", "text" or empty for other types.
 472  * - alt - The alternate text to be associated with the icon.
 473  * - icon - array with icon information, contains 'url' and 'alt' elements.
 474  *
 475  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
 476  *
 477  * @return array
 478  * @throws ClientException
 479  */
 480 function file_get_visible_attachments( $p_bug_id ) {
 481 	$t_attachment_rows = bug_get_attachments( $p_bug_id );
 482 	$t_visible_attachments = array();
 483 
 484 	$t_attachments_count = count( $t_attachment_rows );
 485 	if( $t_attachments_count === 0 ) {
 486 		return $t_visible_attachments;
 487 	}
 488 
 489 	$t_attachments = array();
 490 
 491 	$t_preview_text_ext = config_get( 'preview_text_extensions' );
 492 	$t_preview_image_ext = config_get( 'preview_image_extensions' );
 493 
 494 	foreach( $t_attachment_rows as $t_row ) {
 495 		$t_user_id = (int)$t_row['user_id'];
 496 		$t_attachment_note_id = (int)$t_row['bugnote_id'];
 497 
 498 		if( !file_can_view_bug_attachments( $p_bug_id, $t_user_id )
 499 		|| !file_can_view_bugnote_attachments( $t_attachment_note_id, $t_user_id, $p_bug_id )
 500 		) {
 501 			continue;
 502 		}
 503 
 504 		$t_id = (int)$t_row['id'];
 505 		$t_filename = $t_row['filename'];
 506 		$t_filesize = (int)$t_row['filesize'];
 507 		$t_diskfile = file_normalize_attachment_path( $t_row['diskfile'], bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' ) );
 508 		$t_date_added = $t_row['date_added'];
 509 
 510 		$t_attachment = array();
 511 		$t_attachment['id'] = $t_id;
 512 		$t_attachment['user_id'] = $t_user_id;
 513 		$t_attachment['display_name'] = file_get_display_name( $t_filename );
 514 		$t_attachment['size'] = $t_filesize;
 515 		$t_attachment['date_added'] = $t_date_added;
 516 		$t_attachment['diskfile'] = $t_diskfile;
 517 		$t_attachment['file_type'] = $t_row['file_type'];
 518 		$t_attachment['bugnote_id'] = $t_attachment_note_id;
 519 
 520 		$t_attachment['can_download'] = file_can_download_bug_attachments( $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 521 		$t_attachment['can_delete'] = file_can_delete_bug_attachments( $p_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 522 
 523 		if( $t_attachment['can_download'] ) {
 524 			$t_attachment['download_url'] = 'file_download.php?file_id=' . $t_id . '&type=bug';
 525 		}
 526 
 527 		$t_attachment['exists'] = config_get( 'file_upload_method' ) != DISK || file_exists( $t_diskfile );
 528 		$t_attachment['icon'] = file_get_icon_url( $t_attachment['display_name'] );
 529 
 530 		$t_attachment['preview'] = false;
 531 		$t_attachment['type'] = '';
 532 
 533 		$t_ext = strtolower( pathinfo( $t_attachment['display_name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION ) );
 534 		$t_attachment['alt'] = $t_ext;
 535 
 536 		if( $t_attachment['exists'] && $t_attachment['can_download'] && $t_filesize != 0 ) {
 537 			$t_preview = $t_filesize <= config_get( 'preview_attachments_inline_max_size' );
 538 
 539 			if( stripos( $t_attachment['file_type'], 'text/' ) === 0 || in_array( $t_ext, $t_preview_text_ext, true ) ) {
 540 				$t_attachment['preview'] = $t_preview;
 541 				$t_attachment['type'] = 'text';
 542 			} else if( stripos( $t_attachment['file_type'], 'image/' ) === 0 || in_array( $t_ext, $t_preview_image_ext, true ) ) {
 543 				$t_attachment['preview'] = $t_preview;
 544 				$t_attachment['type'] = 'image';
 545 			} else if( stripos( $t_attachment['file_type'], 'audio/' ) === 0 ) {
 546 				$t_attachment['preview'] = $t_preview;
 547 				$t_attachment['type'] = 'audio';
 548 			} else if( stripos( $t_attachment['file_type'], 'video/' ) === 0 ) {
 549 				$t_attachment['preview'] = $t_preview;
 550 				$t_attachment['type'] = 'video';
 551 			}
 552 		}
 553 
 554 		$t_attachments[] = $t_attachment;
 555 	}
 556 
 557 	return $t_attachments;
 558 }

 560 /**
 561  * Delete all files that are associated with the given bug.
 562  * 
 563  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
 564  *                          
 565  * @return bool
 566  * @throws ClientException
 567  */
 568 function file_delete_attachments( $p_bug_id ) {
 569 	$t_method = config_get( 'file_upload_method' );
 570 
 571 	# Delete files from disk
 572 	db_param_push();
 573 	$t_query = 'SELECT diskfile, filename FROM {bug_file} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 574 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 575 
 576 	$t_file_count = db_num_rows( $t_result );
 577 	if( 0 == $t_file_count ) {
 578 		return true;
 579 	}
 580 
 581 	if( DISK == $t_method ) {
 582 		for( $i = 0; $i < $t_file_count; $i++ ) {
 583 			$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 584 
 585 			$t_local_diskfile = file_normalize_attachment_path( $t_row['diskfile'], bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' ) );
 586 			file_delete_local( $t_local_diskfile );
 587 		}
 588 	}
 589 
 590 	# Delete the corresponding db records
 591 	db_param_push();
 592 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_file} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 593 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 594 
 595 	# db_query() errors on failure so:
 596 	return true;
 597 }

 674  * @return void
 675  */

 705 /**
 706  * Delete File.
 707  *

 709  * @param string $p_table      Table identifier.
 710  * @param int    $p_bugnote_id The bugnote id the file is attached to or 0 if
 711  *                             attached to issue.
 712  *
 713  * @return bool
 714  * @throws ClientException
 715  */
 716 function file_delete( $p_file_id, $p_table = 'bug', $p_bugnote_id = 0 ) {
 717 	$t_upload_method = config_get( 'file_upload_method' );
 718 
 719 	$c_file_id = (int)$p_file_id;
 720 	$t_filename = file_get_field( $p_file_id, 'filename', $p_table );
 721 	$t_diskfile = file_get_field( $p_file_id, 'diskfile', $p_table );
 722 
 723 	if( $p_table == 'bug' ) {
 724 		$t_bug_id = file_get_field( $p_file_id, 'bug_id', $p_table );
 725 		$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $t_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 726 	} else {
 727 		$t_project_id = file_get_field( $p_file_id, 'project_id', $p_table );
 728 	}
 729 
 730 	if( DISK == $t_upload_method ) {
 731 		$t_local_disk_file = file_normalize_attachment_path( $t_diskfile, $t_project_id );
 732 		if( file_exists( $t_local_disk_file ) ) {
 733 			file_delete_local( $t_local_disk_file );
 734 		}
 735 	}
 736 
 737 	if( 'bug' == $p_table ) {
 738 		# log file deletion
 739 		history_log_event_special( $t_bug_id, FILE_DELETED, file_get_display_name( $t_filename ), $p_bugnote_id );
 740 	}
 741 
 742 	$t_file_table = db_get_table( $p_table . '_file' );
 743 	db_param_push();
 744 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM ' . $t_file_table . ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
 745 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_file_id ) );
 746 	return true;
 747 }

 749 /**
 750  * File type check.
 751  *
 752  * @param string $p_file_name File name.
 753  *
 754  * @return bool
 755  */
 756 function file_type_check( $p_file_name ) {
 757 	$t_allowed_files = config_get( 'allowed_files' );
 758 	$t_disallowed_files = config_get( 'disallowed_files' );
 759 
 760 	# grab extension
 761 	$t_extension = pathinfo( $p_file_name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION );
 762 
 763 	# check against disallowed files
 764 	if( !is_blank( $t_disallowed_files ) ) {
 765 		$t_disallowed_arr = explode( ',', $t_disallowed_files );
 766 		foreach( $t_disallowed_arr as $t_val ) {
 767 			if( 0 == strcasecmp( $t_val, $t_extension ) ) {
 768 				return false;
 769 			}
 770 		}
 771 	}
 772 
 773 	# if the allowed list is not populated then the file must be allowed
 774 	if( is_blank( $t_allowed_files ) ) {
 775 		return true;
 776 	}
 777 
 778 	# check against allowed files
 779 	$t_allowed_arr = explode( ',', $t_allowed_files );
 780 	foreach( $t_allowed_arr as $t_val ) {
 781 		if( 0 == strcasecmp( $t_val, $t_extension ) ) {
 782 			return true;
 783 		}
 784 	}
 785 
 786 	return false;
 787 }

 798 function file_clean_name( $p_filename ) {

 802 /**
 803  * Generate a unique string for a given file path.
 804  *
 805  * 32 characters hash to be used as the identifier for the file.
 806  *
 807  * @param string $p_filepath File path.
 808  *
 809  * @return string
 810  * @throws Exception If no randomness source available.
 811  */
 812 function file_generate_unique_name( $p_filepath ) {
 813 	do {
 814 		$t_string = md5( random_bytes( 32 ) );
 815 	} while( !diskfile_is_name_unique( $t_string, $p_filepath ) );
 816 
 817 	return $t_string;
 818 }

 820 /**
 821  * Validates that the given disk file name identifier is unique.
 822  *
 823  * Checking both in the DB tables (bug and project) and on disk.
 824  * This ensures that in case a file has been deleted from disk but its record
 825  * remains in the DB, we never get in a situation where the DB points to a file
 826  * which is not the originally uploaded one.
 827  *
 828  * @param string $p_name     File name.
 829  * @param string $p_filepath File path.
 830  *
 831  * @return bool true if unique
 832  */
 833 function diskfile_is_name_unique( $p_name, $p_filepath ) {
 834 	$c_name = $p_filepath . $p_name;
 835 
 836 	db_param_push();
 837 	$t_query = 'SELECT count(*)
 838 		FROM (
 839 			SELECT diskfile FROM {bug_file} WHERE diskfile=' . db_param() . '
 840 			UNION
 841 			SELECT diskfile FROM {project_file} WHERE diskfile=' . db_param() . '
 842 			) f';
 843 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_name, $c_name) );
 844 	$t_count = db_result( $t_result );
 845 
 846 	return ( $t_count == 0 ) && !file_exists( $c_name );
 847 }

 849 /**
 850  * Validates that the given file name is unique in the given context.
 851  *
 852  * We don't allow multiple attachments with the same name for a given bug or project.
 853  *
 854  * @param string $p_name   File name.
 855  * @param int    $p_bug_id A bug identifier (not used for project files).
 856  * @param string $p_table  Optional file table to check: 'project' or 'bug' (default).
 857  *
 858  * @return bool true if unique
 859  */
 860 function file_is_name_unique( $p_name, $p_bug_id, $p_table = 'bug' ) {
 861 	$t_file_table = db_get_table( "{$p_table}_file" );
 862 
 863 	db_param_push();
 864 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' . $t_file_table . ' WHERE filename=' . db_param();
 865 	$t_param = array( $p_name );
 866 	if( $p_table == 'bug' ) {
 867 		$t_query .= ' AND bug_id=' . db_param();
 868 		$t_param[] = $p_bug_id;
 869 	}
 870 
 871 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_param );
 872 	$t_count = db_result( $t_result );
 873 
 874 	return ( $t_count == 0 );
 875 }

 877 /**
 878  * Add a file to the system using the configured storage method.
 879  *
 880  * If file was not uploaded by the browser standard POST method, set value
 881  * for key `browser_upload` on $p_file to false.  Otherwise, the file_add()
 882  * operation will fail.
 883  *
 884  * @param int    $p_bug_id          The bug id (should be 0 when adding project
 885  *                                  doc).
 886  * @param array  $p_file            The uploaded file info, as retrieved from
 887  *                                  gpc_get_file().
 888  * @param string $p_table           Either 'bug' or 'project' depending on
 889  *                                  attachment type.
 890  * @param string $p_title           File title.
 891  * @param string $p_desc            File description.
 892  * @param int    $p_user_id         User id (defaults to current user).
 893  * @param int    $p_date_added      Date added.
 894  * @param bool   $p_skip_bug_update Skip bug last modification update (useful
 895  *                                  when importing bug attachments).
 896  * @param int    $p_bugnote_id      The bugnote id or 0 if associated with the
 897  *                                  issue.
 898  *
 899  * @return array The file info array (keys: name, size)
 900  * @throws ClientException
 901  * @throws ServiceException
 902  * @throws Exception
 903  */
 904 function file_add( $p_bug_id, array $p_file, $p_table = 'bug', $p_title = '', $p_desc = '', $p_user_id = null, $p_date_added = 0, $p_skip_bug_update = false, $p_bugnote_id = 0 ) {
 905 	$t_file_info = array();
 906 
 907 	if( !isset( $p_file['error'] ) ) {
 908 		$p_file['error'] = UPLOAD_ERR_OK;
 909 	}
 910 
 911 	if( !isset( $p_file['browser_upload'] ) ) {
 912 		$p_file['browser_upload'] = true;
 913 	}
 914 
 915 	$t_tmp_file = $p_file['tmp_name'];
 916 
 917 	# Override passed value with one detected by PHP (if available).
 918 	# If PHP can't detect it, then use supplied value.
 919 	# If no value supplied, then default to a reasonable value.
 920 	# The value will be overridden by PHP anyway if content type is
 921 	# known at rendering time.
 922 	$t_type = file_get_mime_type( $t_tmp_file );
 923 	if( $t_type !== false ) {
 924 		$p_file['type'] = $t_type;
 925 	} else if( !isset( $p_file['type'] ) ) {
 926 		$p_file['type'] = 'application/octet-stream';
 927 	}
 928 
 929 	file_ensure_uploaded( $p_file );
 930 	$t_file_name = $p_file['name'];
 931 
 932 	if( strlen( $t_file_name ) > DB_FIELD_SIZE_FILENAME ) {
 933 		throw new ClientException(
 934 			sprintf( "Filename '%s' is too long", $t_file_name ),
 935 			ERROR_FILE_NAME_TOO_LONG,
 936 			array( $t_file_name )
 937 		);
 938 	}
 939 
 940 	if( !file_type_check( $t_file_name ) ) {
 941 		throw new ClientException(
 942 			sprintf( "File '%s' type not allowed", $t_file_name ),
 943 			ERROR_FILE_NOT_ALLOWED
 944 		);
 945 	}
 946 
 947 	$t_org_filename = $t_file_name;
 948 	$t_suffix_id = 1;
 949 
 950 	while( !file_is_name_unique( $t_file_name, $p_bug_id ) ) {
 951 		$t_suffix_id++;
 952 
 953 		$t_dot_index = strripos( $t_org_filename, '.' );
 954 		if( $t_dot_index === false ) {
 955 			$t_file_name = $t_org_filename . '-' . $t_suffix_id;
 956 		} else {
 957 			$t_extension = substr( $t_org_filename, $t_dot_index, strlen( $t_org_filename ) - $t_dot_index );
 958 			$t_file_name = substr( $t_org_filename, 0, $t_dot_index ) . '-' . $t_suffix_id . $t_extension;
 959 		}
 960 	}
 961 
 962 	$t_file_info['name'] = $t_file_name;
 963 	antispam_check();
 964 
 965 	$t_file_size = filesize( $t_tmp_file );
 966 	if( 0 == $t_file_size ) {
 967 		throw new ClientException(
 968 			sprintf( "File '%s' not uploaded", $t_file_name ),
 969 			ERROR_FILE_NO_UPLOAD_FAILURE );
 970 	}
 971 
 972 	$t_file_info['size'] = $t_file_size;
 973 
 974 	$t_max_file_size = (int)min( ini_get_number( 'upload_max_filesize' ), ini_get_number( 'post_max_size' ), config_get( 'max_file_size' ) );
 975 	if( $t_file_size > $t_max_file_size ) {
 976 		throw new ClientException(
 977 			sprintf( "File '%s' too big", $t_file_name ),
 978 			ERROR_FILE_TOO_BIG );
 979 	}
 980 
 981 	if( 'bug' == $p_table ) {
 982 		$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 983 		$t_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
 984 	} else {
 985 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 986 		$t_id = $t_project_id;
 987 	}
 988 
 989 	if( $p_user_id === null ) {
 990 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 991 	}
 992 
 993 	if( $p_date_added <= 0 ) {
 994 		$p_date_added = db_now();
 995 	}
 996 
 997 	if( $t_project_id == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 998 		$t_file_path = config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder' );
 999 	} else {
1000 		$t_file_path = project_get_field( $t_project_id, 'file_path' );
1001 		if( is_blank( $t_file_path ) ) {
1002 			$t_file_path = config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder' );
1003 		}
1004 	}
1005 
1006 	$t_unique_name = file_generate_unique_name( $t_file_path );
1007 	$t_method = config_get( 'file_upload_method' );
1008 
1009 	switch( $t_method ) {
1010 		case DISK:
1011 			file_ensure_valid_upload_path( $t_file_path );
1012 
1013 			$t_disk_file_name = $t_file_path . $t_unique_name;
1014 			if( !file_exists( $t_disk_file_name ) ) {
1015 				if( $p_file['browser_upload'] ) {
1016 					if( !move_uploaded_file( $t_tmp_file, $t_disk_file_name ) ) {
1017 						throw new ServiceException(
1018 							'Unable to move uploaded file',
1019 							ERROR_FILE_MOVE_FAILED
1020 						);
1021 					}
1022 				} else {
1023 					if( !copy( $t_tmp_file, $t_disk_file_name ) || !unlink( $t_tmp_file ) ) {
1024 						throw new ServiceException(
1025 							'Unable to move uploaded file',
1026 							ERROR_FILE_MOVE_FAILED
1027 						);
1028 					}
1029 				}
1030 
1031 				chmod( $t_disk_file_name, config_get( 'attachments_file_permissions' ) );
1032 
1033 				$c_content = '';
1034 			} else {
1035 				throw new ClientException( 'Duplicate file', ERROR_FILE_DUPLICATE );
1036 			}
1037 			break;
1038 		case DATABASE:
1039 			$c_content = db_prepare_binary_string( fread( fopen( $t_tmp_file, 'rb' ), $t_file_size ) );
1040 			$t_file_path = '';
1041 			break;
1042 		default:
1043 			throw new ServiceException( 'Unknown file upload method', ERROR_GENERIC );
1044 	}
1045 
1046 	$t_file_table = db_get_table( $p_table . '_file' );
1047 	$t_id_col = $p_table . '_id';
1048 
1049 	db_param_push();
1050 
1051 	$t_param = array(
1052 		$t_id_col     => $t_id,
1053 		'title'       => $p_title,
1054 		'description' => $p_desc,
1055 		'diskfile'    => $t_unique_name,
1056 		'filename'    => $t_file_name,
1057 		'folder'      => $t_file_path,
1058 		'filesize'    => $t_file_size,
1059 		'file_type'   => $p_file['type'],
1060 		'date_added'  => $p_date_added,
1061 		'user_id'     => (int)$p_user_id
1062 	);
1063 	if( 'bug' == $p_table ) {
1064 		$t_param['bugnote_id'] = is_null( $p_bugnote_id ) ? null : (int)$p_bugnote_id;
1065 	}
1066 	# Oracle has to update BLOBs separately
1067 	if( !db_is_oracle() ) {
1068 		$t_param['content'] = $c_content;
1069 	}
1070 
1071 	$t_query_param = db_param();
1072 	for( $i = 1; $i < count( $t_param ); $i++ ) {
1073 		$t_query_param .= ', ' . db_param();
1074 	}
1075 
1076 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO ' . $t_file_table . '
1077 		( ' . implode( ', ', array_keys( $t_param ) ) . ' )
1078 	VALUES
1079 		( ' . $t_query_param . ' )';
1080 	db_query( $t_query, array_values( $t_param ) );
1081 
1082 	$t_file_info['id'] = db_insert_id( $t_file_table );
1083 
1084 	if( db_is_oracle() ) {
1085 		db_update_blob( $t_file_table, 'content', $c_content, "diskfile='$t_unique_name'" );
1086 	}
1087 
1088 	if( 'bug' == $p_table ) {
1089 		# update the last_updated date
1090 		if( !$p_skip_bug_update ) {
1091 			bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
1092 		}
1093 
1094 		# log file added to bug history
1095 		history_log_event_special( $p_bug_id, FILE_ADDED, $t_file_name, $p_bugnote_id );
1096 	}
1097 
1098 	return $t_file_info;
1099 }
1100 
1101 /**
1102  * Return true if file uploading is enabled, false otherwise.
1103  *
1104  * Checks both our config and PHP's.
1105  *
1106  * @return bool
1107  */
1108 function file_is_uploading_enabled() {
1109 	return ini_get_bool( 'file_uploads' )
1110 		&& ( ON == config_get( 'allow_file_upload' ) );
1111 }
1112 
1113 /**
1114  * Check if the user can upload files for this project.
1115  *
1116  * the project defaults to the current project and the user to the current user
1117  *
1118  * @param int $p_project_id A project identifier.
1119  * @param int $p_user_id    A user identifier.
1120  *
1121  * @return bool True if user can upload, false otherwise
1122  */
1123 function file_allow_project_upload( $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null ) {
1124 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
1125 		$p_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
1126 	}
1127 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
1128 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1129 	}
1130 	return( file_is_uploading_enabled() && ( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'upload_project_file_threshold' ), $p_project_id, $p_user_id ) ) );
1131 }
1132 
1133 /**
1134  * Check if the user can upload files for this bug.
1135  *
1136  * If the bug Id is null (default) we check whether the user can upload a file
1137  * to a new bug in the project.
1138  *
1139  * @param int $p_bug_id     A bug identifier.
1140  * @param int $p_user_id    A user identifier or null for the current user (default).
1141  * @param int $p_project_id The project id to check for or null for bug
1142  *                          project or current project.
1143  *
1144  * @return bool True if user can upload files, false otherwise.
1145  * @throws ClientException
1146  */
1147 function file_allow_bug_upload( $p_bug_id = null, $p_user_id = null, $p_project_id = null ) {
1148 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
1149 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1150 	}
1151 
1152 	# If uploads are disabled just return false
1153 	if( !file_is_uploading_enabled() ) {
1154 		return false;
1155 	}
1156 
1157 	if( null === $p_bug_id ) {
1158 		# new bug
1159 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id === null ? helper_get_current_project() : $p_project_id;
1160 
1161 		# the user must be the reporter if they're reporting a new bug
1162 		$t_reporter = true;
1163 	} else {
1164 		# existing bug
1165 		$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
1166 
1167 		# check if the user is the reporter of the bug
1168 		$t_reporter = bug_is_user_reporter( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id );
1169 	}
1170 
1171 	if( $t_reporter && ( ON == config_get( 'allow_reporter_upload' ) ) ) {
1172 		return true;
1173 	}
1174 
1175 	# Check the access level against the config setting
1176 	return access_has_project_level( config_get( 'upload_bug_file_threshold' ), $t_project_id, $p_user_id );
1177 }
1178 
1179 /**
1180  * Checks whether the specified upload path exists and is writable.
1181  *
1182  * @param string $p_upload_path Upload path.
1183  *
1184  * @return void
1185  * @throws ServiceException
1186  */
1187 function file_ensure_valid_upload_path( $p_upload_path ) {
1188 	if( !file_exists( $p_upload_path ) || !is_dir( $p_upload_path ) || !is_writable( $p_upload_path ) || !is_readable( $p_upload_path ) ) {
1189 		throw new ServiceException(
1190 			'Upload folder not valid',
1191 			ERROR_FILE_INVALID_UPLOAD_PATH );
1192 	}
1193 }
1194 
1195 /**
1196  * Ensure a file was uploaded.
1197  *
1198  * This function perform various checks for determining if the upload was
1199  * successful.
1200  *
1201  * @param array $p_file The uploaded file info, as retrieved from
1202  *                      gpc_get_file().
1203  *
1204  * @return void
1205  * @throws ClientException
1206  */
1207 function file_ensure_uploaded( array $p_file ) {
1208 	switch( $p_file['error'] ) {
1209 		case UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE:
1210 		case UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE:
1211 			throw new ClientException(
1212 				sprintf( "File '%s' too big", $p_file['name'] ),
1213 				ERROR_FILE_TOO_BIG );
1214 
1215 		case UPLOAD_ERR_PARTIAL:
1216 		case UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE:
1217 			throw new ClientException(
1218 				sprintf( "File '%s' upload failure", $p_file['name'] ),
1219 				ERROR_FILE_NO_UPLOAD_FAILURE );
1220 	}
1221 
1222 	if( ( '' == $p_file['tmp_name'] ) || ( '' == $p_file['name'] ) ) {
1223 		throw new ClientException(
1224 			'File name or path is empty',
1225 			ERROR_FILE_NO_UPLOAD_FAILURE );
1226 	}
1227 
1228 	if( !is_readable( $p_file['tmp_name'] ) ) {
1229 		throw new ClientException( 'File is not readable', ERROR_UPLOAD_FAILURE );
1230 	}
1231 }
1232 
1233 /**
1234  * Return instance of fileinfo class.
1235  *
1236  * @return finfo instance of finfo class.
1237  */
1238 function file_create_finfo() {
1239 	$t_info_file = config_get_global( 'fileinfo_magic_db_file' );
1240 
1241 	if( is_blank( $t_info_file ) ) {
1242 		$t_finfo = new finfo( FILEINFO_MIME );
1243 	} else {
1244 		$t_finfo = new finfo( FILEINFO_MIME, $t_info_file );
1245 	}
1246 
1247 	return $t_finfo;
1248 }
1249 
1250 /**
1251  * Get mime type for the specified file.
1252  *
1253  * @param string $p_file_path The file path.
1254  *
1255  * @return bool|string The mime type or false on failure.
1256  */
1257 function file_get_mime_type( $p_file_path ) {
1258 	if( !file_exists( $p_file_path ) ) {
1259 		return false;
1260 	}
1261 
1262 	$t_finfo = file_create_finfo();
1263 	return $t_finfo->file( $p_file_path );
1264 }
1265 
1266 /**
1267  * Get mime type for the specified content.
1268  *
1269  * @param string $p_content The content.
1270  *
1271  * @return bool|string The mime type or false on failure.
1272  */
1273 function file_get_mime_type_for_content( $p_content ) {
1274 	$t_finfo = file_create_finfo();
1275 	return $t_finfo->buffer( $p_content );
1276 }
1277 
1278 /**
1279  * Get file content.
1280  *
1281  * @param int $p_file_id File identifier.
1282  * @param string  $p_type    File type (either 'bug' or 'doc').
1283  *
1284  * @return array|bool array containing file type and content or false on
1285  *                    failure to retrieve file
1286  * @throws ClientException
1287  */
1288 function file_get_content( $p_file_id, $p_type = 'bug' ) {
1289 	# we handle the case where the file is attached to a bug
1290 	# or attached to a project as a project doc.
1291 	db_param_push();
1292 	switch( $p_type ) {
1293 		case 'bug':
1294 			$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_file} WHERE id=' . db_param();
1295 			break;
1296 		case 'doc':
1297 			$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {project_file} WHERE id=' . db_param();
1298 			break;
1299 		default:
1300 			return false;
1301 	}
1302 
1303 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_file_id ) );
1304 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
1305 
1306 	if( $p_type == 'bug' ) {
1307 		$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $t_row['bug_id'], 'project_id' );
1308 	} else {
1309 		$t_project_id = $t_row['bug_id'];
1310 	}
1311 
1312 	$t_content_type = $t_row['file_type'];
1313 
1314 	switch( config_get( 'file_upload_method' ) ) {
1315 		case DISK:
1316 			$t_local_disk_file = file_normalize_attachment_path( $t_row['diskfile'], $t_project_id );
1317 
1318 			if( file_exists( $t_local_disk_file ) ) {
1319 				$t_file_info_type = file_get_mime_type( $t_local_disk_file );
1320 
1321 				if( $t_file_info_type !== false ) {
1322 					$t_content_type = $t_file_info_type;
1323 				}
1324 
1325 				return array( 'type' => $t_content_type, 'content' => file_get_contents( $t_local_disk_file ) );
1326 			}
1327 			return false;
1328 		case DATABASE:
1329 			$t_file_info_type = file_get_mime_type_for_content( $t_row['content'] );
1330 
1331 			if( $t_file_info_type !== false ) {
1332 				$t_content_type = $t_file_info_type;
1333 			}
1334 
1335 			return array( 'type' => $t_content_type, 'content' => $t_row['content'] );
1336 		default:
1337 			trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
1338 	}
1339 	return false;
1340 }
1341 
1342 /**
1343  * Move any attachments as needed when a bug is moved from project to project.
1344  *
1345  * @param int $p_bug_id        ID of bug containing attachments to be moved.
1346  * @param int $p_project_id_to Destination project ID for the bug.
1347  * @return void
1348  *
1349  * @throws ClientException
1350  * @throws ServiceException
1351  * @todo: this function can't cope with source or target storing attachments in DB
1352  */
1353 function file_move_bug_attachments( $p_bug_id, $p_project_id_to ) {
1354 	$t_project_id_from = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
1355 	if( $t_project_id_from == $p_project_id_to ) {
1356 		return;
1357 	}
1358 
1359 	$t_method = config_get( 'file_upload_method' );
1360 	if( $t_method != DISK ) {
1361 		return;
1362 	}
1363 
1364 	if( !file_bug_has_attachments( $p_bug_id ) ) {
1365 		return;
1366 	}
1367 
1368 	$t_path_from = project_get_field( $t_project_id_from, 'file_path' );
1369 	if( is_blank( $t_path_from ) ) {
1370 		$t_path_from = config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder' );
1371 	}
1372 	file_ensure_valid_upload_path( $t_path_from );
1373 	$t_path_to = project_get_field( $p_project_id_to, 'file_path' );
1374 	if( is_blank( $t_path_to ) ) {
1375 		$t_path_to = config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder' );
1376 	}
1377 	file_ensure_valid_upload_path( $t_path_to );
1378 	if( $t_path_from == $t_path_to ) {
1379 		return;
1380 	}
1381 
1382 	# Initialize the update query to update a single row
1383 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
1384 	db_param_push();
1385 	$t_query_disk_attachment_update = 'UPDATE {bug_file}
1386 	                                 SET folder=' . db_param() . '
1387 	                                 WHERE bug_id=' . db_param() . '
1388 	                                 AND id =' . db_param();
1389 
1390 	$t_attachment_rows = bug_get_attachments( $p_bug_id );
1391 	$t_attachments_count = count( $t_attachment_rows );
1392 	for( $i = 0; $i < $t_attachments_count; $i++ ) {
1393 		$t_row = $t_attachment_rows[$i];
1394 		$t_basename = basename( $t_row['diskfile'] );
1395 
1396 		$t_disk_file_name_from = file_path_combine( $t_path_from, $t_basename );
1397 		$t_disk_file_name_to = file_path_combine( $t_path_to, $t_basename );
1398 
1399 		if( !file_exists( $t_disk_file_name_to ) ) {
1400 			chmod( $t_disk_file_name_from, 0775 );
1401 			if( !rename( $t_disk_file_name_from, $t_disk_file_name_to ) ) {
1402 				if( !copy( $t_disk_file_name_from, $t_disk_file_name_to ) ) {
1403 					trigger_error( ERROR_FILE_MOVE_FAILED, ERROR );
1404 				}
1405 				file_delete_local( $t_disk_file_name_from );
1406 			}
1407 			chmod( $t_disk_file_name_to, config_get( 'attachments_file_permissions' ) );
1408 			# Don't pop the parameters after query execution since we're in a loop
1409 			db_query( $t_query_disk_attachment_update,
1410 				array( $t_path_to, $c_bug_id, (int)$t_row['id'] ),
1411 				-1, -1,
1412 				false
1413 			);
1414 		} else {
1415 			trigger_error( ERROR_FILE_DUPLICATE, ERROR );
1416 		}
1417 	}
1418 	db_param_pop();
1419 }
1420 
1421 /**
1422  * Copies all attachments from the source bug to the destination bug
1423  *
1424  * Does not perform history logging and does not perform access checks.
1425  *
1426  * @param int $p_source_bug_id Source Bug.
1427  * @param int $p_dest_bug_id   Destination Bug.
1428  *
1429  * @return void
1430  * @throws ClientException
1431  * @throws Exception
1432  */
1433 function file_copy_attachments( $p_source_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id ) {
1434 	db_param_push();
1435 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_file} WHERE bug_id = ' . db_param();
1436 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_source_bug_id ) );
1437 	$t_count = db_num_rows( $t_result );
1438 
1439 	$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_source_bug_id, 'project_id' );
1440 
1441 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_count;$i++ ) {
1442 		$t_bug_file = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
1443 
1444 		# prepare the new diskfile name and then copy the file
1445 		$t_source_file = $t_bug_file['folder'] . $t_bug_file['diskfile'];
1446 		if( ( config_get( 'file_upload_method' ) == DISK ) ) {
1447 			$t_source_file = file_normalize_attachment_path( $t_source_file, $t_project_id );
1448 			$t_file_path = dirname( $t_source_file ) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
1449 		} else {
1450 			$t_file_path = $t_bug_file['folder'];
1451 		}
1452 		$t_new_diskfile_name = file_generate_unique_name( $t_file_path );
1453 		$t_new_diskfile_location = $t_file_path . $t_new_diskfile_name;
1454 		$t_new_file_name = file_get_display_name( $t_bug_file['filename'] );
1455 		if( ( config_get( 'file_upload_method' ) == DISK ) ) {
1456 			# Skip copy operation if file does not exist (i.e. target bug will have missing attachment)
1457 			# @todo maybe we should trigger an error instead in this case ?
1458 			if( file_exists( $t_source_file ) ) {
1459 				copy( $t_source_file, $t_new_diskfile_location );
1460 				chmod( $t_new_diskfile_location, config_get( 'attachments_file_permissions' ) );
1461 			}
1462 		}
1463 
1464 		db_param_push();
1465 		$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_file} (
1466 				bug_id, title, description, diskfile, filename, folder,
1467 				filesize, file_type, date_added, user_id, content
1468 			)
1469 			VALUES ( '
1470 			. db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', '
1471 			. db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', '
1472 			. db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', '
1473 			. db_param() . ', ' . db_param() .
1474 			')';
1475 		db_query( $t_query, array(
1476 			$p_dest_bug_id, $t_bug_file['title'], $t_bug_file['description'],
1477 			$t_new_diskfile_name, $t_new_file_name, $t_file_path,
1478 			$t_bug_file['filesize'], $t_bug_file['file_type'], $t_bug_file['date_added'],
1479 			$t_bug_file['user_id'], $t_bug_file['content']
1480 		) );
1481 	}
1482 }
1483 
1484 /**
1485  * Returns a possibly override content type for a file name
1486  *
1487  * @param string $p_filename The filename of the file which will be downloaded.
1488  *
1489  * @return string the content type, or empty if it should not be overridden
1490  */
1491 function file_get_content_type_override( $p_filename ) {
1492 	global $g_file_download_content_type_overrides;
1493 
1494 	$t_extension = pathinfo( $p_filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION );
1495 
1496 	if( isset( $g_file_download_content_type_overrides[$t_extension] ) ) {
1497 		return $g_file_download_content_type_overrides[$t_extension];
1498 	}
1499 
1500 	return null;
1501 }
1502 
1503 /**
1504  * Return the maximum file size that can be uploaded.
1505  *
1506  * Checks both Mantis and PHP configured settings.
1507  *
1508  * @return int File size in bytes
1509  */
1510 function file_get_max_file_size() {
1511 	return (int)min(
1512 		ini_get_number( 'upload_max_filesize' ),
1513 		ini_get_number( 'post_max_size' ),
1514 		config_get( 'max_file_size' )
1515 	);
1516 }

 128 /**
 129  * Allow plugins to define a set of class-based filters, and register/load
 130  * them here to be used by the rest of filter_api.
 131  * @return array Mapping of field name to filter object
 132  */
 133 function filter_get_plugin_filters() {
 134 	static $s_field_array = null;
 135 
 136 	if( is_null( $s_field_array ) ) {
 137 		$s_field_array = array();
 138 
 139 		$t_all_plugin_filters = event_signal( 'EVENT_FILTER_FIELDS' );
 140 		foreach( $t_all_plugin_filters as $t_plugin => $t_plugin_filters ) {
 141 			foreach( $t_plugin_filters as $t_callback => $t_plugin_filter_array ) {
 142 				if( is_array( $t_plugin_filter_array ) ) {
 143 					foreach( $t_plugin_filter_array as $t_filter_item ) {
 144 						if( is_object( $t_filter_item ) && $t_filter_item instanceof MantisFilter ) {
 145 							$t_filter_object = $t_filter_item;
 146 						} elseif( class_exists( $t_filter_item ) && is_subclass_of( $t_filter_item, 'MantisFilter' ) ) {
 147 							$t_filter_object = new $t_filter_item();
 148 						} else {
 149 							continue;
 150 						}
 151 						$t_filter_name = mb_strtolower( $t_plugin . '_' . $t_filter_object->field );
 152 						$s_field_array[$t_filter_name] = $t_filter_object;
 153 					}
 154 				}
 155 			}
 156 		}
 157 	}
 158 
 159 	return $s_field_array;
 160 }

 365 
 366 	if( !filter_field_is_any( $p_custom_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_SELECT] ) ) {
 367 		$t_query[] = filter_encode_field_and_value( FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_SELECT, $p_custom_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_SELECT] );
 368 	}
 369 
 370 	$t_query[] = filter_encode_field_and_value( FILTER_PROPERTY_MATCH_TYPE, $p_custom_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_MATCH_TYPE] );
 371 
 372 	if( isset( $p_custom_filter['custom_fields'] ) ) {
 373 		foreach( $p_custom_filter['custom_fields'] as $t_custom_field_id => $t_custom_field_values ) {
 374 			if( !filter_field_is_any( $t_custom_field_values ) ) {
 375 				$t_query[] = filter_encode_field_and_value( 'custom_field_' . $t_custom_field_id, $t_custom_field_values );
 376 			}
 377 		}
 378 	}
 379 
 380 	# Allow plugins to add filter fields
 381 	$t_plugin_filter_array = filter_get_plugin_filters();
 382 	foreach( $t_plugin_filter_array as $t_field_name => $t_filter_object ) {
 383 		if( !filter_field_is_any( $p_custom_filter[$t_field_name] ) ) {
 384 			$t_query[] = filter_encode_field_and_value( $t_field_name, $p_custom_filter[$t_field_name], $t_filter_object->type );
 385 		}
 386 	}
 387 
 388 	if( count( $t_query ) > 0 ) {
 389 		$t_query_str = implode( '&', $t_query );
 390 		$t_url = config_get_global( 'path' ) . 'search.php?' . $t_query_str;
 391 	} else {
 392 		$t_url = '';
 393 	}
 394 
 395 	return $t_url;
 396 }
 397 
 398 /**
 399  * Encodes a field and it's value for the filter URL.  This handles the URL encoding and arrays.
 400  * @param string  $p_field_name  The field name.
 401  * @param string  $p_field_value The field value (can be an array).
 402  * @param integer $p_field_type  Field Type e.g. FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_STRING.
 403  * @return string url encoded string
 404  */
 405 function filter_encode_field_and_value( $p_field_name, $p_field_value, $p_field_type = null ) {
 406 	$t_query_array = array();
 407 	if( is_array( $p_field_value ) ) {
 408 		$t_count = count( $p_field_value );
 409 		if( $t_count > 1 || $p_field_type == FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_STRING || $p_field_type == FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_INT ) {
 410 			foreach( $p_field_value as $t_value ) {
 411 				$t_query_array[] = string_url( $p_field_name . '[]' ) . '=' . string_url( $t_value );
 412 			}
 413 		} else if( $t_count == 1 ) {
 414 			$t_query_array[] = string_url( $p_field_name ) . '=' . string_url( $p_field_value[0] );
 415 		}
 416 	} else {
 417 		$t_query_array[] = string_url( $p_field_name ) . '=' . string_url( (string)$p_field_value );
 418 	}
 419 
 420 	return implode( '&', $t_query_array );
 421 }
 422 
 423 /**
 424  * Checks the supplied value to see if it is an ANY value.
 425  * @param string $p_field_value The value to check.
 426  * @return boolean true for "ANY" values and false for others.  "ANY" means filter criteria not active.
 427  */
 428 function filter_field_is_any( $p_field_value ) {
 429 	if( is_array( $p_field_value ) ) {
 430 		if( count( $p_field_value ) == 0 ) {
 431 			return true;
 432 		}
 433 
 434 		foreach( $p_field_value as $t_value ) {
 435 			if( ( META_FILTER_ANY == $t_value ) && ( is_numeric( $t_value ) ) ) {
 436 				return true;
 437 			}
 438 		}
 439 	} else {
 440 		if( is_string( $p_field_value ) && is_blank( $p_field_value ) ) {
 441 			return true;
 442 		}
 443 
 444 		if( is_bool( $p_field_value ) && !$p_field_value ) {
 445 			return true;
 446 		}
 447 
 448 		if( ( META_FILTER_ANY == $p_field_value ) && ( is_numeric( $p_field_value ) ) ) {
 449 			return true;
 450 		}
 451 	}
 452 
 453 	return false;
 454 }
 455 
 456 /**
 457  * Checks the supplied value to see if it is a NONE value.
 458  * @param string $p_field_value The value to check.
 459  * @return boolean true for "NONE" values and false for others.
 460  * @todo is a check for these necessary?  if( ( $t_filter_value === 'none' ) || ( $t_filter_value === '[none]' ) )
 461  */
 462 function filter_field_is_none( $p_field_value ) {
 463 	if( is_array( $p_field_value ) ) {
 464 		foreach( $p_field_value as $t_value ) {
 465 			if( ( META_FILTER_NONE == $t_value ) && ( is_numeric( $t_value ) ) ) {
 466 				return true;
 467 			}
 468 		}
 469 	} else {
 470 		if( is_string( $p_field_value ) && is_blank( $p_field_value ) ) {
 471 			return false;
 472 		}
 473 
 474 		if( ( META_FILTER_NONE == $p_field_value ) && ( is_numeric( $p_field_value ) ) ) {
 475 			return true;
 476 		}
 477 	}
 478 
 479 	return false;
 480 }
 481 
 482 /**
 483  *  Checks the supplied value to see if it is a MYSELF value.
 484  * @param string $p_field_value The value to check.
 485  * @return boolean true for "MYSELF" values and false for others.
 486  */
 487 function filter_field_is_myself( $p_field_value ) {
 488 	return( META_FILTER_MYSELF == $p_field_value ? true : false );
 489 }

 491 /**
 492  * Filter per page
 493  * @param array   $p_filter   Filter.
 494  * @param integer $p_count    Count.
 495  * @param integer $p_per_page Per page.
 496  * @return integer
 497  */
 498 function filter_per_page( array $p_filter, $p_count, $p_per_page ) {
 499 	$p_per_page = (( null == $p_per_page ) ? (int)$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_ISSUES_PER_PAGE] : $p_per_page );
 500 	$p_per_page = (( 0 == $p_per_page || -1 == $p_per_page ) ? $p_count : $p_per_page );
 501 
 502 	return (int)abs( $p_per_page );
 503 }
 504 
 505 /**
 506  *  Use $p_count and $p_per_page to determine how many pages to split this list up into.
 507  *  For the sake of consistency have at least one page, even if it is empty.
 508  * @param integer $p_count    Count.
 509  * @param integer $p_per_page Per page.
 510  * @return integer page count
 511  */
 512 function filter_page_count( $p_count, $p_per_page ) {
 513 	$t_page_count = ceil( $p_count / $p_per_page );
 514 	if( $t_page_count < 1 ) {
 515 		$t_page_count = 1;
 516 	}
 517 	return $t_page_count;
 518 }
 519 
 520 /**
 521  * Checks to make sure $p_page_number isn't past the last page.
 522  * and that $p_page_number isn't before the first page
 523  * @param integer $p_page_number Page number.
 524  * @param integer $p_page_count  Page count.
 525  * @return integer
 526  */
 527 function filter_valid_page_number( $p_page_number, $p_page_count ) {
 528 	if( $p_page_number > $p_page_count ) {
 529 		$p_page_number = $p_page_count;
 530 	}
 531 
 532 	if( $p_page_number < 1 ) {
 533 		$p_page_number = 1;
 534 	}
 535 	return $p_page_number;
 536 }
 537 
 538 /**
 539  * Figure out the offset into the db query, offset is which record to start querying from
 540  * @param integer $p_page_number Page number.
 541  * @param integer $p_per_page    Per page.
 542  * @return integer
 543  */
 544 function filter_offset( $p_page_number, $p_per_page ) {
 545 	return(( (int)$p_page_number -1 ) * (int)$p_per_page );
 546 }

 548 /**
 549  * Make sure the filter array contains all the fields. If any field is missing,
 550  * create it with a default value.
 551  * @param array $p_filter_arr Input filter array
 552  * @return array Processed filter array
 553  */
 554 function filter_ensure_fields( array $p_filter_arr ) {
 555 	# Fill missing filter properties with defaults
 556 	if( isset( $p_filter_arr['_view_type'] ) ) {
 557 		$t_filter_default = filter_get_default_array( $p_filter_arr['_view_type'] );
 558 	} else {
 559 		$t_filter_default = filter_get_default_array();
 560 	}
 561 
 562 	foreach( $t_filter_default as $t_key => $t_default_value ) {
 563 		if( !isset( $p_filter_arr[$t_key] ) ) {
 564 			$p_filter_arr[$t_key] = $t_default_value;
 565 		}
 566 	}
 567 
 568 	# Veryfy custom fields
 569 	foreach( $t_filter_default['custom_fields'] as $t_cfid => $t_cf_data ) {
 570 		if( !isset( $p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid] ) ) {
 571 			$p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid] = $t_cf_data;
 572 		}
 573 	}
 574 
 575 	return $p_filter_arr;
 576 }

 578 /**
 579  * A wrapper to compare filter version syntax
 580  * Note: Currently, filter versions have this syntax: "vN",  * where N is an integer number.
 581  * @param string $p_version1    First version number
 582  * @param string $p_version2    Second version number
 583  * @param string $p_operator    Comparison test, if provided. As expected by version_compare()
 584  * @return mixed	As returned by version_compare()
 585  */
 586 function filter_version_compare( $p_version1, $p_version2, $p_operator = null ) {
 587 	return version_compare( $p_version1, $p_version2, $p_operator );
 588 }
 589 
 590 /**
 591  * Upgrade a filter array to the current filter structure, by converting properties
 592  * that have changed from previous filter versions
 593  * @param array $p_filter	Filter array to upgrade
 594  * @return array	Updgraded filter array
 595  */
 596 function filter_version_upgrade( array $p_filter ) {
 597 	# This is a stub for future version upgrades
 598 
 599 	# After conversions are made, update filter value to current version
 600 	$p_filter['_version'] = FILTER_VERSION;
 601 	return $p_filter;
 602 }
 603 
 604 /**
 605  * Make sure that our filters are entirely correct and complete (it is possible that they are not).
 606  * We need to do this to cover cases where we don't have complete control over the filters given.
 607  * @param array $p_filter_arr	A filter array
 608  * @return array	Validated filter array
 609  */
 610 function filter_ensure_valid_filter( array $p_filter_arr ) {
 611 	if( !isset( $p_filter_arr['_version'] ) ) {
 612 		$p_filter_arr['_version'] = FILTER_VERSION;
 613 	}
 614 
 615 	if( filter_version_compare( $p_filter_arr['_version'], FILTER_VERSION, '<' ) ) {
 616 		$p_filter_arr = filter_version_upgrade( $p_filter_arr );
 617 	}
 618 
 619 	$p_filter_arr = filter_ensure_fields( $p_filter_arr );
 620 
 621 	$t_config_view_filters = config_get( 'view_filters' );
 622 	$t_view_type = $p_filter_arr['_view_type'];
 623 	if( ADVANCED_ONLY == $t_config_view_filters ) {
 624 		$t_view_type = FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED;
 625 	}
 626 	if( SIMPLE_ONLY == $t_config_view_filters ) {
 627 		$t_view_type = FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE;
 628 	}
 629 	if( !in_array( $t_view_type, array( FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE, FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED ) ) ) {
 630 		$t_view_type = filter_get_default_view_type();
 631 	}
 632 	$p_filter_arr['_view_type'] = $t_view_type;
 633 
 634 	$t_sort_fields = explode( ',', $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME] );
 635 	$t_dir_fields = explode( ',', $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION] );
 636 	# both arrays should be equal length, just in case
 637 	$t_sort_fields_count = min( count( $t_sort_fields ), count( $t_dir_fields ) );
 638 
 639 	# clean up sort fields, remove invalid columns
 640 	$t_new_sort_array = array();
 641 	$t_new_dir_array = array();
 642 	$t_all_columns = columns_get_all_active_columns();
 643 	for( $ix = 0; $ix < $t_sort_fields_count; $ix++ ) {
 644 		if( isset( $t_sort_fields[$ix] ) ) {
 645 			$t_column = $t_sort_fields[$ix];
 646 			# check that the column name exist
 647 			if( !in_array( $t_column, $t_all_columns ) ) {
 648 				continue;
 649 			}
 650 			# check that it has not been already used
 651 			if( in_array( $t_column, $t_new_sort_array ) ) {
 652 				continue;
 653 			}
 654 			# check that it is sortable
 655 			if( !column_is_sortable( $t_column ) ) {
 656 				continue;
 657 			}
 658 			$t_new_sort_array[] = $t_column;
 659 
 660 			# if there is no dir field, set a dummy value
 661 			if( isset( $t_dir_fields[$ix] ) ) {
 662 				$t_dir = $t_dir_fields[$ix];
 663 			} else {
 664 				$t_dir = '';
 665 			}
 666 			# normalize sort_dir value
 667 			$t_dir = ( $t_dir == 'ASC' ) ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
 668 			$t_new_dir_array[] = $t_dir;
 669 		}
 670 	}
 671 
 672 	if( count( $t_new_sort_array ) > 0 ) {
 673 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME] = implode( ',', $t_new_sort_array );
 674 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION] = implode( ',', $t_new_dir_array );
 675 	} else {
 676 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME] = filter_get_default_property( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME, $t_view_type );
 677 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION] = filter_get_default_property( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION, $t_view_type );
 678 	}
 679 
 680 	# Validate types for values.
 681 
 682 	# helper function to validate types
 683 	$t_function_validate_type = function( $p_value, $p_type ) {
 684 		$t_value = stripslashes( $p_value );
 685 		if( ( $t_value === 'any' ) || ( $t_value === '[any]' ) ) {
 686 			$t_value = META_FILTER_ANY;
 687 		}
 688 		if( ( $t_value === 'none' ) || ( $t_value === '[none]' ) ) {
 689 			$t_value = META_FILTER_NONE;
 690 		}
 691 		# Ensure the filter property has the right type - see #20087
 692 		switch( $p_type ) {
 693 			case 'string' :
 694 			case 'int' :
 695 				settype( $t_value, $p_type );
 696 				break;
 697 		}
 698 		return $t_value;
 699 	};
 700 
 701 	# Validate properties that must not be arrays
 702 	$t_single_value_list = array(
 703 		FILTER_PROPERTY_VIEW_STATE => 'int',
 704 		FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE => 'int',
 705 		FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG => 'int',
 706 	);
 707 	foreach( $t_single_value_list as $t_field_name => $t_field_type ) {
 708 		$t_value = $p_filter_arr[$t_field_name];
 709 		if( is_array( $t_value ) ) {
 710 			if( count( $t_value ) > 0 ) {
 711 				$p_filter_arr[$t_field_name] = reset( $t_value );
 712 			} else {
 713 				$p_filter_arr[$t_field_name] = filter_get_default_property( $t_field_name, $t_view_type );
 714 			}
 715 		}
 716 		$p_filter_arr[$t_field_name] = $t_function_validate_type( $p_filter_arr[$t_field_name], $t_field_type );
 717 	}
 718 
 719 	# Validate properties that must be arrays, and the type of its elements
 720 	$t_array_values_list = array(
 721 		FILTER_PROPERTY_CATEGORY_ID => 'string',
 722 		FILTER_PROPERTY_SEVERITY => 'int',
 723 		FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS => 'int',
 724 		FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID => 'int',
 725 		FILTER_PROPERTY_HANDLER_ID => 'int',
 726 		FILTER_PROPERTY_NOTE_USER_ID => 'int',
 727 		FILTER_PROPERTY_RESOLUTION => 'int',
 728 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PRIORITY => 'int',
 729 		FILTER_PROPERTY_BUILD => 'string',
 730 		FILTER_PROPERTY_VERSION => 'string',
 731 		FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS => 'int',
 732 		FILTER_PROPERTY_FIXED_IN_VERSION => 'string',
 733 		FILTER_PROPERTY_TARGET_VERSION => 'string',
 734 		FILTER_PROPERTY_MONITOR_USER_ID => 'int',
 735 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PROFILE_ID => 'int',
 736 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PLATFORM => 'string',
 737 		FILTER_PROPERTY_OS => 'string',
 738 		FILTER_PROPERTY_OS_BUILD => 'string',
 739 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID => 'int',
 740 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECTION => 'int'
 741 	);
 742 	foreach( $t_array_values_list as $t_multi_field_name => $t_multi_field_type ) {
 743 		if( !is_array( $p_filter_arr[$t_multi_field_name] ) ) {
 744 			$p_filter_arr[$t_multi_field_name] = array(
 745 				$p_filter_arr[$t_multi_field_name],
 746 			);
 747 		}
 748 		$t_checked_array = array();
 749 		foreach( $p_filter_arr[$t_multi_field_name] as $t_filter_value ) {
 750 			$t_checked_array[] = $t_function_validate_type( $t_filter_value, $t_multi_field_type );
 751 		}
 752 		$p_filter_arr[$t_multi_field_name] = $t_checked_array;
 753 	}
 754 
 755 	$t_custom_fields = custom_field_get_ids();
 756 	if( is_array( $t_custom_fields ) && ( count( $t_custom_fields ) > 0 ) ) {
 757 		foreach( $t_custom_fields as $t_cfid ) {
 758 			if( isset( $p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid]) ) {
 759 				if( !is_array( $p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid] ) ) {
 760 					$p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid] = array(
 761 						$p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid],
 762 					);
 763 				}
 764 
 765 				$t_checked_array = array();
 766 
 767 				# Special handling for date custom fields which have a special array format
 768 				$t_def = custom_field_get_definition( $t_cfid );
 769 				if( $t_def['type'] == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE ) {
 770 					# All array elements should be numeric
 771 					# - 0 is one of the CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_xxx constants
 772 					# - 1 & 2 are unix timestamps
 773 					$t_checked_array = array_map( 'intval', $p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid] );
 774 				} else {
 775 					foreach( $p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid] as $t_filter_value ) {
 776 						$t_filter_value = stripslashes( $t_filter_value );
 777 						if( ( $t_filter_value === 'any' ) || ( $t_filter_value === '[any]' ) ) {
 778 							$t_filter_value = META_FILTER_ANY;
 779 						}
 780 						$t_checked_array[] = $t_filter_value;
 781 					}
 782 				}
 783 				$p_filter_arr['custom_fields'][$t_cfid] = $t_checked_array;
 784 			}
 785 		}
 786 	}
 787 
 788 	# If view_type is advanced, and hide_status is present, modify status array
 789 	# to remove hidden status. This may happen after switching from simple to advanced.
 790 	# Then, remove hide_status property, as it does not apply to advanced filter
 791 	if( $p_filter_arr['_view_type'] == FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED
 792 			&& !filter_field_is_none( $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] ) ) {
 793 		if( filter_field_is_any( $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS] ) ) {
 794 			$t_selected_status_array = MantisEnum::getValues( config_get( 'status_enum_string' ) );
 795 		} else {
 796 			$t_selected_status_array = $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS];
 797 		}
 798 		$t_hide_status = $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS][0];
 799 		$t_new_status_array = array();
 800 		foreach( $t_selected_status_array as $t_status ) {
 801 			if( $t_status < $t_hide_status ) {
 802 				$t_new_status_array[] = $t_status;
 803 			}
 804 		}
 805 		# If there is no status left, reset the status property to "any"
 806 		if( empty( $t_new_status_array ) ) {
 807 			$t_new_status_array[] = META_FILTER_ANY;
 808 		}
 809 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS] = $t_new_status_array;
 810 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] = META_FILTER_NONE;
 811 	}
 812 
 813 	#If view_type is simple, resolve conflicts between show_status and hide_status
 814 	if( $p_filter_arr['_view_type'] == FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE
 815 			&& !filter_field_is_none( $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] ) ) {
 816 		# get array of hidden status ids
 817 		$t_all_status = MantisEnum::getValues( config_get( 'status_enum_string' ) );
 818 		$t_hidden_status = $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS][0];
 819 		$t_hidden_status_array = array();
 820 		foreach( $t_all_status as $t_status ) {
 821 			if( $t_status >= $t_hidden_status ) {
 822 				$t_hidden_status_array[] = $t_status;
 823 			}
 824 		}
 825 		# remove hidden status from show_status property array
 826 		# note that this will keep the "any" meta value, if present
 827 		$t_show_status_array = array_diff( $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS], $t_hidden_status_array );
 828 		# If there is no status left, reset the status property previous values, and remove hide_status
 829 		if( empty( $t_show_status_array ) ) {
 830 			$t_show_status_array = $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS];
 831 			$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] = META_FILTER_NONE;
 832 		}
 833 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS] = $t_show_status_array;
 834 	}
 835 
 836 	# validate relationship fields
 837 	if( !(
 838 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG] > 0
 839 		|| $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG] == META_FILTER_ANY
 840 		|| $p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG] == META_FILTER_NONE
 841 		) ) {
 842 		$p_filter_arr[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG] = filter_get_default_property( FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG, $t_view_type );
 843 	}
 844 
 845 	# all of our filter values are now guaranteed to be there, and correct.
 846 	return $p_filter_arr;
 847 }
 848 
 849 /**
 850  * Get a filter array with default values
 851  * Optional view type parameter is used to initialize some fields properly,
 852  * as some may differ in the default content.
 853  * @param string $p_view_type	FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE or FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED
 854  * @return array Filter array with default values
 855  */
 856 function filter_get_default_array( $p_view_type = null ) {
 857 	static $t_cache_default_array = array();
 858 
 859 	$t_default_view_type = filter_get_default_view_type();
 860 	if( !in_array( $p_view_type, array( FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE, FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED ) ) ) {
 861 		$p_view_type = $t_default_view_type;
 862 	}
 863 
 864 	# this function is called multiple times from filter api so return a cached value if possible
 865 	if( isset( $t_cache_default_array[$p_view_type] ) ) {
 866 		return $t_cache_default_array[$p_view_type];
 867 	}
 868 
 869 	$t_default_show_changed = config_get( 'default_show_changed' );
 870 	$t_meta_filter_any_array = array( META_FILTER_ANY );
 871 
 872 	$t_config_view_filters = config_get( 'view_filters' );
 873 	if( ADVANCED_ONLY == $t_config_view_filters ) {
 874 		$t_view_type = FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED;
 875 	} elseif( SIMPLE_ONLY == $t_config_view_filters ) {
 876 		$t_view_type = FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE;
 877 	} else {
 878 		$t_view_type = $p_view_type;
 879 	}
 880 
 881 	if( $t_view_type == FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE ) {
 882 		$t_hide_status_default = config_get( 'hide_status_default' );
 883 	} else {
 884 		$t_hide_status_default = META_FILTER_NONE;
 885 	}
 886 
 887 	$t_filter = array(
 888 		'_version' => FILTER_VERSION,
 889 		'_view_type' => $t_view_type,
 890 		FILTER_PROPERTY_CATEGORY_ID => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 891 		FILTER_PROPERTY_SEVERITY => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 892 		FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 893 		FILTER_PROPERTY_HIGHLIGHT_CHANGED => $t_default_show_changed,
 894 		FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 895 		FILTER_PROPERTY_HANDLER_ID => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 896 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID => array( META_FILTER_CURRENT ),
 897 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECTION => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 898 		FILTER_PROPERTY_RESOLUTION => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 899 		FILTER_PROPERTY_BUILD => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 900 		FILTER_PROPERTY_VERSION => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 901 		FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS => array( $t_hide_status_default ),
 902 		FILTER_PROPERTY_MONITOR_USER_ID => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 903 		FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME => 'last_updated',
 904 		FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION => 'DESC',
 905 		FILTER_PROPERTY_ISSUES_PER_PAGE => config_get( 'default_limit_view' ),
 906 		FILTER_PROPERTY_MATCH_TYPE => FILTER_MATCH_ALL,
 907 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PLATFORM => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 908 		FILTER_PROPERTY_OS => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 909 		FILTER_PROPERTY_OS_BUILD => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 910 		FILTER_PROPERTY_FIXED_IN_VERSION => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 911 		FILTER_PROPERTY_TARGET_VERSION => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 912 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PROFILE_ID => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 913 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PRIORITY => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 914 		FILTER_PROPERTY_NOTE_USER_ID => $t_meta_filter_any_array,
 915 		FILTER_PROPERTY_STICKY => gpc_string_to_bool( config_get( 'show_sticky_issues' ) ),
 916 		FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_DATE_SUBMITTED => false,
 917 		FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_MONTH => date( 'm' ),
 918 		FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_MONTH => date( 'm' ),
 919 		FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_DAY => 1,
 920 		FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_DAY => date( 'd' ),
 921 		FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_YEAR => date( 'Y' ),
 922 		FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_YEAR => date( 'Y' ),
 923 		FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_LAST_UPDATED_DATE => false,
 924 		FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_MONTH => date( 'm' ),
 925 		FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_MONTH => date( 'm' ),
 926 		FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_DAY => 1,
 927 		FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_DAY => date( 'd' ),
 928 		FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_YEAR => date( 'Y' ),
 929 		FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_YEAR => date( 'Y' ),
 930 		FILTER_PROPERTY_SEARCH => '',
 931 		FILTER_PROPERTY_VIEW_STATE => META_FILTER_ANY,
 932 		FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_STRING => '',
 933 		FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_SELECT => 0,
 934 		FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE => BUG_REL_ANY,
 935 		FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG => META_FILTER_ANY,
 936 	);
 937 
 938 	# initialize plugin filters
 939 	$t_plugin_filters = filter_get_plugin_filters();
 940 	foreach( $t_plugin_filters as $t_field_name => $t_filter_object ) {
 941 			switch( $t_filter_object->type ) {
 942 				case FILTER_TYPE_STRING:
 943 					$t_filter[$t_field_name] = $t_filter_object->default;
 944 					break;
 945 				case FILTER_TYPE_INT:
 946 					$t_filter[$t_field_name] = (int)$t_filter_object->default;
 947 					break;
 948 				case FILTER_TYPE_BOOLEAN:
 949 					$t_filter[$t_field_name] = (bool)$t_filter_object->default;
 950 					break;
 951 				case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_STRING:
 952 					$t_filter[$t_field_name] = array( (string)META_FILTER_ANY );
 953 					break;
 954 				case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_INT:
 955 					$t_filter[$t_field_name] = array( META_FILTER_ANY );
 956 					break;
 957 				default:
 958 					$t_filter[$t_field_name] = (string)META_FILTER_ANY;
 959 			}
 960 
 961 		if( !$t_filter_object->validate( $t_filter[$t_field_name] ) ) {
 962 			$t_filter[$t_field_name] = $t_filter_object->default;
 963 		}
 964 	}
 965 
 966 	$t_custom_fields = custom_field_get_ids();
 967 	# @@@ (thraxisp) This should really be the linked ids, but we don't know the project
 968 	$f_custom_fields_data = array();
 969 	if( is_array( $t_custom_fields ) && ( count( $t_custom_fields ) > 0 ) ) {
 970 		foreach( $t_custom_fields as $t_cfid ) {
 971 			$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid] = array( (string)META_FILTER_ANY );
 972 		}
 973 	}
 974 	$t_filter['custom_fields'] = $f_custom_fields_data;
 975 
 976 	$t_cache_default_array[$p_view_type] = $t_filter;
 977 	return $t_filter;
 978 }

1022 /**
1023  * Deserialize filter string.
1024  *
1025  * Expected strings have this format: "<version>#<json string>" where:
1026  * - <version> is the version number of the filter structure used. See constant FILTER_VERSION
1027  * - # is a separator
1028  * - <json string> is the JSON-encoded filter array.
1029  *
1030  * @param string $p_serialized_filter Serialized filter string.
1031  *
1032  * @return array|false $t_filter array
1033  * @see filter_ensure_valid_filter
1034  */
1035 function filter_deserialize( $p_serialized_filter ) {
1036 	if( is_blank( $p_serialized_filter ) ) {
1037 		return false;
1038 	}
1039 
1040 	# @TODO cproensa, we could accept a pure json array, without version prefix.
1041 	#       In this case, the filter version field inside the array is to be used
1042 	#       and if not present, set the current filter version
1043 
1044 	# check filter version mark
1045 	$t_setting_arr = explode( '#', $p_serialized_filter, 2 );
1046 	$t_version_string = $t_setting_arr[0];
1047 	if( in_array( $t_version_string, array( 'v1', 'v2', 'v3', 'v4' ) ) ) {
1048 		# these versions can't be salvaged, they are too old to update
1049 		return false;
1050 	} elseif( in_array( $t_version_string, array( 'v5', 'v6', 'v7', 'v8' ) ) ) {
1051 		# filters from v5 onwards should cope with changing filter indices dynamically
1052 		$t_filter_array = unserialize( $t_setting_arr[1] );
1053 	} else {
1054 		# filters from v9 onwards are stored as json
1055 		$t_filter_array = json_decode( $t_setting_arr[1], /* assoc array */ true );
1056 	}
1057 
1058 	# If the unserialez data is not an array, the some error happened, eg, invalid format
1059 	if( !is_array( $t_filter_array ) ) {
1060 		return false;
1061 	}
1062 
1063 	# Set the filter version that was loaded in the array
1064 	$t_filter_array['_version'] = $t_setting_arr[0];
1065 
1066 	# If upgrade in filter content is needed, it will be done in filter_ensure_valid_filter()
1067 	return filter_ensure_valid_filter( $t_filter_array );
1068 }
1069 
1070 /**
1071  * Creates a serialized filter with the correct format
1072  * @param array $p_filter_array Filter array to be serialized
1073  * @return string Serialized filter string
1074  */
1075 function filter_serialize( $p_filter_array ) {
1076 	$t_cookie_version = FILTER_VERSION;
1077 	$p_filter_array = filter_clean_runtime_properties( $p_filter_array );
1078 	$t_settings_serialized = json_encode( $p_filter_array );
1079 	$t_settings_string = $t_cookie_version . '#' . $t_settings_serialized;
1080 	return $t_settings_string;
1081 }

1083 /**
1084  * Get the filter db row $p_filter_id
1085  * using the cached row if it's available
1086  * @global array $g_cache_filter_db_rows
1087  * @param integer $p_filter_id      A filter identifier to look up in the database.
1088  * @return array|boolean	The row of filter data as stored in db table, or false if does not exist
1089  */
1090 function filter_get_row( $p_filter_id ) {
1091 	global $g_cache_filter_db_rows;
1092 
1093 	if( !isset( $g_cache_filter_db_rows[$p_filter_id] ) ) {
1094 		filter_cache_rows( array($p_filter_id) );
1095 	}
1096 
1097 	$t_row = $g_cache_filter_db_rows[$p_filter_id];
1098 	return $t_row;
1099 }

1119 /**
1120  * Get set of bug rows from given filter
1121  * @todo Had to make all these parameters required because we can't use call-time pass by reference anymore.
1122  * I really preferred not having to pass all the params in if you didn't want to, but I wanted to get
1123  * rid of the errors for now.  If we can think of a better way later (maybe return an object) that would be great.
1124  *
1125  * @param integer &$p_page_number  Page number of the page you want to see (set to the actual page on return).
1126  * @param integer &$p_per_page     The number of bugs to see per page (set to actual on return)
1127  *                                 -1   indicates you want to see all bugs
1128  *                                 null indicates you want to use the value specified in the filter.
1129  * @param integer &$p_page_count   You don't need to give a value here, the number of pages will be stored here on return.
1130  * @param integer &$p_bug_count    You don't need to give a value here, the number of bugs will be stored here on return.
1131  * @param mixed   $p_custom_filter Custom Filter to use.
1132  * @param integer $p_project_id    Project id to use in filtering.
1133  * @param integer $p_user_id       User id to use as current user when filtering.
1134  * @param boolean $p_show_sticky   True/false - get sticky issues only.
1135  * @return boolean|array
1136  */
1137 function filter_get_bug_rows( &$p_page_number, &$p_per_page, &$p_page_count, &$p_bug_count, $p_custom_filter = null, $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null, $p_show_sticky = null ) {
1138 	# assigning to $p_* for this function writes the values back in case the caller wants to know
1139 
1140 	if( $p_custom_filter === null ) {
1141 		$t_filter = filter_get_bug_rows_filter( $p_project_id, $p_user_id );
1142 	} else {
1143 		$t_filter = filter_ensure_valid_filter( $p_custom_filter );
1144 	}
1145 
1146 	# build a filter query, here for counting results
1147 	$t_filter_query = new BugFilterQuery(
1148 			$t_filter,
1149 			array(
1150 				'query_type' => BugFilterQuery::QUERY_TYPE_LIST,
1151 				'project_id' => $p_project_id,
1152 				'user_id' => $p_user_id,
1153 				'use_sticky' => $p_show_sticky
1154 				)
1155 			);
1156 	$p_bug_count = $t_filter_query->get_bug_count();
1157 	if( 0 == $p_bug_count ) {
1158 		return array();
1159 	}
1160 
1161 	# Calculate pagination
1162 	$p_per_page = filter_per_page( $t_filter, $p_bug_count, $p_per_page );
1163 	$p_page_count = filter_page_count( $p_bug_count, $p_per_page );
1164 	$p_page_number = filter_valid_page_number( $p_page_number, $p_page_count );
1165 	$t_offset = filter_offset( $p_page_number, $p_per_page );
1166 
1167 	$t_filter_query->set_limit( $p_per_page );
1168 	$t_filter_query->set_offset( $t_offset );
1169 	# Execute query
1170 	$t_rows = $t_filter_query->fetch_all();
1171 	$t_bug_id_array = array_column( $t_rows, 'id' );
1172 
1173 	# Return the processed rows: cache data, convert to bug objects
1174 	return filter_cache_result( $t_rows, $t_bug_id_array );
1175 }
1176 
1177 /**
1178  * Get the filter defined by user and project.
1179  * @param integer $p_project_id    Project id to use in filtering.
1180  * @param integer $p_user_id       User id to use as current user when filtering.
1181  * @return array
1182  */
1183 function filter_get_bug_rows_filter( $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null ) {
1184 	$t_current_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1185 
1186 	if( $p_user_id === null || $p_user_id === 0 ) {
1187 		$t_user_id = $t_current_user_id;
1188 	} else {
1189 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id;
1190 	}
1191 
1192 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
1193 		# @@@ If project_id is not specified, then use the project id(s) in the filter if set, otherwise, use current project.
1194 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
1195 	} else {
1196 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id;
1197 	}
1198 
1199 	if( $t_user_id == $t_current_user_id ) {
1200 		$t_filter = current_user_get_bug_filter();
1201 	} else {
1202 		$t_filter = user_get_bug_filter( $t_user_id, $t_project_id );
1203 	}
1204 
1205 	# if filter isn't return above, create a new filter from an empty array.
1206 	if( false === $t_filter ) {
1207 		$t_filter = array();
1208 	}
1209 	return $t_filter;
1210 }

1212 /**
1213  * Cache the filter results with bugnote stats for later use
1214  * @param array $p_rows             Results of the filter query.
1215  * @param array $p_id_array_lastmod Array of bug ids.
1216  * @return array
1217  */
1218 function filter_cache_result( array $p_rows, array $p_id_array_lastmod ) {
1219 	$t_stats = bug_get_bugnote_stats_array( $p_id_array_lastmod );
1220 	$t_rows = array();
1221 	foreach( $p_rows as $t_row ) {
1222 		if( array_key_exists( $t_row['id'], $t_stats ) ) {
1223 			$t_rows[] = bug_row_to_object( bug_cache_database_result( $t_row, $t_stats[$t_row['id']] ) );
1224 		} else {
1225 			$t_rows[] = bug_row_to_object( bug_cache_database_result( $t_row ) );
1226 		}
1227 	}
1228 	return $t_rows;
1229 }

1492 function filter_cache_rows( array $p_filter_ids ) {
1493 	global $g_cache_filter_db_rows;
1494 
1495 	if( empty( $p_filter_ids ) ) {
1496 		return;
1497 	}
1498 	$t_ids_not_found = array();
1499 	$t_params = array();
1500 	$t_sql_params = array();
1501 	db_param_push();
1502 	foreach( $p_filter_ids as $t_id ) {
1503 		$t_sql_params[] = db_param();
1504 		$t_params[] = (int)$t_id;
1505 		$t_ids_not_found[$t_id] = $t_id;
1506 	}
1507 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {filters} WHERE id IN ('
1508 			. implode( ',', $t_sql_params ) . ')';
1509 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
1510 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1511 		$g_cache_filter_db_rows[$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
1512 		unset( $t_ids_not_found[$t_row['id']] );
1513 	}
1514 	foreach( $t_ids_not_found as $t_id ) {
1515 		$g_cache_filter_db_rows[$t_id] = false;
1516 	}
1517 }
1518 
1519 /**
1520  * Clear the filter cache (or just the given id if specified)
1521  * @param integer $p_filter_id Filter id.
1522  * @return boolean
1523  */
1524 function filter_clear_cache( $p_filter_id = null ) {
1525 	global $g_cache_filter_db_rows;
1526 
1527 	if( null === $p_filter_id ) {
1528 		$g_cache_filter_db_rows = array();
1529 	} else {
1530 		unset( $g_cache_filter_db_rows[(int)$p_filter_id] );
1531 	}
1532 
1533 	return true;
1534 }
