1536 /**
1537  * Update a filter identified by its id
1538  * Some parameters are optional and only will be updated if provided
1539  * Note that values are not validated
1540  * @param int $p_filter_id Filter id
1541  * @param string $p_filter_string Filter string in custom serialized format
1542  * @param int $p_project_id
1543  * @param bool $p_is_public
1544  * @param string $p_name
1545  */
1546 function filter_db_update_filter( $p_filter_id, $p_filter_string, $p_project_id = null, $p_is_public = null, $p_name = null ) {
1547 	db_param_push();
1548 	$t_params = array();
1549 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {filters} SET filter_string=' . db_param();
1550 	$t_params[] = $p_filter_string;
1551 	if( null !== $p_project_id ) {
1552 		$t_query .= ', project_id=' . db_param();
1553 		$t_params[] = (int)$p_project_id;
1554 	}
1555 	if( null !== $p_is_public ) {
1556 		$t_query .= ', is_public=' . db_param();
1557 		$t_params[] = (bool)$p_is_public;
1558 	}
1559 	if( null !== $p_name ) {
1560 		$t_query .= ', name=' . db_param();
1561 		$t_params[] = $p_name;
1562 	}
1563 	$t_query .= ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
1564 	$t_params[] = (int)$p_filter_id;
1565 	db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
1566 }
1567 
1568 /**
1569  * Add a filter to the database.
1570  * This function does not perform any validation on access or inserted data
1571  *
1572  * @param string $p_filter_string  Filter string in filter-serialized format
1573  * @param integer $p_user_id      User id owner of the filter
1574  * @param integer $p_project_id   Project id associated to the filter
1575  * @param string $p_name          Name of the filter
1576  * @param boolean $p_is_public    Boolean flag to set the filter public
1577  * @return integer	The id of the created row
1578  */
1579 function filter_db_create_filter( $p_filter_string, $p_user_id, $p_project_id, $p_name, $p_is_public ) {
1580 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
1581 	$c_user_id = $p_user_id;
1582 	$c_is_public = (bool)$p_is_public;
1583 
1584 	db_param_push();
1585 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {filters} ( user_id, project_id, is_public, name, filter_string )'
1586 			. ' VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
1587 	$t_params = array( $c_user_id, $c_project_id, $c_is_public, $p_name, $p_filter_string );
1588 	db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
1589 
1590 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'filters' ) );
1591 }
1592 
1593 /**
1594  * Updates the default filter for a project and user.
1595  * We only can have one filter of this kind, per project and user.
1596  * These special filters are saved in database with a negative project id
1597  * to differentiate from standard named filters.
1598  *
1599  * Note: currently this filter is how the current filter in use is persisted
1600  * This means: the last used filter settings, for each project, are saved here.
1601  * @TODO cproensa, theres some suggestions to clean this up:
1602  * - working filters should not be tracked in database, at least not as unique per user
1603  * - include a UI functionality to allow setting/clearing these default filters
1604  * - ideally, the storage should be cleaner: either separated from standard filters
1605  *     or use a proper field in the table, instead of relying on the negative project id
1606  *
1607  * @param array $p_filter        Filter array
1608  * @param integer $p_project_id  Project id
1609  * @param integer $p_user_id     User id
1610  * @return integer	The filter id that was updated or created
1611  */
1612 function filter_set_project_filter( array $p_filter, $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null ) {
1613 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
1614 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
1615 	} else {
1616 		$t_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
1617 	}
1618 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
1619 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1620 	} else {
1621 		$t_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
1622 	}
1623 
1624 	$p_filter_string = filter_serialize( $p_filter );
1625 	# Check if a row already exists
1626 	$t_id = filter_db_get_project_current( $t_project_id, $p_user_id );
1627 	if( $t_id ) {
1628 		# A row already esxists
1629 		filter_db_update_filter( $t_id, $p_filter_string );
1630 	} else {
1631 		# Must create a row
1632 		$t_db_project_id = -1 * $t_project_id;
1633 		$t_id = filter_db_create_filter( $p_filter_string, $t_user_id, $t_db_project_id, '', false );
1634 	}
1635 	return $t_id;
1636 }
1637 
1638 /**
1639  * This function returns the filter string that is tied to the unique id parameter. If the user
1640  * does not have permission to see this filter, the function returns null
1641  * @param integer $p_filter_id A Filter identifier.
1642  * @param integer $p_user_id   A valid user identifier.
1643  * @return mixed
1644  */
1645 function filter_db_get_filter_string( $p_filter_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
1646 	$c_filter_id = (int)$p_filter_id;
1647 
1648 	if( !filter_is_accessible( $c_filter_id, $p_user_id ) ) {
1649 		return null;
1650 	}
1651 
1652 	$t_filter_row = filter_get_row( $c_filter_id );
1653 	return $t_filter_row['filter_string'];
1654 }
1655 
1656 /**
1657  * get current filter for given project and user
1658  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
1659  * @param integer $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
1660  * @return integer|null
1661  */
1662 function filter_db_get_project_current( $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null ) {
1663 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
1664 		$c_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
1665 	} else {
1666 		$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
1667 	}
1668 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
1669 		$c_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1670 	} else {
1671 		$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
1672 	}
1673 
1674 	# we store current filters for each project with a special project index
1675 	$t_filter_project_id = $c_project_id * -1;
1676 
1677 	db_param_push();
1678 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {filters} WHERE user_id = ' . db_param()
1679 			. ' AND project_id = ' . db_param() . ' AND name = ' . db_param();
1680 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_user_id, $t_filter_project_id, '' ) );
1681 
1682 	if( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1683 		return $t_row['id'];
1684 	}
1685 
1686 	return null;
1687 }
1688 
1689 /**
1690  * Query for the filter name using the filter id
1691  * @param integer $p_filter_id Filter id.
1692  * @return string
1693  */
1694 function filter_db_get_name( $p_filter_id ) {
1695 	$c_filter_id = (int)$p_filter_id;
1696 
1697 	$t_filter_row = filter_get_row( $c_filter_id );
1698 	if( !$t_filter_row ) {
1699 		return null;
1700 	}
1701 
1702 	if( $t_filter_row['user_id'] != auth_get_current_user_id() ) {
1703 		if( $t_filter_row['is_public'] != true ) {
1704 			return null;
1705 		}
1706 	}
1707 
1708 	return $t_filter_row['name'];
1709 }

1711 /**
1712  * Check if the current user has permissions to delete the stored query
1713  * @param integer $p_filter_id Filter id.
1714  * @param integer|null User id or null for logged in user.
1715  * @return boolean
1716  */
1717 function filter_db_can_delete_filter( $p_filter_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
1718 	$c_filter_id = (int)$p_filter_id;
1719 	$t_user_id = $p_user_id != null ? $p_user_id : auth_get_current_user_id();
1720 
1721 	# Administrators can delete any filter
1722 	if( user_is_administrator( $t_user_id ) ) {
1723 		return true;
1724 	}
1725 
1726 	$t_filter_row = filter_get_row( $c_filter_id );
1727 	if( $t_filter_row
1728 		&& $t_filter_row['user_id'] == $t_user_id
1729 		&& $t_filter_row['project_id'] >= 0	) {
1730 		return true;
1731 	} else {
1732 		return false;
1733 	}
1734 }
1735 
1736 /**
1737  * Delete the filter specified by $p_filter_id
1738  * @param integer $p_filter_id Filter identifier.
1739  * @return boolean
1740  */
1741 function filter_db_delete_filter( $p_filter_id ) {
1742 	$c_filter_id = (int)$p_filter_id;
1743 
1744 	if( !filter_db_can_delete_filter( $c_filter_id ) ) {
1745 		return false;
1746 	}
1747 
1748 	db_param_push();
1749 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {filters} WHERE id=' . db_param();
1750 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_filter_id ) );
1751 
1752 	return true;
1753 }

1759 function filter_db_delete_current_filters() {

1767 /**
1768  * Returns stored filters based on a combination of linked project, owner user and public status.
1769  * Any parameter can be defaulted to null, to get all results for that field
1770  * @param integer $p_project_id		Project id linked to the filter
1771  * @param integer $p_user_id		User id, meaning filter owner
1772  * @param boolean $p_public			Public flag for filter
1773  * @return array	Array of filter ids and names
1774  */
1775 function filter_db_get_named_filters( $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null, $p_public = null ) {
1776 	db_param_push();
1777 	$t_params = array();
1778 	$t_query = 'SELECT id, name FROM {filters} WHERE project_id >= ' . db_param();
1779 	$t_params[] = 0;
1780 
1781 	# build where clauses
1782 	if( null !== $p_project_id ) {
1783 		$t_query .= ' AND project_id = ' . db_param();
1784 		$t_params[] = (int)$p_project_id;
1785 	}
1786 	if( null !== $p_user_id ) {
1787 		$t_query .= ' AND user_id = ' . db_param();
1788 		$t_params[] = (int)$p_user_id;
1789 	}
1790 	if( null !== $p_public ) {
1791 		$t_query .= ' AND is_public = ' . db_param();
1792 		# cast $p_public to strict true/false values
1793 		$t_params[] = $p_public ? true : false;
1794 	}
1795 
1796 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
1797 
1798 	$t_query_arr = array();
1799 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1800 		$t_query_arr[$t_row['id']] = $t_row['name'];
1801 	}
1802 	return $t_query_arr;
1803 }
1804 
1805 /**
1806  * Get the list of available filters.
1807  *
1808  * @param integer|null $p_project_id A valid project identifier or null for current project.
1809  * @param integer|null $p_user_id    A valid user identifier or null for logged in user.
1810  * @param boolean $p_filter_by_project Only return filters associated with specified project id or All Projects, otherwise return all filters for user.
1811  * @param boolean $p_return_names_only true: return names of filters, false: return structures with filter header information.
1812  * @return array Array of filters.
1813  */
1814 function filter_db_get_available_queries( $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null, $p_filter_by_project = true, $p_return_names_only = true ) {
1815 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
1816 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
1817 	} else {
1818 		$t_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
1819 	}
1820 
1821 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
1822 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1823 	} else {
1824 		$t_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
1825 	}
1826 
1827 	# If the user doesn't have access rights to stored queries, just return
1828 	if( !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'stored_query_use_threshold' ) ) ) {
1829 		return array();
1830 	}
1831 
1832 	# Get the list of available queries. By sorting such that public queries are
1833 	# first, we can override any query that has the same name as a private query
1834 	# with that private one
1835 	db_param_push();
1836 
1837 	if( $p_filter_by_project ) {
1838 		$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {filters}
1839 			WHERE (project_id = ' . db_param() . '
1840 				OR project_id = 0)
1841 			AND name != \'\'
1842 			AND (is_public = ' . db_param() . '
1843 				OR user_id = ' . db_param() . ')
1844 			ORDER BY is_public DESC, name ASC';
1845 
1846 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $t_project_id, true, $t_user_id ) );
1847 	} else {
1848 		$t_project_ids = user_get_all_accessible_projects( $t_user_id );
1849 		$t_project_ids[] = ALL_PROJECTS;
1850 
1851 		$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {filters}
1852 			WHERE project_id in (' . implode( ',', $t_project_ids ) . ')
1853 			AND name != \'\'
1854 			AND (is_public = ' . db_param() . '
1855 				OR user_id = ' . db_param() . ')
1856 			ORDER BY is_public DESC, name ASC';
1857 
1858 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( true, $t_user_id ) );
1859 	}
1860 	
1861 	$t_filters = array();
1862 
1863 	# first build the id=>name array
1864 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1865 		$t_filters[$t_row['id']] = $t_row['name'];
1866 	}
1867 	filter_cache_rows( array_keys( $t_filters ) );
1868 
1869 	if( $p_return_names_only ) {
1870 		asort( $t_filters );
1871 		return $t_filters;
1872 	}
1873 
1874 	# build an extended array of name=>{filter data}
1875 	$t_filter_data = array();
1876 	foreach( $t_filters as $t_filter_id => $t_filter_name ) {
1877 		$t_row = array();
1878 		$t_filter_obj = filter_get( $t_filter_id );
1879 		if( !$t_filter_obj ) {
1880 			continue;
1881 		}
1882 
1883 		$t_row = filter_get_row( $t_filter_id );
1884 		$t_row['criteria'] = $t_filter_obj;
1885 		$t_row['url'] = filter_get_url( $t_filter_obj );
1886 		$t_filter_data[$t_filter_name] = $t_row;
1887 	}
1888 	return $t_filter_data;
1889 }

1891 /**
1892  * Check that the given filter name does not exceed the maximum filter length
1893  * @param string $p_name Filter name.
1894  * @return boolean true when under max_length (64) and false when over
1895  */
1896 function filter_name_valid_length( $p_name ) {
1897 	if( mb_strlen( $p_name ) > 64 ) {
1898 		return false;
1899 	} else {
1900 		return true;
1901 	}
1902 }

1904 /**
1905  * Create a filter for getting issues modified in the last N days.
1906  * @param integer $p_days Number of days counting from today
1907  * @param array $p_filter Add the filter conditions over this filter array. Return a new one if null
1908  * @return array Filter array
1909  */
1910 function filter_create_recently_modified( $p_days, $p_filter = null ) {
1911 	if( null === $p_filter ) {
1912 		$p_filter = filter_get_default();
1913 		# This filter overrides default "hide status" property
1914 		$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] = META_FILTER_NONE;
1915 	}
1916 	$c_days = (int)$p_days;
1917 	$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_LAST_UPDATED_DATE] = true;
1918 	$t_date = new DateTime('today');
1919 	$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_DAY] = $t_date->format( 'j' );
1920 	$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_MONTH] = $t_date->format( 'n' );
1921 	$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_YEAR] = $t_date->format( 'Y' );
1922 	$t_date->modify( '-' . $c_days . ' days' );
1923 	$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_DAY] = $t_date->format( 'j' );
1924 	$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_MONTH] = $t_date->format( 'n' );
1925 	$p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_YEAR] = $t_date->format( 'Y' );
1926 	return filter_ensure_valid_filter( $p_filter );
1927 }

1941 /**
1942  * Create a filter for getting issues assigned to the specified project and user that
1943  * are not yet resolved.
1944  *
1945  * @param integer $p_project_id The project id or ALL_PROJECTS.
1946  * @param integer $p_user_id    The user id or 0 to get unassigned issues.
1947  * @return mixed valid filter.
1948  */
1949 function filter_create_assigned_to_unresolved( $p_project_id, $p_user_id ) {
1950 	$t_filter = filter_get_default();
1951 
1952 	if( $p_user_id == 0 ) {
1953 		$t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HANDLER_ID] = array( '0' => META_FILTER_NONE );
1954 	} else {
1955 		$t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HANDLER_ID] = array( '0' => $p_user_id );
1956 	}
1957 
1958 	$t_bug_resolved_status_threshold = config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold', null, $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
1959 	$t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] = array( '0' => $t_bug_resolved_status_threshold );

1961 	if( $p_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS ) {
1962 		$t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID] = array( '0' => $p_project_id );
1963 	}
1964 
1965 	return filter_ensure_valid_filter( $t_filter );

2007 /**
2008  * Read filter parameters from get/post.
2009  *
2010  * If a filter array is passed as parameter, the read parameters will be appended,
2011  * or override existing ones.
2012  *
2013  * @param array|null $p_filter An existing filter array. If null, a default
2014  *                             filter will be used.
2015  *
2016  * @return array The resulting filter array.
2017  */
2018 function filter_gpc_get( ?array $p_filter = null ): array {
2019 	# Get or copy the view_type first as it's needed to get proper defaults
2020 	$f_view_type = gpc_get_string( 'view_type', null );
2021 	if( null === $f_view_type && is_array( $p_filter ) && isset( $p_filter['_view_type'] ) ) {
2022 		$f_view_type = $p_filter['_view_type'];
2023 	}
2024 
2025 	if( null === $p_filter ) {
2026 		$t_filter = filter_get_default_array( $f_view_type );
2027 	} else {
2028 		$t_filter = filter_ensure_fields( $p_filter );
2029 	}
2030 
2031 	# these are all possibly multiple selections for advanced filtering
2032 	# If a single value is provided, it will be normalized to an array with 'filter_ensure_valid_filter()'
2033 
2034 	$f_show_category = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_CATEGORY_ID, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_CATEGORY_ID] );
2035 	$f_platform = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_PLATFORM, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_PLATFORM] );
2036 	$f_os = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_OS, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_OS] );
2037 	$f_os_build = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_OS_BUILD, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_OS_BUILD] );
2038 	$f_show_severity = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_SEVERITY, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SEVERITY] );
2039 	$f_show_status = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS] );
2040 	$f_hide_status = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] );
2041 	$f_reporter_id = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID] );
2042 	$f_handler_id = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_HANDLER_ID, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HANDLER_ID] );
2043 	$f_project_id = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID] );
2044 	$f_projection = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECTION, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECTION] );
2045 	$f_show_resolution = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_RESOLUTION, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_RESOLUTION] );
2046 	$f_show_build = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_BUILD, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_BUILD] );
2047 	$f_show_version = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_VERSION, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_VERSION] );
2048 	$f_fixed_in_version = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_FIXED_IN_VERSION, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_FIXED_IN_VERSION] );
2049 	$f_target_version = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_TARGET_VERSION, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_TARGET_VERSION] );
2050 	$f_show_profile = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_PROFILE_ID, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_PROFILE_ID] );
2051 	$f_show_priority = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_PRIORITY, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_PRIORITY] );
2052 	$f_user_monitor = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_MONITOR_USER_ID, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_MONITOR_USER_ID] );
2053 	$f_note_user_id = gpc_get( FILTER_PROPERTY_NOTE_USER_ID, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_NOTE_USER_ID] );
2054 
2055 	$f_match_type = gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_MATCH_TYPE, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_MATCH_TYPE] );
2056 
2057 	# these are only single values, even when doing advanced filtering
2058 	$f_per_page = gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_ISSUES_PER_PAGE, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_ISSUES_PER_PAGE] );
2059 	$f_highlight_changed = gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_HIGHLIGHT_CHANGED, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIGHLIGHT_CHANGED] );
2060 	$f_sticky_issues = gpc_get_bool( FILTER_PROPERTY_STICKY, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_STICKY] );
2061 
2062 	# This sort parameter is a set of comma separated values, and can be an array of parameters.
2063 	# sort="c1,c2" as used by permalinks
2064 	# sort[]="c1" sort[]="c2" as used by filter form
2065 	gpc_make_array( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME );
2066 	$f_sort_array = gpc_get_string_array( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME, array() );
2067 
2068 	# This sort parameter is an incremental column addition to current sort set.
2069 	# Only one column/dir, which is added to the front.
2070 	$f_sort_add = gpc_get_string( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME . '_add', null );
2071 
2072 	if( !empty( $f_sort_array ) ) {
2073 		gpc_make_array( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION );
2074 		$f_dir_array = gpc_get_string_array( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION, array() );
2075 		$t_new_sort_array = array();
2076 		$t_new_dir_array = array();
2077 		# evaluate each parameter, checks that "dir" may be omitted in order to avoid shifting subsequent parameters
2078 		$t_count = count( $f_sort_array );
2079 		for( $ix = 0; $ix < $t_count; $ix++ ) {
2080 			$t_param_columns = explode( ',', $f_sort_array[$ix] );
2081 			if( isset( $f_dir_array[$ix] ) ) {
2082 				$t_param_dirs = explode( ',', $f_dir_array[$ix] );
2083 			} else {
2084 				$t_param_dirs = array();
2085 			}
2086 			# fill the gaps with dummy string, they will be defaulted by ensure_valid_filter
2087 			if( count( $t_param_dirs ) < count( $t_param_columns ) ) {
2088 				$t_param_dirs = array_pad( $t_param_dirs, count( $t_param_columns ), '' );
2089 			}
2090 			$t_new_sort_array = array_merge( $t_new_sort_array, $t_param_columns );
2091 			$t_new_dir_array = array_merge( $t_new_dir_array, $t_param_dirs );
2092 		}
2093 		$f_sort = implode( ',', $t_new_sort_array );
2094 		$f_dir = implode( ',', $t_new_dir_array );
2095 	} elseif( null !== $f_sort_add ) {
2096 		# this parameter has to be pushed in front of current sort set
2097 		$f_dir_add = gpc_get_string( FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION . '_add', '' );
2098 		# Plain concatenation. Empty fields, or extra commas will be cleaned by ensure_valid_filter
2099 		$f_sort = $f_sort_add . ',' . $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME];
2100 		$f_dir = $f_dir_add . ',' . $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION];
2101 	} else {
2102 		# use the defaults
2103 		$f_sort = $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME];
2104 		$f_dir = $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION];
2105 	}
2106 
2107 	# date values
2108 	# creation date
2109 	$f_do_filter_by_date	= gpc_get_bool( FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_DATE_SUBMITTED, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_DATE_SUBMITTED] );
2110 	$f_start_month			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_MONTH, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_MONTH] );
2111 	$f_end_month			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_MONTH, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_MONTH] );
2112 	$f_start_day			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_DAY, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_DAY] );
2113 	$f_end_day				= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_DAY, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_DAY] );
2114 	$f_start_year			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_YEAR, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_YEAR] );
2115 	$f_end_year				= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_YEAR, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_YEAR] );
2116 	# last_updated date values
2117 	$f_do_filter_by_last_updated_date	= gpc_get_bool( FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_LAST_UPDATED_DATE, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_LAST_UPDATED_DATE] );
2118 	$f_last_updated_start_month			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_MONTH, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_MONTH] );
2119 	$f_last_updated_end_month			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_MONTH, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_MONTH] );
2120 	$f_last_updated_start_day			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_DAY, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_DAY] );
2121 	$f_last_updated_end_day				= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_DAY, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_DAY] );
2122 	$f_last_updated_start_year			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_YEAR, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_YEAR] );
2123 	$f_last_updated_end_year			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_YEAR, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_YEAR] );
2124 
2125 	$f_search				= gpc_get_string( FILTER_PROPERTY_SEARCH, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SEARCH] );
2126 	$f_view_state			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_VIEW_STATE, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_VIEW_STATE] );
2127 
2128 	$f_tag_string			= gpc_get_string( FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_STRING, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_STRING] );
2129 	$f_tag_select			= gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_SELECT, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_SELECT] );
2130 
2131 	# plugin filter updates
2132 	$t_plugin_filters = filter_get_plugin_filters();
2133 	$t_filter_input = array();
2134 
2135 	foreach( $t_plugin_filters as $t_field_name => $t_filter_object ) {
2136 		switch( $t_filter_object->type ) {
2137 			case FILTER_TYPE_STRING:
2138 				$t_filter_input[$t_field_name] = gpc_get_string( $t_field_name, $t_filter[$t_field_name] );
2139 				break;
2140 
2141 			case FILTER_TYPE_INT:
2142 				$t_filter_input[$t_field_name] = gpc_get_int( $t_field_name, $t_filter[$t_field_name] );
2143 				break;
2144 
2145 			case FILTER_TYPE_BOOLEAN:
2146 				$t_filter_input[$t_field_name] = gpc_get_bool( $t_field_name, $t_filter[$t_field_name]);
2147 				break;
2148 
2149 			case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_STRING:
2150 				$t_filter_input[$t_field_name] = gpc_get_string_array( $t_field_name, $t_filter[$t_field_name] );
2151 				break;
2152 
2153 			case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_INT:
2154 				$t_filter_input[$t_field_name] = gpc_get_int_array( $t_field_name, $t_filter[$t_field_name] );
2155 				break;
2156 		}
2157 	}
2158 
2159 	# custom field updates
2160 	$t_custom_fields 		= custom_field_get_ids(); # @todo (thraxisp) This should really be the linked ids, but we don't know the project
2161 	$f_custom_fields_data 	= $t_filter['custom_fields'];
2162 	if( is_array( $t_custom_fields ) && ( count( $t_custom_fields ) > 0 ) ) {
2163 		foreach( $t_custom_fields as $t_cfid ) {
2164 			if( custom_field_type( $t_cfid ) == CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE ) {
2165 
2166 				# check if gpc parameters are present, otherwise skip parsing.
2167 				if( !gpc_isset( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_control' ) ) {
2168 					continue;
2169 				}
2170 
2171 				$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid] = array();
2172 
2173 				# Get date control property
2174 				$t_control = gpc_get_int( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_control', null );
2175 				$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid][0] = $t_control;
2176 
2177 				$t_one_day = 86399;
2178 				# Get start date. If there is a timestamp input provided, use it,
2179 				# otherwise, look for individual date parts
2180 				$f_start_date = gpc_get( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_start_timestamp', null );
2181 				if( null !== $f_start_date ) {
2182 					$t_start_date = (int)$f_start_date;
2183 					$t_start = $t_start_date;
2184 				} else {
2185 					$t_year = gpc_get_int( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_start_year', null );
2186 					$t_month = gpc_get_int( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_start_month', null );
2187 					$t_day = gpc_get_int( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_start_day', null );
2188 					$t_start_date = mktime( 0, 0, 0, $t_month, $t_day, $t_year );
2189 					# calculate correct timestamps
2190 					$t_start = 1;
2191 					switch( $t_control ) {
2192 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ANY:
2193 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_NONE:
2194 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORBEFORE:
2195 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BEFORE:
2196 							break ;
2197 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BETWEEN:
2198 							$t_start = $t_start_date;
2199 							break ;
2200 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ON:
2201 							$t_start = $t_start_date;
2202 							break;
2203 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_AFTER:
2204 							$t_start = $t_start_date + $t_one_day - 1;
2205 							break;
2206 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORAFTER:
2207 							$t_start = $t_start_date;
2208 							break;
2209 					}
2210 				}
2211 				$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid][1] = $t_start;
2212 
2213 				# Get end date. If there is a timestamp input provided, use it,
2214 				# otherwise, look for individual date parts
2215 				$f_end_date = gpc_get( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_end_timestamp', null );
2216 				if( null !== $f_end_date ) {
2217 					$t_end_date = (int)$f_end_date;
2218 					$t_end = $t_end_date;
2219 				} else {
2220 					$t_year = gpc_get_int( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_end_year', null );
2221 					$t_month = gpc_get_int( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_end_month', null );
2222 					$t_day = gpc_get_int( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid . '_end_day', null );
2223 					$t_end_date = mktime( 0, 0, 0, $t_month, $t_day, $t_year );
2224 					# calculate correct timestamps
2225 					$t_end = 1;
2226 					switch( $t_control ) {
2227 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ANY:
2228 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_NONE:
2229 							break ;
2230 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BETWEEN:
2231 							$t_end = $t_end_date + $t_one_day - 1;
2232 							break ;
2233 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORBEFORE:
2234 							$t_end = $t_start_date + $t_one_day - 1;
2235 							break;
2236 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BEFORE:
2237 							$t_end = $t_start_date;
2238 							break ;
2239 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ON:
2240 							$t_end = $t_start_date + $t_one_day - 1;
2241 							break;
2242 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_AFTER:
2243 							$t_end = 2147483647; # Some time in 2038, max value of a signed int.
2244 							break;
2245 						case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORAFTER:
2246 							$t_end = 2147483647; # Some time in 2038, max value of a signed int.
2247 							break;
2248 					}
2249 				}
2250 				$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid][2] = $t_end;
2251 
2252 			} else {
2253 
2254 				# check if gpc parameters are present, otherwise skip parsing.
2255 				if( !gpc_isset( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid ) ) {
2256 					continue;
2257 				}
2258 
2259 				if( is_array( gpc_get( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid, null ) ) ) {
2260 					$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid] = gpc_get_string_array( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid, array( META_FILTER_ANY ) );
2261 				} else {
2262 					$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid] = gpc_get_string( 'custom_field_' . $t_cfid, META_FILTER_ANY );
2263 					$f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid] = array( $f_custom_fields_data[$t_cfid] );
2264 				}
2265 			}
2266 		}
2267 	}
2268 
2269 	$f_relationship_type = gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE] );
2270 	$f_relationship_bug = gpc_get_int( FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG] );
2271 
2272 	log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'filter_gpc_get: Update filters' );
2273 	$t_filter_input['_version'] 								= FILTER_VERSION;
2274 	$t_filter_input['_view_type'] 							= $f_view_type;
2275 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_CATEGORY_ID] 			= $f_show_category;
2276 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_SEVERITY] 				= $f_show_severity;
2277 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_STATUS] 					= $f_show_status;
2278 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_ISSUES_PER_PAGE] 		= $f_per_page;
2279 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIGHLIGHT_CHANGED] 		= $f_highlight_changed;
2280 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID] 			= $f_reporter_id;
2281 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_HANDLER_ID] 				= $f_handler_id;
2282 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID] 				= $f_project_id;
2283 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECTION] 				= $f_projection;
2284 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME] 		= $f_sort;
2285 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION] 			= $f_dir;
2286 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_DATE_SUBMITTED] 			= $f_do_filter_by_date;
2287 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_MONTH] 			= $f_start_month;
2288 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_DAY] 				= $f_start_day;
2289 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_YEAR] 				= $f_start_year;
2290 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_MONTH] 				= $f_end_month;
2291 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_DAY] 				= $f_end_day;
2292 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_YEAR] 				= $f_end_year;
2293 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_LAST_UPDATED_DATE] = $f_do_filter_by_last_updated_date;
2294 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_MONTH] 	= $f_last_updated_start_month;
2295 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_DAY] 	= $f_last_updated_start_day;
2296 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_START_YEAR] 	= $f_last_updated_start_year;
2297 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_MONTH] 	= $f_last_updated_end_month;
2298 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_DAY] 		= $f_last_updated_end_day;
2299 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_LAST_UPDATED_END_YEAR] 		= $f_last_updated_end_year;
2300 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_SEARCH] 					= $f_search;
2301 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS] 			= $f_hide_status;
2302 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_RESOLUTION] 				= $f_show_resolution;

2304 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_VERSION] 				= $f_show_version;

2309 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_VIEW_STATE] 				= $f_view_state;
2310 	$t_filter_input['custom_fields'] 						= $f_custom_fields_data;
2311 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_STICKY] 					= $f_sticky_issues;
2312 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE] 		= $f_relationship_type;

2321 	$t_filter_input[FILTER_PROPERTY_MATCH_TYPE] 				= $f_match_type;
2322 
2323 	# copy runtime properties, if present
2324 	if( isset( $t_filter['_temporary_key'] ) ) {
2325 		$t_filter_input['_temporary_key'] = $t_filter['_temporary_key'];
2326 	}
2327 	if( isset( $t_filter['_filter_id'] ) ) {
2328 		$t_filter_input['_filter_id'] = $t_filter['_filter_id'];
2329 	}
2330 	# Don't copy cached subquery '_subquery' property
2331 
2332 	return filter_ensure_valid_filter( $t_filter_input );

2335 /**
2336  * Returns the sort columns from a filter, with only those columns that are visible
2337  * according to $p_columns_target user's configuration, and valid for sorting.
2338  * Returns an array consisting of two respective properties of column names, and
2339  * sort direction, each one already exploded into an array.
2340  * Note: Filter array must be a valid filter
2341  * @param array $p_filter Original filter array.
2342  * @param integer $p_columns_target Target view for the columns.
2343  * @return array Array of filtered columns and order
2344  */
2345 function filter_get_visible_sort_properties_array( array $p_filter, $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE ) {
2346 	# get visible columns
2347 	$t_visible_columns = helper_get_columns_to_view( $p_columns_target );
2348 	# filter out those that are not sortable
2349 	$t_visible_columns = array_filter( $t_visible_columns, 'column_is_sortable' );
2350 
2351 	# Special handling for overdue column, which is equivalent to sorting by due_date
2352 	if( in_array( 'overdue', $t_visible_columns ) & !in_array( 'due_date', $t_visible_columns ) ) {
2353 		$t_visible_columns[] = 'due_date';
2354 	}
2355 
2356 	$t_sort_fields = explode( ',', $p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME] );
2357 	$t_dir_fields = explode( ',', $p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION] );
2358 	$t_sort_array = array();
2359 	$t_dir_array = array();
2360 	$t_count = count( $t_sort_fields );
2361 	for( $i = 0; $i < $t_count; $i++ ) {
2362 		$c_sort = $t_sort_fields[$i];
2363 		if( in_array( $c_sort, $t_visible_columns ) ) {
2364 			$t_sort_array[] = $t_sort_fields[$i];
2365 			$t_dir_array[] = $t_dir_fields[$i];
2366 		}
2367 	}
2368 	return array(
2369 		FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME => $t_sort_array,
2370 		FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION => $t_dir_array
2371 	);
2372 }

2374 /**
2375  * Returns true if the filter id is a named stored filter, which can be managed and edited.
2376  * Returns false if it's a temporary filter, or if the filter id does not exists
2377  * @param integer $p_filter_id
2378  * @return boolean
2379  */
2380 function filter_is_named_filter( $p_filter_id ) {
2381 	$t_filter_row = filter_get_row( $p_filter_id );
2382 	if( $t_filter_row ) {
2383 		return !empty( $t_filter_row['name'] ) && $t_filter_row['project_id'] >= 0;
2384 	}
2385 	return false;
2386 }

2388 /**
2389  * Returns true if the filter is accessible by the user, which happens when the user
2390  * is the owner of the filter, or the filter is public.
2391  * @param integer $p_filter_id	Filter id
2392  * @param integer $p_user_id	User id
2393  * @return boolean	true if the filter is accessible by the user
2394  */
2395 function filter_is_accessible( $p_filter_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
2396 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
2397 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
2398 	} else {
2399 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id;
2400 	}
2401 	$t_filter_row = filter_get_row( $p_filter_id );
2402 	if( $t_filter_row ) {
2403 		if( $t_filter_row['user_id'] == $t_user_id || $t_filter_row['is_public'] ) {
2404 			# If the filter is a named filter, check the config options
2405 			if( $t_filter_row['project_id'] >= 0
2406 				&& !is_blank( $t_filter_row['name'] ) ) {
2407 				return access_has_project_level( config_get( 'stored_query_use_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_filter_row['project_id'] ) );
2408 			}
2409 			# it it's a "current" filter, access is ok
2410 			return true;
2411 		}
2412 	}
2413 	return false;
2414 }

2416 /**

2418  * @param string $p_url       Target URL, must end with 'view_type='
2419  * @param string $p_view_type Filter view type (FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE or
2420  *                            FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED)

2422 function filter_print_view_type_toggle( $p_url, $p_view_type ) {
2423 	$t_view_filters = config_get( 'view_filters' );
2424 	if( $t_view_filters == SIMPLE_ONLY || $t_view_filters == ADVANCED_ONLY ) {
2425 		return;
2426 	}
2427 
2428 	if( $p_view_type == FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED ) {
2429 		$t_url = $p_url . FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE;
2430 		$t_icon = 'fa-toggle-off';
2431 		$t_lang_string = 'simple_filters';
2432 	} else {

2434 		$t_icon = 'fa-toggle-on';
2435 		$t_lang_string = 'advanced_filters';
2436 	}
2437 
2438 	echo '<li>';
2439 	printf( '<a href="%s">%s&#160;&#160;%s</a>',
2440 		$t_url,
2441 		icon_get( $t_icon, 'ace-icon' ),
2442 		lang_get( $t_lang_string )
2443 	);

2447 /**
2448  * Returns an array of project ids which are included in the filter.
2449  * This array includes all individual projects/subprojects that are in the search scope.
2450  * If ALL_PROJECTS were included directly, or indirectly, and the parameter $p_return_all_projects
2451  * is set to true, the value ALL_PROJECTS will be returned. Otherwise the array will be expanded
2452  * to all actual accessible projects
2453  * @param array $p_filter                 Filter array
2454  * @param integer $p_project_id           Project id to use in filtering, if applicable by filter type
2455  * @param integer $p_user_id              User id to use as current user when filtering
2456  * @param boolean $p_return_all_projects  If true, return ALL_PROJECTS directly if found, instead of
2457  *                                         expanding to individual project ids
2458  * @return array|integer	Array of project ids, or ALL_PROJECTS if applicable.
2459  */
2460 function filter_get_included_projects( array $p_filter, $p_project_id = null, $p_user_id = null, $p_return_all_projects = false ) {
2461 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
2462 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
2463 	} else {
2464 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id;
2465 	}
2466 	if( !$p_user_id ) {
2467 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
2468 	} else {
2469 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id;
2470 	}
2471 
2472 	$t_view_type = $p_filter['_view_type'];
2473 	# normalize the project filtering into an array $t_project_ids
2474 	if( FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE == $t_view_type ) {
2475 		log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'Simple Filter' );
2476 		$t_project_ids = array( $t_project_id );
2477 		$t_include_sub_projects = true;
2478 	} else {
2479 		log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'Advanced Filter' );
2480 		$t_project_ids = $p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID];
2481 		$t_include_sub_projects = (( count( $t_project_ids ) == 1 ) && ( ( $t_project_ids[0] == META_FILTER_CURRENT ) || ( $t_project_ids[0] == ALL_PROJECTS ) ) );
2482 	}
2483 
2484 	log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'project_ids = @P' . implode( ', @P', $t_project_ids ) );
2485 	log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'include sub-projects = ' . ( $t_include_sub_projects ? '1' : '0' ) );
2486 
2487 	# if the array has ALL_PROJECTS, then reset the array to only contain ALL_PROJECTS.
2488 	# replace META_FILTER_CURRENT with the actual current project id.
2489 
2490 	$t_all_projects_found = false;
2491 	$t_new_project_ids = array();
2492 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_pid ) {
2493 		if( $t_pid == META_FILTER_CURRENT ) {
2494 			$t_pid = $t_project_id;
2495 		}
2496 
2497 		if( $t_pid == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
2498 			$t_all_projects_found = true;
2499 			log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'all projects selected' );
2500 			break;
2501 		}
2502 
2503 		# filter out inaccessible projects.
2504 		if( !project_exists( $t_pid ) || !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'view_bug_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_pid ), $t_pid, $t_user_id ) ) {
2505 			log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'Invalid or inaccessible project: ' . $t_pid );
2506 			continue;
2507 		}
2508 
2509 		$t_new_project_ids[] = $t_pid;
2510 	}
2511 
2512 	# if not expanding ALL_PROJECTS, shortcut return directly
2513 	if( $t_all_projects_found && $p_return_all_projects ) {
2514 		return ALL_PROJECTS;
2515 	}
2516 
2517 	if( $t_all_projects_found ) {
2518 		$t_project_ids = user_get_accessible_projects( $t_user_id );
2519 	} else {
2520 		$t_project_ids = $t_new_project_ids;
2521 	}
2522 
2523 	# expand project ids to include sub-projects
2524 	if( $t_include_sub_projects ) {
2525 		$t_top_project_ids = $t_project_ids;
2526 
2527 		foreach( $t_top_project_ids as $t_pid ) {
2528 			log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'Getting sub-projects for project id @P' . $t_pid );
2529 			$t_subproject_ids = user_get_all_accessible_subprojects( $t_user_id, $t_pid );
2530 			if( !$t_subproject_ids ) {
2531 				continue;
2532 			}
2533 			$t_project_ids = array_merge( $t_project_ids, $t_subproject_ids );
2534 		}
2535 
2536 		$t_project_ids = array_unique( $t_project_ids );
2537 	}
2538 
2539 	if( count( $t_project_ids ) ) {
2540 		log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'project_ids after including sub-projects = @P' . implode( ', @P', $t_project_ids ) );
2541 	} else {
2542 		log_event( LOG_FILTERING, 'no accessible projects' );
2543 	}
2544 
2545 	return $t_project_ids;
2546 }
2547 
2548 /**
2549  * Returns a filter array structure for the given filter_id.
2550  *
2551  * A default value can be provided to be used when the filter_id doesn't exists
2552  * or is not accessible.
2553  *
2554  * You may pass in any array as a default (including null) but if
2555  * you pass in *no* default then an error will be triggered if the filter
2556  * cannot be found.
2557  *
2558  * @param int        $p_filter_id Filter id.
2559  * @param array|null $p_default   A filter array to return when id is not found.
2560  *
2561  * @return array|null A filter array
2562  * @throws ClientException
2563  */
2564 function filter_get( int $p_filter_id, ?array $p_default = null ) {
2565 	# if no default was provided, we will trigger an error if not found
2566 	$t_trigger_error = func_num_args() == 1;
2567 
2568 	# This function checks for user access
2569 	$t_filter_string = filter_db_get_filter_string( $p_filter_id );
2570 	# If value is false, it either doesn't exists or is not accessible
2571 	if( !$t_filter_string ) {
2572 		if( $t_trigger_error ) {
2573 			throw new ClientException(
2574 				"Filter id '$p_filter_id' not found",
2575 				ERROR_FILTER_NOT_FOUND,
2576 				[$p_filter_id]
2577 			);
2578 		} else {
2579 			return $p_default;
2580 		}
2581 	}
2582 	$t_filter = filter_deserialize( $t_filter_string );
2583 	# If the unserialized data is not an array, then some error happened, eg, invalid format
2584 	if( !is_array( $t_filter ) ) {
2585 		# Don't throw error, otherwise the user could not recover navigation easily
2586 		return filter_get_default();
2587 	}
2588 	$t_filter = filter_clean_runtime_properties( $t_filter );
2589 	$t_filter['_filter_id'] = $p_filter_id;
2590 
2591 	$t_filter = filter_update_source_properties( $t_filter );
2592 
2593 	return $t_filter;
2594 }
2595 
2596 /**
2597  * Return a standard filter
2598  * @param string $p_filter_name     The name of the filter
2599  * @param integer|null $p_user_id   A user id to build this filter. Null for current user
2600  * @param integer|null $p_project_id	 A project id to build this filter.  Null for current project
2601  * @return null|boolean|array       null filter not found, false invalid filter, otherwise the filter.
2602  */
2603 function filter_standard_get( $p_filter_name, $p_user_id = null, $p_project_id = null ) {
2604 	$p_filter_name = strtolower( $p_filter_name );
2605 
2606 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
2607 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
2608 	} else {
2609 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id;
2610 	}
2611 
2612 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
2613 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
2614 	} else {
2615 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id;
2616 	}
2617 
2618 	switch( $p_filter_name ) {
2619 		case FILTER_STANDARD_ANY:
2620 			$t_filter = filter_create_any();
2621 			break;
2622 		case FILTER_STANDARD_ASSIGNED:
2623 			$t_filter = filter_create_assigned_to_unresolved( $t_project_id, $t_user_id );
2624 			break;
2625 		case FILTER_STANDARD_UNASSIGNED:
2626 			$t_filter = filter_create_assigned_to_unresolved( $t_project_id, NO_USER );
2627 			break;
2628 		case FILTER_STANDARD_REPORTED:
2629 			$t_filter = filter_create_reported_by( $t_project_id, $t_user_id );
2630 			break;
2631 		case FILTER_STANDARD_MONITORED:
2632 			$t_filter = filter_create_monitored_by( $t_project_id, $t_user_id );
2633 			break;
2634 		default:
2635 			return null;
2636 	}
2637 
2638 	return $t_filter;
2639 }
2640 
2641 /**
2642  * Updates a filter's properties with those from another filter that is referenced
2643  * by it's source-id property.
2644  * This is used when an anonymous filter was created from a named filter. As long
2645  * as this anonymous filter is not modified, it must be keep in sync with the
2646  * referenced filter (source_id), because the source filter may have been modified
2647  * at a later time.
2648  * This is a side effect of always using anonymous filters even when selecting a
2649  * named filter to be applied as current.
2650  *
2651  * @param array $p_filter	Original filter array
2652  * @return array	Updated filter array
2653  */
2654 function filter_update_source_properties( array $p_filter ) {
2655 	# Check if the filter references a named filter
2656 	# This property only makes sense, and should be available on unnamed filters
2657 	if( isset( $p_filter['_filter_id'] ) ) {
2658 		$t_filter_id = $p_filter['_filter_id'];
2659 	} else {
2660 		$t_filter_id = null;
2661 	}
2662 	if( isset( $p_filter['_source_query_id'] ) && $t_filter_id != $p_filter['_source_query_id'] ) {
2663 		$t_source_query_id = $p_filter['_source_query_id'];
2664 		# check if filter id is a proper named filter, and is accessible
2665 		if( filter_is_named_filter( $t_source_query_id ) && filter_is_accessible( $t_source_query_id ) ){
2666 			# replace filter with the referenced one
2667 			$t_new_filter = filter_deserialize( filter_db_get_filter_string( $t_source_query_id ) );
2668 			if( is_array( $t_new_filter ) ) {
2669 				# update the referenced stored filter id for the new loaded filter
2670 				$t_new_filter['_source_query_id'] = $t_source_query_id;
2671 				$p_filter = filter_copy_runtime_properties( $t_new_filter, $p_filter );
2672 			} else {
2673 				# If the unserialez data is not an array, the some error happened, eg, invalid format
2674 				unset( $p_filter['_source_query_id'] );
2675 			}
2676 		} else {
2677 			# If the filter id is not valid, clean the referenced filter id
2678 			unset( $p_filter['_source_query_id'] );
2679 		}
2680 	}
2681 	return $p_filter;
2682 }
2683 
2684 /**
2685  * Returns a filter which is stored in session data, indexed by the provided key.
2686  * A default value can be provided to be used when the key doesn't exists
2687  *
2688  *  You may pass in any array as a default (including null) but if
2689  *  you pass in *no* default then an error will be triggered if the key
2690  *  cannot be found
2691  *
2692  * @param string $p_filter_key  Key to look up for in session data
2693  * @param mixed $p_default		A default value to return if key not found
2694  * @return array	A filter array.
2695  */
2696 function filter_temporary_get( $p_filter_key, $p_default = null ) {
2697 	# if no default was provided, we will trigger an error if not found
2698 	$t_trigger_error = func_num_args() == 1;
2699 
2700 	$t_session_filters = session_get( 'temporary_filters', array() );
2701 	if( isset( $t_session_filters[$p_filter_key] ) ) {
2702 		# setting here the key in the filter array only if the key exists
2703 		# this validates against receiving garbage input as XSS attacks
2704 		$t_filter = $t_session_filters[$p_filter_key];
2705 		$t_filter['_temporary_key'] = $p_filter_key;
2706 		return filter_ensure_valid_filter( $t_filter );
2707 	} else {
2708 		if( $t_trigger_error ) {
2709 			error_parameters( $p_filter_key );
2710 			trigger_error( ERROR_FILTER_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
2711 		} else {
2712 			return $p_default;
2713 		}
2714 	}
2715 }
2716 
2717 /**
2718  * Saves a filter as a temporary filter in session data.
2719  * The filter will be updated or created, indexed by provided $p_filter_key,
2720  * If no key is provided, it will search in the filter property that holds
2721  * its key if it was loaded as a temporary filter.
2722  * If neither key is found, a new one will be created
2723  * @param array $p_filter     Filter array
2724  * @param string $p_filter_key  Key to update, or null
2725  * @return string	The key used for storing the filter.
2726  */
2727 function filter_temporary_set( array $p_filter, $p_filter_key = null ) {
2728 	if( null === $p_filter_key ) {
2729 		$t_filter_key = filter_get_temporary_key( $p_filter );
2730 		if( !$t_filter_key ) {
2731 			$t_filter_key = uniqid();
2732 		}
2733 	} else {
2734 		$t_filter_key = $p_filter_key;
2735 	}
2736 
2737 	$p_filter = filter_clean_runtime_properties( $p_filter );
2738 	$t_session_filters = session_get( 'temporary_filters', array() );
2739 	$t_session_filters[$t_filter_key] = $p_filter;
2740 	session_set( 'temporary_filters', $t_session_filters );
2741 	return $t_filter_key;
2742 }
2743 
2744 /**
2745  * Get the temporary key of the filter, if was loaded from temporary session store
2746  * Return null otherwise
2747  * @param array $p_filter	Filter array
2748  * @return string|null	Key associated with this filter, null if none
2749  */
2750 function filter_get_temporary_key( array $p_filter ) {
2751 	if( isset( $p_filter['_temporary_key'] ) ) {
2752 		return $p_filter['_temporary_key'];
2753 	} else {
2754 		return null;
2755 	}
2756 }
2757 
2758 /**
2759  * Returns true if the filter was loaded as temporary filter
2760  * @param array $p_filter	Filter array
2761  * @return boolean	Whether this filter is temporary
2762  */
2763 function filter_is_temporary( array $p_filter ) {
2764 	return isset( $p_filter['_temporary_key'] );
2765 }
2766 
2767 /**
2768  * Returns a string formatted as GET parameter, suitable for tracking a
2769  * temporary filter by its session key.
2770  * The parameter can be either:
2771  * - an existing key to be used directly, or
2772  * - a filter array, which can contain a property with the key.
2773  * If the provided filter does not contain the key property, the function
2774  * returns null.
2775  *
2776  * @param array|string $p_key_or_filter	Either a string key, or a filter array
2777  *
2778  * @return string|null	Formatted parameter string, or null
2779  */
2780 function filter_get_temporary_key_param( $p_key_or_filter ) {
2781 	if( is_array( $p_key_or_filter ) ) {
2782 		$t_key = filter_get_temporary_key( $p_key_or_filter );
2783 	} else {
2784 		$t_key = $p_key_or_filter;
2785 	}
2786 	if( $t_key ) {
2787 		return 'filter=' . $t_key;
2788 	} else {
2789 		return null;
2790 	}
2791 }
2792 
2793 /**
2794  * Removes runtime properties that are should not be saved as part of the filter
2795  * Use this function before saving the filter.
2796  * @param array $p_filter	Filter array (passed as reference, it gets modified)
2797  * @return array	Modified filter array
2798  */
2799 function filter_clean_runtime_properties( array $p_filter ) {
2800 	if( isset( $p_filter['_temporary_key'] ) ) {
2801 		unset( $p_filter['_temporary_key'] );
2802 	}
2803 	if( isset( $p_filter['_filter_id'] ) ) {
2804 		unset( $p_filter['_filter_id'] );
2805 	}
2806 	if( isset( $p_filter['_subquery'] ) ) {
2807 		unset( $p_filter['_subquery'] );
2808 	}
2809 	return $p_filter;
2810 }
2811 
2812 /**
2813  * Copy the runtime properties from one filter into another.
2814  * @param array $p_filter_to	Destination filter array
2815  * @param array $p_filter_from	Filter array from which properties are copied
2816  * @return array	Updated filter array
2817  */
2818 function filter_copy_runtime_properties( array $p_filter_to, array $p_filter_from ) {
2819 	if( isset( $p_filter_from['_temporary_key'] ) ) {
2820 		$p_filter_to['_temporary_key'] = $p_filter_from['_temporary_key'];
2821 	}
2822 	if( isset( $p_filter_from['_filter_id'] ) ) {
2823 		$p_filter_to['_filter_id'] = $p_filter_from['_filter_id'];
2824 	}
2825 	# we don't copy '_subquery' property, which is a cached subquery object,
2826 	# and can be regenerated at demand
2827 
2828 	return $p_filter_to;
2829 }
2830 
2831 /**
2832  * Return a cached BugFilterQuery object for the provided filter, configured and
2833  * ready to be used as a subquery for building other queries.
2834  * If the query is not in the cache, creates a new one and store it for later reuse.
2835  * Note: Query objects are indexed by a hash value over the serialized contents of the
2836  * filter array.
2837  *
2838  * Warning: Since the returned query is an object, it should not be modified in any way
2839  * that changes the expected behavior from the original filter array, as any further
2840  * reuse of this chached query will share the same instanced object.
2841  * If such a modification is needed over the query object, a clone should be used
2842  * instead, to avoid said side effects.
2843  *
2844  * @param array $p_filter	Filter array
2845  * @return BugFilterQuery	A query object for the filter
2846  */
2847 function filter_cache_subquery( array $p_filter ) {
2848 	global $g_cache_filter_subquery;
2849 
2850 	$t_hash = md5( json_encode( $p_filter ) );
2851 	if( !isset( $g_cache_filter_subquery[$t_hash] ) ) {
2852 		$g_cache_filter_subquery[$t_hash] = new BugFilterQuery( $p_filter, BugFilterQuery::QUERY_TYPE_IDS );
2853 	}
2854 
2855 	return $g_cache_filter_subquery[$t_hash];
2856 }
2857 /**
2858  * Returns true if the user can use peristent filters, in contexts such as view_all_bug_page.
2859  * Persistent filters are remembered across sessions, and are not desirable when the user is
2860  * a shared user, eg: anonymous user
2861  * @param integer $p_user_id	A valid user identifier.
2862  * @return boolean true if the user can use persistent filters, false otherwise
2863  */
2864 function filter_user_can_use_persistent( $p_user_id = null ) {
2865 	return !user_is_anonymous( $p_user_id );
2866 }

  66 /**
  67  * @internal The following functions each print out filter field inputs.
  68  *      They are derived from view_filters_page.php
  69  *      The functions follow a strict naming convention:
  70  *
  71  *      print_filter_[filter_name]
  72  *
  73  *      Where [filter_name] is the same as the "name" of the form element for
  74  *      that filter. This naming convention is depended upon by the controller
  75  *      at the end of the script.
  76  *
  77  * @todo print functions should be abstracted.  Many of these functions
  78  *      are virtually identical except for the property name.
  79  *      Perhaps this code could be made simpler by refactoring into a
  80  *      class to avoid all those calls to global (which are pretty ugly)
  81  *      These functions could also be shared by view_filters_page.php
  82  */
  83 
  84 /**
  85  * Returns HTML for each filter field, to be used in filter form.
  86  *
  87  * $p_filter_target is a field name to match any of "the print_filter_..."
  88  * functions, excluding those related to custom fields and plugin fields. When
  89  * $p_show_options is enabled, the form inputs are returned to allow selection,
  90  * if the option is disabled, returns the current value and a hidden input for
  91  * that value.
  92  *
  93  * @param array   $p_filter        Filter array
  94  * @param string  $p_filter_target Filter field name
  95  * @param boolean $p_show_inputs   True to return a visible form input or false
  96  *                                 for a text value.
  97  *
  98  * @return string The html content for the field requested
  99  *
 100  * @throws StateException if there is no matching print_filter_... function
 101  */
 102 function filter_form_get_input( array $p_filter, $p_filter_target, $p_show_inputs = true ) {
 103 	if( $p_show_inputs ) {
 104 		$t_function_prefix = 'print_filter_';
 105 	} else {
 106 		$t_function_prefix = 'print_filter_values_';
 107 	}
 108 	$t_params = array( $p_filter );
 109 	$t_function_name = $t_function_prefix . $p_filter_target;
 110 
 111 	# override non standard calls
 112 	switch( $p_filter_target ) {
 113 		case 'do_filter_by_date':
 114 		case 'do_filter_by_last_updated_date':
 115 			if( $p_show_inputs ) {
 116 				$t_params = array( false, $p_filter );
 117 			}
 118 			break;
 119 	}
 120 
 121 	if( function_exists( $t_function_name ) ) {
 122 		ob_start();
 123 		call_user_func_array( $t_function_name, $t_params );
 124 		return ob_get_clean();
 125 	} else {
 126 		# error - no function to populate the target (e.g., print_filter_foo)
 127 		throw new StateException(
 128 			"No function to populate the target",
 129 			ERROR_FILTER_NOT_FOUND,
 130 			array( $p_filter_target )
 131 		);
 132 	}
 133 }

 149 /**
 150  * Print the filter field's current value as a visible string and a hidden form input.
 151  *
 152  * @param array $p_filter Filter array
 153  *
 154  * @return void
 155  */
 156 function print_filter_values_reporter_id( array $p_filter ) {
 157 	$t_filter = $p_filter;
 158 	$t_output = '';
 159 	$t_any_found = false;
 160 	if( count( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID] ) == 0 ) {
 161 		echo lang_get( 'any' );
 162 	} else {
 163 		$t_first_flag = true;
 164 		foreach( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID] as $t_current ) {
 165 			$t_this_name = '';
 166 			echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_REPORTER_ID, '[]" value="', string_attribute( $t_current ), '" />';
 167 			if( filter_field_is_any( $t_current ) ) {
 168 				$t_any_found = true;
 169 			} else if( filter_field_is_myself( $t_current ) ) {
 170 				if( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'report_bug_threshold' ) ) ) {

1341 function print_filter_values_do_filter_by_date( array $p_filter ) {
1342 	$t_filter = $p_filter;

1344 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_DATE_SUBMITTED, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_FILTER_BY_DATE_SUBMITTED] ), '" />';
1345 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_MONTH, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_MONTH] ), '" />';
1346 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_DAY, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_DAY] ), '" />';
1347 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_YEAR, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_YEAR] ), '" />';
1348 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_MONTH, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_MONTH] ), '" />';
1349 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_DAY, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_DAY] ), '" />';

1353 		$t_time = mktime( 0, 0, 0, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_MONTH], $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_DAY], $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_START_YEAR] );
1354 		foreach( $t_chars as $t_char ) {
1355 			if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'M' ) == 0 ) {
1356 				echo ' ';
1357 				echo lang_get( 'month_' . strtolower ( date( 'F', $t_time ) ) );
1358 			}
1359 			if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'D' ) == 0 ) {
1360 				echo ' ';
1361 				echo date( 'd', $t_time );
1362 			}
1363 			if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'Y' ) == 0 ) {
1364 				echo ' ';
1365 				echo date( 'Y', $t_time );
1366 			}
1367 		}
1368 
1369 		echo ' - ';
1370 
1371 		$t_time = mktime( 0, 0, 0, $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_MONTH], $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_DAY], $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_DATE_SUBMITTED_END_YEAR] );
1372 		foreach( $t_chars as $t_char ) {
1373 			if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'M' ) == 0 ) {
1374 				echo ' ';
1375 				echo lang_get( 'month_' . strtolower ( date( 'F', $t_time ) ) );
1376 			}
1377 			if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'D' ) == 0 ) {
1378 				echo ' ';
1379 				echo date( 'd', $t_time );
1380 			}
1381 			if( strcasecmp( $t_char, 'Y' ) == 0 ) {
1382 				echo ' ';
1383 				echo date( 'Y', $t_time );
1384 			}
1385 		}
1386 	} else {
1387 		echo lang_get( 'no' );
1388 	}
1389 }

1650  *
1651  * @return void
1652  * @throws ClientException
1653  */
1654 function print_filter_values_relationship_type( array $p_filter ) {
1655 	$t_filter = $p_filter;
1656 	echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE] ), '" />';
1657 	echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG, '" value="', string_attribute( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG] ), '" />';
1658 	$c_rel_type = $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE];
1659 	$c_rel_bug = $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_RELATIONSHIP_BUG];
1660 	if( BUG_REL_ANY == $c_rel_type ) {
1661 		switch ( $c_rel_bug ) {
1662 			case META_FILTER_NONE:
1663 				echo lang_get( 'none' );
1664 				break;
1665 			case META_FILTER_ANY:
1666 				echo lang_get( 'any' );
1667 				break;
1668 			default:
1669 				echo lang_get( 'any' ),' ' , lang_get( 'with' ), ' ', $c_rel_bug;
1670 		}
1671 	} elseif( BUG_REL_NONE == $c_rel_type ) {
1672 		echo lang_get( 'none' );
1673 		switch ( $c_rel_bug ) {
1674 			case META_FILTER_NONE:
1675 			case META_FILTER_ANY:
1676 				break;
1677 			default:
1678 				echo ' ', lang_get( 'with' ), ' ', $c_rel_bug;
1679 		}
1680 	} else {
1681 		echo relationship_get_description_for_history( $c_rel_type ) . ' ';
1682 		switch ( $c_rel_bug ) {
1683 			case META_FILTER_NONE:
1684 				echo lang_get( 'none' );
1685 				break;
1686 			case META_FILTER_ANY:
1687 				echo lang_get( 'any' );
1688 				break;
1689 			default:
1690 				echo $c_rel_bug;
1691 		}
1692 	}
1693 }

1765  *
1766  * @return void
1767  */
1768 function print_filter_values_note_user_id( array $p_filter ) {
1769 	$t_filter = $p_filter;
1770 	$t_output = '';
1771 	$t_any_found = false;
1772 	if( count( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_NOTE_USER_ID] ) == 0 ) {
1773 		echo lang_get( 'any' );
1774 	} else {
1775 		$t_first_flag = true;
1776 		foreach( $t_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_NOTE_USER_ID] as $t_current ) {
1777 			echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_NOTE_USER_ID, '[]" value="', string_attribute( $t_current ), '" />';
1778 			$t_this_name = '';
1779 			if( filter_field_is_none( $t_current ) ) {
1780 				$t_this_name = lang_get( 'none' );
1781 			} else if( filter_field_is_any( $t_current ) ) {
1782 				$t_any_found = true;
1783 			} else if( filter_field_is_myself( $t_current ) ) {
1784 				if( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'handle_bug_threshold' ) ) ) {
1785 					$t_this_name = '[' . lang_get( 'myself' ) . ']';
1786 				} else {
1787 					$t_any_found = true;
1788 				}
1789 			} else {
1790 				$t_this_name = user_get_name( $t_current );
1791 			}
1792 			if( !$t_first_flag ) {
1793 				$t_output .= '<br />';
1794 			} else {
1795 				$t_first_flag = false;
1796 			}
1797 			$t_output .= string_display_line( $t_this_name );
1798 		}
1799 		if( $t_any_found ) {
1800 			echo lang_get( 'any' );
1801 		} else {
1802 			echo $t_output;
1803 		}
1804 	}
1805 }

1840 /**
1841  * Print the filter field's current value as a visible string and a hidden form input.
1842  *
1843  * @param array  $p_filter        Filter array
1844  * @param string $p_field_name    Field name
1845  * @param object $p_filter_object Filter object
1846  *
1847  * @return void
1848  */
1849 function print_filter_values_plugin_field( array $p_filter, $p_field_name, $p_filter_object ) {
1850 	if( !isset( $p_filter[$p_field_name] ) ) {
1851 		echo lang_get( 'any' );
1852 	} else {
1853 		$t_value = $p_filter[$p_field_name];
1854 		switch( $p_filter_object->type ) {
1855 			case FILTER_TYPE_STRING:
1856 			case FILTER_TYPE_INT:
1857 				if( filter_field_is_any( $t_value ) ) {
1858 					echo lang_get( 'any' );
1859 				} else {
1860 					echo string_display_line( $t_value );
1861 				}
1862 				echo '<input type="hidden" name="' . string_attribute( $p_field_name ) . '" value="' . string_attribute( $t_value ) . '">';
1863 				break;
1864 
1865 			case FILTER_TYPE_BOOLEAN:
1866 				echo string_display_line( $p_filter_object->display( (bool)$t_value ) );
1867 				echo '<input type="hidden" name="' . string_attribute( $p_field_name ) . '" value="' . (bool)$t_value . '">';
1868 				break;
1869 
1870 			case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_STRING:
1871 			case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_INT:
1872 				if( !is_array( $t_value ) ) {
1873 					$t_value = array( $t_value );
1874 				}
1875 				$t_strings = array();
1876 				foreach( $t_value as $t_current ) {
1877 					if( filter_field_is_any( $t_current ) ) {
1878 						$t_strings[] = lang_get( 'any' );
1879 					} else {
1880 						$t_strings[] = string_display_line( $p_filter_object->display( $t_current ) );
1881 					}
1882 					echo '<input type="hidden" name="' . string_attribute( $p_field_name ) . '[]" value="' . string_attribute( $t_current ) . '">';
1883 				}
1884 				echo implode( '<br>', $t_strings );
1885 				break;
1886 		}
1887 	}
1888 }

1890 /**
1891  * Print plugin filter fields as defined by MantisFilter objects.
1892  *
1893  * @param string     $p_field_name    Field name.
1894  * @param object     $p_filter_object Filter object.
1895  * @param array|null $p_filter        Filter array
1896  *
1897  * @return void
1898  * @global array     $g_filter
1899  */
1900 function print_filter_plugin_field( $p_field_name, $p_filter_object, ?array $p_filter = null ) {
1901 	global $g_filter;
1902 	if( null === $p_filter ) {
1903 		$p_filter = $g_filter;
1904 	}
1905 
1906 	$t_size = (int)$p_filter_object->size;
1907 
1908 	switch( $p_filter_object->type ) {
1909 		case FILTER_TYPE_STRING:
1910 			echo '<input class="input-xs" type="text" name="', string_attribute( $p_field_name ), '"',
1911 				( $t_size > 0 ? ' size="' . $t_size . '"' : '' ), ' value="',
1912 				string_attribute( $p_filter[$p_field_name] ), '"/>';
1913 			break;
1914 
1915 		case FILTER_TYPE_INT:
1916 			echo '<input class="input-xs" type="text" name="', string_attribute( $p_field_name ), '"',
1917 				( $t_size > 0 ? ' size="' . $t_size . '"' : '' ), ' value="',
1918 				(int)$p_filter[$p_field_name], '"/>';
1919 			break;
1920 
1921 		case FILTER_TYPE_BOOLEAN:
1922 			echo '<input name="', string_attribute( $p_field_name ), '" type="hidden" value="', OFF ,'"/>';
1923 			echo '<label>';
1924 			echo '<input class="input-xs ace" name="', string_attribute( $p_field_name ), '" type="checkbox"',
1925 				( $t_size > 0 ? ' size="' . $t_size . '"' : '' );
1926 			check_checked( (bool)$p_filter[$p_field_name] );
1927 			echo '"/>';
1928 			echo '<span class="lbl"></span>';
1929 			echo '</label>';
1930 			break;
1931 
1932 		case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_STRING:
1933 			echo '<select class="input-xs" ' . filter_select_modifier( $p_filter ) . ( $t_size > 0 ? ' size="' . $t_size . '"' : '' ),
1934 				' name="', string_attribute( $p_field_name ), '[]">', '<option value="', META_FILTER_ANY, '"';
1935 			check_selected( $p_filter[$p_field_name], (string)META_FILTER_ANY );
1936 			echo '>[', lang_get( 'any' ), ']</option>';
1937 
1938 			foreach( $p_filter_object->options() as $t_option_value => $t_option_name ) {
1939 				echo '<option value="', string_attribute( $t_option_value ), '" ';
1940 				check_selected( $p_filter[$p_field_name], $t_option_value, false );
1941 				echo '>', string_display_line( $t_option_name ), '</option>';
1942 			}
1943 
1944 			echo '</select>';
1945 			break;
1946 
1947 		case FILTER_TYPE_MULTI_INT:
1948 			echo '<select class="input-xs"' . filter_select_modifier( $p_filter ) . ( $t_size > 0 ? ' size="' . $t_size . '"' : '' ),
1949 				' name="', string_attribute( $p_field_name ), '[]">', '<option value="', META_FILTER_ANY, '"';
1950 			check_selected( $p_filter[$p_field_name], META_FILTER_ANY );
1951 			echo '>[', lang_get( 'any' ), ']</option>';
1952 
1953 			foreach( $p_filter_object->options() as $t_option_value => $t_option_name ) {
1954 				echo '<option value="', (int)$t_option_value, '" ';
1955 				check_selected( $p_filter[$p_field_name], (int)$t_option_value );
1956 				echo '>', string_display_line( $t_option_name ), '</option>';
1957 			}
1958 
1959 			echo '</select>';
1960 			break;
1961 	}
1962 }

1964 /**
1965  * Print the filter field's current value as a visible string and a hidden form input.
1966  *
1967  * @param array $p_filter Filter array
1968  * @param integer $p_field_id Custom field id
1969  *
1970  * @return void
1971  */
1972 function print_filter_values_custom_field( array $p_filter, $p_field_id ) {
1973 	if( CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE == custom_field_type( $p_field_id ) ) {
1974 		print_filter_values_custom_field_date( $p_filter, $p_field_id );
1975 		return;
1976 	}
1977 
1978 	$t_values = $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id] ?? array();
1979 	$t_strings = array();
1980 	$t_inputs = array();
1981 
1982 	if( filter_field_is_any( $t_values ) ) {
1983 		$t_strings[] = lang_get( 'any' );
1984 	} else {
1985 		foreach( $t_values as $t_val ) {
1986 			$t_val = stripslashes( $t_val );
1987 			if( filter_field_is_none( $t_val ) ) {
1988 				$t_strings[] = lang_get( 'none' );
1989 			} else {
1990 				$t_strings[] = string_attribute( $t_val );
1991 			}
1992 			$t_inputs[] = '<input type="hidden" name="custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '[]" value="' . string_attribute( $t_val ) . '" />';
1993 		}
1994 	}
1995 
1996 	echo implode( '<br>', $t_strings );
1997 	echo implode( '', $t_inputs );
1998 }

2000 /**
2001  * Print the filter field's current value (for a date type field) as a visible
2002  * string and a hidden form input.
2003  *
2004  * @param array $p_filter   Filter array to use
2005  * @param int   $p_field_id	Custom field id
2006  *
2007  * @return void
2008  */
2009 function print_filter_values_custom_field_date( array $p_filter, $p_field_id ) {
2010 	$t_short_date_format = config_get( 'short_date_format' );
2011 	if( !isset( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][1] ) ) {
2012 		$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][1] = 0;
2013 	}
2014 	$t_start = date( $t_short_date_format, $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][1] );
2015 
2016 	if( !isset( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][2] ) ) {
2017 		$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][2] = 0;
2018 	}
2019 	$t_end = date( $t_short_date_format, $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][2] );
2020 	switch( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0] ) {
2021 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ANY:
2022 			echo lang_get( 'any' );
2023 			break;
2024 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_NONE:
2025 			echo lang_get( 'none' );
2026 			break;
2027 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BETWEEN:
2028 			echo lang_get( 'between_date' ) . '<br>';
2029 			echo $t_start . '<br>' . $t_end;
2030 			break;
2031 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORBEFORE:
2032 			echo lang_get( 'on_or_before_date' ) . '<br>';
2033 			echo $t_end;
2034 			break;
2035 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BEFORE:
2036 			echo lang_get( 'before_date' ) . '<br>';
2037 			echo $t_end;
2038 			break;
2039 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ON:
2040 			echo lang_get( 'on_date' ) . '<br>';
2041 			echo $t_start;
2042 			break;
2043 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_AFTER:
2044 			echo lang_get( 'after_date' ) . '<br>';
2045 			echo $t_start;
2046 			break;
2047 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORAFTER:
2048 			echo lang_get( 'on_or_after_date' ) . '<br>';
2049 			echo $t_start;
2050 			break;
2051 	}
2052 	# print hidden inputs
2053 	$t_cf = $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id];
2054 	echo '<input type="hidden" name="custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '_control" value="' . $t_cf[0] . '">';
2055 	echo '<input type="hidden" name="custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '_start_timestamp" value="' . $t_cf[1] . '">';
2056 	echo '<input type="hidden" name="custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '_end_timestamp" value="' . $t_cf[2] . '">';
2057 }
2058 
2059 
2060 /**
2061  * Print custom field input list.
2062  *
2063  * This function does not validate permissions
2064  *
2065  * @param integer    $p_field_id Custom field id
2066  * @param array|null $p_filter   Filter array
2067  *
2068  * @return void
2069  * @global array     $g_filter
2070  */
2071 function print_filter_custom_field( $p_field_id, ?array $p_filter = null ) {
2072 	global $g_filter;
2073 	if( null === $p_filter ) {
2074 		$p_filter = $g_filter;
2075 	}
2076 
2077 	$t_cfdef = custom_field_get_definition( $p_field_id );
2078 
2079 	switch( $t_cfdef['type'] ) {
2080 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE:
2081 			print_filter_custom_field_date( $p_field_id, $p_filter );
2082 			break;
2083 
2084 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA:
2085 			echo '<input class="input-xs" type="text" name="custom_field_', $p_field_id, '" size="10" value="" >';
2086 			break;
2087 
2088 		default:
2089 			echo '<select class="input-xs" ' . filter_select_modifier( $p_filter ) . ' name="custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '[]">';
2090 			# Option META_FILTER_ANY
2091 			echo '<option value="' . META_FILTER_ANY . '"';
2092 			check_selected( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id], META_FILTER_ANY, false );
2093 			echo '>[' . lang_get( 'any' ) . ']</option>';
2094 			# don't show META_FILTER_NONE for enumerated types as it's not possible for them to be blank
2095 			if( !in_array( $t_cfdef['type'], array( CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_ENUM, CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_LIST ) ) ) {
2096 				echo '<option value="' . META_FILTER_NONE . '"';
2097 				check_selected( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id], META_FILTER_NONE, false );
2098 				echo '>[' . lang_get( 'none' ) . ']</option>';
2099 			}
2100 			# Print possible values
2101 			$t_included_projects = filter_get_included_projects( $p_filter );
2102 			$t_values = custom_field_distinct_values( $t_cfdef, $t_included_projects );
2103 			if( is_array( $t_values ) ){
2104 				$t_max_length = config_get( 'max_dropdown_length' );
2105 				foreach( $t_values as $t_val ) {
2106 					if( filter_field_is_any($t_val) || filter_field_is_none( $t_val ) ) {
2107 						continue;
2108 					}
2109 					echo '<option value="' . string_attribute( $t_val ) . '"';
2110 					if( isset( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id] ) ) {
2111 						check_selected( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id], $t_val, false );
2112 					}
2113 					echo '>' . string_attribute( string_shorten( $t_val, $t_max_length ) ) . '</option>';
2114 				}
2115 			}
2116 			echo '</select>';
2117 			break;
2118 	}
2119 }
2120 
2121 /**
2122  * Print the filter field's current value as a visible string and a hidden form input.
2123  *
2124  * @param array $p_filter Filter array
2125  *
2126  * @return void
2127  */
2128 function print_filter_values_show_sort( array $p_filter ) {
2129 	$p_sort_properties = filter_get_visible_sort_properties_array( $p_filter );
2130 	$t_sort_fields = $p_sort_properties[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME];
2131 	$t_dir_fields = $p_sort_properties[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION];
2132 
2133 	# @TODO cproensa: this could be a constant, or config.
2134 	$t_max_displayed_sort = 2;
2135 
2136 	$t_count = count( $t_sort_fields );
2137 	for( $i = 0; $i < $t_count; $i++ ) {
2138 		# Only show the first sort columns
2139 		if( $i< $t_max_displayed_sort ) {
2140 			if( $i > 0 ) {
2141 				echo ', ';
2142 			}
2143 			$t_sort = $t_sort_fields[$i];
2144 			if(column_is_custom_field( $t_sort ) ) {
2145 				$t_field_name = string_attribute( lang_get_defaulted( column_get_custom_field_name( $t_sort ) ) );
2146 			} else {
2147 				$t_field_name = string_get_field_name( $t_sort );
2148 			}
2149 			echo $t_field_name . ' ' . lang_get( 'bugnote_order_' . mb_strtolower( $t_dir_fields[$i] ) );
2150 		} elseif ( $i == $t_max_displayed_sort ) {
2151 			echo ', ...';
2152 		}
2153 		# All sort columns are placed in hidden fields
2154 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME, '[]" value="', string_attribute( $t_sort_fields[$i] ), '" />';
2155 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION, '[]" value="', string_attribute( $t_dir_fields[$i] ), '" />';
2156 	}
2157 }
