2159 /**
2160  * Print sort fields.
2161  *
2162  * @param array|null $p_filter Filter array
2163  *
2164  * @return void
2165  * @global array     $g_filter
2166  */
2167 function print_filter_show_sort( ?array $p_filter = null ) {
2168 	global $g_filter;
2169 	if( null === $p_filter ) {
2170 		$p_filter = $g_filter;
2171 	}
2172 
2173 	# get visible columns, and filter out those that ar not sortable
2174 	$t_visible_columns = array_filter( helper_get_columns_to_view(), 'column_is_sortable' );
2175 
2176 	$t_shown_fields[''] = '';
2177 	foreach( $t_visible_columns as $t_column ) {
2178 		if(column_is_custom_field( $t_column ) ) {
2179 			$t_field_name = string_attribute( lang_get_defaulted( column_get_custom_field_name( $t_column ) ) );
2180 		} else {
2181 			$t_field_name = string_get_field_name( $t_column );
2182 		}
2183 		$t_shown_fields[$t_column] = $t_field_name;
2184 	}
2185 	$t_shown_dirs[''] = '';
2186 	$t_shown_dirs['ASC'] = lang_get( 'bugnote_order_asc' );
2187 	$t_shown_dirs['DESC'] = lang_get( 'bugnote_order_desc' );
2188 
2189 	# get values from filter structure
2190 	$p_sort_properties = filter_get_visible_sort_properties_array( $p_filter );
2191 	$t_sort_fields = $p_sort_properties[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME];
2192 	$t_dir_fields = $p_sort_properties[FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION];
2193 
2194 	# @TODO cproensa: this could be a constant, or config.
2195 	$t_max_inputs_sort = 3;
2196 
2197 	$t_print_select_inputs =
2198 		function( $p_sort_val ='', $p_dir_val ='' ) use ( $t_shown_fields, $t_shown_dirs ) {
2199 			echo '<select class="input-xs" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME, '[]">';
2200 			foreach( $t_shown_fields as $t_key => $t_val ) {
2201 				echo '<option value="' . $t_key . '"';
2202 				check_selected( $t_key, $p_sort_val );
2203 				echo '>' . $t_val . '</option>';
2204 			}
2205 			echo '</select>';
2206 			echo '<select class="input-xs" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION, '[]">';
2207 			foreach( $t_shown_dirs as $t_key => $t_val ) {
2208 				echo '<option value="' . $t_key . '"';
2209 				check_selected( $t_key, $p_dir_val );
2210 				echo '>' . $t_val . '</option>';
2211 			}
2212 			echo '</select>';
2213 		};
2214 
2215 	# if there are fields to display, show the dropdowns
2216 	if( count( $t_visible_columns ) > 0 ) {
2217 		$t_field_count = count( $t_sort_fields );
2218 		$t_count = min( $t_field_count, $t_max_inputs_sort );
2219 		for( $i = 0; $i < $t_count; $i++ ) {
2220 			if( $i > 0 ) {
2221 				echo ', ';
2222 			}
2223 			$t_print_select_inputs( $t_sort_fields[$i], $t_dir_fields[$i] );
2224 		}
2225 		# If we can have more inputs displayed, print one more as empty.
2226 		if( $t_field_count < $t_max_inputs_sort ) {
2227 			echo ', ';
2228 			$t_print_select_inputs();
2229 		}
2230 	} else {
2231 		echo lang_get_defaulted( 'last_updated' ) . lang_get( 'bugnote_order_desc' );
2232 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_FIELD_NAME, '_array[]" value="last_updated" />';
2233 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_SORT_DIRECTION, '_array[]" value="DESC" />';
2234 	}
2235 }

2237 /**
2238  * Print custom field date fields.
2239  *
2240  * @param integer    $p_field_id Custom field identifier.
2241  * @param array|null $p_filter   Filter array
2242  *
2243  * @return void
2244  * @global array     $g_filter
2245  */
2246 function print_filter_custom_field_date( $p_field_id, ?array $p_filter = null ) {
2247 	global $g_filter;
2248 	if( null === $p_filter ) {
2249 		$p_filter = $g_filter;
2250 	}
2251 	$t_cfdef = custom_field_get_definition( $p_field_id );
2252 	$t_included_projects = filter_get_included_projects( $p_filter );
2253 	$t_values = custom_field_distinct_values( $t_cfdef, $t_included_projects );
2254 
2255 	$t_sel_start_year = null;
2256 	$t_sel_end_year = null;
2257 	if( is_array( $t_values ) && !empty( $t_values ) ) {
2258 		# Sort the values so they are ordered numerically
2259 		# (otherwise they are treated as strings, which may be wrong for dates before early 2001)
2260 		array_multisort( $t_values, SORT_NUMERIC, SORT_ASC );
2261 		$t_sel_start_year = date( 'Y', reset( $t_values ) );
2262 		$t_sel_end_year = date( 'Y', end( $t_values ) );
2263 	}
2264 
2265 	$t_start = date( 'U' );
2266 
2267 	# Default to today in filters
2268 	$t_end = $t_start;
2269 
2270 	$t_start_time = $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][1] ?? 0;
2271 	$t_end_time = $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][2] ?? 0;
2272 
2273 	$t_start_disable = true;
2274 	$t_end_disable = true;
2275 
2276 	# if $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0] is not set (ie no filter),
2277 	# we will drop through the following switch and use the default values
2278 	# above, so no need to check if stuff is set or not.
2279 	switch( $p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0] ) {
2280 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ANY:
2281 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_NONE:
2282 			break;
2283 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BETWEEN:
2284 			$t_start_disable = false;
2285 			$t_end_disable = false;
2286 			$t_start = $t_start_time;
2287 			$t_end = $t_end_time;
2288 			break;
2289 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORBEFORE:
2290 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BEFORE:
2291 			$t_start_disable = false;
2292 			$t_start = $t_end_time;
2293 			break;
2294 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ON:
2295 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_AFTER:
2296 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORAFTER:
2297 			$t_start_disable = false;
2298 			$t_start = $t_start_time;
2299 			break;
2300 	}
2301 
2302 	echo '<table><tr><td>' . "\n";
2303 	echo '<select class="input-xs" size="1" name="custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '_control">' . "\n";
2304 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ANY . '"';
2305 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ANY );
2306 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'any' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2307 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_NONE . '"';
2308 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_NONE );
2309 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'none' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2310 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BETWEEN . '"';
2311 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BETWEEN );
2312 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'between_date' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2313 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORBEFORE . '"';
2314 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORBEFORE );
2315 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'on_or_before_date' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2316 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BEFORE . '"';
2317 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_BEFORE );
2318 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'before_date' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2319 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ON . '"';
2320 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ON );
2321 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'on_date' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2322 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_AFTER . '"';
2323 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_AFTER );
2324 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'after_date' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2325 	echo '<option value="' . CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORAFTER . '"';
2326 	check_selected( (int)$p_filter['custom_fields'][$p_field_id][0], CUSTOM_FIELD_DATE_ONORAFTER );
2327 	echo '>' . lang_get( 'on_or_after_date' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
2328 	echo '</select>' . "\n";
2329 
2330 	echo "</td></tr>\n<tr><td>";
2331 
2332 	print_date_selection_set( 'custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '_start', config_get( 'short_date_format' ), $t_start, $t_start_disable, false, $t_sel_start_year, $t_sel_end_year, "input-xs" );
2333 	print "</td></tr>\n<tr><td>";
2334 	print_date_selection_set( 'custom_field_' . $p_field_id . '_end', config_get( 'short_date_format' ), $t_end, $t_end_disable, false, $t_sel_start_year, $t_sel_end_year, "input-xs" );
2335 	print "</td></tr>\n</table>";
2336 }

2553 /**
2554  * Draw the table cells to view and edit a filter.
2555  *
2556  * This will usually be part of a form. This method only prints the cells, not
2557  * the table definition, or any other form element outside of that.
2558  * A filter array is provided, to populate the fields.
2559  * The form will use javascript to show dynamic completion of fields (unless the
2560  * parameter $p_static is provided).
2561  * A page name can be provided to be used as a fallback script when javascript is
2562  * not available on the client, and the form was rendered with dynamic fields.
2563  * By default, the fallback is the current page.
2564  *
2565  * @param array   $p_filter               Filter array to show.
2566  * @param boolean $p_for_screen           Type of output
2567  * @param boolean $p_static               Whether to print a static form (no
2568  *                                        dynamic fields)
2569  * @param string  $p_static_fallback_page Page name to use as javascript
2570  *                                        fallback
2571  * @param boolean $p_show_search          Whether to render the search field
2572  *                                        inside the general fields area. If
2573  *                                        false, the text search should be
2574  *                                        managed externally.
2575  * @return void
2576  * @throws StateException
2577  */
2578 function filter_form_draw_inputs( $p_filter, $p_for_screen = true, $p_static = false, $p_static_fallback_page = null, $p_show_search = true ) {
2579 
2580 	$t_filter = filter_ensure_valid_filter( $p_filter );
2581 	$t_view_type = $t_filter['_view_type'];
2582 	$t_source_query_id = isset( $t_filter['_source_query_id'] ) ? (int)$t_filter['_source_query_id'] : -1;
2583 
2584 	# If it's a stored filter, linked to a specific project, use that project_id to render available fields
2585 	if( $t_source_query_id > 0 ) {
2586 		$t_project_id = (int)filter_get_field( $t_source_query_id, 'project_id' );
2587 		if( ALL_PROJECTS == $t_project_id ) {
2588 			# If all_projects, the filter can be used at any project, select the current project id
2589 			$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
2590 		} else if( $t_project_id < 0 ) {
2591 			# If filter is an unnamed filter, project id is stored as negative value.
2592 			$t_project_id = -1 * $t_project_id;
2593 		}
2594 	} else {
2595 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
2596 	}
2597 
2598 	$t_filter_projects = filter_get_included_projects( $t_filter, $t_project_id );
2599 
2600 	if( null === $p_static_fallback_page ) {
2601 		$p_static_fallback_page = $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'];
2602 	}
2603 	$t_filters_url = helper_mantis_url( $p_static_fallback_page );
2604 	$t_get_params = $_GET;
2605 	$t_get_params['for_screen'] = $p_for_screen;
2606 	$t_get_params['static'] = ON;
2607 	$t_get_params['view_type'] = ( FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED == $t_view_type )
2608 		? FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED
2609 		: FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_SIMPLE;
2610 	$t_filters_url = helper_url_combine( $t_filters_url, $t_get_params );
2611

2981 /**
2982  * Class that extends TableGridLayout and implements the specific HTML output needed for the
2983  * filter form table
2984  */
2985 class FilterBoxGridLayout extends TableGridLayout {
2986 
2987 	/**
2988 	 * Prints HTML code for TD cell representing the Item header
2989 	 * @param TableFieldsItem $p_item Item to display
2990 	 * @param integer $p_colspan Colspan attribute for cell
2991 	 */
2992 	protected function render_td_item_header( TableFieldsItem $p_item, $p_colspan ) {
2993 		echo '<td class="small-caption category ' . $p_item->attr_class . '"';
2994 		if( $p_colspan > 1) {
2995 			echo ' colspan="' . $p_colspan . '"';
2996 		}
2997 		if( $p_item->header_attr_id ) {
2998 			echo ' id="' . $p_item->header_attr_id . '"';
2999 		}
3000 		echo '>';
3001 		echo $p_item->header;
3002 		echo '</td>';
3003 	}
3004 
3005 	/**
3006 	 * Prints HTML code for TD cell representing the Item content
3007 	 * @param TableFieldsItem $p_item Item to display
3008 	 * @param integer $p_colspan Colspan attribute for cell
3009 	 */
3010 	protected function render_td_item_content( TableFieldsItem $p_item, $p_colspan ) {
3011 		echo '<td class="small-caption ' . $p_item->attr_class . '"';
3012 		if( $p_colspan > 1) {
3013 			echo ' colspan="' . $p_colspan . '"';
3014 		}
3015 		if( $p_item->content_attr_id ) {
3016 			echo ' id="' . $p_item->content_attr_id . '"';
3017 		}
3018 		echo '>';
3019 		echo $p_item->content;
3020 		echo '</td>';
3021 	}
3022 
3023 	/**
3024 	 * Prints HTML code for an empty TD cell, of header type
3025 	 * @param integer $p_colspan Colspan attribute for cell
3026 	 */
3027 	protected function render_td_empty_header( $p_colspan ) {
3028 		echo '<td class="small-caption category"';
3029 		if( $p_colspan > 1) {
3030 			echo ' colspan="' . $p_colspan . '"';
3031 		}
3032 		echo '>';
3033 		echo '&nbsp;';
3034 		echo '</td>';
3035 	}
3036 }
3037 
3038 
3039 /**
3040  * Print the filter field's current value as a visible string and a hidden form input.
3041  *
3042  * @param array $p_filter Filter array
3043  *
3044  * @return void
3045  */
3046 function print_filter_values_search( array $p_filter ) {
3047 	# always show the search text input
3048 	print_filter_search( $p_filter );
3049 }
3050 
3051 /**
3052  * Print search field.
3053  *
3054  * @param array|null $p_filter Filter array
3055  *
3056  * @return void
3057  * @global array     $g_filter
3058  */
3059 function print_filter_search( ?array $p_filter = null ) {
3060 	global $g_filter;
3061 	if( null === $p_filter ) {
3062 		$p_filter = $g_filter;
3063 	}
3064 	echo '<input type="text" id="filter-search-txt" class="input-sm" size="48" name="', FILTER_PROPERTY_SEARCH, '"
3065 		placeholder="' . lang_get( 'search' ) . '" value="', string_attribute( $p_filter[FILTER_PROPERTY_SEARCH] ), '" />';
3066 }

  17 /**
  18  * Form API
  19  *
  20  * Handles form security and validation. Security methods are targeted to
  21  * work with both GET and POST form types and should allow multiple
  22  * simultaneous edits of the form to be submitted out-of-order.
  23  *
  24  * @package CoreAPI
  25  * @subpackage FormAPI
  26  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  27  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  28  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  29  *
  30  * @uses config_api.php
  31  * @uses constant_inc.php
  32  * @uses crypto_api.php
  33  * @uses gpc_api.php
  34  * @uses php_api.php
  35  * @uses session_api.php
  36  */
  37 
  38 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  39 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  40 require_api( 'crypto_api.php' );
  41 require_api( 'gpc_api.php' );
  42 require_api( 'php_api.php' );
  43 require_api( 'session_api.php' );
  44 
  45 /**
  46  * Helper function to generate a form action value when forms are designed
  47  * to be submitted to the same url that's is currently being used, such as
  48  * helper_ensure_confirmed() or auth_reauthenticate().
  49  * @return string Form action value
  50  */
  51 function form_action_self() {
  52 	$t_self = trim( str_replace( "\0", '', $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] ) );
  53 	return basename( $t_self );
  54 }
  55 
  56 /**
  57  * Generate a random security token, prefixed by date, store it in the
  58  * user's session, and then return the string to be used as a form element
  59  * element with the security token as the value.
  60  * @param string $p_form_name Form name.
  61  * @return string Security token string
  62  */
  63 function form_security_token( $p_form_name ) {
  64 	if( PHP_CLI == php_mode() || OFF == config_get_global( 'form_security_validation' ) ) {
  65 		return '';
  66 	}
  67 
  68 	$t_tokens = session_get( 'form_security_tokens', array() );
  69 
  70 	# Create a new array for the form name if necessary
  71 	if( !isset( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) || !is_array( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) ) {
  72 		$t_tokens[$p_form_name] = array();
  73 	}
  74 
  75 	# Generate a nonce prefixed by date.
  76 	# With a base64 output encoded nonce length of 32 characters, we are
  77 	# generating a 192bit nonce.
  78 	$t_date = date( 'Ymd' );
  79 	$t_string = $t_date . crypto_generate_uri_safe_nonce( 32 );
  80 
  81 	# Add the token to the user's session
  82 	if( !isset( $t_tokens[$p_form_name][$t_date] ) ) {
  83 		$t_tokens[$p_form_name][$t_date] = array();
  84 	}
  85 
  86 	$t_tokens[$p_form_name][$t_date][$t_string] = true;
  87 	session_set( 'form_security_tokens', $t_tokens );
  88 
  89 	# The token string
  90 	return $t_string;
  91 }
  92 
  93 /**
  94  * Get a hidden form element containing a generated form security token.
  95  * @param string $p_form_name      Form name.
  96  * @param string $p_security_token Optional security token, previously generated for the same form.
  97  * @return string Hidden form element to output
  98  */
  99 function form_security_field( $p_form_name, $p_security_token = null ) {
 100 	if( PHP_CLI == php_mode() || OFF == config_get_global( 'form_security_validation' ) ) {
 101 		return '';
 102 	}
 103 
 104 	if( is_null( $p_security_token ) ) {
 105 		$p_security_token = form_security_token( $p_form_name );
 106 	}
 107 
 108 	# Create the form element HTML string for the security token
 109 	$t_form_token = $p_form_name . '_token';
 110 	$t_element = sprintf(
 111 		'<input type="hidden" name="%s" value="%s"/>',
 112 		$t_form_token,
 113 		$p_security_token
 114 	);
 115 
 116 	return $t_element;
 117 }
 118 
 119 /**
 120  * Get a URL parameter containing a generated form security token.
 121  * @param string $p_form_name Form name.
 122  * @param string $p_security_token Optional security token, previously generated for the same form.
 123  * @return string URL parameter containing security token
 124  */
 125 function form_security_param( $p_form_name, $p_security_token = null ) {
 126 	if( PHP_CLI == php_mode() || OFF == config_get_global( 'form_security_validation' ) ) {
 127 		return '';
 128 	}
 129 
 130 	$t_string = $p_security_token === null ? form_security_token( $p_form_name ) : $p_security_token;
 131 
 132 	# Create the GET parameter to be used in a URL for a secure link
 133 	return sprintf(
 134 		'&%s=%s',
 135 		$p_form_name . '_token',
 136 		$t_string
 137 	);
 138 }
 139 
 140 /**
 141  * Validate the security token for the given form name based on tokens
 142  * stored in the user's session.  While checking stored tokens, any that
 143  * are more than 3 days old will be purged.
 144  * @param string $p_form_name Form name.
 145  * @return boolean Form is valid
 146  */
 147 function form_security_validate( $p_form_name ) {
 148 	if( PHP_CLI == php_mode() || OFF == config_get_global( 'form_security_validation' ) ) {
 149 		return true;
 150 	}
 151 
 152 	$t_tokens = session_get( 'form_security_tokens', array() );
 153 
 154 	# Short-circuit if we don't have any tokens for the given form name
 155 	if( !isset( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) || !is_array( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) || count( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) < 1 ) {
 156 
 157 		trigger_error( ERROR_FORM_TOKEN_INVALID, ERROR );
 158 		return false;
 159 	}
 160 
 161 	# Get the form input
 162 	$t_form_token = $p_form_name . '_token';
 163 	$t_input = gpc_get_string( $t_form_token, '' );
 164 
 165 	# No form input
 166 	if( '' == $t_input ) {
 167 		trigger_error( ERROR_FORM_TOKEN_INVALID, ERROR );
 168 		return false;
 169 	}
 170 
 171 	# Get the date claimed by the token
 172 	$t_date = mb_substr( $t_input, 0, 8 );
 173 
 174 	# Check if the token exists
 175 	if( isset( $t_tokens[$p_form_name][$t_date][$t_input] ) ) {
 176 		return true;
 177 	}
 178 
 179 	# Token does not exist
 180 	trigger_error( ERROR_FORM_TOKEN_INVALID, ERROR );
 181 	return false;
 182 }
 183 
 184 /**
 185  * Purge form security tokens that are older than 3 days, or used
 186  * for form validation.
 187  * @param string $p_form_name Form name.
 188  * @return void
 189  */
 190 function form_security_purge( $p_form_name ) {
 191 	if( PHP_CLI == php_mode() || OFF == config_get_global( 'form_security_validation' ) ) {
 192 		return;
 193 	}
 194 
 195 	$t_tokens = session_get( 'form_security_tokens', array() );
 196 
 197 	# Short-circuit if we don't have any tokens for the given form name
 198 	if( !isset( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) || !is_array( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) || count( $t_tokens[$p_form_name] ) < 1 ) {
 199 		return;
 200 	}
 201 
 202 	# Get the form input
 203 	$t_form_token = $p_form_name . '_token';
 204 	$t_input = gpc_get_string( $t_form_token, '' );
 205 
 206 	# Get the date claimed by the token
 207 	$t_date = mb_substr( $t_input, 0, 8 );
 208 
 209 	# Generate a date string of three days ago
 210 	$t_purge_date = date( 'Ymd', time() - ( 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 ) );
 211 
 212 	# Purge old token data, and the currently-used token
 213 	unset( $t_tokens[$p_form_name][$t_date][$t_input] );
 214 
 215 	foreach( $t_tokens as $t_form_name => $t_dates ) {
 216 		foreach( $t_dates as $t_date => $t_date_tokens ) {
 217 			if( $t_date < $t_purge_date ) {
 218 				unset( $t_tokens[$t_form_name][$t_date] );
 219 			}
 220 		}
 221 	}
 222 
 223 	session_set( 'form_security_tokens', $t_tokens );
 224 
 225 	return;
 226 }

  40 # Determines (once-off) whether the client is accessing this script via a
  41 # secure connection. If they are, we want to use the Secure cookie flag to
  42 # prevent the cookie from being transmitted to other domains.
  43 # @global boolean $g_cookie_secure_flag_enabled
  44 $g_cookie_secure_flag_enabled = http_is_protocol_https();
  45 
  46 /**
  47  * Retrieve a GPC variable.
  48  * If the variable is not set, the default is returned.
  49  *
  50  *  You may pass in any variable as a default (including null) but if
  51  *  you pass in *no* default then an error will be triggered if the field
  52  *  cannot be found
  53  *
  54  * @param string $p_var_name Variable name.
  55  * @param mixed  $p_default  Default value.
  56  * @return null|string
  57  */
  58 function gpc_get( $p_var_name, $p_default = null ) {
  59 	if( isset( $_POST[$p_var_name] ) ) {
  60 		$t_result = $_POST[$p_var_name];
  61 	} else if( isset( $_GET[$p_var_name] ) ) {
  62 		$t_result = $_GET[$p_var_name];
  63 	} else if( func_num_args() > 1 ) {
  64 		# check for a default passed in (allowing null)
  65 		$t_result = $p_default;
  66 	} else {
  67 		error_parameters( $p_var_name );
  68 		trigger_error( ERROR_GPC_VAR_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
  69 		$t_result = null;
  70 	}
  71 
  72 	return $t_result;
  73 }
  74 
  75 /**
  76  * Check if GPC variable is set in $_POST or $_GET
  77  * @param string $p_var_name Variable name to check if set by http request.
  78  * @return boolean
  79  */
  80 function gpc_isset( $p_var_name ) {
  81 	if( isset( $_POST[$p_var_name] ) ) {
  82 		return true;
  83 	} else if( isset( $_GET[$p_var_name] ) ) {
  84 		return true;
  85 	}
  86 
  87 	return false;
  88 }
  89 
  90 /**
  91  * Retrieve a string GPC variable. Uses gpc_get().
  92  * If you pass in *no* default, an error will be triggered if
  93  * the variable does not exist
  94  * @param string $p_var_name Variable name to retrieve.
  95  * @param string $p_default  Default value of the string if not set(optional).
  96  * @return string|null
  97  */
  98 function gpc_get_string( $p_var_name, $p_default = null ) {
  99 	# Don't pass along a default unless one was given to us
 100 	#  otherwise we prevent an error being triggered
 101 	$t_args = func_get_args();
 102 	$t_result = call_user_func_array( 'gpc_get', $t_args );
 103 
 104 	if( is_array( $t_result ) ) {
 105 		error_parameters( $p_var_name );
 106 		trigger_error( ERROR_GPC_ARRAY_UNEXPECTED, ERROR );
 107 	}
 108 
 109 	if( $t_result === null ) {
 110 		return null;
 111 	} else {
 112 		return str_replace( "\0", '', $t_result );
 113 	}
 114 }
 115 
 116 /**
 117  * Retrieve an integer GPC variable. Uses gpc_get().
 118  * If you pass in *no* default, an error will be triggered if
 119  * the variable does not exist
 120  * @param string  $p_var_name Variable name to retrieve.
 121  * @param integer $p_default  Default integer value if not set (optional).
 122  * @return integer|null
 123  */
 124 function gpc_get_int( $p_var_name, $p_default = null ) {
 125 	# Don't pass along a default unless one was given to us
 126 	#  otherwise we prevent an error being triggered
 127 	$t_args = func_get_args();
 128 	$t_result = call_user_func_array( 'gpc_get', $t_args );
 129 
 130 	if( is_array( $t_result ) ) {
 131 		error_parameters( $p_var_name );
 132 		trigger_error( ERROR_GPC_ARRAY_UNEXPECTED, ERROR );
 133 	}
 134 	$t_val = trim( (string)$t_result );
 135 	if( !preg_match( '/^-?[0-9]*$/', $t_val ) ) {
 136 		error_parameters( $p_var_name );
 137 		trigger_error( ERROR_GPC_NOT_NUMBER, ERROR );
 138 	}
 139 
 140 	return (int)$t_val;
 141 }

 143 /**
 144  * Retrieve a boolean GPC variable. Uses gpc_get().
 145  *  If you pass in *no* default, false will be used
 146  * @param string  $p_var_name Variable name to retrieve.
 147  * @param boolean $p_default  Default boolean value if not set (optional).
 148  * @return boolean|null
 149  */
 150 function gpc_get_bool( $p_var_name, $p_default = false ) {
 151 	$t_result = gpc_get( $p_var_name, $p_default );
 152 
 153 	if( $t_result === $p_default ) {
 154 		return (bool)$p_default;
 155 	} else {
 156 		if( is_array( $t_result ) ) {
 157 			error_parameters( $p_var_name );
 158 			trigger_error( ERROR_GPC_ARRAY_UNEXPECTED, ERROR );
 159 		}
 160 
 161 		return gpc_string_to_bool( $t_result );
 162 	}
 163 }

 165 /**
 166  * see if a custom field variable is set.  Uses gpc_isset().
 167  * @param string  $p_var_name          Variable name to retrieve.
 168  * @param integer $p_custom_field_type Custom field type.
 169  * @return boolean
 170  */
 171 function gpc_isset_custom_field( $p_var_name, $p_custom_field_type ) {
 172 	$t_field_name = 'custom_field_' . $p_var_name;
 173 
 174 	switch( $p_custom_field_type ) {
 175 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE:
 176 			# date field is three dropdowns that default to 0
 177 			# Dropdowns are always present, so check if they are set
 178 			return gpc_isset( $t_field_name . '_day' ) &&
 179 				gpc_get_int( $t_field_name . '_day', 0 ) != 0 &&
 180 				gpc_isset( $t_field_name . '_month' ) &&
 181 				gpc_get_int( $t_field_name . '_month', 0 ) != 0 &&
 182 				gpc_isset( $t_field_name . '_year' ) &&
 183 				gpc_get_int( $t_field_name . '_year', 0 ) != 0 ;
 184 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_STRING:
 185 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_NUMERIC:
 186 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT:
 187 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_ENUM:
 188 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_EMAIL:
 189 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_TEXTAREA:
 190 			return gpc_isset( $t_field_name ) && !is_blank( gpc_get_string( $t_field_name ) );
 191 		default:
 192 			return gpc_isset( $t_field_name );
 193 	}
 194 }

 196 /**
 197  * Retrieve a custom field variable.  Uses gpc_get().
 198  * If you pass in *no* default, an error will be triggered if
 199  * the variable does not exist
 200  * @param string  $p_var_name          Variable name.
 201  * @param integer $p_custom_field_type Custom Field Type.
 202  * @param mixed   $p_default           Default value.
 203  * @return string
 204  */
 205 function gpc_get_custom_field( $p_var_name, $p_custom_field_type, $p_default = null ) {
 206 	switch( $p_custom_field_type ) {
 207 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_MULTILIST:
 208 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_CHECKBOX:
 209 			# Ensure that the default is an array
 210 			if( $p_default === null ) {
 211 				$p_default = [];
 212 			} elseif( !is_array( $p_default ) ) {
 213 				$p_default = array( $p_default );
 214 			}
 215 			$t_values = gpc_get_string_array( $p_var_name, $p_default );
 216 			return implode( '|', $t_values );
 217 		case CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_DATE:
 218 			$t_day = gpc_get_int( $p_var_name . '_day', 0 );
 219 			$t_month = gpc_get_int( $p_var_name . '_month', 0 );
 220 			$t_year = gpc_get_int( $p_var_name . '_year', 0 );
 221 			if( ( $t_year == 0 ) || ( $t_month == 0 ) || ( $t_day == 0 ) ) {
 222 				if( $p_default == null ) {
 223 					return '';
 224 				} else {
 225 					return $p_default;
 226 				}
 227 			} else {
 228 				return strtotime( $t_year . '-' . $t_month . '-' . $t_day );
 229 			}
 230 		default:
 231 			return gpc_get_string( $p_var_name, $p_default );
 232 	}
 233 }

 235 /**
 236  * Retrieve a string array GPC variable.
 237  *
 238  * Uses {@see gpc_get()}. If you pass in *no* default, an error will be
 239  * triggered if the variable does not exist.
 240  *
 241  * @param string $p_var_name Variable name to retrieve.
 242  * @param array  $p_default  Default value of the string array if not set.
 243  *
 244  * @return array
 245  */
 246 function gpc_get_string_array( string $p_var_name, array $p_default = [] ): array {
 247 	# Don't pass along a default unless one was given to us
 248 	# otherwise we prevent an error being triggered
 249 	$t_args = func_get_args();
 250 	$t_result = call_user_func_array( 'gpc_get', $t_args );
 251 
 252 	# If the result isn't the default we were given or an array, error
 253 	if( !((( 1 < func_num_args() ) && ( $t_result === $p_default ) ) || is_array( $t_result ) ) ) {
 254 		error_parameters( $p_var_name );
 255 		trigger_error( ERROR_GPC_ARRAY_EXPECTED, ERROR );
 256 	}
 257 
 258 	if( !is_array( $t_result ) ) {
 259 		return $t_result;
 260 	}
 261 	$t_array = array();
 262 	foreach( $t_result as $t_key => $t_value ) {
 263 		if( $t_value === null ) {
 264 			$t_array[$t_key] = null;
 265 		} else {
 266 			$t_array[$t_key] = str_replace( "\0", '', $t_value );
 267 		}
 268 	}
 269 	return $t_array;
 270 }

 335 /**
 336  * Retrieve a cookie variable

 339  * @param string $p_var_name Variable name to retrieve.
 340  * @param string $p_default  Default value if not set.

 342  */
 343 function gpc_get_cookie( $p_var_name, $p_default = null ) {

 358 /**
 359  * Set a cookie variable.
 360  *
 361  * If $p_expire is false instead of a number, the cookie will expire when
 362  * the browser is closed; if it is true, the default time from the config
 363  * file will be used.
 364  * If $p_path, $p_domain or $p_samesite are omitted, defaults are used.
 365  * Set $p_httponly to false if client-side Javascript needs to read/write
 366  * the cookie. Otherwise it is safe to leave this value unspecified, as
 367  * the default value is true.
 368  * @todo this function is to be modified by Victor to add CRC... for now it just passes the parameters through to setcookie()
 369  *
 370  * @param string  $p_name     Cookie name to set.
 371  * @param string  $p_value    Cookie value to set.
 372  * @param boolean|integer $p_expire true: current browser session, false/0: cookie_time_length, otherwise: expiry time.
 373  * @param string  $p_path     Cookie Path - default cookie_path configuration variable.
 374  * @param string  $p_domain   Cookie Domain - default is cookie_domain configuration variable.
 375  * @param boolean $p_httponly Default true.
 376  * @param string  $p_samesite SameSite attribute: Strict, Lax or None -
 377  *                            default cookie_samesite configuration variable.
 378  *
 379  * @return boolean - true on success, false on failure
 380  */
 381 function gpc_set_cookie( $p_name, $p_value, $p_expire = false, $p_path = null, $p_domain = null, $p_httponly = true, $p_samesite = null ) {
 382 	global $g_cookie_secure_flag_enabled;
 383 
 384 	if( false === $p_expire ) {
 385 		$p_expire = 0;
 386 	} else if( true === $p_expire ) {
 387 		$t_cookie_length = config_get_global( 'cookie_time_length' );
 388 		$p_expire = time() + $t_cookie_length;
 389 	}
 390 
 391 	if( null === $p_path ) {
 392 		$p_path = config_get_global( 'cookie_path' );
 393 	}
 394 
 395 	if( null === $p_domain ) {
 396 		$p_domain = config_get_global( 'cookie_domain' );
 397 	}
 398 
 399 	if( null === $p_samesite ) {
 400 		$p_samesite = config_get_global( 'cookie_samesite' );
 401 	}
 402 
 403 	$t_options = array(
 404 		'expires' => $p_expire,
 405 		'path' => $p_path,
 406 		'domain' => $p_domain,
 407 		'samesite' => $p_samesite,
 408 		'secure' => $g_cookie_secure_flag_enabled,
 409 		'httponly' => $p_httponly,
 410 	);
 411 	return setcookie( $p_name, $p_value, $t_options );
 412 }
 413 
 414 /**
 415  * Clear a cookie variable
 416  * @param string $p_name     Cookie clear to set.
 417  * @param string $p_path     Cookie path.
 418  * @param string $p_domain   Cookie domain.
 419  * @param string $p_samesite SameSite attribute.
 420  * @return boolean
 421  */
 422 function gpc_clear_cookie( $p_name, $p_path = null, $p_domain = null, $p_samesite = null ) {
 423 	if( null === $p_path ) {
 424 		$p_path = config_get_global( 'cookie_path' );
 425 	}
 426 	if( null === $p_domain ) {
 427 		$p_domain = config_get_global( 'cookie_domain' );
 428 	}
 429 	if( null === $p_samesite ) {
 430 		$p_samesite = config_get_global( 'cookie_samesite' );
 431 	}
 432 
 433 	if( isset( $_COOKIE[$p_name] ) ) {
 434 		unset( $_COOKIE[$p_name] );
 435 	}
 436 
 437 	# don't try to send cookie if headers are send (guideweb)
 438 	if( !headers_sent() ) {
 439 		# Note: This setcookie() call triggers a console warning in Firefox:
 440 		# Cookie “<PREFIX>_collapse_settings” has been rejected because it is already expired.
 441 		# apparently this is due to bug https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1676651
 442 
 443 		$t_options = array(
 444 			'expires' => 1,
 445 			'path' => $p_path,
 446 			'domain' => $p_domain,
 447 			'samesite' => $p_samesite,
 448 		);
 449 		return setcookie( $p_name, '', $t_options );
 450 	} else {
 451 		return false;
 452 	}
 453 }

 455 /**
 456  * Retrieve a file variable
 457  * You may pass in any variable as a default (including null) but if
 458  * you pass in *no* default then an error will be triggered if the file
 459  * cannot be found
 460  * @param string $p_var_name Variable name.
 461  * @param mixed  $p_default  Default value.
 462  * @return mixed
 463  */
 464 function gpc_get_file( $p_var_name, $p_default = null ) {
 465 	if( isset( $_FILES[$p_var_name] ) ) {
 466 		# FILES are not escaped even if magic_quotes is ON, this applies to Windows paths.
 467 		$t_result = $_FILES[$p_var_name];
 468 	} else if( func_num_args() > 1 ) {
 469 		# check for a default passed in (allowing null)
 470 		$t_result = $p_default;
 471 	} else {
 472 		error_parameters( $p_var_name );
 473 		trigger_error( ERROR_GPC_VAR_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 474 	}
 475 
 476 	/** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
 477 	return $t_result;
 478 }

 480 /**
 481  * Convert a POST/GET parameter to an array if it is not already one.
 482  * There is no return value from this function - The $_POST/$_GET are updated as appropriate.
 483  * @param string $p_var_name The name of the parameter.
 484  * @return void
 485  */
 486 function gpc_make_array( $p_var_name ) {
 487 	if( isset( $_POST[$p_var_name] ) && !is_array( $_POST[$p_var_name] ) ) {
 488 		$_POST[$p_var_name] = array(
 489 			$_POST[$p_var_name],
 490 		);
 491 	}
 492 
 493 	if( isset( $_GET[$p_var_name] ) && !is_array( $_GET[$p_var_name] ) ) {
 494 		$_GET[$p_var_name] = array(
 495 			$_GET[$p_var_name],
 496 		);
 497 	}
 498 }

 500 /**
 501  * Convert a string to a bool
 502  * @param string $p_string A string to convert to a boolean value.
 503  * @return boolean
 504  */
 505 function gpc_string_to_bool( $p_string ) {
 506 	$t_value = trim( strtolower( $p_string ) );
 507 	switch ( $t_value ) {
 508 		case 'off':
 509 		case 'no':
 510 		case 'n':
 511 		case 'false':
 512 		case '0':
 513 		case '':
 514 			return false;
 515 		default:
 516 			return true;
 517 	}
 518 }

  61 /**
  62  * alternate classes for table rows
  63  * If no index is given, continue alternating based on the last index given
  64  * @param int $p_index
  65  * @param string $p_odd_class default: row-1
  66  * @param string $p_even_class default: row-2
  67  * @return string
  68  */
  69 function helper_alternate_class( $p_index = null, $p_odd_class = 'row-1', $p_even_class = 'row-2' ) {
  70 	static $t_index = 1;
  71 
  72 	if( null !== $p_index ) {
  73 		$t_index = $p_index;
  74 	}
  75 
  76 	error_parameters( __FUNCTION__, 'CSS' );
  77 	trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
  78 
  79 	if( 1 == $t_index++ % 2 ) {
  80 		return "class=\"$p_odd_class\"";
  81 	} else {
  82 		return "class=\"$p_even_class\"";
  83 	}
  84 }

  86 /**
  87  * Transpose a bidimensional array
  88  *
  89  * e.g. array('a'=>array('k1'=>1,'k2'=>2),'b'=>array('k1'=>3,'k2'=>4))
  90  * becomes array('k1'=>array('a'=>1,'b'=>3),'k2'=>array('a'=>2,'b'=>4))
  91  *
  92  * @param array $p_array The array to transpose.
  93  *
  94  * @return array|mixed transposed array or $p_array if not 2-dimensional array
  95  * @throws ClientException
  96  */
  97 function helper_array_transpose( array $p_array ) {
  98 	$t_out = array();
  99 	foreach( $p_array as $t_key => $t_sub ) {
 100 		if( !is_array( $t_sub ) ) {
 101 			throw new ClientException(
 102 				__FUNCTION__ . " can only handle bidimensional arrays",
 103 				ERROR_GENERIC
 104 			);
 105 		}
 106 
 107 		foreach( $t_sub as $t_subkey => $t_value ) {
 108 			$t_out[$t_subkey][$t_key] = $t_value;
 109 		}
 110 	}
 111 	return $t_out;
 112 }

 114 /**
 115  * get the color string for the given status, user and project
 116  * @param integer      $p_status        Status value.
 117  * @param integer|null $p_user          User id, defaults to null (all users).
 118  * @param integer|null $p_project       Project id, defaults to null (all projects).
 119  * @param string       $p_default_color Fallback color in case status is not found (defaults to white).
 120  * @return string
 121  */
 122 function get_status_color( $p_status, $p_user = null, $p_project = null, $p_default_color = '#ffffff' ) {
 123 	$t_status_enum = config_get( 'status_enum_string', null, $p_user, $p_project );
 124 	$t_status_colors = config_get( 'status_colors', null, $p_user, $p_project );
 125 	$t_status_label = MantisEnum::getLabel( $t_status_enum, $p_status );
 126 
 127 	if( isset( $t_status_colors[$t_status_label] ) ) {
 128 		return $t_status_colors[$t_status_label];
 129 	}
 130 	return $p_default_color;

 133 /**
 134  * get the status percentages
 135  * @return array key is the status value, value is the percentage of bugs for the status
 136  */
 137 function get_percentage_by_status() {
 138 	$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 139 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 140 
 141 	# checking if it's a per project statistic or all projects
 142 	$t_specific_where = helper_project_specific_where( $t_project_id, $t_user_id );
 143 
 144 	$t_query = 'SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS num
 145 				FROM {bug}
 146 				WHERE ' . $t_specific_where;
 147 	if( !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'private_bug_threshold' ) ) ) {
 148 		$t_query .= ' AND view_state < ' . VS_PRIVATE;
 149 	}
 150 	$t_query .= ' GROUP BY status';
 151 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 152 
 153 	$t_status_count_array = array();
 154 
 155 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 156 		$t_status_count_array[$t_row['status']] = $t_row['num'];
 157 	}
 158 	$t_bug_count = array_sum( $t_status_count_array );
 159 	foreach( $t_status_count_array as $t_status=>$t_value ) {
 160 		$t_status_count_array[$t_status] = round( ( $t_value / $t_bug_count ) * 100 );
 161 	}
 162 
 163 	return $t_status_count_array;
 164 }

 182 /**
 183  * Compares the 2 specified variables, returns true if equal, false if not.
 184  * With strict type checking, will trigger an error if the types of the compared
 185  * variables don't match.
 186  * This helper function is used by {@link check_checked()} and {@link check_selected()}
 187  * @param mixed   $p_var1   The variable to compare.
 188  * @param mixed   $p_var2   The second variable to compare.
 189  * @param boolean $p_strict Set to true for strict type checking, false for loose.
 190  * @return boolean
 191  */
 192 function helper_check_variables_equal( $p_var1, $p_var2, $p_strict ) {
 193 	if( $p_strict ) {
 194 		if( gettype( $p_var1 ) !== gettype( $p_var2 ) ) {
 195 			# Reaching this point is a a sign that you need to check the types
 196 			# of the parameters passed to this function. They should match.
 197 			trigger_error( ERROR_TYPE_MISMATCH, ERROR );
 198 		}
 199 
 200 		# We need to be careful when comparing an array of
 201 		# version number strings (["1.0", "1.1", "1.10"]) to
 202 		# a selected version number of "1.10". If a ==
 203 		# comparison were to be used, PHP would treat
 204 		# "1.1" and "1.10" as being the same as the strings
 205 		# would be converted to numerals before being compared
 206 		# as numerals.
 207 		#
 208 		# This is further complicated by filter dropdowns
 209 		# containing a mixture of string and integer values.
 210 		# The following "meta filter values" exist as integer
 211 		# values in dropdowns:
 212 		#   META_FILTER_MYSELF = -1
 213 		#   META_FILTER_NONE = -2
 214 		#   META_FILTER_CURRENT = -3
 215 		#   META_FILTER_ANY = 0
 216 		#
 217 		# For these reasons, a === comparison is required.
 218 
 219 		return $p_var1 === $p_var2;
 220 	} else {
 221 		return $p_var1 == $p_var2;
 222 	}
 223 }
 224 
 225 /**
 226  * Attach a "checked" attribute to a HTML element if $p_var === $p_val or
 227  * a {value within an array passed via $p_var} === $p_val.
 228  *
 229  * If the second parameter is not given, the first parameter is compared to
 230  * the boolean value true.
 231  *
 232  * @param mixed   $p_var    The variable to compare.
 233  * @param mixed   $p_val    The value to compare $p_var with.
 234  * @param boolean $p_strict Set to false to bypass strict type checking (defaults to true).
 235  * @return void
 236  */
 237 function check_checked( $p_var, $p_val = true, $p_strict = true ) {
 238 	if( is_array( $p_var ) ) {
 239 		foreach( $p_var as $t_this_var ) {
 240 			if( helper_check_variables_equal( $t_this_var, $p_val, $p_strict ) ) {
 241 				echo ' checked="checked"';
 242 				return;
 243 			}
 244 		}
 245 	} else {
 246 		if( helper_check_variables_equal( $p_var, $p_val, $p_strict ) ) {
 247 			echo ' checked="checked"';
 248 			return;
 249 		}
 250 	}
 251 }

 293 /**
 294  * Set up PHP for a long process execution
 295  * The script timeout is set based on the value of the long_process_timeout config option.
 296  * $p_ignore_abort specified whether to ignore user aborts by hitting
 297  * the Stop button (the default is not to ignore user aborts)
 298  * @param boolean $p_ignore_abort Whether to ignore user aborts from the web browser.
 299  * @return integer
 300  */
 301 function helper_begin_long_process( $p_ignore_abort = false ) {
 302 	$t_timeout = config_get_global( 'long_process_timeout' );
 303 
 304 	# silent errors or warnings reported when safe_mode is ON.
 305 	@set_time_limit( $t_timeout );
 306 
 307 	ignore_user_abort( $p_ignore_abort );
 308 	return $t_timeout;
 309 }

 311 # this allows pages to override the current project settings.
 312 # This typically applies to the view bug pages where the "current"
 313 # project as used by the filters, etc, does not match the bug being viewed.
 314 $g_project_override = null;
 315 $g_cache_current_project = null;
 316 
 317 /**
 318  * Return the current project id as stored in a cookie
 319  * If no cookie exists, the user's default project is returned
 320  * @return integer
 321  */
 322 function helper_get_current_project() {
 323 	global $g_project_override, $g_cache_current_project;
 324 
 325 	if( $g_project_override !== null ) {
 326 		return $g_project_override;
 327 	}
 328 
 329 	if( $g_cache_current_project === null ) {
 330 		$t_cookie_name = config_get_global( 'project_cookie' );
 331 
 332 		$t_project_id = gpc_get_cookie( $t_cookie_name, null );
 333 
 334 		if( null === $t_project_id ) {
 335 			$t_pref = user_pref_get( auth_get_current_user_id(), ALL_PROJECTS );
 336 			$t_project_id = $t_pref->default_project;
 337 		} else {
 338 			$t_project_id = explode( ';', $t_project_id );
 339 			$t_project_id = $t_project_id[count( $t_project_id ) - 1];
 340 		}
 341 
 342 		if( !project_exists( $t_project_id ) || ( 0 == project_get_field( $t_project_id, 'enabled' ) ) || !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'view_bug_threshold', null, null, $t_project_id ), $t_project_id ) ) {
 343 			$t_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS;
 344 		}
 345 		$g_cache_current_project = (int)$t_project_id;
 346 	}
 347 	return $g_cache_current_project;
 348 }
 349 
 350 /**
 351  * Return the current project id as stored in a cookie, in an Array
 352  * If no cookie exists, the user's default project is returned
 353  * If the current project is a subproject, the return value will include
 354  * any parent projects
 355  * @return array
 356  */
 357 function helper_get_current_project_trace() {
 358 	$t_cookie_name = config_get_global( 'project_cookie' );
 359 
 360 	$t_project_id = gpc_get_cookie( $t_cookie_name, null );
 361 
 362 	if( null === $t_project_id ) {
 363 		$t_bottom = current_user_get_pref( 'default_project' );
 364 		$t_parent = $t_bottom;
 365 		$t_project_id = array(
 366 			$t_bottom,
 367 		);
 368 
 369 		while( true ) {
 370 			$t_parent = project_hierarchy_get_parent( $t_parent );
 371 			if( 0 == $t_parent ) {
 372 				break;
 373 			}
 374 			array_unshift( $t_project_id, $t_parent );
 375 		}
 376 
 377 	} else {
 378 		$t_project_id = explode( ';', $t_project_id );
 379 		$t_bottom = $t_project_id[count( $t_project_id ) - 1];
 380 	}
 381 
 382 	if( !project_exists( $t_bottom ) || ( 0 == project_get_field( $t_bottom, 'enabled' ) ) || !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'view_bug_threshold', null, null, $t_bottom ), $t_bottom ) ) {
 383 		$t_project_id = array(
 384 			ALL_PROJECTS,
 385 		);
 386 	}
 387 
 388 	return $t_project_id;
 389 }

 418  * Check whether the user has confirmed this action.
 419  *
 420  * If the user has not confirmed the action, generate a page which asks the user to confirm and
 421  * then submits a form back to the current page with all the GET and POST data and an additional
 422  * field called _confirmed to indicate that confirmation has been done.
 423  * @param string $p_message      Confirmation message to display to the end user.
 424  * @param string $p_button_label Button label to display to the end user.
 425  * @return boolean
 426  */
 427 function helper_ensure_confirmed( $p_message, $p_button_label ) {
 428 	if( true == gpc_get_bool( '_confirmed' ) ) {
 429 		return true;
 430 	}
 431 
 432 	layout_page_header();
 433 	layout_page_begin();
 434 
 435 	echo '<div class="col-md-12 col-xs-12">';
 436 	echo '<div class="space-10"></div>';
 437 	echo '<div class="alert alert-warning center">';
 438 	echo '<p class="bigger-110">';
 439 	echo "\n" . $p_message . "\n";
 440 	echo '</p>';
 441 	echo '<div class="space-10"></div>';
 442 
 443 	echo '<form method="post" class="center" action="">' . "\n";
 444 	# CSRF protection not required here - user needs to confirm action
 445 	# before the form is accepted.
 446 	print_hidden_inputs( $_POST );
 447 	print_hidden_inputs( $_GET );
 448 
 449 	echo '<input type="hidden" name="_confirmed" value="1" />' , "\n";
 450 	echo '<input type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-white btn-round" value="' . $p_button_label . '" />';
 451 	echo "\n</form>\n";
 452 
 453 	echo '<div class="space-10"></div>';
 454 	echo '</div></div>';
 455 
 456 	layout_page_end();
 457 	exit;
 458 }

 460 /**
 461  * Call custom function.
 462  *
 463  * $p_function - Name of function to call (eg: do_stuff).  The function will call custom_function_override_do_stuff()
 464  *		if found, otherwise, will call custom_function_default_do_stuff().
 465  * $p_args_array - Parameters to function as an array
 466  * @param string $p_function   Custom function name.
 467  * @param array  $p_args_array An array of arguments to pass to the custom function.
 468  * @return mixed
 469  */
 470 function helper_call_custom_function( $p_function, array $p_args_array ) {
 471 	$t_function = 'custom_function_override_' . $p_function;
 472 
 473 	if( !function_exists( $t_function ) ) {
 474 		$t_function = 'custom_function_default_' . $p_function;
 475 	}
 476 
 477 	return call_user_func_array( $t_function, $p_args_array );
 478 }

 480 /**
 481  * return string to use in db queries containing projects of given user
 482  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 483  * @param integer $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 484  * @return string
 485  */
 486 function helper_project_specific_where( $p_project_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
 487 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
 488 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 489 	}
 490 
 491 	$t_project_ids = user_get_all_accessible_projects( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
 492 
 493 	if( 0 == count( $t_project_ids ) ) {
 494 		$t_project_filter = ' 1<>1';
 495 	} else if( 1 == count( $t_project_ids ) ) {
 496 		$t_project_filter = ' project_id=' . reset( $t_project_ids );
 497 	} else {
 498 		$t_project_filter = ' project_id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_project_ids ) . ')';
 499 	}
 500 
 501 	return $t_project_filter;
 502 }

 504 /**
 505  * Get array of columns for given target
 506  * @param integer $p_columns_target Target view for the columns.
 507  * @param boolean $p_viewable_only  Whether to return viewable columns only.
 508  * @param integer $p_user_id        A valid user identifier.
 509  * @return array
 510  */
 511 function helper_get_columns_to_view( $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE, $p_viewable_only = true, $p_user_id = null ) {
 512 	$t_columns = helper_call_custom_function( 'get_columns_to_view', array( $p_columns_target, $p_user_id ) );
 513 
 514 	# Fix column names for custom field columns that may be stored as lowercase in configuration. See issue #17367
 515 	# If the system was working fine with lowercase names, then database is case-insensitive, eg: mysql
 516 	# Fix by forcing a search with current name to get the id, then get the actual name by looking up this id
 517 	foreach( $t_columns as &$t_column_name ) {
 518 		$t_cf_name = column_get_custom_field_name( $t_column_name );
 519 		if( $t_cf_name ) {
 520 			$t_cf_id = custom_field_get_id_from_name( $t_cf_name );
 521 			$t_column_name = column_get_custom_field_column_name( $t_cf_id );
 522 		}
 523 	}
 524 
 525 	if( !$p_viewable_only ) {
 526 		return $t_columns;
 527 	}
 528 
 529 	$t_keys_to_remove = array();
 530 
 531 	if( $p_columns_target == COLUMNS_TARGET_CSV_PAGE || $p_columns_target == COLUMNS_TARGET_EXCEL_PAGE ) {
 532 		$t_keys_to_remove[] = 'selection';
 533 		$t_keys_to_remove[] = 'edit';
 534 		$t_keys_to_remove[] = 'overdue';
 535 	}
 536 
 537 	$t_current_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 538 
 539 	if( $t_current_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS && !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'view_handler_threshold' ), $t_current_project_id ) ) {
 540 		$t_keys_to_remove[] = 'handler_id';
 541 	}
 542 
 543 	if( $t_current_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS && !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'roadmap_view_threshold' ), $t_current_project_id ) ) {
 544 		$t_keys_to_remove[] = 'target_version';
 545 	}
 546 
 547 	foreach( $t_keys_to_remove as $t_key_to_remove ) {
 548 		$t_keys = array_keys( $t_columns, $t_key_to_remove );
 549 
 550 		foreach( $t_keys as $t_key ) {
 551 			unset( $t_columns[$t_key] );
 552 		}
 553 	}
 554 
 555 	# get the array values to remove gaps in the array which causes issue
 556 	# if the array is accessed using an index.
 557 	return array_values( $t_columns );
 558 }

 612  * @param string $p_url A relative URL to a page within Mantis.
 613  * @return string

 620 	# Return URL as-is if it already starts with short path

 648 /**
 649  * convert a duration string in "[h]h:mm" to an integer (minutes)
 650  * @param string $p_hhmm A string in [h]h:mm format to convert.
 651  * @param string $p_field The field name.
 652  * @return integer
 653  */
 654 function helper_duration_to_minutes( $p_hhmm, $p_field = 'hhmm' ) {
 655 	if( is_blank( $p_hhmm ) ) {
 656 		return 0;
 657 	}
 658 
 659 	$t_a = explode( ':', $p_hhmm );
 660 	$t_min = 0;
 661 
 662 	# time can be composed of max 3 parts (hh:mm:ss)
 663 	if( count( $t_a ) > 3 ) {
 664 		throw new ClientException(
 665 			sprintf( "Invalid value '%s' for field '%s'.", $p_hhmm, $p_field ),
 666 			ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 667 			array( $p_field )
 668 		);
 669 	}
 670 
 671 	$t_count = count( $t_a );
 672 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_count;$i++ ) {
 673 		# all time parts should be integers and non-negative.
 674 		if( !is_numeric( $t_a[$i] ) || ( (int)$t_a[$i] < 0 ) ) {
 675 			throw new ClientException(
 676 				sprintf( "Invalid value '%s' for field '%s'.", $p_hhmm, $p_field ),
 677 				ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 678 				array( $p_field )
 679 			);
 680 		}
 681 
 682 		# minutes and seconds are not allowed to exceed 59.
 683 		if( ( $i > 0 ) && ( $t_a[$i] > 59 ) ) {
 684 			throw new ClientException(
 685 				sprintf( "Invalid value '%s' for field '%s'.", $p_hhmm, $p_field ),
 686 				ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 687 				array( $p_field )
 688 			);
 689 		}
 690 	}
 691 
 692 	switch( $t_count ) {
 693 		case 1:
 694 			$t_min = (int)$t_a[0];
 695 			break;
 696 		case 2:
 697 			$t_min = (int)$t_a[0] * 60 + (int)$t_a[1];
 698 			break;
 699 		case 3:
 700 			# if seconds included, approximate it to minutes
 701 			$t_min = (int)$t_a[0] * 60 + (int)$t_a[1];
 702 
 703 			if( (int)$t_a[2] >= 30 ) {
 704 				$t_min++;
 705 			}
 706 			break;
 707 	}
 708 
 709 	return (int)$t_min;
 710 }

 721 /**
 722  * Filter a set of strings by finding strings that start with a case-insensitive prefix.
 723  * @param array  $p_set    An array of strings to search through.
 724  * @param string $p_prefix The prefix to filter by.
 725  * @return array An array of strings which match the supplied prefix.
 726  */
 727 function helper_filter_by_prefix( array $p_set, $p_prefix ) {
 728 	$t_matches = array();
 729 	foreach ( $p_set as $p_item ) {
 730 		if( mb_strtolower( mb_substr( $p_item, 0, mb_strlen( $p_prefix ) ) ) === mb_strtolower( $p_prefix ) ) {
 731 			$t_matches[] = $p_item;
 732 		}
 733 	}
 734 	return $t_matches;
 735 }

 737 /**
 738  * Combine a URL with a query string or an array of query parameters.
 739  *
 740  * @param string       $p_page         The page (relative or full).
 741  * @param string|array $p_query_string The query string or array of query parameters.
 742  * @return string The combined url.
 743  */
 744 function helper_url_combine( string $p_page, $p_query_string ): string {
 745 	$t_url = $p_page;
 746 	$t_query_string = is_array( $p_query_string )
 747 		? string_build_query( $p_query_string )
 748 		: $p_query_string;
 749 
 750 	if( !is_blank( $t_query_string ) ) {
 751 		$t_url = rtrim( $t_url, '?' );
 752 		if( stripos( $t_url, '?' ) !== false ) {
 753 			$t_url .= '&' . $t_query_string;
 754 		} else {
 755 			$t_url .= '?' . $t_query_string;
 756 		}
 757 	}
 758 
 759 	return $t_url;
 760 }

 762 /**
 763  * Generate a hash to be used with dynamically generated content that is expected
 764  * to be cached by the browser. This hash can be used to differentiate the generated
 765  * content when it may be different based on some runtime attributes like: current user,
 766  * project or language.
 767  * An optional custom string can be provided to be added to the hash, for additional
 768  * differentiating criteria, but this string must be already prepared by the caller.
 769  *
 770  * @param array $p_runtime_attrs    Array of attributes to be calculated from current session.
 771  *                                  possible values: 'user', 'project', 'lang'
 772  * @param string $p_custom_string   Additional string provided by the caller
 773  * @return string                   A hashed md5 string
 774  */
 775 function helper_generate_cache_key( array $p_runtime_attrs = [], $p_custom_string = '' ) {
 776 	# always add core version, to force reload of resources after an upgrade.
 777 	$t_key = $p_custom_string . '+V' . MANTIS_VERSION;
 778 	$t_user_auth = auth_is_user_authenticated();
 779 	foreach( $p_runtime_attrs as $t_attr ) {
 780 		switch( $t_attr ) {
 781 			case 'user':
 782 				$t_key .= '+U' . ( $t_user_auth ? auth_get_current_user_id() : META_FILTER_NONE );
 783 				break;
 784 			case 'project':
 785 				$t_key .= '+P' . ( $t_user_auth ? helper_get_current_project() : META_FILTER_NONE );
 786 				break;
 787 			case 'lang':
 788 				$t_key .= '+L' . lang_get_current();
 789 				break;
 790 			default:
 791 				trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 792 		}
 793 	}
 794 	return md5( $t_key );
 795 }

 797 /**
 798  * Parse view state from provided array.
 799  *
 800  * @param array $p_view_state The view state array (typically would have an id, name or both).
 801  * @return integer view state id
 802  * @throws ClientException if view state is invalid or array is empty.
 803  */
 804 function helper_parse_view_state( $p_view_state ) {
 805 	if( ! is_array( $p_view_state ) ) {
 806 		throw new ClientException(
 807 			"Invalid view state",
 808 			ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 809 			array( lang_get( 'bugnote_view_state' ) )
 810 		);
 811 	}
 812 
 813 	$t_view_state_enum = config_get( 'view_state_enum_string' );
 814 
 815 	$t_view_state_id = VS_PUBLIC;
 816 	if( isset( $p_view_state['id'] ) ) {
 817 		$t_enum_by_ids = MantisEnum::getAssocArrayIndexedByValues( $t_view_state_enum );
 818 		$t_view_state_id = (int)$p_view_state['id'];
 819 		if( !isset( $t_enum_by_ids[$t_view_state_id] ) ) {
 820 			throw new ClientException(
 821 				sprintf( "Invalid view state id '%d'.", $t_view_state_id ),
 822 				ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 823 				array( lang_get( 'bugnote_view_state' ) )
 824 			);
 825 		}
 826 	} else if( isset( $p_view_state['name' ] ) ) {
 827 		$t_enum_by_labels = MantisEnum::getAssocArrayIndexedByLabels( $t_view_state_enum );
 828 		$t_name = $p_view_state['name'];
 829 		if( !isset( $t_enum_by_labels[$t_name] ) ) {
 830 			throw new ClientException(
 831 				sprintf( "Invalid view state id '%d'.", $t_view_state_id ),
 832 				ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 833 				array( lang_get( 'bugnote_view_state' ) )
 834 			);
 835 		}
 836 
 837 		$t_view_state_id = $t_enum_by_labels[$t_name];
 838 	} else {
 839 		throw new ClientException(
 840 			"Empty view state",
 841 			ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD,
 842 			array( lang_get( 'bugnote_view_state' ) )
 843 		);
 844 	}
 845 
 846 	return $t_view_state_id;
 847 }

 849 /**
 850  * Parse numeric positive id.
 851  *
 852  * @param string $p_id The id to parse.
 853  * @param string $p_field_name The field name.
 854  * @return integer The parsed id.
 855  * @throws ClientException Id is not specified or invalid.
 856  */
 857 function helper_parse_id( $p_id, $p_field_name ) {
 858 	$t_id = trim( $p_id );
 859 	if( !is_numeric( $t_id ) ) {
 860 		if( empty( $t_id ) ) {
 861 			throw new ClientException( "'$p_field_name' missing", ERROR_GPC_VAR_NOT_FOUND, array( $p_field_name ) );
 862 		}
 863 
 864 		throw new ClientException( "'$p_field_name' must be numeric", ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE, array( $p_field_name ) );
 865 	}
 866 
 867 	$t_id = (int)$t_id;
 868 	if( $t_id < 1 ) {
 869 		throw new ClientException( "'$p_field_name' must be >= 1", ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE, array( $p_field_name ) );
 870 	}
 871 
 872 	return $t_id;
 873 }

 887 /**
 888  * Return a link's attributes based on Mantis Config.
 889  *
 890  * Depending on $p_return_array parameter, return value will either be
 891  * - an associative array with attribute => value pairs
 892  *   e.g. ['rel'=>'noopener', target=>'_blank'], or
 893  * - a string ready to be added to an html <a> tag,
 894  *   e.g. ' rel="noopener" target="_blank"'
 895  *
 896  * @param bool $p_return_array true to return an array (default), false for string
 897  * @return array|string
 898  *
 899  * @see $g_html_make_links
 900  */
 901 function helper_get_link_attributes( $p_return_array = true, $p_is_external_link = false ) {
 902 	$t_html_make_links = config_get( 'html_make_links' );
 903 
 904 	$t_attributes = array();
 905 	if( $t_html_make_links ) {
 906 		# Link target
 907 		if( $t_html_make_links & LINKS_NEW_WINDOW ) {
 908 			$t_attributes['target'] = '_blank';
 909 		}
 910 
 911 		# Link relation type
 912 		if( $t_html_make_links & ( LINKS_NOOPENER | LINKS_NOREFERRER ) ) {
 913 			if( $t_html_make_links & LINKS_NOREFERRER ) {
 914 				$t_attributes['rel'] = 'noreferrer';
 915 				# noreferrer implies noopener, so no need to set the latter
 916 			}
 917 			elseif( $t_html_make_links & LINKS_NOOPENER ) {
 918 				$t_attributes['rel'] = 'noopener';
 919 			}
 920 		}
 921 		if( $p_is_external_link && ( $t_html_make_links & LINKS_NOFOLLOW_EXTERNAL ) ) {
 922 			if( isset( $t_attributes['rel'] ) ) {
 923 				$t_attributes['rel'] .= ',nofollow';
 924 			}
 925 			else {
 926 				$t_attributes['rel'] = 'nofollow';
 927 			}
 928 		}
 929 	}
 930 	if( $p_return_array ) {
 931 		return $t_attributes;
 932 	}
 933 
 934 	$t_string = '';
 935 	foreach( $t_attributes as $t_attr => $t_value ) {
 936 		$t_string .= " $t_attr=\"$t_value\"";
 937 	}
 938 	return $t_string;
 939 }

 972 /**
 973  * Returns the root domain plus TLD from a URL.
 974  *
 975  * Also handles ccTLDs.
 976  *
 977  * @param string $p_url The URL to parse.
 978  *
 979  * @return string domain.tld or domain.cctld.tld or IP address.
 980  */
 981 function helper_get_root_domain( $p_url ) {
 982 	$t_host = parse_url( $p_url, PHP_URL_HOST );
 983 	if( !$t_host ) {
 984 		return '';
 985 	}
 986 	if ( filter_var( $t_host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP ) ) {
 987 		return $t_host; // Return IP address as is
 988 	}
 989 	$t_parts = explode( '.', $t_host );
 990 	$t_numParts = count( $t_parts );
 991 	if ( $t_numParts >= 2 ) {
 992 		$t_domain = $t_parts[ $t_numParts - 2 ] . '.' . $t_parts[ $t_numParts - 1 ];
 993 		if ( strlen( $t_parts[ $t_numParts - 1 ] ) == 2 && $t_numParts > 2 ) {
 994 			$t_domain = $t_parts[ $t_numParts - 3 ] . '.' . $t_domain; // Handle ccTLDs
 995 		}
 996 		return $t_domain;
 997 	}
 998 	return $t_host; // Return host if nothing matches
 999 }

  65 /**
  66  * log the changes (old / new value are supplied to reduce db access)
  67  * events should be logged *after* the modification
  68  * @param integer $p_bug_id     The bug identifier of the bug being modified.
  69  * @param string  $p_field_name The field name of the field being modified.
  70  * @param string  $p_old_value  The old value of the field.
  71  * @param string  $p_new_value  The new value of the field.
  72  * @param integer $p_user_id    The user identifier of the user modifying the bug.
  73  * @param integer $p_type       The type of the modification.
  74  * @return void
  75  */
  76 function history_log_event_direct( $p_bug_id, $p_field_name, $p_old_value, $p_new_value, $p_user_id = null, $p_type = 0 ) {
  77 	# Only log events that change the value
  78 	if( $p_new_value != $p_old_value ) {
  79 		if( null === $p_user_id ) {
  80 			$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
  81 		}
  82 
  83 		$c_field_name = $p_field_name;
  84 
  85 		if( is_null( $p_old_value ) ) {
  86 			$c_old_value = '';
  87 		} else {
  88 			$c_old_value = string_truncate( $p_old_value, DB_FIELD_SIZE_HISTORY_VALUE, '…' );
  89 		}
  90 		if( is_null( $p_new_value ) ) {
  91 			$c_new_value = '';
  92 		} else {
  93 			$c_new_value = string_truncate( $p_new_value, DB_FIELD_SIZE_HISTORY_VALUE, '…' );
  94 		}
  95 
  96 		db_param_push();
  97 		$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_history}
  98 						( user_id, bug_id, date_modified, field_name, old_value, new_value, type )
  99 					VALUES
 100 						( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
 101 		db_query( $t_query, array( $p_user_id, $p_bug_id, db_now(), $c_field_name, $c_old_value, $c_new_value, $p_type ) );
 102 	}
 103 }

 150 /**
 151  * Retrieves the history events for the specified bug id and returns it in an array
 152  * The array is indexed from 0 to N-1.  The second dimension is: 'date', 'username',
 153  * 'note', 'change'.
 154  * @param integer $p_bug_id  A valid bug identifier.
 155  * @param integer $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
 156  * @return array
 157  */
 158 function history_get_events_array( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
 159 	$t_normal_date_format = config_get( 'normal_date_format' );
 160 
 161 	$t_raw_history = history_get_raw_events_array( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id );
 162 	$t_history = array();
 163 
 164 	foreach( $t_raw_history as $k => $t_item ) {
 165 		/**
 166 		 * @var int $v_userid
 167 		 * @var string $v_username
 168 		 * @var string $v_field
 169 		 * @var string $v_old_value
 170 		 * @var string $v_new_value
 171 		 * @var int $v_type
 172 		 * @var int $v_date
 173 		 */
 174 		extract( $t_item, EXTR_PREFIX_ALL, 'v' );
 175 		$t_history[$k] = history_localize_item( $p_bug_id, $v_field, $v_type, $v_old_value, $v_new_value );
 176 		$t_history[$k]['date'] = date( $t_normal_date_format, $v_date );
 177 		$t_history[$k]['userid'] = $v_userid;
 178 		$t_history[$k]['username'] = $v_username;
 179 	}
 180 
 181 	return( $t_history );
 182 }

 184 /**
 185  * Counts the number of changes done by the specified user within specified time window.
 186  * @param  integer $p_duration_in_seconds The time window in seconds.
 187  * @param  [type]  $p_user_id             The user id or null for logged in user.
 188  * @return integer The number of changes done by user in the specified time window.
 189  */
 190 function history_count_user_recent_events( $p_duration_in_seconds, $p_user_id = null ) {
 191 	$t_user_id = ( ( null === $p_user_id ) ? auth_get_current_user_id() : $p_user_id );
 192 
 193 	$t_params = array( db_now() - $p_duration_in_seconds, $t_user_id );
 194 
 195 	db_param_push();
 196 	$t_query = 'SELECT count(*) as event_count FROM {bug_history} WHERE date_modified > ' . db_param() .
 197 				' AND user_id = ' . db_param();
 198 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 199 
 200 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 201 	return $t_row['event_count'];
 202 }

 204 /**
 205  * Creates and executes a query for the history rows, returning a database result object.
 206  * Query options is an array with parameters to build the query.
 207  *
 208  * Supported options are:
 209  * - "bug_id" => integer | array    Limit search to these bug ids.
 210  * - "start_time" => integer        Timestamp for start time to filter by (inclusive)
 211  * - "end_time" => integer          Timestamp for end time to filter by (exclusive)
 212  * - "user_id" => integer | array   Limit search to actions by these user ids.
 213  * - "filter" => filter array       A filter array to limit history to bugs matched by this filter.
 214  * - "order" => Sort order          'ASC' or 'DESC' for result order.
 215  *
 216  * Any option can be omitted.
 217  *
 218  * @param array $p_query_options	Array of query options
 219  * @return IteratorAggregate|boolean database result to pass into history_get_event_from_row().
 220  */
 221 function history_query_result( array $p_query_options ) {
 222 	# check query order by
 223 	if( isset( $p_query_options['order'] ) ) {
 224 		$t_history_order = $p_query_options['order'];
 225 	} else {
 226 		$t_history_order = config_get( 'history_order' );
 227 	}
 228 
 229 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 230 	$t_where = array();
 231 
 232 	# With bug filter
 233 	if( isset( $p_query_options['filter'] ) ) {
 234 		$t_subquery = new BugFilterQuery( $p_query_options['filter'], BugFilterQuery::QUERY_TYPE_IDS );
 235 		$t_where[] = '{bug_history}.bug_id IN ' . $t_query->param( $t_subquery );
 236 	}
 237 
 238 	# Start time
 239 	if( isset( $p_query_options['start_time'] ) ) {
 240 		$t_where[] = '{bug_history}.date_modified >= ' . $t_query->param( (int)$p_query_options['start_time'] );
 241 	}
 242 
 243 	# End time
 244 	if( isset( $p_query_options['end_time'] ) ) {
 245 		$t_where[] = '{bug_history}.date_modified < ' . $t_query->param( (int)$p_query_options['end_time'] );
 246 	}
 247 
 248 	# Bug ids
 249 	if( isset( $p_query_options['bug_id'] ) ) {
 250 		$c_ids = array();
 251 		if( is_array( $p_query_options['bug_id'] ) ) {
 252 			foreach( $p_query_options['bug_id'] as $t_id ) {
 253 				$c_ids[] = (int)$t_id;
 254 			}
 255 		} else {
 256 			$c_ids[] = (int)$p_query_options['bug_id'];
 257 		}
 258 		$t_where[] = $t_query->sql_in( '{bug_history}.bug_id', $c_ids );
 259 	}
 260 
 261 	# User ids
 262 	if( isset( $p_query_options['user_id'] ) ) {
 263 		$c_ids = array();
 264 		if( is_array( $p_query_options['user_id'] ) ) {
 265 			foreach( $p_query_options['user_id'] as $t_id ) {
 266 				$c_ids[] = (int)$t_id;
 267 			}
 268 		} else {
 269 			$c_ids[] = (int)$p_query_options['user_id'];
 270 		}
 271 		$t_where[] = $t_query->sql_in( '{bug_history}.user_id', $c_ids );
 272 	}
 273 
 274 	$t_query->append_sql( 'SELECT * FROM {bug_history}' );
 275 	if ( count( $t_where ) > 0 ) {
 276 		$t_query->append_sql( ' WHERE ' . implode( ' AND ', $t_where ) );
 277 	}
 278 
 279 	# Order history lines by date. Use the storing sequence as 2nd order field for lines with the same date.
 280 	$t_query->append_sql( ' ORDER BY {bug_history}.date_modified ' . $t_history_order . ', {bug_history}.id ' . $t_history_order );
 281 
 282 	return $t_query->execute();
 283 }

 285 /**
 286  * Creates and executes a query for the history rows related to bugs matched by the provided filter
 287  * @param  array $p_filter           Filter array
 288  * @param  integer $p_start_time     The start time to filter by, or null for all.
 289  * @param  integer $p_end_time       The end time to filter by, or null for all.

 294 function history_get_range_result_filter( $p_filter, $p_start_time = null, $p_end_time = null, $p_history_order = null ) {
 295 	error_parameters( __FUNCTION__ . '()', 'history_query_result()' );
 296 	trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
 297 
 298 	$t_query_options = array();
 299 	if ( $p_history_order !== null ) {
 300 		$t_query_options['order'] = $p_history_order;
 301 	}
 302 	if ( $p_start_time !== null ) {
 303 		$t_query_options['start_time'] = $p_start_time;
 304 	}
 305 	if ( $p_end_time !== null ) {
 306 		$t_query_options['end_time'] = $p_end_time;
 307 	}
 308 	if ( $p_filter !== null ) {
 309 		$t_query_options['filter'] = $p_filter;
 310 	}
 311 	return history_query_result( $t_query_options );
 312 }

 343 /**
 344  * Gets the next accessible history event for current user and specified db result.
 345  * @param  object  $p_result      The database result.
 346  * @param  integer $p_user_id     The user id or null for logged in user.
 347  * @param  boolean $p_check_access_to_issue true: check that user has access to bugs,
 348  *                                          false otherwise.
 349  * @return array|false containing the history event or false if no more matches.
 350  */
 351 function history_get_event_from_row( $p_result, $p_user_id = null, $p_check_access_to_issue = true ) {
 352 	static $s_bug_visible = array();
 353 	static $s_own_notes = array();
 354 
 355 	$t_user_id = ( null === $p_user_id ) ? auth_get_current_user_id() : $p_user_id;
 356 
 357 	while ( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $p_result ) ) {
 358 		/**
 359 		 * @var int $v_user_id
 360 		 * @var int $v_bug_id
 361 		 * @var string $v_field_name
 362 		 * @var string $v_old_value
 363 		 * @var string $v_new_value
 364 		 * @var int $v_type
 365 		 * @var int $v_date_modified
 366 		 */
 367 		extract( $t_row, EXTR_PREFIX_ALL, 'v' );
 368 
 369 		# Ignore entries related to non-existing bugs (see #20727)
 370 		if( !bug_exists( $v_bug_id ) ) {
 371 			continue;
 372 		}
 373 
 374 		if( $p_check_access_to_issue ) {
 375 			if( !isset( $s_bug_visible[$v_bug_id] ) ) {
 376 				$s_bug_visible[$v_bug_id] = access_has_bug_level( VIEWER, $v_bug_id );
 377 			}
 378 
 379 			if( !$s_bug_visible[$v_bug_id] ) {
 380 				continue;
 381 			}
 382 		}
 383 
 384 		$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $v_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 385 
 386 		if( $v_type == NORMAL_TYPE ) {
 387 			if( !in_array( $v_field_name, columns_get_standard() ) ) {
 388 				# check that the item should be visible to the user
 389 				$t_field_id = custom_field_get_id_from_name( $v_field_name );
 390 				if( false !== $t_field_id && !custom_field_has_read_access( $t_field_id, $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 391 					continue;
 392 				}
 393 			}
 394 
 395 			if( ( $v_field_name == 'target_version' ) &&
 396 				!access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'roadmap_view_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 397 				continue;
 398 			}
 399 
 400 			if( ( $v_field_name == 'due_date' ) &&
 401 				!access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'due_date_view_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 402 				continue;
 403 			}
 404 
 405 			if( ( $v_field_name == 'handler_id' ) &&
 406 				!access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'view_handler_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 407 				continue;
 408 			}
 409 		}
 410 
 411 		# bugnotes
 412 		$t_private_bugnote_threshold = config_get( 'private_bugnote_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id );
 413 		$t_can_view_private_notes = access_has_bug_level( $t_private_bugnote_threshold, $v_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 414 		$t_is_own_note = in_array( $v_old_value, $s_own_notes ) ||  in_array( $v_new_value, $s_own_notes ) ;
 415 		# bypass if user created the note or is allowed to view private notes
 416 		if( $t_user_id != $v_user_id && !$t_can_view_private_notes && !$t_is_own_note ) {
 417 			if( $v_type == BUGNOTE_ADDED || $v_type == BUGNOTE_UPDATED || $v_type == BUGNOTE_DELETED ) {
 418 				if( !bugnote_exists( $v_old_value ) ) {
 419 					continue;
 420 				}
 421 
 422 				if( bugnote_get_field( $v_old_value, 'view_state' ) == VS_PRIVATE ) {
 423 					continue;
 424 				}
 425 			}
 426 
 427 			if( $v_type == BUGNOTE_STATE_CHANGED ) {
 428 				if( !bugnote_exists( $v_new_value ) ) {
 429 					continue;
 430 				}
 431 
 432 				if( bugnote_get_field( $v_new_value, 'view_state' ) == VS_PRIVATE ) {
 433 					continue;
 434 				}
 435 			}
 436 		} elseif( $v_type == BUGNOTE_ADDED ) {
 437 			# Keep track of the bugnotes created by the user
 438 			$s_own_notes[(int)$v_old_value] = (int)$v_old_value;
 439 		}
 440 
 441 		# tags
 442 		if( $v_type == TAG_ATTACHED || $v_type == TAG_DETACHED || $v_type == TAG_RENAMED ) {
 443 			if( !access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'tag_view_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 444 				continue;
 445 			}
 446 		}
 447 
 448 		# attachments
 449 		if( $v_type == FILE_ADDED || $v_type == FILE_DELETED ) {
 450 			if( !access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'view_attachments_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_project_id ), $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 451 				continue;
 452 			}
 453 
 454 			# Files were originally just associated with the issue, then association with specific bugnotes
 455 			# was added, so handled legacy and new way of handling attachments.
 456 			if( !empty( $v_new_value ) && (int)$v_new_value != 0 ) {
 457 				if( !bugnote_exists( $v_new_value ) ) {
 458 					continue;
 459 				}
 460 
 461 				if( !access_has_bug_level( $t_private_bugnote_threshold, $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) && ( bugnote_get_field( $v_new_value, 'view_state' ) == VS_PRIVATE ) ) {
 462 					continue;
 463 				}
 464 			}
 465 		}
 466 
 467 		# monitoring
 468 		if( $v_type == BUG_MONITOR || $v_type == BUG_UNMONITOR ) {
 469 			if( !access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'show_monitor_list_threshold' ), $v_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 470 				continue;
 471 			}
 472 		}
 473 
 474 		# relationships
 475 		if( $v_type == BUG_ADD_RELATIONSHIP || $v_type == BUG_DEL_RELATIONSHIP || $v_type == BUG_REPLACE_RELATIONSHIP ) {
 476 			$t_related_bug_id = $v_new_value;
 477 
 478 			# If bug doesn't exist, then we don't know whether to expose it or not based on the fact whether it was
 479 			# accessible to user or not.  This also simplifies client code that is accessing the history log.
 480 			if( !bug_exists( $t_related_bug_id ) || !access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'view_bug_threshold' ), $t_related_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 481 				continue;
 482 			}
 483 		}
 484 
 485 		if( $v_type == BUG_REVISION_DROPPED || $v_type == BUGNOTE_REVISION_DROPPED ) {
 486 			if( !access_can_view_bug_revisions( $v_bug_id ) ) {
 487 				continue;
 488 			}
 489 		}
 490 
 491 		$t_event = array();
 492 		$t_event['bug_id'] = $v_bug_id;
 493 		$t_event['date'] = $v_date_modified;
 494 		$t_event['userid'] = $v_user_id;
 495 		$t_event['username'] = user_get_name( $v_user_id );
 496 		$t_event['field'] = $v_field_name;
 497 		$t_event['type'] = $v_type;
 498 		$t_event['old_value'] = $v_old_value;
 499 		$t_event['new_value'] = $v_new_value;
 500 
 501 		return $t_event;
 502 	}
 503 
 504 	return false;
 505 }
 506 
 507 /**
 508  * Retrieves the raw history events for the specified bug id and returns it in an array
 509  * The array is indexed from 0 to N-1.  The second dimension is: 'date', 'userid', 'username',
 510  * 'field','type','old_value','new_value'
 511  * @param integer $p_bug_id  A valid bug identifier or null to not filter by bug.  If no bug id is specified,
 512  *                           then returned array will have a field for bug_id, otherwise it won't.
 513  * @param integer $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
 514  * @param integer $p_start_time The start time to filter by, or null for all.
 515  * @param integer $p_end_time   The end time to filter by, or null for all.
 516  * @return array
 517  */
 518 function history_get_raw_events_array( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id = null, $p_start_time = null, $p_end_time = null ) {
 519 	$t_user_id = (( null === $p_user_id ) ? auth_get_current_user_id() : $p_user_id );
 520 
 521 	$t_query_options = array(
 522 		'bug_id' => $p_bug_id,
 523 		'start_time' => $p_start_time,
 524 		'end_time' => $p_end_time
 525 		);
 526 	$t_result = history_query_result( $t_query_options );
 527 
 528 	$t_raw_history = array();
 529 
 530 	$j = 0;
 531 	while( true ) {
 532 		$t_event = history_get_event_from_row( $t_result, $t_user_id, /* check access */ true );
 533 		if ( $t_event === false ) {
 534 			break;
 535 		}
 536 
 537 		$t_raw_history[$j] = $t_event;
 538 		$j++;
 539 	}
 540 
 541 	# end for loop
 542 
 543 	return $t_raw_history;
 544 }
