 743 /**
 744  * Localizes one raw history item.
 745  *
 746  * @param int     $p_bug_id     Parent bug id
 747  * @param string  $p_field_name The field name of the field being localized.
 748  * @param integer $p_type       The type of the history entry.
 749  * @param string  $p_old_value  The old value of the field.
 750  * @param string  $p_new_value  The new value of the field.
 751  * @param boolean $p_linkify    Whether to return a string containing hyperlinks.
 752  *
 753  * @return array with two elements indexed as 'note' and 'change'
 754  */
 755 function history_localize_item( $p_bug_id, $p_field_name, $p_type, $p_old_value, $p_new_value, $p_linkify = true ) {
 756 	$t_note = '';
 757 	$t_change = '';
 758 	$t_raw = true;
 759 
 760 	if( PLUGIN_HISTORY == $p_type ) {
 761 		$t_note = lang_get_defaulted( 'plugin_' . $p_field_name, $p_field_name );
 762 		$t_change = ( isset( $p_new_value ) ? $p_old_value . ' => ' . $p_new_value : $p_old_value );
 763 
 764 		return array( 'note' => $t_note, 'change' => $t_change, 'raw' => true );
 765 	}
 766 
 767 	$t_field_localized = history_localize_field_name( $p_field_name );
 768 	switch( $p_field_name ) {
 769 		case 'status':
 770 		case 'severity':
 771 		case 'reproducibility':
 772 		case 'resolution':
 773 		case 'priority':
 774 		case 'eta':
 775 		case 'view_state':
 776 		case 'projection':
 777 			$p_old_value = get_enum_element( $p_field_name, $p_old_value );
 778 			$p_new_value = get_enum_element( $p_field_name, $p_new_value );
 779 			break;
 780 		case 'sticky':
 781 			$p_old_value = gpc_string_to_bool( $p_old_value ) ? lang_get( 'yes' ) : lang_get( 'no' );
 782 			$p_new_value = gpc_string_to_bool( $p_new_value ) ? lang_get( 'yes' ) : lang_get( 'no' );
 783 			break;
 784 		case 'project_id':
 785 			if( project_exists( $p_old_value ) ) {
 786 				$p_old_value = project_get_field( $p_old_value, 'name' );
 787 			} else {
 788 				$p_old_value = '@' . $p_old_value . '@';
 789 			}
 790 
 791 			# Note that the new value maybe an intermediately project and not the
 792 			# current one.
 793 			if( project_exists( $p_new_value ) ) {
 794 				$p_new_value = project_get_field( $p_new_value, 'name' );
 795 			} else {
 796 				$p_new_value = '@' . $p_new_value . '@';
 797 			}
 798 			break;
 799 		case 'handler_id':
 800 		case 'reporter_id':
 801 			if( 0 == $p_old_value ) {
 802 				$p_old_value = '';
 803 			} else {
 804 				$p_old_value = user_get_name( $p_old_value );
 805 			}
 806 
 807 			if( 0 == $p_new_value ) {
 808 				$p_new_value = '';
 809 			} else {
 810 				$p_new_value = user_get_name( $p_new_value );
 811 			}
 812 			break;
 813 		case 'date_submitted':
 814 		case 'last_updated':
 815 			$p_old_value = date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ), $p_old_value );
 816 			$p_new_value = date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ), $p_new_value );
 817 			break;
 818 		case 'due_date':
 819 			if( $p_old_value !== '' ) {
 820 				$p_old_value = date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ), (int)$p_old_value );
 821 			}
 822 			if( $p_new_value !== '' ) {
 823 				$p_new_value = date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ), (int)$p_new_value );
 824 			}
 825 			break;
 826 		default:
 827 			# assume it's a custom field name
 828 			$t_field_id = custom_field_get_id_from_name( $p_field_name );
 829 			if( false !== $t_field_id ) {
 830 				$t_cf_type = custom_field_type( $t_field_id );
 831 				if( '' != $p_old_value ) {
 832 					$p_old_value = string_custom_field_value_for_email( $p_old_value, $t_cf_type );
 833 				}
 834 
 835 				$p_new_value = string_custom_field_value_for_email( $p_new_value, $t_cf_type );
 836 			}
 837 	}
 838 
 839 	if( NORMAL_TYPE != $p_type ) {
 840 		switch( $p_type ) {
 841 			case NEW_BUG:
 842 				$t_note = lang_get( 'new_bug' );
 843 				break;
 844 			case BUGNOTE_ADDED:
 845 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bugnote_added' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 846 				break;
 847 			case BUGNOTE_UPDATED:
 848 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bugnote_edited' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 849 				$t_old_value = (int)$p_old_value;
 850 				$t_new_value = (int)$p_new_value;
 851 				if( $p_linkify
 852 					&& bug_revision_exists( $t_new_value )
 853 					&& access_can_view_bugnote_revisions( $t_old_value )
 854 				) {
 855 					if( bugnote_exists( $t_old_value ) ) {
 856 						$t_bug_revision_view_page_argument = 'bugnote_id=' . $t_old_value . '#r' . $t_new_value;
 857 					} else {
 858 						$t_bug_revision_view_page_argument = 'rev_id=' . $t_new_value;
 859 					}
 860 					$t_change = '<a href="bug_revision_view_page.php?' . $t_bug_revision_view_page_argument . '">' .
 861 						lang_get( 'view_revisions' ) . '</a>';
 862 					$t_raw = false;
 863 				}
 864 				break;
 865 			case BUGNOTE_DELETED:
 866 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bugnote_deleted' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 867 				break;
 868 			case DESCRIPTION_UPDATED:
 869 			case STEP_TO_REPRODUCE_UPDATED:
 870 			case ADDITIONAL_INFO_UPDATED:
 871 				switch( $p_type ) {
 872 					case DESCRIPTION_UPDATED:
 873 						$t_note = lang_get( 'description_updated' );
 874 						break;
 875 					case STEP_TO_REPRODUCE_UPDATED:
 876 						$t_note = lang_get( 'steps_to_reproduce_updated' );
 877 						break;
 878 					case ADDITIONAL_INFO_UPDATED:
 879 						$t_note = lang_get( 'additional_information_updated' );
 880 						break;
 881 				}
 882 				$t_old_value = (int)$p_old_value;
 883 				if( $p_linkify
 884 					&& bug_revision_exists( $t_old_value )
 885 					&& access_can_view_bug_revisions( $p_bug_id )
 886 				) {
 887 					$t_change = '<a href="bug_revision_view_page.php?rev_id=' . $t_old_value . '#r' . $t_old_value . '">' .
 888 						lang_get( 'view_revisions' ) . '</a>';
 889 					$t_raw = false;
 890 				}
 891 				break;
 892 			case FILE_ADDED:
 893 				$t_note = lang_get( 'file_added' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 894 				break;
 895 			case FILE_DELETED:
 896 				$t_note = lang_get( 'file_deleted' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 897 				break;
 898 			case BUGNOTE_STATE_CHANGED:
 899 				$p_old_value = get_enum_element( 'view_state', $p_old_value );
 900 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bugnote_view_state' ) . ': ' . $p_new_value . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 901 				break;
 902 			case BUG_MONITOR:
 903 				$p_old_value = user_get_name( $p_old_value );
 904 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bug_monitor' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 905 				break;
 906 			case BUG_UNMONITOR:
 907 				if( $p_old_value !== '' ) {
 908 					$p_old_value = user_get_name( $p_old_value );
 909 				}
 910 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bug_end_monitor' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 911 				break;
 912 			case BUG_DELETED:
 913 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bug_deleted' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 914 				break;
 915 			case BUG_ADD_SPONSORSHIP:
 916 				$t_note = lang_get( 'sponsorship_added' );
 917 				$t_change = user_get_name( $p_old_value ) . ': ' . sponsorship_format_amount( $p_new_value );
 918 				break;
 919 			case BUG_UPDATE_SPONSORSHIP:
 920 				$t_note = lang_get( 'sponsorship_updated' );
 921 				$t_change = user_get_name( $p_old_value ) . ': ' . sponsorship_format_amount( $p_new_value );
 922 				break;
 923 			case BUG_DELETE_SPONSORSHIP:
 924 				$t_note = lang_get( 'sponsorship_deleted' );
 925 				$t_change = user_get_name( $p_old_value ) . ': ' . sponsorship_format_amount( $p_new_value );
 926 				break;
 927 			case BUG_PAID_SPONSORSHIP:
 928 				$t_note = lang_get( 'sponsorship_paid' );
 929 				$t_change = user_get_name( $p_old_value ) . ': ' . get_enum_element( 'sponsorship', $p_new_value );
 930 				break;
 931 			case BUG_ADD_RELATIONSHIP:
 932 				$t_note = lang_get( 'relationship_added' );
 933 				$t_change = relationship_get_description_for_history( $p_old_value ) . ' ' . bug_format_id( $p_new_value );
 934 				break;
 935 			case BUG_REPLACE_RELATIONSHIP:
 936 				$t_note = lang_get( 'relationship_replaced' );
 937 				$t_change = relationship_get_description_for_history( $p_old_value ) . ' ' . bug_format_id( $p_new_value );
 938 				break;
 939 			case BUG_DEL_RELATIONSHIP:
 940 				$t_note = lang_get( 'relationship_deleted' );
 941 
 942 				# Fix for #7846: There are some cases where old value is empty, this may be due to an old bug.
 943 				if( !is_blank( $p_old_value ) && $p_old_value > 0 ) {
 944 					$t_change = relationship_get_description_for_history( $p_old_value ) . ' ' . bug_format_id( $p_new_value );
 945 				} else {
 946 					$t_change = bug_format_id( $p_new_value );
 947 				}
 948 				break;
 949 			case BUG_CLONED_TO:
 950 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bug_cloned_to' ) . ': ' . bug_format_id( $p_new_value );
 951 				break;
 952 			case BUG_CREATED_FROM:
 953 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bug_created_from' ) . ': ' . bug_format_id( $p_new_value );
 954 				break;
 955 			case TAG_ATTACHED:
 956 				$t_note = lang_get( 'tag_history_attached' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 957 				break;
 958 			case TAG_DETACHED:
 959 				$t_note = lang_get( 'tag_history_detached' ) . ': ' . $p_old_value;
 960 				break;
 961 			case TAG_RENAMED:
 962 				$t_note = lang_get( 'tag_history_renamed' );
 963 				$t_change = $p_old_value . ' => ' . $p_new_value;
 964 				break;
 965 			case BUG_REVISION_DROPPED:
 966 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bug_revision_dropped_history' ) . ': '
 967 					. bug_revision_get_type_name( $p_new_value ) . ': '
 968 					. $p_old_value;
 969 				break;
 970 			case BUGNOTE_REVISION_DROPPED:
 971 				$t_note = lang_get( 'bugnote_revision_dropped_history' ) . ': '
 972 					. $p_new_value . ': '
 973 					. $p_old_value;
 974 				break;
 975 		}
 976 	}
 977 
 978 	# output special cases
 979 	if( NORMAL_TYPE == $p_type ) {
 980 		$t_note = $t_field_localized;
 981 		$t_change = $p_old_value . ' => ' . $p_new_value;
 982 	}
 983 
 984 	# end if DEFAULT
 985 	return array( 'note' => $t_note, 'change' => $t_change, 'raw' => $t_raw );
 986 }
 987 
 988 /**
 989  * delete all history associated with a bug
 990  * @param integer $p_bug_id A valid bug identifier.
 991  * @return void
 992  */
 993 function history_delete( $p_bug_id ) {
 994 	db_param_push();
 995 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_history} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param();
 996 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_bug_id ) );
 997 }
 998 
 999 /**
1000  * Link the file added/deleted history events that match the specified bug_id and filename
1001  * with the specified bugnote id.
1002  *
1003  * @param integer $p_bug_id The bug id.
1004  * @param string $p_filename The filename dot extension (display name).
1005  * @param integer $p_bugnote_id The bugnote id.
1006  * @return void
1007  */
1008 function history_link_file_to_bugnote( $p_bug_id, $p_filename, $p_bugnote_id ) {
1009 	db_param_push();
1010 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug_history} SET new_value = ' . db_param() .
1011 		' WHERE bug_id=' . db_param() . ' AND old_value=' . db_param() .
1012 		' AND (type=' . db_param() . ' OR type=' . db_param() . ')';
1013 
1014 	db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_bugnote_id, (int)$p_bug_id, $p_filename, FILE_ADDED, FILE_DELETED ) );
1015 }

 207 /**
 208  * Print the link to include the CSS file
 209  * @return void
 210  */
 211 function html_css() {
 212 	global $g_stylesheets_included;
 213 
 214 	$t_cache_key = helper_generate_cache_key();
 215 
 216 	html_css_link( config_get_global( 'css_include_file' ), $t_cache_key );
 217 
 218 	# Add right-to-left css if needed
 219 	if( lang_get( 'directionality' ) == 'rtl' ) {
 220 		html_css_link( config_get_global( 'css_rtl_include_file' ), $t_cache_key );
 221 	}
 222 
 223 	foreach( $g_stylesheets_included as $t_stylesheet_path ) {
 224 		# status_config.php is a special css file, dynamically generated.
 225 		# Add a hash to the query string to differentiate content based on its
 226 		# relevant properties. This allows a browser to cache them separately and force
 227 		# a reload when the content may differ.
 228 		if( $t_stylesheet_path == 'status_config.php' ) {
 229 			$t_stylesheet_path = helper_url_combine(
 230 				helper_mantis_url( 'css/status_config.php' ),
 231 				[ 'cache_key' => helper_generate_cache_key( array( 'user' ) ) ]
 232 			);
 233 		}
 234 
 235 		html_css_link( $t_stylesheet_path );
 236 	}
 237 
 238 	# dropzone css
 239 	if ( config_get_global( 'cdn_enabled' ) == ON ) {
 240 		html_css_cdn_link( 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dropzone/' . DROPZONE_VERSION . '/min/dropzone.min.css' );
 241 	} else {
 242 		html_css_link( 'dropzone-' . DROPZONE_VERSION . '.min.css' );
 243 	}
 244 }

 282 /**
 283  * Print an HTML meta tag to redirect to another page
 284  * This function is optional and may be called by pages that need a redirect.
 285  * $p_time is the number of seconds to wait before redirecting.
 286  * If we have handled any errors on this page return false and don't redirect.
 287  *
 288  * @param string  $p_url      The page to redirect: has to be relative to the install path {@see $g_path}.
 289  * @param integer $p_time     Seconds to wait for before redirecting.
 290  * @param boolean $p_sanitize Apply string_sanitize_url to passed URL.
 291  * @return boolean
 292  */
 293 function html_meta_redirect( $p_url, $p_time = null, $p_sanitize = true ) {
 294 	if( ON == config_get_global( 'stop_on_errors' ) && error_handled() ) {
 295 		return false;
 296 	}
 297 
 298 	if( null === $p_time ) {
 299 		$p_time = current_user_get_pref( 'redirect_delay' );
 300 	}
 301 
 302 	$t_url = config_get_global( 'path' );
 303 	if( $p_sanitize ) {
 304 		$t_url .= string_sanitize_url( $p_url );
 305 	} else {
 306 		$t_url .= $p_url;
 307 	}
 308 
 309 	$t_url = htmlspecialchars( $t_url );
 310 
 311 	echo "\t" . '<meta http-equiv="Refresh" content="' . $p_time . '; URL=' . $t_url . '" />' . "\n";
 312 
 313 	return true;
 314 }

 453 /**
 454  * Outputs a message to confirm an operation's result.
 455  *
 456  * @param array  $p_buttons  Array of (URL, label) pairs used to generate
 457  *                           the buttons; if label is null or unspecified,
 458  *                           the default 'proceed' text will be displayed;
 459  *                           If the array is empty or not provided, no
 460  *                           buttons will be printed.
 461  * @param string $p_message  Message to display to the user. If none is
 462  *                           provided, a default message will be printed
 463  * @param int    $p_type     One of the constants CONFIRMATION_TYPE_SUCCESS,
 464  *                           CONFIRMATION_TYPE_WARNING, CONFIRMATION_TYPE_FAILURE
 465  *
 466  * @return void
 467  */
 468 function html_operation_confirmation( array $p_buttons = [], string $p_message = '', int $p_type = CONFIRMATION_TYPE_SUCCESS ): void {
 469 	switch( $p_type ) {
 470 		case CONFIRMATION_TYPE_FAILURE:
 471 			$t_alert_css = 'alert-danger';
 472 			$t_message = 'operation_failed';
 473 			break;
 474 		case CONFIRMATION_TYPE_WARNING:
 475 			$t_alert_css = 'alert-warning';
 476 			$t_message = 'operation_warnings';
 477 			break;
 478 		case CONFIRMATION_TYPE_SUCCESS:
 479 		default:
 480 			$t_alert_css = 'alert-success';
 481 			$t_message = 'operation_successful';
 482 			break;
 483 	}
 484 
 485 	echo '<div class="container-fluid">';
 486 	echo '<div class="col-md-12 col-xs-12">';
 487 	echo '<div class="space-0"></div>';
 488 	echo '<div class="alert ' . $t_alert_css . ' center">';
 489 
 490 	# Print message
 491 	if( is_blank( $p_message ) ) {
 492 		$t_message = lang_get( $t_message );
 493 	} else {
 494 		$t_message = $p_message;
 495 	}
 496 	echo '<p class="bold bigger-110">' . $t_message  . '</p>';
 497 
 498 	# Print buttons
 499 	if( !empty( $p_buttons ) ) {
 500 		echo '<br />';
 501 		echo '<div class="btn-group">';
 502 		foreach( $p_buttons as $t_button ) {
 503 			$t_url = string_sanitize_url( $t_button[0] );
 504 			$t_label = $t_button[1] ?? lang_get( 'proceed' );
 505 
 506 			print_link_button( $t_url, $t_label );
 507 		}
 508 		echo '</div>';
 509 	}
 510 
 511 	echo '</div></div></div>', PHP_EOL;
 512 }
 513 
 514 /**
 515  * Outputs an operation successful message with a single redirect link.

 517  * @param string $p_message      Message to display to the user.
 518  * @return void
 519  */
 520 function html_operation_successful( $p_redirect_url, $p_message = '' ) {
 521 	html_operation_confirmation( array( array( $p_redirect_url ) ), $p_message );
 522 }

 524 /**
 525  * Outputs a warning message with a single redirect link.
 526  * @param string $p_redirect_url The url to redirect to.
 527  * @param string $p_message      Message to display to the user.
 528  * @return void
 529  */
 530 function html_operation_warning( $p_redirect_url, $p_message = '' ) {
 531 	html_operation_confirmation(
 532 		array( array( $p_redirect_url ) ),
 533 		$p_message,

 641 /**
 642  * Print a generic menu (tabs).
 643  *
 644  * A menu item is an associative array with the following structure:
 645  *  - 'url' (string): MantisBT page name or URL the menu item points to
 646  *  - 'label' (string): Language string or Text to display on the menu item
 647  *  - 'absolute' (bool): optional, set to true if the URL is absolute; if false
 648  *    or unspecified, it will be processed by {@see helper_mantis_url()}.
 649  *
 650  * Plugins hooking $p_event are expected to provide a list of cooked HTML links
 651  * instead (i.e. `<a href="url">label</a>`).
 652  *
 653  * @param array  $p_menu_items   List of menu items.
 654  * @param string $p_current_page Current page's file name to highlight active tab.
 655  * @param string $p_event        Optional event to signal.
 656  */
 657 function print_menu( array $p_menu_items, $p_current_page = '', $p_event = null ) {
 658 	echo '<ul class="nav nav-tabs padding-18">' . "\n";
 659 
 660 	foreach( $p_menu_items as $t_item ) {
 661 		$t_url = $t_item['url'];
 662 		$t_active = $p_current_page && strpos( $t_url, $p_current_page ) !== false ? 'active' : '';
 663 
 664 		# Generate relative URL if caller didn't specify it as absolute
 665 		if( !($t_item['absolute'] ?? false) ) {
 666 			$t_url = helper_mantis_url( $t_url );
 667 		}
 668 
 669 		echo '<li class="' . $t_active .  '"><a href="'. $t_url .'">';
 670 		if( $t_item['label'] == '' ) {
 671 			print_icon( 'fa-info-circle', 'blue ace-icon' );
 672 		} else {
 673 			echo lang_get_defaulted( $t_item['label'] );
 674 		}
 675 		echo '</a></li>' . "\n";
 676 	}
 677 
 678 	# Plugins menu items - these are html hyperlinks (<a> tags)
 679 	foreach( plugin_menu_items( $p_event ) as $t_item ) {
 680 		$t_active = $p_current_page && strpos( $t_item, $p_current_page ) !== false
 681 			? 'active'
 682 			: '';
 683 		echo '<li class="' . $t_active . '">', $t_item, '</li>', "\n";
 684 	}
 685 
 686 	echo '</ul>' . "\n";
 687 }
 688 
 689 /**
 690  * Print a generic submenu (buttons group).
 691  *
 692  * @param array  $p_menu_items   List of menu items
 693  * @param string $p_current_page Current page's file name to highlight active tab
 694  * @param string $p_event        Optional event to signal,
 695  */
 696 function print_submenu( array $p_menu_items, $p_current_page = '', $p_event = null ) {
 697 	# Plugin / Event added options
 698 	$t_plugin_menu_items = plugin_menu_items( $p_event );
 699 
 700 	if( $p_menu_items || $t_plugin_menu_items ) {
 701 		echo '<div class="space-10"></div>';
 702 		echo '<div class="col-md-12 col-xs-12 center">';
 703 		echo '<div class="btn-group">', "\n";
 704 
 705 		/** @noinspection HtmlUnknownTarget */
 706 		$t_btn_template = '<a class="btn btn-sm btn-primary btn-white %s" href="%s">%s%s</a>' . "\n";
 707 
 708 		foreach( $p_menu_items as $t_item ) {
 709 			if( is_array( $t_item ) ) {
 710 				$t_active = $p_current_page && strpos( $t_item['url'], $p_current_page ) !== false
 711 					? 'active' : '';
 712 				$t_icon = array_key_exists( 'icon', $t_item )
 713 					? icon_get( $t_item['icon'] ) . '&nbsp;'
 714 					: '';
 715 
 716 				printf( $t_btn_template,
 717 					$t_active,
 718 					$t_item['url'],
 719 					$t_icon,
 720 					lang_get_defaulted( $t_item['label'] )
 721 				);
 722 			} else {
 723 				# Cooked link
 724 				echo $t_item;
 725 			}
 726 		}
 727 
 728 		# Plugins menu items - these are html hyperlinks (<a> tags)
 729 		# The plugin is responsible for setting the 'active' class as appropriate
 730 		foreach( plugin_menu_items( $p_event ) as $t_item ) {
 731 			echo $t_item;
 732 		}
 733 
 734 		echo '</div></div>', "\n";
 735 	}
 736 }

 981  * @return void
 982  */
 983 function print_admin_menu_bar( $p_page ) {
 984 	# Build array with admin menu items, add Upgrade tab if necessary
 985 	$t_menu_items['index.php'] = icon_get( 'fa-info-circle', 'blue ace-icon' );
 986 
 987 	# At the beginning of admin checks the DB is not yet loaded, so we can't
 988 	# check the schema to inform user that an upgrade is needed
 989 	if( $p_page == 'check/index.php' ) {
 990 		# Relative URL up one level to ensure valid links on Admin Checks page
 991 		$t_path = '../';
 992 	} else {
 993 		global $g_absolute_path, $g_upgrade;
 994 		require_once( $g_absolute_path . 'admin/schema.php' );
 995 		if( count( $g_upgrade ) - 1 != config_get( 'database_version', -1, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS ) ) {
 996 			$t_menu_items['install.php'] = 'Upgrade your installation';
 997 		}
 998 
 999 		$t_path = '';
1000 	}
1001 
1002 	$t_menu_items += array(
1003 		'check/index.php' => 'Check Installation',
1004 		'system_utils.php' => 'System Utilities',
1005 		'test_langs.php' => 'Test Lang',
1006 		'email_queue.php' => 'Email Queue',
1007 	);
1008 
1009 	echo '<div class="space-10"></div>' . "\n";
1010 	echo '<ul class="nav nav-tabs padding-18">' . "\n";
1011 
1012 	foreach( $t_menu_items as $t_menu_page => $t_description ) {
1013 		$t_class_active = $t_menu_page == $p_page ? ' class="active"' : '';
1014 		$t_class_green = $t_menu_page == 'install.php' ? ' class="bold green"' : '';
1015 
1016 		echo "\t<li$t_class_active>";
1017 		echo '<a href="' . $t_path . $t_menu_page . '"' . $t_class_green . '>'
1018 			. $t_description . "</a>";
1019 		echo '</li>' . "\n";
1020 	}
1021 
1022 	echo '</ul>' . "\n";
1023 }

1025 /**
1026  * Print an html button inside a form
1027  * @param string $p_action      Form Action.
1028  * @param string $p_button_text Button Text.
1029  * @param array  $p_fields      An array of hidden fields to include on the form.
1030  * @param string $p_method      Form submit method - default post.
1031  * @return void
1032  */
1033 function html_button( $p_action, $p_button_text, array $p_fields = array(), $p_method = 'post' ) {
1034 	$t_form_name = explode( '.php', $p_action, 2 );
1035 	$p_action = string_url( $p_action );
1036 	$p_button_text = string_attribute( $p_button_text );
1037 
1038 	if( strtolower( $p_method ) == 'get' ) {
1039 		$t_method = 'get';
1040 	} else {
1041 		$t_method = 'post';
1042 	}
1043 
1044 	echo '<form method="' . $t_method . '" action="' . $p_action . '" class="form-inline">' . "\n";
1045 	echo "\t" . '<fieldset>';
1046 	# Add a CSRF token only when the form is being sent via the POST method
1047 	if( $t_method == 'post' ) {
1048 		echo form_security_field( $t_form_name[0] );
1049 	}
1050 
1051 	foreach( $p_fields as $t_key => $t_val ) {
1052 		$t_key = string_attribute( $t_key );
1053 		$t_val = string_attribute( $t_val );
1054 
1055 		echo "\t\t" . '<input type="hidden" name="' . $t_key . '" value="' . $t_val . '" />' . "\n";
1056 	}
1057 
1058 	echo "\t\t" . '<input type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm btn-white btn-round" value="' . $p_button_text . '" />' . "\n";
1059 	echo "\t" . '</fieldset>';
1060 	echo '</form>' . "\n";
1061 }

1115 function html_get_status_css_class( $p_status, $p_user = null, $p_project = null ) {

1119 	);

1129 /**
1130  * Class that provides managed generation of an HTML table content, consisting of <tr> and <td> elements
1131  * which are arranged sequentially on a grid.
1132  * Items consist of "header" and "content", which are rendered to separate table cells.
1133  * An option is provided to arrange the header and content in vertical or horizontal orientation.
1134  * Vertical orientation places header on top of content, while horizontal orientation places the header
1135  * to the left of content cell.
1136  * Each item can have a different colspan, which is used to arrange the items efficiently. When the
1137  * arrangement is made, an item with higher colspan than current free space may be placed in next row,
1138  * but still fill the current row with next items if they fit. This may cause a variation in expected
1139  * order, but allows for a more compact fill for rows.
1140  */
1141 class TableGridLayout {
1142 	const ORIENTATION_VERTICAL = 0;
1143 	const ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL = 1;
1144 
1145 	protected $cols;
1146 	private $_max_colspan;
1147 
1148 	public $items = array();
1149 	public $item_orientation;
1150 
1151 	/**
1152 	 * Set this variable to add a class attribute for each <tr>
1153 	 * @var string
1154 	 */
1155 	public $tr_class = null;
1156 
1157 	/**
1158 	 * Constructor.
1159 	 * $p_orientation may be one of this class constants:
1160 	 * ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL
1161 	 * @param integer $p_cols	Number of columns for the table
1162 	 * @param integer $p_orientation	Orientation for header and content cells
1163 	 */
1164 	public function __construct( $p_cols, $p_orientation = null ) {
1165 		# sanitize values
1166 		switch( $p_orientation ) {
1167 			case self::ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL:
1168 				if( $p_cols < 2 ) {
1169 					$p_cols = 2;
1170 				}
1171 				$this->_max_colspan = $p_cols-1;
1172 				break;
1173 			case self::ORIENTATION_VERTICAL:
1174 			default:
1175 				$p_orientation = self::ORIENTATION_VERTICAL;
1176 				if( $p_cols < 1 ) {
1177 					$p_cols = 1;
1178 				}
1179 				$this->_max_colspan = $p_cols;
1180 		}
1181 
1182 		$this->cols = $p_cols;
1183 		$this->item_orientation = $p_orientation;
1184 	}
1185 
1186 	/**
1187 	 * Adds an item to the collection.
1188 	 *
1189 	 * @param TableFieldsItem $p_item An item
1190 	 */
1191 	public function add_item( TableFieldsItem $p_item ) {
1192 		if( $p_item->colspan > $this->_max_colspan ) {
1193 			$p_item->colspan = $this->_max_colspan;
1194 		}
1195 		$this->items[] = $p_item;
1196 	}
1197 
1198 	/**
1199 	 * Prints the HTMl for the generated table cells, for all items contained
1200 	 */
1201 	public function render() {
1202 		$t_rows_items = array();
1203 		$t_rows_freespace = array();
1204 		$t_used_rows = 0;
1205 
1206 		# Arrange the items in rows accounting for their actual cell space
1207 		foreach( $this->items as $t_item ) {
1208 			# Get the actual table columns needed to render the item
1209 			$t_item_cols = ( $this->item_orientation == self::ORIENTATION_VERTICAL ) ? $t_item->colspan : $t_item->colspan + 1;
1210 			# Search for a row with enough space to fit the item
1211 			$t_found = false;
1212 			for( $t_ix = 0; $t_ix < $t_used_rows; $t_ix++ ) {
1213 				if( $t_rows_freespace[$t_ix] >= $t_item_cols ) {
1214 					# Found a row with available space. Add the item here
1215 					$t_found = true;
1216 					$t_rows_freespace[$t_ix] -= $t_item_cols;
1217 					$t_rows_items[$t_ix][] = $t_item;
1218 					break;
1219 				}
1220 			}
1221 			# If no suitable row was found, create new one and add the item here
1222 			if( !$t_found ) {
1223 				$t_rows_items[] = array( $t_item );
1224 				$t_used_rows++;
1225 				$t_rows_freespace[] = $this->cols - $t_item_cols;
1226 			}
1227 		}
1228 
1229 		# Render the arranged items
1230 		if( $this->tr_class ) {
1231 			$p_tr_attr_class = ' class="' . $this->tr_class . '"';
1232 		} else {
1233 			$p_tr_attr_class = '';
1234 		}
1235 		foreach( $t_rows_items as $t_row ) {
1236 			$t_cols_left = $this->cols;
1237 			echo '<tr' . $p_tr_attr_class . '>';
1238 
1239 			switch( $this->item_orientation ) {
1240 				case self::ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL:
1241 					foreach( $t_row as $t_item ) {
1242 						$this->render_td_item_header( $t_item, 1 );
1243 						$this->render_td_item_content( $t_item, $t_item->colspan );
1244 						$t_cols_left -= ( $t_item->colspan + 1 );
1245 					}
1246 					break;
1247 
1248 				# default is vertical orientation
1249 				default:
1250 					# row for headers
1251 					foreach( $t_row as $t_item ) {
1252 						$this->render_td_item_header( $t_item, $t_item->colspan );
1253 						$t_cols_left -= $t_item->colspan;
1254 					}
1255 					if( $t_cols_left > 0 ) {
1256 						$this->render_td_empty_header( $t_cols_left );
1257 					}
1258 					echo '</tr>';
1259 					# row for contents
1260 					$t_cols_left = $this->cols;
1261 					echo '<tr' . $p_tr_attr_class . '>';
1262 					foreach( $t_row as $t_item ) {
1263 						$this->render_td_item_content( $t_item, $t_item->colspan );
1264 						$t_cols_left -= $t_item->colspan;
1265 					}
1266 			}
1267 
1268 			if( $t_cols_left > 0 ) {
1269 				$this->render_td_empty($t_cols_left);
1270 			}
1271 			echo '</tr>';
1272 		}
1273 	}
1274 
1275 	/**
1276 	 * Prints HTML code for a spacer row
1277 	 */
1278 	public function render_spacer() {
1279 		print_table_spacer( $this->cols );
1280 	}
1281 
1282 	/**
1283 	 * Prints HTML code for an empty TD cell
1284 	 * @param integer $p_colspan Colspan attribute for cell
1285 	 */
1286 	protected function render_td_empty( $p_colspan ) {
1287 		echo '<td';
1288 		if( $p_colspan > 1) {
1289 			echo ' colspan="' . $p_colspan . '"';
1290 		}
1291 		echo '>';
1292 		echo '&nbsp;';
1293 		echo '</td>';
1294 	}
1295 
1296 	/**
1297 	 * Prints HTML code for an empty TD cell, of header type
1298 	 * @param integer $p_colspan Colspan attribute for cell
1299 	 */
1300 	protected function render_td_empty_header( $p_colspan ) {
1301 		$this->render_td_empty( $p_colspan );
1302 	}
1303 
1304 	/**
1305 	 * Prints HTML code for TD cell representing the Item header
1306 	 * @abstract
1307 	 * @param TableFieldsItem $p_item Item to display
1308 	 * @param integer $p_colspan Colspan attribute for cell
1309 	 */
1310 	protected function render_td_item_header( TableFieldsItem $p_item, $p_colspan ) {
1311 		echo '<th';
1312 		if( $p_item->attr_class ) {
1313 			echo 'class="' . $p_item->attr_class . '"';
1314 		}
1315 		if( $p_colspan > 1) {
1316 			echo ' colspan="' . $p_colspan . '"';
1317 		}
1318 		if( $p_item->header_attr_id ) {
1319 			echo ' id="' . $p_item->header_attr_id . '"';
1320 		}
1321 		echo '>';
1322 		echo $p_item->header;
1323 		echo '</th>';
1324 	}
1325 
1326 	/**
1327 	 * Prints HTML code for TD cell representing the Item content
1328 	 * @abstract
1329 	 * @param TableFieldsItem $p_item Item to display
1330 	 * @param integer $p_colspan Colspan attribute for cell
1331 	 */
1332 	protected function render_td_item_content( TableFieldsItem $p_item, $p_colspan  ) {
1333 		echo '<td';
1334 		if( $p_item->attr_class ) {
1335 			echo 'class="' . $p_item->attr_class . '"';
1336 		}
1337 		if( $p_colspan > 1) {
1338 			echo ' colspan="' . $p_colspan . '"';
1339 		}
1340 		if( $p_item->content_attr_id ) {
1341 			echo ' id="' . $p_item->content_attr_id . '"';
1342 		}
1343 		echo '>';
1344 		echo $p_item->header;
1345 		echo '</td>';
1346 	}
1347 }
1348 
1349 /**
1350  * Class that represent Items to use with TableGridLayout
1351  */
1352 class TableFieldsItem {
1353 	public $header;
1354 	public $content;
1355 	public $colspan;
1356 	public $attr_class = null;
1357 	public $content_attr_id = null;
1358 	public $header_attr_id = null;
1359 
1360 	/**
1361 	 * Constructor
1362 	 * @param string $p_header		HTMl to be used in header cell
1363 	 * @param string $p_content		HTMl to be used in content cell
1364 	 * @param integer $p_colspan	Colspan for the content cell
1365 	 * @param string $p_class		Class to be added to the cells
1366 	 * @param string $p_content_id	Id attribute to use for content cell
1367 	 * @param string $p_header_id	Id attribute to use for header cell
1368 	 */
1369 	public function __construct( $p_header, $p_content, $p_colspan = 1, $p_class = null, $p_content_id = null, $p_header_id = null ) {
1370 		$this->header = $p_header;
1371 		$this->content = $p_content;
1372 		if( $p_colspan < 1 ) {
1373 			$p_colspan = 1;
1374 		}
1375 		$this->colspan = $p_colspan;
1376 		$this->attr_class = $p_class;
1377 		$this->content_attr_id = $p_content_id;
1378 		$this->header_attr_id = $p_header_id;
1379 	}
1380 }

  17 /**
  18  * HTTP API
  19  *
  20  * Provides functions to manage HTTP response headers.
  21  *
  22  * @package CoreAPI
  23  * @subpackage HTTPAPI
  24  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  25  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  26  *
  27  * @uses config_api.php
  28  * @uses string_api.php
  29  */
  30 
  31 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  32 require_api( 'string_api.php' );
  33 
  34 /**
  35  * The Content-Security-Policy settings array.  Use http_csp_add() to update it.
  36  * @var array
  37  */
  38 $g_csp = array();
  39 
  40 /**
  41  * Check to see if the client is using Microsoft Internet Explorer so we can
  42  * enable quirks and hacky non-standards-compliant workarounds.
  43  * @return boolean True if Internet Explorer is detected as the user agent
  44  */
  45 function is_browser_internet_explorer() {
  46 	$t_user_agent = isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ) ? $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] : 'none';
  47 
  48 	if( strpos( $t_user_agent, 'MSIE' ) ) {
  49 		return true;
  50 	}
  51 
  52 	return false;
  53 }
  54 
  55 /**
  56  * Checks to see if the client is using Google Chrome so we can enable quirks
  57  * and hacky non-standards-compliant workarounds.
  58  * @return boolean True if Chrome is detected as the user agent
  59  */
  60 function is_browser_chrome() {
  61 	$t_user_agent = isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ) ? $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] : 'none';
  62 
  63 	if( strpos( $t_user_agent, 'Chrome/' ) ) {
  64 		return true;
  65 	}
  66 
  67 	return false;
  68 }
  69 
  70 /**
  71  * Send a Content-Disposition header. This is more complex than it sounds
  72  * because only a few browsers properly support RFC2231. For those browsers
  73  * which are behind the times or are otherwise broken, we need to use
  74  * some hacky workarounds to get them to work 'nicely' with attachments and
  75  * inline files. See http://greenbytes.de/tech/tc2231/ for full reasoning.
  76  * @param string  $p_filename Filename.
  77  * @param boolean $p_inline   Display file inline (optional, default = treat as attachment).
  78  * @return void
  79  */
  80 function http_content_disposition_header( $p_filename, $p_inline = false ) {
  81 	if( !headers_sent() ) {
  82 		$t_encoded_filename = string_url( $p_filename );
  83 		$t_disposition = '';
  84 		if( !$p_inline ) {
  85 			$t_disposition = 'attachment;';
  86 		}
  87 		if( is_browser_internet_explorer() || is_browser_chrome() ) {
  88 			# Internet Explorer does not support RFC2231 however it does
  89 			# incorrectly decode URL encoded filenames and we can use this to
  90 			# get UTF8 filenames to work with the file download dialog. Chrome
  91 			# behaves in the same was as Internet Explorer in this respect.
  92 			# See http://greenbytes.de/tech/tc2231/#attwithfnrawpctenclong
  93 			header( 'Content-Disposition:' . $t_disposition . ' filename="' . $t_encoded_filename . '"' );
  94 		} else {
  95 			# For most other browsers, we can use this technique:
  96 			# http://greenbytes.de/tech/tc2231/#attfnboth2
  97 			header( 'Content-Disposition:' . $t_disposition . ' filename*=UTF-8\'\'' . $t_encoded_filename . '; filename="' . $t_encoded_filename . '"' );
  98 		}
  99 	}
 100 }

 102 /**
 103  * Set caching headers that will allow or prevent browser caching.
 104  *
 105  * @param bool|null $p_allow_caching True to force caching, false to disable it;
 106  *                                   If null, use default behavior defined by
 107  *                                   {@see $g_allow_browser_cache}.
 108  *
 109  * @return void
 110  */
 111 function http_caching_headers( $p_allow_caching = null ) {
 112 	if( headers_sent() ) {
 113 		return;
 114 	}
 115 
 116 	if( $p_allow_caching === null ) {
 117 		$t_allow_caching = ON == config_get_global( 'allow_browser_cache' );
 118 	} else {
 119 		$t_allow_caching = $p_allow_caching;
 120 	}
 121 
 122 	if( $t_allow_caching ) {
 123 		if( is_browser_internet_explorer() ) {
 124 			header( 'Cache-Control: private, proxy-revalidate' );
 125 		} else {
 126 			header( 'Cache-Control: private, must-revalidate' );
 127 		}
 128 		# set an expire time to +10 days
 129 		header( 'Expires: ' . gmdate( 'D, d M Y H:i:s \G\M\T', time()+864000 ) );
 130 	} else {
 131 		header( 'Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' );
 132 		header( 'Expires: ' . gmdate( 'D, d M Y H:i:s \G\M\T', time() ) );
 133 		header( 'Last-Modified: ' . gmdate( 'D, d M Y H:i:s \G\M\T', time() ) );
 134 	}
 135 }
 136 
 137 /**
 138  * Set content-type headers.
 139  * @return void
 140  */
 141 function http_content_headers() {
 142 	if( !headers_sent() ) {
 143 		header( 'Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8' );
 144 		# Don't let Internet Explorer second-guess our content-type, as per
 145 		# http://blogs.msdn.com/b/ie/archive/2008/07/02/ie8-security-part-v-comprehensive-protection.aspx
 146 		header( 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' );
 147 	}
 148 }
 149 
 150 /**
 151  * Add a Content-Security-Policy directive.
 152  *
 153  * @param  string $p_type  The directive type, e.g. style-src, script-src.
 154  * @param  string $p_value The directive value, e.g. 'self', https://ajax.googleapis.com
 155  * @return void
 156  */
 157 function http_csp_add( $p_type, $p_value ) {
 158 	global $g_csp;
 159 
 160 	if ( $g_csp === null ) {
 161 		# Development error, headers already emitted.
 162 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 163 	}
 164 
 165 	if ( isset( $g_csp[$p_type] ) ) {
 166 		if ( !in_array( $p_value, $g_csp[$p_type] ) ) {
 167 			$g_csp[$p_type][] = $p_value;
 168 		}
 169 	} else {
 170 		$g_csp[$p_type] = array( $p_value );
 171 	}
 172 }
 173 
 174 /**
 175  * Constructs the value of the CSP header.
 176  * @return string CSP header value.
 177  */
 178 function http_csp_value() {
 179 	global $g_csp;
 180 
 181 	if ( $g_csp === null ) {
 182 		# Development error, headers already emitted.
 183 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 184 	}
 185 
 186 	$t_csp_value = '';
 187 
 188 	# frame-ancestors can't have 'none' together with other values.
 189 	if( isset( $g_csp['frame-ancestors'] ) ) {
 190 		$t_frame_ancestors = &$g_csp['frame-ancestors'];
 191 		if( count( $t_frame_ancestors ) > 1 ) {
 192 			$t_key_none = array_search( "'none'", $t_frame_ancestors );
 193 			unset( $t_frame_ancestors[$t_key_none] );
 194 		}
 195 	}
 196 
 197 	foreach ( $g_csp as $t_key => $t_values ) {
 198 		$t_csp_value .= $t_key . ' ' . implode( ' ', $t_values ) . '; ';
 199 	}
 200 
 201 	$t_csp_value = trim( $t_csp_value, '; ' );
 202 
 203 	return $t_csp_value;
 204 }
 205 
 206 /**
 207  * Send header for Content-Security-Policy.
 208  * @return void
 209  */
 210 function http_csp_emit_header() {
 211 	header( 'Content-Security-Policy: ' . http_csp_value() );
 212 
 213 	global $g_csp;
 214 	$g_csp = null;
 215 }
 216 
 217 /**
 218  * Set security headers (frame busting, clickjacking/XSS/CSRF protection).
 219  * @return void
 220  */
 221 function http_security_headers() {
 222 	if( !headers_sent() ) {
 223 		header( 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' );
 224 
 225 		# Define Content Security Policy
 226 		http_csp_add( 'default-src', "'self'" );
 227 		http_csp_add( 'frame-ancestors', "'none'" );
 228 		http_csp_add( 'style-src', "'self'" );
 229 		http_csp_add( 'style-src', "'unsafe-inline'" );
 230 		http_csp_add( 'script-src', "'self'" );
 231 		http_csp_add( 'img-src', "'self'" );
 232 		http_csp_add( 'img-src', "data:" );
 233 
 234 		# White list the CDN urls (if enabled)
 235 		if ( config_get_global( 'cdn_enabled' ) == ON ) {
 236 			http_csp_add( 'style-src', 'ajax.googleapis.com' );
 237 			http_csp_add( 'style-src', 'stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com' );
 238 			http_csp_add( 'style-src', 'fonts.googleapis.com' );
 239 			http_csp_add( 'style-src', 'cdnjs.cloudflare.com' );
 240 
 241 			http_csp_add( 'font-src', 'fonts.gstatic.com' );
 242 			http_csp_add( 'font-src', 'stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com' );
 243 
 244 			http_csp_add( 'script-src', 'ajax.googleapis.com' );
 245 			http_csp_add( 'script-src', 'stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com' );
 246 			http_csp_add( 'script-src', 'cdnjs.cloudflare.com' );
 247 
 248 			http_csp_add( 'img-src', 'ajax.googleapis.com' );
 249 
 250 		}
 251 
 252 		http_csp_emit_header();
 253 	}
 254 }
 255 
 256 /**
 257  * Load and set any custom headers defined by the site configuration.
 258  * @return void
 259  */
 260 function http_custom_headers() {
 261 	if( !headers_sent() ) {
 262 		# send user-defined headers
 263 		foreach( config_get_global( 'custom_headers' ) as $t_header ) {
 264 			header( $t_header );
 265 		}
 266 	}
 267 }
 268 
 269 /**
 270  * Set all headers used by a normal page load.
 271  * @return void
 272  */
 273 function http_all_headers() {
 274 	global $g_bypass_headers;
 275 
 276 	if( !$g_bypass_headers && !headers_sent() ) {
 277 		http_content_headers();
 278 		http_caching_headers();
 279 		http_security_headers();
 280 		http_custom_headers();
 281 	}
 282 }
 283 
 284 if( !function_exists( 'http_build_url' ) ) {
 285 /**
 286  * Builds an URL from its components
 287  * This is basically the reverse of parse_url(), a minimalistic implementation
 288  * of pecl_http extension's http_build_url() function.
 289  * @param array $p_url The URL components (as results from parse_url())
 290  * @return string
 291  */
 292 function http_build_url( array $p_url ) {
 293 	return
 294 		  ( isset( $p_url['scheme'] )   ? $p_url['scheme'] . '://' : '' )
 295 		. ( isset( $p_url['user'] )
 296 			? $p_url['user'] . ( isset( $p_url['pass'] ) ? ':' . $p_url['pass'] : '' ) .'@'
 297 			: ''
 298 		  )
 299 		. ( isset( $p_url['host'] )     ? $p_url['host'] : '' )
 300 		. ( isset( $p_url['port'] )     ? ':' . $p_url['port'] : '' )
 301 		. ( isset( $p_url['path'] )     ? $p_url['path'] : '' )
 302 		. ( isset( $p_url['query'] )    ? '?' . $p_url['query'] : '' )
 303 		. ( isset( $p_url['fragment'] ) ? '#' . $p_url['fragment'] : '' )
 304 	;
 305 }
 306 }

  37 /**
  38  * Returns HTML to display an icon with optional title pop-up.
  39  *
  40  * @param string $p_icon       Fontawesome icon name (fa-xxx)
  41  * @param string $p_classes    Optional additional CSS classes
  42  * @param string $p_title      Optional pop-up text
  43  * @param string $p_inner_html Optional html to insert with the icon.
  44  *
  45  * @return string
  46  */
  47 function icon_get( $p_icon, $p_classes = '', $p_title = '', $p_inner_html = '' ) {
  48 	# Add 'fa-' prefix if missing
  49 	if( substr( $p_icon, 0, 3 ) != 'fa-' ) {
  50 		$p_icon = 'fa-' . $p_icon;
  51 	}
  52 
  53 	if( $p_title ) {
  54 		$p_title = 'title="' . $p_title . '"';
  55 	}
  56 
  57 	/** @noinspection HtmlUnknownAttribute */
  58 	return sprintf( '<i class="fa %s %s" %s>%s</i>', $p_icon, $p_classes, $p_title, $p_inner_html );
  59 }
  60 
  61 /**
  62  * Prints an icon with optional title pop-up.
  63  *
  64  * @param string $p_icon    Fontawesome icon name (fa-xxx)
  65  * @param string $p_classes Optional additional CSS classes
  66  * @param string $p_title   Optional pop-up text
  67  * @param string $p_inner_html Optional html to insert with the icon.
  68  */
  69 function print_icon( $p_icon, $p_classes = '', $p_title = '', $p_inner_html = '' ) {
  70 	echo icon_get( $p_icon, $p_classes, $p_title, $p_inner_html );
  71 }

  82 	if( isset( $t_status_icon_arr[$p_icon] ) && !is_blank( $t_status_icon_arr[$p_icon] ) ) {
  83 		return icon_get( $t_status_icon_arr[$p_icon], '', $t_priotext );
  84 	} else {
  85 		return '&#160;';

  89 /**

  99 /**
 100  * The input $p_dir is either ASC or DESC
 101  * The inputs $p_sort_by and $p_field are compared to see if they match
 102  * If the fields match then the sort icon is printed
 103  * This is a convenience feature to push the comparison code into this function instead of in the
 104  * page(s)
 105  * $p_field is a constant and $p_sort_by is whatever the page happens to be sorting by at the moment
 106  * Multiple sort keys are not supported
 107  * @param integer $p_dir     Direction to sort by ( either ASC or DESC ).
 108  * @param string  $p_sort_by Field.
 109  * @param string  $p_field   Field to sort by.
 110  * @return void
 111  * @access public
 112  */
 113 function print_sort_icon( $p_dir, $p_sort_by, $p_field ) {
 114 	$t_sort_icon_arr = config_get( 'sort_icon_arr' );
 115 
 116 	if( $p_sort_by != $p_field ) {
 117 		return;
 118 	}
 119 
 120 	if( ( 'DESC' == $p_dir ) || ( DESCENDING == $p_dir ) ) {
 121 		$t_dir = DESCENDING;
 122 	} else {
 123 		$t_dir = ASCENDING;
 124 	}
 125 
 126 	echo '&#160;';
 127 	if( !is_blank( $t_sort_icon_arr[$t_dir] ) ) {
 128 		echo icon_get( $t_sort_icon_arr[$t_dir], 'fa-lg blue' );
 129 	}
 130 }

  17 /**
  18  * Install Helper Functions API
  19  *
  20  * @package CoreAPI
  21  * @subpackage InstallHelperFunctionsAPI
  22  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  23  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net

  32 require_api( 'database_api.php' );

  34 
  35 /**
  36  * Legacy pre-1.2 date function used for upgrading from datetime to integer
  37  * representation of dates in the database.
  38  * @return string Formatted date representing unixtime(0) + 1 second, ready for database insertion
  39  */
  40 function db_null_date() {
  41 	global $g_db;
  42 
  43 	return $g_db->BindTimestamp( $g_db->UserTimeStamp( 1, 'Y-m-d H:i:s', true ) );
  44 }
  45 
  46 /**
  47  * Legacy pre-1.2 date function used for upgrading from datetime to integer
  48  * representation of dates in the database. This function converts a formatted
  49  * datetime string to an that represents the number of seconds elapsed since
  50  * the Unix epoch.
  51  * @param string  $p_date Formatted datetime string from a database.
  52  * @return integer Unix timestamp representation of a datetime string
  53  */
  54 function db_unixtimestamp( $p_date = null ) {
  55 	global $g_db;
  56 
  57 	if( null !== $p_date ) {
  58 		$p_timestamp = $g_db->UnixTimeStamp( $p_date );
  59 	} else {
  60 		$p_timestamp = time();
  61 	}
  62 	return $p_timestamp;
  63 }
  64 
  65 /**
  66  * Legacy date function for installer backwards compatibility
  67  * @return string
  68  */
  69 function installer_db_now() {
  70 	global $g_db;
  71 
  72 	# Timezone must not be set to UTC prior to calling BindTimestamp(), as
  73 	# ADOdb assumes a local timestamp and does the UTC conversion itself.
  74 	return $g_db->BindTimeStamp( time() );
  75 }
  76 
  77 /**
  78  * Check PostgreSQL boolean columns' type in the DB
  79  * Verifies that columns defined as type "L" (logical) in the Mantis schema
  80  * have the correct type in the underlying database.
  81  * The ADOdb library bundled with MantisBT releases prior to 1.1.0 (schema
  82  * version 51) created type "L" columns in PostgreSQL as SMALLINT, whereas later
  83  * versions created them as BOOLEAN.
  84  * @return bool|string|array true if columns check OK
  85  *               error message string if errors occurred
  86  *               array of invalid columns otherwise (empty if all columns check OK)
  87  */
  88 function check_pgsql_bool_columns() {
  89 	global $f_db_type, $f_database_name;
  90 	global $g_db;
  91 
  92 	# Only applies to PostgreSQL
  93 	if( $f_db_type != 'pgsql' ) {
  94 		return true;
  95 	}
  96 
  97 	# Build the list of "L" type columns as of schema version 51
  98 	$t_bool_columns = array(
  99 		'bug'             => array( 'sticky' ),
 100 		'custom_field'    => array( 'advanced', 'require_report', 'require_update', 'display_report', 'display_update', 'require_resolved', 'display_resolved', 'display_closed', 'require_closed' ),
 101 		'filters'         => array( 'is_public' ),
 102 		'news'            => array( 'announcement' ),
 103 		'project'         => array( 'enabled' ),
 104 		'project_version' => array( 'released' ),
 105 		'sponsorship'     => array( 'paid' ),
 106 		'user_pref'       => array( 'advanced_report', 'advanced_view', 'advanced_update', 'email_on_new', 'email_on_assigned', 'email_on_feedback', 'email_on_resolved', 'email_on_closed', 'email_on_reopened', 'email_on_bugnote', 'email_on_status', 'email_on_priority' ),
 107 		'user'            => array( 'enabled', 'protected' ),
 108 	);
 109 
 110 	# Generate SQL to check columns against schema
 111 	$t_where = '';
 112 	foreach( $t_bool_columns as $t_table_name => $t_columns ) {
 113 		$t_table = db_get_table( $t_table_name );
 114 		$t_where .= 'table_name = \'' . $t_table . '\' AND column_name IN ( \''
 115 			. implode( "', '", $t_columns )
 116 			. '\' ) OR ';
 117 	}
 118 	$t_sql = 'SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, column_default, is_nullable
 119 		FROM information_schema.columns
 120 		WHERE
 121 			table_catalog = \'' . $f_database_name . '\' AND
 122 			data_type <> \'boolean\' AND
 123 			(' . rtrim( $t_where, ' OR' ) . ')';
 124 
 125 	$t_result = @$g_db->Execute( $t_sql );
 126 	if( $t_result === false ) {
 127 		return 'Unable to check information_schema';
 128 	} else if( $t_result->RecordCount() == 0 ) {
 129 		return array();
 130 	}
 131 
 132 	# Some columns are not BOOLEAN type, return the list
 133 	return $t_result->GetArray();
 134 }
 135 
 136 /**
 137  * Get pgsql column's data type
 138  *
 139  * @param string $p_table  Table name
 140  * @param string $p_column Column name
 141  *
 142  * @return string column data_type
 143  *
 144  * @throws Exception
 145  */
 146 function pgsql_get_column_type( $p_table, $p_column ) {
 147 	global $f_database_name;
 148 	global $g_db;
 149 
 150 	# Generate SQL to check columns against schema
 151 	$t_sql = 'SELECT data_type
 152 		FROM information_schema.columns
 153 		WHERE table_catalog = $1 
 154 		AND table_name = $2
 155 		AND column_name = $3';
 156 	$t_param = array(
 157 		$f_database_name,
 158 		db_get_table( $p_table ),
 159 		$p_column,
 160 	);
 161 
 162 	/** @var ADORecordSet|bool $t_result */
 163 	$t_result = @$g_db->execute( $t_sql, $t_param );
 164 	if( $t_result === false ) {
 165 		throw new Exception( 'Unable to check information_schema' );
 166 	} else if( $t_result->recordCount() == 0 ) {
 167 		throw new Exception( "Column '$p_column' not found in table '$p_table'" );
 168 	}
 169 
 170 	$t_rows = $t_result->getAll();
 171 	return reset( $t_rows[0] );
 172 }
 173 
 174 /**
 175  * Set the value of $g_db_log_queries as specified
 176  * This is used by install callback functions to ensure that only the relevant
 177  * queries are logged
 178  * @global integer $g_db_log_queries
 179  * @param integer $p_new_state New value to set $g_db_log_queries to (defaults to OFF).
 180  * @return bool old value of $g_db_log_queries
 181  */
 182 function install_set_log_queries( $p_new_state = OFF ) {
 183 	global $g_db_log_queries;
 184 
 185 	$t_log_queries = $g_db_log_queries;
 186 
 187 	if( $g_db_log_queries !== $p_new_state ) {
 188 		$g_db_log_queries = $p_new_state;
 189 	}
 190 
 191 	# Return the old value of $g_db_log_queries
 192 	return $t_log_queries;
 193 }

 195 /**
 196  * Migrate the legacy category data to the new category_id-based schema.
 197  * @return integer
 198  */
 199 function install_category_migrate() {
 200 	# Disable query logging even if enabled in config, due to possibility of mass spam
 201 	$t_log_queries = install_set_log_queries();
 202 
 203 	$t_data = array();
 204 
 205 	# Find categories specified by project
 206 	$t_query = new DbQuery(
 207 		'SELECT project_id, category, user_id FROM {project_category} ORDER BY project_id, category'
 208 	);
 209 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 210 		$t_project_id = $t_row['project_id'];
 211 		$t_name = $t_row['category'];
 212 		$t_data[$t_project_id][$t_name] = $t_row['user_id'];
 213 	}
 214 
 215 	# Find orphaned categories from bugs
 216 	$t_query = new DbQuery(
 217 		'SELECT project_id, category FROM {bug} ORDER BY project_id, category'
 218 	);
 219 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 220 		$t_project_id = $t_row['project_id'];
 221 		$t_name = $t_row['category'];
 222 
 223 		if( !isset( $t_data[$t_project_id][$t_name] ) ) {
 224 			$t_data[$t_project_id][$t_name] = 0;
 225 		}
 226 	}
 227 
 228 	$t_insert = new DbQuery(
 229 		'INSERT INTO {category} ( name, project_id, user_id ) VALUES ( :name, :project_id, :user_id )'
 230 	);
 231 	$t_update = new DbQuery(
 232 		'UPDATE {bug} SET category_id=:id WHERE project_id=:project_id AND category=:name'
 233 	);
 234 
 235 	# In every project, go through all the categories found, and create them and update the bug
 236 	foreach( $t_data as $t_project_id => $t_categories ) {
 237 		$t_inserted = array();
 238 		foreach( $t_categories as $t_name => $t_user_id ) {
 239 			$t_lower_name = mb_strtolower( trim( $t_name ) );
 240 			$t_category = array(
 241 				'name' => $t_name,
 242 				'project_id' => $t_project_id,
 243 				'user_id' => $t_user_id,
 244 			);
 245 			if( !isset( $t_inserted[$t_lower_name] ) ) {
 246 				$t_insert->execute( $t_category );
 247 				$t_category['id'] = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'category' ) );
 248 				$t_inserted[$t_lower_name] = $t_category['id'];
 249 			} else {
 250 				$t_category['id'] = $t_inserted[$t_lower_name];
 251 			}
 252 
 253 			$t_update->execute( $t_category );
 254 		}
 255 	}
 256 
 257 	# Re-enable query logging if we disabled it
 258 	install_set_log_queries( $t_log_queries );
 259 
 260 	# return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 261 	return 2;
 262 }
 263 
 264 /**
 265  * Migrate the legacy date format.
 266  * @param array $p_data Array: [0] = tablename, [1] id column, [2] = old column, [3] = new column.
 267  * @return integer
 268  */
 269 function install_date_migrate( array $p_data ) {
 270 	# Disable query logging even if enabled in config, due to possibility of mass spam
 271 	$t_log_queries = install_set_log_queries();
 272 
 273 	$t_table = $p_data[0];
 274 	$t_id_column = $p_data[1];
 275 	$t_date_array = is_array( $p_data[2] );
 276 
 277 	if( $t_date_array ) {
 278 		$t_old_column = implode( ',', $p_data[2] );
 279 		$t_cnt_fields = count( $p_data[2] );
 280 		$t_sql = "SELECT $t_id_column, $t_old_column FROM $t_table";
 281 		$t_first_column = true;
 282 		$t_pairs = array();
 283 
 284 		# In order to handle large databases where we may timeout during the upgrade, we don't
 285 		# start from the beginning every time.  Here we will only pickup rows where at least one
 286 		# of the datetime fields wasn't upgraded yet and upgrade them all.
 287 		foreach ( $p_data[3] as $t_new_column_name ) {
 288 			if( $t_first_column ) {
 289 				$t_first_column = false;
 290 				$t_sql .= ' WHERE ';
 291 			} else {
 292 				$t_sql .= ' OR ';
 293 			}
 294 
 295 			$t_sql .= $t_new_column_name. ' = 1';
 296 			array_push( $t_pairs, "$t_new_column_name = :$t_new_column_name" ) ;
 297 		}
 298 		$t_update_columns = implode( ',', $t_pairs );
 299 	} else {
 300 		$t_old_column = $p_data[2];
 301 
 302 		# The check for timestamp being = 1 is to make sure the field wasn't upgraded
 303 		# already in a previous run - see bug #12601 for more details.
 304 		$t_new_column_name = $p_data[3];
 305 		$t_sql = "SELECT $t_id_column, $t_old_column FROM $t_table WHERE $t_new_column_name = 1";
 306 
 307 		$t_update_columns = "$t_new_column_name = :$t_new_column_name";
 308 	}
 309 
 310 	$t_query = new DbQuery( $t_sql );
 311 	$t_update = new DbQuery(
 312 		"UPDATE $t_table SET $t_update_columns WHERE $t_id_column = :$t_id_column"
 313 	);
 314 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 315 		$t_values[$t_id_column] = (int)$t_row[$t_id_column];
 316 		if( $t_date_array ) {
 317 			for( $i = 0; $i < $t_cnt_fields; $i++ ) {
 318 				$t_old_value = $t_row[$p_data[2][$i]];
 319 
 320 				if( is_numeric( $t_old_value ) ) {
 321 					return 1; # Fatal: conversion may have already been run. If it has been run, proceeding will wipe timestamps from db
 322 				}
 323 
 324 				$t_new_column_name = $p_data[3][$i];
 325 				$t_new_value = db_unixtimestamp( $t_old_value );
 326 				if( $t_new_value < 100000 ) {
 327 					$t_new_value = 1;
 328 				}
 329 				$t_values[$t_new_column_name] = $t_new_value;
 330 			}
 331 		} else {
 332 			$t_old_value = $t_row[$t_old_column];
 333 
 334 			if( is_numeric( $t_old_value ) ) {
 335 				return 1; # Fatal: conversion may have already been run. If it has been run, proceeding will wipe timestamps from db
 336 			}
 337 
 338 			$t_new_value = db_unixtimestamp( $t_old_value );
 339 			if( $t_new_value < 100000 ) {
 340 				$t_new_value = 1;
 341 			}
 342 			/** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
 343 			$t_values[$t_new_column_name] = $t_new_value;
 344 		}
 345 
 346 		$t_update->execute( $t_values );
 347 	}
 348 
 349 	# Re-enable query logging if we disabled it
 350 	install_set_log_queries( $t_log_queries );
 351 
 352 	# return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 353 	return 2;
 354 
 355 }
 356 
 357 /**
 358  * Once upon a time multi-select custom field types (checkbox and multiselect)
 359  * were stored in the database in the format of "option1|option2|option3" where
 360  * they should have been stored in a format of "|option1|option2|option3|".
 361  * Additionally, radio custom field types were being stored in the database
 362  * with an unnecessary vertical pipe prefix and suffix when there is only ever
 363  * one possible value that can be assigned to a radio field.
 364  * @return integer
 365  */
 366 function install_correct_multiselect_custom_fields_db_format() {
 367 	# Disable query logging even if enabled in config, due to possibility of mass spam
 368 	$t_log_queries = install_set_log_queries();
 369 
 370 	$t_update_query = new DbQuery( 'UPDATE {custom_field_string}
 371 		SET value = :value
 372 		WHERE field_id = :field_id AND bug_id = :bug_id'
 373 	);
 374 
 375 	# Ensure multilist and checkbox custom field values have a vertical pipe |
 376 	# as a prefix and suffix.
 377 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT v.field_id, v.bug_id, v.value 
 378 		FROM {custom_field_string} v
 379 		LEFT JOIN {custom_field} c
 380 		ON v.field_id = c.id
 381 		WHERE (c.type = ' . CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_MULTILIST . ' OR c.type = ' . CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_CHECKBOX . ")
 382 			AND v.value != ''
 383 			AND v.value NOT LIKE '|%|'"
 384 	);
 385 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 386 		$t_param = array(
 387 			'field_id' => (int)$t_row['field_id'],
 388 			'bug_id' => (int)$t_row['bug_id'],
 389 			'value' => '|' . rtrim( ltrim( $t_row['value'], '|' ), '|' ) . '|'
 390 		);
 391 		$t_update_query->execute( $t_param );
 392 	}
 393 
 394 	# Remove vertical pipe | prefix and suffix from radio custom field values.
 395 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT v.field_id, v.bug_id, v.value 
 396 		FROM {custom_field_string} v
 397 		LEFT JOIN {custom_field} c
 398 		ON v.field_id = c.id
 399 		WHERE c.type = ' . CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_RADIO . "
 400 			AND v.value != ''
 401 			AND v.value LIKE '|%|'"
 402 	);
 403 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 404 		$t_param = array(
 405 			'field_id' => (int)$t_row['field_id'],
 406 			'bug_id' => (int)$t_row['bug_id'],
 407 			'value' => rtrim( ltrim( $t_row['value'], '|' ), '|' )
 408 		);
 409 		$t_update_query->execute( $t_param );
 410 	}
 411 
 412 	# Re-enable query logging if we disabled it
 413 	install_set_log_queries( $t_log_queries );
 414 
 415 	# Return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 416 	return 2;
 417 }

 419 /**
 420  *	The filters have been changed so the field names are the same as the database
 421  *	field names.  This updates any filters stored in the database to use the correct
 422  *	keys. The 'and_not_assigned' field is no longer used as it is replaced by the meta
 423  *	filter None.  This removes it from all filters.
 424  *
 425  * Filter Versions:
 426  * v1,2,3,4 - Legacy Filters that can not be migrated (not used since 2004)
 427  * v5 - https://github.com/mantisbt/mantisbt/commit/eb1b93057e470e40727bc75a85f436ab35b84a74
 428  * v6 - https://github.com/mantisbt/mantisbt/commit/de2e2931f993c3b6fc82781eff051f9037fdc6b5
 429  * v7 - https://github.com/mantisbt/mantisbt/commit/0450981225647544083d21576dfb2bae044b3e98
 430  * v8 - https://github.com/mantisbt/mantisbt/commit/5cb368796528bcb35aa3935bf431b08a29cb1e90
 431  * v9 - https://github.com/mantisbt/mantisbt/commit/9dfc5fb6edb6da1e0324ceac3a27a727f2b23ba7
 432  *
 433  * Filters are stored within the database as vX#FILTER, where vX is a raw version string and
 434  * FILTER is a serialized string in php serialization or json format.
 435  *
 436  * This function is used to upgrade any previous filters to the latest version, and should be
 437  * updated when bouncing filter version number. Schema.php should be updated to call do_nothing
 438  * for the existing filter schema update and the updated version of this function called in a
 439  * new schema update step
 440  *
 441  * @return integer
 442  */
 443 function install_stored_filter_migrate() {
 444 	# Disable query logging even if enabled in config, due to possibility of mass spam
 445 	$t_log_queries = install_set_log_queries();
 446 
 447 	require_api( 'filter_api.php' );
 448 
 449 	# convert filters to use the same value for the filter key and the form field
 450 	# Note: This list should only be updated for basic renames i.e. data + type of data remain the same
 451 	# before and after the rename.
 452 	$t_filter_fields['show_category'] = 'category_id';
 453 	$t_filter_fields['show_severity'] = 'severity';
 454 	$t_filter_fields['show_status'] = 'status';
 455 	$t_filter_fields['show_priority'] = 'priority';
 456 	$t_filter_fields['show_resolution'] = 'resolution';
 457 	$t_filter_fields['show_build'] = 'build';
 458 	$t_filter_fields['show_version'] = 'version';
 459 	$t_filter_fields['user_monitor'] = 'monitor_user_id';
 460 	$t_filter_fields['show_profile'] = 'profile_id';
 461 	$t_filter_fields['do_filter_by_date'] = 'filter_by_date';
 462 	$t_filter_fields['and_not_assigned'] = null;
 463 	$t_filter_fields['sticky_issues'] = 'sticky';
 464 
 465 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT * FROM {filters}' );
 466 	$t_delete = new DbQuery( 'DELETE FROM {filters} WHERE id=:id' );
 467 	$t_update = new DbQuery( 'UPDATE {filters} SET filter_string=:filter_string WHERE id=:id' );
 468 
 469 	$t_errors = array();
 470 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 471 		$t_filter_arr = null;
 472 		$t_error = false;
 473 		$t_filter_string = &$t_row['filter_string'];
 474 
 475 		# Grab Filter Version and data into $t_setting_arr
 476 		$t_setting_arr = explode( '#', $t_filter_string, 2 );
 477 
 478 		switch( $t_setting_arr[0] ) {
 479 			# Remove any non-upgradeable filters i.e. versions 1 to 4.
 480 			case 'v1':
 481 			case 'v2':
 482 			case 'v3':
 483 			case 'v4':
 484 				$t_delete->bind_values( $t_row );
 485 				$t_delete->execute();
 486 				continue 2;
 487 		}
 488 
 489 		if( isset( $t_setting_arr[1] ) ) {
 490 			switch( $t_setting_arr[0] ) {
 491 				# Filter versions 5 to 8 are stored in php serialized format
 492 				case 'v5':
 493 				case 'v6':
 494 				case 'v7':
 495 				case 'v8':
 496 					try {
 497 						$t_filter_arr = safe_unserialize( $t_setting_arr[1] );
 498 					}
 499 					catch( ErrorException $e ) {
 500 						$t_error = $e->getMessage();
 501 					}
 502 					break;
 503 				default:
 504 					$t_filter_arr = json_decode( $t_setting_arr[1], /* assoc array */ true );
 505 					if( $t_filter_arr === null ) {
 506 						$t_error = 'Invalid JSON';
 507 					}
 508 			}
 509 			# Serialized or json encoded data in filter table is invalid.
 510 			# Log the error for later processing.
 511 			if( $t_error ) {
 512 				$t_row['error'] = $t_error;
 513 				$t_errors[] = $t_row;
 514 				continue;
 515 			}
 516 		} else {
 517 			$t_delete->bind_values( $t_row );
 518 			$t_delete->execute();
 519 			continue;
 520 		}
 521 
 522 		# If the filter version does not match the latest version,
 523 		# pass it through filter_ensure_valid_filter to do any updates.
 524 		# This will set default values for filter fields
 525 		if( $t_filter_arr['_version'] != FILTER_VERSION ) {
 526 			$t_filter_arr = filter_ensure_valid_filter( $t_filter_arr );
 527 		}
 528 
 529 		# For any fields that are being renamed, we can now perform the rename and migrate existing data.
 530 		# We unset the old field when done to ensure the filter contains only current optimised data.
 531 		foreach( $t_filter_fields AS $t_old=>$t_new ) {
 532 			if( isset( $t_filter_arr[$t_old] ) ) {
 533 				$t_value = $t_filter_arr[$t_old];
 534 				unset( $t_filter_arr[$t_old] );
 535 				if( !is_null( $t_new ) ) {
 536 					$t_filter_arr[$t_new] = $t_value;
 537 				}
 538 			}
 539 		}
 540 
 541 		# We now have a valid filter in with updated version number (version is updated by filter_ensure_valid_filter)
 542 		# Check that this is the case, to before storing the updated filter values.
 543 		# Abort if the filter is invalid as this should not be possible
 544 		if( $t_filter_arr['_version'] != FILTER_VERSION ) {
 545 			$t_row['error'] = 'Invalid filter';
 546 			$t_errors[] = $t_row;
 547 			continue;
 548 		}
 549 
 550 		$t_filter_string = FILTER_VERSION . '#' . json_encode( $t_filter_arr );
 551 
 552 		$t_update->bind_values( $t_row );
 553 		$t_update->execute();
 554 	}
 555 
 556 	# Errors occurred, provide details and abort the upgrade to
 557 	# let the user investigate and fix the problem before trying again.
 558 	if( $t_errors ) {
 559 		install_print_unserialize_errors_csv( 'filters', $t_errors );
 560 		return 1; # Fatal: invalid data found in filters table
 561 	}
 562 
 563 	# Re-enable query logging if we disabled it
 564 	install_set_log_queries( $t_log_queries );
 565 
 566 	# Return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 567 	return 2;
 568 }

 570 /**
 571  * History table's field name column used to be 32 chars long (before 1.1.0a4),
 572  * while custom field names can be up to 64. This function updates history
 573  * records related to long custom fields to store the complete field name
 574  * instead of the truncated version
 575  *
 576  *
 577  * @return integer 2, because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 578  */
 579 function install_update_history_long_custom_fields() {
 580 	# Disable query logging even if enabled in config, due to possibility of mass spam
 581 	$t_log_queries = install_set_log_queries();
 582 
 583 	# Build list of custom field names longer than 32 chars for reference
 584 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT name FROM {custom_field}' );
 585 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_field ) {
 586 		if( mb_strlen( $t_field['name'] ) > 32 ) {
 587 			$t_custom_fields[mb_substr( $t_field['name'], 0, 32 )] = $t_field['name'];
 588 		}
 589 	}
 590 	if( !isset( $t_custom_fields ) ) {
 591 		# There are no custom fields longer than 32, nothing to do
 592 
 593 		# Re-enable query logging if we disabled it
 594 		install_set_log_queries( $t_log_queries );
 595 		return 2;
 596 	}
 597 
 598 	# Build list of standard fields to filter out from history
 599 	# This is as per result of columns_get_standard() at the time of this schema update
 600 	# Fields mapping: category_id is actually logged in history as 'category'
 601 	$t_standard_fields = array( 'id', 'project_id', 'reporter_id', 'handler_id', 'priority', 'severity', 'eta', 'os',
 602 								'reproducibility', 'status', 'resolution', 'projection', 'category', 'date_submitted',
 603 								'last_updated', 'os_build', 'platform', 'version', 'fixed_in_version', 'target_version',
 604 								'build', 'view_state', 'summary', 'sponsorship_total', 'due_date', 'description',
 605 								'steps_to_reproduce', 'additional_information', 'attachment_count', 'bugnotes_count',
 606 								'selection', 'edit', 'overdue' );
 607 	$t_field_list = '';
 608 	foreach( $t_standard_fields as $t_field ) {
 609 		$t_field_list .= "'$t_field', ";
 610 	}
 611 	$t_field_list = rtrim( $t_field_list, ', ' );
 612 
 613 	$t_update_query = new DbQuery(
 614 		'UPDATE {bug_history} SET field_name = :full_name WHERE field_name = :truncated'
 615 	);
 616 
 617 	# Get the list of custom fields from the history table
 618 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT DISTINCT field_name FROM {bug_history}
 619 		WHERE type = ' . NORMAL_TYPE . ' AND field_name NOT IN ( ' . $t_field_list . ' )'
 620 	);
 621 
 622 	# For each entry, update the truncated custom field name with its full name
 623 	# if a matching custom field exists
 624 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_field ) {
 625 		$t_name = $t_field['field_name'];
 626 		# If field name's length is 32, then likely it was truncated so we try to match
 627 		if( mb_strlen( $t_name ) == 32 && array_key_exists( $t_name, $t_custom_fields ) ) {
 628 			# Match found, update all history records with this field name
 629 			$t_update_query->bind( 'truncated', $t_name );
 630 			$t_update_query->bind( 'full_name', $t_custom_fields[$t_name] );
 631 			$t_update_query->execute();
 632 		}
 633 	}
 634 
 635 	# Re-enable query logging if we disabled it
 636 	install_set_log_queries( $t_log_queries );
 637 
 638 	return 2;
 639 }

 641 /**
 642  * Schema update to check that project hierarchy was valid.
 643  *
 644  * Removes possible duplicate rows in the table.
 645  *
 646  * @return integer
 647  */
 648 function install_check_project_hierarchy() {
 649 	$t_query = new DbQuery(
 650 		'SELECT count(child_id) as count, child_id, parent_id FROM {project_hierarchy} '
 651 		. 'GROUP BY child_id, parent_id'
 652 	);
 653 	$t_child_projects = new DbQuery(
 654 		'SELECT inherit_parent, child_id, parent_id FROM {project_hierarchy} '
 655 		. 'WHERE child_id=:child_id AND parent_id=:parent_id'
 656 	);
 657 	$t_delete = new DbQuery(
 658 		'DELETE FROM {project_hierarchy} WHERE child_id=:child_id AND parent_id=:parent_id'
 659 	);
 660 	$t_insert = new DbQuery(
 661 		'INSERT INTO {project_hierarchy} (child_id, parent_id, inherit_parent) '
 662 		. 'VALUES ( :child_id, :parent_id, :inherit_parent )'
 663 	);
 664 
 665 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_project ) {
 666 		$t_count = (int)$t_project['count'];
 667 
 668 		if( $t_count > 1 ) {
 669 			# get first result for inherit_parent, discard the rest
 670 			$t_child_projects->execute( $t_project );
 671 			$t_child_project = $t_child_projects->fetch();
 672 
 673 			$t_delete->execute( $t_child_project );
 674 			$t_insert->execute( $t_child_project );
 675 		}
 676 	}
 677 
 678 	# Return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 679 	return 2;
 680 }

 682 /**
 683  * Schema update to migrate config data from php serialization to json.
 684  * This ensures it is not possible to execute code during un-serialization
 685  */
 686 function install_check_config_serialization() {
 687 	$t_errors = array();
 688 
 689 	$t_update = new DbQuery(
 690 		'UPDATE {config} SET value=:value '
 691 		. 'WHERE config_id=:config_id AND project_id=:project_id AND user_id=:user_id'
 692 	);
 693 
 694 	$t_query = new DbQuery(
 695 		'SELECT config_id, project_id, user_id, value '
 696 		. 'FROM {config} WHERE type=3'
 697 	);
 698 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
 699 		$t_value = &$t_row['value'];
 700 
 701 		# Don't try to convert the value if it's already valid JSON
 702 		if( $t_value === null || json_decode( $t_value ) !== null ) {
 703 			continue;
 704 		}
 705 
 706 		try {
 707 			$t_config = safe_unserialize( $t_value );
 708 		}
 709 		catch( ErrorException $e ) {
 710 			$t_row['error'] = $e->getMessage();
 711 			$t_errors[] = $t_row;
 712 			continue;
 713 		}
 714 
 715 		$t_value = json_encode( $t_config );
 716 
 717 		$t_update->bind_values( $t_row );
 718 		$t_update->execute();
 719 	}
 720 
 721 	if( $t_errors ) {
 722 		install_print_unserialize_errors_csv( 'config', $t_errors );
 723 		return 1; # Fatal: invalid data found in config table
 724 	}
 725 
 726 	# flush config here as we've changed the format of the configuration table
 727 	config_flush_cache();
 728 
 729 	# Return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 730 	return 2;
 731 }

 739 	$t_update = new DbQuery( 'UPDATE {tokens} SET value=:value WHERE id=:id' );

 743 		$t_value = &$t_row['value'];
 744 
 745 		# Don't try to convert the value if it's already valid JSON
 746 		$t_token = json_decode( $t_value );
 747 		if( $t_value === null || $t_token !== null ) {
 748 			continue;
 749 		}
 750 
 751 		try {
 752 			$t_token = safe_unserialize( $t_value );
 753 		}
 754 		catch( ErrorException $e ) {
 755 			$t_row['error'] = $e->getMessage();
 756 			$t_errors[] = $t_row;
 757 			continue;
 758 		}
 759 
 760 		$t_value = json_encode( $t_token );
 761 
 762 		$t_update->bind_values( $t_row );
 763 		$t_update->execute();
 764 	}
 765 
 766 	if( $t_errors ) {
 767 		install_print_unserialize_errors_csv( 'tokens', $t_errors );
 768 		return 1; # Fatal: invalid data found in tokens table

 770 
 771 	# Return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly

 775 /**
 776  * Schema update to install and configure new Gravatar plugin.
 777  * If the instance has enabled use of avatars, then we register the plugin
 778  * @return int 2 if successful
 779  */
 780 function install_gravatar_plugin() {
 781 	if( config_get_global( 'show_avatar' ) ) {
 782 		$t_avatar_plugin = 'Gravatar';
 783 
 784 		# Register and install the plugin
 785 		$t_plugin = plugin_register( $t_avatar_plugin, true );
 786 		if( !is_null( $t_plugin ) ) {
 787 			plugin_install( $t_plugin );
 788 		} else {
 789 			error_parameters( $t_avatar_plugin );
 790 			echo '<br>' . error_string( ERROR_PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED );
 791 			return 1;
 792 		}
 793 	}
 794 
 795 	# Return 2 because that's what ADOdb/DataDict does when things happen properly
 796 	return 2;
 797 }

 799 /**
 800  * create an SQLArray to insert data
 801  *
 802  * @param string $p_table Table.
 803  * @param string $p_data  Data.
 804  * @return array
 805  */
 806 function InsertData( $p_table, $p_data ) {
 807 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO ' . $p_table . $p_data;
 808 	return array( $t_query );

 811 /**
 812  * Print a friendly error message and link to download errors list as CSV.
 813  *
 814  * @param string $p_table Mantis table name
 815  * @param array  $p_data  Errors list
 816  *
 817  * @return void
 818  */
 819 function install_print_unserialize_errors_csv( $p_table, $p_data ) {
 820 	# Memory file handle to generate error data as CSV for download
 821 	$f = fopen( 'php://memory', 'r+' );
 822 
 823 	# CSV file headers
 824 	$t_csv = implode( ',', array_keys( $p_data[0] ) ) . PHP_EOL;
 825 
 826 	# Generate CSV data
 827 	foreach( $p_data as $t_error ) {
 828 		fputcsv( $f, $t_error, ',', '"', '' );
 829 	}
 830 	$t_csv .= stream_get_contents( $f, -1,0 );
 831 	fclose( $f );
 832 
 833 	# Display message and download link
 834 	printf( "<p><br>%d rows in <em>%s</em> could not be converted because of invalid data.<br>",
 835 		count( $p_data ),
 836 		db_get_table( $p_table )
 837 	);
 838 	echo "Fix the problem by manually repairing or deleting the offending row(s) "
 839 		. "as appropriate, then try again.</p>";
 840 
 841 	# CSV download (as data URL)
 842 ?>
 843 	<a href="data:text/csv;charset=UTF-8,<?php echo string_url( $t_csv ) ?>"
 844 	   download="errors_<?php echo $p_table; ?>.csv"
 845 	   class="btn btn-primary btn-white btn-round"
 846 	>
 847 		Download errors list as CSV
 848 	</a>
 849 <?php
 850 }

 852 /**
 853  * Set existing categories' status to new default 1.
 854  *
 855  * Prior to 2.27.0, categories.status column was defaulted to 0. With the
 856  * implementation of #31017, status == 0 means disabled, so we need to update
 857  * all existing categories to prevent regressions.
 858  *
 859  * @return integer
 860  */
 861 function install_category_status_default() {
 862 	$t_update_query = new DbQuery(
 863 		'UPDATE {category} SET status = 1 WHERE status = 0'
 864 	);
 865 
 866 	return $t_update_query->execute() ? 2 : 1;
 867 }
