  37 require_api( 'error_api.php' );
  38 require_api( 'plugin_api.php' );
  39 require_api( 'user_pref_api.php' );
  40 
  41 # Cache of localization strings in the language specified by the last
  42 # lang_load call
  43 $g_lang_strings = array();
  44 
  45 # stack for language overrides
  46 $g_lang_overrides = array();
  47 
  48 # To be used in custom_strings_inc.php :
  49 $g_active_language = '';
  50 
  51 /**
  52  * Loads the specified language and stores it in $g_lang_strings, to be used by lang_get
  53  * @param string $p_lang Name of Language to load.
  54  * @param string $p_dir  Directory Containing language file.
  55  * @return void
  56  */
  57 function lang_load( $p_lang, $p_dir = null ) {
  58 	global $g_lang_strings, $g_active_language;
  59 
  60 	$g_active_language = $p_lang;
  61 	if( isset( $g_lang_strings[$p_lang] ) && is_null( $p_dir ) ) {
  62 		return;
  63 	}
  64 
  65 	if( !lang_language_exists( $p_lang ) ) {
  66 		return;
  67 	}
  68 
  69 	if( $p_dir === null ) {
  70 		include_once( config_get_global( 'language_path' ) . 'strings_' . $p_lang . '.txt' );
  71 	} else {
  72 		if( is_file( $p_dir . 'strings_' . $p_lang . '.txt' ) ) {
  73 			include_once( $p_dir . 'strings_' . $p_lang . '.txt' );
  74 		}
  75 	}
  76 
  77 	# Allow overriding strings declared in the language file.
  78 	# custom_strings_inc.php can use $g_active_language.
  79 	# Include file multiple times to allow for overrides per language.
  80 	global $g_config_path;
  81 
  82 	if( file_exists( $g_config_path . 'custom_strings_inc.php' ) ) {
  83 		include( $g_config_path . 'custom_strings_inc.php' );
  84 	}
  85 
  86 	$t_vars = get_defined_vars();
  87 
  88 	foreach( array_keys( $t_vars ) as $t_var ) {
  89 		if( $t_var[0] === 's' && $t_var[1] === '_' ) {
  90 			$g_lang_strings[$p_lang][substr( $t_var, 2 )] = $$t_var;
  91 		} else if( 'MANTIS_ERROR' == $t_var ) {
  92 			if( isset( $g_lang_strings[$p_lang][$t_var] ) ) {
  93 				foreach( $$t_var as $t_key => $t_val ) {
  94 					$g_lang_strings[$p_lang][$t_var][$t_key] = $t_val;
  95 				}
  96 			} else {
  97 				$g_lang_strings[$p_lang][$t_var] = $$t_var;
  98 			}
  99 		}
 100 	}
 101 }
 102 
 103 /**
 104  * Determine the preferred language
 105  * @return string
 106  */
 107 function lang_get_default() {
 108 	global $g_active_language;
 109 
 110 	$t_lang = false;
 111 
 112 	# Confirm that the user's language can be determined
 113 	if( function_exists( 'auth_is_user_authenticated' ) && auth_is_user_authenticated() ) {
 114 		$t_lang = user_pref_get_language( auth_get_current_user_id() );
 115 	}
 116 
 117 	# Otherwise fall back to default
 118 	if( !$t_lang ) {
 119 		$t_lang = config_get_global( 'default_language' );
 120 	}
 121 
 122 	if( $t_lang == 'auto' ) {
 123 		$t_lang = lang_map_auto();
 124 	}
 125 
 126 	# Remember the language
 127 	$g_active_language = $t_lang;
 128 
 129 	return $t_lang;
 130 }
 131 
 132 /**
 133  * Auto Map Language from HTTP server data
 134  * @return string
 135  */
 136 function lang_map_auto() {
 137 	$t_lang = config_get_global( 'fallback_language' );
 138 
 139 	if( isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE'] ) ) {
 140 		$t_accept_langs = explode( ',', $_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE'] );
 141 		$t_auto_map = config_get_global( 'language_auto_map' );
 142 
 143 		# Expand language map
 144 		$t_auto_map_exp = array();
 145 		foreach( $t_auto_map as $t_encs => $t_enc_lang ) {
 146 			$t_encs_arr = explode( ',', $t_encs );
 147 
 148 			foreach( $t_encs_arr as $t_enc ) {
 149 				$t_auto_map_exp[trim( $t_enc )] = $t_enc_lang;
 150 			}
 151 		}
 152 
 153 		# Find encoding
 154 		foreach( $t_accept_langs as $t_accept_lang ) {
 155 			$t_tmp = explode( ';', mb_strtolower( $t_accept_lang ) );
 156 
 157 			if( isset( $t_auto_map_exp[trim( $t_tmp[0] )] ) ) {
 158 				$t_valid_langs = config_get( 'language_choices_arr' );
 159 				$t_found_lang = $t_auto_map_exp[trim( $t_tmp[0] )];
 160 
 161 				if( in_array( $t_found_lang, $t_valid_langs, true ) ) {
 162 					$t_lang = $t_found_lang;
 163 					break;
 164 				}
 165 			}
 166 		}
 167 	}
 168 
 169 	return $t_lang;
 170 }
 171 
 172 /**
 173  * Ensures that a language file has been loaded.
 174  * Also load the currently active plugin's strings, if there is one.
 175  * @param string $p_lang The language name.
 176  * @return void
 177  */
 178 function lang_ensure_loaded( $p_lang ) {
 179 	global $g_lang_strings;
 180 
 181 	if( !isset( $g_lang_strings[$p_lang] ) ) {
 182 		lang_load( $p_lang );
 183 	}
 184 
 185 	# Load current plugin's strings
 186 	$t_plugin_current = plugin_get_current();
 187 	if( $t_plugin_current !== null ) {
 188 		lang_load( $p_lang, config_get_global( 'plugin_path' ) . $t_plugin_current . '/lang/' );
 189 	}
 190 }
 191 
 192 /**
 193 * Check if the given language exists
 194 *
 195 * @param string $p_lang The language name.
 196 * @return boolean
 197 */
 198 function lang_language_exists( $p_lang ) {
 199 	$t_valid_langs = config_get( 'language_choices_arr' );
 200 	$t_valid = in_array( $p_lang, $t_valid_langs, true );
 201 	return $t_valid;
 202 }
 203 
 204 /**
 205  * language stack implementation
 206  * push a language onto the stack
 207  * @param string $p_lang The language name.
 208  * @return void
 209  */
 210 function lang_push( $p_lang = null ) {
 211 	global $g_lang_overrides;
 212 
 213 	# If no specific language is requested, we'll
 214 	#  try to determine the language from the users
 215 	#  preferences
 216 
 217 	$t_lang = $p_lang;
 218 
 219 	if( null === $t_lang ) {
 220 		$t_lang = config_get_global( 'default_language' );
 221 	}
 222 
 223 	# don't allow 'auto' as a language to be pushed onto the stack
 224 	#  The results from auto are always the local user, not what the
 225 	#  override wants, unless this is the first language setting
 226 	if( ( 'auto' == $t_lang ) && ( 0 < count( $g_lang_overrides ) ) ) {
 227 		$t_lang = config_get_global( 'fallback_language' );
 228 	}
 229 
 230 	$g_lang_overrides[] = $t_lang;
 231 
 232 	# Remember the language
 233 	$g_active_language = $t_lang;
 234 
 235 	# make sure it's loaded
 236 	lang_ensure_loaded( $t_lang );
 237 }
 238 
 239 /**
 240  * pop a language from the stack and return it
 241  * @return string
 242  */
 243 function lang_pop() {
 244 	global $g_lang_overrides;
 245 
 246 	return array_pop( $g_lang_overrides );
 247 }
 248 
 249 /**
 250  * return value on top of the language stack
 251  * return default if stack is empty
 252  * @return string
 253  */
 254 function lang_get_current() {
 255 	global $g_lang_overrides;
 256 
 257 	$t_count_overrides = count( $g_lang_overrides );
 258 	if( $t_count_overrides > 0 ) {
 259 		$t_lang = $g_lang_overrides[$t_count_overrides - 1];
 260 	} else {
 261 		$t_lang = lang_get_default();
 262 	}
 263 
 264 	return $t_lang;
 265 }
 266 
 267 /**
 268  * Retrieves an internationalized string
 269  * This function will return one of (in order of preference):
 270  *  1. The string in the current user's preferred language (if defined)
 271  *  2. The string in English
 272  * Note: when $p_string is 'MANTIS_ERROR', the return value is an array of error messages.
 273  * @param string $p_string The language string to retrieve.
 274  * @param string $p_lang   The language name.
 275  * @return string|array
 276  */
 277 function lang_get( $p_string, $p_lang = null ) {
 278 	global $g_lang_strings;
 279 
 280 	# If no specific language is requested, we'll try to
 281 	# determine the language from the users preferences
 282 
 283 	$t_lang = $p_lang;
 284 
 285 	if( null === $t_lang ) {
 286 		$t_lang = lang_get_current();
 287 	}
 288 
 289 	# Now we'll make sure that the requested language is loaded
 290 	lang_ensure_loaded( $t_lang );
 291 
 292 	# note in the current implementation we always return the same value
 293 	#  because we don't have a concept of falling back on a language.  The
 294 	#  language files actually *contain* English strings if none has been
 295 	#  defined in the correct language
 296 	# @todo thraxisp - not sure if this is still true. Strings from last language loaded
 297 	#      may still be in memory if a new language is loaded.
 298 
 299 	if( lang_exists( $p_string, $t_lang ) ) {
 300 		return $g_lang_strings[$t_lang][$p_string];
 301 	} elseif( $t_lang != 'english' ) {
 302 		# If the string was not found in the foreign language, then retry with English.
 303 		return lang_get( $p_string, 'english' );
 304 	} else {
 305 		error_parameters( $p_string );
 306 		trigger_error( ERROR_LANG_STRING_NOT_FOUND, WARNING );
 307 		return $p_string;
 308 	}
 309 }
 310 
 311 /**
 312  * Check the language entry, if found return true, otherwise return false.
 313  * @param string $p_string The language string to retrieve.
 314  * @param string $p_lang   The language name.
 315  * @return boolean
 316  */
 317 function lang_exists( $p_string, $p_lang ) {
 318 	global $g_lang_strings;
 319 
 320 	return( isset( $g_lang_strings[$p_lang] ) && isset( $g_lang_strings[$p_lang][$p_string] ) );
 321 }
 322 
 323 /**
 324  * Get language:
 325  * - If found, return the appropriate string (as lang_get()).
 326  * - If not found, no default supplied, return the supplied string as is.
 327  * - If not found, default supplied, return default.
 328  * @param string $p_string  The language string to retrieve.
 329  * @param string $p_default The default value to return.
 330  * @param string $p_lang    The language name.
 331  * @return string
 332  */
 333 function lang_get_defaulted( $p_string, $p_default = null, $p_lang = null ) {
 334 	$t_lang = $p_lang;
 335 
 336 	if( null === $t_lang ) {
 337 		$t_lang = lang_get_current();
 338 	}
 339 
 340 	# Now we'll make sure that the requested language is loaded
 341 	lang_ensure_loaded( $t_lang );
 342 
 343 	if( lang_exists( $p_string, $t_lang ) ) {
 344 		return lang_get( $p_string );
 345 	} elseif( $t_lang != 'english' ) {
 346 		# If the string was not found in the foreign language, then retry with English.
 347 		return lang_get_defaulted( $p_string, $p_default, 'english' );
 348 	} else {
 349 		# English string was not found either, return the default,
 350 		# or the original string if no default was provided
 351 		return $p_default !== null ? $p_default : $p_string;
 352 	}
 353 }
 354 
 355 /**
 356  * Get current language code (ISO 639-1).
 357  * @return string Browser language code (e.g. 'en' for English)
 358  */
 359 function lang_get_current_lang() {
 360 	$t_key_arr = explode( ',', array_search( lang_get_current(),
 361 		config_get_global( 'language_auto_map' ) ) );
 362 	return trim( end( $t_key_arr ) );
 363 }
 364 
 365 /**
 366  * Maps current lang string to moment.js locale.
 367  * @see https://github.com/moment/moment/tree/develop/locale
 368  * @return string Two chars browser language code (e.g. 'de' for German)
 369  */
 370 function lang_get_current_datetime_locale() {
 371 	$t_lang = lang_get_current();
 372 
 373 	# Lookup $g_language_auto_map by value and then return the first key
 374 	$t_auto_map = config_get_global( 'language_auto_map' );
 375 	$t_entry = array_search( $t_lang, $t_auto_map );
 376 	$t_key_arr = explode( ',', $t_entry );
 377 
 378 	return $t_key_arr[0];
 379 }

  17 /**

  28  * @uses constant_inc.php
  29  * @uses current_user_api.php
  30  * @uses database_api.php
  31  * @uses tokens_api.php
  32  */
  33 
  34 require_api( 'bug_api.php' );
  35 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  36 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  37 require_api( 'current_user_api.php' );
  38 require_api( 'database_api.php' );
  39 require_api( 'tokens_api.php' );

  41 /**
  42  * Determine if last visited feature is enabled
  43  *
  44  * @return boolean true: enabled; false: otherwise.
  45  * @access public
  46  */
  47 function last_visited_enabled() {
  48 	return !( 0 == config_get( 'recently_visited_count' ) || current_user_is_anonymous() );
  49 }
  50 
  51 /**
  52  * This method should be called from view, update, print pages for issues,
  53  * mantisconnect.
  54  *
  55  * @param integer $p_issue_id The issue id that was just visited.
  56  * @param integer $p_user_id  The user id that visited the issue, or null for current logged in user.
  57  * @access public
  58  * @return void
  59  */
  60 function last_visited_issue( $p_issue_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
  61 	if( !last_visited_enabled() ) {
  62 		return;
  63 	}
  64 
  65 	$t_value = token_get_value( TOKEN_LAST_VISITED, $p_user_id );
  66 	if( is_null( $t_value ) ) {
  67 		$t_value = $p_issue_id;
  68 	} else {
  69 		$t_ids = explode( ',', $p_issue_id . ',' . $t_value );
  70 		$t_ids = array_unique( $t_ids );
  71 		$t_ids = array_slice( $t_ids, 0, config_get( 'recently_visited_count' ) );
  72 		$t_value = implode( ',', $t_ids );
  73 	}
  74 
  75 	token_set( TOKEN_LAST_VISITED, $t_value, TOKEN_EXPIRY_LAST_VISITED, $p_user_id );
  76 }
  77 
  78 /**
  79  * Get an array of the last visited bug ids.  We intentionally don't check
  80  * if the ids still exists to avoid performance degradation.
  81  *
  82  * @param integer $p_user_id The user id to get the last visited issues for, or null for current logged in user.
  83  * @return array An array of issue ids or an empty array if none found.
  84  * @access public
  85  */
  86 function last_visited_get_array( $p_user_id = null ) {
  87 	if( !last_visited_enabled() ) {
  88 		return array();
  89 	}
  90 
  91 	$t_value = token_get_value( TOKEN_LAST_VISITED, $p_user_id );
  92 
  93 	if( is_null( $t_value ) ) {
  94 		return array();
  95 	}
  96 
  97 	# we don't slice the array here to optimise for performance.  If the user reduces the number of recently
  98 	# visited to track, then he/she will get the extra entries until visiting an issue.
  99 	$t_ids = explode( ',', $t_value );
 100 
 101 	bug_cache_array_rows( $t_ids );
 102 	return $t_ids;
 103 }

  17 /**
  18  * Layout API
  19  *
  20  * UI functions to render layout elements in every page. The layout api layer sits above the html api and abstract
  21  * the lower level html markup into web components
  22  *
  23  * Here is the call order for the layout functions
  24  *
  25  * layout_page_header
  26  *      layout_page_header_begin
  27  *      layout_page_header_end
  28  * layout_page_begin
  29  *      ...Page content here...
  30  * layout_page_end
  31  *
  32  *
  33  *
  34  * @package CoreAPI
  35  * @subpackage LayoutAPI
  36  * @copyright Copyright 2014 MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  37  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  38  *
  39  * @uses access_api.php
  40  * @uses utility_api.php
  41  */
  42 
  43 
  44 require_api( 'access_api.php' );
  45 require_api( 'utility_api.php' );
  46 
  47 
  48 /**
  49  * Print the page header section
  50  * @param string $p_page_title    Html page title.
  51  * @param string $p_redirect_url  URL to redirect to if necessary: has to be relative to the install path {@see $g_path}.
  52  * @param string $p_page_id       The page id.
  53  * @param string $p_canonical_url Canonical URL if necessary: has to be relative to the install path {@see $g_path}.
  54  * @return void
  55  */
  56 function layout_page_header( $p_page_title = '', $p_redirect_url = null, $p_page_id = null, $p_canonical_url = null ) {
  57 	layout_page_header_begin( $p_page_title );
  58 	if( $p_redirect_url !== null ) {
  59 		html_meta_redirect( $p_redirect_url );
  60 	}
  61 	if( $p_canonical_url !== null ) {
  62 		html_meta_canonical( $p_canonical_url );
  63 	}
  64 
  65 	layout_page_header_end( $p_page_id );
  66 }
  67 
  68 /**
  69  * Print the part of the page that comes before meta redirect tags should be inserted
  70  * @param string $p_page_title Page title.
  71  * @return void
  72  */
  73 function layout_page_header_begin( $p_page_title = '' ) {
  74 	html_begin();
  75 	html_head_begin();
  76 	html_content_type();
  77 
  78 	global $g_robots_meta;
  79 	if( !is_blank( $g_robots_meta ) ) {
  80 		echo "\t", '<meta name="robots" content="', $g_robots_meta, '" />', "\n";
  81 	}
  82 
  83 	html_title( $p_page_title );
  84 	layout_head_meta();
  85 	html_css();
  86 	layout_head_css();
  87 	html_rss_link();
  88 
  89 	$t_favicon_image = config_get_global( 'favicon_image' );
  90 	if( !is_blank( $t_favicon_image ) ) {
  91 		echo "\t", '<link rel="shortcut icon" href="', helper_mantis_url( $t_favicon_image ), '" type="image/x-icon" />', "\n";
  92 	}
  93 
  94 	# Advertise the availability of the browser search plug-ins.
  95 	$t_title = htmlspecialchars( config_get( 'search_title' ) );
  96 	$t_searches = array( 'text', 'id' );
  97 	foreach( $t_searches as $t_type ) {
  98 		echo "\t",
  99 			'<link rel="search" type="application/opensearchdescription+xml" ',
 100 				'title="' . sprintf( lang_get( "opensearch_{$t_type}_description" ), $t_title ) . '" ',
 101 				'href="' . string_sanitize_url( 'browser_search_plugin.php?type=' . $t_type, true ) .
 102 				'"/>',
 103 			"\n";
 104 	}
 105 
 106 	html_head_javascript();
 107 }

 109 /**
 110  * Print the part of the page that comes after meta tags and before the
 111  *  actual page content, but without login info or menus.  This is used
 112  *  directly during the login process and other times when the user may
 113  *  not be authenticated
 114  *
 115  * @param string $p_page_id The id of the page.
 116  *
 117  * @return void
 118  */
 119 function layout_page_header_end( $p_page_id = null) {
 120 	global $g_error_send_page_header;
 121 
 122 	event_signal( 'EVENT_LAYOUT_RESOURCES' );
 123 	html_head_end();
 124 
 125 	if ( $p_page_id === null ) {
 126 		$t_body_id = '';
 127 	} else {
 128 		$t_body_id = 'id="' . $p_page_id . '" ';
 129 	}
 130 
 131 	# Add right-to-left css if needed
 132 	if( layout_is_rtl() ) {
 133 		echo '<body ' . $t_body_id . 'class="skin-3 rtl">', "\n";
 134 	} else {
 135 		echo '<body ' . $t_body_id . 'class="skin-3">', "\n";
 136 	}
 137 
 138 	event_signal( 'EVENT_LAYOUT_BODY_BEGIN' );
 139 
 140 	$g_error_send_page_header = false;
 141 }
 142 
 143 /**
 144  * Print page common elements including navbar, sidebar, info bar
 145  * @param string $p_active_sidebar_page sidebar page where the current page lives under
 146  * @return void
 147  */
 148 function layout_page_begin( $p_active_sidebar_page = null ) {
 149 	if( !db_is_connected() ) {
 150 		return;
 151 	}
 152 	current_user_modify_single_project_default();
 153 
 154 	layout_navbar();
 155 	
 156 	event_signal( 'EVENT_LAYOUT_PAGE_HEADER' );
 157 
 158 	layout_main_container_begin();
 159 
 160 	layout_print_sidebar( $p_active_sidebar_page );
 161 
 162 	layout_main_content_begin();
 163 
 164 	layout_breadcrumbs();
 165 
 166 	layout_page_content_begin();

 580 /**
 581  * Print projects that the current user has access to.
 582  *
 583  * @param int $p_project_id 	The current project id or null to use cookie.
 584  * @param bool $p_include_all_projects  true: include "All Projects", otherwise false.
 585  * @param int|null $p_filter_project_id  The id of a project to exclude or null.
 586  * @param string|bool $p_trace  The current project trace, identifies the sub-project via a path from top to bottom.
 587  * @return void
 588  */
 589 function layout_navbar_projects_list( $p_project_id = null, $p_include_all_projects = true, $p_filter_project_id = null, $p_trace = false ) {
 590 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 591 
 592 	# Cache all needed projects
 593 	project_cache_array_rows( user_get_all_accessible_projects( $t_user_id ) );
 594 
 595 	# Get top level projects
 596 	$t_project_ids = user_get_accessible_projects( $t_user_id );
 597 
 598 	echo '<li>';
 599 	echo '<div class="projects-searchbox">';
 600 	echo '<input class="search form-control input-md" placeholder="' . lang_get( 'search' ) . '" />';
 601 	echo '</div>';
 602 	echo "</li>\n";
 603 
 604 	echo '<li class="divider"></li>' . "\n";
 605 
 606 	echo '<li>';
 607 	echo '<div class="scrollable-menu">' . "\n";
 608 	echo '<ul class="list dropdown-yellow no-margin">' . "\n";
 609 
 610 	if( $p_include_all_projects && $p_filter_project_id !== ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 611 		echo '<li>';
 612 		echo project_link_for_menu( ALL_PROJECTS, false, 'project-link' );
 613 		echo "</li>\n";
 614 		echo '<li class="divider"></li>' . "\n";
 615 	}
 616 
 617 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 618 		echo 0 == strcmp( $t_id, $p_project_id ) ? '<li class="active">' : '<li>';
 619 		echo project_link_for_menu( $t_id, false, 'project-link' );
 620 		echo "</li>\n";
 621 		layout_navbar_subproject_option_list( $t_id, $p_project_id, $p_filter_project_id, $p_trace );
 622 	}
 623 
 624 	echo "</ul>\n";
 625 	echo "</div>\n";
 626 	echo "</li>\n";
 627 }
 628 
 629 /**
 630  * List projects that the current user has access to
 631  *
 632  * @param integer $p_parent_id         A parent project identifier.
 633  * @param integer $p_project_id        A project identifier.
 634  * @param integer $p_filter_project_id A filter project identifier.
 635  * @param boolean $p_trace             Whether to trace parent projects.
 636  * @param array   $p_parents           Array of parent projects.
 637  * @return void
 638  */
 639 function layout_navbar_subproject_option_list( $p_parent_id, $p_project_id = null, $p_filter_project_id = null, $p_trace = false, array $p_parents = array() ) {
 640 	array_push( $p_parents, $p_parent_id );
 641 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 642 	$t_project_ids = user_get_accessible_subprojects( $t_user_id, $p_parent_id );
 643 	$t_indent = str_repeat( '&nbsp;', 4 );
 644 
 645 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 646 		if( $p_trace ) {
 647 			$t_full_id = implode( ";", $p_parents ) . ';' . $t_id;
 648 		} else {
 649 			$t_full_id = $t_id;
 650 		}
 651 
 652 		echo 0 == strcmp( $p_project_id, $t_full_id ) ? '<li class="active">' : '<li>';
 653 		echo project_link_for_menu( $t_id, false, 'project-link', $p_parents, $t_indent );
 654 		echo "</li>\n";
 655 
 656 		layout_navbar_subproject_option_list( $t_id, $p_project_id, $p_filter_project_id, $p_trace, $p_parents );
 657 	}
 658 }

 661 /**
 662  * Print user avatar in the navbar
 663  * @param string $p_img_class css class to use with the img tag
 664  * @return void
 665  */
 666 function layout_navbar_user_avatar( $p_img_class = 'nav' ) {
 667 	$t_default_avatar = icon_get( 'fa-user', 'ace-icon fa-2x white' ) . ' ';
 668 
 669 	if( OFF === config_get( 'show_avatar' ) ) {
 670 		echo $t_default_avatar;
 671 		return;
 672 	}
 673 
 674 	$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 675 	if( !user_exists( $p_user_id ) ) {
 676 		echo $t_default_avatar;
 677 		return;
 678 	}
 679 
 680 	if( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'show_avatar_threshold' ), null, $p_user_id ) ) {
 681 		$t_avatar = Avatar::get( $p_user_id, 40 );
 682 		if( false !== $t_avatar ) {
 683 			echo prepare_raw_avatar( $t_avatar, $p_img_class, 40 );
 684 			return;
 685 		}
 686 	}
 687 
 688 	echo $t_default_avatar;
 689 }

 753 			'url' => 'roadmap_page.php',

 755 			'icon' => 'fa-road',
 756 			'access_level' => config_get( 'roadmap_view_threshold' )
 757 		);
 758 
 759 		# Summary Page
 760 		$t_sidebar_items[] = array(
 761 			'url' => 'summary_page.php',
 762 			'title' => 'summary_link',
 763 			'icon' => 'fa-bar-chart-o',
 764 			'access_level' => config_get( 'view_summary_threshold' )
 765 		);
 766 
 767 		# Project Documentation Page
 768 		if( ON == config_get( 'enable_project_documentation' ) ) {
 769 			$t_sidebar_items[] = array(
 770 				'url' => 'proj_doc_page.php',
 771 				'title' => 'docs_link',
 772 				'icon' => 'fa-book'
 773 			);
 774 		}
 775 
 776 		# Project Wiki
 777 		if( ON == config_get_global( 'wiki_enable' )  ) {
 778 			$t_sidebar_items[] = array(
 779 				'url' => 'wiki.php?type=project&amp;id=' . $t_current_project,
 780 				'title' => 'wiki',
 781 				'icon' => 'fa-book'
 782 			);
 783 		}
 784 
 785 		# Manage Users (admins) or Manage Project (managers) or Manage Custom Fields
 786 		$t_link = layout_manage_menu_link();
 787 		if( !is_blank( $t_link ) ) {
 788 			$t_sidebar_items[] = array(
 789 				'url' => $t_link,
 790 				'title' => 'manage_link',
 791 				'icon' => 'fa-gears',
 792 			);
 793 		}
 794 
 795 		# Time Tracking / Billing
 796 		if( config_get( 'time_tracking_enabled' ) && access_has_project_level( config_get( 'time_tracking_reporting_threshold', $t_current_project ) ) ) {
 797 			$t_sidebar_items[] = array(
 798 				'url' => 'billing_page.php',
 799 				'title' => 'time_tracking_billing_link',
 800 				'icon' => 'fa-clock-o',
 801 			);
 802 		}
 803 
 804 		# Plugin / Event added options
 805 		$t_event_menu_main = event_signal( 'EVENT_MENU_MAIN' );
 806 		$t_plugin_menu_items_back = layout_plugin_menu_options_for_sidebar( $t_event_menu_main );
 807 
 808 		if( is_array( $t_plugin_menu_items_back ) ) {
 809 			$t_sidebar_items = array_merge( $t_sidebar_items, $t_plugin_menu_items_back );
 810 		}
 811 
 812 		# Config based custom options
 813 		$t_config_menu_items = layout_config_menu_options_for_sidebar();
 814 
 815 		if( is_array( $t_config_menu_items ) ) {
 816 			$t_sidebar_items = array_merge( $t_sidebar_items, $t_config_menu_items );
 817 		}
 818 
 819 		# Allow plugins to alter the sidebar items array
 820 		$t_modified_sidebar_items = event_signal( 'EVENT_MENU_MAIN_FILTER', array( $t_sidebar_items ) );
 821 		if( is_array( $t_modified_sidebar_items ) && count( $t_modified_sidebar_items ) > 0 ) {
 822 			$t_sidebar_items = $t_modified_sidebar_items[0];
 823 		}
 824 
 825 		if( count( $t_sidebar_items ) > 0 ) {
 826 			# Starting sidebar markup
 827 			layout_sidebar_begin();
 828 
 829 			# Output the sidebar items
 830 			layout_options_for_sidebar( $t_sidebar_items, $p_active_sidebar_page );
 831 
 832 			# Ending sidebar markup
 833 			layout_sidebar_end();
 834 		}
 835 	}
 836 }

 838 /**
 839  * Process plugin menu options for sidebar
 840  * @param array $p_plugin_event_response The response from the plugin event signal.
 841  * @return array containing sidebar items
 842  */
 843 function layout_plugin_menu_options_for_sidebar( $p_plugin_event_response ) {
 844 	$t_menu_options = array();
 845 
 846 	foreach( $p_plugin_event_response as $t_plugin => $t_plugin_menu_options ) {
 847 		foreach( $t_plugin_menu_options as $t_callback => $t_callback_menu_options ) {
 848 			if( is_array( $t_callback_menu_options ) ) {
 849 				$t_menu_options = array_merge( $t_menu_options, $t_callback_menu_options );
 850 			} else {
 851 				if( !is_null( $t_callback_menu_options ) ) {
 852 					$t_menu_options[] = $t_callback_menu_options;
 853 				}
 854 			}
 855 		}
 856 	}
 857 
 858 	return $t_menu_options;
 859 }
 860 
 861 /**
 862  * Process main menu options from config.
 863  * @return array containing sidebar items
 864  */
 865 function layout_config_menu_options_for_sidebar( ) {
 866 	$t_menu_options = array();
 867 	$t_custom_options = config_get( 'main_menu_custom_options' );
 868 
 869 	foreach( $t_custom_options as $t_custom_option ) {
 870 		if( isset( $t_custom_option['url'] ) ) {
 871 			$t_menu_option = $t_custom_option;
 872 		} else {
 873 			# Support < 2.0.0 custom menu options config format
 874 			$t_menu_option = array();
 875 			$t_menu_option['title'] = $t_custom_option[0];
 876 			$t_menu_option['access_level'] = $t_custom_option[1];
 877 			$t_menu_option['url'] = $t_custom_option[2];
 878 		}
 879 
 880 		$t_menu_options[] = $t_menu_option;
 881 	}
 882 
 883 	return $t_menu_options;
 884 }

 886 /**
 887  * Process main menu options
 888  * @param array $p_menu_options Array of menu options to output.
 889  * @param string $p_active_sidebar_page The active page on the sidebar.
 890  * @return void
 891  */
 892 function layout_options_for_sidebar( $p_menu_options, $p_active_sidebar_page ) {
 893 	foreach( $p_menu_options as $t_menu_option ) {
 894 		$t_icon = isset( $t_menu_option['icon'] ) ? $t_menu_option['icon'] : 'fa-plug';
 895 		if( !isset( $t_menu_option['url'] ) || !isset( $t_menu_option['title'] ) ) {
 896 			continue;
 897 		}
 898 
 899 		if( isset( $t_menu_option['access_level'] ) ) {
 900 			if( !access_has_project_level( $t_menu_option['access_level'] ) ) {
 901 				continue;
 902 			}
 903 		}
 904 
 905 		layout_sidebar_menu( $t_menu_option['url'], $t_menu_option['title'], $t_icon, $p_active_sidebar_page );
 906 	}
 907 }

1047 /**
1048  * Render breadcrumbs bar.
1049  * @return void
1050  */
1051 function layout_breadcrumbs() {
1052 	if( !auth_is_user_authenticated() ) {
1053 		return;
1054 	}
1055 
1056 	echo '<div id="breadcrumbs" class="breadcrumbs noprint">' , "\n";
1057 
1058 	# Login information
1059 	echo '<ul class="breadcrumb">' , "\n";
1060 	echo '  <li>';
1061 	print_icon( 'fa-user', 'home-icon active' );
1062 	if( current_user_is_anonymous() ) {
1063 		$t_return_page = $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'];
1064 		if( isset( $_SERVER['QUERY_STRING'] ) && !is_blank( $_SERVER['QUERY_STRING'] )) {
1065 			$t_return_page .= '?' . $_SERVER['QUERY_STRING'];
1066 		}
1067 
1068 		echo '  ' . lang_get( 'anonymous' ) . "\n";
1069 
1070 		echo '  <div class="btn-group btn-corner">' . "\n";
1071 		echo '	<a href="' . helper_mantis_url( auth_login_page( [ 'return' => $t_return_page ] ) ) .
1072 			'" class="btn btn-primary btn-xs">' . lang_get( 'login' ) . '</a>' . "\n";
1073 		if( auth_signup_enabled() ) {
1074 			echo '	<a href="' . helper_mantis_url( 'signup_page.php' ) . '" class="btn btn-primary btn-xs">' .
1075 				lang_get( 'signup_link' ) . '</a>' . "\n";
1076 		}
1077 		echo '  </div></li>' . "\n";
1078 
1079 	} else {
1080 		$t_protected = current_user_get_field( 'protected' );
1081 		$t_access_level = get_enum_element( 'access_levels', current_user_get_access_level() );
1082 		$t_display_username = string_html_specialchars( current_user_get_field( 'username' ) );
1083 		$t_realname = current_user_get_field( 'realname' );
1084 		$t_display_realname = is_blank( $t_realname ) ? '' : ' ( ' . string_html_specialchars( $t_realname ) . ' ) ';
1085 
1086 		$t_page = ( OFF == $t_protected ) ? 'account_page.php' : 'my_view_page.php';
1087 		echo '  <a href="' . helper_mantis_url( $t_page ) . '">' .
1088 			$t_display_username . $t_display_realname . '</a>' . "\n";
1089 
1090 		$t_label = layout_is_rtl() ? 'arrowed-right' : 'arrowed';
1091 		echo '  <span class="label hidden-xs label-default ' . $t_label . '">' . $t_access_level . '</span></li>' . "\n";
1092 	}
1093 	echo '</ul>' , "\n";
1094 
1095 	# Recently visited
1096 	if( last_visited_enabled() ) {
1097 		$t_ids = last_visited_get_array();
1098 
1099 		if( count( $t_ids ) > 0 ) {
1100 			echo '<div class="nav-recent hidden-xs">' . lang_get( 'recently_visited' ) . ': ';
1101 			$t_first = true;
1102 
1103 			foreach( $t_ids as $t_id ) {
1104 				if( !$t_first ) {
1105 					echo ', ';
1106 				} else {
1107 					$t_first = false;
1108 				}
1109 
1110 				echo string_get_bug_view_link( $t_id );
1111 			}
1112 			echo '</div>';
1113 		}
1114 	}
1115 
1116 	# Bug Jump form
1117 	# CSRF protection not required here - form does not result in modifications
1118 	echo '<div id="nav-search" class="nav-search">';
1119 	echo '<form class="form-search" method="post" action="' . helper_mantis_url( 'jump_to_bug.php' ) . '">';
1120 	echo '<span class="input-icon">';
1121 	echo '<input type="text" name="bug_id" autocomplete="off" class="nav-search-input" placeholder="' . lang_get( 'issue_id' ) . '">';
1122 	print_icon( 'fa-search', 'ace-icon nav-search-icon' );
1123 	echo '</span>';
1124 	echo '</form>';
1125 	echo '</div>';
1126 	echo PHP_EOL;
1127 
1128 	echo '</div>';
1129 	echo PHP_EOL;
1130 }

1132 /**
1133  * Print the page footer information
1134  * @return void
1135  */
1136 function layout_footer() {
1137 	global $g_queries_array, $g_request_time;
1138 
1139 	# If a user is logged in, update their last visit time.
1140 	# We do this at the end of the page so that:
1141 	#  1) we can display the user's last visit time on a page before updating it
1142 	#  2) we don't invalidate the user cache immediately after fetching it
1143 	#  3) don't do this on pages that auto-refresh
1144 	#  4) don't do this on the password verification or update page, as it causes the
1145 	#    verification comparison to fail
1146 	if( !gpc_get_bool( 'refresh' ) &&
1147 		auth_is_user_authenticated() &&
1148 		!current_user_is_anonymous() &&
1149 		!( is_page_name( 'verify.php' ) || is_page_name( 'account_update.php' ) ) ) {
1150 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1151 		user_update_last_visit( $t_user_id );
1152 	}
1153 
1154 	layout_footer_begin();
1155 
1156 	# Show MantisBT version and copyright statement
1157 	$t_version_suffix = '';
1158 	$t_copyright_years = ' 2000 - ' . date( 'Y' );
1159 	if( config_get_global( 'show_version' ) == ON ) {
1160 		$t_version_suffix = ' ' . htmlentities( MANTIS_VERSION . config_get_global( 'version_suffix' ) );
1161 	}
1162 	echo '<div class="col-md-6 col-xs-12 no-padding">' . "\n";
1163 	echo '<address>' . "\n";
1164 	echo '<strong>Powered by <a href="https://www.mantisbt.org" title="bug tracking software">MantisBT ' . $t_version_suffix . '</a></strong> <br>' . "\n";
1165 	echo "<small>Copyright &copy;$t_copyright_years MantisBT Team</small>" . '<br>';
1166 
1167 	# Show optional user-specified custom copyright statement
1168 	$t_copyright_statement = config_get_global( 'copyright_statement' );
1169 	if( $t_copyright_statement ) {
1170 		echo '<small>' . $t_copyright_statement . '</small>' . "\n";
1171 	}
1172 
1173 	# Show contact information
1174 	if( !is_page_name( 'login_page' ) ) {
1175 		$t_webmaster_contact_information = sprintf( lang_get( 'webmaster_contact_information' ), string_html_specialchars( config_get_global( 'webmaster_email' ) ) );
1176 		echo '<small>' . $t_webmaster_contact_information . '</small>' . '<br>' . "\n";
1177 	}
1178 
1179 	echo '</address>' . "\n";
1180 	echo '</div>' . "\n";
1181 
1182 
1183 	# We don't have a button anymore, so for now we will only show the resized
1184 	# version of the logo when not on login page.
1185 	if( !is_page_name( 'login_page' ) ) {
1186 		echo '<div class="col-md-6 col-xs-12">' . "\n";
1187 		echo '<div class="pull-right" id="powered-by-mantisbt-logo">' . "\n";
1188 		$t_mantisbt_logo_url = helper_mantis_url( 'images/mantis_logo.png' );
1189 		echo '<a href="https://www.mantisbt.org" '.
1190 			'title="Mantis Bug Tracker: a free and open source web based bug tracking system.">' .
1191 			'<img src="' . $t_mantisbt_logo_url . '" width="102" height="35" ' .
1192 			'alt="Powered by Mantis Bug Tracker: a free and open source web based bug tracking system." />' .
1193 			'</a>' . "\n";
1194 		echo '</div>' . "\n";
1195 		echo '</div>' . "\n";
1196 	}
1197 
1198 	event_signal( 'EVENT_LAYOUT_PAGE_FOOTER' );
1199 
1200 	$t_show_timer = config_get_global( 'show_timer' );
1201 	$t_show_memory_usage = config_get_global( 'show_memory_usage' );
1202 	$t_show_queries_count = config_get_global( 'show_queries_count' );
1203 	$t_display_debug_info = $t_show_timer || $t_show_memory_usage || $t_show_queries_count;
1204 
1205 	if( $t_display_debug_info ) {
1206 		echo '<div class="col-xs-12 no-padding grey">' . "\n";
1207 		echo '<address class="no-margin pull-right">' . "\n";
1208 	}
1209 
1210 	# Print the page execution time
1211 	if( $t_show_timer ) {
1212 		$t_page_execution_time = sprintf( lang_get( 'page_execution_time' ), number_format( microtime( true ) - $g_request_time, 4 ) );
1213 		echo '<small>';
1214 		print_icon( 'fa-clock-o' );
1215 		echo ' ' . $t_page_execution_time . '</small>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;' . "\n";
1216 	}
1217 
1218 	# Print the page memory usage
1219 	if( $t_show_memory_usage ) {
1220 		$t_page_memory_usage = sprintf( lang_get( 'memory_usage' ), number_format( memory_get_peak_usage() / 1024 ) );
1221 		echo '<small>';
1222 		print_icon( 'fa-bolt' );
1223 		echo ' ' . $t_page_memory_usage . '</small>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;' . "\n";
1224 	}
1225 
1226 	# Determine number of unique queries executed
1227 	if( $t_show_queries_count ) {
1228 		$t_total_queries_count = count( $g_queries_array );
1229 		$t_unique_queries_count = 0;
1230 		$t_total_query_execution_time = 0;
1231 		$t_unique_queries = array();
1232 		for ( $i = 0; $i < $t_total_queries_count; $i++ ) {
1233 			if( !in_array( $g_queries_array[$i][0], $t_unique_queries ) ) {
1234 				$t_unique_queries_count++;
1235 				$g_queries_array[$i][3] = false;
1236 				array_push( $t_unique_queries, $g_queries_array[$i][0] );
1237 			} else {
1238 				$g_queries_array[$i][3] = true;
1239 			}
1240 			$t_total_query_execution_time += $g_queries_array[$i][1];
1241 		}
1242 
1243 		$t_total_queries_executed = sprintf( lang_get( 'total_queries_executed' ), $t_total_queries_count );
1244 		echo '<small>';
1245 		print_icon( 'fa-database' );
1246 		echo ' ' . $t_total_queries_executed . '</small>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;' . "\n";
1247 		if( config_get_global( 'db_log_queries' ) ) {
1248 			$t_unique_queries_executed = sprintf( lang_get( 'unique_queries_executed' ), $t_unique_queries_count );
1249 			echo '<small>';
1250 			print_icon( 'fa-database' );
1251 			echo ' ' . $t_unique_queries_executed . '</small>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;' . "\n";
1252 		}
1253 		$t_total_query_time = sprintf( lang_get( 'total_query_execution_time' ), $t_total_query_execution_time );
1254 		echo '<small>';
1255 		print_icon( 'fa-clock-o' );
1256 		echo ' ' . $t_total_query_time . '</small>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;' . "\n";
1257 	}
1258 
1259 	if( $t_display_debug_info ) {
1260 		echo '</address>' . "\n";
1261 		echo '</div>' . "\n";
1262 	}
1263 
1264 	html_bottom_banner();
1265 
1266 	layout_footer_end();
1267 }

1312 /**
1313  * Returns a single link for the "manage" menu item in sidebar, based on current
1314  * user permissions, and priority if several subpages are available.
1315  * If there is not any accesible manage page, returns null.
1316  * @return string|null	Page name for the manage menu link, or null if unavailable.
1317  */
1318 function layout_manage_menu_link() {
1319 	static $t_link = null;
1320 	if( access_has_global_level( config_get( 'manage_site_threshold' ) ) ) {
1321 		$t_link = 'manage_overview_page.php';
1322 	} else {
1323 		if( access_has_global_level( config_get( 'manage_user_threshold' ) ) ) {
1324 			$t_link = 'manage_user_page.php';
1325 		} else {
1326 			if( access_has_any_project_level( 'manage_project_threshold' ) ) {
1327 				$t_current_project = helper_get_current_project();
1328 				if( $t_current_project == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
1329 					$t_link = 'manage_proj_page.php';
1330 				} else {
1331 					if( access_has_project_level( config_get( 'manage_project_threshold' ), $t_current_project ) ) {
1332 						$t_link = 'manage_proj_edit_page.php?project_id=' . $t_current_project;
1333 					} else {
1334 						if ( access_has_global_level( config_get( 'manage_custom_fields_threshold' ) ) ) {
1335 							$t_link = 'manage_custom_field_page.php';
1336 						}
1337 					}
1338 				}
1339 			}
1340 		}
1341 	}
1342 	return $t_link;
1343 }
1344 
1345 /**
1346  * Returns true if the projects menu can be shown for current user.
1347  * In some circumstances, we won't show the menu to simplify the UI.
1348  * @return boolean	True if the projects menu can be shown.
1349  */
1350 function layout_navbar_can_show_projects_menu() {
1351 	if( !auth_is_user_authenticated() ) {
1352 		return false;
1353 	}
1354 
1355 	# Project selector is only shown if there are more than one project, or
1356 	# if the user hass access to manage pages, where having ALL_PROJECTS is
1357 	# needed (#20054)
1358 	$t_show_project_selector =
1359 		!is_blank( layout_manage_menu_link() )
1360 		|| current_user_has_more_than_one_project();
1361 	return $t_show_project_selector;
1362 }

  36 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  37 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  38 require_api( 'logging_api.php' );
  39 require_api( 'user_api.php' );
  40 require_api( 'utility_api.php' );

  42 /**
  43  * LDAP attributes cache, indexed by username
  44  * @see ldap_cache_user_data()
  45  */
  46 $g_cache_ldap_data = array();
  47 
  48 /**
  49  * Logs the most recent LDAP error
  50  * @param resource $p_ds LDAP resource identifier returned by ldap_connect.
  51  * @return void
  52  */
  53 function ldap_log_error( $p_ds ) {
  54 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'ERROR #' . ldap_errno( $p_ds ) . ': ' . ldap_error( $p_ds ) );
  55 }
  56 
  57 /**
  58  * Connect and bind to the LDAP directory
  59  * @param string $p_binddn   DN to use for LDAP bind.
  60  * @param string $p_password Password to use for LDAP bind.
  61  * @return resource|false
  62  */
  63 function ldap_connect_bind( $p_binddn = '', $p_password = '' ) {
  64 	$t_ldap_server = config_get_global( 'ldap_server' );
  65 
  66 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Checking syntax of LDAP server URI \'' . $t_ldap_server . '\'.' );
  67 	$t_ds = @ldap_connect( $t_ldap_server );
  68 	if( $t_ds === false ) {
  69 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'LDAP server URI syntax check failed, make sure its in URI form' );
  70 		trigger_error( ERROR_LDAP_SERVER_CONNECT_FAILED, ERROR );
  71 		# Return required as function may be called with error suppressed
  72 		return false;
  73 	}
  74 
  75 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'LDAP server URI syntax check succeeded' );
  76 
  77 	$t_network_timeout = config_get_global( 'ldap_network_timeout' );
  78 	if( $t_network_timeout > 0 ) {
  79 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Setting LDAP network timeout to " . $t_network_timeout );
  80 		$t_result = @ldap_set_option( $t_ds, LDAP_OPT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT, $t_network_timeout );
  81 		if( !$t_result ) {
  82 			ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
  83 		}
  84 	}
  85 
  86 	$t_protocol_version = config_get_global( 'ldap_protocol_version' );
  87 	if( $t_protocol_version > 0 ) {
  88 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Setting LDAP protocol version to ' . $t_protocol_version );
  89 		$t_result = @ldap_set_option( $t_ds, LDAP_OPT_PROTOCOL_VERSION, $t_protocol_version );
  90 		if( !$t_result ) {
  91 			ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
  92 		}
  93 	}
  94 
  95 	# Set referrals flag.
  96 	$t_follow_referrals = ON == config_get_global( 'ldap_follow_referrals' );
  97 	$t_result = @ldap_set_option( $t_ds, LDAP_OPT_REFERRALS, $t_follow_referrals );
  98 	if( !$t_result ) {
  99 		ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
 100 	}
 101 
 102 	# Set minimum TLS protocol version flag (ex: LDAP_OPT_X_TLS_PROTOCOL_TLS1_2).
 103 	$t_tls_protocol_min = config_get_global( 'ldap_tls_protocol_min' );
 104 	if( $t_tls_protocol_min > 0 ) {
 105 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Attempting to set minimum TLS protocol' );
 106 		$t_result = @ldap_set_option( $t_ds, LDAP_OPT_X_TLS_PROTOCOL_MIN, $t_tls_protocol_min );
 107 		if( !$t_result ) {
 108 			ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
 109 			log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Error: Failed to set minimum TLS version on LDAP server" );
 110 			trigger_error( ERROR_LDAP_UNABLE_TO_SET_MIN_TLS, ERROR );
 111 
 112 			# Return required as function may be called with error suppressed
 113 			return false;
 114 		}
 115 	}
 116 
 117 	$t_use_starttls = config_get_global( 'ldap_use_starttls' );
 118 	if ( $t_use_starttls ) {
 119 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Attempting StartTLS' );
 120 		$t_result = @ldap_start_tls( $t_ds );
 121 		if( !$t_result ) {
 122 			ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
 123 			log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Error: Cannot initiate StartTLS on LDAP server" );
 124 			trigger_error( ERROR_LDAP_UNABLE_TO_STARTTLS, ERROR );
 125 
 126 			# Return required as function may be called with error suppressed
 127 			return false;
 128 		}
 129 	}
 130 	
 131 	# If no Bind DN and Password is set, attempt to login as the configured
 132 	# Bind DN.
 133 	if( is_blank( $p_binddn ) && is_blank( $p_password ) ) {
 134 		$p_binddn = config_get_global( 'ldap_bind_dn', '' );
 135 		$p_password = config_get_global( 'ldap_bind_passwd', '' );
 136 	}
 137 
 138 	if( !is_blank( $p_binddn ) && !is_blank( $p_password ) ) {
 139 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Attempting bind to ldap server as '$p_binddn'" );
 140 		$t_br = @ldap_bind( $t_ds, $p_binddn, $p_password );
 141 	} else {
 142 		# Either the Bind DN or the Password are empty, so attempt an anonymous bind.
 143 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Attempting anonymous bind to ldap server' );
 144 		$t_br = @ldap_bind( $t_ds );
 145 	}
 146 
 147 	if( !$t_br ) {
 148 		ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
 149 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Bind to ldap server failed' );
 150 		trigger_error( ERROR_LDAP_SERVER_CONNECT_FAILED, ERROR );
 151 	} else {
 152 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Bind to ldap server successful' );
 153 	}
 154 
 155 	return $t_ds;
 156 }
 157 
 158 /**
 159  * returns an email address from LDAP, given a userid
 160  * @param integer $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
 161  * @return string
 162  */
 163 function ldap_email( $p_user_id ) {
 164 	return ldap_email_from_username( user_get_username( $p_user_id ) );
 165 }

 167 /**
 168  * Return an email address from LDAP, given a username
 169  * @param string $p_username The username of a user to lookup.
 170  * @return string
 171  */
 172 function ldap_email_from_username( $p_username ) {
 173 	if( ldap_simulation_is_enabled() ) {
 174 		$t_email = ldap_simulation_email_from_username( $p_username );
 175 	} else {
 176 		$t_email = (string)ldap_get_field_from_username(
 177 			$p_username,
 178 			config_get_global( 'ldap_email_field' )
 179 		);
 180 	}
 181 	return $t_email;
 182 }

 194 /**
 195  * Gets a user real name given their user name.

 199 function ldap_realname_from_username( $p_username ) {
 200 	if( ldap_simulation_is_enabled() ) {
 201 		$t_realname = ldap_simulatiom_realname_from_username( $p_username );
 202 	} else {
 203 		$t_ldap_realname_field = config_get_global( 'ldap_realname_field' );

 209 /**
 210  * Escapes the LDAP string to disallow injection.
 211  *
 212  * @param string $p_string The string to escape.
 213  * @return string The escaped string.
 214  */
 215 function ldap_escape_string( $p_string ) {
 216 	$t_find = array( '\\', '*', '(', ')', '/', "\x00" );
 217 	$t_replace = array( '\5c', '\2a', '\28', '\29', '\2f', '\00' );
 218 
 219     return str_replace( $t_find, $t_replace, $p_string );
 220 }

 222 /**
 223  * Retrieves user data from LDAP and stores it in cache.
 224  *
 225  * Uses a single LDAP query to retrieve the following fields:
 226  * - email {@see $g_ldap_email_field}
 227  * - realname {@see $g_ldap_realname_field}
 228  *
 229  * @param string $p_username The username.
 230  *
 231  * @return array|false User data, false if not found or errors occurred
 232  */
 233 function ldap_cache_user_data( $p_username ) {
 234 	global $g_cache_ldap_data;
 235 
 236 	# Return cached data if available
 237 	if( isset( $g_cache_ldap_data[$p_username] ) ) {
 238 		return $g_cache_ldap_data[$p_username];
 239 	}
 240 
 241 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Retrieving data for '$p_username' from LDAP server" );
 242 
 243 	# Bind and connect.
 244 	# We suppress errors, because failing to connect is not blocking in this
 245 	# context, it just means we won't be able to retrieve user data from LDAP.
 246 	$t_ds = @ldap_connect_bind();
 247 	if( $t_ds === false ) {
 248 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, "ERROR: could not bind to LDAP server" );
 249 		return false;
 250 	}
 251 
 252 	# Search
 253 	$t_ldap_organization = config_get_global( 'ldap_organization' );
 254 	$t_ldap_root_dn      = config_get_global( 'ldap_root_dn' );
 255 	$t_ldap_uid_field    = config_get_global( 'ldap_uid_field' );
 256 
 257 	$t_search_filter = '(&' . $t_ldap_organization
 258 		. '(' . $t_ldap_uid_field . '=' . ldap_escape_string( $p_username ) . '))';
 259 	$t_search_attrs = array(
 260 		config_get_global( 'ldap_email_field' ),
 261 		config_get_global( 'ldap_realname_field' )
 262 	);
 263 
 264 	$t_extra_attrs = event_signal( 'EVENT_LDAP_CACHE_ATTRS', array( $p_username ) );
 265 	foreach( $t_extra_attrs as $t_plugin => $t_callback ) {
 266 		foreach( $t_callback as $t_attr ) {
 267 			if( is_array( $t_attr ) ) {
 268 				$t_search_attrs = array_merge( $t_search_attrs, $t_attr );
 269 				$t_attr = implode( ', ', $t_attr );
 270 			} elseif( !is_null( $t_attr ) ) {
 271 				$t_search_attrs[] = $t_attr;
 272 			}
 273 			log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Extra attributes for '$t_plugin' plugin: '$t_attr'" );
 274 		}
 275 	}
 276 	# array_values() is required as ldap_search() will fail if keys are not sequential
 277 	$t_search_attrs = array_values( array_unique( $t_search_attrs ) );
 278 
 279 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Searching for '$t_search_filter'" );
 280 	$t_sr = @ldap_search( $t_ds, $t_ldap_root_dn, $t_search_filter, $t_search_attrs );
 281 	if( $t_sr === false ) {
 282 		ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
 283 		ldap_unbind( $t_ds );
 284 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Search '$t_search_filter' failed" );
 285 		return false;
 286 	}
 287 
 288 	# Get results
 289 	$t_entry = ldap_first_entry( $t_ds, $t_sr );
 290 	if( $t_entry === false ) {
 291 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'No matches found.' );
 292 		$g_cache_ldap_data[$p_username] = false;
 293 		return false;
 294 	}
 295 
 296 	$t_data = array();
 297 	foreach( $t_search_attrs as $t_attr ) {
 298 		# Suppress error to avoid Warning in case an invalid attribute was specified
 299 		$t_value = @ldap_get_values( $t_ds, $t_entry, $t_attr );
 300 		if( $t_value === false ) {
 301 			log_event( LOG_LDAP, "WARNING: field '$t_attr' does not exist" );
 302 			continue;
 303 		}
 304 		$t_data[$t_attr] = $t_value[0];
 305 	}
 306 	if( empty( $t_data ) ) {
 307 		$t_data = false;
 308 	}
 309 
 310 	# Store data in the cache
 311 	$g_cache_ldap_data[$p_username] = $t_data;
 312 
 313 	# Unbind
 314 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Unbinding from LDAP server' );
 315 	ldap_unbind( $t_ds );
 316 
 317 	return $t_data;
 318 }
 319 
 320 /**
 321  * Gets the value of a specific LDAP field given the user name.
 322  *
 323  * Values are retrieved from the LDAP cache.
 324  * {@see ldap_cache_user_data()} for the list of valid field names.
 325  *
 326  * @param string $p_username The user name.
 327  * @param string $p_field    The LDAP field name.
 328  *
 329  * @return string The field value or null if not found.
 330  */
 331 function ldap_get_field_from_username( $p_username, $p_field ) {
 332 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Retrieving field '$p_field' for '$p_username'" );
 333 	$t_ldap_data = ldap_cache_user_data( $p_username );
 334 
 335 	# Make sure LDAP data is available and the requested field exists
 336 	if( !$t_ldap_data || !isset( $t_ldap_data[$p_field] ) ) {
 337 		return null;
 338 	}
 339 
 340 	return $t_ldap_data[$p_field];
 341 }
 342 
 343 /**
 344  * Attempt to authenticate the user against the LDAP directory
 345  * return true on successful authentication, false otherwise
 346  * @param integer $p_user_id  A valid user identifier.
 347  * @param string  $p_password A password to test against the user user.
 348  * @return boolean
 349  */
 350 function ldap_authenticate( $p_user_id, $p_password ) {
 351 	# if password is empty and ldap allows anonymous login, then
 352 	# the user will be able to login, hence, we need to check
 353 	# for this special case.
 354 	if( is_blank( $p_password ) ) {
 355 		return false;
 356 	}
 357 
 358 	$t_username = user_get_username( $p_user_id );
 359 
 360 	return ldap_authenticate_by_username( $t_username, $p_password );
 361 }
 362 
 363 /**
 364  * Authenticates a user via LDAP given the username and password.
 365  *
 366  * @param string $p_username The user name.
 367  * @param string $p_password The password.
 368  * @return true: authenticated, false: failed to authenticate.
 369  *
 370  * @noinspection PhpDocMissingThrowsInspection
 371  */
 372 function ldap_authenticate_by_username( $p_username, $p_password ) {
 373 	if( ldap_simulation_is_enabled() ) {
 374 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Authenticating via LDAP simulation' );
 375 		$t_authenticated = ldap_simulation_authenticate_by_username( $p_username, $p_password );
 376 	} else {
 377 		$c_username = ldap_escape_string( $p_username );
 378 
 379 		$t_ldap_organization = config_get_global( 'ldap_organization' );
 380 		$t_ldap_root_dn = config_get_global( 'ldap_root_dn' );
 381 
 382 		$t_ldap_uid_field = config_get_global( 'ldap_uid_field', 'uid' );
 383 		$t_search_filter = '(&' . $t_ldap_organization . '(' . $t_ldap_uid_field . '=' . $c_username . '))';
 384 		$t_search_attrs = array(
 385 			$t_ldap_uid_field,
 386 			'dn',
 387 		);
 388 
 389 		# Bind and connect.
 390 		# No need to check for failures, as ldap_connect_bind() throws errors.
 391 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Binding to LDAP server' );
 392 		$t_ds = ldap_connect_bind();
 393 
 394 		# Search for the user id
 395 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Searching for ' . $t_search_filter );
 396 		$t_sr = ldap_search( $t_ds, $t_ldap_root_dn, $t_search_filter, $t_search_attrs );
 397 		if( $t_sr === false ) {
 398 			ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
 399 			ldap_unbind( $t_ds );
 400 			log_event( LOG_LDAP, "Search '$t_search_filter' failed" );
 401 			trigger_error( ERROR_LDAP_AUTH_FAILED, ERROR );
 402 		}
 403 
 404 		$t_info = @ldap_get_entries( $t_ds, $t_sr );
 405 		if( $t_info === false ) {
 406 			ldap_log_error( $t_ds );
 407 			ldap_unbind( $t_ds );
 408 			trigger_error( ERROR_LDAP_AUTH_FAILED, ERROR );
 409 		}
 410 
 411 		$t_authenticated = false;
 412 
 413 		if( $t_info['count'] > 0 ) {
 414 			# Try to authenticate to each until we get a match
 415 			for( $i = 0; $i < $t_info['count']; $i++ ) {
 416 				$t_dn = $t_info[$i]['dn'];
 417 				log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Checking ' . $t_info[$i]['dn'] );
 418 
 419 				# Attempt to bind with the DN and password
 420 				if( @ldap_bind( $t_ds, $t_dn, $p_password ) ) {
 421 					$t_authenticated = true;
 422 					break;
 423 				}
 424 			}
 425 		} else {
 426 			log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'No matching entries found' );
 427 		}
 428 
 429 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Unbinding from LDAP server' );
 430 		ldap_unbind( $t_ds );
 431 	}
 432 
 433 	# If user authenticated successfully then update the local DB with information
 434 	# from LDAP.  This will allow us to use the local data after login without
 435 	# having to go back to LDAP.  This will also allow fallback to DB if LDAP is down.
 436 	if( $t_authenticated ) {
 437         /** @noinspection PhpUnhandledExceptionInspection */
 438         $t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $p_username );
 439 
 440 		if( false !== $t_user_id ) {
 441 
 442 			$t_fields_to_update = array('password' => md5( $p_password ));
 443 
 444 			if( ON == config_get_global( 'use_ldap_realname' ) ) {
 445 				$t_fields_to_update['realname'] = ldap_realname_from_username( $p_username );
 446 			}
 447 
 448 			if( ON == config_get_global( 'use_ldap_email' ) ) {
 449 				$t_fields_to_update['email'] = ldap_email_from_username( $p_username );
 450 			}
 451 
 452 			user_set_fields( $t_user_id, $t_fields_to_update );
 453 		}
 454 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'User \'' . $p_username . '\' authenticated' );
 455 	} else {
 456 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'Authentication failed' );
 457 	}
 458 
 459 	return $t_authenticated;
 460 }
 461 
 462 /**
 463  * Checks if the LDAP simulation mode is enabled.
 464  *
 465  * @return boolean true if enabled, false otherwise.
 466  */
 467 function ldap_simulation_is_enabled() {
 468 	$t_filename = config_get_global( 'ldap_simulation_file_path' );
 469 	return !is_blank( $t_filename );
 470 }
 471 
 472 /**
 473  * Gets a user from LDAP simulation mode given the username.
 474  *
 475  * @param string $p_username The user name.
 476  * @return array|null An associate array with user information or null if not found.
 477  */
 478 function ldap_simulation_get_user( $p_username ) {
 479 	$t_filename = config_get_global( 'ldap_simulation_file_path' );
 480 	$t_lines = file( $t_filename );
 481 	if( $t_lines === false ) {
 482 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'could not read simulation data from ' . $t_filename );
 483 		trigger_error( ERROR_LDAP_SERVER_CONNECT_FAILED, ERROR );
 484 	}
 485 
 486 	foreach ( $t_lines as $t_line ) {
 487 		$t_line = trim( $t_line, " \t\r\n" );
 488 		$t_row = explode( ',', $t_line );
 489 
 490 		if( $t_row[0] !== $p_username ) {
 491 			continue;
 492 		}
 493 
 494 		$t_user = array();
 495 
 496 		$t_user['username'] = $t_row[0];
 497 		$t_user['realname'] = $t_row[1];
 498 		$t_user['email'] = $t_row[2];
 499 		$t_user['password'] = $t_row[3];
 500 
 501 		return $t_user;
 502 	}
 503 
 504 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'user \'' . $p_username . '\' not found.' );
 505 	return null;
 506 }
 507 
 508 /**
 509  * Given a username, gets the email address or empty address if user is not found.
 510  *
 511  * @param string $p_username The user name.
 512  * @return string The email address or blank if user is not found.
 513  */
 514 function ldap_simulation_email_from_username( $p_username ) {
 515 	$t_user = ldap_simulation_get_user( $p_username );
 516 	if( $t_user === null ) {
 517 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'user \'' . $p_username . '\' not found.' );
 518 		return '';
 519 	}
 520 
 521 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'user \'' . $p_username . '\' has email \'' . $t_user['email'] .'\'.' );
 522 	return $t_user['email'];
 523 }
 524 
 525 /**
 526  * Given a username, this methods gets the realname or empty string if not found.
 527  *
 528  * @param string $p_username The username.
 529  * @return string The real name or an empty string if not found.
 530  */
 531 function ldap_simulatiom_realname_from_username( $p_username ) {
 532 	$t_user = ldap_simulation_get_user( $p_username );
 533 	if( $t_user === null ) {
 534 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'ldap_simulatiom_realname_from_username: user \'' . $p_username . '\' not found.' );
 535 		return '';
 536 	}
 537 
 538 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'ldap_simulatiom_realname_from_username: user \'' . $p_username . '\' has real name \'' . $t_user['realname'] . '\'.' );
 539 	return $t_user['realname'];
 540 }
 541 
 542 /**
 543  * Authenticates the specified user id / password based on the simulation data.
 544  *
 545  * @param string $p_username The username.
 546  * @param string $p_password The password.
 547  * @return boolean true for authenticated, false otherwise.
 548  */
 549 function ldap_simulation_authenticate_by_username( $p_username, $p_password ) {
 550 	$c_username = ldap_escape_string( $p_username );
 551 
 552 	$t_user = ldap_simulation_get_user( $c_username );
 553 	if( $t_user === null ) {
 554 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'user \'' . $p_username . '\' not found.' );
 555 		return false;
 556 	}
 557 
 558 	if( $t_user['password'] != $p_password ) {
 559 		log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'expected password \'' . $t_user['password'] . '\' and got \'' . $p_password . '\'.' );
 560 		return false;
 561 	}
 562 
 563 	log_event( LOG_LDAP, 'authentication successful for user \'' . $p_username . '\'.' );
 564 	return true;
 565 }

  17 /**
  18  * Logging API
  19  *
  20  * Provides functionality to log system events other than bug related history.
  21  *
  22  * @package CoreAPI
  23  * @subpackage LoggingAPI
  24  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  25  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  26  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  27  *
  28  * @uses collapse_api.php
  29  * @uses config_api.php
  30  * @uses constant_inc.php
  31  * @uses event_api.php
  32  * @uses utility_api.php
  33  */
  34 
  35 require_api( 'collapse_api.php' );
  36 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  37 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  38 require_api( 'event_api.php' );
  39 require_api( 'utility_api.php' );
  40 
  41 $g_log_levels = array(
  42 	LOG_EMAIL => 'MAIL',
  43 	LOG_EMAIL_RECIPIENT => 'RECIPIENT',
  44 	LOG_EMAIL_VERBOSE => 'MAIL_VERBOSE',
  45 	LOG_FILTERING => 'FILTER',
  46 	LOG_AJAX => 'AJAX',
  47 	LOG_LDAP => 'LDAP',
  48 	LOG_DATABASE => 'DB',
  49 	LOG_WEBSERVICE => 'WEBSERVICE',
  50 	LOG_PLUGIN => 'PLUGIN',
  51 );
  52 
  53 /**
  54  * Log an event.
  55  *
  56  * @param integer      $p_level Valid debug log level.
  57  * @param string|array $p_msg   Either a string, or an array structured as (string,execution time).
  58  *
  59  * @return void
  60  */
  61 function log_event( $p_level, $p_msg ) {
  62 	global $g_log_levels;
  63 
  64 	# check to see if logging is enabled
  65 	$t_sys_log = config_get_global( 'log_level' );
  66 
  67 	if( 0 == ( $t_sys_log & $p_level ) ) {
  68 		return;
  69 	}
  70 
  71 	if( is_array( $p_msg ) ) {
  72 		$t_event = $p_msg;
  73 		$t_msg = var_export( $p_msg, true );
  74 	} else {
  75 		if( func_num_args() > 2 ) {
  76 			$t_args = func_get_args();
  77 			array_shift( $t_args ); # skip level
  78 			array_shift( $t_args ); # skip message
  79 			$p_msg = vsprintf( $p_msg, $t_args );
  80 		}
  81 		$t_event = array( $p_msg, 0 );
  82 		$t_msg = $p_msg;
  83 	}
  84 
  85 	$t_caller = log_get_caller( $p_level );
  86 
  87 	$t_now = date( config_get_global( 'complete_date_format' ) );
  88 	$t_level = $g_log_levels[$p_level];
  89 
  90 	# Prevent recursion from plugins hooked on EVENT_LOG
  91 	static $s_event_log_called = false;
  92 	# Checking existence of event_signal function is required, because Logging
  93 	# API is loaded before Event API.
  94 	if( !$s_event_log_called && function_exists( 'event_signal' ) ) {
  95 		$t_plugin_event = '[' . $t_level . '] ' . $t_msg;
  96 		$s_event_log_called = true;
  97 		event_signal( 'EVENT_LOG', array( $t_plugin_event ) );
  98 		$s_event_log_called = false;
  99 	}
 100 
 101 	$t_log_destination = config_get_global( 'log_destination' );
 102 
 103 	if( is_blank( $t_log_destination ) ) {
 104 		$t_destination = '';
 105 	} else {
 106 		$t_result = explode( ':', $t_log_destination, 2 );
 107 		$t_destination = $t_result[0];
 108 		if( isset( $t_result[1] ) ) {
 109 			$t_modifiers = $t_result[1];
 110 		}
 111 	}
 112 
 113 	$t_php_event = $t_now . ' ' . $t_level . ' ' . $t_caller . ' ' . $t_msg;
 114 
 115 	switch( $t_destination ) {
 116 		case 'none':
 117 			break;
 118 		case 'file':
 119 			if( isset( $t_modifiers ) ) {
 120 				static $s_log_writable = null;
 121 
 122 				if( $s_log_writable ) {
 123 					error_log( $t_php_event . PHP_EOL, 3, $t_modifiers );
 124 				} elseif( $s_log_writable === null ) {
 125 					# Try to log the event, suppress errors in case the file is not writable
 126 					$s_log_writable = @error_log( $t_php_event . PHP_EOL, 3, $t_modifiers );
 127 
 128 					if( !$s_log_writable ) {
 129 						# Display a one-time warning message and write it to PHP system log as well.
 130 						# Note: to ensure the error is shown regardless of $g_display_error settings,
 131 						# we manually set the message and log it with error_log_delayed(), which will
 132 						# cause it to be displayed at page bottom.
 133 						error_parameters( $t_modifiers );
 134 						$t_message = error_string( ERROR_LOGFILE_NOT_WRITABLE );
 135 						error_log_delayed( $t_message );
 136 						error_log( 'MantisBT - ' . htmlspecialchars_decode( $t_message ) );
 137 					}
 138 				}
 139 			}
 140 			break;
 141 		case 'page':
 142 			global $g_log_events;
 143 			$g_log_events[] = array( time(), $p_level, $t_event, $t_caller);
 144 			break;
 145 		default:
 146 			# use default PHP error log settings
 147 			error_log( $t_php_event . PHP_EOL );
 148 			break;
 149 	}
 150 
 151 	# If running from command line, echo log event to stdout
 152 	if( $t_destination != 'none' && php_sapi_name() == 'cli' ) {
 153 		echo $t_php_event . PHP_EOL;
 154 	}
 155 }

 157 /**
 158  * Print logging api output to bottom of html page.
 159  *
 160  * @return void
 161  * @throws \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\Exception
 162  */
 163 function log_print_to_page() {
 164 	if( !helper_log_to_page() ) {
 165 		return;
 166 	}
 167 
 168 	global $g_log_events, $g_log_levels, $g_email_shutdown_processing;
 169 
 170 	if( $g_email_shutdown_processing ) {
 171 		email_send_all();
 172 	}
 173 
 174 
 175 	$t_total_event_count = count( $g_log_events ?? [] );
 176 	$t_total_query_execution_time = 0;
 177 	$t_unique_queries = array();
 178 	$t_total_queries_count = 0;
 179 
 180 	$t_icon = icon_get( 'fa-flag-o', 'ace-icon' );
 181 	$t_section_title = lang_get( 'debug_log' );
 182 	$t_collapse_block = is_collapsed( 'debuglog' );
 183 	$t_block_css = $t_collapse_block ? ' collapsed' : '';
 184 	$t_block_icon = icon_get(
 185 		$t_collapse_block ? 'fa-chevron-down' : 'fa-chevron-up',
 186 		'1 ace-icon bigger-125'
 187 	);
 188 	echo <<<HTML
 189 
 190 		<!-- Mantis Debug Log Output -->
 191 		<div class="space-10"></div>
 192 		<div class="row">
 193 			<div class="col-xs-12">
 194 				<div id="debuglog" class="widget-box widget-color-red$t_block_css">
 195 					<div class="widget-header widget-header-small">
 196 						<h4 class="widget-title lighter">
 197 							$t_icon 
 198 							$t_section_title
 199 							<span class="badge">$t_total_event_count</span>
 200 						</h4>
 201 						<div class="widget-toolbar">
 202 							<a data-action="collapse" href="#">$t_block_icon</a>
 203 						</div>
 204 					</div>
 205 					<div class="widget-body">
 206 
 207 		HTML;
 208 
 209 	if( $g_log_events ) {
 210 		# Table header
 211 		$t_columns = [
 212 			'log_page_number',
 213 			'log_page_time',
 214 			'log_page_caller',
 215 			'log_page_event',
 216 		];
 217 		echo <<<HTML
 218 						<div class="widget-main no-padding">
 219 							<div class="table-responsive">
 220 								<table id="log-event-list" class="table table-bordered table-condensed table-striped">
 221 									<thead>
 222 										<tr class="small-caption">
 223 
 224 		HTML;
 225 		foreach( $t_columns as $t_column ) {
 226 			echo '<th>' . lang_get( $t_column ) . '</th>' . PHP_EOL;
 227 		}
 228 		echo <<<HTML
 229 						</tr>
 230 					</thead>
 231 					<tbody>
 232 
 233 		HTML;
 234 
 235 		$t_print_row_format = '<tr class="%s">' . PHP_EOL
 236 			. str_repeat( "\t<td>%s</td>\n", 4 )
 237 			. '</tr>' . PHP_EOL;
 238 		$t_count = [];
 239 		foreach( array_keys( $g_log_levels ) as $t_level ) {
 240 			$t_count[$t_level] = 0;
 241 		}
 242 		foreach( $g_log_events as $t_log_event ) {
 243 			$t_level = $t_log_event[1];
 244 			$t_count[$t_level]++;
 245 
 246 			$t_class = 'small';
 247 			if( $t_level == LOG_DATABASE ) {
 248 				# Compute Statistics for DB queries
 249 				if( !in_array( $t_log_event[2][0], $t_unique_queries ) ) {
 250 					$t_unique_queries[] = $t_log_event[2][0];
 251 				} else {
 252 					$t_class .= ' duplicate-query';
 253 				}
 254 				$t_total_query_execution_time += $t_log_event[2][1];
 255 				$t_total_queries_count++;
 256 			}
 257 
 258 			# Print row
 259 			printf( $t_print_row_format,
 260 				$t_class,
 261 				$g_log_levels[$t_level] . '-' . $t_count[$t_log_event[1]],
 262 				$t_log_event[2][1] ?: '',
 263 				string_html_specialchars( $t_log_event[3] ),
 264 				string_html_specialchars( $t_log_event[2][0] )
 265 			);
 266 		} # foreach $g_log_events
 267 
 268 		# Print statistics
 269 		$t_statistics = [
 270 			'total_queries_executed' => $t_total_queries_count,
 271 			'unique_queries_executed' => count( $t_unique_queries ),
 272 			'total_query_execution_time' => $t_total_query_execution_time,
 273 		];
 274 		foreach( $t_statistics as $t_stat => $t_value ) {
 275 			if( $t_value ) {
 276 				printf($t_print_row_format,
 277 				'small',
 278 					$g_log_levels[LOG_DATABASE],
 279 					'',
 280 					'',
 281 					sprintf( lang_get( $t_stat ), $t_value )
 282 				);
 283 			}
 284 		}
 285 
 286 		echo <<<HTML
 287 					</tbody>
 288 				</table>
 289 			</div>
 290 		</div>
 291 
 292 		HTML;
 293 	} else {
 294 		echo '<div class="widget-main">', lang_get( 'debug_log_empty' ), '</div>';
 295 	}
 296 
 297 	echo <<<HTML
 298 				</div>
 299 			</div>
 300 		</div>
 301 	</div>
 302 	<div class="space-10"></div>
 303 	<!--END Mantis Debug Log Output-->
 304 
 305 
 306 	HTML;
 307 }

 309 /**
 310  * Builds a string with information from the call backtrace of current logging action.
 311  *
 312  * The output format is, where available:
 313  *    {plugin} {file}:{line} {class}[::|->]{function}
 314  *
 315  * Some of the actual backtrace is removed to get more informative line to the user.
 316  * The log type is used to selectively remove some internal call traces.
 317  *
 318  * @param int $p_level Log level type constant
 319  *
 320  * @return string Output string with caller information
 321  */
 322 function log_get_caller( $p_level = null ) {
 323 	$t_full_backtrace = debug_backtrace();
 324 	$t_backtrace = $t_full_backtrace;
 325 	$t_root_path = dirname( __DIR__ ) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
 326 
 327 	# Remove top trace, as it's this function
 328 	unset( $t_backtrace[0] );
 329 
 330 	# Remove trace step from the include in plugin.php
 331 	# if any log is triggered from the body of a plugin page, we don't want
 332 	# to show the caller function "include()" from plugin.php
 333 	$t_last = end( $t_backtrace );
 334 	$t_last_key = key( $t_backtrace );
 335 	if( isset( $t_last['function'] )
 336 		&& $t_last['function'] == 'include'
 337 		&& $t_last['file'] == $t_root_path . 'plugin.php'
 338 		) {
 339 		unset( $t_backtrace[$t_last_key] );
 340 		unset( $t_full_backtrace[$t_last_key] );
 341 	}
 342 
 343 	# Iterate over the backtrace and clean up some steps to show a cleaner info
 344 	foreach( $t_backtrace as $t_index => $t_step ) {
 345 
 346 		# Remove special cases of steps for each log type
 347 		switch( $p_level ) {
 348 			# For plugin logs, we want to hide the plugin api calls
 349 			case LOG_PLUGIN:
 350 				if( isset( $t_step['function'] ) ) {
 351 					# Remove trace step executed for plugin_log_event()
 352 					if( $t_step['function'] == 'plugin_log_event'
 353 						&& $t_full_backtrace[$t_index-1]['file'] == $t_root_path . 'core/plugin_api.php'
 354 						) {
 355 						unset( $t_backtrace[$t_index-1] );
 356 						continue 2; # next foreach
 357 					}
 358 				}
 359 				break;
 360 
 361 			# For database logs, we want to hide all the intermediate db api calls
 362 			case LOG_DATABASE:
 363 				# Remove trace steps that are executed inside DbQuery class, or inherited classes
 364 				if( isset( $t_step['class'] ) && (
 365 					$t_step['class'] == 'DbQuery'
 366 					|| is_subclass_of( $t_step['class'], 'DbQuery', true )
 367 					) ) {
 368 					unset( $t_backtrace[$t_index-1] );
 369 					continue 2; # next foreach
 370 				}
 371 				if( isset( $t_step['function'] ) ) {
 372 					# Remove trace step executed for db_query() or db_query_bound()
 373 					if( ( $t_step['function'] == 'db_query' || $t_step['function'] == 'db_query_bound' )
 374 						&& $t_full_backtrace[$t_index-1]['file'] == $t_root_path . 'core/database_api.php'
 375 						) {
 376 						unset( $t_backtrace[$t_index-1] );
 377 						continue 2; # next foreach
 378 					}
 379 				}
 380 				break;
 381 		}
 382 
 383 		# shortcut break the loop as soon as there is a step that has not been deleted.
 384 		reset( $t_backtrace );
 385 		$t_first_key = key( $t_backtrace );
 386 		# note, we are deleting steps at <current index> - 1
 387 		# this section is only reached when no deletion has been performed
 388 		if( $t_index > $t_first_key ) {
 389 			break;
 390 		}
 391 	}
 392 
 393 	# At this point, first step in the cleaned backtrace is the one we want to show
 394 	$t_step = reset( $t_backtrace);
 395 	$t_step_key = key( $t_backtrace );
 396 	$t_caller_file = basename( $t_step['file'] );
 397 	$t_caller_line = $t_step['line'];
 398 	$t_caller_function = '';
 399 	$t_caller_class = '';
 400 	$t_caller_plugin = ( LOG_PLUGIN == $p_level ) ? plugin_get_current() . ' ' : '';
 401 	# Get the function that called this, from the next backtrace step, if it exists
 402 	if( isset( $t_full_backtrace[$t_step_key+1] ) ) {
 403 		$t_caller_function = $t_full_backtrace[$t_step_key+1]['function'] . '()';
 404 		if( isset( $t_full_backtrace[$t_step_key+1]['class'] ) ) {
 405 			$t_caller_class = $t_full_backtrace[$t_step_key+1]['class'];
 406 			$t_caller_class .= $t_full_backtrace[$t_step_key+1]['type'];
 407 		}
 408 	}
 409 
 410 	$t_caller = $t_caller_plugin . $t_caller_file . ':' . $t_caller_line . ' '
 411 			. $t_caller_class . $t_caller_function;
 412 	return $t_caller;
 413 }

  17 /**

  19  *
  20  * @package CoreAPI
  21  * @subpackage LanguageAPI
  22  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org

  33 /**
  34  * Check if @ mentions feature is enabled or not.
  35  *
  36  * @return bool true enabled, false otherwise.
  37  */
  38 function mention_enabled() {
  39 	return config_get( 'mentions_enabled' ) != OFF;
  40 }
  41 
  42 /**
  43  * Get the tag to use for mentions.
  44  * @return string The mentions tag.
  45  */
  46 function mentions_tag() {
  47 	return config_get( 'mentions_tag', null, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS );
  48 }
  49 
  50 /**
  51  * A method that takes in a text argument and extracts all candidate @ mentions
  52  * from it.  The return list will not include the @ sign and will not include
  53  * duplicates.  This method is mainly for testability and it doesn't take into
  54  * consideration whether the @ mentions features is enabled or not.
  55  *
  56  * @param string $p_text The text to process.
  57  * @return array of @ mentions without the @ sign.
  58  * @private
  59  */
  60 function mention_get_candidates( $p_text ) {
  61 	if( is_blank( $p_text ) ) {
  62 		return array();
  63 	}
  64 
  65 	static $s_pattern = null;
  66 	if( $s_pattern === null ) {
  67 		$t_quoted_tag = preg_quote( mentions_tag() );
  68 		$s_pattern = '/(?:'
  69 			# Negative lookbehind to ensure we have whitespace or start of
  70 			# string before the tag - ensures we don't match a tag in the
  71 			# middle of a word (e.g. e-mail address)
  72 			. '(?<=^|[^\w])'
  73 			# Negative lookbehind  to ensure we don't match multiple tags
  74 			. '(?<!' . $t_quoted_tag . ')' . $t_quoted_tag
  75 			. ')'
  76 			# any word char, dash or period, must end with word char
  77 			. '([\w\-.]*[\w])'
  78 			# Lookforward to ensure next char is not a valid mention char or
  79 			# the end of the string, or the mention tag
  80 			. '(?=[^\w@]|$)'
  81 			. '(?!$t_quoted_tag)'
  82 			. '/';
  83 	}
  84 
  85 	preg_match_all( $s_pattern, $p_text, $t_mentions );
  86 
  87 	return array_unique( $t_mentions[1] );
  88 }
  89 
  90 /**
  91  * Given a string find the @ mentioned users.  The return list is a valid
  92  * list of valid mentioned users.  The list will be empty if the mentions
  93  * feature is disabled.
  94  *
  95  * @param string $p_text The text to process.
  96  * @return array with valid usernames as keys and their ids as values.
  97  */
  98 function mention_get_users( $p_text ) {
  99 	if ( !mention_enabled() ) {
 100 		return array();
 101 	}
 102 
 103 	$t_matches = mention_get_candidates( $p_text );
 104 	if( empty( $t_matches )) {
 105 		return array();
 106 	}
 107 
 108 	$t_mentioned_users = array();
 109 
 110 	foreach( $t_matches as $t_candidate ) {
 111 		if( $t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $t_candidate ) ) {
 112 			if( false === $t_user_id ) {
 113 				continue;
 114 			}
 115 
 116 			$t_mentioned_users[$t_candidate] = $t_user_id;
 117 		}
 118 	}
 119 
 120 	return $t_mentioned_users;
 121 }
 122 
 123 /**
 124  * Process users that are mentioned on the specified bug.
 125  *
 126  * @param int $p_bug_id The bug id.
 127  * @param array $p_mentioned_user_ids An array of user ids
 128  * @param string $p_message The message containing the mentions.
 129  * @param array $p_removed_mentions_user_ids The list of ids removed due to lack of access to issue or note.
 130  * @return array array of user ids actually received mention notifications.
 131  */
 132 function mention_process_user_mentions( $p_bug_id, $p_mentioned_user_ids, $p_message, $p_removed_mentions_user_ids ) {
 133 	return email_user_mention( $p_bug_id, $p_mentioned_user_ids, $p_message, $p_removed_mentions_user_ids );
 134 }
 135 
 136 /**
 137  * Format and hyperlink mentions
 138  *
 139  * @param string $p_text The text to process.
 140  * @param bool $p_html true for html, false otherwise.
 141  * @return string The processed text.
 142  */
 143 function mention_format_text( $p_text, $p_html = true ) {
 144 	$t_mentioned_users = mention_get_users( $p_text );
 145 	if( empty( $t_mentioned_users ) ) {
 146 		return $p_text;
 147 	}
 148 
 149 	$t_mentions_tag = mentions_tag();
 150 	$t_formatted_mentions = array();
 151 
 152 	foreach( $t_mentioned_users as $t_username => $t_user_id  ) {
 153 		$t_mention = $t_mentions_tag . $t_username;
 154 		$t_mention_formatted = $t_mention;
 155 
 156 		if( $p_html ) {
 157 			$t_mention_formatted = string_display_line( $t_mention_formatted );
 158 
 159 			$t_mention_formatted = '<a href="' . string_sanitize_url( 'view_user_page.php?id=' . $t_user_id, true ) . '">' . $t_mention_formatted . '</a>';
 160 
 161 			if( !user_is_enabled( $t_user_id ) ) {
 162 				$t_mention_formatted = '<s>' . $t_mention_formatted . '</s>';
 163 			}
 164 
 165 			$t_mention_formatted = '<span class="mention">' . $t_mention_formatted . '</span>';
 166 		}
 167 
 168 		$t_formatted_mentions[$t_mention] = $t_mention_formatted;
 169 	}
 170 
 171 	# Replace the mentions, ignoring existing anchor tags (otherwise
 172 	# previously set mailto links would be processed as mentions,
 173 	# corrupting the output
 174 	$t_text = string_process_exclude_anchors(
 175 		$p_text,
 176 		function( $p_string ) use ( $t_formatted_mentions ) {
 177 			return str_replace(
 178 				array_keys( $t_formatted_mentions ),
 179 				array_values( $t_formatted_mentions ),
 180 				$p_string
 181 			);
 182 		}
 183 	);
 184 
 185 	return $t_text;
 186 }
 187

  48 /**
  49  * Add a news item
  50  *
  51  * @param integer $p_project_id   A project identifier.
  52  * @param integer $p_poster_id    The user id of poster.
  53  * @param integer $p_view_state   View state.
  54  * @param boolean $p_announcement Whether article is an announcement.
  55  * @param string  $p_headline     News Headline.
  56  * @param string  $p_body         News Body.
  57  * @return integer news article id
  58  */
  59 function news_create( $p_project_id, $p_poster_id, $p_view_state, $p_announcement, $p_headline, $p_body ) {
  60 	if( is_blank( $p_headline ) ) {
  61 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'headline' ) );
  62 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
  63 	}
  64 
  65 	if( is_blank( $p_body ) ) {
  66 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'body' ) );
  67 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
  68 	}
  69 
  70 	db_param_push();
  71 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {news}
  72 	    		  ( project_id, poster_id, date_posted, last_modified,
  73 	    		    view_state, announcement, headline, body )
  74 				VALUES
  75 				    ( ' . db_param() . ',
  76 				      ' . db_param() . ',
  77 				      ' . db_param() . ',
  78 				      ' . db_param() . ',
  79 				      ' . db_param() . ',
  80 				      ' . db_param() . ',
  81 				      ' . db_param() . ',
  82 				      ' . db_param() . '
  83 					)';
  84 	db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_project_id, (int)$p_poster_id, db_now(), db_now(), (int)$p_view_state, $p_announcement, $p_headline, $p_body ) );
  85 
  86 	$t_news_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'news' ) );
  87 
  88 	return $t_news_id;
  89 }
  90

 126 function news_update( $p_news_id, $p_project_id, $p_view_state, $p_announcement, $p_headline, $p_body ) {

 130 	}
 131 
 132 	if( is_blank( $p_body ) ) {
