 136 
 137 	# Update entry
 138 	db_param_push();
 139 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {news}
 140 				  SET view_state=' . db_param() . ',
 141 					announcement=' . db_param() . ',
 142 					headline=' . db_param() . ',
 143 					body=' . db_param() . ',
 144 					project_id=' . db_param() . ',
 145 					last_modified= ' . db_param() . '
 146 				  WHERE id=' . db_param();
 147 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_view_state, $p_announcement, $p_headline, $p_body, $p_project_id, db_now(), $p_news_id ) );

 170 /**
 171  * get news count (selected project plus site wide posts)
 172  *
 173  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 174  * @param boolean $p_global     Whether this is site wide news i.e. ALL_PROJECTS.
 175  * @return int news count
 176  */
 177 function news_get_count( $p_project_id, $p_global = true ) {
 178 	$t_project_where = helper_project_specific_where( $p_project_id );
 179 
 180 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {news} WHERE ' . $t_project_where;
 181 
 182 	if( $p_global ) {
 183 		$t_query .= ' OR project_id=' . ALL_PROJECTS;
 184 	}
 185 
 186 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query );
 187 
 188 	return db_result( $t_result, 0 );

 191 /**
 192  * get news items (selected project plus site wide posts)
 193  *
 194  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 195  * @param boolean $p_global     Whether this is site wide news i.e. ALL_PROJECTS.
 196  * @return array Array of news articles
 197  */
 198 function news_get_rows( $p_project_id, $p_global = true ) {
 199 	$t_projects = current_user_get_all_accessible_subprojects( $p_project_id );
 200 	$t_projects[] = (int)$p_project_id;
 201 
 202 	if( $p_global && ALL_PROJECTS != $p_project_id ) {
 203 		$t_projects[] = ALL_PROJECTS;
 204 	}
 205 
 206 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {news}';
 207 
 208 	if( 1 == count( $t_projects ) ) {
 209 		$c_project_id = $t_projects[0];
 210 		$t_query .= ' WHERE project_id=\'$c_project_id\'';
 211 	} else {
 212 		$t_query .= ' WHERE project_id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_projects ) . ')';
 213 	}
 214 
 215 	$t_query .= ' ORDER BY date_posted DESC';
 216 
 217 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array() );
 218 
 219 	$t_rows = array();
 220 
 221 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 222 		array_push( $t_rows, $t_row );
 223 	}
 224 
 225 	return $t_rows;
 226 }

 228 /**
 229  * Get field from news item

 234  */
 235 function news_get_field( $p_news_id, $p_field_name ) {
 236 	$t_row = news_get_row( $p_news_id );
 237 	return( $t_row[$p_field_name] );

 240 /**
 241  * Check if the specified news item is private
 242  *
 243  * @param integer $p_news_id A news article identifier.
 244  * @return boolean
 245  */
 246 function news_is_private( $p_news_id ) {
 247 	return( news_get_field( $p_news_id, 'view_state' ) == VS_PRIVATE );
 248 }

 250 /**
 251  * Gets a limited set of news rows to be viewed on one page based on the criteria
 252  * defined in the configuration file.
 253  *
 254  * @param integer $p_offset     Offset.
 255  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 256  * @return array
 257  */
 258 function news_get_limited_rows( $p_offset, $p_project_id = null ) {
 259 	if( $p_project_id === null ) {
 260 		$p_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 261 	}
 262 
 263 	$c_offset = (int)$p_offset;
 264 
 265 	$t_projects = current_user_get_all_accessible_subprojects( $p_project_id );
 266 	$t_projects[] = (int)$p_project_id;
 267 	if( ALL_PROJECTS != $p_project_id ) {
 268 		$t_projects[] = ALL_PROJECTS;
 269 	}
 270 
 271 	$t_news_view_limit = config_get( 'news_view_limit' );
 272 	$t_news_view_limit_days = config_get( 'news_view_limit_days' ) * SECONDS_PER_DAY;
 273 
 274 	switch( config_get( 'news_limit_method' ) ) {
 275 		case 0:
 276 			db_param_push();
 277 			
 278 			# BY_LIMIT - Select the news posts
 279 			$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {news}';
 280 
 281 			if( 1 == count( $t_projects ) ) {
 282 				$c_project_id = $t_projects[0];
 283 				$t_query .= ' WHERE project_id=' . db_param();
 284 				$t_params = array( $c_project_id );
 285 			} else {
 286 				$t_query .= ' WHERE project_id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_projects ) . ')';
 287 				$t_params = [];
 288 			}
 289 
 290 			$t_query .= ' ORDER BY announcement DESC, id DESC';
 291 			$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params, $t_news_view_limit, $c_offset );
 292 			break;
 293 		case 1:
 294 			db_param_push();
 295 			
 296 			# BY_DATE - Select the news posts
 297 			$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {news} WHERE
 298 						( ' . db_helper_compare_time( db_param(), '<', 'date_posted', $t_news_view_limit_days ) . '
 299 						 OR announcement = ' . db_param() . ' ) ';
 300 			$t_params = array(
 301 				db_now(),
 302 				1,
 303 			);
 304 			if( 1 == count( $t_projects ) ) {
 305 				$c_project_id = $t_projects[0];
 306 				$t_query .= ' AND project_id=' . db_param();
 307 				$t_params[] = $c_project_id;
 308 			} else {
 309 				$t_query .= ' AND project_id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_projects ) . ')';
 310 			}
 311 			$t_query .= ' ORDER BY announcement DESC, id DESC';
 312 			$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params, $t_news_view_limit, $c_offset );
 313 			break;
 314 	}
 315 
 316 	$t_rows = array();
 317 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 318 		array_push( $t_rows, $t_row );
 319 	}
 320 
 321 	return $t_rows;
 322 }

 324 /**
 325  * Checks if the news feature is enabled or not.
 326  * true: enabled, otherwise false.
 327  * @return boolean

 329 function news_is_enabled() {

 331 }

 333 /**
 334  * Ensures that the news feature is enabled, otherwise generates an access denied error.
 335  * @return void
 336  */
 337 function news_ensure_enabled() {
 338 	if( !news_is_enabled() ) {
 339 		access_denied();
 340 	}
 341 }

  17 /**
  18  * PHP Compatibility API
  19  *
  20  * Provides functions to assist with backwards compatibility between PHP
  21  * versions.
  22  *
  23  * @package CoreAPI
  24  * @subpackage PHPCompatibilityAPI
  25  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  26  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  27  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  28  */
  29 
  30 /**
  31  * Determine if PHP is running in CLI or CGI mode and return the mode.
  32  * @return int PHP mode
  33  */
  34 function php_mode() {
  35 	static $s_mode = null;
  36 
  37 	if( is_null( $s_mode ) ) {
  38 		# Check to see if this is CLI mode or CGI mode
  39 		if( isset( $_SERVER['SERVER_ADDR'] )
  40 			|| isset( $_SERVER['LOCAL_ADDR'] )
  41 			|| isset( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ) ) {
  42 			$s_mode = PHP_CGI;
  43 		} else {
  44 			$s_mode = PHP_CLI;
  45 		}
  46 	}
  47 
  48 	return $s_mode;
  49 }

  88 $g_plugin_current = array();

 206 /**
 207  * Returns the path to a plugin file, or the plugin's files directory.
 208  *
 209  * @param string $p_filename  File name; if not set, the function will return the plugin's files directory.
 210  * @param string $p_base_name Plugin base name (defaults to the current plugin).
 211  *
 212  * @return string|false File path or false if file cannot be found.
 213  */
 214 function plugin_file_path( $p_filename = '', $p_base_name = '' ) {
 215 	$t_file_path = config_get_global( 'plugin_path' )
 216 		. ( $p_base_name ?: plugin_get_current() ) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR
 217 		. 'files' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
 218 
 219 	if( !$p_filename ) {
 220 		return $t_file_path;
 221 	}
 222 	$t_file_path .= $p_filename;
 223 
 224 	return( is_file( $t_file_path ) ? $t_file_path : false );
 225 }

 249 /**
 250  * Include the contents of a file as output.
 251  *
 252  * @param string $p_filename File name.
 253  * @param string $p_basename Plugin basename.
 254  *
 255  * @return void
 256  */
 257 function plugin_file_include( $p_filename, $p_basename = null ) {
 258 	global $g_plugin_mime_types;
 259 
 260 	if( is_null( $p_basename ) ) {
 261 		$t_current = plugin_get_current();
 262 	} else {
 263 		$t_current = $p_basename;
 264 	}
 265 
 266 	$t_file_path = plugin_file_path( $p_filename, $t_current );
 267 	if( false === $t_file_path ) {
 268 		error_parameters( $t_current, $p_filename );
 269 		trigger_error( ERROR_PLUGIN_FILE_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 270 	}
 271 
 272 	$t_content_type = '';
 273 
 274 	# allow overriding the content type for specific text and image extensions
 275 	# see bug #13193 for details
 276 	$t_extension = pathinfo( $t_file_path, PATHINFO_EXTENSION );
 277 	if( $t_extension && array_key_exists( $t_extension, $g_plugin_mime_types ) ) {
 278 		$t_content_type = $g_plugin_mime_types[$t_extension];
 279 	}
 280 
 281 	if( !$t_content_type ) {
 282 		$t_file_info_type = file_get_mime_type( $t_file_path );
 283 		if( $t_file_info_type !== false ) {
 284 			$t_content_type = $t_file_info_type;
 285 		}
 286 	}
 287 
 288 	if( $t_content_type ) {
 289 		header( 'Content-Type: ' . $t_content_type );
 290 	}
 291 
 292 	$t_mtime = @filemtime( $t_file_path );
 293 	header( 'Last-Modified: ' . gmdate( 'D, d M Y H:i:s \G\M\T', $t_mtime ) );
 294 	if( isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_IF_MODIFIED_SINCE'] )
 295 		&& ( $t_mtime <= strtotime( $_SERVER['HTTP_IF_MODIFIED_SINCE'] ) ) ) {
 296 		http_response_code( HTTP_STATUS_NOT_MODIFIED );
 297 	} else {
 298 		readfile( $t_file_path );
 299 	}
 300 }

 302 /**
 303  * Given a base table name for a plugin, add appropriate prefix and suffix.
 304  *
 305  * Convenience for plugin schema definitions.
 306  *
 307  * @param string $p_name     Table name.
 308  * @param string $p_basename Plugin basename (defaults to current plugin).
 309  *
 310  * @return string Full table name
 311  */
 312 function plugin_table( $p_name, $p_basename = null ) {
 313 	if( is_null( $p_basename ) ) {
 314 		$t_current = plugin_get_current();
 315 	} else {
 316 		$t_current = $p_basename;
 317 	}
 318 
 319 	# Determine plugin table prefix including trailing '_'
 320 	$t_prefix = trim( config_get_global( 'db_table_plugin_prefix' ) );
 321 	if( !empty( $t_prefix ) && '_' != substr( $t_prefix, -1 ) ) {
 322 		$t_prefix .= '_';
 323 	}
 324 
 325 	return db_get_table( $t_prefix . $t_current . '_' . $p_name );
 326 }

 508  * functions will not be called.

 520 /**
 521  * Hook multiple plugin callbacks at once.
 522  *
 523  * @param array $p_hooks Array of event name/callback key/value pairs.
 524  *
 525  * @return bool True if all events were successfully hooked, false otherwise.
 526  */
 527 function plugin_event_hook_many( array $p_hooks ) {
 528 	$t_basename = plugin_get_current();
 529 
 530 	$t_return = true;
 531 	foreach( $p_hooks as $t_event => $t_callbacks ) {
 532 		if( !is_array( $t_callbacks ) ) {
 533 			$t_callbacks = array( $t_callbacks );
 534 		}
 535 		foreach( $t_callbacks as $t_callback ) {
 536 			if( !event_hook( $t_event, $t_callback, $t_basename ) ) {
 537 				$t_return = false;
 538 			}
 539 		}
 540 	}
 541 	return $t_return;
 542 }

 577 /**
 578  * Checks two versions for minimum or maximum version dependencies.
 579  *
 580  * @param string $p_version  Version number to check.
 581  * @param string $p_required Version number required.
 582  * @param bool   $p_maximum  Minimum (false) or maximum (true) version check.¨
 583  *
 584  * @return int 1 if the version dependency succeeds, -1 if it fails
 585  */
 586 function plugin_version_check( $p_version, $p_required, $p_maximum = false ) {
 587 	if( $p_maximum ) {
 588 		$t_operator = '<';
 589 	} else {
 590 		$t_operator = '>=';
 591 	}
 592 	$t_result = version_compare( $p_version, $p_required, $t_operator );
 593 	return $t_result ? 1 : -1;
 594 }
 595 
 596 /**
 597  * Check a plugin dependency given a basename and required version.
 598  *
 599  * Versions are checked using PHP's library version_compare routine
 600  * and allows both minimum and maximum version requirements.
 601  * Returns
 602  *
 603  * @param string $p_base_name   Plugin base name.
 604  * @param string $p_required    Required version.
 605  * @param bool   $p_initialized Whether plugin is initialized.
 606  *
 607  * @return int Plugin dependency status: 1 if plugin dependency is met,
 608  *                 0 if not met or -1 if dependency is the wrong version.
 609  */
 610 function plugin_dependency( $p_base_name, $p_required, $p_initialized = false ) {
 611 	global $g_plugin_cache, $g_plugin_cache_init;
 612 
 613 	# check for registered dependency
 614 	if( isset( $g_plugin_cache[$p_base_name] ) ) {
 615 
 616 		# require dependency initialized?
 617 		if( $p_initialized && !isset( $g_plugin_cache_init[$p_base_name] ) ) {
 618 			return 0;
 619 		}
 620 
 621 		$t_plugin_version = $g_plugin_cache[$p_base_name]->version;
 622 
 623 		$t_required_array = explode( ',', $p_required );
 624 
 625 		# Set maximum dependency for MantisCore if none is specified.
 626 		# This effectively disables plugins which have not been specifically
 627 		# designed for a new major Mantis release to force authors to review
 628 		# their code, adapt it if necessary, and release a new version of the
 629 		# plugin with updated dependencies.
 630 		if( $p_base_name == 'MantisCore' && strpos( $p_required, '<' ) === false ) {
 631 			$t_version_core = mb_substr( $t_plugin_version, 0, strpos( $t_plugin_version, '.' ) );
 632 			$t_is_current_core_supported = false;
 633 			foreach( $t_required_array as $t_version_required ) {
 634 				$t_is_current_core_supported = $t_is_current_core_supported
 635 					|| version_compare( trim( $t_version_required ), $t_version_core, '>=' );
 636 			}
 637 			if( !$t_is_current_core_supported ) {
 638 				# Add current major version as maximum
 639 				$t_required_array[] = '<' . $t_version_core;
 640 			}
 641 		}
 642 
 643 		foreach( $t_required_array as $t_required ) {
 644 			$t_required = trim( $t_required );
 645 			$t_maximum = false;
 646 
 647 			# check for a less-than-or-equal version requirement
 648 			$t_ltpos = strpos( $t_required, '<=' );
 649 			if( $t_ltpos !== false ) {
 650 				$t_required = trim( mb_substr( $t_required, $t_ltpos + 2 ) );
 651 				$t_maximum = true;
 652 			} else {
 653 				$t_ltpos = strpos( $t_required, '<' );
 654 				if( $t_ltpos !== false ) {
 655 					$t_required = trim( mb_substr( $t_required, $t_ltpos + 1 ) );
 656 					$t_maximum = true;
 657 				}
 658 			}
 659 
 660 			$t_check = plugin_version_check( $t_plugin_version, $t_required, $t_maximum );
 661 
 662 			if( $t_check < 1 ) {
 663 				return $t_check;
 664 			}
 665 		}
 666 
 667 		return 1;
 668 	} else {
 669 		return 0;
 670 	}
 671 }

 706 function plugin_is_installed( $p_basename ) {

 717 /**
 718  * Install a plugin to the database.
 719  *
 720  * @param MantisPlugin $p_plugin Plugin basename.
 721  *
 722  * @return void
 723  */
 724 function plugin_install( MantisPlugin $p_plugin ) {
 725 	if( plugin_is_installed( $p_plugin->basename ) ) {
 726 		error_parameters( $p_plugin->basename );
 727 		trigger_error( ERROR_PLUGIN_ALREADY_INSTALLED, WARNING );
 728 	}
 729 
 730 	plugin_push_current( $p_plugin->basename );
 731 
 732 	if( !$p_plugin->install() ) {
 733 		plugin_pop_current();
 734 		return;
 735 	}
 736 
 737 	db_param_push();
 738 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {plugin} ( basename, enabled )
 739 				VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
 740 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_plugin->basename, true ) );
 741 
 742 	if( false === ( plugin_config_get( 'schema', false ) ) ) {
 743 		plugin_config_set( 'schema', -1 );
 744 	}
 745 
 746 	plugin_upgrade( $p_plugin );
 747 
 748 	plugin_pop_current();
 749 }
 750 
 751 /**
 752  * Determine if an installed plugin needs to upgrade its schema.
 753  *
 754  * @param MantisPlugin $p_plugin Plugin basename.
 755  *
 756  * @return bool True if plugin needs schema upgrades.
 757  */
 758 function plugin_needs_upgrade( MantisPlugin $p_plugin ) {
 759 	plugin_push_current( $p_plugin->basename );
 760 	$t_plugin_schema = $p_plugin->schema();
 761 	plugin_pop_current();
 762 	if( is_null( $t_plugin_schema ) ) {
 763 		return false;
 764 	}
 765 
 766 	$t_config_option = 'plugin_' . $p_plugin->basename . '_schema';
 767 	$t_plugin_schema_version = config_get( $t_config_option, -1, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS );
 768 
 769 	return( $t_plugin_schema_version < count( $t_plugin_schema ) - 1 );
 770 }
 771 
 772 /**
 773  * Upgrade an installed plugin's schema.
 774  *
 775  * This is mostly identical to the code in the MantisBT installer, and should
 776  * be reviewed and updated accordingly whenever that changes.
 777  *
 778  * @param MantisPlugin $p_plugin Plugin basename.
 779  *
 780  * @return bool|null True if upgrade completed, null if problem
 781  */
 782 function plugin_upgrade( MantisPlugin $p_plugin ) {
 783 	if( !plugin_is_installed( $p_plugin->basename ) ) {
 784 		return null;
 785 	}
 786 
 787 	require_api( 'install_helper_functions_api.php' );
 788 
 789 	plugin_push_current( $p_plugin->basename );
 790 
 791 	$t_schema_version = (int)plugin_config_get( 'schema', -1 );
 792 	$t_schema = $p_plugin->schema();
 793 
 794 	global $g_db;
 795 	$t_dict = NewDataDictionary( $g_db );
 796 
 797 	$i = $t_schema_version + 1;
 798 	while( $i < count( $t_schema ) ) {
 799 		if( !$p_plugin->upgrade( $i ) ) {
 800 			plugin_pop_current();
 801 			return false;
 802 		}
 803 		$t_status = false;
 804 
 805 		switch( $t_schema[$i][0] ) {
 806 			case 'InsertData':
 807 				$t_sqlarray = array(
 808 					'INSERT INTO ' . $t_schema[$i][1][0] . $t_schema[$i][1][1],
 809 				);
 810 				break;
 811 
 812 			case 'UpdateSQL':
 813 				$t_sqlarray = array(
 814 					'UPDATE ' . $t_schema[$i][1][0] . $t_schema[$i][1][1],
 815 				);
 816 				break;
 817 
 818 			case 'UpdateFunction':
 819 				$t_sqlarray = false;
 820 				if( isset( $t_schema[$i][2] ) ) {
 821 					$t_status = call_user_func( 'install_' . $t_schema[$i][1], $t_schema[$i][2] );
 822 				} else {
 823 					$t_status = call_user_func( 'install_' . $t_schema[$i][1] );
 824 				}
 825 				break;
 826 
 827 			case null:
 828 				# No-op upgrade step
 829 				$t_sqlarray = false;
 830 				$t_status = 2;
 831 				break;
 832 
 833 			default:
 834 				$t_sqlarray = call_user_func_array(
 835 					array( $t_dict, $t_schema[$i][0] ),
 836 					$t_schema[$i][1]
 837 				);
 838 		}
 839 
 840 		if( $t_sqlarray ) {
 841 			$t_status = $t_dict->ExecuteSQLArray( $t_sqlarray );
 842 		}
 843 
 844 		if( 2 == $t_status ) {
 845 			plugin_config_set( 'schema', $i );
 846 		} else {
 847 			error_parameters( 
 848 				$i, 
 849 				$g_db->ErrorMsg(), 
 850 				implode( '<br>', $t_sqlarray ) 
 851 			);
 852 			trigger_error( ERROR_PLUGIN_UPGRADE_FAILED, ERROR );
 853 			return null;
 854 		}
 855 
 856 		$i++;
 857 	}
 858 
 859 	plugin_pop_current();
 860 
 861 	return true;
 862 }
 863 
 864 /**
 865  * Uninstall a plugin from the database.
 866  *
 867  * Return without action if given plugin is protected or not installed, unless
 868  * it is a missing plugin, in which case we delete it regardless of protected
 869  * status.
 870  *
 871  * @param MantisPlugin $p_plugin Plugin basename.
 872  *
 873  * @return void
 874  */
 875 function plugin_uninstall( MantisPlugin $p_plugin ) {
 876 	access_ensure_global_level( config_get_global( 'manage_plugin_threshold' ) );
 877 
 878 	if( !$p_plugin->status == MantisPlugin::STATUS_MISSING_BASE_CLASS &&
 879 		( !plugin_is_installed( $p_plugin->basename ) || plugin_protected( $p_plugin->basename ) )
 880 	) {
 881 		return;
 882 	}
 883 
 884 	db_param_push();
 885 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {plugin} WHERE basename=' . db_param();
 886 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_plugin->basename ) );
 887 
 888 	plugin_push_current( $p_plugin->basename );
 889 
 890 	$p_plugin->uninstall();
 891 
 892 	plugin_pop_current();
 893 }

 895 /**
 896  * Search the system for plugins.
 897  *
 898  * Goes through all directories under plugin_path and builds a list of all
 899  * plugins found. Those that do not register successfully, (e.g. because of
 900  * missing source code) or that are registered in the database but their
 901  * code is no longer available, will have a special `MantisInvalid` class
 902  * (or one of its child classes) allowing special handling by the caller.
 903  *
 904  * @return MantisPlugin[] List of found plugins, with basename as key.
 905  */
 906 function plugin_find_all() {
 907 	static $s_plugins;
 908 	if( !is_null( $s_plugins ) ) {
 909 		return $s_plugins;
 910 	}
 911 	
 912 	$t_plugin_path = config_get_global( 'plugin_path' );
 913 	$s_plugins = array(
 914 		'MantisCore' => new MantisCorePlugin( 'MantisCore' ),
 915 	);
 916 
 917 	# Get list of installed plugins
 918 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT basename FROM {plugin}' );
 919 	$t_installed_plugins = array();
 920 	while( $t_query->fetch() ) {
 921 		$t_installed_plugins[] = $t_query->value();
 922 	}
 923 
 924 	# Register all plugins found in directory
 925 	if( $t_dir = opendir( $t_plugin_path ) ) {
 926 		while( ( $t_file = readdir( $t_dir ) ) !== false ) {
 927 			if( '.' == $t_file || '..' == $t_file ) {
 928 				continue;
 929 			}
 930 			if( is_dir( $t_plugin_path . $t_file ) ) {
 931 				$t_plugin = plugin_register( $t_file, true );
 932 
 933 				if( !is_null( $t_plugin ) ) {
 934 					$s_plugins[$t_file] = $t_plugin;
 935 				}
 936 			}
 937 		}
 938 		closedir( $t_dir );
 939 	}
 940 
 941 	# Process missing plugins (i.e. installed without code in plugins directory)
 942 	$t_missing_plugins = array_diff( $t_installed_plugins, array_keys( $s_plugins ) );
 943 	foreach( $t_missing_plugins as $t_missing_plugin ) {
 944 		$s_plugins[$t_missing_plugin] = new MissingPlugin( $t_missing_plugin );
 945 	}
 946 
 947 	return $s_plugins;
 948 }
 949 
 950 /**
 951  * Load a plugin's core class file.
 952  *
 953  * @param string $p_basename Plugin basename.
 954  * @param string $p_child    Child filename.
 955  *
 956  * @return bool
 957  */
 958 function plugin_include( $p_basename, $p_child = null ) {
 959 	$t_path = config_get_global( 'plugin_path' ) . $p_basename . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
 960 
 961 	if( is_null( $p_child ) ) {
 962 		$t_plugin_file = $t_path . $p_basename . '.php';
 963 	} else {
 964 		$t_plugin_file = $t_path . $p_child . '.php';
 965 	}
 966 	$t_included = false;
 967 	if( is_file( $t_plugin_file ) ) {
 968 		include_once( $t_plugin_file );
 969 		$t_included = true;
 970 	}
 971 
 972 	return $t_included;
 973 }
 974 
 975 /**
 976  * Allows a plugin page to require a plugin-specific API.
 977  *
 978  * This function's purpose is to include a plugin-specific API (e.g. helper
 979  * functions) without having to worry about the actual plugin path.
 980  *
 981  * NOTE: it is not intended to, and in fact will not register variables in the
 982  * global namespace.
 983  *
 984  * @param string $p_file     The API to be included.
 985  * @param string $p_basename Plugin's basename (defaults to current plugin).
 986  *
 987  * @return void
 988  */
 989 function plugin_require_api( $p_file, $p_basename = null ) {
 990 	if( is_null( $p_basename ) ) {
 991 		$t_current = plugin_get_current();
 992 	} else {
 993 		$t_current = $p_basename;
 994 	}
 995 
 996 	$t_path = config_get_global( 'plugin_path' ) . $t_current . '/';
 997 
 998 	require_once( $t_path . $p_file );
 999 }

1001 /**
1002  * Determine if a given plugin is registered.
1003  *
1004  * @param string $p_basename Plugin basename.
1005  *                           
1006  * @return bool True if plugin is registered
1007  */
1008 function plugin_is_registered( $p_basename ) {
1009 	global $g_plugin_cache;
1010 
1011 	return isset( $g_plugin_cache[$p_basename] );
1012 }
1013 
1014 /**
1015  * Register a plugin with MantisBT.
1016  *
1017  * The plugin class must already be loaded before calling.
1018  * If the plugin could not be registered, the returned object will be a special
1019  * MantisPlugin child class:
1020  * - InvalidPlugin: if the plugin's name or version is not defined
1021  * - MissingClassPlugin: if the plugin's source code can't be found or loaded
1022  *
1023  * @param string $p_basename Plugin classname without 'Plugin' postfix.
1024  * @param bool   $p_return   Return.
1025  * @param string $p_child    Child filename.
1026  *
1027  * @return MantisPlugin
1028  */
1029 function plugin_register( $p_basename, $p_return = false, $p_child = null ) {
1030 	global $g_plugin_cache;
1031 
1032 	$t_basename = is_null( $p_child ) ? $p_basename : $p_child;
1033 	if( !isset( $g_plugin_cache[$t_basename] ) ) {
1034 		$t_classname = $t_basename . 'Plugin';
1035 
1036 		# Include the plugin script if the class is not already declared.
1037 		if( !class_exists( $t_classname ) ) {
1038 			if( !plugin_include( $p_basename, $p_child ) ) {
1039 				log_event( LOG_PLUGIN, "Source code for Plugin '$t_basename' not found");
1040 				return new MissingClassPlugin( $t_basename );
1041 			}
1042 		}
1043 
1044 		# Make sure the class exists and that it's of the right type.
1045 		if( class_exists( $t_classname ) && is_subclass_of( $t_classname, 'MantisPlugin' ) ) {
1046 			plugin_push_current( $t_basename );
1047 			/** @var MantisPlugin $t_plugin */
1048 			$t_plugin = new $t_classname( $t_basename );
1049 			plugin_pop_current();
1050 
1051 			# Final check on the class
1052 			if( !$t_plugin->isValid() ) {
1053 				log_event(
1054 					LOG_PLUGIN,
1055 					"Plugin '$t_basename' is invalid (undefined Name or Version)"
1056 				);
1057 				return $t_plugin->getInvalidPlugin();
1058 			}
1059 		} elseif( basename( $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] ) == 'manage_plugin_page.php' ) {
1060 			# We don't want to throw an error here, as this is the place where
1061 			# information about the invalid Plugin is displayed.
1062 			$t_plugin = new MissingClassPlugin( $t_basename );
1063 			log_event(
1064 				LOG_PLUGIN,
1065 				"Plugin '$t_basename' is invalid ('$t_classname' class is not defined)"
1066 			);
1067 		} else {
1068 			error_parameters( $t_basename, $t_classname );
1069 			trigger_error( ERROR_PLUGIN_CLASS_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
1070 		}
1071 
1072 		if( $p_return ) {
1073 			/** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
1074 			return $t_plugin;
1075 		} else {
1076 			/** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
1077 			$g_plugin_cache[$t_basename] = $t_plugin;
1078 		}
1079 	}
1080 
1081 	return $g_plugin_cache[$t_basename];
1082 }
1083 
1084 /**
1085  * Find and register all installed plugins.
1086  *
1087  * This includes the MantisCore pseudo-plugin.
1088  *
1089  * @return void
1090  */
1091 function plugin_register_installed() {
1092 	global $g_plugin_cache_priority, $g_plugin_cache_protected;
1093 
1094 	# register plugins specified in the site configuration
1095 	$t_plugins_to_register = plugin_get_force_installed();
1096 	arsort( $t_plugins_to_register );
1097 	foreach( $t_plugins_to_register as $t_basename => $t_priority ) {
1098 		plugin_register( $t_basename );
1099 		$g_plugin_cache_priority[$t_basename] = $t_priority;
1100 		$g_plugin_cache_protected[$t_basename] = true;
1101 	}
1102 
1103 	# register plugins installed via the interface/database
1104 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT basename, priority, protected 
1105 		FROM {plugin} 
1106 		WHERE enabled=:enabled
1107 		ORDER BY priority DESC'
1108 	);
1109 	$t_query->bind( 'enabled', true );
1110 	foreach( $t_query->fetch_all() as $t_row ) {
1111 		$t_basename = $t_row['basename'];
1112 		if( !plugin_is_registered( $t_basename ) ) {
1113 			plugin_register( $t_basename );
1114 			$g_plugin_cache_priority[$t_basename] = (int)$t_row['priority'];
1115 			$g_plugin_cache_protected[$t_basename] = (bool)$t_row['protected'];
1116 		}
1117 	}
1118 }
1119 
1120 /**
1121  * Initialize all installed plugins.
1122  *
1123  * Post-signals EVENT_PLUGIN_INIT.
1124  *
1125  * @return void
1126  */
1127 function plugin_init_installed() {
1128 	if( OFF == config_get_global( 'plugins_enabled' ) || !db_table_exists( db_get_table( 'plugin' ) ) ) {
1129 		return;
1130 	}
1131 
1132 	global $g_plugin_cache, $g_plugin_current, $g_plugin_cache_priority, $g_plugin_cache_protected, $g_plugin_cache_init;
1133 	$g_plugin_cache = array();
1134 	$g_plugin_current = array();
1135 	$g_plugin_cache_init = array();
1136 	$g_plugin_cache_priority = array();
1137 	$g_plugin_cache_protected = array();
1138 
1139 	plugin_register_installed();
1140 
1141 	$t_plugins = array_keys( $g_plugin_cache );
1142 
1143 	do {
1144 		$t_continue = false;
1145 		$t_plugins_retry = array();
1146 
1147 		foreach( $t_plugins as $t_basename ) {
1148 			if( plugin_init( $t_basename ) ) {
1149 				$t_continue = true;
1150 
1151 			} else {
1152 				# Dependent plugin
1153 				$t_plugins_retry[] = $t_basename;
1154 			}
1155 		}
1156 
1157 		$t_plugins = $t_plugins_retry;
1158 	} while( $t_continue );
1159 
1160 	event_signal( 'EVENT_PLUGIN_INIT' );
1161 }
1162 
1163 /**
1164  * Initialize a single plugin.
1165  *
1166  * @param string $p_basename Plugin basename.
1167  *
1168  * @return bool True if plugin initialized, false otherwise.
1169  */
1170 function plugin_init( $p_basename ) {
1171 	global $g_plugin_cache, $g_plugin_cache_init;
1172 
1173 	# handle dependent plugins
1174 	if( isset( $g_plugin_cache[$p_basename] ) ) {
1175 		$t_plugin = $g_plugin_cache[$p_basename];
1176 
1177 		# hard dependencies; return false if the dependency is not registered,
1178 		# does not meet the version requirement, or is not yet initialized.
1179 		if( is_array( $t_plugin->requires ) ) {
1180 			foreach( $t_plugin->requires as $t_required => $t_version ) {
1181 				if( plugin_dependency( $t_required, $t_version, true ) !== 1 ) {
1182 					return false;
1183 				}
1184 			}
1185 		}
1186 
1187 		# soft dependencies; only return false if the soft dependency is
1188 		# registered, but not yet initialized.
1189 		if( is_array( $t_plugin->uses ) ) {
1190 			foreach( $t_plugin->uses as $t_used => $t_version ) {
1191 				if( isset( $g_plugin_cache[$t_used] ) && !isset( $g_plugin_cache_init[$t_used] ) ) {
1192 					return false;
1193 				}
1194 			}
1195 		}
1196 
1197 		# if plugin schema needs an upgrade, do not initialize
1198 		if( plugin_needs_upgrade( $t_plugin ) ) {
1199 			return false;
1200 		}
1201 
1202 		plugin_push_current( $p_basename );
1203 
1204 		# load plugin error strings
1205 		global $g_lang_strings;
1206 		$t_lang = lang_get_current();
1207 		$t_plugin_errors = $t_plugin->errors();
1208 
1209 		foreach( $t_plugin_errors as $t_error_name => $t_error_string ) {
1210 			$t_error_code = "plugin_{$p_basename}_$t_error_name";
1211 			$g_lang_strings[$t_lang]['MANTIS_ERROR'][$t_error_code] = $t_error_string;
1212 		}
1213 
1214 		# finish initializing the plugin
1215 		if( !$t_plugin->__init() ) {
1216 			$t_invalid = new MissingHooksPlugin( $p_basename );
1217 			$t_invalid->setInvalidPlugin( $t_plugin );
1218 			$g_plugin_cache[$p_basename] = $t_invalid;
1219 			plugin_pop_current();
1220 			return false;
1221 		}
1222 		$g_plugin_cache_init[$p_basename] = true;
1223 
1224 		plugin_pop_current();
1225 
1226 		return true;
1227 	} else {
1228 		return false;
1229 	}
1230 }
1231 
1232 /**
1233  * Log a plugin-specific event.
1234  *
1235  * @param string|array $p_msg       Log message - either a string, or an array
1236  *                                  structured as (string,execution time).
1237  * @param string        $p_basename Plugin's basename (defaults to current plugin)
1238  */
1239 function plugin_log_event( $p_msg, $p_basename = null ) {
1240 	$t_current_plugin = plugin_get_current();
1241 	if( is_null( $p_basename ) ) {
1242 		$t_basename = $t_current_plugin;
1243 	} else {
1244 		$t_basename = $p_basename;
1245 	}
1246 
1247 	if( $t_basename != $t_current_plugin ) {
1248 		plugin_push_current( $t_basename );
1249 		log_event( LOG_PLUGIN, $p_msg);
1250 		plugin_pop_current();
1251 	} else {
1252 		log_event( LOG_PLUGIN, $p_msg);
1253 	}
1254 }
1255 
1256 /**
1257  * Retrieve plugin-defined menu items for a given event.
1258  *
1259  * These are HTML hyperlinks (<a> tags).
1260  *
1261  * @param string $p_event Plugin event to signal
1262  *
1263  * @return array
1264  */
1265 function plugin_menu_items( $p_event ) {
1266 	$t_items = array();
1267 
1268 	if( $p_event ) {
1269 		$t_event_items = event_signal( $p_event );
1270 
1271 		foreach( $t_event_items as $t_plugin_items ) {
1272 			foreach( $t_plugin_items as $t_callback_items ) {
1273 				if( is_array( $t_callback_items ) ) {
1274 					$t_items = array_merge( $t_items, $t_callback_items );
1275 				}
1276 				else {
1277 					if( $t_callback_items !== null ) {
1278 						$t_items[] = $t_callback_items;
1279 					}
1280 				}
1281 			}
1282 		}
1283 	}
1284 
1285 	return $t_items;
1286 }

  36 use Mantis\Exceptions\ClientException;
  37 
  38 require_api( 'access_api.php' );
  39 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  40 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  41 require_api( 'string_api.php' );

  45 /**
  46  * Return a ready-to-use mailto: URL.
  47  *
  48  * No validation is performed on the e-mail address, it is the caller's
  49  * responsibility to ensure it is valid and not empty.
  50  *
  51  * @param string $p_email   Target e-mail address
  52  * @param string $p_subject Optional e-mail subject
  53  *
  54  * @return string
  55  */
  56 function prepare_mailto_url ( $p_email, $p_subject = '' ) {
  57 	# If we apply string_url() to the whole mailto: link then the @ gets
  58 	# turned into a %40 and you can't right click in browsers to use the
  59 	# Copy Email Address functionality.
  60 	if( $p_subject ) {
  61 		# URL-encoding the subject is required otherwise special characters
  62 		# (ampersand for example) will truncate the text
  63 		$p_subject = '?subject=' . string_url( $p_subject );
  64 	}
  65 	$t_mailto = 'mailto:' . $p_email . $p_subject;
  66 
  67 	return string_attribute( $t_mailto );
  68 }
  69 
  70 /**
  71  * return an HTML link with mailto: href.
  72  *
  73  * If user does not have access level required to see email addresses, the
  74  * function will only return the display text (with tooltip if provided).
  75  *
  76  * @param string $p_email           Email address to prepare.
  77  * @param string $p_text            Display text for the hyperlink.
  78  * @param string $p_subject         Optional e-mail subject
  79  * @param string  $p_tooltip        Optional tooltip to show.
  80  * @param boolean $p_show_as_button If true, show link as button with envelope
  81  *                                  icon, otherwise display a plain-text link.
  82  *
  83  * @return string
  84  */
  85 function prepare_email_link( $p_email, $p_text, $p_subject = '', $p_tooltip ='', $p_show_as_button = false ) {
  86 	$t_text = string_display_line( $p_text );
  87 	if( !is_blank( $p_tooltip ) && $p_tooltip != $p_text ) {
  88 		$t_tooltip = ' title="' . string_display_line( $p_tooltip ) . '"';
  89 	} else {
  90 		$t_tooltip = '';
  91 	}
  92 
  93 	if( !access_has_project_level( config_get( 'show_user_email_threshold' ) ) ) {
  94 		return $t_tooltip ? '<a' . $t_tooltip . '>' . $t_text . '</a>' : $t_text;
  95 	}
  96 
  97 	$t_mailto = prepare_mailto_url( $p_email, $p_subject );
  98 
  99 	if( $p_show_as_button ) {
 100 		$t_class = ' class="noprint blue zoom-130"';
 101 		$t_text = icon_get( 'fa-envelope-o', 'bigger-115' )
 102 			. ( $t_text ? "&nbsp;$t_text" : '' );
 103 	} else {
 104 		$t_class = '';
 105 	}
 106 
 107 	return sprintf( '<a href="%s"%s%s>%s</a>',
 108 		$t_mailto,
 109 		$t_tooltip,
 110 		$t_class,
 111 		$t_text
 112 	);
 113 }

 115 /**
 116  * Prepares the name of the user given the id.
 117  * Also can make it a link to user info page.
 118  * @param integer $p_user_id  A valid user identifier.
 119  * @param boolean $p_link     Whether to include an html link
 120  * @return string
 121  */
 122 function prepare_user_name( $p_user_id, $p_link = true ) {
 123 	# Catch a user_id of NO_USER (like when a handler hasn't been assigned)
 124 	if( NO_USER == $p_user_id ) {
 125 		return '';
 126 	}
 127 
 128 	$t_username = user_get_username( $p_user_id );
 129 	$t_name = user_get_name( $p_user_id );
 130 	if( $t_username != $t_name ) {
 131 		$t_tooltip = ' title="' . string_attribute( $t_username ) . '"';
 132 	} else {
 133 		$t_tooltip = '';
 134 	}
 135 
 136 	$t_name = string_display_line( $t_name );
 137 
 138 	if( user_exists( $p_user_id ) && user_get_field( $p_user_id, 'enabled' ) ) {
 139 		if( $p_link ) {
 140 			return '<a' . $t_tooltip . ' href="' . string_sanitize_url( 'view_user_page.php?id=' . $p_user_id, true ) . '">' . $t_name . '</a>';
 141 		} else {
 142 			return '<span ' . $t_tooltip . '>' . $t_name . '</span>';
 143 		}
 144 	}
 145 
 146 	return '<del ' . $t_tooltip . '>' . $t_name . '</del>';
 147 }

 149 /**
 150  * Prepares Version string for output.
 151  *
 152  * A function that prepares the version string for outputting to the user on
 153  * view / print issue pages. This function will add the version date, if
 154  * appropriate {@see $g_show_version_dates_threshold}.
 155  *
 156  * @param integer      $p_project_id    The project id to use as context.
 157  * @param integer      $p_version_id    The version id. If false then this
 158  *                                      method will return an empty string.
 159  * @param boolean|null $p_show_project  Whether to include the project name or
 160  *                                      not, null means include the project if
 161  *                                      different from current context.
 162  *
 163  * @return string The formatted version string.
 164  * @throws ClientException if the version id does not exist.
 165  */
 166 function prepare_version_string( $p_project_id, $p_version_id, $p_show_project = null ) {
 167 	$t_version_text = version_full_name( $p_version_id, $p_show_project, $p_project_id );
 168 
 169     $t_show_version_dates = config_get('show_version_dates_threshold', null, null, $p_project_id);
 170     if( access_has_project_level( $t_show_version_dates, $p_project_id ) ) {
 171 		$t_date_order = version_get_field( $p_version_id, 'date_order' );
 172 		if( $t_date_order != date_get_null() ) {
 173 			$t_short_date_format = config_get( 'short_date_format', null, null, $p_project_id );
 174 			$t_version_text .= ' (' . date( $t_short_date_format, $t_date_order ) . ')';
 175 		}
 176 	}
 177 
 178 	return $t_version_text;
 179 }

 181 /**
 182  * Prepares avatar for raw outputting (only avatar image).
 183  *
 184  * @param Avatar $p_avatar          An instance of class Avatar.
 185  * @param string $p_class_prefix    CSS class prefix to add to the avatar's surrounding div and to the img.
 186  *   The CSS classes to implement will be named [$p_class_prefix]-avatar_container-[$p_size] and 
 187  *   [$p_class_prefix]-avatar-[$p_size].
 188  * @param integer $p_size           Image maximum size.
 189  * @return string the HTML string of the avatar.
 190  */
 191 function prepare_raw_avatar( $p_avatar, $p_class_prefix, $p_size) {
 192 	if( $p_avatar === null ) {
 193 		return '';
 194 	}
 195 
 196 	$t_image = htmlspecialchars( $p_avatar->image );
 197 	$t_text = htmlspecialchars( $p_avatar->text );
 198 
 199 	$t_avatar_class = $p_class_prefix . '-avatar' . '-' . $p_size;
 200 	return '<img class="' . $t_avatar_class . '" src="' . $t_image . '" alt="' .
 201 			$t_text . '" />';
 202 }

 204 /**
 205  * Prepares avatar for outputting.
 206  *
 207  * @param Avatar $p_avatar          An instance of class Avatar.
 208  * @param string $p_class_prefix    CSS class prefix to add to the avatar's surrounding div and to the img.
 209  *   The CSS classes to implement will be named [$p_class_prefix]-avatar-container-[$p_size] and
 210  *   [$p_class_prefix]-avatar-[$p_size].
 211  * @param integer $p_size           Image maximum size.
 212  * @return string the HTML string of the avatar.
 213  */
 214 function prepare_avatar( $p_avatar, $p_class_prefix, $p_size ) {
 215 	if( $p_avatar === null ) {
 216 		return '';
 217 	}
 218 
 219 	$t_link = htmlspecialchars( $p_avatar->link );
 220 
 221 	$t_container_class = $p_class_prefix . '-avatar-container' . '-' . $p_size;
 222 	return '<div class="' . $t_container_class . '">' . 
 223 			'<a rel="nofollow" href="' . $t_link . '">' .
 224 			prepare_raw_avatar( $p_avatar, $p_class_prefix, $p_size ) . 
 225 			'</a></div>';
 226 }

  85 /**
  86  * Print the headers to cause the page to redirect to $p_url
  87  * If $p_die is true (default), terminate the execution of the script immediately
  88  * If we have handled any errors on this page return false and don't redirect.
  89  * $p_sanitize - true/false - true in the case where the URL is extracted from GET/POST or untrusted source.
  90  * This would be false if the URL is trusted (e.g. read from config_inc.php).
  91  *
  92  * @param string  $p_url      The page to redirect: has to be a relative path.
  93  * @param boolean $p_die      If true, stop the script after redirecting.
  94  * @param boolean $p_sanitize Apply string_sanitize_url to passed URL.
  95  * @param boolean $p_absolute Indicate if URL is absolute.
  96  * @return boolean
  97  */
  98 function print_header_redirect( $p_url, $p_die = true, $p_sanitize = false, $p_absolute = false ) {
  99 	if( error_handled() ) {
 100 		# Display a basic "proceed" page to show any pending errors, regardless
 101 		# of $g_stop_on_errors setting which is actually handled in
 102 		# html_meta_redirect(), called by layout_page_header().
 103 		layout_page_header( null, $p_url );
 104 		layout_page_begin();
 105 		html_operation_successful( $p_url );
 106 		layout_page_end();
 107 		return false;
 108 	}
 109 
 110 	# validate the url as part of this site before continuing
 111 	if( $p_absolute ) {
 112 		if( $p_sanitize ) {
 113 			$t_url = string_sanitize_url( $p_url );
 114 		} else {
 115 			$t_url = $p_url;
 116 		}
 117 	} else {
 118 		if( $p_sanitize ) {
 119 			$t_url = string_sanitize_url( $p_url, true );
 120 		} else {
 121 			$t_url = config_get_global( 'path' ) . $p_url;
 122 		}
 123 	}
 124 
 125 	$t_url = string_prepare_header( $t_url );
 126 
 127 	# don't send more headers if they have already been sent
 128 	if( !headers_sent() ) {
 129 		header( 'Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8' );
 130 		header( 'Location: ' . $t_url );
 131 	} else {
 132 		trigger_error( ERROR_PAGE_REDIRECTION, ERROR );
 133 		return false;
 134 	}
 135 
 136 	if( $p_die ) {
 137 		die;
 138 
 139 		# additional output can cause problems so let's just stop output here
 140 	}
 141 
 142 	return true;
 143 }

 299 /**
 300  * This populates an option list with the appropriate users by access level
 301  * @todo from print_reporter_option_list
 302  * @param integer|array $p_user_id    A user identifier or a list of them.
 303  * @param integer       $p_project_id A project identifier.
 304  * @param integer       $p_access     An access level.
 305  * @return void
 306  */
 307 function print_user_option_list( $p_user_id, $p_project_id = null, $p_access = ANYBODY ) {
 308 	$t_current_user = auth_get_current_user_id();
 309 
 310 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
 311 		$p_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 312 	}
 313 
 314 	if( $p_project_id === ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 315 		$t_projects = user_get_accessible_projects( $t_current_user );
 316 
 317 		# Get list of users having access level for all accessible projects
 318 		$t_users = array();
 319 		foreach( $t_projects as $t_project_id ) {
 320 			$t_project_users_list = project_get_all_user_rows( $t_project_id, $p_access );
 321 			# Do a 'smart' merge of the project's user list, into an
 322 			# associative array (to remove duplicates)
 323 			foreach( $t_project_users_list as $t_id => $t_user ) {
 324 				$t_users[$t_id] = $t_user;
 325 			}
 326 			# Clear the array to release memory
 327 			unset( $t_project_users_list );
 328 		}
 329 		unset( $t_projects );
 330 	} else {
 331 		$t_users = project_get_all_user_rows( $p_project_id, $p_access );
 332 	}
 333 
 334 	# Add the specified user ID to the list
 335 	# If we have an array of user IDs, then we've been called from a filter
 336 	# so don't add anything
 337 	if( !is_array( $p_user_id ) &&
 338 		$p_user_id != NO_USER &&
 339 		!array_key_exists( $p_user_id, $t_users )
 340 	) {
 341 		$t_row = user_cache_row( $p_user_id, /* trigger_error */ false );
 342 		if( $t_row === false ) {
 343 			# User doesn't exist - create a dummy record for display purposes
 344 			$t_name = user_get_name( $p_user_id );
 345 			$t_row = array(
 346 				'id' => $p_user_id,
 347 				'username' => $t_name,
 348 				'realname' => $t_name,
 349 			);
 350 		}
 351 		$t_users[$p_user_id] = $t_row;
 352 	}
 353 
 354 	$t_display = array();
 355 	$t_sort = array();
 356 
 357 	foreach( $t_users as $t_key => $t_user ) {
 358 		$t_display[] = user_get_expanded_name_from_row( $t_user );
 359 		$t_sort[] = user_get_name_for_sorting_from_row( $t_user );
 360 	}
 361 
 362 	array_multisort( $t_sort, SORT_ASC, SORT_STRING, $t_users, $t_display );
 363 	unset( $t_sort );
 364 
 365 	$t_count = count( $t_users );
 366 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_count;$i++ ) {
 367 		$t_row = $t_users[$i];
 368 		echo '<option value="' . $t_row['id'] . '" ';
 369 		check_selected( $p_user_id, (int)$t_row['id'] );

 484 /**
 485  * Get current headlines and id prefix with v_
 486  * @return void
 487  */
 488 function print_news_item_option_list() {
 489 	$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 490 
 491 	$t_global = access_has_global_level( config_get_global( 'admin_site_threshold' ) );
 492 	db_param_push();
 493 	if( $t_global ) {
 494 		$t_query = 'SELECT id, headline, announcement, view_state FROM {news} ORDER BY date_posted DESC';
 495 	} else {
 496 		$t_query = 'SELECT id, headline, announcement, view_state FROM {news}
 497 				WHERE project_id=' . db_param() . '
 498 				ORDER BY date_posted DESC';
 499 	}
 500 
 501 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, ($t_global == true ? array() : array( $t_project_id ) ) );
 502 
 503 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 504 		$t_headline = string_display_line( $t_row['headline'] );
 505 		$t_announcement = $t_row['announcement'];
 506 		$t_view_state = $t_row['view_state'];
 507 		$t_id = $t_row['id'];
 508 
 509 		$t_notes = array();
 510 		$t_note_string = '';
 511 
 512 		if( 1 == $t_announcement ) {
 513 			array_push( $t_notes, lang_get( 'announcement' ) );
 514 		}
 515 
 516 		if( VS_PRIVATE == $t_view_state ) {
 517 			array_push( $t_notes, lang_get( 'private' ) );
 518 		}
 519 
 520 		if( count( $t_notes ) > 0 ) {
 521 			$t_note_string = ' [' . implode( ' ', $t_notes ) . ']';
 522 		}
 523 
 524 		echo '<option value="' . $t_id . '">' . $t_headline . $t_note_string . '</option>';
 525 	}
 526 }

 646 /**
 647  * List projects that the current user has access to.
 648  *
 649  * @param integer        $p_project_id           The current project id or null to use cookie.
 650  * @param boolean        $p_include_all_projects True: include "All Projects", otherwise false.
 651  * @param integer|null   $p_filter_project_id    The id of a project to exclude or null.
 652  * @param string|boolean $p_trace                The current project trace, identifies the sub-project via a path from top to bottom.
 653  * @param boolean        $p_can_report_only      If true, disables projects in which user can't report issues; defaults to false (all projects enabled).
 654  * @return void
 655  */
 656 function print_project_option_list( $p_project_id = null, $p_include_all_projects = true, $p_filter_project_id = null, $p_trace = false, $p_can_report_only = false ) {
 657 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 658 	$t_project_ids = user_get_accessible_projects( $t_user_id );
 659 	$t_can_report = true;
 660 	project_cache_array_rows( $t_project_ids );
 661 
 662 	if( $p_include_all_projects && $p_filter_project_id !== ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 663 		echo '<option value="' . ALL_PROJECTS . '"';
 664 		if( $p_project_id !== null ) {
 665 			check_selected( $p_project_id, ALL_PROJECTS, false );
 666 		}
 667 		echo '>' . lang_get( 'all_projects' ) . '</option>' . "\n";
 668 	}
 669 
 670 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 671 		if( $p_can_report_only ) {
 672 			$t_report_bug_threshold = config_get( 'report_bug_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_id );
 673 			$t_can_report = access_has_project_level( $t_report_bug_threshold, $t_id, $t_user_id );
 674 		}
 675 
 676 		echo '<option value="' . $t_id . '"';
 677 		check_selected( $p_project_id, $t_id, false );
 678 		check_disabled( $t_id == $p_filter_project_id || !$t_can_report );
 679 		echo '>' . string_attribute( project_get_field( $t_id, 'name' ) ) . '</option>' . "\n";
 680 		print_subproject_option_list( $t_id, $p_project_id, $p_filter_project_id, $p_trace, $p_can_report_only );
 681 	}
 682 }
 683 
 684 /**
 685  * List projects that the current user has access to
 686  * @param integer $p_parent_id         A parent project identifier.
 687  * @param integer $p_project_id        A project identifier.
 688  * @param integer $p_filter_project_id A filter project identifier.
 689  * @param boolean $p_trace             Whether to trace parent projects.
 690  * @param boolean $p_can_report_only   If true, disables projects in which user can't report issues; defaults to false (all projects enabled).
 691  * @param array   $p_parents           Array of parent projects.
 692  * @return void
 693  */
 694 function print_subproject_option_list( $p_parent_id, $p_project_id = null, $p_filter_project_id = null, $p_trace = false, $p_can_report_only = false, array $p_parents = array() ) {
 695 	if ( config_get_global( 'subprojects_enabled' ) == OFF ) {
 696 		return;
 697 	}
 698 
 699 	array_push( $p_parents, $p_parent_id );
 700 	$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 701 	$t_project_ids = user_get_accessible_subprojects( $t_user_id, $p_parent_id );
 702 	project_cache_array_rows( $t_project_ids );
 703 	$t_can_report = true;
 704 
 705 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 706 		if( $p_can_report_only ) {
 707 			$t_report_bug_threshold = config_get( 'report_bug_threshold', null, $t_user_id, $t_id );
 708 			$t_can_report = access_has_project_level( $t_report_bug_threshold, $t_id, $t_user_id );
 709 		}
 710 
 711 		if( $p_trace ) {
 712 			$t_full_id = implode( ';', $p_parents ) . ';' . $t_id;
 713 		} else {
 714 			$t_full_id = $t_id;
 715 		}
 716 
 717 		echo '<option value="' . $t_full_id . '"';
 718 		check_selected( $p_project_id, $t_full_id, false );
 719 		check_disabled( $t_id == $p_filter_project_id || !$t_can_report );
 720 		echo '>'
 721 			. str_repeat( '&#160;', count( $p_parents ) )
 722 			. str_repeat( '&raquo;', count( $p_parents ) ) . ' '
 723 			. string_attribute( project_get_field( $t_id, 'name' ) )
 724 			. '</option>' . "\n";
 725 		print_subproject_option_list( $t_id, $p_project_id, $p_filter_project_id, $p_trace, $p_can_report_only, $p_parents );
 726 	}
 727 }

 793 /**
 794  * Print categories option list.
 795  *
 796  * Since categories can be orphaned we need to grab all unique instances of category
 797  * We check in the project category table and in the bug table
 798  * We put them all in one array and make sure the entries are unique.
 799  *
 800  * @param integer $p_category_id  A category identifier.
 801  * @param null    $p_project_id   A project identifier.
 802  * @param bool    $p_enabled_only True to exclude disabled categories.
 803  *
 804  * @return void
 805  */
 806 function print_category_option_list( $p_category_id = 0, $p_project_id = null, $p_enabled_only = false ) {
 807 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
 808 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 809 	} else {
 810 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id;
 811 	}
 812 
 813 	$t_cat_arr = category_get_all_rows( $t_project_id, null, true, $p_enabled_only );
 814 
 815 	# Add the current category if it is not in the list
 816 	if( $p_category_id != 0
 817         && !in_array( $p_category_id, array_column( $t_cat_arr, 'id' ) )
 818     ) {
 819 		$t_category_row = category_get_row( $p_category_id );
 820 		$t_category_row['project_name'] = project_get_name( $t_category_row['project_id'] );
 821 		$t_cat_arr[] = $t_category_row;
 822 	}
 823 
 824 	if( config_get( 'allow_no_category' ) ) {
 825 		echo '<option value="0"';
 826 		check_selected( $p_category_id, 0 );
 827 		echo '>';
 828 		echo category_full_name( 0, false );
 829 		echo '</option>', PHP_EOL;
 830 	} else {
 831 		if( 0 == $p_category_id && count( $t_cat_arr ) == 1 ) {
 832 			# Single option are selected by default
 833 			$p_category_id = (int) $t_cat_arr[0]['id'];
 834 		}
 835 		echo '<option value="" disabled hidden';
 836 		check_selected( $p_category_id, 0 );
 837 		echo '>';
 838 		echo string_attribute( lang_get( 'select_option' ) );
 839 		echo '</option>', PHP_EOL;
 840 	}
 841 
 842 	foreach( $t_cat_arr as $t_category_row ) {
 843 		$t_category_id = (int)$t_category_row['id'];
 844 		$t_disabled = $t_category_row['status'] == CATEGORY_STATUS_DISABLED;
 845 		$t_category_name = category_full_name(
 846 			$t_category_id,
 847 			$t_category_row['project_id'] != $t_project_id
 848 		);
 849 		if( $t_disabled ) {
 850 //			$t_category_name .= ' [' . lang_get( 'disabled' ) . ']';
 851 		}
 852 		echo '<option value="' . $t_category_id . '"';
 853 		check_selected( $p_category_id, $t_category_id );
 854 		check_disabled( $t_disabled );
 855 		echo '>';
 856 		echo string_attribute( $t_category_name ), '</option>', PHP_EOL;
 857 	}
 858 }
 859 
 860 /**
 861  * Now that categories are identified by numerical ID, we need an old-style name
 862  * based option list to keep existing filter functionality.
 863  * @param string       $p_category_name The selected category.
 864  * @param integer|null $p_project_id    A specific project or null.
 865  * @return void
 866  */

 930 /**
 931  * Print the option list for versions.
 932  * All versions related for each project will be printed. Those include, for each
 933  * project, the directly linked versions and the inherited versions if applicable.
 934  *
 935  * @param string              $p_version       The currently selected version.
 936  * @param integer|array|null  $p_project_ids   A project id, or array of ids, or null to use current project.
 937  * @param bool|null           $p_released      One of VERSION_ALL, VERSION_FUTURE or VERSION_RELEASED
 938  *                                             to define which versions to include in the list (defaults to ALL).
 939  * @param boolean $p_leading_blank Allow selection of no version.
 940  *
 941  * @return void
 942  */
 943 function print_version_option_list( $p_version = '', $p_project_ids = null, $p_released = VERSION_ALL, $p_leading_blank = true ) {
 944 	if( null === $p_project_ids ) {
 945 		$p_project_ids = helper_get_current_project();
 946 	}
 947 	$t_project_ids = is_array( $p_project_ids ) ? $p_project_ids : array( $p_project_ids );
 948 
 949 	$t_versions = version_get_all_rows( $t_project_ids, $p_released, true );
 950 
 951 	# Ensure the selected version (if specified) is included in the list
 952 	# Note: Filter API specifies selected versions as an array
 953 	if( !is_array( $p_version ) ) {
 954 		if( !empty( $p_version ) ) {
 955 			foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_project_id ) {
 956 				$t_version_id = version_get_id( $p_version, $t_project_id );
 957 				if( $t_version_id !== false ) {
 958 					$t_versions[] = version_cache_row( $t_version_id );
 959 					break;
 960 				}
 961 			}
 962 		}
 963 	}
 964 
 965 	if( $p_leading_blank ) {
 966 		echo '<option value="">&nbsp;</option>';
 967 	}
 968 
 969 	$t_listed = array();
 970 	$t_max_length = config_get( 'max_dropdown_length' );
 971 
 972 	$t_show_project_name = count( $t_project_ids ) > 1;
 973 
 974 	foreach( $t_versions as $t_version ) {
 975 		# If the current version is obsolete, and current version not equal to $p_version,
 976 		# then skip it.
 977 		if( ( (int)$t_version['obsolete'] ) == 1 ) {
 978 			if( $t_version['version'] != $p_version ) {
 979 				continue;
 980 			}
 981 		}
 982 
 983 		$t_version_version = string_attribute( $t_version['version'] );
 984 
 985 		if( !in_array( $t_version_version, $t_listed, true ) ) {
 986 			$t_listed[] = $t_version_version;
 987 			echo '<option value="' . $t_version_version . '"';
 988 			check_selected( $p_version, $t_version['version'] );
 989 			$t_version_string = string_attribute( prepare_version_string( $t_version['project_id'], $t_version['id'], $t_show_project_name ) );
 990 
 991 			echo '>', string_shorten( $t_version_string, $t_max_length ), '</option>';
 992 		}
 993 	}
 994 }
 995

1029 /**

1032  * @param string  $p_enum_name Name of enumeration (eg: status).
1033  * @param integer|array $p_val	The current value(s)
1034  * @return void
1035  */
1036 function print_enum_string_option_list( $p_enum_name, $p_val = 0 ) {
1037 	$t_config_var_name = $p_enum_name . '_enum_string';
1038 	$t_config_var_value = config_get( $t_config_var_name );
1039 	$t_string_var = lang_get( $t_config_var_name );
1040 
1041 	if( is_array( $p_val ) ) {
1042 		$t_val = $p_val;
1043 	} else {
1044 		$t_val = (int)$p_val;
1045 	}
1046 
1047 	$t_enum_values = MantisEnum::getValues( $t_config_var_value );
1048 
1049 	foreach ( $t_enum_values as $t_key ) {
1050 		$t_label = MantisEnum::getLocalizedLabel( $t_config_var_value, $t_string_var, $t_key );
1051 
1052 		echo '<option value="' . $t_key . '"';
1053 		check_selected( $t_val, $t_key );
1054 		echo '>' . string_html_specialchars( $t_label ) . '</option>';

1058 /**
1059  * Select the proper enumeration values for status based on workflow
1060  * or the input parameter if workflows are not used
1061  * @param integer $p_user_auth     A user identifier.
1062  * @param integer $p_current_value The current value.
1063  * @param boolean $p_show_current  Whether to show the current status.
1064  * @param boolean $p_add_close     Whether to add close option.
1065  * @param integer $p_project_id    A project identifier.
1066  * @return array
1067  */
1068 function get_status_option_list( $p_user_auth = 0, $p_current_value = 0, $p_show_current = true, $p_add_close = false, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
1069 	$t_config_var_value = config_get( 'status_enum_string', null, null, $p_project_id );
1070 	$t_enum_workflow = config_get( 'status_enum_workflow', null, null, $p_project_id );
1071 
1072 	if( count( $t_enum_workflow ) < 1 || !MantisEnum::hasValue( $t_config_var_value, $p_current_value ) ) {
1073 		# workflow not defined, use default enumeration
1074 		$t_enum_values = MantisEnum::getValues( $t_config_var_value );
1075 	} else {
1076 		# workflow defined - find allowed states
1077 		if( isset( $t_enum_workflow[$p_current_value] ) ) {
1078 			$t_enum_values = MantisEnum::getValues( $t_enum_workflow[$p_current_value] );
1079 		} else {
1080 			# workflow was not set for this status, this shouldn't happen
1081 			# caller should be able to handle empty list
1082 			$t_enum_values = array();
1083 		}
1084 	}
1085 	$t_enum_list = array();
1086 
1087 	foreach ( $t_enum_values as $t_enum_value ) {
1088 		if( ( $p_show_current || $p_current_value != $t_enum_value )
1089 			&& access_compare_level( $p_user_auth, access_get_status_threshold( $t_enum_value, $p_project_id ) )
1090 		) {
1091 			$t_enum_list[$t_enum_value] = get_enum_element( 'status', $t_enum_value );
1092 		}
1093 	}
1094 
1095 	if( $p_show_current ) {
1096 		$t_enum_list[$p_current_value] = get_enum_element( 'status', $p_current_value );
1097 	}
1098 
1099 	if( $p_add_close && access_compare_level( $p_current_value, config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold', null, null, $p_project_id ) ) ) {
1100 		$t_closed = config_get( 'bug_closed_status_threshold', null, null, $p_project_id );
1101 		if( $p_show_current || $p_current_value != $t_closed ) {
1102 			$t_enum_list[$t_closed] = get_enum_element( 'status', $t_closed );
1103 		}
1104 	}
1105 
1106 	return $t_enum_list;
1107 }
1108 
1109 /**
1110  * print the status option list for the bug_update pages
1111  * @param string  $p_select_label  The id/name html attribute of the select box.
1112  * @param integer $p_current_value The current value.
1113  * @param boolean $p_allow_close   Whether to allow close.
1114  * @param integer $p_project_id    A project identifier.
1115  * @return void
1116  */
1117 function print_status_option_list( $p_select_label, $p_current_value = 0, $p_allow_close = false, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
1118 	$t_current_auth = access_get_project_level( $p_project_id );
1119 
1120 	$t_enum_list = get_status_option_list( $t_current_auth, $p_current_value, true, $p_allow_close, $p_project_id );
1121 
1122 	if( count( $t_enum_list ) > 1 ) {
1123 		# resort the list into ascending order
1124 		ksort( $t_enum_list );
1125 		reset( $t_enum_list );
1126 		echo '<select class="input-sm" ' . helper_get_tab_index() . ' id="' . $p_select_label . '" name="' . $p_select_label . '">';
1127 		foreach( $t_enum_list as $t_key => $t_val ) {
1128 			echo '<option value="' . $t_key . '"';
1129 			check_selected( $t_key, $p_current_value );
1130 			echo '>' . string_html_specialchars( $t_val ) . '</option>';
1131 		}
1132 		echo '</select>';
1133 	} else if( count( $t_enum_list ) == 1 ) {
1134 		echo array_pop( $t_enum_list );
1135 	} else {
1136 		echo MantisEnum::getLabel( lang_get( 'status_enum_string' ), $p_current_value );
1137 	}
1138 }

1335 /**

1337  * shows the priority in BOLD if the bug is NOT closed and is of significant priority
1338  * @param BugData $p_bug Bug Object.
1339  * @return void
1340  */
1341 function print_formatted_priority_string( BugData $p_bug ) {
1342 	$t_pri_str = get_enum_element( 'priority', $p_bug->priority, auth_get_current_user_id(), $p_bug->project_id );
1343 	$t_priority_threshold = config_get( 'priority_significant_threshold' );
1344 
1345 	if( $t_priority_threshold >= 0 &&
1346 		$p_bug->priority >= $t_priority_threshold &&
1347 		$p_bug->status < config_get( 'bug_closed_status_threshold' ) ) {
1348 		echo '<span class="bold">' . $t_pri_str . '</span>';
1349 	} else {
1350 		echo $t_pri_str;
1351 	}
1352 }

1354 /**
1355  * formats the severity given the status
1356  * shows the severity in BOLD if the bug is NOT closed and is of significant severity
1357  * @param BugData $p_bug Bug Object.
1358  * @return void
1359  */
1360 function print_formatted_severity_string( BugData $p_bug ) {
1361 	$t_sev_str = get_enum_element( 'severity', $p_bug->severity, auth_get_current_user_id(), $p_bug->project_id );
1362 	$t_severity_threshold = config_get( 'severity_significant_threshold' );
1363 
1364 	if( $t_severity_threshold >= 0 &&
1365 		$p_bug->severity >= $t_severity_threshold &&
1366 		$p_bug->status < config_get( 'bug_closed_status_threshold' ) ) {
1367 		echo '<span class="bold">' . $t_sev_str . '</span>';
1368 	} else {
1369 		echo $t_sev_str;
1370 	}
1371 }

1373 /**
1374  * Print view bug sort link.
1375  *
1376  * Prints the column header as a link allowing to change the sort order.
1377  *
1378  * @param string $p_label          The displayed text of the link.
1379  * @param string $p_sort_field     The field to sort.
1380  * @param string $p_sort           The field to sort by.
1381  * @param string $p_dir            The sort direction - either ASC or DESC.
1382  * @param int    $p_columns_target See COLUMNS_TARGET_* in constant_inc.php.
1383  * @param string $p_icon           Optional Fontawesome icon to display instead of text.
1384  *                                 If is set, $p_label will be used as the icon's title attribute.
1385  *
1386  * @return void
1387  *
1388  * @todo params should be in same order as print_manage_user_sort_link
1389  */
1390 function print_view_bug_sort_link( $p_label, $p_sort_field, $p_sort, $p_dir, $p_columns_target = COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE, $p_icon = '' ) {
1391 	# @TODO cproensa, $g_filter is needed to get the temporary id, since the
1392 	# actual filter is not provided as parameter. Ideally, we should not
1393 	# rely on this global variable, but at the moment is not possible without
1394 	# a rewrite of these print functions.
1395 	global $g_filter;
1396 
1397 	switch( $p_columns_target ) {
1398 		case COLUMNS_TARGET_PRINT_PAGE:
1399 		case COLUMNS_TARGET_VIEW_PAGE:
1400 			if( $p_sort_field == $p_sort ) {
1401 				# We toggle between ASC and DESC if the user clicks the same sort order
1402 				if( 'ASC' == $p_dir ) {
1403 					$p_dir = 'DESC';
1404 				} else {
1405 					$p_dir = 'ASC';
1406 				}
1407 			} else {
1408 				# Otherwise always start with ascending
1409 				$p_dir = 'ASC';
1410 			}
1411 			$t_params = [
1412 				'sort_add' => $p_sort_field,
1413 				'dir_add' => $p_dir,
1414 				'type' => FILTER_ACTION_PARSE_ADD
1415 			];
1416 			if( $p_columns_target == COLUMNS_TARGET_PRINT_PAGE ) {
1417 				$t_params['print'] = 1;
1418 			}
1419 			$t_url = helper_url_combine( 'view_all_set.php', $t_params );
1420 			if( filter_is_temporary( $g_filter ) ) {
1421 				$t_url .= '&' . filter_get_temporary_key_param( $g_filter );
1422 			}
1423 			print_link( $t_url, $p_label, false, '', $p_icon );
1424 			break;
1425 		default:
1426 			echo $p_label;
1427 	}
1428 }

1504 /**
1505  * Print a button which presents a standalone form.
1506  *
1507  * If $p_security_token is OFF, the button's form will not contain a security
1508  * field; this is useful when form does not result in modifications (CSRF is not
1509  * needed). If otherwise specified (i.e. not null), the parameter must contain
1510  * a valid security token, previously generated by {@see form_security_token()}.
1511  * Use this to avoid performance issues when loading pages having many calls to
1512  * this function, such as adm_config_report.php.
1513  *
1514  * The security token field's name is derived from $p_action_page. If it's a
1515  * regular page, we use its name without the '.php' extension. In case of a
1516  * plugin page (generated by {@see plugin_page()}, we use the value of the
1517  * 'page' parameter, replacing '/' by '_'.
1518  *
1519  * Note: we assume that $p_action_page is valid - no error handling is done.
1520  *
1521  * @param string $p_action_page    The action page.
1522  * @param string $p_label          The button label.
1523  * @param array  $p_args_to_post   Associative array of arguments to be posted, with
1524  *                                 arg name => value, defaults to null (no args).
1525  * @param mixed  $p_security_token Optional; null (default), OFF or security token string.
1526  * @param string $p_class          The CSS class of the button.
1527  *
1528  * @return void
1529  */
1530 function print_form_button( $p_action_page, $p_label, array $p_args_to_post = [], $p_security_token = null, $p_class = '' ) {
1531 	# TODO: ensure all uses of print_button supply arguments via $p_args_to_post (POST)
1532 	# instead of via $p_action_page (GET). Then only add the CSRF form token if
1533 	# arguments are being sent via the POST method.
1534 	echo '<form method="post" action="', htmlspecialchars( $p_action_page ),
1535 		'" class="form-inline inline single-button-form">';
1536 
1537 	if( $p_security_token !== OFF ) {
1538 		$t_url = parse_url( $p_action_page );
1539 		$t_page = basename( $t_url['path'] );
1540 		if( $t_page == 'plugin.php' ) {
1541 			# Plugin page
1542 			parse_str( $t_url['query'], $t_param );
1543 			$t_form_name = 'plugin_' . str_replace( '/', '_', $t_param['page'] );
1544 		} else {
1545 			# Regular page
1546 			list( $t_form_name ) = explode( '.php', $p_action_page, 2 );
1547 		}
1548 		echo form_security_field( $t_form_name, $p_security_token );
1549 	}
1550 
1551 	if( $p_args_to_post ) {
1552 		print_hidden_inputs( $p_args_to_post );
1553 	}
1554 
1555 	if( $p_class == '') {
1556 		$p_class = 'btn btn-primary btn-xs btn-white btn-round';
1557 	}
1558 	echo '<button type="submit" class="' . $p_class . '">' . $p_label . '</button>';
1559 	echo '</form>';
1560 }

1578 /**
1579  * Print a HTML link with optional icon.
1580  *
1581  * @param string $p_link       The target URL.
1582  * @param string $p_url_text   Displayed text for the link, will be escaped prior to display.
1583  * @param bool   $p_new_window Whether to open in a new window.
1584  * @param string $p_class      The CSS class of the link.
1585  * @param string $p_icon       Optional Fontawesome icon to display before $p_label
1586  *
1587  * @return void
1588  */
1589 function print_link( $p_link, $p_url_text, $p_new_window = false, $p_class = '', $p_icon = '' ) {
1590 	if( $p_icon ) {
1591 		$t_url_text = icon_get( $p_icon, '', $p_url_text );
1592 	} else {
1593 		$t_url_text = string_attribute( $p_url_text );
1594 	}
1595 
1596 	if( is_blank( $p_link ) ) {
1597 		echo $t_url_text;
1598 	} else {
1599 		$t_link = htmlspecialchars( $p_link );
1600 		if( $p_new_window === true ) {
1601 			echo '<a class="new-window ' . $p_class . '" href="' . $t_link . '" target="_blank">' . $t_url_text . '</a>';
1602 		} else {
1603 			if( $p_class !== '' ) {
1604 				echo '<a class="' . $p_class . '" href="' . $t_link . '">' . $t_url_text . '</a>';
1605 			} else {
1606 				echo '<a href="' . $t_link . '">' . $t_url_text . '</a>';
1607 			}
1608 		}
1609 	}
1610 }

1648 /**
1649  * print a HTML page link
1650  * @param string  $p_page_url       The Page URL.
1651  * @param string  $p_text           The displayed text for the link.
1652  * @param integer $p_page_no        The page number to link to.
1653  * @param integer $p_page_cur       The current page number.
1654  * @param integer $p_temp_filter_key Temporary filter key.
1655  * @return void
1656  */
1657 function print_page_link( $p_page_url, $p_text = '', $p_page_no = 0, $p_page_cur = 0, $p_temp_filter_key = null ) {
1658 	if( is_blank( $p_text ) ) {
1659 		$p_text = $p_page_no;
1660 	}
1661 
1662 	if( ( 0 < $p_page_no ) && ( $p_page_no != $p_page_cur ) ) {
1663 		echo '<li class="pull-right"> ';
1664 		$t_delimiter = ( strpos( $p_page_url, '?' ) ? '&' : '?' );
1665 		if( $p_temp_filter_key ) {
1666 			print_link( $p_page_url . $t_delimiter . 'filter=' . $p_temp_filter_key . '&page_number=' . $p_page_no, $p_text );
1667 		} else {
1668 			print_link( $p_page_url . $t_delimiter . 'page_number=' . $p_page_no, $p_text );
1669 		}
1670 		echo ' </li>';
1671 	} else {
1672 		echo '<li class="disabled pull-right"><a>' . $p_text . '</a></li>';
1673 	}
1674 }

1676 /**
1677  * print a list of page number links (eg [1 2 3])
1678  * @param string  $p_page           The Page URL.
1679  * @param integer $p_start          The first page number.
1680  * @param integer $p_end            The last page number.
1681  * @param integer $p_current        The current page number.
1682  * @param integer $p_temp_filter_key Temporary filter key.
1683  * @return void
1684  */
1685 function print_page_links( $p_page, $p_start, $p_end, $p_current, $p_temp_filter_key = null ) {
1686 	$t_items = array();
1687 
1688 	# @TODO cproensa
1689 	# passing the temporary filter id to build ad-hoc url parameter is weak
1690 	# ideally, we should pass a parameters array which is appended to all generated links
1691 	# those parameters are provided as needed by the main page calling this functions
1692 
1693 	# Check if we have more than one page,
1694 	#  otherwise return without doing anything.
1695 
1696 	if( $p_end - $p_start < 1 ) {
1697 		return;
1698 	}
1699 
1700 	# Get localized strings
1701 	$t_first = lang_get( 'first' );
1702 	$t_last = lang_get( 'last' );
1703 	$t_prev = lang_get( 'prev' );
1704 	$t_next = lang_get( 'next' );
1705 
1706 	$t_page_links = 10;
1707 
1708 	print( '<ul class="pagination small no-margin"> ' );
1709 
1710 	# Next and Last links
1711 	print_page_link( $p_page, $t_last, $p_end, $p_current, $p_temp_filter_key );
1712 	if( $p_current < $p_end ) {
1713 		print_page_link( $p_page, $t_next, $p_current + 1, $p_current, $p_temp_filter_key );
1714 	} else {
1715 		print_page_link( $p_page, $t_next, 0, 0, $p_temp_filter_key );
1716 	}
1717 
1718 	# Page numbers ...
1719 
1720 	$t_first_page = max( $p_start, $p_current - $t_page_links / 2 );
1721 	$t_first_page = min( $t_first_page, $p_end - $t_page_links );
1722 	$t_first_page = max( $t_first_page, $p_start );
1723 
1724 	$t_last_page = $t_first_page + $t_page_links;
1725 	$t_last_page = min( $t_last_page, $p_end );
1726 
1727 	if( $t_last_page < $p_end ) {
1728 		print( '<li class="pull-right"><a> ... </a></li>' );
1729 	}
1730 
1731 	for( $i = $t_last_page;$i >= $t_first_page;$i-- ) {
1732 		if( $i == $p_current ) {
1733 			array_push( $t_items, '<li class="active pull-right"><a>' . $i . '</a></li>' );
1734 		} else {
1735 			$t_delimiter = ( strpos( $p_page, '?' ) ? '&' : '?' ) ;
1736 			$t_filter_param = filter_get_temporary_key_param( $p_temp_filter_key );
1737 			$t_filter_param .= $t_filter_param === null ? '' : '&amp;';
1738 			array_push( $t_items, '<li class="pull-right"><a href="' . $p_page . $t_delimiter . $t_filter_param . 'page_number=' . $i . '">' . $i . '</a></li>' );
1739 		}
1740 	}
1741 	echo implode( '&#160;', $t_items );
1742 
1743 	if( $t_first_page > 1 ) {
1744 		print( '<li class="pull-right"><a> ... </a></li>' );
1745 	}
1746 
1747 
1748 	# First and previous links
1749 	print_page_link( $p_page, $t_prev, $p_current - 1, $p_current, $p_temp_filter_key );
1750 	print_page_link( $p_page, $t_first, 1, $p_current, $p_temp_filter_key );
1751 
1752 	print( ' </ul>' );
1753 }

1802  */

1809 /**
1810  * Print hidden html input tag <input type=hidden>
1811  *
1812  * @param string $p_field_key Name parameter.
1813  * @param string|array $p_field_val Value parameter.
1814  * @return void
1815  */
1816 function print_hidden_input( $p_field_key, $p_field_val ) {
1817 	if( is_array( $p_field_val ) ) {
1818 		foreach( $p_field_val as $t_key => $t_value ) {
1819 			if( is_array( $t_value ) ) {
1820 				$t_key = string_html_entities( $t_key );
1821 				$t_field_key = $p_field_key . '[' . $t_key . ']';
1822 				print_hidden_input( $t_field_key, $t_value );
1823 			} else {
1824 				$t_field_key = $p_field_key . '[' . $t_key . ']';
1825 				print_hidden_input( $t_field_key, $t_value );
1826 			}
1827 		}
1828 	} else {
1829 		$t_key = string_html_entities( $p_field_key );
1830 		$t_val = string_html_entities( $p_field_val );
1831 		echo '<input type="hidden" name="' . $t_key . '" value="' . $t_val . '" />' . "\n";
1832 	}
1833 }

1935 /**
1936  * print a drop down box from input array
1937  * @param array        $p_control_array Array of elements in drop down list (name, description).
1938  * @param string       $p_control_name  Name attribute of <select> box.
1939  * @param string|array $p_match	        Either a string or an array of selected values.
1940  * @param boolean      $p_add_any       Whether to display an '[any]' option in the drop down.
1941  * @param boolean      $p_multiple      Whether drop down list allows multiple values to be selected.
1942  * @return string
1943  */
1944 function get_dropdown( array $p_control_array, $p_control_name, $p_match = '', $p_add_any = false, $p_multiple = false ) {
1945 	if( $p_multiple ) {
1946 		$t_size = ' size="5"';
1947 		$t_multiple = ' multiple="multiple"';
1948 	} else {
1949 		$t_size = '';
1950 		$t_multiple = '';
1951 	}
1952 	$t_info = sprintf( '<select class="input-sm" %s name="%s" id="%s"%s>', $t_multiple, $p_control_name, $p_control_name, $t_size );
1953 	if( $p_add_any ) {
1954 		array_unshift( $p_control_array, [ META_FILTER_ANY => '[any]' ] );
1955 	}
1956 	foreach ( $p_control_array as $t_name => $t_desc ) {
1957 		$t_sel = '';
1958 		if( is_array( $p_match ) ) {
1959 			if( in_array( $t_name, array_values( $p_match ) ) || in_array( $t_desc, array_values( $p_match ) ) ) {
1960 				$t_sel = ' selected="selected"';
1961 			}
1962 		} else {
1963 			if( ( $t_name === $p_match ) || ( $t_desc === $p_match ) ) {
1964 				$t_sel = ' selected="selected"';
1965 			}
1966 		}
1967 		$t_info .= sprintf( '<option%s value="%s">%s</option>', $t_sel, $t_name, $t_desc );
1968 	}
1969 	$t_info .= "</select>\n";
1970 	return $t_info;
1971 }
