1973 /**
1974  * Prints information about a single attachment including download link, file
1975  * size, upload timestamp and an expandable preview for text and image file
1976  * types.
1977  * If $p_security_token is null, a token will be generated with form_security_token().
1978  * If otherwise specified (i.e. not null), the parameter must contain
1979  * a valid security token, previously generated by form_security_token().
1980  * Use this to avoid performance issues when loading pages having many calls to
1981  * this function.
1982  * @param array $p_attachment An attachment array from within the array returned
1983  *                            by the file_get_visible_attachments() function.
1984  * @param string $p_security_token The security token to use for deleting attachments.
1985  * @return void
1986  */
1987 function print_bug_attachment( array $p_attachment, $p_security_token ) {
1988 	echo '<div class="well well-xs">';
1989 
1990 	if( $p_attachment['preview'] || $p_attachment['type'] === 'audio' || $p_attachment['type'] === 'video' ) {
1991 		$t_collapse_id = 'attachment_preview_' . $p_attachment['id'];
1992 		global $g_collapse_cache_token;
1993 		$g_collapse_cache_token[$t_collapse_id] = 
1994 			$p_attachment['type'] == 'image' ||
1995 			$p_attachment['type'] == 'audio' ||
1996 			$p_attachment['type'] == 'video';
1997 
1998 		collapse_open( $t_collapse_id, '');
1999 	}
2000 
2001 	print_bug_attachment_header( $p_attachment, $p_security_token );
2002 
2003 	if( $p_attachment['preview'] ) {
2004 		echo lang_get( 'word_separator' );
2005 		collapse_icon( $t_collapse_id );
2006 
2007 		switch( $p_attachment['type'] ) {
2008 			case 'text':
2009 				print_bug_attachment_preview_text( $p_attachment );
2010 				break;
2011 			case 'image':
2012 				print_bug_attachment_preview_image( $p_attachment );
2013 				break;
2014 			case 'audio':
2015 			case 'video':
2016 				print_bug_attachment_preview_audio_video(
2017 					$p_attachment, $p_attachment['file_type'], $p_attachment['preview'] );
2018 				break;
2019 		}
2020 
2021 		collapse_closed( $t_collapse_id, '' );
2022 
2023 		print_bug_attachment_header( $p_attachment, $p_security_token );
2024 		echo lang_get( 'word_separator' );
2025 		collapse_icon( $t_collapse_id );
2026 		collapse_end( $t_collapse_id );
2027 	} else {
2028 		# Audio / Video support showing control without preloading.
2029 		if( $p_attachment['type'] === 'audio' || $p_attachment['type'] === 'video' ) {
2030 			echo lang_get( 'word_separator' );
2031 			collapse_icon( $t_collapse_id );
2032 	
2033 			print_bug_attachment_preview_audio_video(
2034 				$p_attachment,
2035 				$p_attachment['file_type'],
2036 				$p_attachment['preview'] );
2037 	
2038 			collapse_closed( $t_collapse_id );
2039 			print_bug_attachment_header( $p_attachment, $p_security_token );
2040 			echo lang_get( 'word_separator' );
2041 			collapse_icon( $t_collapse_id );
2042 			collapse_end( $t_collapse_id );	
2043 		} else {
2044 			echo '<br />';
2045 		}
2046 	}
2047 
2048 	echo '</div>';
2049 }
2050 
2051 /**
2052  * Prints a single textual line of information about an attachment including download link, file
2053  * size and upload timestamp.
2054  * If $p_security_token is null, a token will be generated with form_security_token().
2055  * If otherwise specified (i.e. not null), the parameter must contain
2056  * a valid security token, previously generated by form_security_token().
2057  * Use this to avoid performance issues when loading pages having many calls to
2058  * this function.
2059  * @param array $p_attachment An attachment array from within the array returned by
2060  *              the file_get_visible_attachments() function.
2061  * @param string $p_security_token The security token to use for deleting attachments.
2062  * @return void
2063  */
2064 function print_bug_attachment_header( array $p_attachment, $p_security_token ) {
2065 	if( $p_attachment['exists'] ) {
2066 		if( $p_attachment['can_download'] ) {
2067 			echo '<a href="' . string_attribute( $p_attachment['download_url'] ) . '"' . print_attachment_link_target() . '>';
2068 		}
2069 		print_file_icon( $p_attachment['display_name'] );
2070 		if( $p_attachment['can_download'] ) {
2071 			echo '</a>';
2072 		}
2073 		echo lang_get( 'word_separator' );
2074 		if( $p_attachment['can_download'] ) {
2075 			echo '<a href="' . string_attribute( $p_attachment['download_url'] ) . '"' . print_attachment_link_target() . '>';
2076 		}
2077 		echo string_display_line( $p_attachment['display_name'] );
2078 		if( $p_attachment['can_download'] ) {
2079 			echo '</a>';
2080 		}
2081 
2082 		echo lang_get( 'word_separator' ) . '(' . number_format( $p_attachment['size'] ) . lang_get( 'word_separator' ) . lang_get( 'bytes' ) . ')';
2083 		event_signal( 'EVENT_VIEW_BUG_ATTACHMENT', array( $p_attachment ) );
2084 	} else {
2085 		print_file_icon( $p_attachment['display_name'] );
2086 		echo lang_get( 'word_separator' ) . '<s>' . string_display_line( $p_attachment['display_name'] ) . '</s>' . lang_get( 'word_separator' ) . '(' . lang_get( 'attachment_missing' ) . ')';
2087 	}
2088 
2089 	if( $p_attachment['can_delete'] ) {
2090 		echo '<a class="noprint red zoom-130 pull-right" '
2091 			. 'href="bug_file_delete.php?file_id=' . $p_attachment['id']
2092 			. form_security_param( 'bug_file_delete', $p_security_token ) . '">';
2093 		print_icon( 'fa-trash-o', '1 ace-icon bigger-115' );
2094 		echo '</a>';
2095 	}
2096 }

2098 /**
2099  * Prints the preview of a text file attachment.
2100  * @param array $p_attachment An attachment array from within the array returned by
2101  *              the file_get_visible_attachments() function.
2102  * @return void
2103  */
2104 function print_bug_attachment_preview_text( array $p_attachment ) {
2105 	if( !$p_attachment['exists'] ) {
2106 		return;
2107 	}
2108 	echo "\n<pre class=\"bug-attachment-preview-text\">";
2109 	switch( config_get( 'file_upload_method' ) ) {
2110 		case DISK:
2111 			if( file_exists( $p_attachment['diskfile'] ) ) {
2112 				$t_content = file_get_contents( $p_attachment['diskfile'] );
2113 			}
2114 			break;
2115 		case DATABASE:
2116 			db_param_push();
2117 			$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_file} WHERE id=' . db_param();
2118 			$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_attachment['id'] ) );
2119 			$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
2120 			$t_content = $t_row['content'];
2121 			break;
2122 		default:
2123 			trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
2124 	}
2125 	echo htmlspecialchars( $t_content, ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8' );
2126 	echo '</pre>';
2127 }

2179 /**
2180  * Print the option list for time zones
2181  * @param string $p_timezone Selected time zone.
2182  * @return void
2183  */
2184 function print_timezone_option_list( $p_timezone ) {
2185 	$t_identifiers = timezone_identifiers_list( DateTimeZone::ALL );
2186 
2187 	foreach( $t_identifiers as $t_identifier ) {
2188 		$t_zone = explode( '/', $t_identifier, 2 );
2189 		if( isset( $t_zone[1] ) ) {
2190 			$t_id = $t_zone[1];
2191 		} else {
2192 			$t_id = $t_identifier;
2193 		}
2194 		$t_locations[$t_zone[0]][$t_identifier] = array(
2195 			str_replace( '_', ' ', $t_id ),
2196 			$t_identifier
2197 		);
2198 	}
2199 
2200 	foreach( $t_locations as $t_continent => $t_locations ) {
2201 		echo "\t" . '<optgroup label="' . $t_continent . '">' . "\n";
2202 		foreach ( $t_locations as $t_location ) {
2203 			echo "\t\t" . '<option value="' . $t_location[1] . '"';
2204 			check_selected( $p_timezone, $t_location[1] );
2205 			echo '>' . $t_location[0] . '</option>' . "\n";
2206 		}
2207 		echo "\t" . '</optgroup>' . "\n";
2208 	}
2209 }

2348 function print_relationship_list_box( $p_default_rel_type = BUG_REL_ANY, $p_select_name = 'rel_type', $p_include_any = false, $p_include_none = false, $p_input_css = "input-sm" ) {

2350 	?>
2351 <select class="<?php echo $p_input_css ?>" name="<?php echo $p_select_name?>">

2355 	}

2360 	}

2363 		?>

2365 <?php
2366 	}?>
2367 </select>
2368 <?php
2369 }

  45 use Mantis\Exceptions\ClientException;

  47 /**
  48  * System Profile information
  49  *
  50  * @property int $id
  51  * @property int $user_id
  52  * @property string $platform
  53  * @property string $os
  54  * @property string $os_build
  55  * @property string $description
  56  */
  57 class ProfileData {
  58 	/** @var int Profile Id */
  59 	protected int $id;
  60 
  61 	/** @var int User Id */
  62 	protected int $user_id;
  63 
  64 	/** @var string Platform */
  65 	protected string $platform;
  66 
  67 	/** @var string Operating System */
  68 	protected string $os;
  69 
  70 	/** @var string Operating System Build */
  71 	protected string $os_build;
  72 
  73 	/** @var string Profile description */
  74 	protected string $description;
  75 
  76 	/**
  77 	 * Class constructor
  78 	 *
  79 	 * @param int $p_profile_id Id of Profile to initialize object with.
  80 	 *
  81 	 * @throws ClientException if the Profile Id does not exist.
  82 	 */
  83 	public function __construct( int $p_profile_id ) {
  84 		$t_row = $this->load_row( $p_profile_id );
  85 
  86 		$this->id = $t_row['id'];
  87 		$this->user_id = $t_row['user_id'];
  88 		$this->platform = $t_row['platform'];
  89 		$this->os = $t_row['os'];
  90 		$this->os_build = $t_row['os_build'];
  91 		$this->description = $t_row['description'];
  92 	}
  93 
  94 	/**
  95 	 * Load and return a profile row from the database.
  96 	 *
  97 	 * @param int $p_profile_id A profile identifier.
  98 	 *
  99 	 * @return array
 100 	 * @throws ClientException if the Profile Id does not exist
 101 	 */
 102 	public static function load_row( int $p_profile_id ): array {
 103 		$t_query = new DbQuery();
 104 		$t_query->sql( 'SELECT * FROM {user_profile} WHERE id=:profile_id' );
 105 		$t_query->bind( 'profile_id',  $p_profile_id );
 106 		$t_query->execute();
 107 
 108 		$t_row = $t_query->fetch();
 109 		if( !$t_row ) {
 110 			throw new ClientException(
 111 				"Profile #$p_profile_id not found",
 112 				ERROR_USER_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND,
 113 				array( $p_profile_id )
 114 			);
 115 		}
 116 
 117 		return $t_row;
 118 	}
 119 
 120 	/**
 121 	 * Allow direct, read-only access to class properties.
 122 	 *
 123 	 * @param string $p_property Property name.
 124 	 *
 125 	 * @return int|string Property value.
 126 	 * @throws ClientException if property does not exist
 127 	 */
 128 	public function __get( string $p_property ) {
 129 		if( !property_exists( $this, $p_property ) ) {
 130 			throw new ClientException( "Unknown property '$p_property'", ERROR_GENERIC );
 131 		}
 132 		return $this->$p_property;
 133 	}
 134 
 135 	/**
 136 	 * Return the profile's name as concatenation of platform, os and build.
 137 	 *
 138 	 * @return string
 139 	 */
 140 	public function get_name(): string {
 141 		return "$this->platform $this->os $this->os_build";
 142 	}
 143 
 144 	/**
 145 	 * Returns true if the specified profile is global.
 146 	 *
 147 	 * @return bool
 148 	 */
 149 	public function is_global(): bool {
 150 		return $this->user_id == ALL_USERS;
 151 	}
 152 
 153 	/**
 154 	 * Check if user is allowed to update or delete the given Profile.
 155 	 *
 156 	 * @param int|null $p_user_id User id or null for current user (default).
 157 	 *
 158 	 * @return bool True if allowed, false otherwise.
 159 	 */
 160 	function can_update( ?int $p_user_id = null ): bool {
 161 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id === null ? auth_get_current_user_id() : $p_user_id;
 162 
 163 		# Global profile ?
 164 		if( $this->is_global()) {
 165 			return access_has_global_level( config_get( 'manage_global_profile_threshold' ) );
 166 		}
 167 
 168 		return $this->user_id == $t_user_id;
 169 	}
 170 
 171 	/**
 172 	 * Throws Access Denied error if user is not allowed to update the Profile.
 173 	 *
 174 	 * @param int|null $p_user_id User id or null for current user (default).
 175 	 */
 176 	function ensure_can_update( ?int $p_user_id = null ) {
 177 		if( !$this->can_update( $p_user_id ) ) {
 178 			access_denied();
 179 		}
 180 	}
 181 
 182 }

 184 /**
 185  * Create a new profile for the user, return the ID of the new profile.
 186  *
 187  * @param int    $p_user_id     A valid user identifier.
 188  * @param string $p_platform    Value for profile platform.
 189  * @param string $p_os          Value for profile operating system.
 190  * @param string $p_os_build    Value for profile operation system build.
 191  * @param string $p_description Description of profile.
 192  *
 193  * @return int
 194  * @throws ClientException if user is protected
 195  */
 196 function profile_create( $p_user_id, $p_platform, $p_os, $p_os_build, $p_description ) {
 197 	$p_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 198 
 199 	profile_validate_before_update( $p_user_id, $p_platform, $p_os, $p_os_build, $p_description );
 200 
 201 	# Add profile
 202 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 203 	$t_query->sql( 'INSERT INTO {user_profile}
 204 		( user_id, platform, os, os_build, description )
 205 		VALUES
 206 		( :user_id, :platform, :os, :os_build, :description )'
 207 	);
 208 	$t_query->bind( 'user_id',  $p_user_id );
 209 	$t_query->bind( 'platform',  $p_platform );
 210 	$t_query->bind( 'os',  $p_os );
 211 	$t_query->bind( 'os_build',  $p_os_build );
 212 	$t_query->bind( 'description',  $p_description );
 213 	$t_query->execute();
 214 
 215 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'user_profile' ) );
 216 }
 217 
 218 /**
 219  * Delete a profile for the user.
 220  *
 221  * Note that although profile IDs are currently globally unique, the existing
 222  * code included the user_id in the query and I have chosen to keep that for
 223  * this API as it hides the details of id implementation from users of the API
 224  *
 225  * @param int $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 226  * @param int $p_profile_id A profile identifier.
 227  *
 228  * @return void
 229  * @throws ClientException if user is protected
 230  */
 231 function profile_delete( $p_user_id, $p_profile_id ) {
 232 	if( ALL_USERS != $p_user_id ) {
 233 		user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
 234 	}
 235 
 236 	# Delete the profile
 237 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 238 	$t_query->sql( 'DELETE FROM {user_profile} WHERE id=:profile_id AND user_id=:user_id' );
 239 	$t_query->bind( 'profile_id',  $p_profile_id );
 240 	$t_query->bind( 'user_id',  $p_user_id );
 241 	$t_query->execute();
 242 }
 243 
 244 /**
 245  * Update a profile for the user.
 246  *
 247  * @param int    $p_user_id     A valid user identifier.
 248  * @param int    $p_profile_id  A profile identifier.
 249  * @param string $p_platform    Value for profile platform.
 250  * @param string $p_os          Value for profile operating system.
 251  * @param string $p_os_build    Value for profile operation system build.
 252  * @param string $p_description Description of profile.
 253  *
 254  * @return void
 255  * @throws ClientException if user is protected
 256  */
 257 function profile_update( $p_user_id, $p_profile_id, $p_platform, $p_os, $p_os_build, $p_description ) {
 258 	profile_validate_before_update( $p_user_id, $p_platform, $p_os, $p_os_build, $p_description );
 259 
 260 	# Update profile
 261 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 262 	$t_query->sql( 'UPDATE {user_profile}
 263 		SET platform=:platform, 
 264 			os=:os,
 265 			os_build=:os_build,
 266 			description=:description
 267 		WHERE id=:profile_id AND user_id=:user_id'
 268 	);
 269 	$t_query->bind( 'platform',  $p_platform );
 270 	$t_query->bind( 'os',  $p_os );
 271 	$t_query->bind( 'os_build',  $p_os_build );
 272 	$t_query->bind( 'description',  $p_description );
 273 	$t_query->bind( 'profile_id',  $p_profile_id );
 274 	$t_query->bind( 'user_id',  $p_user_id );
 275 	$t_query->execute();
 276 }

 278 /**
 279  * Validates that the given profile data is valid, throw errors if not.
 280  *
 281  * @param int    $p_user_id     A valid user identifier.
 282  * @param string $p_platform    Value for profile platform.
 283  * @param string $p_os          Value for profile operating system.
 284  * @param string $p_os_build    Value for profile operation system build.
 285  * @param string $p_description Value for profile description.
 286  *
 287  * @throws ClientException
 288  * @internal
 289  */
 290 function profile_validate_before_update( $p_user_id, $p_platform, $p_os, $p_os_build, $p_description ) {
 291 	if( ALL_USERS != $p_user_id ) {
 292 		user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
 293 	}
 294 
 295 	# platform cannot be blank
 296 	if( is_blank( $p_platform ) ) {
 297 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'platform' ) );
 298 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 299 	}
 300 
 301 	# os cannot be blank
 302 	if( is_blank( $p_os ) ) {
 303 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'os' ) );
 304 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 305 	}
 306 
 307 	# os_build cannot be blank
 308 	if( is_blank( $p_os_build ) ) {
 309 		error_parameters( lang_get( 'version' ) );
 310 		trigger_error( ERROR_EMPTY_FIELD, ERROR );
 311 	}
 312 
 313 	# Description length
 314 	helper_ensure_longtext_length_valid( $p_description, 'profile_description' );
 315 }

 352 /**
 353  * Return an array containing all rows for a given user.
 354  *
 355  * @param int  $p_user_id   A valid user identifier.
 356  * @param bool $p_all_users Include profiles for all users.
 357  *
 358  * @return array
 359  */
 360 function profile_get_all_rows( $p_user_id, $p_all_users = false ) {
 361 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 362 	$t_query->sql( 'SELECT * FROM {user_profile} WHERE user_id=:user_id' );
 363 	if( $p_all_users && ALL_USERS != $p_user_id ) {
 364 		$t_query->append_sql( ' OR user_id=' . ALL_USERS );
 365 	}
 366 	$t_query->append_sql( ' ORDER BY platform, os, os_build' );
 367 
 368 	$t_query->bind( 'user_id',  $p_user_id );
 369 	$t_query->execute();
 370 
 371 	return $t_query->fetch_all();

 374 /**

 376  * including global profiles.

 382 function profile_get_all_for_user( $p_user_id ) {

 386 /**
 387  * Return an array of strings containing unique values for the specified field
 388  * based on private and public profiles accessible to the specified user.
 389  *
 390  * @param string $p_field   Field name of the profile to retrieve.
 391  * @param int    $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
 392  *
 393  * @return array
 394  */
 395 function profile_get_field_all_for_user( $p_field, $p_user_id = null ) {
 396 	$c_user_id = ( $p_user_id === null ) ? auth_get_current_user_id() : $p_user_id;
 397 
 398 	switch( $p_field ) {
 399 		case 'id':
 400 		case 'user_id':
 401 		case 'platform':
 402 		case 'os':
 403 		case 'os_build':
 404 		case 'description':
 405 			$c_field = $p_field;
 406 			break;
 407 		default:
 408 			trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 409 	}
 410 
 411 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 412 	/** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
 413 	$t_query->sql( "SELECT DISTINCT $c_field 
 414 		FROM {user_profile}
 415 		WHERE user_id=:user_id OR user_id=" . ALL_USERS . "
 416 		ORDER BY $c_field"
 417 	);
 418 	$t_query->bind( 'user_id',  $c_user_id );
 419 	$t_query->execute();
 420 
 421 	return array_column( $t_query->fetch_all(), $p_field );
 422 }

 424 /**
 425  * Return an array containing all profiles used in a given project.

 427  * @param int $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 428  *

 430  */
 431 function profile_get_all_for_project( $p_project_id ) {
 432 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 433 	$t_query->sql( 'SELECT DISTINCT(up.id), up.user_id, up.platform, up.os, up.os_build
 434 		FROM {user_profile} up
 435 		JOIN {bug} b ON b.profile_id = up.id
 436 		WHERE ' . helper_project_specific_where( $p_project_id ) . '
 437 		ORDER BY up.platform, up.os, up.os_build'
 438 	);
 439 	$t_query->execute();
 440 
 441 	return $t_query->fetch_all();
 442 }

  59 $g_cache_project = array();
  60 $g_cache_project_missing = array();
  61 $g_cache_project_all = false;
  62 
  63 use Mantis\Exceptions\ClientException;
  64 
  65 /**
  66  * Checks if there are no projects defined.
  67  * @return boolean true if there are no projects defined, false otherwise.
  68  * @access public
  69  */
  70 function project_table_empty() {
  71 	global $g_cache_project;
  72 
  73 	# If projects already cached, use the cache.
  74 	if( isset( $g_cache_project ) && count( $g_cache_project ) > 0 ) {
  75 		return false;
  76 	}
  77 
  78 	# Otherwise, check if the projects table contains at least one project.
  79 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
  80 	$t_query->sql( 'SELECT * FROM {project}' );
  81 	$t_query->set_limit( 1 );
  82 	$t_result = $t_query->execute();
  83 
  84 	return db_num_rows( $t_result ) == 0;
  85 }

  87 /**
  88  * Cache a project row if necessary and return the cached copy
  89  *  If the second parameter is true (default), trigger an error
  90  *  if the project can't be found.  If the second parameter is
  91  *  false, return false if the project can't be found.
  92  * @param integer $p_project_id     A project identifier.
  93  * @param boolean $p_trigger_errors Whether to trigger errors.
  94  * @return array|boolean
  95  * @throws ClientException
  96  */
  97 function project_cache_row( $p_project_id, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
  98 	global $g_cache_project, $g_cache_project_missing;
  99 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 100 
 101 	if( $c_project_id == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 102 		return false;
 103 	}
 104 
 105 
 106 	if( isset( $g_cache_project[$c_project_id] ) ) {
 107 		return $g_cache_project[$c_project_id];
 108 	} else if( isset( $g_cache_project_missing[$c_project_id] ) ) {
 109 		return false;
 110 	}
 111 
 112 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 113 	$t_query->sql( 'SELECT * FROM {project} WHERE id=' . $t_query->param( $p_project_id ) );
 114 	$t_row = $t_query->fetch();
 115 
 116 	if( $t_row === false ) {
 117 		$g_cache_project_missing[$c_project_id] = true;
 118 
 119 		if( $p_trigger_errors ) {
 120 			throw new ClientException( "Project #$p_project_id not found", ERROR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, array( $p_project_id ) );
 121 		}
 122 
 123 		return false;
 124 	}
 125 
 126 	$g_cache_project[$c_project_id] = $t_row;
 127 	return $t_row;
 128 }
 129 
 130 /**
 131  * Cache project data for array of project ids
 132  * @param array $p_project_id_array An array of project identifiers.
 133  * @return void
 134  */
 135 function project_cache_array_rows( array $p_project_id_array ) {
 136 	global $g_cache_project, $g_cache_project_missing;
 137 
 138 	$c_project_id_array = array();
 139 	foreach( $p_project_id_array as $t_project_id ) {
 140 		$c_id = (int)$t_project_id;
 141 		if( !isset( $g_cache_project[$c_id] ) && !isset( $g_cache_project_missing[$c_id] ) ) {
 142 			$c_project_id_array[] = $c_id;
 143 		}
 144 	}
 145 
 146 	if( empty( $c_project_id_array ) ) {
 147 		return;
 148 	}
 149 
 150 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 151 	$t_query->sql(
 152 		'SELECT * FROM {project} WHERE '
 153 		. $t_query->sql_in( 'id', $c_project_id_array )
 154 	);
 155 	$t_query->execute();
 156 
 157 	$t_projects_found = array();
 158 	while( $t_row = $t_query->fetch() ) {
 159 		$t_id = (int)$t_row['id'];
 160 		$g_cache_project[$t_id] = $t_row;
 161 		$t_projects_found[$t_id] = true;
 162 	}
 163 
 164 	foreach ( $c_project_id_array as $c_project_id ) {
 165 		if( !isset( $t_projects_found[$c_project_id] ) ) {
 166 			$g_cache_project_missing[$c_project_id] = true;
 167 		}
 168 	}
 169 }
 170 
 171 /**
 172  * Cache all project rows and return an array of them
 173  * @return array
 174  */
 175 function project_cache_all() {
 176 	global $g_cache_project, $g_cache_project_all;
 177 
 178 	if( !$g_cache_project_all ) {
 179 		$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT * FROM {project}' );
 180 		$t_query->execute();
 181 
 182 		while( $t_row = $t_query->fetch() ) {
 183 			$g_cache_project[(int)$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
 184 		}
 185 
 186 		$g_cache_project_all = true;
 187 	}
 188 
 189 	return $g_cache_project;
 190 }

 192 /**
 193  * Clear the project cache (or just the given id if specified)
 194  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 195  * @return void
 196  */
 197 function project_clear_cache( $p_project_id = null ) {
 198 	global $g_cache_project, $g_cache_project_missing, $g_cache_project_all;
 199 
 200 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
 201 		$g_cache_project = array();
 202 		$g_cache_project_missing = array();
 203 		$g_cache_project_all = false;
 204 	} else {
 205 		unset( $g_cache_project[(int)$p_project_id] );
 206 		unset( $g_cache_project_missing[(int)$p_project_id] );
 207 		$g_cache_project_all = false;
 208 	}
 209 }

 220 /**

 223  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 224  * @return boolean
 225  */
 226 function project_exists( $p_project_id ) {
 227 	# we're making use of the caching function here.  If we succeed in caching the project then it exists and is
 228 	# now cached for use by later function calls.  If we can't cache it we return false.
 229 	if( false == project_cache_row( $p_project_id, false ) ) {
 230 		return false;
 231 	} else {
 232 		return true;

 306 /**
 307  * Make sure that the project file path is valid: add trailing slash and
 308  * set it to blank if equal to default path
 309  * @param string $p_file_path A file path.
 310  * @return string
 311  * @access public
 312  */
 313 function validate_project_file_path( $p_file_path ) {
 314 	if( !is_blank( $p_file_path ) ) {
 315 		# Make sure file path has trailing slash
 316 		$p_file_path = terminate_directory_path( $p_file_path );
 317 
 318 		# If the provided path is the same as the default, make the path blank.
 319 		# This means that if the default upload path is changed, you don't have
 320 		# to update the upload path for every single project.
 321 		if( !strcmp( $p_file_path, config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder' ) ) ) {
 322 			$p_file_path = '';
 323 		} else {
 324 			file_ensure_valid_upload_path( $p_file_path );
 325 		}
 326 	}
 327 
 328 	return $p_file_path;
 329 }

 333 /**
 334  * Create a new project
 335  * @param string  $p_name           The name of the project being created.
 336  * @param string  $p_description    A description for the project.
 337  * @param integer $p_status         The status of the project.
 338  * @param integer $p_view_state     The view state of the project - public or private.
 339  * @param string  $p_file_path      The attachment file path for the project, if not storing in the database.
 340  * @param boolean $p_enabled        Whether the project is enabled.
 341  * @param boolean $p_inherit_global Whether the project inherits global categories.
 342  * @return integer
 343  */
 344 function project_create( $p_name, $p_description, $p_status, $p_view_state = VS_PUBLIC, $p_file_path = '', $p_enabled = true, $p_inherit_global = true ) {
 345 	$c_enabled = (bool)$p_enabled;
 346 
 347 	if( is_blank( $p_name ) ) {
 348 		trigger_error( ERROR_PROJECT_NAME_INVALID, ERROR );
 349 	}
 350 
 351 	$t_name = trim( $p_name );
 352 
 353 	project_ensure_name_unique( $t_name );
 354 
 355 	# Project does not exist yet, so we get global config
 356 	if( DATABASE !== config_get( 'file_upload_method', null, null, ALL_PROJECTS ) ) {
 357 		$p_file_path = validate_project_file_path( $p_file_path );
 358 	}
 359 
 360 	$t_param = array(
 361 		'name' => $t_name,
 362 		'status' => (int)$p_status,
 363 		'enabled' => $c_enabled,
 364 		'view_state' => (int)$p_view_state,
 365 		'file_path' => $p_file_path,
 366 		'description' => $p_description,
 367 		'inherit_global' => $p_inherit_global,
 368 	);
 369 
 370 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'INSERT INTO {project}
 371 		( ' . implode( ', ', array_keys( $t_param ) ) . ' )
 372 		VALUES :param'
 373 	);
 374 
 375 	$t_query->bind( 'param', $t_param );
 376 	$t_query->execute();
 377 
 378 	# return the id of the new project
 379 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'project' ) );
 380 }

 382 /**
 383  * Delete a project
 384  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 385  * @return void
 386  */
 387 function project_delete( $p_project_id ) {
 388 	$t_email_notifications = config_get( 'enable_email_notification' );
 389 
 390 	# temporarily disable all notifications
 391 	config_set_cache( 'enable_email_notification', OFF, CONFIG_TYPE_INT );
 392 
 393 	# Delete the bugs
 394 	bug_delete_all( $p_project_id );
 395 
 396 	# Delete associations with custom field definitions.
 397 	custom_field_unlink_all( $p_project_id );
 398 
 399 	# Delete the project categories
 400 	category_remove_all( $p_project_id );
 401 
 402 	# Delete the project versions
 403 	version_remove_all( $p_project_id );
 404 
 405 	# Delete relations to other projects
 406 	project_hierarchy_remove_all( $p_project_id );
 407 
 408 	# Delete the project files
 409 	project_delete_all_files( $p_project_id );
 410 
 411 	# Set default to ALL_PROJECTS for all users who had the project as default
 412 	user_pref_clear_project_default( $p_project_id );
 413 
 414 	# Delete the records assigning users to this project
 415 	project_remove_all_users( $p_project_id );
 416 
 417 	# Delete all news entries associated with the project being deleted
 418 	news_delete_all( $p_project_id );
 419 
 420 	# Delete project specific configurations
 421 	config_delete_project( $p_project_id );
 422 
 423 	# Delete any user prefs that are project specific
 424 	user_pref_db_delete_project( $p_project_id );
 425 
 426 	# Delete the project entry
 427 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'DELETE FROM {project} WHERE id=:project_id' );
 428 	$t_query->bind( 'project_id', $p_project_id );
 429 	$t_query->execute();
 430 
 431 	config_set_cache( 'enable_email_notification', $t_email_notifications, CONFIG_TYPE_INT );
 432 
 433 	project_clear_cache( $p_project_id );
 434 }

 436 /**
 437  * Update a project
 438  * @param integer $p_project_id     The project identifier being updated.
 439  * @param string  $p_name           The project name.
 440  * @param string  $p_description    A description of the project.
 441  * @param integer $p_status         The current status of the project.
 442  * @param integer $p_view_state     The view state of the project - public or private.
 443  * @param string  $p_file_path      The attachment file path for the project, if not storing in the database.
 444  * @param boolean $p_enabled        Whether the project is enabled.
 445  * @param boolean $p_inherit_global Whether the project inherits global categories.
 446  * @return void
 447  */
 448 function project_update( $p_project_id, $p_name, $p_description, $p_status, $p_view_state, $p_file_path, $p_enabled, $p_inherit_global ) {
 449 	$p_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 450 	$c_enabled = (bool)$p_enabled;
 451 	$c_inherit_global = (bool)$p_inherit_global;
 452 
 453 	if( is_blank( $p_name ) ) {
 454 		trigger_error( ERROR_PROJECT_NAME_INVALID, ERROR );
 455 	}
 456 
 457 	$t_new_name = trim( $p_name );
 458 	$t_old_name = project_get_field( $p_project_id, 'name' );
 459 
 460 	# If project is becoming private, save current user's access level
 461 	# so we can add them to the project afterwards so they don't lock
 462 	# themselves out
 463 	$t_old_view_state = project_get_field( $p_project_id, 'view_state' );
 464 	$t_is_becoming_private = VS_PRIVATE == $p_view_state && VS_PRIVATE != $t_old_view_state;
 465 	if( $t_is_becoming_private ) {
 466 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 467 		$t_access_level = user_get_access_level( $t_user_id, $p_project_id );
 468 		$t_manage_project_threshold = config_get( 'manage_project_threshold' );
 469 	}
 470 
 471 	if( strcasecmp( $t_new_name, $t_old_name ) != 0 ) {
 472 		project_ensure_name_unique( $p_name, $p_project_id );
 473 	}
 474 
 475 	if( DATABASE !== config_get( 'file_upload_method', null, null, $p_project_id ) ) {
 476 		$p_file_path = validate_project_file_path( $p_file_path );
 477 	}
 478 
 479 	$t_param = array(
 480 		'name' => $t_new_name,
 481 		'status' => (int)$p_status,
 482 		'enabled' => $c_enabled,
 483 		'view_state' => (int)$p_view_state,
 484 		'file_path' => $p_file_path,
 485 		'description' => $p_description,
 486 		'inherit_global' => $c_inherit_global,
 487 	);
 488 
 489 	$t_columns = '';
 490 	foreach( array_keys( $t_param ) as $t_col ) {
 491 		$t_columns .= "\n\t\t$t_col = :$t_col,";
 492 	}
 493 
 494 	$t_param['project_id'] = $p_project_id;
 495 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'UPDATE {project} SET'
 496 		. rtrim( $t_columns, ',' ) . '
 497 		WHERE id = :project_id'
 498 	);
 499 
 500 	$t_query->execute( $t_param );
 501 
 502 	project_clear_cache( $p_project_id );
 503 
 504 	# User just locked themselves out of the project by making it private,
 505 	# so we add them to the project with their previous access level
 506 	if( $t_is_becoming_private && !access_has_project_level( $t_manage_project_threshold, $p_project_id ) ) {
 507 		project_add_user( $p_project_id, $t_user_id, $t_access_level );
 508 	}
 509 
 510 	if( $t_is_becoming_private ) {
 511 		user_pref_clear_invalid_project_default( $p_project_id );
 512 	}
 513 }

 515 /**
 516  * Copy custom fields
 517  * @param integer $p_destination_id The destination project identifier.
 518  * @param integer $p_source_id      The source project identifier.
 519  * @return void
 520  */
 521 function project_copy_custom_fields( $p_destination_id, $p_source_id ) {
 522 	$t_custom_field_ids = custom_field_get_linked_ids( $p_source_id );
 523 	foreach( $t_custom_field_ids as $t_custom_field_id ) {
 524 		if( !custom_field_is_linked( $t_custom_field_id, $p_destination_id ) ) {
 525 			custom_field_link( $t_custom_field_id, $p_destination_id );
 526 			$t_sequence = custom_field_get_sequence( $t_custom_field_id, $p_source_id );
 527 			custom_field_set_sequence( $t_custom_field_id, $p_destination_id, $t_sequence );
 528 		}
 529 	}
 530 }

 637 /**
 638  * Return an array of info about users who have access to the the given project
 639  * For each user we have 'id', 'username', and 'access_level' (overall access level)
 640  * If the second parameter is given, return only users with an access level
 641  * higher than the given value.
 642  * if the first parameter is given as 'ALL_PROJECTS', return the global access level (without
 643  * any reference to the specific project
 644  * @param integer $p_project_id           A project identifier.
 645  * @param integer $p_access_level         Access level.
 646  * @param boolean $p_include_global_users Whether to include global users.
 647  * @return array List of users, array key is user ID
 648  */
 649 function project_get_all_user_rows( $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS, $p_access_level = ANYBODY, $p_include_global_users = true ) {
 650 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 651 
 652 	# Optimization when access_level is NOBODY
 653 	if( NOBODY == $p_access_level ) {
 654 		return array();
 655 	}
 656 
 657 	$t_on = ON;
 658 	$t_users = array();
 659 
 660 	$t_global_access_level = $p_access_level;
 661 	if( $c_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS && $p_include_global_users ) {
 662 
 663 		# looking for specific project
 664 		if( VS_PRIVATE == project_get_field( $p_project_id, 'view_state' ) ) {
 665 			# @todo (thraxisp) this is probably more complex than it needs to be
 666 			# When a new project is created, those who meet 'private_project_threshold' are added
 667 			# automatically, but don't have an entry in project_user_list_table.
 668 			#  if they did, you would not have to add global levels.
 669 			$t_private_project_threshold = config_get( 'private_project_threshold' );
 670 			if( is_array( $t_private_project_threshold ) ) {
 671 				if( is_array( $p_access_level ) ) {
 672 					# both private threshold and request are arrays, use intersection
 673 					$t_global_access_level = array_intersect( $p_access_level, $t_private_project_threshold );
 674 				} else {
 675 					# private threshold is an array, but request is a number, use values in threshold higher than request
 676 					$t_global_access_level = array();
 677 					foreach( $t_private_project_threshold as $t_threshold ) {
 678 						if( $p_access_level <= $t_threshold ) {
 679 							$t_global_access_level[] = $t_threshold;
 680 						}
 681 					}
 682 				}
 683 			} else {
 684 				if( is_array( $p_access_level ) ) {
 685 					# private threshold is a number, but request is an array, use values in request higher than threshold
 686 					$t_global_access_level = array();
 687 					foreach( $p_access_level as $t_threshold ) {
 688 						if( $t_threshold >= $t_private_project_threshold ) {
 689 							$t_global_access_level[] = $t_threshold;
 690 						}
 691 					}
 692 				} else {
 693 					# both private threshold and request are numbers, use maximum
 694 					$t_global_access_level = max( $p_access_level, $t_private_project_threshold );
 695 				}
 696 			}
 697 		}
 698 	}
 699 
 700 	if( $p_include_global_users ) {
 701 		$t_query = new DbQuery();
 702 		$t_query->sql( 'SELECT id, username, realname, access_level
 703 			FROM {user}
 704 			WHERE enabled = ' . $t_query->param( $t_on ) . ' 
 705 				AND '
 706 		);
 707 		if( is_array( $t_global_access_level ) ) {
 708 			if( empty( $t_global_access_level ) ) {
 709 				$t_query->append_sql( 'access_level >= ' . $t_query->param( NOBODY ) );
 710 			} else {
 711 				$t_query->append_sql( $t_query->sql_in( 'access_level', $t_global_access_level ) );
 712 			}
 713 		} else {
 714 			$t_query->append_sql( 'access_level >= ' . $t_query->param( $t_global_access_level ) );
 715 		}
 716 		$t_query->execute();
 717 
 718 		while( $t_row = $t_query->fetch() ) {
 719 			$t_users[(int)$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
 720 		}
 721 	}
 722 
 723 	if( $c_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 724 		# Get the project overrides
 725 		$t_query = new DbQuery();
 726 		$t_query->sql( 'SELECT u.id, u.username, u.realname, l.access_level
 727 			FROM {project_user_list} l, {user} u
 728 			WHERE l.user_id = u.id
 729 			AND u.enabled = ' . $t_query->param( $t_on ) . '
 730 			AND l.project_id = ' . $t_query->param( $c_project_id )
 731 		);
 732 		$t_query->execute();
 733 
 734 		while( $t_row = $t_query->fetch() ) {
 735 			if( is_array( $p_access_level ) ) {
 736 				$t_keep = in_array( $t_row['access_level'], $p_access_level );
 737 			} else {
 738 				$t_keep = $t_row['access_level'] >= $p_access_level;
 739 			}
 740 
 741 			if( $t_keep ) {
 742 				$t_users[(int)$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
 743 			} else {
 744 				# If user's overridden level is lower than required, so remove
 745 				#  them from the list if they were previously there
 746 				unset( $t_users[(int)$t_row['id']] );
 747 			}
 748 		}
 749 	}
 750 
 751 	return $t_users;
 752 }

 754 /**

 756  * file_upload_method is DATABASE
 757  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 758  * @return string upload path
 759  */
 760 function project_get_upload_path( $p_project_id ) {
 761 	if( DATABASE == config_get( 'file_upload_method', null, ALL_USERS, $p_project_id ) ) {
 762 		return '';
 763 	}
 764 
 765 	if( $p_project_id == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 766 		$t_path = config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder', '' );
 767 	} else {
 768 		$t_path = project_get_field( $p_project_id, 'file_path' );
 769 		if( is_blank( $t_path ) ) {
 770 			$t_path = config_get_global( 'absolute_path_default_upload_folder', '' );
 771 		}
 772 	}
 773 
 774 	return $t_path;
 775 }

 802  * @param integer $p_project_id   A project identifier.

 811 /**
 812  * Add or modify multiple users associated to a project with a specific access level.
 813  * $p_changes is an array of access levels indexed by user_id, such as:
 814  *   array ( user1 => access_level, user2 => access_level, ... )
 815  * This function will manage inserts and updates as needed.
 816  *
 817  * @param integer $p_project_id   A project identifier.
 818  * @param array $p_changes        An array of modifications.
 819  * @return void
 820  */
 821 function project_add_users( $p_project_id, array $p_changes ) {
 822 	# normalize input
 823 	$t_changes = array();
 824 	foreach( $p_changes as $t_id => $t_value ) {
 825 		if( DEFAULT_ACCESS_LEVEL == $t_value ) {
 826 			$t_changes[(int)$t_id] = user_get_access_level( $t_id );
 827 		} else {
 828 			$t_changes[(int)$t_id] = (int)$t_value;
 829 		}
 830 	}
 831 
 832 	$t_user_ids = array_keys( $t_changes );
 833 	if( empty( $t_user_ids ) ) {
 834 		return;
 835 	}
 836 
 837 	$t_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 838 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 839 	$t_sql = 'SELECT user_id FROM {project_user_list} 
 840 		WHERE project_id = ' . $t_query->param( $t_project_id ) . ' 
 841 		AND ' . $t_query->sql_in( 'user_id', $t_user_ids );
 842 	$t_query->sql( $t_sql );
 843 	$t_updating = array_column( $t_query->fetch_all(), 'user_id' );
 844 
 845 	if( !empty( $t_updating ) ) {
 846 		$t_update = new DbQuery( 'UPDATE {project_user_list} 
 847 			SET access_level = :new_value 
 848 			WHERE user_id = :user_id AND project_id = :project_id'
 849 		);
 850 		foreach( $t_updating as $t_id ) {
 851 			$t_params = array(
 852 				'project_id' => $t_project_id,
 853 				'user_id' => (int)$t_id,
 854 				'new_value' => $t_changes[$t_id]
 855 			);
 856 			$t_update->execute( $t_params );
 857 			unset( $t_changes[$t_id] );
 858 
 859 			# Trigger event for user access modification on project
 860 			event_signal('EVENT_MANAGE_PROJECT_USER_UPDATE', array('user_id' => $t_id, 'project_id' => $p_project_id));
 861 		}
 862 	}
 863 	# remaining items are for insert
 864 	if( !empty( $t_changes ) ) {
 865 		$t_insert = new DbQuery( 'INSERT INTO {project_user_list} 
 866 			( project_id, user_id, access_level ) 
 867 			VALUES :params'
 868 		);
 869 		foreach( $t_changes as $t_id => $t_value ) {
 870 			$t_insert->bind( 'params', array( $t_project_id, $t_id, $t_value ) );
 871 			$t_insert->execute();
 872 
 873 			# Trigger event for user added on project
 874 			event_signal('EVENT_MANAGE_PROJECT_USER_CREATE', array('user_id' => $t_id, 'project_id' => $p_project_id));
 875 		}
 876 	}
 877 }

 889 /**
 890  * Remove multiple users from project.
 891  *
 892  * The user's default_project preference will be set to ALL_PROJECTS if they
 893  * no longer have access to the project.
 894 
 895  * @param integer $p_project_id  A project identifier.
 896  * @param array $p_user_ids      Array of user identifiers.
 897  * @return void
 898  */
 899 function project_remove_users( $p_project_id, array $p_user_ids ) {
 900 	# normalize input
 901 	$t_user_ids = array();
 902 	foreach( $p_user_ids as $t_id ) {
 903 		$t_user_ids[] = (int)$t_id;
 904 	}
 905 	if( empty( $t_user_ids ) ) {
 906 		return;
 907 	}
 908 
 909 	# Trigger event for each user deleted from project
 910 	foreach( $p_user_ids as $t_id ) {
 911 		event_signal('EVENT_MANAGE_PROJECT_USER_DELETE', array('user_id' => $t_id, 'project_id' => $p_project_id));
 912 	}
 913 
 914 	# Remove users from the project
 915 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 916 	$t_sql = 'DELETE FROM {project_user_list}'
 917 		. ' WHERE project_id = ' . $t_query->param( (int)$p_project_id )
 918 		. ' AND ' . $t_query->sql_in( 'user_id', $t_user_ids );
 919 	$t_query->sql( $t_sql );
 920 	$t_query->execute();
 921 
 922 	user_pref_clear_invalid_project_default( $p_project_id );
 923 }

 925 /**
 926  * Delete all users from the project user list for a given project.
 927  *
 928  * This is useful when deleting or closing a project. The $p_access_level_limit
 929  * parameter can be used to only remove users from a project if their access
 930  * level is below or equal to the limit.
 931  *
 932  * The user's default_project preference will be set to ALL_PROJECTS if they
 933  * no longer have access to the project.
 934  *
 935  * @param integer $p_project_id         A project identifier.
 936  * @param integer $p_access_level_limit Access level limit (null = no limit).
 937  * @return void
 938  */
 939 function project_remove_all_users( $p_project_id, $p_access_level_limit = null ) {
 940 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 941 	$t_sql = 'DELETE FROM {project_user_list} '
 942 		. 'WHERE project_id = ' . $t_query->param( (int)$p_project_id );
 943 	if( $p_access_level_limit !== null ) {
 944 		$t_sql .= ' AND access_level <= ' . $t_query->param( (int)$p_access_level_limit );
 945 	}
 946 	$t_query->sql( $t_sql );
 947 	$t_query->execute();
 948 }

 950 /**
 951  * Copy all users and their permissions from the source project to the
 952  * destination project. The $p_access_level_limit parameter can be used to
 953  * limit the access level for users as they're copied to the destination
 954  * project (the highest access level they'll receive in the destination
 955  * project will be equal to $p_access_level_limit).
 956  * @param integer $p_destination_id     The destination project identifier.
 957  * @param integer $p_source_id          The source project identifier.
 958  * @param integer $p_access_level_limit Access level limit (null = no limit).
 959  * @return void
 960  */
 961 function project_copy_users( $p_destination_id, $p_source_id, $p_access_level_limit = null ) {
 962 	# Copy all users from current project over to another project
 963 	$t_rows = project_get_local_user_rows( $p_source_id );
 964 
 965 	$t_count = count( $t_rows );
 966 	for( $i = 0; $i < $t_count; $i++ ) {
 967 		$t_row = $t_rows[$i];
 968 
 969 		if( $p_access_level_limit !== null &&
 970 			$t_row['access_level'] > $p_access_level_limit ) {
 971 			$t_destination_access_level = $p_access_level_limit;
 972 		} else {
 973 			$t_destination_access_level = $t_row['access_level'];
 974 		}
 975 
 976 		# if there is no duplicate then add a new entry
 977 		# otherwise just update the access level for the existing entry
 978 		if( project_includes_user( $p_destination_id, $t_row['user_id'] ) ) {
 979 			project_update_user_access( $p_destination_id, $t_row['user_id'], $t_destination_access_level );
 980 		} else {
 981 			project_add_user( $p_destination_id, $t_row['user_id'], $t_destination_access_level );
 982 		}
 983 	}
 984 }

 995 /**
 996  * Returns the project name as a link formatted for display in menus and buttons.
 997  *
 998  * The link is formatted as a link to set_project.php, which can be used to
 999  * display project selection menus:
1000  * - projects list in navbar {@see layout_navbar_projects_menu()}
1001  * - project menu bar {@see print_project_menu_bar()}
1002  *
1003  * @param integer $p_project_id Project Id to display
1004  * @param bool    $p_active     True if it's the currently active project
1005  * @param string  $p_class      CSS classes to apply
1006  * @param array   $p_parents    Array of parent projects (empty if top-level)
1007  * @param string  $p_indent     String to use to indent the subprojects
1008  *
1009  * @return string Fully formatted HTML link to the project
1010  */
1011 function project_link_for_menu( $p_project_id, $p_active = false, $p_class = '', array $p_parents = array(), $p_indent = '' ) {
1012 	if( $p_parents ) {
1013 		$t_full_id = implode( ";", $p_parents ) . ';' . $p_project_id;
1014 		$t_indent = str_repeat( $p_indent, count( $p_parents ) ) . '&nbsp;';
1015 	} else {
1016 		$t_full_id = $p_project_id;
1017 		$t_indent = '';
1018 	}
1019 
1020 	$t_url = helper_mantis_url( 'set_project.php?project_id=' . $t_full_id );
1021 	$t_label = $t_indent . string_html_specialchars( project_get_name( $p_project_id ) );
1022 
1023 	if( $p_active ) {
1024 		$p_class .= ' active';
1025 	}
1026 
1027 	return sprintf('<a class="%s" href="%s">%s</a>', $p_class, $t_url, $t_label );
1028 }

  31 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );

  33 
  34 # We may need to build caches for either all projects or enabled projects or both
  35 $g_cache_project_hierarchy_enabled = null;
  36 $g_cache_project_hierarchy_all = null;
  37 $g_cache_project_inheritance_enabled = null;
  38 $g_cache_show_disabled_all = null;
  39 # To make it simpler for callers of project_hierarchy_cache(), we provide
  40 # these two aliases for the correct pair of caches above
  41 $g_cache_project_hierarchy = null;
  42 $g_cache_project_inheritance = null;

  44 /**
  45  * Add project to project hierarchy
  46  * @param integer $p_child_id       Child project identifier.
  47  * @param integer $p_parent_id      Parent project identifier.
  48  * @param boolean $p_inherit_parent Whether or not the child project inherits from the parent project.
  49  * @return void
  50  */
  51 function project_hierarchy_add( $p_child_id, $p_parent_id, $p_inherit_parent = true ) {
  52 	if( in_array( $p_parent_id, project_hierarchy_get_all_subprojects( $p_child_id ) ) ) {
  53 		trigger_error( ERROR_PROJECT_RECURSIVE_HIERARCHY, ERROR );
  54 	}
  55 
  56 	db_param_push();
  57 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {project_hierarchy}
  58 						( child_id, parent_id, inherit_parent )
  59 						VALUES
  60 						( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
  61 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_child_id, $p_parent_id, $p_inherit_parent ) );
  62 }
  63 
  64 /**
  65  * Update project hierarchy
  66  * @param integer $p_child_id       Child project identifier.
  67  * @param integer $p_parent_id      Parent project identifier.
  68  * @param boolean $p_inherit_parent Whether or not the child project inherits from the parent project.
  69  * @return void
  70  */
  71 function project_hierarchy_update( $p_child_id, $p_parent_id, $p_inherit_parent = true ) {
  72 	db_param_push();
  73 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {project_hierarchy}
  74 					SET inherit_parent=' . db_param() . '
  75 					WHERE child_id=' . db_param() . '
  76 						AND parent_id=' . db_param();
  77 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_inherit_parent, $p_child_id, $p_parent_id ) );
  78 }
  79 
  80 /**
  81  * Remove project from project hierarchy
  82  * @param integer $p_child_id  Child project identifier.
  83  * @param integer $p_parent_id Parent project identifier.
  84  * @return void
  85  */
  86 function project_hierarchy_remove( $p_child_id, $p_parent_id ) {
  87 	db_param_push();
  88 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {project_hierarchy} WHERE child_id = ' . db_param() . '
  89 						AND parent_id = ' . db_param();
  90 
  91 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_child_id, $p_parent_id ) );

  99 function project_hierarchy_remove_all( $p_project_id ) {

 107 /**
 108  * Returns true if project is at top of hierarchy
 109  * @param integer $p_project_id    Project identifier.
 110  * @param boolean $p_show_disabled Whether or not to consider projects which are disabled.
 111  * @return boolean
 112  */
 113 function project_hierarchy_is_toplevel( $p_project_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
 114 	global $g_cache_project_hierarchy;
 115 
 116 	project_hierarchy_cache( $p_show_disabled );
 117 
 118 	if( isset( $g_cache_project_hierarchy[ALL_PROJECTS] ) ) {
 119 		return in_array( $p_project_id, $g_cache_project_hierarchy[ALL_PROJECTS] );
 120 	} else {
 121 		return false;
 122 	}
 123 }

 125 /**
 126  * Returns the id of the project's parent (0 if top-level or not found)
 127  * @param integer $p_project_id    Project Identifier.
 128  * @param boolean $p_show_disabled Whether or not to consider projects which are disabled.
 129  * @return integer
 130  */
 131 function project_hierarchy_get_parent( $p_project_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
 132 	global $g_cache_project_hierarchy;
 133 
 134 	project_hierarchy_cache( $p_show_disabled );
 135 
 136 	if( ALL_PROJECTS == $p_project_id ) {
 137 		return 0;
 138 	}
 139 
 140 	foreach( $g_cache_project_hierarchy as $t_parent_id => $t_child_projects ) {
 141 		if( in_array( $p_project_id, $t_child_projects ) ) {
 142 			return $t_parent_id;
 143 		}
 144 	}
 145 
 146 	return 0;
 147 }

 149 /**
 150  * Cache project hierarchy
 151  * @param boolean $p_show_disabled Whether or not to cache projects which are disabled.
 152  * @return void
 153  */
 154 function project_hierarchy_cache( $p_show_disabled = false ) {
 155 	global $g_cache_project_hierarchy_enabled, $g_cache_project_inheritance_enabled;
 156 	global $g_cache_project_hierarchy_all, $g_cache_project_inheritance_all;
 157 	global $g_cache_project_hierarchy, $g_cache_project_inheritance;
 158 
 159 	# Set Cache aliases...
 160 	if( $p_show_disabled ) {
 161 		# ... to the whole hierarchy cache
 162 		$g_cache_project_hierarchy = $g_cache_project_hierarchy_all;
 163 		$g_cache_project_inheritance = $g_cache_project_inheritance_all;
 164 	} else {
 165 		# ... to the enabled hierarchy cache
 166 		$g_cache_project_hierarchy = $g_cache_project_hierarchy_enabled;
 167 		$g_cache_project_inheritance = $g_cache_project_inheritance_enabled;
 168 	}
 169 
 170 	# Cache is already built
 171 	if( !is_null( $g_cache_project_hierarchy ) ) {
 172 		return;
 173 	}
 174 
 175 	# Build the missing cache
 176 	db_param_push();
 177 	$t_enabled_clause = $p_show_disabled ? '1=1' : 'p.enabled = ' . db_param();
 178 
 179 	$t_query = 'SELECT DISTINCT p.id, ph.parent_id, p.name, p.inherit_global, ph.inherit_parent
 180 				  FROM {project} p
 181 				  LEFT JOIN {project_hierarchy} ph
 182 				    ON ph.child_id = p.id
 183 				  WHERE ' . $t_enabled_clause . '
 184 				  ORDER BY p.name';
 185 
 186 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, ( $p_show_disabled ? array() : array( true ) ) );
 187 
 188 	$g_cache_project_hierarchy = array();
 189 	$g_cache_project_inheritance = array();
 190 
 191 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 192 		$t_project_id = (int)$t_row['id'];
 193 		$t_parent_id = ( null === $t_row['parent_id'] ) ? ALL_PROJECTS : (int)$t_row['parent_id'];
 194 
 195 		$g_cache_project_hierarchy[$t_parent_id][] = $t_project_id;
 196 
 197 		if( !isset( $g_cache_project_inheritance[$t_project_id] ) ) {
 198 			$g_cache_project_inheritance[$t_project_id] = array();
 199 		}
 200 
 201 		if( $t_row['inherit_global'] ) {
 202 			$g_cache_project_inheritance[$t_project_id][ALL_PROJECTS] = ALL_PROJECTS;
 203 		}
 204 
 205 		if( $t_row['inherit_parent'] ) {
 206 			$g_cache_project_inheritance[$t_project_id][$t_parent_id] = $t_parent_id;
 207 		}
 208 	}
 209 
 210 	# Copy aliases into the right pair of cache variables
 211 	if( $p_show_disabled ) {
 212 		$g_cache_project_hierarchy_all = $g_cache_project_hierarchy;
 213 		$g_cache_project_inheritance_all = $g_cache_project_inheritance;
 214 	} else {
 215 		$g_cache_project_hierarchy_enabled = $g_cache_project_hierarchy;
 216 		$g_cache_project_inheritance_enabled = $g_cache_project_inheritance;
 217 	}
 218 }

 220 /**
 221  * Returns true if the child project inherits categories from the parent.
 222  * @param integer $p_child_id      Child project identifier.
 223  * @param integer $p_parent_id     Parent project identifier.
 224  * @param boolean $p_show_disabled Whether or not to consider projects which are disabled.
 225  * @return boolean
 226  */
 227 function project_hierarchy_inherit_parent( $p_child_id, $p_parent_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
 228 	global $g_cache_project_inheritance;
 229 
 230 	project_hierarchy_cache( $p_show_disabled );
 231 
 232 	return in_array( $p_parent_id, $g_cache_project_inheritance[$p_child_id] );
 233 }

 235 /**
 236  * Generate an array of project's the given project inherits from,
 237  * including the original project in the result.
 238  * @param integer $p_project_id    Project identifier.
 239  * @param boolean $p_show_disabled Whether or not to consider projects which are disabled.
 240  * @return array
 241  */
 242 function project_hierarchy_inheritance( $p_project_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
 243 	global $g_cache_project_inheritance;
 244 
 245 	project_hierarchy_cache( $p_show_disabled );
 246 
 247 	$t_project_ids = array( (int)$p_project_id, );
 248 	$t_lookup_ids = array( (int)$p_project_id, );
 249 
 250 	while( count( $t_lookup_ids ) > 0 ) {
 251 		$t_project_id = array_shift( $t_lookup_ids );
 252 
 253 		if( !isset( $g_cache_project_inheritance[$t_project_id] ) ) {
 254 			continue;
 255 		}
 256 
 257 		foreach( $g_cache_project_inheritance[$t_project_id] as $t_parent_id ) {
 258 			if( !in_array( $t_parent_id, $t_project_ids ) ) {
 259 				$t_project_ids[] = $t_parent_id;
 260 
 261 				if( !in_array( $t_lookup_ids, $t_project_ids ) ) {
 262 					$t_lookup_ids[] = $t_parent_id;
 263 				}
 264 			}
 265 		}
 266 	}
 267 
 268 	return $t_project_ids;
 269 }

 271 /**
 272  * Get subprojects for a project
 273  * @param integer $p_project_id    Project identifier.
 274  * @param boolean $p_show_disabled Whether or not to consider projects which are disabled.
 275  * @return array
 276  */
 277 function project_hierarchy_get_subprojects( $p_project_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
 278 	global $g_cache_project_hierarchy;
 279 
 280 	project_hierarchy_cache( $p_show_disabled );
 281 
 282 	return $g_cache_project_hierarchy[$p_project_id] ?? [];
 283 }

 285 /**
 286  * Get complete subproject hierarchy for a project
 287  * @param integer $p_project_id    Project identifier.
 288  * @param boolean $p_show_disabled Whether or not to consider projects which are disabled.
 289  * @return array
 290  */
 291 function project_hierarchy_get_all_subprojects( $p_project_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
 292 	$t_todo = project_hierarchy_get_subprojects( $p_project_id, $p_show_disabled );
 293 	$t_subprojects = array();
 294 
 295 	while( $t_todo ) {
 296 		$t_elem = array_shift( $t_todo );
 297 		if( !in_array( $t_elem, $t_subprojects ) ) {
 298 			$t_subprojects[] = $t_elem;
 299 			$t_todo = array_merge( $t_todo, project_hierarchy_get_subprojects( $t_elem, $p_show_disabled ) );
 300 		}
 301 	}
 302 
 303 	return $t_subprojects;
 304 }

  17 /**
  18  * Relationship API
  19  *
  20  * RELATIONSHIP DEFINITIONS
  21  * * Child/parent relationship:
  22  *    the child bug is generated by the parent bug or is directly linked with the parent with the following meaning
  23  *    the child bug has to be resolved before resolving the parent bug (the child bug "blocks" the parent bug)
  24  *    example: bug A is child bug of bug B. It means: A blocks B and B is blocked by A
  25  * * General relationship:
  26  *    two bugs related each other without any hierarchy dependence
  27  *    bugs A and B are related
  28  * * Duplicates:
  29  *    it's used to mark a bug as duplicate of an other bug already stored in the database
  30  *    bug A is marked as duplicate of B. It means: A duplicates B, B has duplicates
  31  *
  32  * Relations are always visible in the email body
  33  * --------------------------------------------------------------------
  34  * ADD NEW RELATIONSHIP
  35  * - Permission: user can update the source bug and at least view the destination bug
  36  * - Action recorded in the history of both the bugs
  37  * - Email notification sent to the users of both the bugs based based on the 'updated' bug notify type.
  38  * --------------------------------------------------------
  39  * DELETE RELATIONSHIP
  40  * - Permission: user can update the source bug and at least view the destination bug
  41  * - Action recorded in the history of both the bugs
  42  * - Email notification sent to the users of both the bugs based based on the 'updated' bug notify type.
  43  * --------------------------------------------------------
  44  * RESOLVE/CLOSE BUGS WITH BLOCKING CHILD BUGS STILL OPEN
  45  * Just a warning is print out on the form when a user attempts to resolve or close a bug with
  46  * related bugs in relation BUG_DEPENDANT still not resolved.
  47  * Anyway the user can force the resolving/closing action.
  48  * --------------------------------------------------------
  49  * EMAIL NOTIFICATION TO PARENT BUGS WHEN CHILDREN BUGS ARE RESOLVED/CLOSED
  50  * Every time a child bug is resolved or closed, an email notification is sent directly to all the handlers
  51  * of the parent bugs. The notification is sent to bugs not already marked as resolved or closed.
  52  * --------------------------------------------------------
  53  * ADD CHILD
  54  * This function gives the opportunity to generate a child bug. In details the function:
  55  * - create a new bug with the same basic information of the parent bug (plus the custom fields)
  56  * - copy all the attachment of the parent bug to the child
  57  * - not copy history, bugnotes, monitoring users
  58  * - set a relationship between parent and child
  59  *
  60  * @package CoreAPI
  61  * @subpackage RelationshipAPI
  62  * @author Marcello Scata' <marcelloscata at users.sourceforge.net> ITALY
  63  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  64  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  65  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  66  *
  67  * @uses access_api.php
  68  * @uses bug_api.php
  69  * @uses collapse_api.php
  70  * @uses config_api.php
  71  * @uses constant_api.php
  72  * @uses current_user_api.php
  73  * @uses database_api.php
  74  * @uses form_api.php
  75  * @uses helper_api.php
  76  * @uses lang_api.php
  77  * @uses prepare_api.php
  78  * @uses print_api.php
  79  * @uses project_api.php
  80  * @uses string_api.php
  81  * @uses utility_api.php
  82  */
  83

 195 /**
 196  * Ensure that specified relationship type is valid.

 198  * @param int $p_relationship_type The relationship type id.
 199  *
 200  * @return void
 201  * @throws ClientException if the relationship type is not valid.
 202  */
 203 function relationship_type_ensure_valid( $p_relationship_type ) {
 204 	global $g_relationships;
 205 
 206 	if( !is_numeric( $p_relationship_type ) || !isset( $g_relationships[$p_relationship_type] ) ) {
 207 		throw new ClientException(
 208 			sprintf( "Relation type '%s' not found.", $p_relationship_type ),
 209 			ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 210 			['relationship_type']
 211 		);
 212 	}

 215 /**

 219  *

 222 function relationship_get_complementary_type( $p_relationship_type ) {
 223 	global $g_relationships;
 224 	if( !isset( $g_relationships[$p_relationship_type] ) ) {
 225 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 226 	}
 227 	return $g_relationships[$p_relationship_type]['#complementary'];

 230 /**
 231  * Prepare source and destination bug id and relationship type for assignment.
 232  *
 233  * Directional relationships (e.g. parent/child) must be normalized to the
 234  * "forward" direction prior to creating or updating a relationship record.
 235  * If $p_relationship_type is backwards, we get the type's complement and swap
 236  * the source and destination bug ids.
 237  *
 238  * @param int $p_src_bug_id
 239  * @param int $p_dest_bug_id
 240  * @param int $p_relationship_type
 241  *
 242  * @return array Prepared data for database insert/update query
 243  * @internal
 244  */
 245 function relationship_prepare_for_assignment( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type ) {
 246 	global $g_relationships;
 247 
 248 	if( $g_relationships[$p_relationship_type]['#forward'] === false ) {
 249 		# Invert backwards relationships
 250 		$t_data = array(
 251 			(int)$p_dest_bug_id,
 252 			(int)$p_src_bug_id,
 253 			relationship_get_complementary_type( $p_relationship_type )
 254 		);
 255 	} else {
 256 		$t_data = array(
 257 			(int)$p_src_bug_id,
 258 			(int)$p_dest_bug_id,
 259 			(int)$p_relationship_type
 260 		);
 261 	}
 262 	return $t_data;
 263 }

 265 /**
 266  * Add a new relationship.
 267  *
 268  * @param int  $p_src_bug_id        Source Bug Id.
 269  * @param int  $p_dest_bug_id       Destination Bug Id.
 270  * @param int  $p_relationship_type Relationship type.
 271  * @param bool $p_email_for_source  Should an email be triggered for source issue?
 272  *
 273  * @return int The new bug relationship id.
 274  */
 275 function relationship_add( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type, $p_email_for_source = true ) {
 276 	db_param_push();
 277 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_relationship}
 278 				( source_bug_id, destination_bug_id, relationship_type )
 279 				VALUES
 280 				( ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 281 	$t_param = relationship_prepare_for_assignment( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type );
 282 	db_query( $t_query, $t_param );
 283 
 284 	$t_relationship_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'bug_relationship' ) );
 285 
 286 	history_log_event_special( $p_src_bug_id, BUG_ADD_RELATIONSHIP, $p_relationship_type, $p_dest_bug_id );
 287 	history_log_event_special( $p_dest_bug_id, BUG_ADD_RELATIONSHIP, relationship_get_complementary_type( $p_relationship_type ), $p_src_bug_id );
 288 
 289 	bug_update_date( $p_src_bug_id );
 290 	bug_update_date( $p_dest_bug_id );
 291 
 292 	email_relationship_added( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type, $p_email_for_source );
 293 
 294 	return $t_relationship_id;
 295 }
 296 
 297 /**
 298  * Update a relationship.
 299  *
 300  * @param int  $p_relationship_id   Relationship Id to update.
 301  * @param int  $p_src_bug_id        Source Bug Id.
 302  * @param int  $p_dest_bug_id       Destination Bug Id.
 303  * @param int  $p_relationship_type Relationship type.
 304  * @param bool $p_email_for_source  Should an email be triggered for source issue?
 305  *
 306  * @return void
 307  */
 308 function relationship_update( $p_relationship_id, $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type, $p_email_for_source = true ) {
 309 	db_param_push();
 310 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug_relationship}
 311 				SET source_bug_id=' . db_param() . ',
 312 					destination_bug_id=' . db_param() . ',
 313 					relationship_type=' . db_param() . '
 314 				WHERE id=' . db_param();
 315 	$t_param = relationship_prepare_for_assignment( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type );
 316 	$t_param[] = (int)$p_relationship_id;
 317 	db_query( $t_query, $t_param );
 318 
 319 	history_log_event_special( $p_src_bug_id, BUG_REPLACE_RELATIONSHIP, $p_relationship_type, $p_dest_bug_id );
 320 	history_log_event_special( $p_dest_bug_id, BUG_REPLACE_RELATIONSHIP, relationship_get_complementary_type( $p_relationship_type ), $p_src_bug_id );
 321 
 322 	bug_update_date( $p_src_bug_id );
 323 	bug_update_date( $p_dest_bug_id );
 324 
 325 	email_relationship_added( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type, $p_email_for_source );
 326 }
 327 
 328 /**
 329  * Add/Update relationship based on whether the relationship already exists or not.
 330  *
 331  * @param int  $p_src_bug_id        Source Bug Id.
 332  * @param int  $p_dest_bug_id       Destination Bug Id.
 333  * @param int  $p_relationship_type Relationship type.
 334  * @param bool $p_email_for_source  Should an email be triggered for source issue?
 335  *
 336  * @return int The new bug relationship id.
 337  */
 338 function relationship_upsert( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type, $p_email_for_source = true ) {
 339 	# Check if there is other relationship between the bugs.
 340 	$t_id_relationship = relationship_same_type_exists( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type );
 341 
 342 	if( $t_id_relationship > 0 ) {
 343 		relationship_update( $t_id_relationship, $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type, $p_email_for_source );
 344 		$t_relationship_id = $t_id_relationship;
 345 	} else if( $t_id_relationship != -1 ) {
 346 		$t_relationship_id = relationship_add( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_relationship_type, $p_email_for_source );
 347 	} else {
 348 		# else relationship is -1 - same type exists
 349 		$t_relationship_id = relationship_exists( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id );
 350 	}
 351 
 352 	return $t_relationship_id;
 353 }
 354 
 355 /**
 356  * Delete a relationship.
 357  *
 358  * @param int  $p_relationship_id Relationship Id to update.
 359  * @param bool $p_send_email      Send email?
 360  *
 361  * @return void
 362  * @throws ClientException If the relationship does not exist.
 363  */
 364 function relationship_delete( $p_relationship_id, $p_send_email = true ) {
 365 	$t_relationship = relationship_get( $p_relationship_id );
 366 
 367 	db_param_push();
 368 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_relationship} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 369 	db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_relationship_id ) );
 370 
 371 	$t_src_bug_id = $t_relationship->src_bug_id;
 372 	$t_dest_bug_id = $t_relationship->dest_bug_id;
 373 	$t_rel_type = $t_relationship->type;
 374 
 375 	bug_update_date( $t_src_bug_id );
 376 	bug_update_date( $t_dest_bug_id );
 377 
 378 	history_log_event_special( $t_src_bug_id, BUG_DEL_RELATIONSHIP, $t_rel_type, $t_dest_bug_id );
 379 
 380 	if( bug_exists( $t_dest_bug_id ) ) {
 381 		history_log_event_special(
 382 			$t_dest_bug_id,
 383 			BUG_DEL_RELATIONSHIP,
 384 			relationship_get_complementary_type( $t_rel_type ),
 385 			$t_src_bug_id );
 386 	}
 387 
 388 	if( $p_send_email ) {
 389 		email_relationship_deleted( $t_src_bug_id, $t_dest_bug_id, $t_rel_type );
 390 	}
 391 }

 393 /**
 394  * Deletes all the relationships related to a specific bug (both source and destination).
 395  *
 396  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug Identifier.
 397  *
 398  * @return void
 399  * @throws ClientException
 400  */
 401 function relationship_delete_all( $p_bug_id ) {
 402 	$t_is_different_projects = false;
 403 	$t_relationships = relationship_get_all( $p_bug_id, $t_is_different_projects );
 404 	foreach( $t_relationships as $t_relationship ) {
 405 		relationship_delete( $t_relationship->id, /* send_email */ false );

 409 /**
 410  * Copy all the relationships related to a specific bug to a new bug.
 411  *
 412  * @param int $p_bug_id     Source bug identifier.
 413  * @param int $p_new_bug_id Destination bug identifier.
 414  *
 415  * @return void
 416  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
 417  */
 418 function relationship_copy_all( $p_bug_id, $p_new_bug_id ) {
 419 	$t_relationships = relationship_get_all_src( $p_bug_id );
 420 	foreach( $t_relationships as $t_relationship ) {
 421 		relationship_add(
 422 			$p_new_bug_id,
 423 			$t_relationship->dest_bug_id,
 424 			$t_relationship->type,
 425 			/* email_for_source */ false );
 426 	}
 427 
 428 	$t_relationships = relationship_get_all_dest( $p_bug_id );
 429 	foreach( $t_relationships as $t_relationship ) {
 430 		relationship_add(
 431 			$p_new_bug_id,
 432 			$t_relationship->src_bug_id,
 433 			relationship_get_complementary_type( $t_relationship->type ),
 434 			/* email_for_source */ false );
 435 	}
 436 }

 438 /**
 439  * Get a relationship's data from its Id.
 440  *
 441  * @param int $p_relationship_id Relationship Identifier.
 442  *
 443  * @return BugRelationshipData BugRelationshipData object
 444  * @throws ClientException If the relationship does not exist.
 445  */
 446 function relationship_get( $p_relationship_id ) {
 447 	db_param_push();
 448 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_relationship} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 449 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_relationship_id ) );
 450 
 451 	$t_relationship = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 452 
 453 	if( $t_relationship ) {
 454 		$t_bug_relationship_data = new BugRelationshipData;
 455 		$t_bug_relationship_data->id = $t_relationship['id'];
 456 		$t_bug_relationship_data->src_bug_id = $t_relationship['source_bug_id'];
 457 		$t_bug_relationship_data->dest_bug_id = $t_relationship['destination_bug_id'];
 458 		$t_bug_relationship_data->type = $t_relationship['relationship_type'];
 459 	} else {
 460 		throw new ClientException(
 461 			sprintf( "Unknown relationship '%d'", $p_relationship_id ),
 462 			ERROR_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_FOUND
 463 		);
 464 	}
 465 
 466 	return $t_bug_relationship_data;
 467 }

 469 /**
 470  * get all relationships with the given bug as source.
 471  *
 472  * @param int $p_src_bug_id Source Bug identifier.
 473  *
 474  * @return array Array of BugRelationshipData objects
 475  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
 476  */
 477 function relationship_get_all_src( $p_src_bug_id ) {
 478 	db_param_push();
 479 	$t_query = 'SELECT {bug_relationship}.id, {bug_relationship}.relationship_type,
 480 				{bug_relationship}.source_bug_id, {bug_relationship}.destination_bug_id,
 481 				{bug}.project_id
 482 				FROM {bug_relationship}
 483 				INNER JOIN {bug} ON {bug_relationship}.destination_bug_id = {bug}.id
 484 				WHERE source_bug_id=' . db_param() . '
 485 				ORDER BY relationship_type, {bug_relationship}.id';
 486 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_src_bug_id ) );
 487 
 488 	$t_src_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_src_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 489 
 490 	$t_bug_relationship_data = array();
 491 	$t_bug_array = array();
 492 	$i = 0;
 493 
 494 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 495 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i] = new BugRelationshipData;
 496 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->id = $t_row['id'];
 497 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->src_bug_id = $t_row['source_bug_id'];
 498 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->src_project_id = $t_src_project_id;
 499 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->dest_bug_id = $t_row['destination_bug_id'];
 500 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->dest_project_id = $t_row['project_id'];
 501 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->type = $t_row['relationship_type'];
 502 		$t_bug_array[] = $t_row['destination_bug_id'];
 503 		$i++;
 504 	}
 505 
 506 	if( !empty( $t_bug_array ) ) {
 507 		bug_cache_array_rows( $t_bug_array );
 508 	}
 509 
 510 	return $t_bug_relationship_data;
 511 }

 513 /**

 526 				FROM {bug_relationship}

 529 				ORDER BY relationship_type, {bug_relationship}.id';

 532 	$t_dest_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_dest_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 533 
 534 	$t_bug_relationship_data = array();
 535 	$t_bug_array = array();
 536 	$i = 0;
 537 
 538 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 539 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i] = new BugRelationshipData;
 540 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->id = $t_row['id'];
 541 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->src_bug_id = $t_row['source_bug_id'];

 543 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->dest_bug_id = $t_row['destination_bug_id'];
 544 		$t_bug_relationship_data[$i]->dest_project_id = $t_dest_project_id;

 556 /**
 557  * Get all relationships associated with the given bug.
 558  *
 559  * @param int  $p_bug_id                 A bug identifier.
 560  * @param bool &$p_is_different_projects Returned Boolean value indicating if
 561  *                                       some relationships cross project boundaries.
 562  *
 563  * @return array Array of BugRelationshipData objects
 564  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
 565  */
 566 function relationship_get_all( $p_bug_id, &$p_is_different_projects ) {
 567 	$t_src = relationship_get_all_src( $p_bug_id );
 568 	$t_dest = relationship_get_all_dest( $p_bug_id );
 569 	$t_all = array_merge( $t_src, $t_dest );
 570 
 571 	$p_is_different_projects = false;
 572 	$t_count = count( $t_all );
 573 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_count;$i++ ) {
 574 		$p_is_different_projects |= ( $t_all[$i]->src_project_id != $t_all[$i]->dest_project_id );
 575 	}
 576 	return $t_all;
 577 }

 579 /**
 580  * Check if there is a relationship between two bugs.
 581  *
 582  * @param int $p_src_bug_id  Source bug identifier.
 583  * @param int $p_dest_bug_id Destination bug identifier.
 584  *
 585  * @return int Relationship ID if found, 0 otherwise.
 586  */
 587 function relationship_exists( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id ) {
 588 	$c_src_bug_id = (int)$p_src_bug_id;
 589 	$c_dest_bug_id = (int)$p_dest_bug_id;
 590 
 591 	db_param_push();
 592 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {bug_relationship}
 593 				WHERE (source_bug_id=' . db_param() . ' AND destination_bug_id=' . db_param() . ')
 594 				OR
 595 				(source_bug_id=' . db_param() . '
 596 				AND destination_bug_id=' . db_param() . ')';
 597 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_src_bug_id, $c_dest_bug_id, $c_dest_bug_id, $c_src_bug_id ), 1 );
 598 
 599 	if( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 600 		# return the first id
 601 		return $t_row['id'];
 602 	} else {
 603 		# no relationship found
 604 		return 0;
 605 	}
 606 }

 608 /**
 609  * Check if there is a relationship between two bugs.
 610  *
 611  * @param int $p_src_bug_id  Source Bug Id.
 612  * @param int $p_dest_bug_id Destination Bug Id.
 613  * @param int $p_rel_type    Relationship Type.
 614  *
 615  * @return int 0 if the relationship is not found,
 616  *             -1 if the relationship is found and it's of the same type $p_rel_type, or
 617  *             Id if the relationship is found and it's of a different type
 618  *             (this means it can be replaced with the new type $p_rel_type)
 619  *
 620  * @noinspection PhpDocMissingThrowsInspection
 621  */
 622 function relationship_same_type_exists( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id, $p_rel_type ) {
 623 	# Check if there is already a relationship set between them
 624 	$t_id_relationship = relationship_exists( $p_src_bug_id, $p_dest_bug_id );
 625 
 626 	if( $t_id_relationship > 0 ) {
 627 		# The relationship exists, get all the info
 628 		/** @noinspection PhpUnhandledExceptionInspection */
 629 		$t_relationship = relationship_get( $t_id_relationship );
 630 
 631 		if( $t_relationship->src_bug_id == $p_src_bug_id && $t_relationship->dest_bug_id == $p_dest_bug_id ) {
 632 			if( $t_relationship->type == $p_rel_type ) {
 633 				$t_id_relationship = -1;
 634 			}
 635 		} else {
 636 			if( $t_relationship->type == relationship_get_complementary_type( $p_rel_type ) ) {
 637 				$t_id_relationship = -1;
 638 			}
 639 		}
 640 	}
 641 	return $t_id_relationship;
 642 }
 643 
 644 /**
 645  * Retrieve the linked bug id of the relationship.
 646  *
 647  * If given the source bug Id return the destination bug Id, and vice-versa.
 648  *
 649  * @param int $p_relationship_id Relationship id.
 650  * @param int $p_bug_id          A bug identifier.
 651  *
 652  * @return int Complementary bug id
 653  *
 654  * @throws ClientException If the relationship does not exist.
 655  */
 656 function relationship_get_linked_bug_id( $p_relationship_id, $p_bug_id ) {
 657 	$t_bug_relationship_data = relationship_get( $p_relationship_id );
 658 
 659 	if( $t_bug_relationship_data->src_bug_id == $p_bug_id ) {
 660 		return $t_bug_relationship_data->dest_bug_id;
 661 	}
 662 
 663 	if( $t_bug_relationship_data->dest_bug_id == $p_bug_id ) {
 664 		return $t_bug_relationship_data->src_bug_id;
 665 	}
 666 
 667 	throw new ClientException(
 668 		sprintf( "Unknown relationship '%d' for issue '%d'", $p_relationship_id, $p_bug_id ),
 669 		ERROR_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_FOUND
 670 	);
 671 }

 716 /**
 717  * Get class API name of a relationship as it's stored in the history.
 718  *
 719  * @param int $p_relationship_type Relationship Type.
 720  *
 721  * @return string Relationship API name
 722  * @throws ClientException if the relationship type does not exist.
 723  */
 724 function relationship_get_name_for_api( $p_relationship_type ) {
 725 	global $g_relationships;
 726 
 727 	if( !isset( $g_relationships[$p_relationship_type] ) ) {
 728 		switch( $p_relationship_type ) {
 729 			case BUG_REL_NONE:
 730 				return 'none';
 731 			case BUG_REL_ANY:
 732 				return 'any';
 733 			default:
 734 				# This will trigger the invalid relationship type exception.
 735 				relationship_type_ensure_valid( $p_relationship_type );
 736 		}
 737 	}
 738 
 739 	return $g_relationships[$p_relationship_type]['#name'];
 740 }
