 742 /**
 743  * Get relationship type id given its API name.
 744  *
 745  * @param string $p_relationship_type_name relationship type name.
 746  *
 747  * @return int relationship type id
 748  * @throws ClientException unknown relationship type name.
 749  */
 750 function relationship_get_id_from_api_name( $p_relationship_type_name ) {
 751 	global $g_relationships;
 752 
 753 	$t_relationship_type_name = strtolower( $p_relationship_type_name );
 754 	foreach( $g_relationships as $t_id => $t_relationship ) {
 755 		if( $t_relationship['#name'] == $t_relationship_type_name ) {
 756 			return $t_id;
 757 		}
 758 	}
 759 
 760 	throw new ClientException(
 761 		sprintf( "Unknown relationship type '%s'", $p_relationship_type_name ),
 762 		ERROR_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE,
 763 		array( 'relationship_type' )
 764 	);
 765 }
 766 
 767 /**
 768  * Return false if there are child bugs not resolved/closed.
 769  *
 770  * N.B. we don't check if the parent bug is read-only. This is because the
 771  * answer of this function is independent from the state of the parent bug
 772  * itself.
 773  *
 774  * @param int $p_bug_id A bug identifier.
 775  *
 776  * @return bool
 777  * @throws ClientException if the bug does not exist.
 778  */
 779 function relationship_can_resolve_bug( $p_bug_id ) {
 780 	# retrieve all the relationships in which the bug is the source bug
 781 	$t_relationships = relationship_get_all_src( $p_bug_id );
 782 
 783 	foreach( $t_relationships as $t_relationship ) {
 784 		# verify if each bug in relation BUG_DEPENDANT is already marked as resolved
 785 		if( $t_relationship->type == BUG_DEPENDANT ) {
 786 			$t_status = bug_get_field( $t_relationship->dest_bug_id, 'status' );
 787 
 788 			if( $t_status < config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold', null, null, $t_relationship->dest_project_id ) ) {
 789 				# the bug is NOT marked as resolved/closed
 790 				return false;
 791 			}
 792 		}
 793 	}
 794 
 795 	return true;
 796 }

  44 /**
  45  * Calculates a key to be used for RSS authentication based on user name,
  46  * cookie and password. If the user changes their user name or password, this
  47  * RSS authentication key will become invalidated.
  48  * @param integer $p_user_id User ID for the user which the key is being calculated for.
  49  * @return string RSS authentication key (384bit) encoded according to the base64 with URI safe alphabet approach described in RFC4648.
  50  */
  51 function rss_calculate_key( $p_user_id = null ) {
  52 	if( $p_user_id === null ) {
  53 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
  54 	} else {
  55 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id;
  56 	}
  57 
  58 	$t_username = user_get_username( $t_user_id );
  59 	$t_password = user_get_field( $t_user_id, 'password' );
  60 	$t_cookie = user_get_field( $t_user_id, 'cookie_string' );
  61 
  62 	$t_key_raw = hash( 'whirlpool', 'rss_key' . config_get_global( 'crypto_master_salt' ) . $t_username . $t_password . $t_cookie, true );
  63 	# Note: We truncate the last 8 bits from the hash output so that base64
  64 	# encoding can be performed without any trailing padding.
  65 	$t_key_base64_encoded = base64_encode( substr( $t_key_raw, 0, 63 ) );
  66 	$t_key = strtr( $t_key_base64_encoded, '+/', '-_' );
  67 
  68 	return $t_key;
  69 }
  70 
  71 /**
  72  * Given the user name and the rss key, this method attempts to login the user.  If successful, it
  73  * return true, otherwise, returns false.
  74  * @param string $p_username A user name to attempt to login as.
  75  * @param string $p_key      The RSS key to use for the given user.
  76  * @return boolean
  77  */
  78 function rss_login( $p_username, $p_key ) {
  79 	if( ( $p_username === null ) || ( $p_key === null ) ) {
  80 		return false;
  81 	}
  82 
  83 	$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $p_username );
  84 
  85 	if( false === $t_user_id ) {
  86 		return false;
  87 	}
  88 
  89 	$t_correct_key = rss_calculate_key( $t_user_id );
  90 	if( $p_key != $t_correct_key ) {
  91 		return false;
  92 	}
  93 
  94 	if( !auth_attempt_script_login( $p_username ) ) {
  95 		return false;
  96 	}
  97 
  98 	return true;
  99 }

 101 /**
 102  * return RSS issues feed URL
 103  * @param integer $p_project_id The project identifier to retrieve the news feed URL for.
 104  * @param string  $p_username   The user name accessing the news feed.
 105  * @param integer $p_filter_id  The filter identifier to generate a URL for.
 106  * @param boolean $p_relative   Whether to return relative links.
 107  * @return string
 108  */
 109 function rss_get_issues_feed_url( $p_project_id = null, $p_username = null, $p_filter_id = null, $p_relative = true ) {
 110 	if( $p_username === null ) {
 111 		$t_username = current_user_get_field( 'username' );
 112 	} else {
 113 		$t_username = $p_username;
 114 	}
 115 
 116 	if( $p_project_id === null ) {
 117 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 118 	} else {
 119 		$t_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 120 	}
 121 
 122 	$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $t_username );
 123 
 124 	if( $p_relative ) {
 125 		$t_url = config_get_global( 'path' );
 126 	} else {
 127 		$t_url = '';
 128 	}
 129 
 130 	if( user_is_anonymous( $t_user_id ) ) {
 131 		$t_url .= 'issues_rss.php?';
 132 
 133 		if( $t_project_id == ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 134 			$t_url .= 'project_id=' . $t_project_id;
 135 		}
 136 	} else {
 137 		$t_url .= 'issues_rss.php?username=' . $t_username . '&key=' . rss_calculate_key( $t_user_id );
 138 
 139 		if( $t_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 140 			$t_url .= '&project_id=' . $t_project_id;
 141 		}
 142 	}
 143 
 144 	if( $p_filter_id !== null ) {
 145 		$t_url .= '&filter_id=' . $p_filter_id;
 146 	}
 147 
 148 	return $t_url;
 149 }

 151 /**
 152  * return RSS news feed URL
 153  * @param integer $p_project_id The project identifier to retrieve the news feed URL for.
 154  * @param string  $p_username   The user name accessing the news feed.
 155  * @param boolean $p_relative   Whether to return relative links.
 156  * @return string
 157  */
 158 function rss_get_news_feed_url( $p_project_id = null, $p_username = null, $p_relative = true ) {
 159 	if( $p_username === null ) {
 160 		$t_username = current_user_get_field( 'username' );
 161 	} else {
 162 		$t_username = $p_username;
 163 	}
 164 
 165 	if( $p_project_id === null ) {
 166 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 167 	} else {
 168 		$t_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 169 	}
 170 
 171 	if( $p_relative ) {
 172 		$t_rss_link = '';
 173 	} else {
 174 		$t_rss_link = config_get_global( 'path' );
 175 	}
 176 
 177 	$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $t_username );
 178 
 179 	# If we have a logged in user then they can be given a 'proper' feed, complete with auth string.
 180 	if( user_is_anonymous( $t_user_id ) ) {
 181 		$t_rss_link .= 'news_rss.php';
 182 
 183 		if( $t_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 184 			$t_rss_link .= '?project_id=' . $t_project_id;
 185 		}
 186 	} else {
 187 		$t_rss_link .= 'news_rss.php?username=' . $t_username . '&key=' . rss_calculate_key( $t_user_id );
 188 
 189 		if( $t_project_id != ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 190 			$t_rss_link .= '&project_id=' . $t_project_id;
 191 		}
 192 	}
 193 
 194 	return $t_rss_link;
 195 }

  17 /**
  18  * Session API
  19  *
  20  * Handles user/browser sessions in an extendable manner. New session handlers
  21  * can be added and configured without affecting how the API is used. Calls to
  22  * session_*() are appropriately directed at the session handler class as
  23  * chosen in config_inc.php.
  24  *
  25  * @package CoreAPI
  26  * @subpackage SessionAPI
  27  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  28  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  29  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org

  31  * @uses config_api.php
  32  * @uses constant_inc.php
  33  * @uses error_api.php
  34  * @uses gpc_api.php
  35  * @uses php_api.php
  36  *
  37  * @noinspection PhpUnused
  38  */
  39 
  40 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  41 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  42 require_api( 'error_api.php' );
  43 require_api( 'gpc_api.php' );
  44 require_api( 'php_api.php' );

  46 $g_session = null;

  48 /**
  49  * Abstract interface for a MantisBT session handler.
  50  */
  51 abstract class MantisSession {
  52 	/**
  53 	 * Session ID
  54 	 */
  55 	protected $id;
  56 
  57 	/**
  58 	 * Constructor
  59 	 */
  60 	abstract function __construct();
  61 
  62 	/**
  63 	 * get session data
  64 	 * @param string $p_name    The name of the value to set.
  65 	 * @param mixed  $p_default The value to set.
  66 	 * @return string
  67 	 */
  68 	abstract function get( $p_name, $p_default = null );
  69 
  70 	/**
  71 	 * set session data
  72 	 * @param string $p_name  The name of the value to set.
  73 	 * @param mixed  $p_value The value to set.
  74 	 * @return void
  75 	 */
  76 	abstract function set( $p_name, $p_value );
  77 
  78 	/**
  79 	 * delete session data
  80 	 * @param string $p_name The name of the value to set.
  81 	 * @return void
  82 	 */
  83 	abstract function delete( $p_name );
  84 
  85 	/**
  86 	 * destroy session
  87 	 * @return void
  88 	 */
  89 	abstract function destroy();
  90 }

  92 /**
  93  * MantisPHPSession Class.
  94  *
  95  * Implementation of the abstract MantisBT session interface using
  96  * standard PHP sessions stored on the server's filesystem according
  97  * to PHP's session.* settings in 'php.ini'.
  98  */
  99 class MantisPHPSession extends MantisSession {
 100 	/**
 101 	 * Session key prefix.
 102 	 * Used with {@see $g_crypto_master_salt} to build a unique Session key.
 103 	 */
 104 	const SESSION_KEY_PREFIX = 'session_key_v_2';
 105 
 106 	/**
 107 	 * @var string Session key
 108 	 */
 109 	protected $key;
 110 
 111 	/**
 112 	 * Constructor
 113 	 * @param integer $p_session_id The session id.
 114 	 */
 115 	function __construct( $p_session_id = null ) {
 116 		global $g_cookie_secure_flag_enabled;
 117 
 118 		$this->key = hash( 'whirlpool',
 119 			$this::SESSION_KEY_PREFIX . config_get_global( 'crypto_master_salt' )
 120 		);
 121 
 122 		# Save session information where specified or with PHP's default
 123 		$t_session_save_path = config_get_global( 'session_save_path' );
 124 		if( $t_session_save_path ) {
 125 			session_save_path( $t_session_save_path );
 126 		}
 127 
 128 		# Handle session cookie and caching
 129 		session_cache_limiter( 'private_no_expire' );
 130 		$t_path = config_get_global( 'cookie_path' );
 131 		$t_domain = config_get_global( 'cookie_domain' );
 132 		$t_samesite = config_get_global( 'cookie_samesite' );
 133 		$t_options = array(
 134 			'lifetime' => 0,
 135 			'path' => $t_path,
 136 			'domain' => $t_domain,
 137 			'samesite' => $t_samesite,
 138 			'secure' => $g_cookie_secure_flag_enabled,
 139 			'httponly' => true,
 140 		);
 141 		session_set_cookie_params( $t_options );
 142 
 143 		# Handle existent session ID
 144 		if( !is_null( $p_session_id ) ) {
 145 			session_id( $p_session_id );
 146 		}
 147 
 148 		# Initialize the session
 149 		session_start();
 150 		$this->id = session_id();
 151 
 152 		# Initialize the keyed session store
 153 		if( !isset( $_SESSION[$this->key] ) ) {
 154 			$_SESSION[$this->key] = array();
 155 		}
 156 	}
 157 
 158 	/**
 159 	 * get session data
 160 	 *
 161 	 * @param string $p_name    The name of the value to set.
 162 	 * @param mixed  $p_default The value to set.
 163 	 *
 164 	 * @return string
 165 	 * @noinspection PhpInconsistentReturnPointsInspection
 166 	 */
 167 	function get( $p_name, $p_default = null ) {
 168 		if( isset( $_SESSION[$this->key][$p_name] ) ) {
 169 			return $_SESSION[$this->key][$p_name];
 170 		}
 171 
 172 		if( func_num_args() > 1 ) {
 173 			return $p_default;
 174 		}
 175 
 176 		error_parameters( $p_name );
 177 		trigger_error( ERROR_SESSION_VAR_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 178 	}
 179 
 180 	/**
 181 	 * set session data
 182 	 * @param string $p_name  The name of the value to set.
 183 	 * @param mixed  $p_value The value to set.
 184 	 * @return void
 185 	 */
 186 	function set( $p_name, $p_value ) {
 187 		$_SESSION[$this->key][$p_name] = $p_value;
 188 	}
 189 
 190 	/**
 191 	 * delete session data
 192 	 * @param string $p_name The name of the value to set.
 193 	 * @return void
 194 	 */
 195 	function delete( $p_name ) {
 196 		unset( $_SESSION[$this->key][$p_name] );
 197 	}
 198 
 199 	/**
 200 	 * destroy session
 201 	 * @return void
 202 	 */
 203 	function destroy() {
 204 		if( isset( $_COOKIE[session_name()] ) && !headers_sent() ) {
 205 			gpc_set_cookie( session_name(), '', time() - 42000 );
 206 		}
 207 
 208 		unset( $_SESSION[$this->key] );
 209 	}
 210 }
 211 
 212 /**
 213  * Initialize the appropriate session handler.
 214  * @param string $p_session_id Session ID.
 215  * @return void
 216  */
 217 function session_init( $p_session_id = null ) {
 218 	global $g_session;
 219 
 220 	$g_session = new MantisPHPSession( $p_session_id );
 221 
 222 	if( ON == config_get_global( 'session_validation' ) && session_get( 'secure_session', false ) ) {
 223 		session_validate( $g_session );
 224 	}
 225 }
 226 
 227 /**
 228  * Validate the legitimacy of a session.
 229  * Checks may include last-known IP address, or more.
 230  * Triggers an error when the session is invalid.
 231  * @param object $p_session Session object.
 232  * @return void
 233  */
 234 function session_validate( $p_session ) {
 235 	$t_user_ip = '';
 236 	if( isset( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ) ) {
 237 		$t_user_ip = trim( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] );
 238 	}
 239 
 240 	if( is_null( $t_last_ip = $p_session->get( 'last_ip', null ) ) ) {
 241 		# First session usage
 242 		$p_session->set( 'last_ip', $t_user_ip );
 243 
 244 	} else {
 245 		# Check a continued session request
 246 		if( $t_user_ip != $t_last_ip ) {
 247 			session_clean();
 248 
 249 			trigger_error( ERROR_SESSION_NOT_VALID, WARNING );
 250 
 251 			$t_url = config_get_global( 'path' ) . config_get_global( 'default_home_page' );
 252 			echo "\t", '<meta http-equiv="Refresh" content="4; URL=' . $t_url . '" />', "\n";
 253 
 254 			die();
 255 		}
 256 	}
 257 }
 258 
 259 /**
 260  * Get arbitrary data from the session.
 261  * @param string $p_name    Session variable name.
 262  * @param mixed  $p_default Default value.
 263  * @return mixed Session variable
 264  */
 265 function session_get( $p_name, $p_default = null ) {
 266 	global $g_session;
 267 
 268 	$t_args = func_get_args();
 269 	return call_user_func_array( array( $g_session, 'get' ), $t_args );
 270 }
 271 
 272 /**
 273  * Get an integer from the session.
 274  * @param string       $p_name    Session variable name.
 275  * @param integer|null $p_default Default value.
 276  * @return integer Session variable
 277  */
 278 function session_get_int( $p_name, $p_default = null ) {
 279 	$t_args = func_get_args();
 280 	return (int)call_user_func_array( 'session_get', $t_args );
 281 }
 282 
 283 /**
 284  * Get a boolean from the session.
 285  * @param string       $p_name    Session variable name.
 286  * @param boolean|null $p_default Default value.
 287  * @return boolean Session variable
 288  */
 289 function session_get_bool( $p_name, $p_default = null ) {
 290 	$t_args = func_get_args();
 291 	return (bool)call_user_func_array( 'session_get', $t_args );
 292 }
 293 
 294 /**
 295  * Get a string from the session.
 296  * @param string      $p_name    Session variable name.
 297  * @param string|null $p_default Default value.
 298  * @return string Session variable
 299  */
 300 function session_get_string( $p_name, $p_default = null ) {
 301 	$t_args = func_get_args();
 302 	return (string)call_user_func_array( 'session_get', $t_args );
 303 }
 304 
 305 /**
 306  * Set a session variable.
 307  * @param string $p_name  Session variable name.
 308  * @param mixed  $p_value Variable value.
 309  * @return void
 310  */
 311 function session_set( $p_name, $p_value ) {
 312 	global $g_session;
 313 	$g_session->set( $p_name, $p_value );
 314 }
 315 
 316 /**
 317  * Delete a session variable.
 318  * @param string $p_name Session variable name.
 319  * @return void
 320  */
 321 function session_delete( $p_name ) {
 322 	global $g_session;
 323 	$g_session->delete( $p_name );
 324 }
 325 
 326 /**
 327  * Destroy the session entirely.
 328  * @return void
 329  */
 330 function session_clean() {
 331 	global $g_session;
 332 	$g_session->destroy();
 333 }
 334 
 335 # Initialize the session
 336 if( PHP_CGI == php_mode() ) {
 337 	$t_session_id = gpc_get_string( 'session_id', '' );
 338 
 339 	if( empty( $t_session_id ) ) {
 340 		session_init();
 341 	} else {
 342 		session_init( $t_session_id );
 343 	}
 344 }

  95 $g_cache_sponsorships = array();
  96 
  97 /**
  98  * Cache a sponsorship row if necessary and return the cached copy
  99  * If the second parameter is true (default), trigger an error
 100  * if the sponsorship can't be found.  If the second parameter is
 101  * false, return false if the sponsorship can't be found.
 102  * @param integer $p_sponsorship_id The sponsorship identifier to retrieve and cache.
 103  * @param boolean $p_trigger_errors Whether to trigger an error if the identifier is not found.
 104  * @return array|boolean
 105  */
 106 function sponsorship_cache_row( $p_sponsorship_id, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
 107 	global $g_cache_sponsorships;
 108 
 109 	$c_sponsorship_id = (int)$p_sponsorship_id;
 110 
 111 	if( isset( $g_cache_sponsorships[$c_sponsorship_id] ) ) {
 112 		return $g_cache_sponsorships[$c_sponsorship_id];
 113 	}
 114 
 115 	db_param_push();
 116 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {sponsorship} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 117 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_sponsorship_id ) );
 118 
 119 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 120 
 121 	if( !$t_row ) {
 122 		$g_cache_sponsorships[$c_sponsorship_id] = false;
 123 
 124 		if( $p_trigger_errors ) {
 125 			error_parameters( $p_sponsorship_id );
 126 			trigger_error( ERROR_SPONSORSHIP_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 127 		} else {
 128 			return false;
 129 		}
 130 	}
 131 
 132 	$g_cache_sponsorships[$c_sponsorship_id] = $t_row;
 133 
 134 	return $t_row;
 135 }
 136 
 137 /**
 138  * Clear the sponsorship cache (or just the given id if specified)
 139  * @param integer $p_sponsorship_id The sponsorship identifier to clear.
 140  * @return void
 141  */
 142 function sponsorship_clear_cache( $p_sponsorship_id = null ) {
 143 	global $g_cache_sponsorships;
 144 
 145 	if( $p_sponsorship_id === null ) {
 146 		$g_cache_sponsorships = array();
 147 	} else {
 148 		unset( $g_cache_sponsorships[(int)$p_sponsorship_id] );
 149 	}
 150 }
 151 
 152 /**
 153  * check to see if sponsorship exists by id
 154  * return true if it does, false otherwise
 155  * @param integer $p_sponsorship_id The sponsorship identifier to check.
 156  * @return boolean
 157  */
 158 function sponsorship_exists( $p_sponsorship_id ) {
 159 	return sponsorship_cache_row( $p_sponsorship_id, false ) !== false;
 160 }
 161 
 162 /**
 163  * return false if not found
 164  * otherwise returns sponsorship id
 165  * @param integer $p_bug_id  A valid bug identifier.
 166  * @param integer $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
 167  * @return integer|false
 168  */
 169 function sponsorship_get_id( $p_bug_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
 170 	if( $p_user_id === null ) {
 171 		$c_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 172 	} else {
 173 		$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 174 	}
 175 
 176 	db_param_push();
 177 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {sponsorship} WHERE bug_id=' . db_param() . ' AND user_id = ' . db_param();
 178 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_bug_id, $c_user_id ), 1 );
 179 
 180 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 181 
 182 	if( !$t_row ) {
 183 		return false;
 184 	}
 185 
 186 	return (int)$t_row['id'];
 187 }
 188 
 189 /**
 190  * get information about a sponsorship given its id
 191  * @param integer $p_sponsorship_id The sponsorship identifier to retrieve.
 192  * @return SponsorShipData
 193  */
 194 function sponsorship_get( $p_sponsorship_id ) {
 195 	$t_row = sponsorship_cache_row( $p_sponsorship_id );
 196 
 197 	$t_sponsorship_data = new SponsorShipData;
 198 	$t_row_keys = array_keys( $t_row );
 199 	$t_vars = get_object_vars( $t_sponsorship_data );
 200 
 201 	# Check each variable in the class
 202 	foreach( $t_vars as $t_var => $t_val ) {
 203 		# If we got a field from the DB with the same name
 204 		if( in_array( $t_var, $t_row_keys, true ) ) {
 205 			# Store that value in the object
 206 			$t_sponsorship_data->$t_var = $t_row[$t_var];
 207 		}
 208 	}
 209 
 210 	return $t_sponsorship_data;
 211 }
 212 
 213 /**
 214  * Return an array of Sponsorships associated with the specified bug id
 215  * @param integer $p_bug_id The bug identifier to retrieve.
 216  * @return array
 217  */
 218 function sponsorship_get_all_ids( $p_bug_id ) {
 219 	global $g_cache_sponsorships;
 220 	static $s_cache_sponsorship_bug_ids = array();
 221 
 222 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
 223 
 224 	if( isset( $s_cache_sponsorship_bug_ids[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
 225 		return $s_cache_sponsorship_bug_ids[$c_bug_id];
 226 	}
 227 
 228 	db_param_push();
 229 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {sponsorship} WHERE bug_id = ' . db_param();
 230 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bug_id ) );
 231 
 232 	$t_sponsorship_ids = array();
 233 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 234 		$t_sponsorship_ids[] = $t_row['id'];
 235 		$g_cache_sponsorships[(int)$t_row['id']] = $t_row;
 236 	}
 237 
 238 	$s_cache_sponsorship_bug_ids[$c_bug_id] = $t_sponsorship_ids;
 239 
 240 	return $t_sponsorship_ids;
 241 }
 242 
 243 /**
 244  * Get the amount of sponsorships for the specified id(s)
 245  * handles the case where $p_sponsorship_id is an array or an id.
 246  * @param array|integer $p_sponsorship_id The sponsorship identifier(s) to check.
 247  * @return integer
 248  */
 249 function sponsorship_get_amount( $p_sponsorship_id ) {
 250 	if( is_array( $p_sponsorship_id ) ) {
 251 		$t_total = 0;
 252 
 253 		foreach( $p_sponsorship_id as $t_id ) {
 254 			$t_total += sponsorship_get_amount( $t_id );
 255 		}
 256 
 257 		return $t_total;
 258 	} else {
 259 		$t_sponsorship = sponsorship_get( $p_sponsorship_id );
 260 		return $t_sponsorship->amount;
 261 	}
 262 }

 264 /**
 265  * Return the currency used for all sponsorships
 266  * @return string
 267  */
 268 function sponsorship_get_currency() {
 269 	return config_get( 'sponsorship_currency' );
 270 }
 271 
 272 /**
 273  * This function should return the string in a globalized format.
 274  * @param integer $p_amount A numeric value represent the amount to format.
 275  * @return string
 276  * @todo add some currency formatting in the future
 277  */
 278 function sponsorship_format_amount( $p_amount ) {
 279 	$t_currency = sponsorship_get_currency();
 280 	return $t_currency . ' ' . $p_amount;
 281 }

 283 /**
 284  * Update bug to reflect sponsorship change
 285  * This is to be called after adding/updating/deleting sponsorships
 286  * @param integer $p_bug_id The bug identifier to update.
 287  * @return void
 288  */
 289 function sponsorship_update_bug( $p_bug_id ) {
 290 	$t_total_amount = sponsorship_get_amount( sponsorship_get_all_ids( $p_bug_id ) );
 291 	bug_set_field( $p_bug_id, 'sponsorship_total', $t_total_amount );
 292 	bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
 293 }
 294 
 295 /**
 296  * if sponsorship contains a non-zero id, then update the corresponding record.
 297  * if sponsorship contains a zero id, search for bug_id/user_id, if found, then update the entry
 298  * otherwise add a new entry
 299  * @param SponsorshipData $p_sponsorship The sponsorship data object to set.
 300  * @return integer
 301  */
 302 function sponsorship_set( SponsorshipData $p_sponsorship ) {
 303 	$t_min_sponsorship = config_get( 'minimum_sponsorship_amount' );
 304 	if( $p_sponsorship->amount < $t_min_sponsorship ) {
 305 		error_parameters( $p_sponsorship->amount, $t_min_sponsorship );
 306 		trigger_error( ERROR_SPONSORSHIP_AMOUNT_TOO_LOW, ERROR );
 307 	}
 308 
 309 	# if id == 0, check if the specified user is already sponsoring the bug, if so, overwrite
 310 	if( $p_sponsorship->id == 0 ) {
 311 		$t_sponsorship_id = sponsorship_get_id( $p_sponsorship->bug_id, $p_sponsorship->user_id );
 312 		if( $t_sponsorship_id !== false ) {
 313 			$p_sponsorship->id = $t_sponsorship_id;
 314 		}
 315 	}
 316 
 317 	$c_id = (int)$p_sponsorship->id;
 318 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_sponsorship->bug_id;
 319 	$c_user_id = (int)$p_sponsorship->user_id;
 320 	$c_amount = (int)$p_sponsorship->amount;
 321 	$c_logo = $p_sponsorship->logo;
 322 	$c_url = $p_sponsorship->url;
 323 	$c_now = db_now();
 324 
 325 	# if new sponsorship
 326 	if( $c_id == 0 ) {
 327 		# Insert
 328 		db_param_push();
 329 		$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {sponsorship}
 330 				    ( bug_id, user_id, amount, logo, url, date_submitted, last_updated )
 331 				  VALUES
 332 				    (' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 333 		db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bug_id, $c_user_id, $c_amount, $c_logo, $c_url, $c_now, $c_now ) );
 334 
 335 		$t_sponsorship_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'sponsorship' ) );
 336 
 337 		history_log_event_special( $c_bug_id, BUG_ADD_SPONSORSHIP, $c_user_id, $c_amount );
 338 	} else {
 339 		$t_old_amount = sponsorship_get_amount( $c_id );
 340 		$t_sponsorship_id = $c_id;
 341 
 342 		if( $t_old_amount == $c_amount ) {
 343 			return $t_sponsorship_id;
 344 		}
 345 
 346 		# Update
 347 		db_param_push();
 348 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {sponsorship}
 349 					SET	bug_id = ' . db_param() . ',
 350 						user_id = ' . db_param() . ',
 351 						amount = ' . db_param() . ',
 352 						logo = ' . db_param() . ',
 353 						url = ' . db_param() . ',
 354 						last_updated = ' . db_param() . '
 355 					WHERE	id = ' . db_param();
 356 
 357 		sponsorship_clear_cache( $c_id );
 358 
 359 		db_query( $t_query, array( $c_bug_id, $c_user_id, $c_amount, $c_logo, $c_url, $c_now, $c_id ) );
 360 
 361 		history_log_event_special( $c_bug_id, BUG_UPDATE_SPONSORSHIP, $c_user_id, $c_amount );
 362 	}
 363 
 364 	sponsorship_update_bug( $c_bug_id );
 365 	bug_monitor( $c_bug_id, $c_user_id );
 366 
 367 	if( $c_id == 0 ) {
 368 		email_sponsorship_added( $c_bug_id );
 369 	} else {
 370 		email_sponsorship_updated( $c_bug_id );
 371 	}
 372 
 373 	return $t_sponsorship_id;
 374 }

 389 /**
 390  * delete a sponsorship given its id
 391  * id can be an array of ids or just an id.
 392  * @param integer $p_sponsorship_id The sponsorship identifier to delete.
 393  * @return void
 394  */
 395 function sponsorship_delete( $p_sponsorship_id ) {
 396 	# handle the case of array of ids
 397 	if( is_array( $p_sponsorship_id ) ) {
 398 		foreach( $p_sponsorship_id as $t_id ) {
 399 			sponsorship_delete( $t_id );
 400 		}
 401 		return;
 402 	}
 403 
 404 	$t_sponsorship = sponsorship_get( $p_sponsorship_id );
 405 
 406 	# Delete the bug entry
 407 	db_param_push();
 408 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {sponsorship} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 409 	db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_sponsorship_id ) );
 410 
 411 	sponsorship_clear_cache( $p_sponsorship_id );
 412 
 413 	history_log_event_special( $t_sponsorship->bug_id, BUG_DELETE_SPONSORSHIP, $t_sponsorship->user_id, $t_sponsorship->amount );
 414 	sponsorship_update_bug( $t_sponsorship->bug_id );
 415 
 416 	email_sponsorship_deleted( $t_sponsorship->bug_id );
 417 }

  56 /**
  57  * Preserve spaces at beginning of lines.
  58  * Lines must be separated by \n rather than <br />
  59  * @param string $p_string String to be processed.
  60  * @return string
  61  */
  62 function string_preserve_spaces_at_bol( $p_string ) {
  63 	$t_lines = explode( "\n", $p_string );
  64 	$t_line_count = count( $t_lines );
  65 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_line_count;$i++ ) {
  66 		$t_count = 0;
  67 		$t_prefix = '';
  68 
  69 		$t_char = mb_substr( $t_lines[$i], $t_count, 1 );
  70 		$t_spaces = 0;
  71 		while( ( $t_char == ' ' ) || ( $t_char == "\t" ) ) {
  72 			if( $t_char == ' ' ) {
  73 				$t_spaces++;
  74 			} else {
  75 				$t_spaces += 4;
  76 			}
  77 
  78 			# 1 tab = 4 spaces, can be configurable.
  79 
  80 			$t_count++;
  81 			$t_char = mb_substr( $t_lines[$i], $t_count, 1 );
  82 		}
  83 
  84 		for( $j = 0;$j < $t_spaces;$j++ ) {
  85 			$t_prefix .= '&#160;';
  86 		}
  87 
  88 		$t_lines[$i] = $t_prefix . mb_substr( $t_lines[$i], $t_count );
  89 	}
  90 	return implode( "\n", $t_lines );
  91 }

 106 /**
 107  * Similar to nl2br, but fixes up a problem where new lines are doubled between
 108  * html pre tags.
 109  * additionally, wrap the text an $p_wrap character intervals if the config is set
 110  * @param string  $p_string String to be processed.
 111  * @param integer $p_wrap   Number of characters to wrap text at.
 112  * @return string
 113  */
 114 function string_nl2br( $p_string, $p_wrap = 100 ) {
 115 	$t_pieces = preg_split( '/(<pre[^>]*>.*?<\/pre>)/is', $p_string, -1, PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE );
 116 	if( isset( $t_pieces[1] ) ) {
 117 		$t_output = '';
 118 		foreach( $t_pieces as $t_piece ) {
 119 			if( preg_match( '/(<pre[^>]*>.*?<\/pre>)/is', $t_piece ) ) {
 120 				$t_piece = preg_replace( '/<br[^>]*?>/', '', $t_piece );
 121 
 122 				# @@@ thraxisp - this may want to be replaced by html_entity_decode (or equivalent)
 123 				#     if other encoded characters are a problem
 124 				$t_piece = preg_replace( '/&#160;/', ' ', $t_piece );
 125 				if( ON == config_get( 'wrap_in_preformatted_text' ) ) {
 126 					# Use PCRE_UTF8 modifier to ensure a correct char count
 127 					$t_output .= preg_replace( '/([^\n]{' . $p_wrap . ',}?[\s]+)(?!<\/pre>)/u', "$1", $t_piece );
 128 				} else {
 129 					$t_output .= $t_piece;
 130 				}
 131 			} else {
 132 				$t_output .= nl2br( $t_piece );
 133 			}
 134 		}
 135 		return $t_output;
 136 	} else {
 137 		return nl2br( $p_string );
 138 	}
 139 }

 249 /**
 250  * validate the url as part of this site before continuing
 251  * @param string  $p_url             URL to be processed.
 252  * @param boolean $p_return_absolute Whether to return the absolute URL to this Mantis instance.
 253  * @return string
 254  */
 255 function string_sanitize_url( $p_url, $p_return_absolute = false ) {
 256 	$t_url = strip_tags( urldecode( $p_url ) );
 257 
 258 	$t_path = rtrim( config_get_global( 'path' ), '/' );
 259 	$t_short_path = rtrim( config_get_global( 'short_path' ), '/' );
 260 
 261 	$t_pattern = '(?:/*(?P<script>[^\?#]*))(?:\?(?P<query>[^#]*))?(?:#(?P<anchor>[^#]*))?';
 262 
 263 	# Break the given URL into pieces for path, script, query, and anchor
 264 	$t_type = 0;
 265 	if( preg_match( '@^(?P<path>' . preg_quote( $t_path, '@' ) . ')' . $t_pattern . '$@', $t_url, $t_matches ) ) {
 266 		$t_type = 1;
 267 	} else if( !empty( $t_short_path )
 268 			&& preg_match( '@^(?P<path>' . preg_quote( $t_short_path, '@' ) . ')' . $t_pattern . '$@', $t_url, $t_matches )
 269 	) {
 270 		$t_type = 2;
 271 	} else if( preg_match( '@^(?P<path>)' . $t_pattern . '$@', $t_url, $t_matches ) ) {
 272 		$t_type = 3;
 273 	}
 274 
 275 	# Check for URL's pointing to other domains
 276 	if( 0 == $t_type || empty( $t_matches['script'] ) ||
 277 		3 == $t_type && preg_match( '@(?:[^:]*)?:/*@', $t_url ) > 0 ) {
 278 
 279 		return ( $p_return_absolute ? $t_path . '/' : '' ) . 'index.php';
 280 	}
 281 
 282 	# Start extracting regex matches
 283 	# Encode backslashes to prevent unwanted escaping of a leading '/' allowing
 284 	# redirection to external sites
 285 	$t_script = strtr( $t_matches['script'], array( '\\' => '%5C' ) );
 286 	$t_script_path = $t_matches['path'];
 287 
 288 	# Clean/encode query params
 289 	$t_query = '';
 290 	if( isset( $t_matches['query'] ) ) {
 291 		$t_pairs = array();
 292 		parse_str( html_entity_decode( $t_matches['query'] ), $t_pairs );
 293 
 294 		$t_clean_pairs = array();
 295 		foreach( $t_pairs as $t_key => $t_value ) {
 296 			if( is_array( $t_value ) ) {
 297 				foreach( $t_value as $t_value_each ) {
 298 					$t_clean_pairs[] = string_url( $t_key ) . '[]=' . string_url( $t_value_each );
 299 				}
 300 			} else {
 301 				$t_clean_pairs[] = string_url( $t_key ) . '=' . string_url( $t_value );
 302 			}
 303 		}
 304 
 305 		if( !empty( $t_clean_pairs ) ) {
 306 			$t_query = '?' . implode( '&', $t_clean_pairs );
 307 		}
 308 	}
 309 
 310 	# encode link anchor
 311 	$t_anchor = '';
 312 	if( isset( $t_matches['anchor'] ) ) {
 313 		$t_anchor = '#' . string_url( $t_matches['anchor'] );
 314 	}
 315 
 316 	# Return an appropriate re-combined URL string
 317 	if( $p_return_absolute ) {
 318 		return $t_path . '/' . $t_script . $t_query . $t_anchor;
 319 	} else {
 320 		return ( !empty( $t_script_path ) ? $t_script_path . '/' : '' ) . $t_script . $t_query . $t_anchor;
 321 	}
 322 }

 324 /**
 325  * Process $p_string, looking for bug ID references and creating bug view
 326  * links for them.
 327  *
 328  * Returns the processed string.
 329  *
 330  * If $p_include_anchor is true, include the href tag, otherwise just insert
 331  * the URL
 332  *
 333  * The bug tag ('#' by default) must be at the beginning of the string or
 334  * preceded by a character that is not a letter, a number or an underscore
 335  *
 336  * if $p_include_anchor = false, $p_fqdn is ignored and assumed to true.
 337  * @param string  $p_string         String to be processed.
 338  * @param boolean $p_include_anchor Whether to include the href tag or just the URL.
 339  * @param boolean $p_detail_info    Whether to include more detailed information (e.g. title attribute / project) in the returned string.
 340  * @param boolean $p_fqdn           Whether to return an absolute or relative link.
 341  * @return string
 342  */
 343 function string_process_bug_link( $p_string, $p_include_anchor = true, $p_detail_info = true, $p_fqdn = false ) {
 344 	static $s_bug_link_callback = array();
 345 
 346 	$t_tag = config_get( 'bug_link_tag' );
 347 
 348 	# bail if the link tag is blank
 349 	if( '' == $t_tag || $p_string == '' ) {
 350 		return $p_string;
 351 	}
 352 
 353 	if( !isset( $s_bug_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn] ) ) {
 354 		if( $p_include_anchor ) {
 355 			$s_bug_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn] =
 356 				function( $p_array ) use( $p_detail_info, $p_fqdn ) {
 357 					$c_bug_id = (int)$p_array[2];
 358 					if( bug_exists( $c_bug_id ) ) {
 359 						$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $c_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 360 						$t_view_bug_threshold = config_get( 'view_bug_threshold', null, null, $t_project_id );
 361 						if( access_has_bug_level( $t_view_bug_threshold, $c_bug_id ) ) {
 362 							return $p_array[1] .
 363 								string_get_bug_view_link(
 364 									$c_bug_id,
 365 									(bool)$p_detail_info,
 366 									(bool)$p_fqdn
 367 								);
 368 						}
 369 					}
 370 					return $p_array[0];
 371 				}; # end of bug link callback closure
 372 		} else {
 373 			$s_bug_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn] =
 374 				function( $p_array ) {
 375 					$c_bug_id = (int)$p_array[2];
 376 					if( bug_exists( $c_bug_id ) ) {
 377 						# Create link regardless of user's access to the bug
 378 						return $p_array[1] .
 379 							string_get_bug_view_url_with_fqdn( $c_bug_id );
 380 					}
 381 					return $p_array[0];
 382 				}; # end of bug link callback closure
 383 		}
 384 	}
 385 
 386 	$p_string = preg_replace_callback(
 387 		'/(^|[^\w&])' . preg_quote( $t_tag, '/' ) . '(\d+)\b/',
 388 		$s_bug_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn],
 389 		$p_string
 390 	);
 391 	return $p_string;
 392 }
 393 
 394 /**
 395  * Process $p_string, looking for bugnote ID references and creating bug view
 396  * links for them.
 397  *
 398  * Returns the processed string.
 399  *
 400  * If $p_include_anchor is true, include the href tag, otherwise just insert
 401  * the URL
 402  *
 403  * The bugnote tag ('~' by default) must be at the beginning of the string or
 404  * preceded by a character that is not a letter, a number or an underscore
 405  *
 406  * if $p_include_anchor = false, $p_fqdn is ignored and assumed to true.
 407  * @param string  $p_string         String to be processed.
 408  * @param boolean $p_include_anchor Whether to include the href tag or just the URL.
 409  * @param boolean $p_detail_info    Whether to include more detailed information (e.g. title attribute / project) in the returned string.
 410  * @param boolean $p_fqdn           Whether to return an absolute or relative link.
 411  * @return string
 412  */
 413 function string_process_bugnote_link( $p_string, $p_include_anchor = true, $p_detail_info = true, $p_fqdn = false ) {
 414 	static $s_bugnote_link_callback = array();
 415 
 416 	$t_tag = config_get( 'bugnote_link_tag' );
 417 
 418 	# bail if the link tag is blank
 419 	if( '' == $t_tag || $p_string == '' ) {
 420 		return $p_string;
 421 	}
 422 
 423 	if( !isset( $s_bugnote_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn] ) ) {
 424 		if( $p_include_anchor ) {
 425 			$s_bugnote_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn] =
 426 				function( $p_array ) use( $p_detail_info, $p_fqdn ) {
 427 					global $g_project_override;
 428 					$c_bugnote_id = (int)$p_array[2];
 429 					if( bugnote_exists( $c_bugnote_id ) ) {
 430 						$t_bug_id = bugnote_get_field( $c_bugnote_id, 'bug_id' );
 431 						if( bug_exists( $t_bug_id ) ) {
 432 							$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $t_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 433 							$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 434 
 435 							$g_project_override = $t_project_id;
 436 
 437 							$t_can_view_issue = access_has_bug_level( config_get( 'view_bug_threshold' ), $t_bug_id, $t_user_id );
 438 							if( $t_can_view_issue ) {
 439 								$t_can_view_note = access_compare_level(
 440 									user_get_access_level( $t_user_id, $t_project_id ),
 441 									config_get( 'private_bugnote_threshold' )
 442 									)
 443 									|| bugnote_get_field( $c_bugnote_id, 'reporter_id' ) == $t_user_id
 444 									|| bugnote_get_field( $c_bugnote_id, 'view_state' ) == VS_PUBLIC;
 445 
 446 								if( $t_can_view_note ) {
 447 									$g_project_override = null;
 448 									return $p_array[1] .
 449 										string_get_bugnote_view_link(
 450 											$t_bug_id,
 451 											$c_bugnote_id,
 452 											(bool)$p_detail_info,
 453 											(bool)$p_fqdn
 454 										);
 455 								}
 456 							}
 457 
 458 							$g_project_override = null;
 459 						}
 460 					}
 461 					return $p_array[0];
 462 				}; # end of bugnote link callback closure
 463 		} else {
 464 			$s_bugnote_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn] =
 465 				function( $p_array ) {
 466 					$c_bugnote_id = (int)$p_array[2];
 467 					if( bugnote_exists( $c_bugnote_id ) ) {
 468 						$t_bug_id = bugnote_get_field( $c_bugnote_id, 'bug_id' );
 469 						if( $t_bug_id && bug_exists( $t_bug_id ) ) {
 470 							return $p_array[1] .
 471 								string_get_bugnote_view_url_with_fqdn( $t_bug_id, $c_bugnote_id );
 472 						}
 473 					}
 474 					return $p_array[0];
 475 				}; # end of bugnote link callback closure
 476 		}
 477 	}
 478 	$p_string = preg_replace_callback(
 479 		'/(^|[^\w])' . preg_quote( $t_tag, '/' ) . '(\d+)\b/',
 480 		$s_bugnote_link_callback[$p_include_anchor][$p_detail_info][$p_fqdn],
 481 		$p_string
 482 	);
 483 	return $p_string;
 484 }

 486 /**
 487  * Search email addresses and URLs for a few common protocols in the given
 488  * string, and replace occurrences with href anchors.
 489  * @param string $p_string String to be processed.
 490  * @return string
 491  */
 492 function string_insert_hrefs( $p_string ) {
 493 	static $s_url_regex = null;
 494 	static $s_email_regex = null;
 495 
 496 	$t_html_make_links = config_get( 'html_make_links' );
 497 	if( !$t_html_make_links ) {
 498 		return $p_string;
 499 	}
 500 
 501 	# Initialize static variables
 502 	if( is_null( $s_url_regex ) ) {
 503 		# URL protocol. The regex accepts a small subset from the list of valid
 504 		# IANA permanent and provisional schemes defined in
 505 		# http://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml
 506 		$t_url_protocol = '(?:https?|s?ftp|file|irc[6s]?|ssh|telnet|nntp|git|svn(?:\+ssh)?|cvs):\/\/';
 507 
 508 		# %2A notation in url's
 509 		$t_url_hex = '%[[:digit:]A-Fa-f]{2}';
 510 
 511 		# valid set of characters that may occur in url scheme. Note: - should be first (A-F != -AF).
 512 		$t_url_valid_chars       = '-_.,!~*\';\/?%^\\\\:@&={\|}+$#[:alnum:]\pL';
 513 		$t_url_chars             = "(?:{$t_url_hex}|[{$t_url_valid_chars}\(\)\[\]])";
 514 		$t_url_chars2            = "(?:{$t_url_hex}|[{$t_url_valid_chars}])";
 515 		$t_url_chars_in_brackets = "(?:{$t_url_hex}|[{$t_url_valid_chars}\(\)])";
 516 		$t_url_chars_in_parens   = "(?:{$t_url_hex}|[{$t_url_valid_chars}\[\]])";
 517 
 518 		$t_url_part1 = $t_url_chars;
 519 		$t_url_part2 = "(?:\({$t_url_chars_in_parens}*\)|\[{$t_url_chars_in_brackets}*\]|{$t_url_chars2})";
 520 
 521 		$s_url_regex = "/({$t_url_protocol}({$t_url_part1}*?{$t_url_part2}+))/su";
 522 
 523 		# e-mail regex
 524 		$s_email_regex = substr_replace( email_regex_simple(), '(?:mailto:)?', 1, 0 );
 525 	}
 526 
 527 	# Find any URL in a string and replace it with a clickable link
 528 	$p_string = preg_replace_callback(
 529 		$s_url_regex,
 530 		function ( $p_match ) {
 531 			$t_url = $p_match[1];
 532 			$t_is_external_link = helper_is_link_external( $t_url );
 533 			# Set the link's target and type according to configuration
 534 			$t_link_attributes = helper_get_link_attributes( false, $t_is_external_link );
 535 			$t_url_href = 'href="' . rtrim( $t_url, '.' ) . '"';
 536 			return "<a {$t_url_href}{$t_link_attributes}>{$t_url}</a>";
 537 		},
 538 		$p_string
 539 	);
 540 
 541 	# Find any email addresses in the string and replace them with a clickable
 542 	# mailto: link, making sure that we skip processing of any existing anchor
 543 	# tags, to avoid parts of URLs such as https://user@example.com/ or
 544 	# http://user:password@example.com/ to be not treated as an email.
 545 	$p_string = string_process_exclude_anchors(
 546 		$p_string,
 547 		function( $p_string ) use ( $s_email_regex ) {
 548 			return preg_replace( $s_email_regex, '<a href="mailto:\0">\0</a>', $p_string );
 549 		}
 550 	);
 551 
 552 	return $p_string;
 553 }
 554 
 555 /**
 556  * Processes a string, ignoring anchor tags.
 557  * Applies the specified callback function to the text between anchor tags;
 558  * the anchors themselves will be left as-is.
 559  * @param string   $p_string   String to process
 560  * @param callable $p_callback Function to apply
 561  * @return string
 562  */
 563 function string_process_exclude_anchors( $p_string, $p_callback ) {
 564 	static $s_anchor_regex = '/(<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>)/is';
 565 
 566 	$t_pieces = preg_split( $s_anchor_regex, $p_string, -1, PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE );
 567 
 568 	$t_string = '';
 569 	foreach( $t_pieces as $t_piece ) {
 570 		if( preg_match( $s_anchor_regex, $t_piece ) ) {
 571 			$t_string .= $t_piece;
 572 		} else {
 573 			$t_string .= $p_callback( $t_piece );
 574 		}
 575 	}
 576 
 577 	return $t_string;
 578 }
 579 
 580 /**
 581  * Detect href anchors in the string and replace them with URLs and email addresses
 582  * @param string $p_string String to be processed.
 583  * @return string
 584  */
 585 function string_strip_hrefs( $p_string ) {
 586 	# First grab mailto: hrefs.  We don't care whether the URL is actually
 587 	# correct - just that it's inside an href attribute.
 588 	$p_string = preg_replace( '/<a\s[^\>]*href="mailto:([^\"]+)"[^\>]*>[^\<]*<\/a>/si', '\1', $p_string );
 589 
 590 	# Then grab any other href
 591 	$p_string = preg_replace( '/<a\s[^\>]*href="([^\"]+)"[^\>]*>[^\<]*<\/a>/si', '\1', $p_string );
 592 	return $p_string;
 593 }
 594 
 595 /**
 596  * This function looks for text with htmlentities
 597  * like &lt;b&gt; and converts it into the corresponding
 598  * html < b > tag based on the configuration information
 599  * @param string  $p_string    String to be processed.
 600  * @param boolean $p_multiline Whether the string being processed is a multi-line string.
 601  * @return string
 602  */
 603 function string_restore_valid_html_tags( $p_string, $p_multiline = true ) {
 604 	global $g_cache_html_valid_tags_single_line, $g_cache_html_valid_tags;
 605 
 606 	if( is_blank( ( $p_multiline ? $g_cache_html_valid_tags : $g_cache_html_valid_tags_single_line ) ) ) {
 607 		$t_html_valid_tags = config_get_global( $p_multiline ? 'html_valid_tags' : 'html_valid_tags_single_line' );
 608 
 609 		if( OFF === $t_html_valid_tags || is_blank( $t_html_valid_tags ) ) {
 610 			return $p_string;
 611 		}
 612 
 613 		$t_tags = explode( ',', $t_html_valid_tags );
 614 		foreach( $t_tags as $t_key => $t_value ) {
 615 			if( !is_blank( $t_value ) ) {
 616 				$t_tags[$t_key] = trim( $t_value );
 617 			}
 618 		}
 619 		$t_tags = implode( '|', $t_tags );
 620 		if( $p_multiline ) {
 621 			$g_cache_html_valid_tags = $t_tags;
 622 		} else {
 623 			$g_cache_html_valid_tags_single_line = $t_tags;
 624 		}
 625 	} else {
 626 		$t_tags = ( $p_multiline ? $g_cache_html_valid_tags : $g_cache_html_valid_tags_single_line );
 627 	}
 628 
 629 	$p_string = preg_replace( '/&lt;(' . $t_tags . ')\s*&gt;/ui', '<\\1>', $p_string );
 630 	$p_string = preg_replace( '/&lt;\/(' . $t_tags . ')\s*&gt;/ui', '</\\1>', $p_string );
 631 	return preg_replace( '/&lt;(' . $t_tags . ')\s*\/&gt;/ui', '<\\1 />', $p_string );
 632 }

 653 /**
 654  * return an href anchor that links to a bug VIEW page for the given bug
 655  * @param integer $p_bug_id	     A bug identifier.
 656  * @param boolean $p_detail_info Whether to include more detailed information (e.g. title attribute / project) in the returned string.
 657  * @param boolean $p_fqdn        Whether to return an absolute or relative link.
 658  * @return string
 659  */
 660 function string_get_bug_view_link( $p_bug_id, $p_detail_info = true, $p_fqdn = false ) {
 661 	if( bug_exists( $p_bug_id ) ) {
 662 		$t_link = '<a href="';
 663 		if( $p_fqdn ) {
 664 			$t_link .= config_get_global( 'path' );
 665 		} else {
 666 			$t_link .= config_get_global( 'short_path' );
 667 		}
 668 		$t_link .= string_get_bug_view_url( $p_bug_id ) . '"';
 669 		if( $p_detail_info ) {
 670 			$t_summary = string_attribute( bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'summary' ) );
 671 			$t_project_id = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'project_id' );
 672 			$t_status = string_attribute( get_enum_element( 'status', bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'status' ), $t_project_id ) );
 673 			$t_link .= ' title="[' . $t_status . '] ' . $t_summary . '"';
 674 
 675 			$t_resolved = bug_get_field( $p_bug_id, 'status' ) >= config_get( 'bug_resolved_status_threshold', null, null, $t_project_id );
 676 			if( $t_resolved ) {
 677 				$t_link .= ' class="resolved"';
 678 			}
 679 		}
 680 		$t_link .= '>' . bug_format_id( $p_bug_id ) . '</a>';
 681 	} else {
 682 		$t_link = bug_format_id( $p_bug_id );
 683 	}
 684 
 685 	return $t_link;
 686 }

 696 function string_get_bugnote_view_link( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_id, $p_detail_info = true, $p_fqdn = false ) {
 697 	$t_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
 698 
 699 	if( bug_exists( $t_bug_id ) && bugnote_exists( $p_bugnote_id ) ) {
 700 		$t_link = '<a href="';
 701 		if( $p_fqdn ) {
 702 			$t_link .= config_get_global( 'path' );
 703 		} else {
 704 			$t_link .= config_get_global( 'short_path' );
 705 		}
 706 
 707 		$t_link .= string_get_bugnote_view_url( $p_bug_id, $p_bugnote_id ) . '"';
 708 		if( $p_detail_info ) {
 709 			$t_reporter = string_attribute( user_get_name( bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'reporter_id' ) ) );
 710 			$t_update_date = string_attribute( date( config_get( 'normal_date_format' ), ( bugnote_get_field( $p_bugnote_id, 'last_modified' ) ) ) );

 713 
 714 		if( bug_is_resolved( $t_bug_id ) ) {
 715 			$t_link .= ' class="resolved"';
 716 		}
 717 
 718 		$t_link .= '>' . bug_format_id( $t_bug_id ) . ':' . bugnote_format_id( $p_bugnote_id ) . '</a>';

 720 		$t_link = bug_format_id( $t_bug_id ) . ':' . bugnote_format_id( $p_bugnote_id );

 722 
 723 	return $t_link;
 724 }

 837 /**
 838  * Shorten a string for display on a dropdown to prevent the page rendering too wide
 839  * ref issues #4630, #5072, #5131
 840  * @param string  $p_string The string to process.
 841  * @param integer $p_max    The maximum length of the string to use.
 842  *                          If not set, defaults to max_dropdown_length configuration variable.
 843  * @return string
 844  */
 845 function string_shorten( $p_string, $p_max = null ) {
 846 	if( $p_max === null ) {
 847 		$t_max = config_get( 'max_dropdown_length' );
 848 	} else {
 849 		$t_max = (int)$p_max;
 850 	}
 851 
 852 	if( ( $t_max > 0 ) && ( mb_strlen( $p_string ) > $t_max ) ) {
 853 		$t_pattern = '/([\s|.|,|\-|_|\/|\?]+)/';
 854 		$t_bits = preg_split( $t_pattern, $p_string, -1, PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE );
 855 
 856 		$t_string = '';
 857 		$t_last = $t_bits[count( $t_bits ) - 1];
 858 		$t_last_len = strlen( $t_last );
 859 
 860 		if( count( $t_bits ) == 1 ) {
 861 			$t_string .= mb_substr( $t_last, 0, $t_max - 3 );
 862 			$t_string .= '...';
 863 		} else {
 864 			foreach( $t_bits as $t_bit ) {
 865 				if( ( mb_strlen( $t_string ) + mb_strlen( $t_bit ) + $t_last_len + 3 <= $t_max ) || ( strpos( $t_bit, '.,-/?' ) > 0 ) ) {
 866 					$t_string .= $t_bit;
 867 				} else {
 868 					break;
 869 				}
 870 			}
 871 			$t_string .= '...' . $t_last;
 872 		}
 873 		return $t_string;
 874 	} else {
 875 		return $p_string;
 876 	}
 877 }

 923 /**
 924  * Calls htmlspecialchars on the specified string, handling utf8
 925  * @param string $p_string The string to process.
 926  * @return string
 927  */
 928 function string_html_specialchars( $p_string ) {
 929 	# achumakov: @ added to avoid warning output in unsupported codepages
 930 	# e.g. 8859-2, windows-1257, Korean, which are treated as 8859-1.
 931 	# This is VERY important for Eastern European, Baltic and Korean languages
 932 	return preg_replace( '/&amp;(#x?[0-9]+|[a-z]+);/i', '&$1;', @htmlspecialchars( $p_string, ENT_COMPAT, 'utf-8' ) );
 933 }

 935 /**
 936  * Prepares a string to be used as part of header().
 937  * @param string $p_string The string to process.
 938  * @return string
 939  */
 940 function string_prepare_header( $p_string ) {
 941 	$t_string= explode( "\n", $p_string, 2 );
 942 	$t_string= explode( "\r", $t_string[0], 2 );
 943 	return $t_string[0];
 944 }

 946 /**
 947  * Truncate a string to the specified length, optionally appending a marker.
 948  *
 949  * This is similar to {@see mb_strimwidth()}, but working on the string's length
 950  * (i.e. number of chars) instead of its width.
 951  *
 952  * @param string $p_string The string to truncate
 953  * @param int $p_length    Number of chars to keep. If negative, remove this
 954  *                         many chars from the end of the string.
 955  * @param string $p_marker If set, the string's last chars are replaced by this
 956  *                         to match the given length.
 957  *
 958  * @return string
 959  */
 960 function string_truncate( $p_string, $p_length, $p_marker = '') {
 961 	$t_string_length = mb_strlen( $p_string );
 962 	$t_marker_length = mb_strlen( $p_marker );
 963 	$t_truncate_length = $p_length - $t_marker_length;
 964 	if( $t_string_length <= $t_truncate_length ) {
 965 		return $p_string;
 966 	}
 967 
 968 	return mb_substr( $p_string, 0, $t_truncate_length ) . $p_marker;
 969 }
 970 
 971 /**
 972  * Replacement for str_pad. $padStr may contain multi-byte characters.
 973  *
 974  * @author Oliver Saunders <oliver (a) osinternetservices.com>
 975  * @param string $input
 976  * @param int $length
 977  * @param string $padStr
 978  * @param int $type ( same constants as str_pad )
 979  * @return string
 980  * @see http://www.php.net/str_pad
 981  * @see utf8_substr
 982  */
 983 function utf8_str_pad( $input, $length, $padStr = ' ', $type = STR_PAD_RIGHT ) {
 984 
 985     $inputLen = mb_strlen($input);
 986     if ($length <= $inputLen) {
 987         return $input;
 988     }
 989 
 990     $padStrLen = mb_strlen($padStr);
 991     $padLen = $length - $inputLen;
 992 
 993     if ($type == STR_PAD_RIGHT) {
 994         $repeatTimes = ceil($padLen / $padStrLen);
 995         return mb_substr($input . str_repeat($padStr, $repeatTimes), 0, $length);
 996     }
 997 
 998     if ($type == STR_PAD_LEFT) {
 999         $repeatTimes = ceil($padLen / $padStrLen);
1000         return mb_substr(str_repeat($padStr, $repeatTimes), 0, floor($padLen)) . $input;
1001     }
1002 
1003     if ($type == STR_PAD_BOTH) {
1004 
1005         $padLen/= 2;
1006         $padAmountLeft = floor($padLen);
1007         $padAmountRight = ceil($padLen);
1008         $repeatTimesLeft = ceil($padAmountLeft / $padStrLen);
1009         $repeatTimesRight = ceil($padAmountRight / $padStrLen);
1010 
1011         $paddingLeft = mb_substr(str_repeat($padStr, $repeatTimesLeft), 0, $padAmountLeft);
1012         $paddingRight = mb_substr(str_repeat($padStr, $repeatTimesRight), 0, $padAmountLeft);
1013         return $paddingLeft . $input . $paddingRight;
1014     }
1015 
1016     trigger_error('utf8_str_pad: Unknown padding type (' . $type . ')',E_USER_ERROR);
1017 }
1018 
1019 /**
1020  * Return the number of UTF-8 characters in a string
1021  * @param string $p_string
1022  * @return integer number of UTF-8 characters in string
1023  * @deprecated mb_strlen() should be used in preference to this function
1024  */
1025 function utf8_strlen( $p_string ) {
1026     error_parameters( __FUNCTION__ . '()', 'mb_strlen()' );
1027     trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
1028     return mb_strlen( $p_string );
1029 }
1030 
1031 /**
1032  * Get part of string
1033  * @param string $p_string
1034  * @param integer $p_offset
1035  * @param integer $p_length
1036  * @return mixed string or FALSE if failure
1037  * @deprecated mb_substr() should be used in preference to this function
1038  */
1039 function utf8_substr( $p_string, $p_offset, $p_length = NULL ) {
1040     error_parameters( __FUNCTION__ . '()', 'mb_substr()' );
1041     trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
1042     return mb_substr( $p_string, $p_offset, $p_length );
1043 }
1044 
1045 /**
1046  * Make a string lowercase
1047  * @param string $p_string
1048  * @return string with all alphabetic characters converted to lowercase
1049  * @deprecated mb_strtolower() should be used in preference to this function
1050  */
1051 function utf8_strtolower( $p_string ) {
1052     error_parameters( __FUNCTION__ . '()', 'mb_strtolower()' );
1053     trigger_error( ERROR_DEPRECATED_SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED );
1054     return mb_strtolower( $p_string );
1055 }

  58 use Mantis\Exceptions\ClientException;
  59 
  60 # cache the tag definitions, indexed by tag id
  61 # tag ids that don't exist are stored as 'false', to avoid repeated searches
  62 $g_cache_tags = array();
  63 
  64 # cache the bug tags indexed by [bug_id, tag_id]. Items stored are rows (arrays) fetched from table {bug_tags}
  65 # bugs with no tags will be stored as 'false'.
  66 $g_cache_bug_tags = array();
  67 
  68 /**
  69  * Loads into cache a set of tag definitions from tag table.
  70  *
  71  * Non existent ids are cached as 'false'.
  72  *
  73  * @global array $g_cache_tags
  74  * @param array $p_tag_ids Array of tag ids.
  75  *
  76  * @return void
  77  */
  78 function tag_cache_rows( array $p_tag_ids ) {
  79 	global $g_cache_tags;
  80 
  81 	$t_ids_to_search = array();
  82 	foreach( $p_tag_ids as $t_id ) {
  83 		if( !isset( $g_cache_tags[(int)$t_id]) ) {
  84 			$t_ids_to_search[(int)$t_id] = (int)$t_id;
  85 		}
  86 	}
  87 	if( empty( $t_ids_to_search ) ) {
  88 		return;
  89 	}
  90 
  91 	db_param_push();
  92 	$t_sql_in_params = array();
  93 	$t_params = array();
  94 	foreach( $t_ids_to_search as $t_id ) {
  95 		$t_sql_in_params[] = db_param();
  96 		$t_params[] = $t_id;
  97 	}
  98 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {tag} where id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_sql_in_params ) . ')';
  99 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 100 
 101 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 102 		$c_id = (int)$t_row['id'];
 103 		$g_cache_tags[$c_id] = $t_row;
 104 		unset( $t_ids_to_search[$c_id] );
 105 	}
 106 	# mark the non existent ids
 107 	foreach( $t_ids_to_search as $t_id ) {
 108 		$g_cache_tags[$t_id] = false;
 109 	}
 110 }
 111 
 112 /**
 113  * Loads into cache the tags associated to a set of bug ids.
 114  *
 115  * A bug id that has no tags will be cached as 'false'.
 116  *
 117  * @global array $g_cache_bug_tags
 118  * @param array $p_bug_ids Array of bug ids.
 119  *
 120  * @return void
 121  */
 122 function tag_cache_bug_tag_rows( array $p_bug_ids ) {
 123 	global $g_cache_bug_tags;
 124 
 125 	$t_ids_to_search = array();
 126 	foreach( $p_bug_ids as $t_id ) {
 127 		if( !isset( $g_cache_bug_tags[(int)$t_id]) ) {
 128 			$t_ids_to_search[] = (int)$t_id;
 129 		}
 130 	}
 131 
 132 	if( empty( $t_ids_to_search ) ) {
 133 		return;
 134 	}
 135 
 136 	db_param_push();
 137 	$t_sql_in_params = array();
 138 	$t_params = array();
 139 	foreach( $t_ids_to_search as $t_id ) {
 140 		$t_sql_in_params[] = db_param();
 141 		$t_params[] = $t_id;
 142 	}
 143 	$t_query = 'SELECT B.id AS bug_id, BT.tag_id, BT.user_id, BT.date_attached FROM {bug} B LEFT OUTER JOIN {bug_tag} BT ON B.id=BT.bug_id'
 144 			. ' WHERE B.id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_sql_in_params ) . ')';
 145 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 146 
 147 	$t_found_tags = array();
 148 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 149 		$c_bug_id = (int)$t_row['bug_id'];
 150 		$t_has_tags = !empty( $t_row['tag_id'] );
 151 		# create a bug index if needed
 152 		if( !isset( $g_cache_bug_tags[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
 153 			$g_cache_bug_tags[$c_bug_id] = $t_has_tags? array() : false;
 154 		}
 155 		if( $t_has_tags ) {
 156 			$c_tag_id = (int)$t_row['tag_id'];
 157 			$g_cache_bug_tags[$c_bug_id][$c_tag_id] = $t_row;
 158 			$t_found_tags[$c_tag_id] = $c_tag_id;
 159 		}
 160 	}
 161 	# also cache the tags founds
 162 	if( !empty( $t_found_tags ) ) {
 163 		tag_cache_rows( $t_found_tags );
 164 	}
 165 }

 167 /**
 168  * Clear the bug tags cache (or just the given bug id if specified).
 169  *
 170  * @global array $g_cache_bug_tags
 171  * @param int $p_bug_id Bug id
 172  *
 173  * @return void
 174  */
 175 function tag_clear_cache_bug_tags( $p_bug_id = null ) {
 176 	global $g_cache_bug_tags;
 177 
 178 	if( null === $p_bug_id ) {
 179 		$g_cache_bug_tags = array();
 180 	} else {
 181 		if( isset( $g_cache_bug_tags[(int)$p_bug_id] ) ) {
 182 			unset( $g_cache_bug_tags[(int)$p_bug_id] );
 183 		}
 184 	}
 185 }

 187 /**
 188  * Determine if a tag exists with the given ID.
 189  *
 190  * @param int $p_tag_id A tag ID to check.
 191  *
 192  * @return bool True if tag exists
 193  */
 194 function tag_exists( $p_tag_id ) {
 195 	return ( tag_get( $p_tag_id ) !== false );

 198 /**
 199  * Ensure a tag exists with the given ID.
 200  *
 201  * @param int $p_tag_id A tag ID to check.
 202  *
 203  * @return void
 204  * @throws ClientException

 206 function tag_ensure_exists( $p_tag_id ) {

 208 		throw new ClientException(
 209 			sprintf( "Tag '%d' does not exist", $p_tag_id ),
 210 			ERROR_TAG_NOT_FOUND,
 211 			array( $p_tag_id ) );
 212 	}

 215 /**
 216  * Determine if a given name is unique (not already used).
 217  *
 218  * Uses a case-insensitive search of the database for existing tags with the
 219  * same name.
 220  *
 221  * @param string $p_name The tag name to check.
 222  *
 223  * @return bool True if name is unique
 224  */
 225 function tag_is_unique( $p_name ) {
 226 	$c_name = trim( $p_name );
 227 
 228 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {tag} WHERE ' . db_helper_like( 'name' );
 229 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_name ) );
 230 
 231 	if( db_result( $t_result ) ) {
 232 		return false;
 233 	}
 234 	return true;
 235 }

 237 /**
 238  * Ensure that a name is unique.
 239  *
 240  * @param string $p_name The tag name to check.
 241  *
 242  * @return void
 243  */
 244 function tag_ensure_unique( $p_name ) {
 245 	if( !tag_is_unique( $p_name ) ) {
 246 		error_parameters( $p_name );
 247 		trigger_error( ERROR_TAG_DUPLICATE, ERROR );
 248 	}
 249 }

 251 /**
 252  * Determine if a given name is valid.
 253  *
 254  * Name must not begin with '+' and '-' characters (they are used for
 255  * filters) and must not contain the configured tag separator.
 256  * The matches parameter allows to also receive an array of regex matches,
 257  * which by default only includes the valid tag name itself.
 258  * The prefix parameter is optional, but allows you to prefix the regex
 259  * check, which is useful for filters, etc.
 260  *
 261  * @param string $p_name     The tag name to check.
 262  * @param array  &$p_matches Array reference for regex matches.
 263  * @param string $p_prefix   The regex pattern to use as a prefix.
 264  *
 265  * @return bool True if the name is valid.
 266  */
 267 function tag_name_is_valid( $p_name, array &$p_matches, $p_prefix = '' ) {
 268 	$t_separator = config_get( 'tag_separator' );
 269 	$t_pattern = '/^' . $p_prefix . '([^+\-' . $t_separator . '][^' . $t_separator . ']*)$/';
 270 	return preg_match( $t_pattern, $p_name, $p_matches );
 271 }
 272 
 273 /**
 274  * Ensure a tag name is valid.
 275  *
 276  * @param string $p_name The tag name to check.
 277  *
 278  * @return void
 279  */
 280 function tag_ensure_name_is_valid( $p_name ) {
 281 	$t_matches = array();
 282 	if( !tag_name_is_valid( $p_name, $t_matches ) ) {
 283 		error_parameters( $p_name );
 284 		trigger_error( ERROR_TAG_NAME_INVALID, ERROR );
 285 	}
 286 }

 288 /**
 289  * Compare two tag rows based on tag name.
 290  *
 291  * @param array $p_tag1 The first tag row to compare.
 292  * @param array $p_tag2 The second tag row to compare.
 293  *
 294  * @return int -1 when Tag 1 < Tag 2, +1 when Tag 1 > Tag 2, 0 otherwise.
 295  */
 296 function tag_cmp_name( array $p_tag1, array $p_tag2 ) {
 297 	return strcasecmp( $p_tag1['name'], $p_tag2['name'] );
 298 }
 299 
 300 /**
 301  * Parse a form input string to extract existing and new tags.
 302  *
 303  * When given a string, parses for tag names separated by configured separator,
 304  * then returns an array of tag rows for each tag.  Existing tags get the full
 305  * row of information returned.  If the tag does not exist, a row is returned with
 306  * id = -1 and the tag name, and if the name is invalid, a row is returned with
 307  * id = -2 and the tag name.  The resulting array is then sorted by tag name.
 308  *
 309  * @param string $p_string Input string to parse.
 310  *
 311  * @return array Rows of tags parsed from input string
 312  */
 313 function tag_parse_string( $p_string ) {
 314 	$t_tags = array();
 315 
 316 	$t_strings = explode( config_get( 'tag_separator' ), $p_string );
 317 	foreach( $t_strings as $t_name ) {
 318 		$t_name = trim( $t_name );
 319 		if( is_blank( $t_name ) ) {
 320 			continue;
 321 		}
 322 
 323 		$t_matches = array();
 324 		$t_tag_row = tag_get_by_name( $t_name );
 325 		if( $t_tag_row !== false ) {
 326 			$t_tags[] = $t_tag_row;
 327 		} else {
 328 			if( tag_name_is_valid( $t_name, $t_matches ) ) {
 329 				$t_id = -1;
 330 			} else {
 331 				$t_id = -2;
 332 			}
 333 			$t_tags[] = array(
 334 				'id' => $t_id,
 335 				'name' => $t_name,
 336 			);
 337 		}
 338 	}
 339 	usort( $t_tags, 'tag_cmp_name' );
 340 	return $t_tags;
 341 }
 342 
 343 /**
 344  * Attaches a bunch of tags to the specified issue.
 345  *
 346  * @param int    $p_bug_id     The bug id.
 347  * @param string $p_tag_string String of tags separated by configured separator.
 348  * @param int    $p_tag_id     Tag id to add or 0 to skip.
 349  *
 350  * @return array|bool True for success, otherwise array of failures.
 351  *                    The array elements follow the tag_parse_string() format.
 352  * @throws ClientException
 353  */
 354 function tag_attach_many( $p_bug_id, $p_tag_string, $p_tag_id = 0 ) {
 355 	# If no work, then there is no need to do access check.
 356 	if( $p_tag_id === 0 && is_blank( $p_tag_string ) ) {
 357 		return true;
 358 	}
 359 
 360 	access_ensure_bug_level( config_get( 'tag_attach_threshold' ), $p_bug_id );
 361 
 362 	$t_tags = tag_parse_string( $p_tag_string );
 363 	$t_can_create = tag_can_create();
 364 
 365 	$t_tags_create = array();
 366 	$t_tags_attach = array();
 367 	$t_tags_failed = array();
 368 
 369 	foreach ( $t_tags as $t_tag_row ) {
 370 		if( -1 == $t_tag_row['id'] ) {
 371 			if( $t_can_create ) {
 372 				$t_tags_create[] = $t_tag_row;
 373 			} else {
 374 				$t_tags_failed[] = $t_tag_row;
 375 			}
 376 		} else if( -2 == $t_tag_row['id'] ) {
 377 			$t_tags_failed[] = $t_tag_row;
 378 		} else {
 379 			$t_tags_attach[] = $t_tag_row;
 380 		}
 381 	}
 382 
 383 	if( 0 < $p_tag_id && tag_exists( $p_tag_id ) ) {
 384 		$t_tags_attach[] = tag_get( $p_tag_id );
 385 	}
 386 
 387 	# failed to attach at least one tag
 388 	if( count( $t_tags_failed ) > 0 ) {
 389 		return $t_tags_failed;
 390 	}
 391 
 392 	foreach( $t_tags_create as $t_tag_row ) {
 393 		$t_tag_row['id'] = tag_create( $t_tag_row['name'] );
 394 		$t_tags_attach[] = $t_tag_row;
 395 	}
 396 
 397 	foreach( $t_tags_attach as $t_tag_row ) {
 398 		if( !tag_bug_is_attached( $t_tag_row['id'], $p_bug_id ) ) {
 399 			tag_bug_attach( $t_tag_row['id'], $p_bug_id );
 400 		}
 401 	}
 402 
 403 	event_signal( 'EVENT_TAG_ATTACHED', array( $p_bug_id, $t_tags_attach ) );
 404 	return true;
 405 }
 406 
 407 /**
 408  * Parse a filter string to extract existing and new tags.
 409  *
 410  * When given a string, parses for tag names separated by configured separator,
 411  * then returns an array of tag rows for each tag.  Existing tags get the full
 412  * row of information returned.  If the tag does not exist, a row is returned with
 413  * id = -1 and the tag name, and if the name is invalid, a row is returned with
 414  * id = -2 and the tag name.  The resulting array is then sorted by tag name.
 415  *
 416  * @param string $p_string Filter string to parse.
 417  *
 418  * @return array Rows of tags parsed from filter string
 419  */
 420 function tag_parse_filters( $p_string ) {
 421 	$t_tags = array();
 422 	$t_prefix = '[+-]{0,1}';
 423 
 424 	$t_strings = explode( config_get( 'tag_separator' ), $p_string );
 425 	foreach( $t_strings as $t_name ) {
 426 		$t_name = trim( $t_name );
 427 		$t_matches = array();
 428 
 429 		if( !is_blank( $t_name ) && tag_name_is_valid( $t_name, $t_matches, $t_prefix ) ) {
 430 			$t_tag_row = tag_get_by_name( $t_matches[1] );
 431 			if( $t_tag_row !== false ) {
 432 				$t_filter = mb_substr( $t_name, 0, 1 );
 433 
 434 				if( '+' == $t_filter ) {
 435 					$t_tag_row['filter'] = 1;
 436 				} else if( '-' == $t_filter ) {
 437 					$t_tag_row['filter'] = -1;
 438 				} else {
 439 					$t_tag_row['filter'] = 0;
 440 				}
 441 
 442 				$t_tags[] = $t_tag_row;
 443 			}
 444 		}
 445 	}
 446 	usort( $t_tags, 'tag_cmp_name' );
 447 	return $t_tags;
 448 }
 449 
 450 /**
 451  * Returns all available tags.
 452  *
 453  * @param int $p_name_filter A string to match the beginning of the tag name.
 454  * @param int $p_count       The number of tags to return.
 455  * @param int $p_offset      The offset of the result.
 456  *
 457  * @return ADORecordSet|bool Tags sorted by name, or false if the query failed.
 458  */
 459 function tag_get_all( $p_name_filter, $p_count, $p_offset ) {
 460 	$t_where = '';
 461 	$t_where_params = array();
 462 
 463 	if( !is_blank( $p_name_filter ) ) {
 464 		$t_where = 'WHERE ' . db_helper_like( 'name' );
 465 		$t_where_params[] = $p_name_filter . '%';
 466 	}
 467 
 468 	$t_query = <<<SQL
 469 		SELECT t.*, num FROM {tag} t
 470 		LEFT JOIN (SELECT tag_id, COUNT(1) AS num FROM {bug_tag} GROUP BY tag_id) cnt
 471 			ON cnt.tag_id = t.id
 472 		$t_where
 473 		ORDER BY name
 474 		SQL;
 475 
 476 	return db_query( $t_query, $t_where_params, $p_count, $p_offset );
 477 }
 478 
 479 /**
 480  * Returns all unused tags (i.e. not linked to any Issue).
 481  *
 482  * @param int $p_name_filter A string to match the beginning of the tag name.
 483  * @param int $p_count       The number of tags to return.
 484  * @param int $p_offset      The offset of the result.
 485  *
 486  * @return ADORecordSet|bool Tags sorted by name, or false if the query failed.
 487  */
 488 function tag_get_unused( $p_name_filter, $p_count, $p_offset ) {
 489 	$t_where = '';
 490 	$t_where_params = array();
 491 
 492 	if( !is_blank( $p_name_filter ) ) {
 493 		$t_where = ' AND ' . db_helper_like( 'name' );
 494 		$t_where_params[] = $p_name_filter . '%';
 495 	}
 496 
 497 	$t_query = <<< SQL
 498 		SELECT t.*, 0 AS num FROM {tag} t
 499 		LEFT JOIN {bug_tag} bt ON bt.tag_id = t.id
 500 		WHERE bt.tag_id IS NULL $t_where 
 501 		ORDER BY name
 502 		SQL;
 503 
 504 	return db_query( $t_query, $t_where_params, $p_count, $p_offset );
 505 }
 506 
 507 /**
 508  * Counts all available tags.
 509  *
 510  * @param int  $p_name_filter A string to match the beginning of the tag name.
 511  * @param bool $p_unused      True to filter on unused tags, False for all tags.
 512  *
 513  * @return int
 514  */
 515 function tag_count( $p_name_filter, $p_unused = false ) {
 516 	$t_where = '';
 517 	$t_where_params = array();
 518 
 519 	if( $p_name_filter ) {
 520 		$t_where = ' WHERE ' . db_helper_like( 'name' );
 521 		$t_where_params[] = $p_name_filter . '%';
 522 	}
 523 	if( $p_unused ) {
 524 		$t_where .= $t_where ? ' AND ': ' WHERE ';
 525 		$t_where .= "bt.tag_id IS NULL";
 526 	}
 527 
 528 	$t_query = 'SELECT count(DISTINCT t.id) FROM {tag} t LEFT JOIN {bug_tag} bt ON bt.tag_id = t.id' . $t_where;
 529 
 530 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_where_params );
 531 	return (int)db_result( $t_result );
 532 }

 636 /**
 637  * Create a tag with the given name, creator, and description.
 638  *
 639  * Defaults to the currently logged in user, and a blank description.
 640  *
 641  * @param string $p_name        The tag name to create.
 642  * @param int    $p_user_id     The user ID to link the new tag to.
 643  * @param string $p_description A Description for the tag.
 644  *
 645  * @return int Tag ID
 646  * @throws ClientException
 647  */
 648 function tag_create( $p_name, $p_user_id = null, $p_description = '' ) {
 649 	tag_ensure_can_create( $p_user_id );
 650 
 651 	tag_ensure_name_is_valid( $p_name );
 652 	tag_ensure_unique( $p_name );
 653 
 654 	if( null == $p_user_id ) {
 655 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 656 	} else {
 657 		user_ensure_exists( $p_user_id );
 658 	}
 659 
 660 	$c_date_created = db_now();
 661 
 662 	db_param_push();
 663 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {tag}
 664 				( user_id, name, description, date_created, date_updated )
 665 				VALUES
 666 				( ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 667 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_user_id, trim( $p_name ), trim( $p_description ), $c_date_created, $c_date_created ) );
 668 
 669 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'tag' ) );
 670 }

 672 /**
 673  * Update a tag with given name, creator, and description.
 674  *
 675  * @param int    $p_tag_id      The tag ID which is being updated.
 676  * @param string $p_name        The name of the tag.
 677  * @param int    $p_user_id     The user ID to set when updating the tag.
 678  *                              Note: This replaces the existing user id.
 679  * @param string $p_description An updated description for the tag.
 680  *
 681  * @return bool
 682  * @throws ClientException
 683  */
 684 function tag_update( $p_tag_id, $p_name, $p_user_id, $p_description ) {
 685 	$t_tag_row = tag_get( $p_tag_id );
 686 	$t_tag_name = $t_tag_row['name'];
 687 
 688 	if( $t_tag_name == $p_name &&
 689 		 $t_tag_row['description'] == $p_description &&
 690 		 $t_tag_row['user_id'] == $p_user_id ) {
 691 		# nothing has changed
 692 		return true;
 693 	}
 694 
 695 	user_ensure_exists( $p_user_id );
 696 
 697 	if( auth_get_current_user_id() == $t_tag_row['user_id'] ) {
 698 		$t_update_level = config_get( 'tag_edit_own_threshold' );
 699 	} else {
 700 		$t_update_level = config_get( 'tag_edit_threshold' );
 701 	}
 702 	access_ensure_global_level( $t_update_level );
 703 
 704 	tag_ensure_name_is_valid( $p_name );
 705 
 706 	# Do not allow assigning a tag to a user who is not allowed to create one
 707 	if( !access_has_global_level( config_get( 'tag_create_threshold' ), $p_user_id ) ) {
 708 		trigger_error( ERROR_USER_DOES_NOT_HAVE_REQ_ACCESS, ERROR );
 709 	}
 710 
 711 	$t_rename = false;
 712 	if( mb_strtolower( $p_name ) != mb_strtolower( $t_tag_name ) ) {
 713 		tag_ensure_unique( $p_name );
 714 		$t_rename = true;
 715 	}
 716 
 717 	$c_date_updated = db_now();
 718 
 719 	db_param_push();
 720 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {tag}
 721 					SET user_id=' . db_param() . ',
 722 						name=' . db_param() . ',
 723 						description=' . db_param() . ',
 724 						date_updated=' . db_param() . '
 725 					WHERE id=' . db_param();
 726 	db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_user_id, $p_name, $p_description, $c_date_updated, $p_tag_id ) );
 727 
 728 	if( $t_rename ) {
 729 		$t_bugs = tag_get_bugs_attached( $p_tag_id );
 730 
 731 		foreach( $t_bugs as $t_bug_id ) {
 732 			history_log_event_special( $t_bug_id, TAG_RENAMED, $t_tag_name, $p_name );
 733 		}
 734 	}
 735 
 736 	return true;
 737 }
 738 
 739 /**
 740  * Delete a tag with the given ID.
 741  *
 742  * @param int $p_tag_id The tag ID to delete.
 743  *
 744  * @return bool
 745  * @throws ClientException
 746  */
 747 function tag_delete( $p_tag_id ) {
 748 	tag_ensure_exists( $p_tag_id );
 749 
 750 	access_ensure_global_level( config_get( 'tag_edit_threshold' ) );
 751 
 752 	$t_bugs = tag_get_bugs_attached( $p_tag_id );
 753 	foreach( $t_bugs as $t_bug_id ) {
 754 		tag_bug_detach( $p_tag_id, $t_bug_id );
 755 	}
 756 
 757 	db_param_push();
 758 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {tag} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 759 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_tag_id ) );
 760 
 761 	return true;
 762 }

 764 /**
 765  * Gets the tags that are not associated with the specified bug.
 766  *
 767  * @param int $p_bug_id The bug id, if 0 returns all available tags.
 768  *
 769  * @return array List of tag rows, each with id, name, and description.
 770  */
 771 function tag_get_candidates_for_bug( $p_bug_id ) {
 772 	db_param_push();
 773 	$t_query = 'SELECT id, name, description FROM {tag}';
 774 	$t_params = array();
 775 
 776 	if( 0 != $p_bug_id ) {
 777 		$t_assoc_tags_query = 'SELECT tag_id FROM {bug_tag} WHERE bug_id = ' . db_param();
 778 		$t_params[] = $p_bug_id;
 779 
 780 		# Define specific where clause to exclude tags already attached to the bug
 781 		# Special handling for odbc_mssql which does not support bound subqueries (#14774)
 782 		if( config_get_global( 'db_type' ) == 'odbc_mssql' ) {
 783 			db_param_push();
 784 			$t_result = db_query( $t_assoc_tags_query, $t_params );
 785 
 786 			$t_subquery_results = array();
 787 			while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 788 				$t_subquery_results[] = (int)$t_row['tag_id'];
 789 			}
 790 			if( $t_subquery_results ) {
 791 				$t_where = ' WHERE id NOT IN (' . implode( ', ', $t_subquery_results ) . ')';
 792 			} else {
 793 				$t_where = '';
 794 			}
 795 			$t_params = null;
 796 		} else {
 797 			$t_where = " WHERE id NOT IN ($t_assoc_tags_query)";
 798 		}
 799 		$t_query .= $t_where;
 800 	}
 801 
 802 	$t_query .= ' ORDER BY name ASC ';
 803 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 804 
 805 	$t_results_to_return = array();
 806 
 807 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 808 		$t_results_to_return[] = $t_row;
 809 	}
 810 
 811 	return $t_results_to_return;
 812 }

 814 /**

 817  * @param int $p_tag_id The tag ID to check.
 818  * @param int $p_bug_id The bug ID to check.

 822 function tag_bug_is_attached( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id ) {
 823 	db_param_push();

 826 	return( db_result( $t_result ) !== false );

 829 /**
 830  * Return the tag attachment row.
 831  *
 832  * @param int $p_tag_id The tag ID to check.
 833  * @param int $p_bug_id The bug ID to check.
 834  *
 835  * @return array Tag attachment row
 836  */
 837 function tag_bug_get_row( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id ) {
 838 	global $g_cache_bug_tags;
 839 
 840 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
 841 	if( !isset( $g_cache_bug_tags[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
 842 		tag_cache_bug_tag_rows( array( $c_bug_id ) );
 843 	}
 844 
 845 	$t_bug_tags = $g_cache_bug_tags[$c_bug_id];
 846 	if( !$t_bug_tags || !isset( $t_bug_tags[$p_tag_id] ) ) {
 847 		trigger_error( ERROR_TAG_NOT_ATTACHED, ERROR );
 848 	}
 849 	return $t_bug_tags[$p_tag_id];
 850 }
 851 
 852 /**
 853  * Return an array of tags attached to a given bug sorted by tag name.
 854  *
 855  * @param int $p_bug_id The bug ID to check.
 856  *
 857  * @return array Array of tag rows with attachment information.
 858  */
 859 function tag_bug_get_attached( $p_bug_id ) {
 860 	global $g_cache_bug_tags;
 861 
 862 	$c_bug_id = (int)$p_bug_id;
 863 	if( !isset( $g_cache_bug_tags[$c_bug_id] ) ) {
 864 		tag_cache_bug_tag_rows( array( $c_bug_id ) );
 865 	}
 866 
 867 	$t_bug_tags = $g_cache_bug_tags[$c_bug_id];
 868 	if( !$t_bug_tags ) {
 869 		return array();
 870 	}
 871 
 872 	$t_tag_info_rows = array();
 873 	foreach( $t_bug_tags as $t_row ) {
 874 		$t_tag_data = tag_get($t_row['tag_id']);
 875 		$t_tag_data['user_attached'] = $t_row['user_id'];
 876 		$t_tag_data['date_attached'] = $t_row['date_attached'];
 877 		$t_tag_info_rows[] = $t_tag_data;
 878 	}
 879 	usort( $t_tag_info_rows, 'tag_cmp_name' );
 880 	return $t_tag_info_rows;
 881 }

 883 /**
 884  * Return an array of bugs that a tag is attached to.

 890 function tag_get_bugs_attached( $p_tag_id ) {

 893 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_tag_id ) );
 894 
 895 	$t_bugs = array();
 896 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 897 		$t_bugs[] = $t_row['bug_id'];
 898 	}
 899 
 900 	return $t_bugs;
 901 }
