 903 /**
 904  * Attach a tag to a bug.
 905  *
 906  * @param int $p_tag_id  The tag ID to attach.
 907  * @param int $p_bug_id  The bug ID to attach.
 908  * @param int $p_user_id The user ID to attach.
 909  *
 910  * @return bool
 911  * @throws ClientException
 912  */
 913 function tag_bug_attach( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id, $p_user_id = null ) {
 914 	antispam_check();
 915 
 916 	access_ensure_bug_level( config_get( 'tag_attach_threshold' ), $p_bug_id, $p_user_id );
 917 
 918 	tag_ensure_exists( $p_tag_id );
 919 
 920 	if( tag_bug_is_attached( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id ) ) {
 921 		trigger_error( ERROR_TAG_ALREADY_ATTACHED, ERROR );
 922 	}
 923 
 924 	if( null == $p_user_id ) {
 925 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 926 	} else {
 927 		user_ensure_exists( $p_user_id );
 928 	}
 929 
 930 	db_param_push();
 931 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {bug_tag}
 932 					( tag_id, bug_id, user_id, date_attached )
 933 					VALUES
 934 					( ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ')';
 935 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id, $p_user_id, db_now() ) );
 936 
 937 	tag_clear_cache_bug_tags( $p_bug_id );
 938 
 939 	$t_tag_name = tag_get_field( $p_tag_id, 'name' );
 940 	history_log_event_special( $p_bug_id, TAG_ATTACHED, $t_tag_name );
 941 
 942 	# updated the last_updated date
 943 	bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
 944 
 945 	return true;
 946 }
 947 
 948 /**
 949  * Detach a tag from a bug.
 950  *
 951  * @param int  $p_tag_id      The tag ID to detach.
 952  * @param int  $p_bug_id      The bug ID to detach.
 953  * @param bool $p_add_history Add history entries to bug.
 954  * @param int  $p_user_id     User Id (or null for current logged in user).
 955  *
 956  * @return bool
 957  * @throws ClientException
 958  */
 959 function tag_bug_detach( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id, $p_add_history = true, $p_user_id = null ) {
 960 	if( $p_user_id === null ) {
 961 		$t_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 962 	} else {
 963 		$t_user_id = $p_user_id;
 964 	}
 965 
 966 	if( !tag_bug_is_attached( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id ) ) {
 967 		trigger_error( ERROR_TAG_NOT_ATTACHED, ERROR );
 968 	}
 969 
 970 	$t_tag_row = tag_bug_get_row( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id );
 971 	if( $t_user_id == tag_get_field( $p_tag_id, 'user_id' ) || $t_user_id == $t_tag_row['user_id'] ) {
 972 		$t_detach_level = config_get( 'tag_detach_own_threshold' );
 973 	} else {
 974 		$t_detach_level = config_get( 'tag_detach_threshold' );
 975 	}
 976 
 977 	if( !access_has_bug_level( $t_detach_level, $p_bug_id, $t_user_id ) ) {
 978 		throw new ClientException(
 979 			sprintf( "Access denied to detach '%s'", $t_tag_row['name'] ),
 980 			ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED
 981 		);
 982 	}
 983 
 984 	db_param_push();
 985 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {bug_tag} WHERE tag_id=' . db_param() . ' AND bug_id=' . db_param();
 986 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_tag_id, $p_bug_id ) );
 987 
 988 	tag_clear_cache_bug_tags( $p_bug_id );
 989 
 990 	if( $p_add_history ) {
 991 		$t_tag_name = tag_get_field( $p_tag_id, 'name' );
 992 		history_log_event_special( $p_bug_id, TAG_DETACHED, $t_tag_name );
 993 	}
 994 
 995 	# updated the last_updated date
 996 	bug_update_date( $p_bug_id );
 997 
 998 	return true;
 999 }
1000 
1001 /**
1002  * Detach all tags from a given bug.
1003  *
1004  * @param int  $p_bug_id      The bug ID to detach.
1005  * @param bool $p_add_history Add history entries to bug.
1006  * @param int  $p_user_id     User Id (or null for current logged in user).
1007  *
1008  * @return void
1009  * @throws ClientException
1010  */
1011 function tag_bug_detach_all( $p_bug_id, $p_add_history = true, $p_user_id = null ) {
1012 	$t_tags = tag_bug_get_attached( $p_bug_id );
1013 	foreach( $t_tags as $t_tag_row ) {
1014 		tag_bug_detach( $t_tag_row['id'], $p_bug_id, $p_add_history, $p_user_id );
1015 	}
1016 }

1018 /**
1019  * Builds a hyperlink to the Tag Detail page.
1020  *
1021  * @param array $p_tag_row Tag row.
1022  *
1023  * @return string
1024  */
1025 function tag_get_link( array $p_tag_row ) {
1026 	/** @noinspection HtmlUnknownTarget */
1027 	return sprintf(
1028 		'<a class="btn btn-xs btn-primary btn-white btn-round" href="tag_view_page.php?tag_id=%s" title="%s">%s</a>',
1029 		$p_tag_row['id'],
1030 		string_display_line( $p_tag_row['description'] ),
1031 		string_display_line( $p_tag_row['name'] )
1032 	);
1033 }
1034 
1035 /**
1036  * Display a tag hyperlink.
1037  *
1038  * If a bug ID is passed, the tag link will include a detach link if the
1039  * user has appropriate privileges.
1040  *
1041  * @param array $p_tag_row Tag row.
1042  * @param int   $p_bug_id  The bug ID to display.
1043  *
1044  * @return bool
1045  */
1046 function tag_display_link( array $p_tag_row, $p_bug_id = 0 ) {
1047 	static $s_security_token = null;
1048 	if( is_null( $s_security_token ) ) {
1049 		$s_security_token = htmlspecialchars( form_security_param( 'tag_detach' ) );
1050 	}
1051 
1052 	echo tag_get_link( $p_tag_row );
1053 
1054 	if( isset( $p_tag_row['user_attached'] ) && auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_tag_row['user_attached']
1055 	 || auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_tag_row['user_id']
1056 	) {
1057 		$t_detach = config_get( 'tag_detach_own_threshold' );
1058 	} else {
1059 		$t_detach = config_get( 'tag_detach_threshold' );
1060 	}
1061 
1062 	if( $p_bug_id > 0 && access_has_bug_level( $t_detach, $p_bug_id ) ) {
1063 		$t_tooltip = string_html_specialchars( sprintf( lang_get( 'tag_detach' ), string_display_line( $p_tag_row['name'] ) ) );
1064 		$t_href = 'tag_detach.php?bug_id=' . $p_bug_id . '&amp;tag_id=' . $p_tag_row['id'] . $s_security_token;
1065 		echo ' <a class="btn btn-xs btn-primary btn-white btn-round" title="' . $t_tooltip . '" href="' . $t_href . '">';
1066 		print_icon( 'fa-times' );
1067 		echo '</a>';
1068 	}
1069 
1070 	return true;
1071 }
1072 
1073 /**
1074  * Display a list of attached tag hyperlinks separated by the configured hyperlinks.
1075  *
1076  * @param int $p_bug_id The bug ID to display.
1077  *
1078  * @return bool
1079  */
1080 function tag_display_attached( $p_bug_id ) {
1081 	$t_tag_rows = tag_bug_get_attached( $p_bug_id );
1082 
1083 	if( count( $t_tag_rows ) == 0 ) {
1084 		echo lang_get( 'tag_none_attached' );
1085 	} else {
1086 		$i = 0;
1087 		foreach( $t_tag_rows as $t_tag ) {
1088 			echo( $i > 0 ? config_get( 'tag_separator' ) . ' ' : '' );
1089 			tag_display_link( $t_tag, $p_bug_id );
1090 			$i++;
1091 		}
1092 	}
1093 
1094 	return true;
1095 }
1096 
1097 /**
1098  * Get all attached tags separated by the Tag Separator.
1099  *
1100  * @param int $p_bug_id The bug ID to display.
1101  *
1102  * @return string tags separated by the configured Tag Separator.
1103  */
1104 function tag_bug_get_all( $p_bug_id ) {
1105 	$t_tag_rows = tag_bug_get_attached( $p_bug_id );
1106 	$t_value = '';
1107 
1108 	$i = 0;
1109 	foreach( $t_tag_rows as $t_tag ) {
1110 		$t_value .= ( $i > 0 ? config_get( 'tag_separator' ) . ' ' : '' );
1111 		$t_value .= $t_tag['name'];
1112 		$i++;
1113 	}
1114 
1115 	return $t_value;
1116 }
1117 
1118 /**
1119  * Get the number of bugs a given tag is attached to.
1120  *
1121  * @param int $p_tag_id The tag ID to retrieve statistics on.
1122  *
1123  * @return int Number of attached bugs.
1124  */
1125 function tag_stats_attached( $p_tag_id ) {
1126 	db_param_push();
1127 	$t_query = 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {bug_tag} WHERE tag_id=' . db_param();
1128 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_tag_id ) );
1129 
1130 	return db_result( $t_result );
1131 }
1132 
1133 /**
1134  * Get a list of related tags.
1135  *
1136  * Returns a list of tags that are the most related to the given tag,
1137  * based on the number of times they have been attached to the same bugs.
1138  *
1139  * @param int $p_tag_id The tag ID to retrieve statistics on.
1140  * @param int $p_limit  List size, defaults to 5 (0 = no limit).
1141  *
1142  * @return array Array of tag rows, with share count added.
1143  */
1144 function tag_stats_related( $p_tag_id, $p_limit = 5 ) {
1145 
1146 	# Use a filter to get all visible issues for this tag id
1147 	$t_filter = array(
1148 		FILTER_PROPERTY_HIDE_STATUS => array( META_FILTER_NONE ),
1149 		FILTER_PROPERTY_TAG_SELECT => $p_tag_id,
1150 		FILTER_PROPERTY_PROJECT_ID => array( ALL_PROJECTS ),
1151 		'_view_type' => FILTER_VIEW_TYPE_ADVANCED,
1152 	);
1153 	$t_filter = filter_ensure_valid_filter( $t_filter );
1154 
1155 	$t_filter_subquery = new BugFilterQuery( $t_filter, BugFilterQuery::QUERY_TYPE_IDS );
1156 
1157 	$t_sql = 'SELECT tag_id, COUNT(1) AS tag_count FROM {bug_tag}'
1158 			. ' WHERE bug_id IN :filter AND tag_id <> :tagid'
1159 			. ' GROUP BY tag_id ORDER BY tag_count DESC';
1160 	$t_query = new DbQuery( $t_sql );
1161 	if( $p_limit > 0 ) {
1162 		$t_query->set_limit( $p_limit );
1163 	}
1164 	$t_query->bind( 'filter', $t_filter_subquery );
1165 	$t_query->bind( 'tagid', (int)$p_tag_id );
1166 	$t_query->execute();
1167 
1168 	$t_tags = array();
1169 	while( $t_row = $t_query->fetch() ) {
1170 		$t_tag_row = tag_get( $t_row['tag_id'] );
1171 		$t_tag_row['count'] = (int)$t_row['tag_count'];
1172 		$t_tags[] = $t_tag_row;
1173 	}
1174 
1175 	return $t_tags;
1176 }

  17 /**
  18  * Tokens API
  19  *
  20  * This implements temporary storage of strings.
  21  * DB schema: id, type, owner, timestamp, value
  22  *
  23  * @package CoreAPI
  24  * @subpackage TokensAPI

  30  * @uses constant_inc.php
  31  * @uses database_api.php
  32  */
  33 
  34 require_api( 'authentication_api.php' );
  35 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  36 require_api( 'database_api.php' );
  37 
  38 # Set up global for token_purge_expired_once()
  39 $g_tokens_purged = false;
  40 
  41 /**
  42  * Check if a token exists.
  43  * @param integer $p_token_id A token identifier.
  44  * @return boolean True if token exists
  45  */
  46 function token_exists( $p_token_id ) {
  47 	db_param_push();
  48 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {tokens} WHERE id=' . db_param();
  49 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_token_id ), 1 );
  50 
  51 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
  52 	if( $t_row ) {
  53 		return true;
  54 	}
  55 	return false;
  56 }
  57 
  58 /**
  59  * Make sure a token exists.
  60  * @param integer $p_token_id A token identifier.
  61  * @return boolean True if token exists
  62  */
  63 function token_ensure_exists( $p_token_id ) {
  64 	if( !token_exists( $p_token_id ) ) {
  65 		trigger_error( ERROR_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
  66 	}
  67 
  68 	return true;
  69 }
  70 
  71 /**
  72  * Get a token's information
  73  * @param integer $p_type    The token type to retrieve.
  74  * @param integer $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
  75  * @return array|null Token row
  76  */
  77 function token_get( $p_type, $p_user_id = null ) {
  78 	token_purge_expired_once();
  79 
  80 	$c_type = (int)$p_type;
  81 	$c_user_id = (int)( $p_user_id == null ? auth_get_current_user_id() : $p_user_id );
  82 
  83 	db_param_push();
  84 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {tokens} WHERE type=' . db_param() . ' AND owner=' . db_param();
  85 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_type, $c_user_id ) );
  86 
  87 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
  88 	if( $t_row ) {
  89 		return $t_row;
  90 	}
  91 
  92 	return null;
  93 }
  94 
  95 /**
  96  * Get all tokens of a given type.
  97  *
  98  * @param int $p_type The token type to retrieve.
  99  *
 100  * @return array Token rows
 101  */
 102 function token_get_by_type( int $p_type ) {
 103 	token_purge_expired_once();
 104 
 105 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 106 	$t_query->sql( 'SELECT * FROM {tokens} WHERE type=' . $t_query->param( $p_type ) );
 107 	return $t_query->fetch_all();
 108 }
 109 
 110 /**
 111  * Get a token's value or null if not found
 112  * @param integer $p_type    The token type to retrieve.
 113  * @param integer $p_user_id The user identifier (null for current user).
 114  * @return string Token value
 115  */
 116 function token_get_value( $p_type, $p_user_id = null ) {
 117 	$t_token = token_get( $p_type, $p_user_id );
 118 
 119 	if( null !== $t_token ) {
 120 		return $t_token['value'];
 121 	}
 122 
 123 	return null;
 124 }
 125 
 126 /**
 127  * Create or update a token's value and expiration
 128  * @param integer $p_type    The token type.
 129  * @param string  $p_value   The token value.
 130  * @param integer $p_expiry  Token expiration in seconds.
 131  * @param integer $p_user_id A user identifier.
 132  * @return int Token ID
 133  */
 134 function token_set( $p_type, $p_value, $p_expiry = TOKEN_EXPIRY, $p_user_id = null ) {
 135 	$t_token = token_get( $p_type, $p_user_id );
 136 	if( $t_token === null ) {
 137 		return token_create( $p_type, $p_value, $p_expiry, $p_user_id );
 138 	}
 139 
 140 	token_update( $t_token['id'], $p_value, $p_expiry );
 141 	return $t_token['id'];
 142 }
 143 
 144 /**
 145  * Touch a token to update its expiration time.
 146  * @param integer $p_token_id A token identifier.
 147  * @param integer $p_expiry   Token expiration in seconds.
 148  * @return void
 149  */
 150 function token_touch( $p_token_id, $p_expiry = TOKEN_EXPIRY ) {
 151 	token_ensure_exists( $p_token_id );
 152 
 153 	$c_token_expiry = time() + $p_expiry;
 154 	db_param_push();
 155 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {tokens} SET expiry=' . db_param() . ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
 156 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_token_expiry, $p_token_id ) );
 157 }
 158 
 159 /**
 160  * Delete a token.
 161  * @param integer $p_type    The token type.
 162  * @param integer $p_user_id A user identifier or null for current logged in user.
 163  * @return void
 164  */
 165 function token_delete( $p_type, $p_user_id = null ) {
 166 	if( $p_user_id == null ) {
 167 		$c_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 168 	} else {
 169 		$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 170 	}
 171 
 172 	db_param_push();
 173 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {tokens} WHERE type=' . db_param() . ' AND owner=' . db_param();
 174 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_type, $c_user_id ) );
 175 }
 176 
 177 /**
 178  * Delete all tokens owned by a specified user.
 179  * @param integer $p_user_id A user identifier or null for current logged in user.
 180  * @return void
 181  */
 182 function token_delete_by_owner( $p_user_id = null ) {
 183 	if( $p_user_id == null ) {
 184 		$c_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 185 	} else {
 186 		$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 187 	}
 188 
 189 	db_param_push();
 190 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {tokens} WHERE owner=' . db_param();
 191 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_user_id ) );
 192 }
 193 
 194 /**
 195  * Create a token.
 196  * @param integer $p_type    The token type.
 197  * @param string  $p_value   The token value.
 198  * @param integer $p_expiry  Token expiration in seconds.
 199  * @param integer $p_user_id The user identifier to link the token to.
 200  * @return int Token ID
 201  */
 202 function token_create( $p_type, $p_value, $p_expiry = TOKEN_EXPIRY, $p_user_id = null ) {
 203 	if( $p_user_id == null ) {
 204 		$c_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
 205 	} else {
 206 		$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 207 	}
 208 
 209 	$c_type = (int)$p_type;
 210 	$c_timestamp = db_now();
 211 	$c_expiry = time() + $p_expiry;
 212 
 213 	db_param_push();
 214 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {tokens}
 215 					( type, value, timestamp, expiry, owner )
 216 					VALUES ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
 217 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_type, (string)$p_value, $c_timestamp, $c_expiry, $c_user_id ) );
 218 	return db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'tokens' ) );
 219 }
 220 
 221 /**
 222  * Update a token
 223  * @param integer $p_token_id A token identifier.
 224  * @param string  $p_value    The new token value.
 225  * @param integer $p_expiry   Token expiration in seconds.
 226  * @return boolean always true.
 227  */
 228 function token_update( $p_token_id, $p_value, $p_expiry = TOKEN_EXPIRY ) {
 229 	token_ensure_exists( $p_token_id );
 230 	$c_token_id = (int)$p_token_id;
 231 	$c_expiry = time() + $p_expiry;
 232 
 233 	db_param_push();
 234 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {tokens}
 235 					SET value=' . db_param() . ', expiry=' . db_param() . '
 236 					WHERE id=' . db_param();
 237 	db_query( $t_query, array( (string)$p_value, $c_expiry, $c_token_id ) );
 238 
 239 	return true;
 240 }
 241 
 242 /**
 243  * Delete all tokens of a specified type.
 244  * @param integer $p_token_type The token type.
 245  * @return boolean always true.
 246  */
 247 function token_delete_by_type( $p_token_type ) {
 248 	db_param_push();
 249 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {tokens} WHERE type=' . db_param();
 250 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_token_type ) );
 251 
 252 	return true;
 253 }
 254 
 255 /**
 256  * Purge all expired tokens.
 257  * @param integer $p_token_type The token type.
 258  * @return boolean always true.
 259  */
 260 function token_purge_expired( $p_token_type = null ) {
 261 	global $g_tokens_purged;
 262 
 263 	db_param_push();
 264 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {tokens} WHERE ' . db_param() . ' > expiry';
 265 	if( !is_null( $p_token_type ) ) {
 266 		$t_query .= ' AND type=' . db_param();
 267 		db_query( $t_query, array( db_now(), (int)$p_token_type ) );
 268 	} else {
 269 		db_query( $t_query, array( db_now() ) );
 270 	}
 271 
 272 	$g_tokens_purged = true;
 273 
 274 	return true;
 275 }
 276 
 277 /**
 278  * Purge all expired tokens only once per session.
 279  * @return void
 280  */
 281 function token_purge_expired_once() {
 282 	global $g_tokens_purged;
 283 	if( !$g_tokens_purged ) {
 284 		token_purge_expired();
 285 	}
 286 }

  17 /**
  18  * User API
  19  *
  20  * @package CoreAPI
  21  * @subpackage UserAPI
  22  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  23  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net

  30  * @uses database_api.php

  33  * @uses filter_api.php
  34  * @uses helper_api.php
  35  * @uses lang_api.php
  36  * @uses ldap_api.php
  37  * @uses project_api.php
  38  * @uses project_hierarchy_api.php
  39  * @uses string_api.php
  40  * @uses user_pref_api.php
  41  * @uses utility_api.php
  42  */
  43 
  44 require_api( 'access_api.php' );
  45 require_api( 'authentication_api.php' );
  46 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  47 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  48 require_api( 'database_api.php' );
  49 require_api( 'email_api.php' );
  50 require_api( 'error_api.php' );
  51 require_api( 'filter_api.php' );
  52 require_api( 'helper_api.php' );
  53 require_api( 'lang_api.php' );
  54 require_api( 'ldap_api.php' );
  55 require_api( 'project_api.php' );
  56 require_api( 'project_hierarchy_api.php' );
  57 require_api( 'string_api.php' );
  58 require_api( 'user_pref_api.php' );
  59 require_api( 'utility_api.php' );
  60 
  61 use Mantis\Exceptions\ClientException;
  62 
  63 # Cache of user rows from {user} table, indexed by user_id
  64 # If id does not exists, a value of 'false' is stored
  65 $g_cache_user = array();
  66 
  67 $g_user_accessible_subprojects_cache = null;
  68 
  69 /**
  70  * Cache a user row if necessary and return the cached copy.
  71  *
  72  * If the second parameter is true (default), trigger an error
  73  * if the user can't be found.  If the second parameter is
  74  * false, return false if the user can't be found.
  75  *
  76  * @param int $p_user_id         A valid user identifier.
  77  * @param bool $p_trigger_errors Trigger an error is the user does not exist.
  78  *
  79  * @return array|false array of database data or false if not found
  80  * @throws ClientException
  81  */
  82 function user_cache_row( $p_user_id, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
  83 	global $g_cache_user;
  84 
  85 	$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
  86 
  87 	if( !isset( $g_cache_user[$c_user_id] ) ) {
  88 		user_cache_array_rows( array( $c_user_id ) );
  89 
  90 		/** @noinspection PhpConditionAlreadyCheckedInspection */
  91 		if( !isset( $g_cache_user[$c_user_id] ) ) {
  92 			if( $p_trigger_errors ) {
  93 				throw new ClientException(
  94 					sprintf( "User id '%d' not found.", (int)$p_user_id ),
  95 					ERROR_USER_BY_ID_NOT_FOUND,
  96 					array( (int)$p_user_id )
  97 				);
  98 			}
  99 
 100 			return false;
 101 		}
 102 	}
 103 
 104 	return $g_cache_user[$c_user_id];
 105 }
 106 
 107 /**
 108  * Loads user rows in cache for a set of User ID's.
 109  * 
 110  * Store false if the user does not exists
 111  * 
 112  * @param array $p_user_id_array An array of user identifiers.
 113  *                               
 114  * @return void
 115  */
 116 function user_cache_array_rows( array $p_user_id_array ) {
 117 	global $g_cache_user;
 118 	$c_user_id_array = array();
 119 
 120 	foreach( $p_user_id_array as $t_user_id ) {
 121 		if( !isset( $g_cache_user[(int)$t_user_id] ) ) {
 122 			$c_user_id_array[(int)$t_user_id] = (int)$t_user_id;
 123 		}
 124 	}
 125 	if( empty( $c_user_id_array ) ) {
 126 		return;
 127 	}
 128 
 129 	db_param_push();
 130 	$t_params = array();
 131 	$t_sql_in_params = array();
 132 	foreach( $c_user_id_array as $t_id ) {
 133 		$t_params[] = $t_id;
 134 		$t_sql_in_params[] = db_param();
 135 	}
 136 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {user} WHERE id IN (' . implode( ',', $t_sql_in_params ) . ')';
 137 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_params );
 138 
 139 	if( $t_result !== false ) {
 140 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 141 			$c_user_id = (int)$t_row['id'];
 142 			$g_cache_user[$c_user_id] = $t_row;
 143 			unset( $c_user_id_array[$c_user_id] );
 144 		}
 145 		# set the remaining ids to false as not-found
 146 		foreach( $c_user_id_array as $t_id ) {
 147 			$g_cache_user[$t_id] = false;
 148 		}
 149 	}
 150 }

 185 /**

 188  * @param int $p_user_id A valid user id to update.
 189  * @param string  $p_field   The name of the field on the user object to update.
 190  * @param mixed   $p_value   The updated value for the user object field.
 191  *
 192  * @return void
 193  */
 194 function user_update_cache( $p_user_id, $p_field, $p_value ) {
 195 	global $g_cache_user;
 196 
 197 	if( isset( $g_cache_user[$p_user_id][$p_field] ) ) {

 204 /**
 205  * Searches the cache for a given field and value pair.
 206  *
 207  * Returns the first user id that matches.
 208  *
 209  * @param string $p_field The user object field name to search the cache for.
 210  * @param mixed  $p_value The field value to look for in the cache.
 211  * @param bool   $p_case_sensitive False to perform case-insensitive search; defaults to true.
 212  *
 213  * @return array|bool User Id, false if not found
 214  */
 215 function user_search_cache( $p_field, $p_value, $p_case_sensitive = true ) {
 216 	global $g_cache_user;
 217 	if( isset( $g_cache_user ) ) {
 218 		$t_compare = $p_case_sensitive ? 'strcmp' : 'strcasecmp';
 219 		$t_value = $p_value ?? '';
 220 		foreach( $g_cache_user as $t_user ) {
 221 			if( $t_user && 0 == $t_compare( $t_user[$p_field], $t_value ) ) {
 222 				return $t_user;
 223 			}
 224 		}
 225 	}
 226 	return false;
 227 }

 308 /**
 309  * Returns a list of duplicate email addresses (case-insensitive).
 310  *
 311  * Each array entry's key is the lowercase e-mail address, and the value is an array
 312  * listing the associated user accounts, with key=id and value=username.
 313  *
 314  * Note that the complex query used by this function is quite expensive (average
 315  * execution time of about 0.3 seconds for 50K users with 1000 duplicates).
 316  *
 317  * @return array
 318  */
 319 function user_get_duplicate_emails() {
 320 	static $s_duplicate_emails;
 321 
 322 	if( $s_duplicate_emails === null ) {
 323 		$t_user_table = db_get_table( 'user' );
 324 
 325 		# Using a sub-query within the IN clause's SELECT statement, as a workaround for
 326 		# MySQL >= 5.7 with sql_mode=only_full_group_by throwing ERROR 1055 (42000):
 327 		# Expression #1 of HAVING clause is not in GROUP BY clause
 328 		$t_sql = <<< ENDSQL
 329 SELECT lower(email) email, id, username
 330 FROM {$t_user_table} 
 331 WHERE lower(email) IN (
 332 	SELECT email 
 333 	FROM (
 334 		SELECT lower(email) AS email, COUNT(*) AS mycount
 335 		FROM {$t_user_table}
 336 		GROUP BY lower(email) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
 337 		) tmp
 338 	)
 339 ORDER BY lower(email), username
 340 ENDSQL;
 341 		$t_query = new DbQuery( $t_sql );
 342 		$t_rows = $t_query->fetch_all();
 343 
 344 		$s_duplicate_emails = array();
 345 		if( $t_rows ) {
 346 			foreach( $t_rows as $t_row ) {
 347 				/**
 348 				 * @var int $v_id
 349 				 * @var string $v_email
 350 				 * @var string $v_username
 351 				 */
 352 				extract( $t_row, EXTR_PREFIX_ALL, 'v' );
 353 				$s_duplicate_emails[$v_email][$v_id] = $v_username;
 354 			}
 355 		}
 356 	}
 357 
 358 	return $s_duplicate_emails;
 359 }

 361 /**
 362  * Checks if the email address is unique.
 363  *
 364  * Note on performance: this function's execution time is about 0.05 seconds.
 365  * If it must be called multiple times in a given page, it is generally more
 366  * efficient to adopt a global approach and check for duplicates instead
 367  * {@see user_get_duplicate_emails()}.
 368  *
 369  * @param string $p_email   The email to check.
 370  * @param int    $p_user_id The user id that we are validating for or null for
 371  *                          the case of a new user.
 372  *
 373  * @return bool true: unique or blank, false: otherwise
 374  */
 375 function user_is_email_unique( $p_email, $p_user_id = null ) {
 376 	if( is_blank( $p_email ) ) {
 377 		return true;
 378 	}
 379 
 380 	$p_email = trim( $p_email );
 381 	// Escape SQL LIKE pattern chars to ensure exact match
 382 	$p_email = preg_replace( '/([%_])/', '\\\\$1', $p_email );
 383 
 384 	$t_query = new DbQuery;
 385 	$t_query->sql( 'SELECT email FROM {user} WHERE '
 386 		// Case-insensitive like
 387 		. $t_query->sql_ilike( 'email', $p_email, '\\' )
 388 	);
 389 	if( $p_user_id !== null ) {
 390 		$t_query->append_sql( ' AND id<>' . $t_query->param( $p_user_id ) );
 391 	}
 392 
 393 	$t_query->execute();
 394 	return !$t_query->value();
 395 }
 396

 419 /**
 420  * Check if the username is a valid username.
 421  *
 422  * Does not account for uniqueness.
 423  *
 424  * @param string $p_username The username to check.
 425  *
 426  * @return bool true if username is valid, false otherwise
 427  */
 428 function user_is_name_valid( $p_username ) {
 429 	# The DB field is hard-coded. DB_FIELD_SIZE_USERNAME should not be modified.
 430 	if( mb_strlen( $p_username ) > DB_FIELD_SIZE_USERNAME ) {
 431 		return false;
 432 	}
 433 
 434 	# username must consist of at least one character
 435 	if( is_blank( $p_username ) ) {
 436 		return false;
 437 	}
 438 
 439 	# Only allow a basic set of characters
 440 	if( 0 == preg_match( config_get( 'user_login_valid_regex' ), $p_username ) ) {
 441 		return false;
 442 	}
 443 
 444 	# We have a valid username
 445 	return true;
 446 }

 593 /**
 594  * Return an array of user ids that are logged in.
 595  *
 596  * A user is considered logged in if the last visit timestamp is within the
 597  * specified session duration.
 598  *
 599  * If the session duration is 0, then no users will be returned.
 600  *
 601  * @param int $p_session_duration_in_minutes The duration to return logged in users for.
 602  *
 603  * @return array
 604  * @noinspection PhpUnused
 605  */
 606 function user_get_logged_in_user_ids( $p_session_duration_in_minutes ) {
 607 	$t_session_duration_in_minutes = (int)$p_session_duration_in_minutes;
 608 
 609 	# if session duration is 0, then there is no logged in users.
 610 	if( $t_session_duration_in_minutes == 0 ) {
 611 		return array();
 612 	}
 613 
 614 	# Generate timestamp
 615 	$t_last_timestamp_threshold = mktime(
 616 		date( 'H' ), date( 'i' ) - $t_session_duration_in_minutes, date( 's' ),
 617 		date( 'm' ), date( 'd' ), date( 'Y' )
 618 	);
 619 
 620 	# Execute query
 621 	db_param_push();
 622 	$t_query = 'SELECT id FROM {user} WHERE last_visit > ' . db_param();
 623 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $t_last_timestamp_threshold ), 1 );
 624 
 625 	# Get the list of connected users
 626 	$t_users_connected = array();
 627 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 628 		$t_users_connected[] = (int)$t_row['id'];
 629 	}
 630 
 631 	return $t_users_connected;
 632 }

 634 /**
 635  * Create a user.
 636  *
 637  * @param string $p_username     A valid username.
 638  * @param string $p_password     The password to set for the user.
 639  * @param string $p_email        The Email Address of the user.
 640  * @param int    $p_access_level The global access level for the user.
 641  * @param bool   $p_protected    Whether the account is protected from modifications (default false).
 642  * @param bool   $p_enabled      Whether the account is enabled.
 643  * @param string $p_realname     The realname of the user.
 644  * @param string $p_admin_name   The name of the administrator creating the account.
 645  *
 646  * @return string Cookie String
 647  * @throws ClientException if error
 648  */
 649 function user_create( $p_username, $p_password, $p_email = '',
 650 	$p_access_level = null, $p_protected = false, $p_enabled = true,
 651 	$p_realname = '', $p_admin_name = '' ) {
 652 	if( null === $p_access_level ) {
 653 		$p_access_level = config_get( 'default_new_account_access_level' );
 654 	}
 655 
 656 	$t_password = auth_process_plain_password( $p_password );
 657 
 658 	$c_enabled = (bool)$p_enabled;
 659 
 660 	user_ensure_name_valid( $p_username );
 661 	user_ensure_name_unique( $p_username );
 662 	user_ensure_email_unique( $p_email );
 663 	email_ensure_valid( $p_email );
 664 	email_ensure_not_disposable( $p_email );
 665 
 666 	$t_cookie_string = auth_generate_unique_cookie_string();
 667 
 668 	db_param_push();
 669 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {user}
 670 				    ( username, email, password, date_created, last_visit,
 671 				     enabled, access_level, login_count, cookie_string, realname )
 672 				  VALUES
 673 				    ( ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param()  . ',
 674 				     ' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ',' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ')';
 675 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_username, $p_email, $t_password, db_now(), db_now(), $c_enabled, (int)$p_access_level, 0, $t_cookie_string, $p_realname ) );
 676 
 677 	# Create preferences for the user
 678 	$t_user_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'user' ) );
 679 
 680 	# Users are added with protected set to FALSE in order to be able to update
 681 	# preferences.  Now set the real value of protected.
 682 	if( $p_protected ) {
 683 		user_set_field( $t_user_id, 'protected', (bool)$p_protected );
 684 	}
 685 
 686 	# Send notification email
 687 	if( !is_blank( $p_email ) ) {
 688 		$t_confirm_hash = auth_generate_confirm_hash( $t_user_id );
 689 		token_set( TOKEN_ACCOUNT_ACTIVATION, $t_confirm_hash, TOKEN_EXPIRY_ACCOUNT_ACTIVATION, $t_user_id );
 690 		email_signup( $t_user_id, $t_confirm_hash, $p_admin_name );
 691 	}
 692 
 693 	event_signal( 'EVENT_MANAGE_USER_CREATE', array( $t_user_id ) );
 694 
 695 	return $t_cookie_string;
 696 }
 697 
 698 /**
 699  * Signup a user.
 700  *
 701  * If the use_ldap_email config option is on then tries to find email using
 702  * ldap. $p_email may be empty, but the user won't get any emails.
 703  *
 704  * @param string $p_username The username to sign up.
 705  * @param string $p_email    The email address of the user signing up.
 706  *
 707  * @return string Cookie string or false on error
 708  * @throws ClientException
 709  */
 710 function user_signup( $p_username, $p_email = null ) {
 711 	if( null === $p_email ) {
 712 		$p_email = '';
 713 
 714 		# @@@ I think the ldap_email stuff is a bit borked
 715 		#  Where is it being set?  When is it being used?
 716 		#  Shouldn't we override an email that is passed in here?
 717 		#  If the user doesn't exist in ldap, is the account created?
 718 		#  If so, there password won't get set anywhere...  (etc)
 719 		#  RJF: I was going to check for the existence of an LDAP email.
 720 		#  however, since we can't create an LDAP account at the moment,
 721 		#  and we don't know the user password in advance, we may not be able
 722 		#  to retrieve it anyway.
 723 		#  I'll re-enable this once a plan has been properly formulated for LDAP
 724 		#  account management and creation.
 725 		#			$t_email = '';
 726 		#			if( ON == config_get_global( 'use_ldap_email' ) ) {
 727 		#				$t_email = ldap_email_from_username( $p_username );
 728 		#			}
 729 		#			if( !is_blank( $t_email ) ) {
 730 		#				$p_email = $t_email;
 731 		#			}
 732 	}
 733 
 734 	$p_email = trim( $p_email );
 735 
 736 	email_ensure_not_disposable( $p_email );
 737 	email_ensure_valid( $p_email );
 738 	user_ensure_email_unique( $p_email );
 739 
 740 	# Create random password
 741 	$t_password = auth_generate_random_password();
 742 
 743 	return user_create( $p_username, $t_password, $p_email, auth_signup_access_level() );
 744 }

 766 /**
 767  * Delete profiles for the specified user.
 768  *
 769  * @param int $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
 770  *
 771  * @return true
 772  * @throws ClientException if user is protected
 773  */
 774 function user_delete_profiles( $p_user_id ) {
 775 	user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
 776 
 777 	# Remove associated profiles
 778 	db_param_push();
 779 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {user_profile} WHERE user_id=' . db_param();
 780 	db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_user_id ) );
 781 
 782 	user_clear_cache( $p_user_id );
 783 
 784 	return true;
 785 }
 786 
 787 /**
 788  * Delete a user account.
 789  *
 790  * Related information is also deleted (profiles, preferences, project-specific
 791  * access levels).
 792  *
 793  * @param int $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
 794  *
 795  * @return true
 796  * @throws ClientException if user is protected or error occurred
 797  */
 798 function user_delete( $p_user_id ) {
 799 	$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 800 
 801 	user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
 802 
 803 	event_signal( 'EVENT_MANAGE_USER_DELETE', array( $p_user_id ) );
 804 
 805 	# Remove associated profiles
 806 	user_delete_profiles( $p_user_id );
 807 
 808 	# Remove associated preferences
 809 	user_pref_db_delete_user( $p_user_id );
 810 
 811 	# Remove project specific access levels
 812 	user_delete_project_specific_access_levels( $p_user_id );
 813 	user_clear_cache( $p_user_id );
 814 
 815 	# Revoke all API tokens
 816 	api_token_revoke_all( $p_user_id );
 817 
 818 	# Remove account
 819 	db_param_push();
 820 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {user} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 821 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_user_id ) );
 822 
 823 	return true;
 824 }

 831  *
 832  * @return int|false User Id or false if the username does not exist.
 833  * @throws ClientException
 834  */
 835 function user_get_id_by_name( $p_username, $p_throw = false ) {
 836 	if( $t_user = user_search_cache( 'username', $p_username ) ) {
 837 		return (int)$t_user['id'];
 838 	}
 839 
 840 	db_param_push();
 841 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {user} WHERE username=' . db_param();
 842 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_username ) );
 843 
 844 	$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 845 	if( $t_row ) {
 846 		user_cache_database_result( $t_row );
 847 		return (int)$t_row['id'];
 848 	}
 849 
 850 	if( $p_throw ) {
 851 		throw new ClientException(
 852 			"Username '$p_username' not found",
 853 			ERROR_USER_BY_NAME_NOT_FOUND,
 854 			array( $p_username ) );

 856

 860 /**
 861  * Get a user's id from their email address.
 862  *
 863  * The check is case insensitive.
 864  *
 865  * This function should not be used when {@see $g_email_ensure_unique} is OFF:
 866  * if there are multiple users found matching the given email, the function will
 867  * not consider that to be an error, and arbitrarily return one of them (exactly
 868  * which one is undetermined).
 869  *
 870  * @param string $p_email The email address to retrieve data for.
 871  * @param bool   $p_throw True to throw exception when not found, false otherwise.
 872  *
 873  * @return int|false User Id or false if the email does not exist.
 874  * @throws ClientException
 875  */
 876 function user_get_id_by_email( $p_email, $p_throw = false ) {
 877 	if( $t_user = user_search_cache( 'email', $p_email, false ) ) {
 878 		return (int)$t_user['id'];
 879 	}
 880 
 881 	// Escape SQL LIKE pattern chars to ensure exact match
 882 	$p_email = preg_replace( '/([%_])/', '\\\\$1', $p_email );
 883 
 884 	$t_query = new DbQuery;
 885 	$t_query->sql( 'SELECT * FROM {user} WHERE '
 886 		// Case-insensitive like
 887 		. $t_query->sql_ilike( 'email', $p_email, '\\' )
 888 	);
 889 	$t_row = $t_query->fetch();
 890 
 891 	if( $t_row ) {
 892 		user_cache_database_result( $t_row );
 893 		return (int)$t_row['id'];
 894 	}
 895 
 896 	if( $p_throw ) {
 897 		throw new ClientException(
 898 			"User with email '$p_email' not found",
 899 			ERROR_USER_BY_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND,
 900 			array( $p_email ) );
 901 	}
 902 
 903 	return false;
 904 }

 906 /**
 907  * Get ids of enabled users with a given email address.
 908  *
 909  * E-mail address comparison is case-insensitive.
 910  * The returned list will be sorted by higher access level first.
 911  *
 912  * @param string $p_email The email address, can be an empty string to get users
 913  *                        without an email address.
 914  *
 915  * @return array The user ids or an empty array.
 916  */
 917 function user_get_enabled_ids_by_email( $p_email ) {
 918 	db_param_push();
 919 	$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {user} '
 920 		. 'WHERE lower(email)=' . db_param()
 921 		. ' AND enabled=' . db_param()
 922 		. ' ORDER BY access_level DESC';
 923 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( strtolower( $p_email ), 1 ) );
 924 
 925 	$t_user_ids = array();
 926 	while ( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
 927 		user_cache_database_result( $t_row );
 928 		$t_user_ids[] = (int)$t_row['id'];
 929 	}
 930 
 931 	return $t_user_ids;
 932 }

1002 /**
1003  * Get a user id given user information
1004  *
1005  * Information is an array with one or more of the following keys, checked in
1006  * this order of priority: id, name, real_name, email, or name_or_realname.
1007  *
1008  * @param array $p_user The user info.
1009  * @param bool  $p_throw_if_id_not_found If id specified and doesn't exist, then throw.
1010  * @param bool  $p_allow_all_users Allow user id 0 to be returned.
1011  *
1012  * @return integer user id
1013  * @throws ClientException
1014  */
1015 function user_get_id_by_user_info( array $p_user, $p_throw_if_id_not_found = false, $p_allow_all_users = false ) {
1016 	if( isset( $p_user['id'] ) && ( $p_allow_all_users || ( (int)$p_user['id'] != 0 ) ) ) {
1017 		$t_user_id = (int)$p_user['id'];
1018 		if( $t_user_id != 0 && $p_throw_if_id_not_found && !user_exists( $t_user_id ) ) {
1019 			throw new ClientException(
1020 				sprintf( "User with id '%d' doesn't exist", $t_user_id ),
1021 				ERROR_USER_BY_ID_NOT_FOUND,
1022 				array( $t_user_id ) );
1023 		}
1024 	} else if( isset( $p_user['name'] ) && !is_blank( $p_user['name'] ) ) {
1025 		$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $p_user['name'], /* throw */ true );
1026 	} else if( isset( $p_user['email'] ) && !is_blank( $p_user['email'] ) ) {
1027 		$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_email( $p_user['email'], /* throw */ true );
1028 	} else if( isset( $p_user['real_name'] ) && !is_blank( $p_user['real_name'] ) ) {
1029 		$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_realname( $p_user['real_name'], /* throw */ true );
1030 	} else if( isset( $p_user['name_or_realname' ] ) && !is_blank( $p_user['name_or_realname' ] ) ) {
1031 		$t_identifier = $p_user['name_or_realname'];
1032 		$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_name( $t_identifier );
1033 
1034 		if( !$t_user_id ) {
1035 			$t_user_id = user_get_id_by_realname( $t_identifier );
1036 		}
1037 
1038 		if( !$t_user_id ) {
1039 			throw new ClientException(
1040 				"User '$t_identifier' not found",
1041 				ERROR_USER_BY_NAME_NOT_FOUND,
1042 				array( $t_identifier ) );
1043 		}
1044 	} else {
1045 		throw new ClientException(
1046 			"User id missing",
1047 			ERROR_GPC_VAR_NOT_FOUND,
1048 			array( 'user id' ) );
1049 	}
1050 
1051 	return $t_user_id;
1052 }

1074 /**
1075  * Return a user row.

1077  * @param int $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
1078  *
1079  * @return array
1080  * @throws ClientException
1081  */
1082 function user_get_row( $p_user_id ) {

1086 /**
1087  * Return the specified user field for the user id.
1088  *
1089  * @param int    $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
1090  * @param string $p_field_name The field name to retrieve.
1091  *
1092  * @return string
1093  * @throws ClientException
1094  */
1095 function user_get_field( $p_user_id, $p_field_name ) {
1096 	if( NO_USER == $p_user_id ) {
1097 		$t_row = false;
1098 	} else {
1099 		$t_row = user_get_row( $p_user_id );
1100 	}
1101 
1102 	if( !$t_row ) {
1103 		error_parameters( $p_user_id );
1104 		trigger_error( ERROR_USER_BY_ID_NOT_FOUND, WARNING );
1105 		return '@null@';
1106 	}
1107 
1108 	if( isset( $t_row[$p_field_name] ) ) {
1109 		switch( $p_field_name ) {
1110 			case 'access_level':
1111 				return (int)$t_row[$p_field_name];
1112 			default:
1113 				return $t_row[$p_field_name];
1114 		}
1115 	} else {
1116 		error_parameters( $p_field_name );
1117 		trigger_error( ERROR_DB_FIELD_NOT_FOUND, WARNING );
1118 		return '';
1119 	}
1120 }

1187  *   string (prefix_for_deleted_users, "user" by default);

1189  * - Otherwise, return the username

1220 /**

1223  * If user_show_realname() is true and realname is not empty then return the
1224  * realname otherwise return username.
1225  *

1227  *
1228  * @return string display name
1229  */
1230 function user_get_name_from_row( array $p_user_row ) {

1232 		if( !is_blank( $p_user_row['realname'] ) ) {
1233 			return $p_user_row['realname'];
1234 		}
1235 	}

1240 /**
1241  * Return display name.
1242  *
1243  * The format is "realname (username)" if user_show_realname() is true and
1244  * realname is not empty otherwise return username
1245  *
1246  * @param array $p_user_row The user row with 'realname' and 'username' fields
1247  *
1248  * @return string display name

1250 function user_get_expanded_name_from_row( array $p_user_row ) {
1251 	$t_name = user_get_name_from_row( $p_user_row );

1259 /**

1263  *
1264  * @return string name for sorting
1265  */
1266 function user_get_name_for_sorting_from_row( array $p_user_row ) {
1267 	if( !is_blank( $p_user_row['realname'] ) ) {
1268 		if( user_show_realname() ) {
1269 			if( config_get( 'sort_by_last_name' ) == ON ) {
1270 				$t_sort_name_bits = explode( ' ', mb_strtolower( trim( $p_user_row['realname'] ) ), 2 );
1271 				return ( isset( $t_sort_name_bits[1] ) ? $t_sort_name_bits[1] . ', ' : '' ) . $t_sort_name_bits[0];
1272 			}
1273 
1274 			return mb_strtolower( trim( $p_user_row['realname'] ) );
1275 		}
1276 	}
1277 
1278 	return mb_strtolower( $p_user_row['username'] );
1279 }

1281 /**
1282  * Return the user's access level
1283  *
1284  * Account for private project and the project user lists.
1285  *
1286  * @param int $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
1287  * @param int $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
1288  *
1289  * @return integer
1290  * @throws ClientException
1291  */
1292 function user_get_access_level( $p_user_id, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
1293 	$t_access_level = (int)user_get_field( $p_user_id, 'access_level' );
1294 
1295 	if( user_is_administrator( $p_user_id ) ) {
1296 		return $t_access_level;
1297 	}
1298 
1299 	$t_project_access_level = access_get_local_level( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
1300 
1301 	if( false === $t_project_access_level ) {
1302 		return $t_access_level;
1303 	} else {
1304 		return $t_project_access_level;
1305 	}
1306 }
1307 
1308 $g_user_accessible_projects_cache = null;
1309 
1310 /**
1311  * return an array of project IDs to which the user has access
1312  *
1313  * @param int $p_user_id       A valid user identifier.
1314  * @param bool $p_show_disabled Whether to include disabled projects in the result array.
1315  * @return array
1316  */
1317 function user_get_accessible_projects( $p_user_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
1318 	global $g_user_accessible_projects_cache;
1319 
1320 	if( null !== $g_user_accessible_projects_cache
1321 		&& auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_user_id
1322 		&& !$p_show_disabled
1323 	) {
1324 		return $g_user_accessible_projects_cache;
1325 	}
1326 
1327 	if( access_has_global_level( config_get( 'private_project_threshold' ), $p_user_id ) ) {
1328 		$t_projects = project_hierarchy_get_subprojects( ALL_PROJECTS, $p_show_disabled );
1329 	} else {
1330 		$t_public = VS_PUBLIC;
1331 		$t_private = VS_PRIVATE;
1332 
1333 		db_param_push();
1334 		$t_query = 'SELECT p.id, p.name, ph.parent_id
1335 						  FROM {project} p
1336 						  LEFT JOIN {project_user_list} u
1337 						    ON p.id=u.project_id AND u.user_id=' . db_param() . '
1338 						  LEFT JOIN {project_hierarchy} ph
1339 						    ON ph.child_id = p.id
1340 						  WHERE ' . ( $p_show_disabled ? '' : ( 'p.enabled = ' . db_param() . ' AND ' ) ) . '
1341 							( p.view_state=' . db_param() . '
1342 							    OR (p.view_state=' . db_param() . '
1343 								    AND
1344 							        u.user_id=' . db_param() . ' )
1345 							) ORDER BY p.name';
1346 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, ( $p_show_disabled ? array( $p_user_id, $t_public, $t_private, $p_user_id ) : array( $p_user_id, true, $t_public, $t_private, $p_user_id ) ) );
1347 
1348 		$t_projects = array();
1349 
1350 		while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1351 			$t_projects[(int)$t_row['id']] = ( $t_row['parent_id'] === null ) ? 0 : (int)$t_row['parent_id'];
1352 		}
1353 
1354 		# prune out children where the parents are already listed. Make the list
1355 		#  first, then prune to avoid pruning a parent before the child is found.
1356 		$t_prune = array();
1357 		foreach( $t_projects as $t_id => $t_parent ) {
1358 			if( ( $t_parent !== 0 ) && isset( $t_projects[$t_parent] ) ) {
1359 				$t_prune[] = $t_id;
1360 			}
1361 		}
1362 		foreach( $t_prune as $t_id ) {
1363 			unset( $t_projects[$t_id] );
1364 		}
1365 		$t_projects = array_keys( $t_projects );
1366 	}
1367 
1368 	if( auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_user_id ) {
1369 		$g_user_accessible_projects_cache = $t_projects;
1370 	}
1371 
1372 	return $t_projects;
1373 }
1374 
1375 /**
1376  * Get a list of a project's sub-projects to which the user has access.
1377  *
1378  * @param int $p_user_id       A valid user identifier.
1379  * @param int $p_project_id    A valid project identifier.
1380  * @param bool $p_show_disabled Include disabled projects in the resulting array.
1381  *
1382  * @return array List of project Id.
1383  */
1384 function user_get_accessible_subprojects( $p_user_id, $p_project_id, $p_show_disabled = false ) {
1385 	global $g_user_accessible_subprojects_cache;
1386 
1387 	if( null !== $g_user_accessible_subprojects_cache && auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_user_id && !$p_show_disabled ) {
1388 		return $g_user_accessible_subprojects_cache[$p_project_id] ?? array();
1389 	}
1390 
1391 	db_param_push();
1392 
1393 	if( access_has_global_level( config_get( 'private_project_threshold' ), $p_user_id ) ) {
1394 		$t_enabled_clause = $p_show_disabled ? '' : 'p.enabled = ' . db_param() . ' AND';
1395 		$t_query = 'SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, ph.parent_id
1396 					  FROM {project} p
1397 					  LEFT JOIN {project_hierarchy} ph
1398 					    ON ph.child_id = p.id
1399 					  WHERE ' . $t_enabled_clause . '
1400 					  	 ph.parent_id IS NOT NULL
1401 					  ORDER BY p.name';
1402 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, ( $p_show_disabled ? array() : array( true ) ) );
1403 	} else {
1404 		$t_query = 'SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, ph.parent_id
1405 					  FROM {project} p
1406 					  LEFT JOIN {project_user_list} u
1407 					    ON p.id = u.project_id AND u.user_id=' . db_param() . '
1408 					  LEFT JOIN {project_hierarchy} ph
1409 					    ON ph.child_id = p.id
1410 					  WHERE ' . ( $p_show_disabled ? '' : ( 'p.enabled = ' . db_param() . ' AND ' ) ) . '
1411 					  	ph.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND
1412 						( p.view_state=' . db_param() . '
1413 						    OR (p.view_state=' . db_param() . '
1414 							    AND
1415 						        u.user_id=' . db_param() . ' )
1416 						)
1417 					  ORDER BY p.name';
1418 		$t_param = array( $p_user_id, VS_PUBLIC, VS_PRIVATE, $p_user_id );
1419 		if( !$p_show_disabled ) {
1420 			# Insert enabled flag value in 2nd position of parameter array
1421 			array_splice( $t_param, 1, 0, true );
1422 		}
1423 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, $t_param );
1424 	}
1425 
1426 	$t_projects = array();
1427 
1428 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1429 		if( !isset( $t_projects[(int)$t_row['parent_id']] ) ) {
1430 			$t_projects[(int)$t_row['parent_id']] = array();
1431 		}
1432 
1433 		$t_projects[(int)$t_row['parent_id']][] = (int)$t_row['id'];
1434 	}
1435 
1436 	if( auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_user_id ) {
1437 		$g_user_accessible_subprojects_cache = $t_projects;
1438 	}
1439 
1440 	if( !isset( $t_projects[(int)$p_project_id] ) ) {
1441 		$t_projects[(int)$p_project_id] = array();
1442 	}
1443 
1444 	return $t_projects[(int)$p_project_id];
1445 }
1446 
1447 /**
1448  * return an array of sub-project IDs of all sub-projects project to which the user has access
1449  *
1450  * @param int $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
1451  * @param int $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
1452  *
1453  * @return array List of Project Ids
1454  */
1455 function user_get_all_accessible_subprojects( $p_user_id, $p_project_id ) {
1456 	# @todo (thraxisp) Should all top level projects be a sub-project of ALL_PROJECTS implicitly?
1457 	# affects how news and some summaries are generated
1458 	$t_todo = user_get_accessible_subprojects( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
1459 	$t_subprojects = array();
1460 
1461 	while( $t_todo ) {
1462 		$t_elem = (int)array_shift( $t_todo );
1463 		if( !in_array( $t_elem, $t_subprojects ) ) {
1464 			$t_subprojects[] = $t_elem;
1465 			$t_todo = array_merge( $t_todo, user_get_accessible_subprojects( $p_user_id, $t_elem ) );
1466 		}
1467 	}
1468 
1469 	return $t_subprojects;
1470 }
1471 
1472 /**
1473  * Returns an array of project and sub-project IDs of all projects to which the
1474  * user has access and that are children of the specified project.
1475  *
1476  * @param int $p_user_id    A valid user identifier or null for logged in user.
1477  * @param int $p_project_id A valid project identifier.  ALL_PROJECTS returns
1478  *                              all top level projects and sub-projects.
1479  *
1480  * @return array
1481  */
1482 function user_get_all_accessible_projects( $p_user_id = null, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
1483 	if( $p_user_id === null ) {
1484 		$p_user_id = auth_get_current_user_id();
1485 	}
1486 
1487 	if( ALL_PROJECTS == $p_project_id ) {
1488 		$t_top_projects = user_get_accessible_projects( $p_user_id );
1489 
1490 		# Create a combined array where key = value
1491 		$t_project_ids = array_combine( $t_top_projects, $t_top_projects );
1492 
1493 		# Add all subprojects user has access to
1494 		foreach( $t_top_projects as $t_project ) {
1495 			$t_subprojects_ids = user_get_all_accessible_subprojects( $p_user_id, $t_project );
1496 			foreach( $t_subprojects_ids as $t_id ) {
1497 				$t_project_ids[$t_id] = $t_id;
1498 			}
1499 		}
1500 	} else {
1501 		access_ensure_project_level( config_get( 'view_bug_threshold' ), $p_project_id );
1502 		$t_project_ids = user_get_all_accessible_subprojects( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
1503 		array_unshift( $t_project_ids, $p_project_id );
1504 	}
1505 
1506 	return $t_project_ids;
1507 }

1517 function user_get_assigned_projects( $p_user_id ) {

1535 /**
1536  * List of users that are NOT in the specified project and that are enabled.
1537  *
1538  * If no project is specified use the current project.
1539  * Administrators are excluded from the list.
1540  *
1541  * @param int $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
1542  *
1543  * @return array List of users not assigned to the specified project
1544  */
1545 function user_get_unassigned_by_project_id( $p_project_id = null ) {
1546 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
1547 		$p_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
1548 	}
1549 
1550 	$t_adm = config_get_global( 'admin_site_threshold' );
1551 	db_param_push();
1552 	$t_query = 'SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.username, u.realname
1553 				FROM {user} u
1554 				LEFT JOIN {project_user_list} p
1555 				ON p.user_id=u.id AND p.project_id=' . db_param() . '
1556 				WHERE u.access_level<' . db_param() . ' AND
1557 					u.enabled = ' . db_param() . ' AND
1558 					p.user_id IS NULL
1559 				ORDER BY u.realname, u.username';
1560 	$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $p_project_id, $t_adm, true ) );
1561 	$t_display = array();
1562 	$t_sort = array();
1563 	$t_users = array();
1564 
1565 	while( $t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result ) ) {
1566 		$t_users[] = (int)$t_row['id'];
1567 		$t_display[] = user_get_expanded_name_from_row( $t_row );
1568 		$t_sort[] = user_get_name_for_sorting_from_row( $t_row );
1569 	}
1570 
1571 	array_multisort( $t_sort, SORT_ASC, SORT_STRING, $t_users, $t_display );
1572 
1573 	$t_count = count( $t_sort );
1574 	$t_user_list = array();
1575 	for( $i = 0;$i < $t_count; $i++ ) {
1576 		$t_user_list[$t_users[$i]] = $t_display[$i];
1577 	}
1578 	return $t_user_list;
1579 }

1680 /**

1682  *
1683  * @param int $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
1684  * @param int $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
1685  *
1686  * @return array The user filter, or default filter if not valid.
1687  */
1688 function user_get_bug_filter( $p_user_id, $p_project_id = null ) {
1689 	if( null === $p_project_id ) {
1690 		$t_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
1691 	} else {
1692 		$t_project_id = $p_project_id;
1693 	}
1694 
1695 	# Currently we use the filters saved in db as "current" special filters,
1696 	# to track the active settings for filters in use.
1697 
1698 	# for anonymous user, we don't allow using persistent filter
1699 	# if this function is reached, we return a default filter for it.
1700 	if( user_is_anonymous( $p_user_id ) ) {
1701 		return filter_get_default();
1702 	}
1703 
1704 	$t_filter_id = filter_db_get_project_current( $t_project_id, $p_user_id );
1705 	if( $t_filter_id ) {
1706 		return filter_get( $t_filter_id );
1707 	} else {
1708 		return filter_get_default();
1709 	}
1710 }

1821 /**
1822  * Sets multiple fields on a user.
1823  *
1824  * @param int   $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
1825  * @param array $p_fields  Keys are the field names and the values are the field values.
1826  *
1827  * @return void
1828  * @throws ClientException
1829  */
1830 function user_set_fields( $p_user_id, array $p_fields ) {
1831 	if( empty( $p_fields ) ) {
1832 		return;
1833 	}
1834 
1835 	if( !array_key_exists( 'protected', $p_fields ) ) {
1836 		user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
1837 	}
1838 
1839 	db_param_push();
1840 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {user}';
1841 	$t_parameters = array();
1842 
1843 	foreach ( $p_fields as $t_field_name => $t_field_value ) {
1844 		$t_query .= ( empty( $t_parameters ) ? ' SET ' :  ', ' )
1845 			. $t_field_name. '=' . db_param();
1846 		$t_parameters[] = $t_field_value;
1847 	}
1848 
1849 	$t_query .= ' WHERE id=' . db_param();
1850 	$t_parameters[] = (int)$p_user_id;
1851 
1852 	db_query( $t_query, $t_parameters );
1853 
1854 	user_clear_cache( $p_user_id );
1855 }

1866  */
1867 function user_set_field( $p_user_id, $p_field_name, $p_field_value ) {

1885 /**
1886  * Set the user's password to the given string, encoded as appropriate.
1887  *
1888  * @param int    $p_user_id         A valid user identifier.
1889  * @param string $p_password        A password to set.
1890  * @param bool   $p_allow_protected Whether Allow password change to a
1891  *                                  protected account. This defaults to false.
1892  *
1893  * @return true
1894  * @throws ClientException
1895  */
1896 function user_set_password( $p_user_id, $p_password, $p_allow_protected = false ) {
1897 	if( !$p_allow_protected ) {
1898 		user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
1899 	}
1900 
1901 	# When the password is changed, invalidate the cookie to expire sessions that
1902 	# may be active on all browsers.
1903 	$c_cookie_string = auth_generate_unique_cookie_string();
1904 
1905 	# Delete token for password activation if there is any
1906 	token_delete( TOKEN_ACCOUNT_ACTIVATION, $p_user_id );
1907 	token_delete( TOKEN_ACCOUNT_CHANGE_EMAIL, $p_user_id );
1908 
1909 	$c_password = auth_process_plain_password( $p_password );
1910 
1911 	db_param_push();
1912 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {user}
1913 				  SET password=' . db_param() . ', cookie_string=' . db_param() . '
1914 				  WHERE id=' . db_param();
1915 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_password, $c_cookie_string, (int)$p_user_id ) );
1916 
1917 	return true;
1918 }
1919 
1920 /**
1921  * Validate the user's email address.
1922  *
1923  * @param int    $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
1924  * @param string $p_email   An email address to set.
1925  *
1926  * @return void
1927  * @throws ClientException If mail is not valid.
1928  */
1929 function user_ensure_email_valid( $p_user_id, $p_email ) {
1930 	$p_email = trim( $p_email );
1931 
1932 	email_ensure_valid( $p_email );
1933 	email_ensure_not_disposable( $p_email );
1934 
1935 	$t_old_email = user_get_email( $p_user_id );
1936 	if( strcasecmp( $t_old_email, $p_email ) != 0 ) {
1937 		user_ensure_email_unique( $p_email );
1938 	}
1939 }

1946  *
1947  * @return void

1950 function user_set_email( $p_user_id, $p_email ) {
1951 	user_ensure_email_valid( $p_user_id, $p_email );
1952 	user_set_field( $p_user_id, 'email', $p_email );

1981 	user_ensure_name_unique( $p_username, $p_user_id );
1982

1986 /**
1987  * Reset the user's password.
1988  *
1989  * Take into account the 'send_reset_password' setting
1990  *   - if it is ON, generate a random password and send an email
1991  *      (unless the second parameter is false)
1992  *   - if it is OFF, set the password to blank
1993  *
1994  * @param int  $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
1995  * @param bool $p_send_email Whether to send confirmation email.
1996  *
1997  * @return bool True if the password was successfully reset
1998  *              False if the user is protected.
1999  * @throws ClientException
2000  */
2001 function user_reset_password( $p_user_id, $p_send_email = true ) {
2002 	if( user_is_protected( $p_user_id ) ) {
2003 		return false;
2004 	}
2005 
2006 	# Go with random password and email it to the user
2007 	# @@@ do we want to force blank password instead of random if
2008 	#      email notifications are turned off?
2009 	#     How would we indicate that we had done this with a return value?
2010 	#     Should we just have two functions? (user_reset_password_random()
2011 	#     and user_reset_password() )?
2012 	if( ( ON == config_get( 'send_reset_password' ) ) && ( ON == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) ) ) {
2013 		$t_email = user_get_field( $p_user_id, 'email' );
2014 		if( is_blank( $t_email ) ) {
2015 			trigger_error( ERROR_LOST_PASSWORD_NO_EMAIL_SPECIFIED, ERROR );
2016 			throw new ClientException(
2017 				sprintf( "User id '%d' does not have an e-mail address.", (int)$p_user_id ),
2018 				ERROR_LOST_PASSWORD_NO_EMAIL_SPECIFIED,
2019 				array( (int)$p_user_id )
2020 			);
2021 		}
2022 
2023 		# Create random password
2024 		$t_password = auth_generate_random_password();
2025 		$t_password2 = auth_process_plain_password( $t_password );
2026 
2027 		user_set_field( $p_user_id, 'password', $t_password2 );
2028 
2029 		# Send notification email
2030 		if( $p_send_email ) {
2031 			$t_confirm_hash = auth_generate_confirm_hash( $p_user_id );
2032 			token_set( TOKEN_ACCOUNT_ACTIVATION, $t_confirm_hash, TOKEN_EXPIRY_ACCOUNT_ACTIVATION, $p_user_id );
2033 			email_send_confirm_hash_url( $p_user_id, $t_confirm_hash, true );
2034 		}
2035 	} else {
2036 		# use blank password, no emailing
2037 		$t_password = auth_process_plain_password( '' );
2038 		user_set_field( $p_user_id, 'password', $t_password );
2039 
2040 		# reset the failed login count because in this mode there is no emailing
2041 		user_reset_failed_login_count_to_zero( $p_user_id );
2042 	}
2043 
2044 	return true;
2045 }
2046 
2047 /**
2048  * Helper function to check if the user has access to more than one project.
2049  *
2050  * Checks for any kind of project or subproject. This can be used to simplify
2051  * logic when the user only has one project to choose from.
2052  *
2053  * @param int $p_user_id A valid user identifier.
2054  *
2055  * @return bool	True if the user has access to more than one project.
2056  */
2057 function user_has_more_than_one_project( $p_user_id ) {
2058 	$t_project_ids = user_get_accessible_projects( $p_user_id );
2059 	$t_count = count( $t_project_ids );
2060 	if( 0 == $t_count ) {
2061 		return false;
2062 	}
2063 	if( 1 == $t_count ) {
2064 		$t_project_id = (int) $t_project_ids[0];
2065 		if( count( user_get_accessible_subprojects( $p_user_id, $t_project_id ) ) == 0 ) {
2066 			return false;
2067 		}
2068 	}
2069 	return true;
2070 }

 261 	/**
 262 	 * Overloaded function
 263 	 * @param string $p_name  The Property name to set.
 264 	 * @param string $p_value A value to set the property to.
 265 	 * @return void
 266 	 * @access private
 267 	 */
 268 	public function __set( $p_name, $p_value ) {
 269 		switch( $p_name ) {
 270 			case 'timezone':
 271 				if( $p_value == '' ) {
 272 					$p_value = null;
 273 				}
 274 		}
 275 		$this->$p_name = $p_value;
 276 	}
 277 
 278 	/**
 279 	 * Overloaded function
 280 	 * @param string $p_string Property name.
 281 	 * @access private
 282 	 * @return mixed
 283 	 */
 284 	public function __get( $p_string ) {
 285 		if( is_null( $this->$p_string ) ) {
 286 			$this->$p_string = config_get( self::$_default_mapping[$p_string][0], null, $this->pref_user_id, $this->pref_project_id );
 287 		}
 288 		switch( self::$_default_mapping[$p_string][1] ) {
 289 			case 'int':
 290 				return (int)($this->$p_string);
 291 			default:
 292 				return $this->$p_string;
 293 		}
 294 	}
 295 
 296 	/**
 297 	 * Public Get() function
 298 	 * @param string $p_string Property to get.
 299 	 * @return mixed
 300 	 */
 301 	function Get( $p_string ) {
 302 		if( is_null( $this->$p_string ) ) {
 303 			$this->$p_string = config_get( self::$_default_mapping[$p_string][0], null, $this->pref_user_id, $this->pref_project_id );
 304 		}
 305 		return $this->$p_string;
 306 	}
 307 }

 309 $g_cache_user_pref = array();

 312 /**
 313  * Cache a user preferences row if necessary and return the cached copy.
 314  * If preferences can't be found, will trigger an error if $p_trigger_errors is
 315  * true (default), or return false otherwise
 316  * @param integer $p_user_id        A valid user identifier.
 317  * @param integer $p_project_id     A valid project identifier.
 318  * @param boolean $p_trigger_errors Whether to trigger error on failure.
 319  * @return boolean|array
 320  */
 321 function user_pref_cache_row( $p_user_id, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS, $p_trigger_errors = true ) {
 322 	global $g_cache_user_pref;
 323 
 324 	if( !isset( $g_cache_user_pref[(int)$p_user_id][(int)$p_project_id] ) ) {
 325 		user_pref_cache_array_rows( array( $p_user_id ), $p_project_id );
 326 	}
 327 
 328 	$t_row = $g_cache_user_pref[(int)$p_user_id][(int)$p_project_id];
 329 	if( false === $t_row && $p_trigger_errors ) {
 330 		trigger_error( ERROR_USER_PREFS_NOT_FOUND, ERROR );
 331 	}
 332 	return $t_row;
 333 }
 334 
 335 /**
 336  * Cache user preferences for a set of users
 337  * @param array   $p_user_id_array An array of valid user identifiers.
 338  * @param integer $p_project_id    A valid project identifier.
 339  * @return void
 340  */
 341 function user_pref_cache_array_rows( array $p_user_id_array, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 342 	global $g_cache_user_pref;
 343 	$c_user_id_array = array();
 344 
 345 	# identify the user ids that are not cached already.
 346 	foreach( $p_user_id_array as $t_user_id ) {
 347 		if( !isset( $g_cache_user_pref[(int)$t_user_id][(int)$p_project_id] ) ) {
 348 			$c_user_id_array[(int)$t_user_id] = (int)$t_user_id;
 349 		}
 350 	}
 351 
 352 	# if all users are already cached, then return
 353 	if( empty( $c_user_id_array ) ) {
 354 		return;
 355 	}
 356 
 357 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT * FROM {user_pref} WHERE user_id IN :user_array AND project_id = :project_id' );
 358 	$t_query->bind( 'user_array', $c_user_id_array );
 359 	$t_query->bind( 'project_id', (int)$p_project_id );
 360 
 361 	$t_result = $t_query->fetch_all();
 362 	if( $t_result ) {
 363 		foreach( $t_result as $t_row ) {
 364 			$t_user_id = (int)$t_row['user_id'];
 365 			if( !isset( $g_cache_user_pref[$t_user_id] ) ) {
 366 				$g_cache_user_pref[$t_user_id] = array();
 367 			}
 368 			$g_cache_user_pref[$t_user_id][(int)$p_project_id] = $t_row;
 369 
 370 			# remove found users from required set.
 371 			unset( $c_user_id_array[$t_user_id] );
 372 		}
 373 	}
 374 
 375 	# cache users that are not found as false (i.e. negative cache)
 376 	foreach( $c_user_id_array as $t_user_id ) {
 377 		$g_cache_user_pref[(int)$t_user_id][(int)$p_project_id] = false;
 378 	}
 379 }

 381 /**
 382  * Clear the user preferences cache (or just the given id if specified)
 383  * @param integer $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 384  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 385  * @return boolean
 386  */
 387 function user_pref_clear_cache( $p_user_id = null, $p_project_id = null ) {
 388 	global $g_cache_user_pref;
 389 
 390 	if( null === $p_user_id ) {
 391 		$g_cache_user_pref = array();
 392 	} else if( null === $p_project_id ) {
 393 		unset( $g_cache_user_pref[(int)$p_user_id] );
 394 	} else {
 395 		unset( $g_cache_user_pref[(int)$p_user_id][(int)$p_project_id] );
 396 	}
 397 
 398 	return true;
 399 }

 426  * perform an insert of a preference object into the DB
 427  * @param integer         $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 428  * @param integer         $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 429  * @param UserPreferences $p_prefs      A UserPrefences Object.
 430  * @return boolean
 431  */
 432 function user_pref_db_insert( $p_user_id, $p_project_id, UserPreferences $p_prefs ) {
 433 	static $s_vars;
 434 	$c_user_id = (int)$p_user_id;
 435 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 436 
 437 	if( $s_vars == null ) {
 438 		$s_vars = getClassProperties( 'UserPreferences', 'protected' );
 439 	}
 440 
 441 	$t_values = array();
 442 	$t_values[] = $c_user_id;
 443 	$t_values[] = $c_project_id;
 444 	foreach( $s_vars as $t_var => $t_val ) {
 445 		array_push( $t_values, $p_prefs->Get( $t_var ) );
 446 	}
 447 
 448 	$t_columns = 'user_id, project_id, ' . implode( ', ', array_keys( $s_vars ) );
 449 	$t_query = new DBQuery( 'INSERT INTO {user_pref} (' . $t_columns . ') VALUES :values' );
 450 	$t_query->bind( 'values', $t_values );
 451 	$t_query->execute();
 452 
 453 	return true;
 454 }

 466 /**
 467  * perform an update of a preference object into the DB
 468  * @param integer         $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 469  * @param integer         $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 470  * @param UserPreferences $p_prefs      A UserPrefences Object.
 471  * @return void
 472  */
 473 function user_pref_db_update( $p_user_id, $p_project_id, UserPreferences $p_prefs ) {
 474 	static $s_vars;
 475 
 476 	if( $s_vars == null ) {
 477 		$s_vars = getClassProperties( 'UserPreferences', 'protected' );
 478 	}
 479 
 480 	$t_pairs = array();
 481 	foreach( $s_vars as $t_var => $t_val ) {
 482 		$t_pairs[] = "$t_var = :$t_var";
 483 		$t_param[$t_var] = $p_prefs->$t_var;
 484 	}
 485 
 486 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'UPDATE {user_pref}
 487 		SET ' . implode( ', ', $t_pairs ) . '
 488 		WHERE user_id = :user_id AND project_id = :project_id' );
 489 	$t_query->bind( $t_param );
 490 	$t_query->bind( 'user_id', $p_user_id );
 491 	$t_query->bind( 'project_id', $p_project_id );
 492 	$t_query->execute();
 493 }

 547 /**
 548  * Sets project default to ALL_PROJECTS.
 549  *
 550  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 551  * @param array   $p_users      A list of users (empty = all users).
 552  *
 553  * @return void
 554  */
 555 function user_pref_clear_project_default( $p_project_id, array $p_users = array() ) {
 556 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'UPDATE {user_pref}'
 557 		. ' SET default_project = ' . ALL_PROJECTS
 558 		. ' WHERE default_project = :default'
 559 	);
 560 	$t_query->bind( 'default', (int)$p_project_id );
 561 	if( $p_users ) {
 562 		$t_query->append_sql( ' AND ' . $t_query->sql_in( 'user_id', 'users' ) );
 563 		$t_query->bind( 'users', $p_users );
 564 	}
 565 	$t_query->execute();

 568 /**
 569  * Sets project default to ALL_PROJECTS if current default is not valid.
 570  *
 571  * When users are removed from a project, the ones having that project as
 572  * default but who are no longer authorized to access it, need to have their
 573  * now-invalid preference updated.
 574  *
 575  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 576  * @param array   $p_users      A list of users (empty = all users).
 577  *
 578  * @return void
 579  */
 580 function user_pref_clear_invalid_project_default( $p_project_id, array $p_users = array() ) {
 581 	# Get all users having the project as default
 582 	$t_query = new DbQuery( 'SELECT user_id FROM {user_pref} WHERE default_project = :default' );
 583 	$t_query->bind( 'default', (int)$p_project_id );
 584 	if( $p_users ) {
 585 		$t_query->append_sql( ' AND ' . $t_query->sql_in( 'user_id', 'users' ) );
 586 		$t_query->bind( 'users', $p_users );
 587 	}
 588 	$t_query->execute();
 589 
 590 	$t_users_having_project_as_default = array_column( $t_query->fetch_all(), 'user_id' );
 591 
 592 	# Users who can't access the project anymore must have the default cleared
 593 	user_cache_array_rows( $t_users_having_project_as_default );
 594 	$t_users_to_clear = array();
 595 	foreach( $t_users_having_project_as_default as $t_id ) {
 596 		if( access_get_project_level( $p_project_id, $t_id ) == ANYBODY ) {
 597 			$t_users_to_clear[] = $t_id;
 598 		}
 599 	}
 600 
 601 	if( !empty( $t_users_to_clear ) ) {
 602 		user_pref_clear_project_default( $p_project_id, $t_users_to_clear );
 603 	}
 604 }

 621 /**
 622  * return the user's preferences in a UserPreferences object
 623  * @param integer $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 624  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 625  * @return UserPreferences
 626  */
 627 function user_pref_get( $p_user_id, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 628 	static $s_vars;
 629 	global $g_cache_current_user_pref;
 630 
 631 	if( isset( $g_cache_current_user_pref[(int)$p_project_id] ) &&
 632 		auth_is_user_authenticated() &&
 633 		auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_user_id ) {
 634 		return $g_cache_current_user_pref[(int)$p_project_id];
 635 	}
 636 
 637 	$t_prefs = new UserPreferences( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
 638 
 639 	$t_row = user_pref_cache_row( $p_user_id, $p_project_id, false );
 640 
 641 	# If the user has no preferences for the given project
 642 	if( false === $t_row ) {
 643 		if( ALL_PROJECTS != $p_project_id ) {
 644 			# Try to get the prefs for ALL_PROJECTS (the defaults)
 645 			$t_row = user_pref_cache_row( $p_user_id, ALL_PROJECTS, false );
 646 		}
 647 
 648 		# If $t_row is still false (the user doesn't have default preferences)
 649 		if( false === $t_row ) {
 650 			# We use an empty array
 651 			$t_row = array();
 652 		}
 653 	}
 654 
 655 	if( $s_vars == null ) {
 656 		$s_vars = getClassProperties( 'UserPreferences', 'protected' );
 657 	}
 658 
 659 	$t_row_keys = array_keys( $t_row );
 660 
 661 	# Check each variable in the class
 662 	foreach( $s_vars as $t_var => $t_val ) {
 663 		# If we got a field from the DB with the same name
 664 		if( in_array( $t_var, $t_row_keys, true ) ) {
 665 			# Store that value in the object
 666 			$t_prefs->$t_var = $t_row[$t_var];
 667 		}
 668 	}
 669 	if( auth_is_user_authenticated() && auth_get_current_user_id() == $p_user_id ) {
 670 		$g_cache_current_user_pref[(int)$p_project_id] = $t_prefs;
 671 	}
 672 	return $t_prefs;
 673 }
 674 
 675 /**
 676  * Return the specified preference field for the user id
 677  * If the preference can't be found try to return a defined default
 678  * If that fails, trigger a WARNING and return ''
 679  * @param integer $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 680  * @param string  $p_pref_name  A valid user preference name.
 681  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 682  * @return string
 683  */
 684 function user_pref_get_pref( $p_user_id, $p_pref_name, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS ) {
 685 	static $s_vars;
 686 
 687 	$t_prefs = user_pref_get( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
 688 
 689 	if( $s_vars == null ) {
 690 		$t_reflection = new ReflectionClass( 'UserPreferences' );
 691 		$s_vars = $t_reflection->getDefaultProperties();
 692 	}
 693 
 694 	if( in_array( $p_pref_name, array_keys( $s_vars ), true ) ) {
 695 		return $t_prefs->Get( $p_pref_name );
 696 	} else {
 697 		error_parameters( $p_pref_name );
 698 		trigger_error( ERROR_DB_FIELD_NOT_FOUND, WARNING );
 699 		return '';
 700 	}
 701 }

 704  * returns user language

 720 /**
 721  * Set a user preference
 722  *
 723  * By getting the preferences for the project first we deal fairly well with defaults. If there are currently no
 724  * preferences for that project, the ALL_PROJECTS preferences will be returned so we end up storing a new set of
 725  * preferences for the given project based on the preferences for ALL_PROJECTS.  If there isn't even an entry for
 726  * ALL_PROJECTS, we'd get returned a default UserPreferences object to modify.
 727  * @param integer $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 728  * @param string  $p_pref_name  The name of the preference value to set.
 729  * @param string  $p_pref_value A preference value to set.
 730  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 731  * @param boolean $p_check_protected	Whether to perform a check to not allow modify protected users
 732  * @return boolean
 733  */
 734 function user_pref_set_pref( $p_user_id, $p_pref_name, $p_pref_value, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS, $p_check_protected = true ) {
 735 	$t_prefs = user_pref_get( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
 736 
 737 	if( $t_prefs->$p_pref_name != $p_pref_value ) {
 738 		$t_prefs->$p_pref_name = $p_pref_value;
 739 		user_pref_set( $p_user_id, $t_prefs, $p_project_id, $p_check_protected );
 740 	}
 741 
 742 	return true;
 743 }
 744 
 745 /**
 746  * Set the user's preferences for the project from the given preferences object
 747  * Do the work by calling update or insert as appropriate
 748  * @param integer         $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 749  * @param UserPreferences $p_prefs      A UserPreferences object containing settings to set.
 750  * @param integer         $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 751  * @param boolean         $p_check_protected	Whether to perform a check to not allow modify protected users
 752  * @return void
 753  */
 754 function user_pref_set( $p_user_id, UserPreferences $p_prefs, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS, $p_check_protected = true ) {
 755 	if( $p_check_protected ) {
 756 		user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
 757 	}
 758 	if( user_pref_exists( $p_user_id, $p_project_id ) ) {
 759 		user_pref_db_update( $p_user_id, $p_project_id, $p_prefs );
 760 	} else {
 761 		user_pref_db_insert( $p_user_id, $p_project_id, $p_prefs );
 762 	}
 763 	user_pref_clear_cache( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
 764 }
 765 
 766 /**
 767  * Delete the user's preferences row for the given project
 768  * @param integer         $p_user_id    A valid user identifier.
 769  * @param integer         $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 770  * @param boolean         $p_check_protected	Whether to perform a check to not allow modify protected users
 771  * @return void
 772  */
 773 function user_pref_reset( $p_user_id, $p_project_id = ALL_PROJECTS, $p_check_protected = true ) {
 774 	if( $p_check_protected ) {
 775 		user_ensure_unprotected( $p_user_id );
 776 	}
 777 	if( user_pref_exists( $p_user_id, $p_project_id ) ) {
 778 		user_pref_db_delete( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
 779 	}
 780 	user_pref_clear_cache( $p_user_id, $p_project_id );
 781 }

  43 /**
  44  * converts a 1 value to X
  45  * converts a 0 value to a space
  46  * @param integer $p_num A numeric to translate as a boolean for display.
  47  * @return string X or space
  48  * @access public
  49  */
  50 function trans_bool( $p_num ) {
  51 	if( 0 == $p_num ) {
  52 		return '&#160;';
  53 	} else {
  54 		return icon_get( 'fa-check', 'fa-lg' );
  55 	}
  56 }

  58 /**
  59  * Add a trailing DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR to a string if it isn't present
  60  * @param string $p_path A string representing a file system path.
  61  * @return string
  62  * @access public
  63  */
  64 function terminate_directory_path( $p_path ) {

  68 /**
  69  * Return true if the parameter is an empty string or a string
  70  * containing only whitespace, false otherwise
  71  * @param string $p_var String to test whether it is blank.
  72  * @return boolean
  73  * @access public
  74  */
  75 function is_blank( $p_var ) {
  76 	$p_var = trim( (string)$p_var );
  77 	$t_str_len = strlen( $p_var );
  78 	if( 0 == $t_str_len ) {
  79 		return true;
  80 	}
  81 	return false;
