  84 /**
  85  * Get the named php ini variable but return it as a boolean
  86  * @param string $p_name A php.ini variable to evaluate.
  87  * @return boolean
  88  * @access public
  89  */
  90 function ini_get_bool( $p_name ) {
  91 	$t_result = ini_get( $p_name );
  92 
  93 	if( is_string( $t_result ) ) {
  94 		switch( strtolower( $t_result ) ) {
  95 			case 'off':
  96 			case 'false':
  97 			case 'no':
  98 			case 'none':
  99 			case '':
 100 			case '0':
 101 				return false;
 102 			case 'on':
 103 			case 'true':
 104 			case 'yes':
 105 			case '1':
 106 				return true;
 107 		}
 108 	}
 109 	return (bool)$t_result;
 110 }
 111 
 112 /**
 113  * Get the named php.ini variable but return it as a number after converting
 114  * the giga (g/G), mega (m/M) and kilo (k/K) postfixes. These postfixes do not
 115  * adhere to IEEE 1541 in that k=1024, not k=1000. For more information see
 116  * http://www.php.net/manual/en/faq.using.php#faq.using.shorthandbytes
 117  * @param string $p_name Name of the configuration option to read.
 118  * @return int Integer value of the configuration option.
 119  * @access public
 120  */
 121 function ini_get_number( $p_name ) {
 122 	$t_value = ini_get( $p_name );
 123 
 124 	switch( substr( $t_value, -1 ) ) {
 125 		case 'G':
 126 		case 'g':
 127 			$t_result = (int)$t_value * 1073741824;
 128 			break;
 129 		case 'M':
 130 		case 'm':
 131 			$t_result = (int)$t_value * 1048576;
 132 			break;
 133 		case 'K':
 134 		case 'k':
 135 			$t_result = (int)$t_value * 1024;
 136 			break;
 137 		default:
 138 			$t_result = (int)$t_value;
 139 			break;
 140 	}
 141 	return $t_result;
 142 }
 143 
 144 /**
 145  * Sort a multi-dimensional array by one of its keys
 146  * @param array   $p_array     Array to sort.
 147  * @param string  $p_key       Array key to sort array on.
 148  * @param integer $p_direction Sort direction.
 149  * @return array sorted array
 150  * @access public
 151  */
 152 function multi_sort( array $p_array, $p_key, $p_direction = ASCENDING ) {
 153 	if( DESCENDING == $p_direction ) {
 154 		$t_factor = -1;
 155 	} else {
 156 		# might as well allow everything else to mean ASC rather than erroring
 157 		$t_factor = 1;
 158 	}
 159 
 160 	if( empty( $p_array ) ) {
 161 		return $p_array;
 162 	}
 163 	if( !is_array( current( $p_array ) ) ) {
 164 		error_parameters( 'tried to multisort an invalid multi-dimensional array' );
 165 		trigger_error( ERROR_GENERIC, ERROR );
 166 	}
 167 
 168 	# Security measure: see http://www.mantisbt.org/bugs/view.php?id=9704 for details
 169 	if( array_key_exists( $p_key, current( $p_array ) ) ) {
 170 		uasort(
 171 			$p_array,
 172 			function( $a, $b ) use( $t_factor, $p_key ) {
 173 				return $t_factor * strnatcasecmp( $a[$p_key], $b[$p_key] );
 174 			}
 175 		);
 176 	} else {
 177 		trigger_error( ERROR_INVALID_SORT_FIELD, ERROR );
 178 	}
 179 	return $p_array;
 180 }

 182 /**
 183  * Return GD version
 184  * It doesn't use gd_info() so it works with PHP < 4.3.0 as well
 185  * @return int represents gd version
 186  * @access public
 187  */
 188 function get_gd_version() {
 189 	$t_GDfuncList = get_extension_funcs( 'gd' );
 190 	if( !is_array( $t_GDfuncList ) ) {
 191 		return 0;
 192 	} else {
 193 		if( in_array( 'imagegd2', $t_GDfuncList ) ) {
 194 			return 2;
 195 		} else {
 196 			return 1;
 197 		}
 198 	}
 199 }

 201 /**
 202  * return true or false if string matches current page name
 203  * @param string $p_string To test against the php script name.
 204  * @return boolean
 205  * @access public
 206  */
 207 function is_page_name( $p_string ) {
 208 	return isset( $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] ) && ( 0 < strpos( $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'], $p_string ) );
 209 }

 211 /**
 212  * Return true if the host operating system is Windows, false otherwise.
 213  *
 214  * @return bool
 215  * @access public
 216  */
 217 function is_windows_server() {
 218 	if( defined( 'PHP_WINDOWS_VERSION_MAJOR' ) ) {
 219 		return PHP_WINDOWS_VERSION_MAJOR > 0;
 220 	}
 221 	return 'Windows' === PHP_OS_FAMILY;

 224 /**
 225  * return array of class properties (via reflection api)
 226  * @param string  $p_classname      Class name.
 227  * @param string  $p_type           Property type - public/private/protected/static.
 228  * @param boolean $p_return_object  Whether to return array of property objects.
 229  * @param boolean $p_include_parent Whether to include properties of parent classes.
 230  * @return array
 231  * @access public
 232  */
 233 function getClassProperties( $p_classname, $p_type = 'public', $p_return_object = false, $p_include_parent = false ) {
 234 	$t_ref = new ReflectionClass( $p_classname );
 235 	$t_props = $t_ref->getProperties();
 236 	$t_props_arr = array();
 237 	foreach( $t_props as $t_prop ){
 238 		$t_name = $t_prop->getName();
 239 		if( $t_prop->isPublic() and (stripos( $p_type, 'public' ) === false) ) {
 240 			continue;
 241 		}
 242 		if( $t_prop->isPrivate() and (stripos( $p_type, 'private' ) === false) ) {
 243 			continue;
 244 		}
 245 		if( $t_prop->isProtected() and (stripos( $p_type, 'protected' ) === false) ) {
 246 			continue;
 247 		}
 248 		if( $t_prop->isStatic() and (stripos( $p_type, 'static' ) === false) ) {
 249 			continue;
 250 		}
 251 		if( $p_return_object ) {
 252 			$t_props_arr[$t_name] = $t_prop;
 253 		} else {
 254 			$t_props_arr[$t_name] = true;
 255 		}
 256 	}
 257 	if( $p_include_parent ) {
 258 		if( $t_parentclass = $t_ref->getParentClass() ) {
 259 			$t_parent_props_arr = getClassProperties( $t_parentclass->getName() );
 260 			if( count( $t_parent_props_arr ) > 0 ) {
 261 				$t_props_arr = array_merge( $t_parent_props_arr, $t_props_arr );
 262 			}
 263 		}
 264 	}
 265 	return $t_props_arr;
 266 }

 268 /**
 269  * return string of system font path
 270  * @access public
 271  * @return string representing system path to font location
 272  */
 273 function get_font_path() {
 274 		$t_font_path = config_get_global( 'system_font_folder' );
 275 		if( $t_font_path == '' ) {
 276 			if( is_windows_server() ) {
 277 				$t_system_root = $_SERVER['SystemRoot'];
 278 				if( empty( $t_system_root ) ) {
 279 					return '';
 280 				} else {
 281 					$t_font_path = $t_system_root . '/fonts/';
 282 				}
 283 			} else {
 284 				if( file_exists( '/usr/share/fonts/corefonts/' ) ) {
 285 					$t_font_path = '/usr/share/fonts/corefonts/';
 286 				} else if( file_exists( '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/msttcorefonts/' ) ) {
 287 					$t_font_path = '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/msttcorefonts/';
 288 				} else if( file_exists( '/usr/share/fonts/msttcorefonts/' ) ) {
 289 					$t_font_path = '/usr/share/fonts/msttcorefonts/';
 290 				} else {
 291 					$t_font_path = '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/';
 292 				}
 293 			}
 294 		}
 295 		return $t_font_path;
 296 }

 298 /**
 299  * unserialize() with Exception instead of PHP notice.
 300  *
 301  * When given invalid data, unserialize() throws a PHP notice; this function
 302  * relies on a custom error handler to throw an Exception instead.
 303  *
 304  * @param string $p_string The serialized string.
 305  * @return mixed The converted value
 306  *
 307  * @throws ErrorException
 308  */
 309 function safe_unserialize( $p_string ) {
 310 	set_error_handler( 'error_convert_to_exception' );
 311 	try {
 312 		$t_data = unserialize( $p_string );
 313 	}
 314 	catch( ErrorException $e ) {
 315 		restore_error_handler();
 316 		throw $e;
 317 	}
 318 	restore_error_handler();
 319 	return $t_data;
 320 }

  49 /**
  50  * Version Data Structure Definition
  51  *
  52  * @property int $id
  53  * @property int $project_id
  54  * @property string $version
  55  * @property string $description
  56  * @property bool $released
  57  * @property bool $obsolete
  58  * @property int $date_order
  59  */
  60 class VersionData {
  61 	/**
  62 	 * Version id
  63 	 */
  64 	protected $id = 0;
  65 
  66 	/**
  67 	 * Project ID
  68 	 */
  69 	protected $project_id = 0;
  70 
  71 	/**
  72 	 * Version name
  73 	 */
  74 	protected $version = '';
  75 
  76 	/**
  77 	 * Version Description
  78 	 */
  79 	protected $description = '';
  80 
  81 	/**
  82 	 * Version Release Status e.g. VERSION_FUTURE
  83 	 */
  84 	protected $released = VERSION_FUTURE;
  85 
  86 	/**
  87 	 * Version Obsolescence Status
  88 	 */
  89 	protected $obsolete = false;
  90 
  91 	/**
  92 	 * Date Order
  93 	 */
  94 	protected $date_order = 1;
  95 
  96 	/**
  97 	 * VersionData constructor.
  98 	 *
  99 	 * Initialize the object with default values, or with data from a
 100 	 * project_version table row.
 101 	 *
 102 	 * @param array|null $p_row
 103 	 */
 104 	public function __construct( ?array $p_row = null ) {
 105 		if( $p_row !== null ) {
 106 			$this->set_from_db_row( $p_row );
 107 		}
 108 	}
 109 
 110 	/**
 111 	 * Setting protected class properties.
 112 	 *
 113 	 * @param string $p_name A valid property name.
 114 	 * @param integer|string $p_value The property value to set.
 115 	 * @return void
 116 	 * @throws ClientException
 117 	 */
 118 	public function __set( $p_name, $p_value ) {
 119 		if( $p_name == 'date_order' && !is_numeric( $p_value ) ) {
 120 			$this->date_order = date_strtotime( $p_value );
 121 			return;
 122 		}
 123 
 124 		$this->$p_name = $p_value;
 125 	}
 126 
 127 	/**
 128 	 * Getting protected class properties.
 129 	 *
 130 	 * @param string $p_name A valid property name.
 131 	 * @return integer|string
 132 	 */
 133 	public function __get( $p_name ) {
 134 		return $this->{$p_name};
 135 	}
 136 
 137 	/**
 138 	 * Initialize the object with data from a database row.
 139 	 *
 140 	 * @param array $p_row
 141 	 */
 142 	public function set_from_db_row( array $p_row ) {
 143 		static $s_vars;
 144 
 145 		if( $s_vars == null ) {
 146 			$t_reflection = new ReflectionClass( $this );
 147 			$s_vars = $t_reflection->getDefaultProperties();
 148 		}
 149 
 150 		# Check each variable in the class
 151 		foreach( $s_vars as $t_var => $t_val ) {
 152 			# If we got a field from the DB with the same name
 153 			if( array_key_exists( $t_var, $p_row ) ) {
 154 				# Store that value in the object
 155 				$this->$t_var = $p_row[$t_var];
 156 			}
 157 		}
 158 	}
 159 }

 161 /**
 162  * Array indexed by version id.
 163  * Each item is a version row, as retrieved from project_version table.
 164  */
 165 $g_cache_versions = array();
 166 
 167 /**
 168  * Array indexed by project_id.
 169  * Each item is an array of version ids that are linked to that project.
 170  * Note that this does not include versions inherited from parent projects.
 171  */
 172 $g_cache_versions_project  = array();
 173 
 174 /**
 175  * Clear version cache
 176  *
 177  * @return void
 178  */
 179 function version_cache_clear() {
 180 	global $g_cache_versions_project, $g_cache_versions;
 181 	$g_cache_versions_project = array();
 182 	$g_cache_versions = array();

 185 /**
 186  * Remove specified version from version cache
 187  *
 188  * @param integer $p_version_id The version id to remove from cache.
 189  * @return void
 190  */
 191 function version_cache_clear_row( $p_version_id ) {
 192 	global $g_cache_versions;
 193 
 194 	$c_version_id = (int)$p_version_id;
 195 
 196 	unset( $g_cache_versions[$c_version_id] );
 197 }

 199 /**
 200  * Cache a version row if necessary and return the cached copy.
 201  *
 202  * @param integer $p_version_id A Version identifier.
 203  *
 204  * @return array Version data
 205  * @throws ClientException if the Version does not exist.
 206  */
 207 function version_cache_row( $p_version_id ) {
 208 	global $g_cache_versions;
 209 
 210 	$c_version_id = (int)$p_version_id;
 211 
 212 	if( empty( $g_cache_versions[$c_version_id] ) ) {
 213 		db_param_push();
 214 		$t_query = 'SELECT * FROM {project_version} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 215 		$t_result = db_query( $t_query, array( $c_version_id ) );
 216 		$t_row = db_fetch_array( $t_result );
 217 
 218 		$g_cache_versions[$c_version_id] = $t_row;
 219 	} else {
 220 		$t_row = $g_cache_versions[$c_version_id];
 221 	}
 222 
 223 	if( false === $t_row ) {
 224 		throw new ClientException(
 225 			"Version with id $p_version_id not found",
 226 			ERROR_VERSION_NOT_FOUND,
 227 			array( $p_version_id )
 228 		);
 229 	}
 230 
 231 	return $t_row;
 232 }

 234 /**
 235  * Cache version information for an array of project id's.
 236  *
 237  * @param array $p_project_ids An array of project identifiers.
 238  *
 239  * @return void
 240  */
 241 function version_cache_array_rows( array $p_project_ids ) {
 242 	global $g_cache_versions_project, $g_cache_versions;
 243 
 244 	$t_ids_to_fetch = array();
 245 	foreach( $p_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 246 		$c_id = (int)$t_id;
 247 		if( !isset( $g_cache_versions_project[$c_id] ) ) {
 248 			$t_ids_to_fetch[$c_id] = $c_id;
 249 		}
 250 	}
 251 	if( empty( $t_ids_to_fetch ) ) {
 252 		return;
 253 	}
 254 
 255 	$t_query = new DbQuery();
 256 	$t_sql = 'SELECT * FROM {project_version} WHERE ' . $t_query->sql_in( 'project_id', $t_ids_to_fetch );
 257 	$t_query->sql( $t_sql );
 258 	while( $t_row = $t_query->fetch() ) {
 259 		$c_project_id = (int)$t_row['project_id'];
 260 		$c_version_id = (int)$t_row['id'];
 261 		$g_cache_versions[$c_version_id] = $t_row;
 262 		if( !isset( $g_cache_versions_project[$c_project_id] ) ) {
 263 			$g_cache_versions_project[$c_project_id] = array();
 264 		}
 265 		$g_cache_versions_project[$c_project_id][] = $c_version_id;
 266         unset( $t_ids_to_fetch[$c_project_id] );
 267 	}
 268 	foreach( $t_ids_to_fetch as $t_id_not_found ) {
 269 		$g_cache_versions_project[$t_id_not_found] = false;
 270 	}
 271 }

 289 /**

 293  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid Project identifier.
 294  *
 295  * @return boolean True if the name is unique, false otherwise.

 297 function version_is_unique( $p_version, $p_project_id = null ) {
 298 	return version_get_id( $p_version, $p_project_id ) === false;
 299 }

 301 /**
 302  * Validate the specified version name
 303  *
 304  * @param string $p_version_name Version name to validate.
 305  * @return boolean true: valid, false: otherwise.
 306  */
 307 function version_is_valid_name( $p_version_name ) {
 308 	if( is_null( $p_version_name ) ||
 309 		is_blank( $p_version_name ) ||
 310 		stripos( $p_version_name, "\r" ) !== false ||
 311 		stripos( $p_version_name, "\n" ) !== false ||
 312 		trim( $p_version_name ) !== $p_version_name ||
 313 		strlen( $p_version_name ) > 64 ) {
 314 		return false;
 315 	}
 316 
 317 	return true;
 318 }

 341  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid Project identifier.
 342  *

 346 function version_ensure_unique( $p_version, $p_project_id = null ) {

 355 /**
 356  * Add a version to the project.
 357  *
 358  * @param integer $p_project_id  A valid project id.
 359  * @param string  $p_version     Name of a version to add.
 360  * @param integer $p_released    Release status of the version.
 361  * @param string  $p_description Description of the version.
 362  * @param integer $p_date_order  Date Order.
 363  * @param boolean $p_obsolete    Obsolete status of the version.
 364  *
 365  * @return integer
 366  * @throws ClientException if Version already exists in the Project.
 367  */
 368 function version_add( $p_project_id, $p_version, $p_released = VERSION_FUTURE, $p_description = '', $p_date_order = null, $p_obsolete = false ) {
 369 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id ;
 370 	$c_released = (bool)$p_released;
 371 	$c_obsolete = (bool)$p_obsolete;
 372 
 373 	if( null === $p_date_order ) {
 374 		$c_date_order = db_now();
 375 	} else {
 376 		$c_date_order = $p_date_order;
 377 	}
 378 
 379 	version_ensure_unique( $p_version, $p_project_id );
 380 
 381 	db_param_push();
 382 	$t_query = 'INSERT INTO {project_version}
 383 					( project_id, version, date_order, description, released, obsolete )
 384 				  VALUES
 385 					(' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ', ' . db_param() . ' )';
 386 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_project_id, $p_version, $c_date_order, $p_description, $c_released, $c_obsolete ) );
 387 
 388 	$t_version_id = db_insert_id( db_get_table( 'project_version' ) );
 389 
 390 	event_signal( 'EVENT_MANAGE_VERSION_CREATE', array( $t_version_id ) );
 391 
 392 	return $t_version_id;
 393 }

 395 /**
 396  * Update the definition of a version.
 397  *
 398  * @param VersionData $p_version_info A version structure to update.
 399  *
 400  * @return void
 401  * @throws ClientException if Version does not exist.
 402  */
 403 function version_update( VersionData $p_version_info ) {
 404 	version_ensure_exists( $p_version_info->id );
 405 
 406 	$t_old_version_name = version_get_field( $p_version_info->id, 'version' );
 407 
 408 	# check for duplicates
 409 	if( ( mb_strtolower( $t_old_version_name ) != mb_strtolower( $p_version_info->version ) ) && !version_is_unique( $p_version_info->version, $p_version_info->project_id ) ) {
 410 		$t_version = $p_version_info->version;
 411 		throw new ClientException(
 412 			"Version '$t_version' already exists",
 413 			ERROR_VERSION_DUPLICATE,
 414 			array( $t_version ) );
 415 	}
 416 
 417 	$c_version_id = (int)$p_version_info->id;
 418 	$c_version_name = $p_version_info->version;
 419 	$c_old_version_name = $t_old_version_name;
 420 	$c_description = $p_version_info->description;
 421 	$c_released = (bool)$p_version_info->released;
 422 	$c_obsolete = (bool)$p_version_info->obsolete;
 423 	$c_date_order = $p_version_info->date_order;
 424 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_version_info->project_id;
 425 
 426 	db_param_push();
 427 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {project_version}
 428 				  SET version=' . db_param() . ',
 429 					description=' . db_param() . ',
 430 					released=' . db_param() . ',
 431 					date_order=' . db_param() . ',
 432 					obsolete=' . db_param() . '
 433 				  WHERE id=' . db_param();
 434 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_version_name, $c_description, $c_released, $c_date_order, $c_obsolete, $c_version_id ) );
 435 
 436 	if( $c_version_name != $c_old_version_name ) {
 437 		$t_project_list = array( $c_project_id );
 438 		if( config_get( 'subprojects_inherit_versions', null, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS ) ) {
 439 			$t_project_list = array_merge( $t_project_list, project_hierarchy_get_all_subprojects( $c_project_id, true ) );
 440 		}
 441 		$t_project_list = implode( ',', $t_project_list );
 442 
 443 		db_param_push();
 444 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET version=' . db_param() .
 445 				 ' WHERE ( project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ) ) AND ( version=' . db_param() . ')';
 446 		db_query( $t_query, array( $c_version_name, $c_old_version_name ) );
 447 
 448 		db_param_push();
 449 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET fixed_in_version=' . db_param() . '
 450 					  WHERE ( project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ) ) AND ( fixed_in_version=' . db_param() . ')';
 451 		db_query( $t_query, array( $c_version_name, $c_old_version_name ) );
 452 
 453 		db_param_push();
 454 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET target_version=' . db_param() . '
 455 					  WHERE ( project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ) ) AND ( target_version=' . db_param() . ')';
 456 		db_query( $t_query, array( $c_version_name, $c_old_version_name ) );
 457 
 458 		db_param_push();
 459 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug_history}
 460 			SET old_value='.db_param().'
 461 			WHERE field_name IN (\'version\',\'fixed_in_version\',\'target_version\')
 462 				AND old_value='.db_param().'
 463 				AND bug_id IN (SELECT id FROM {bug} WHERE project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ))';
 464 		db_query( $t_query, array( $c_version_name, $c_old_version_name ) );
 465 
 466 		db_param_push();
 467 		$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug_history}
 468 			SET new_value='.db_param().'
 469 			WHERE field_name IN (\'version\',\'fixed_in_version\',\'target_version\')
 470 				AND new_value='.db_param().'
 471 				AND bug_id IN (SELECT id FROM {bug} WHERE project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ))';
 472 		db_query( $t_query, array( $c_version_name, $c_old_version_name ) );
 473 
 474 		# @todo We should consider using ids instead of names for foreign keys.  The main advantage of using the names are:
 475 		#		- for history the version history entries will still be valid even if the version is deleted in the future. --  we can ban deleting referenced versions.
 476 		# 		- when an issue is copied or moved from one project to another, we can keep the last version with the issue even if it doesn't exist in the new project.  Also previous history entries remain valid.
 477 		# @todo We probably need to update the saved filters too?
 478 	}
 479 }

 481 /**
 482  * Remove a version from the project.
 483  *
 484  * @param integer $p_version_id  A valid version identifier.
 485  * @param string  $p_new_version A version string to update issues using the old version with.
 486  *
 487  * @return void
 488  * @throws ClientException if Version does not exist.
 489  */
 490 function version_remove( $p_version_id, $p_new_version = '' ) {
 491 	version_ensure_exists( $p_version_id );
 492 
 493 	event_signal( 'EVENT_MANAGE_VERSION_DELETE', array( $p_version_id, $p_new_version ) );
 494 
 495 	$t_old_version = version_get_field( $p_version_id, 'version' );
 496 	$t_project_id = version_get_field( $p_version_id, 'project_id' );
 497 
 498 	db_param_push();
 499 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {project_version} WHERE id=' . db_param();
 500 	db_query( $t_query, array( (int)$p_version_id ) );
 501 
 502 	$t_project_list = array( $t_project_id );
 503 	if( config_get( 'subprojects_inherit_versions', null, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS ) ) {
 504 		$t_project_list = array_merge( $t_project_list, project_hierarchy_get_all_subprojects( $t_project_id, true ) );
 505 	}
 506 	$t_project_list = implode( ',', $t_project_list );
 507 
 508 	db_param_push();
 509 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET version=' . db_param() . '
 510 				  WHERE project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ) AND version=' . db_param();
 511 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_new_version, $t_old_version ) );
 512 
 513 	db_param_push();
 514 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET fixed_in_version=' . db_param() . '
 515 				  WHERE ( project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ) ) AND ( fixed_in_version=' . db_param() . ')';
 516 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_new_version, $t_old_version ) );
 517 
 518 	db_param_push();
 519 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug} SET target_version=' . db_param() . '
 520 				  WHERE ( project_id IN ( ' . $t_project_list . ' ) ) AND ( target_version=' . db_param() . ')';
 521 	db_query( $t_query, array( $p_new_version, $t_old_version ) );
 522 }

 524 /**
 525  * Remove all versions associated with a project.
 526  *
 527  * @param integer $p_project_id A project identifier.
 528  *
 529  * @return void
 530  */
 531 function version_remove_all( $p_project_id ) {
 532 	$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 533 
 534 	# remove all references to versions from version, fixed in version and target version.
 535 	db_param_push();
 536 	$t_query = 'UPDATE {bug}
 537 				  SET version=\'\', fixed_in_version=\'\', target_version=\'\'
 538 				  WHERE project_id=' . db_param();
 539 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_project_id ) );
 540 
 541 	# remove the actual versions associated with the project.
 542 	db_param_push();
 543 	$t_query = 'DELETE FROM {project_version} WHERE project_id=' . db_param();
 544 	db_query( $t_query, array( $c_project_id ) );
 545 }

 547 /**
 548  * Return all versions for the specified project or projects list.
 549  *
 550  * Returned versions are ordered by reverse 'date_order'
 551  *
 552  * @param integer|array $p_project_ids A valid project id, or array of ids
 553  * @param boolean       $p_released    Whether to show only released, unreleased, or both.
 554  *                                     For this parameter, use constants defined as:
 555  *                                     VERSION_ALL (null): returns any
 556  *                                     VERSION_FUTURE (false): returns only unreleased versions
 557  *                                     VERSION_RELEASED (true): returns only released versions
 558  * @param boolean       $p_obsolete    Whether to include obsolete versions.
 559  * @param boolean       $p_inherit     True to include versions from parent projects,
 560  *                                     false not to, or null to use configuration
 561  *                                     setting ($g_subprojects_inherit_versions).
 562  *
 563  * @return array Array of version rows (in array format)
 564  *
 565  * @noinspection PhpDocMissingThrowsInspection
 566  */
 567 function version_get_all_rows( $p_project_ids, $p_released = null, $p_obsolete = false, $p_inherit = null ) {
 568 	global $g_cache_versions_project;
 569 	if( $p_inherit === null && ON == config_get( 'subprojects_inherit_versions', null, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS ) ) {
 570 		$t_inherit = true;
 571 	} else {
 572 		$t_inherit = (bool)$p_inherit;
 573 	}
 574 	$t_project_ids = is_array( $p_project_ids ) ? $p_project_ids : array( $p_project_ids );
 575 
 576 	if( $t_inherit ) {
 577 		# add all parents for the requested projects
 578 		$t_project_list = array();
 579 		foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 580 			if( in_array( $t_id, $t_project_list ) ) {
 581 				# if it's already in the list, it appeared as parent of other project,
 582 				# thus its own parents were added too.
 583 				continue;
 584 			}
 585 			$t_project_list = array_merge( $t_project_list, project_hierarchy_inheritance( $t_id ) );
 586 		}
 587 		$t_project_list = array_unique( $t_project_list );
 588 	} else {
 589 		$t_project_list = $t_project_ids;
 590 	}
 591 
 592 	version_cache_array_rows( $t_project_list );
 593 	$t_versions = array();
 594 	foreach( $t_project_list as $t_project_id ) {
 595 		if( !empty( $g_cache_versions_project[$t_project_id]) ) {
 596 			foreach( $g_cache_versions_project[$t_project_id] as $t_id ) {
 597 				/** @noinspection PhpUnhandledExceptionInspection */
 598 				$t_version_row = version_cache_row( $t_id );
 599 				if( $p_obsolete === false && (int)$t_version_row['obsolete'] == 1 ) {
 600 					continue;
 601 				}
 602 				if( $p_released !== null ) {
 603 					$c_ver_released = (int)$t_version_row['released'] == 1;
 604 					if( $p_released && !$c_ver_released || !$p_released && $c_ver_released ) {
 605 						continue;
 606 					}
 607 				}
 608 
 609 				$t_versions[] = $t_version_row;
 610 				$t_order[] = (int)$t_version_row['date_order'];
 611 			}
 612 		}
 613 	}
 614 	if( !empty( $t_versions ) ) {
 615 		# @TODO this function should not be responsible for sorting, let the
 616 		# caller sort as needed
 617 		# Included for backward compatibilty with calls that expect this.
 618 		array_multisort( $t_order, SORT_DESC, SORT_REGULAR, $t_versions );
 619 	}
 620 	return $t_versions;
 621 }

 623 /**
 624  * Get the version_id, given the project_id and $p_version_id.
 625  *
 626  * @param string  $p_version    A version string to look up.
 627  * @param integer $p_project_id A valid project identifier.
 628  * @param boolean $p_inherit    True to include versions from parent projects,
 629  *                              false not to, or null to use configuration
 630  *                              setting ($g_subprojects_inherit_versions).
 631  *
 632  * @return int|false False if not found, otherwise returns the id.
 633  */
 634 function version_get_id( $p_version, $p_project_id = null, $p_inherit = null ) {
 635 
 636 	if( $p_project_id === null ) {
 637 		$c_project_id = helper_get_current_project();
 638 	} else {
 639 		$c_project_id = (int)$p_project_id;
 640 	}
 641 
 642 	$t_versions = version_get_all_rows( $c_project_id, VERSION_ALL, true /* incl. obsolete */ ,  $p_inherit );
 643 	foreach( $t_versions as $t_version ) {
 644 		if( $t_version['version'] === $p_version ) {
 645 			return $t_version['id'];
 646 		}
 647 	}
 648 	return false;
 649 }
 650 
 651 /**
 652  * Get the specified field name for the specified version id.
 653  *
 654  * @param integer $p_version_id A valid version identifier.
 655  * @param string  $p_field_name A valid field name to lookup.
 656  *
 657  * @return mixed The Version field's value.
 658  *
 659  * @throws ClientException if the Version or the Field does not exist.
 660  */
 661 function version_get_field( $p_version_id, $p_field_name ) {
 662 	$t_row = version_cache_row( $p_version_id );
 663 
 664 	if( isset( $t_row[$p_field_name] ) ) {
 665 		switch( $p_field_name ) {
 666 			case 'project_id':
 667 				return (int)$t_row[$p_field_name];
 668 			default:
 669 				return $t_row[$p_field_name];
 670 		}
 671 	} else {
 672 		throw new ClientException(
 673 			"Field '$p_field_name' not found",
 674 			ERROR_DB_FIELD_NOT_FOUND,
 675 			array( $p_field_name ) );
 676 	}
 677 }

 679 /**
 680  * Gets the full name of a version.
 681  *
 682  * This may include the project name as a prefix (e.g. '[MantisBT] 2.0.0')
 683  *
 684  * @param integer $p_version_id         The version id.
 685  * @param boolean $p_show_project       Whether to include the project name or
 686  *                                      not, null means include the project if
 687  *                                      different from current.
 688  * @param integer $p_current_project_id The current project id or null to use
 689  *                                      the cookie.
 690  *
 691  * @return string The full name of the version.
 692  *
 693  * @throws ClientException if the Version does not exist.
 694  */
 695 function version_full_name( $p_version_id, $p_show_project = null, $p_current_project_id = null ) {
 696 	$t_row = version_cache_row( $p_version_id );
 697 	$t_project_id = $t_row['project_id'];
 698 
 699 	$t_current_project_id = is_null( $p_current_project_id ) ? helper_get_current_project() : $p_current_project_id;
 700 
 701 	if( $p_show_project === null ) {
 702 		$t_show_project = $t_project_id != $t_current_project_id;
 703 	} else {
 704 		$t_show_project = $p_show_project;
 705 	}
 706 
 707 	if( $t_show_project ) {
 708 		return '[' . project_get_name( $t_project_id ) . '] ' . $t_row['version'];
 709 	}
 710 
 711 	return $t_row['version'];
 712 }

 714 /**
 715  * Get information about a version given its id.
 716  *
 717  * @param integer $p_version_id A valid version identifier.
 718  *
 719  * @return VersionData
 720  * @throws ClientException if Version does not exist.
 721  */
 722 function version_get( $p_version_id ) {
 723 	$t_row = version_cache_row( $p_version_id );
 724 
 725 	return new VersionData( $t_row );

 728 /**
 729  * Checks whether the product version should be shown
 730  * (i.e. report, update, view, print).
 731  *
 732  * @param integer|array $p_project_ids  A valid project id or array of ids
 733  *
 734  * @return boolean true: show, false: otherwise.
 735  */
 736 function version_should_show_product_version( $p_project_ids ) {
 737 	$t_project_ids = is_array( $p_project_ids ) ? $p_project_ids : array( $p_project_ids );
 738 
 739 	$t_check_projects = array();
 740 	foreach( $t_project_ids as $t_id ) {
 741 		$t_option = config_get( 'show_product_version', null, null, $t_id );
 742 		if( ON == $t_option ) {
 743 			# if at least one of the projects have the option enabled is enough
 744 			# condition to return true
 745 			return true;
 746 		}
 747 		if( AUTO == $t_option ) {
 748 			# if option is AUTO, save this project for later check it there are
 749 			# any actual versions.
 750 			$t_check_projects[] = $t_id;
 751 		}
 752 		# if option is not ON or AUTO, ignore this project
 753 	}
 754 
 755 	if( !empty( $t_check_projects ) ) {
 756 		return count( version_get_all_rows( $t_check_projects ) ) > 0;
 757 	}
 758 
 759 	return false;
 760 }

  17 /**
  18  * Login page accepts username and posts results to login_password_page.php,
  19  * which may take the users credential or redirect to a plugin specific page.
  20  *
  21  * This page also offers features like anonymous login and signup.
  22  *
  23  * @package MantisBT
  24  * @copyright Copyright 2000 - 2002  Kenzaburo Ito - kenito@300baud.org
  25  * @copyright Copyright 2002  MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  26  * @link http://www.mantisbt.org
  27  *
  28  * @uses core.php
  29  * @uses authentication_api.php
  30  * @uses config_api.php
  31  * @uses constant_inc.php
  32  * @uses current_user_api.php
  33  * @uses database_api.php
  34  * @uses gpc_api.php
  35  * @uses helper_api.php
  36  * @uses html_api.php
  37  * @uses lang_api.php
  38  * @uses print_api.php
  39  * @uses string_api.php
  40  * @uses user_api.php
  41  * @uses utility_api.php
  42  */
  43 
  44 require_once( 'core.php' );
  45 require_api( 'authentication_api.php' );
  46 require_api( 'config_api.php' );
  47 require_api( 'constant_inc.php' );
  48 require_api( 'current_user_api.php' );
  49 require_api( 'database_api.php' );
  50 require_api( 'gpc_api.php' );
  51 require_api( 'helper_api.php' );
  52 require_api( 'html_api.php' );
  53 require_api( 'lang_api.php' );
  54 require_api( 'print_api.php' );
  55 require_api( 'string_api.php' );
  56 require_api( 'user_api.php' );
  57 require_api( 'utility_api.php' );
  58 require_css( 'login.css' );
  59 
  60 $f_error                 = gpc_get_bool( 'error' );
  61 $f_cookie_error          = gpc_get_bool( 'cookie_error' );
  62 $f_return                = string_sanitize_url( gpc_get_string( 'return', '' ) );
  63 $f_username              = gpc_get_string( 'username', '' );
  64 $f_secure_session        = gpc_get_bool( 'secure_session', false );
  65 $f_secure_session_cookie = gpc_get_cookie( config_get_global( 'cookie_prefix' ) . '_secure_session', null );
  66 
  67 # Set username to blank if invalid to prevent possible XSS exploits
  68 $t_username = auth_prepare_username( $f_username );
  69 
  70 if( config_get_global( 'email_login_enabled' ) ) {
  71 	$t_username_label = lang_get( 'username_or_email' );
  72 } else {
  73 	$t_username_label = lang_get( 'username' );
  74 }
  75 
  76 $t_show_signup =
  77 	( auth_signup_enabled() ) &&
  78 	( LDAP != config_get_global( 'login_method' ) ) &&
  79 	( ON == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) );
  80 
  81 $t_show_anonymous_login = auth_anonymous_enabled();
  82 
  83 $t_form_title = lang_get( 'login_title' );
  84 
  85 # If user is already authenticated and not anonymous
  86 if( auth_is_user_authenticated() && !current_user_is_anonymous() ) {
  87 	# If return URL is specified redirect to it; otherwise use default page
  88 	if( !is_blank( $f_return ) ) {
  89 		print_header_redirect( $f_return, false, false, true );
  90 	} else {
  91 		print_header_redirect( config_get_global( 'default_home_page' ) );
  92 	}
  93 }
  94 
  95 # Check for automatic logon methods where we want the logon to just be handled by login.php
  96 if( auth_automatic_logon_bypass_form() ) {
  97 	$t_uri = 'login.php';
  98 
  99 	if( auth_anonymous_enabled() ) {
 100 		$t_uri = 'login_anon.php';
 101 	}
 102 
 103 	if( !is_blank( $f_return ) ) {
 104 		$t_uri = helper_url_combine( $t_uri, [ 'return' => $f_return ] );
 105 	}
 106

 135 $t_warnings = array();

 138 if( config_get_global( 'admin_checks' ) == ON ) {

 141 	$t_admin_dir_is_accessible = @is_readable( $t_admin_dir );
 142 	if( $t_admin_dir_is_accessible ) {
 143 		$t_warnings[] = lang_get( 'warning_admin_directory_present' );

 154 	# $g_path was defaulted - risk of Host Header injection attack
 155 	global $g_defaulted_path;

 157 		$t_warnings[] = lang_get( 'warning_host_header_injection_hazard' );
 158 	}

 160 	/**
 161 	 * Display Warnings for enabled debugging / developer settings
 162 	 * @param string $p_type    Message Type.
 163 	 * @param string $p_setting Setting.
 164 	 * @param string $p_value   Value.
 165 	 * @return string
 166 	 */
 167 	function debug_setting_message ( $p_type, $p_setting, $p_value ) {
 168 		return sprintf( lang_get( 'warning_change_setting' ), $p_setting, $p_value )
 169 			. lang_get( 'word_separator' )
 170 			. lang_get( "warning_{$p_type}_hazard" );
 171 	}
 172 
 173 	$t_config = 'show_detailed_errors';
 174 	if( config_get_global( $t_config ) != OFF ) {
 175 		$t_warnings[] = debug_setting_message( 'security', $t_config, 'OFF' );
 176 	}
 177 
 178 	# since admin directory and db_upgrade lists are available check for missing db upgrades
 179 	# if db version is 0, we do not have a valid database.
 180 	$t_db_version = config_get( 'database_version', 0, ALL_USERS, ALL_PROJECTS );
 181 	if( $t_db_version == 0 ) {
 182 		$t_warnings[] = lang_get( 'error_database_no_schema_version' );
 183 	}
 184 
 185 	# Check for db upgrade for versions > 1.0.0 using new installer and schema
 186 	if( $t_admin_dir_is_accessible
 187 		&& @include_once( $t_admin_dir . '/schema.php' )
 188 	) {
 189 		/** @var array $g_upgrade */
 190 		$t_upgrades_reqd = count( $g_upgrade ) - 1;
 191 
 192 		if( ( 0 < $t_db_version ) &&
 193 			( $t_db_version != $t_upgrades_reqd ) ) {
 194 
 195 			if( $t_db_version < $t_upgrades_reqd ) {
 196 				$t_warnings[] = lang_get( 'error_database_version_out_of_date_2'
 197 				);
 198 				$t_upgrade_required = true;
 199 			}
 200 			else {
 201 				$t_warnings[] = lang_get( 'error_code_version_out_of_date' );
 202 			}
 203 		}
 204 	}
 205 }

  17 /**

  22  * This page also offers features like remember me, secure session, and forgot password.

  44 require_once( 'core.php' );
  45 require_api( 'authentication_api.php' );

  58 require_css( 'login.css' );
  59 
  60 $f_error                 = gpc_get_bool( 'error' );
  61 $f_cookie_error          = gpc_get_bool( 'cookie_error' );
  62 $f_return                = string_sanitize_url( gpc_get_string( 'return', '' ) );
  63 $f_username              = trim( gpc_get_string( 'username', '' ) );
  64 $f_reauthenticate        = gpc_get_bool( 'reauthenticate', false );
  65 $f_perm_login            = gpc_get_bool( 'perm_login', false );
  66 $f_secure_session        = gpc_get_bool( 'secure_session', false );
  67 $f_secure_session_cookie = gpc_get_cookie( config_get_global( 'cookie_prefix' ) . '_secure_session', null );
  68 
  69 # Set username to blank if invalid to prevent possible XSS exploits
  70 $t_username = auth_prepare_username( $f_username );
  71 
  72 if( is_blank( $t_username ) ) {
  73 	$t_query_args = array(
  74 		'error' => 1,
  75 		'return' => $f_return,
  76 	);
  77 
  78 	$t_redirect_url = auth_login_page( $t_query_args );
  79 	print_header_redirect( $t_redirect_url );
  80 }
  81 
  82 # Get the user id and based on the user decide whether to continue with native password credential
  83 # page or one provided by a plugin.
  84 $t_user_id = auth_get_user_id_from_login_name( $t_username );
  85 # User id could be false if the user does not exist in DB, should be calling auth_credential_page
  86 # regardless if the user exists or not to give the plugin an opportunity to handle non-existent
  87 # users per #29517
  88 $t_should_redirect = AUTH_PAGE_CREDENTIAL != ( $t_user_id !== false
  89 		? auth_credential_page( '', $t_user_id )
  90 		: auth_credential_page( '', NO_USER, $t_username ) );
  91 if( $t_should_redirect ) {
  92 	$t_query_args = array(
  93 		'username' => $t_username,
  94 		'cookie_error' => $f_cookie_error,
  95 		'reauthenticate' => $f_reauthenticate,
  96 	);
  97 
  98 	if( !is_blank( $f_error ) ) {
  99 		$t_query_args['error'] = $f_error;
 100 	}
 101 
 102 	if( !is_blank( $f_cookie_error ) ) {
 103 		$t_query_args['cookie_error'] = $f_cookie_error;
 104 	}
 105 
 106 	# Determine the credential page URL based on user id (if it exists) or username
 107 	$t_redirect_url = $t_user_id !== false
 108 		? auth_credential_page( $t_query_args, $t_user_id )
 109 		: auth_credential_page( $t_query_args, NO_USER, $t_username );
 110 	print_header_redirect( $t_redirect_url );
 111 }
 112 
 113 $t_session_validation = !$f_reauthenticate && ( ON == config_get_global( 'session_validation' ) );
 114 
 115 $t_show_reset_password = !$f_reauthenticate &&
 116 	( LDAP != config_get_global( 'login_method' ) ) &&
 117 	( ON == config_get( 'lost_password_feature' ) ) &&
 118 	( ON == config_get( 'send_reset_password' ) ) &&
 119 	( ON == config_get( 'enable_email_notification' ) );
 120 
 121 $t_show_remember_me = !$f_reauthenticate && auth_allow_perm_login( $t_user_id, $t_username );
 122 
 123 $t_form_title = $f_reauthenticate ? lang_get( 'reauthenticate_title' ) : lang_get( 'login_title' );
 124 
 125 # If user is already authenticated and not anonymous
 126 if( auth_is_user_authenticated() && !current_user_is_anonymous() && !$f_reauthenticate) {
 127 	# If return URL is specified redirect to it; otherwise use default page
 128 	if( !is_blank( $f_return ) ) {
 129 		print_header_redirect( $f_return, false, false, true );
 130 	} else {
 131 		print_header_redirect( config_get_global( 'default_home_page' ) );
 132 	}
 133 }
 134 
 135 # Determine if secure_session should default on or off?
 136 # - If no errors, and no cookies set, default to on.
 137 # - If no errors, but cookie is set, use the cookie value.
 138 # - If errors, use the value passed in.
 139 if( $t_session_validation ) {
 140 	if( !$f_error && !$f_cookie_error ) {
 141 		$t_default_secure_session = is_null( $f_secure_session_cookie ) ? true : $f_secure_session_cookie;
 142 	} else {
 143 		$t_default_secure_session = $f_secure_session;
 144 	}
 145 }
 146 
 147 layout_login_page_begin( $t_form_title );

 154 		<div class="space-24 hidden-480"></div>
 155 <?php
 156 if( $f_error || $f_cookie_error || $f_reauthenticate ) {

 158 
 159 	if( $f_reauthenticate ) {
 160 		echo '<p>' . lang_get( 'reauthenticate_message' ) . '</p>';

 175 $t_upgrade_required = false;
 176 if( config_get_global( 'admin_checks' ) == ON && file_exists( __DIR__ .'/admin/.' ) ) {
 177 	# since admin directory and db_upgrade lists are available check for missing db upgrades
 178 	# if db version is 0, we do not have a valid database.

 190 
 191 		if( $t_db_version < $t_upgrades_reqd ) {
 192 			$t_upgrade_required = true;
 193 		}
 194 	}
 195 }

  97 					<?php print_icon( 'fa-user', 'ace-icon' ); ?>
  98 				</span>

  24 /**
  25  * Mantis Core Formatting plugin
  26  */
  27 class MantisCoreFormattingPlugin extends MantisFormattingPlugin {
  28 	/**
  29 	 * A method that populates the plugin information and minimum requirements.
  30 	 * @return void
  31 	 */
  32 	function register() {
  33 		$this->name = lang_get( 'plugin_format_title' );
  34 		$this->description = lang_get( 'plugin_format_description' );
  35 		$this->page = 'config';
  36 
  37 		$this->version = MANTIS_VERSION;
  38 		$this->requires = array(
  39 			'MantisCore' => '2.25.0',
  40 		);
  41 
  42 		$this->author = 'MantisBT Team';
  43 		$this->contact = 'mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net';
  44 		$this->url = 'https://mantisbt.org';
  45 	}
  46 
  47 	/**
  48 	 * Event hook declaration.
  49 	 * @return array
  50 	 */
  51 	function hooks() {
  52 		return array(
  53 			'EVENT_DISPLAY_TEXT'		=> 'text',			# Text String Display
  54 			'EVENT_DISPLAY_FORMATTED'	=> 'formatted',		# Formatted String Display
  55 			'EVENT_DISPLAY_RSS'			=> 'rss',			# RSS String Display
  56 			'EVENT_DISPLAY_EMAIL'		=> 'email',			# Email String Display
  57 			'EVENT_LAYOUT_RESOURCES'	=> 'resources'		# Load stylesheet
  58 		);
  59 	}
  60 
  61 	/**
  62 	 * @return void
  63 	 */
  64 	function resources() {
  65 		if ( ON == plugin_config_get( 'process_markdown' ) ) {
  66 			echo '<link rel="stylesheet" href="' . plugin_file( 'markdown.css' ) . '" />';
  67 
  68 			if ( ON == plugin_config_get( 'syntax_highlighting' ) ) {
  69 				$t_plugins = plugin_config_get( 'syntax_highlighting_plugins' );
  70 				echo '<script
  71 					id="mantis-core-formatting-syntax-highlighting-init"
  72 					data-cdn="' . config_get( 'cdn_enabled' ) . '"
  73 					data-theme="' . plugin_config_get( 'syntax_highlighting_theme' ) . '"
  74 					data-plugins="' . implode( ',', array_map(
  75 						'trim',
  76 						is_array( $t_plugins ) ? $t_plugins : []
  77 					) ) . '"
  78 					data-i18n=\'' . json_encode([
  79 						'copy-to-clipboard' => [
  80 							'copy' => lang_get( 'plugin_format_syntax_highlighting_plugin_copy_to_clipboard_copy' ),
  81 							'copy-success' => lang_get( 'plugin_format_syntax_highlighting_plugin_copy_to_clipboard_success' ),
  82 							'copy-error' => lang_get( 'plugin_format_syntax_highlighting_plugin_copy_to_clipboard_error' ),
  83 						],
  84 					])  . '\'
  85 					src="' . plugin_file( 'syntax-highlighting/init.js' ) . '"></script>';
  86 			}
  87 		}
  88 	}
  89 
  90 	/**
  91 	 * Default plugin configuration.
  92 	 * @return array
  93 	 */
  94 	function config() {
  95 		return array(
  96 			'process_text'					=> ON,
  97 			'process_urls'					=> ON,
  98 			'process_buglinks'				=> ON,
  99 			'process_markdown'				=> OFF,
 100 			'syntax_highlighting'			=> OFF,
 101 			'syntax_highlighting_theme'		=> 'prism.min.css',
 102 			'syntax_highlighting_plugins'	=> []
 103 		);
 104 	}
 105 
 106 	/**
 107 	 * Process Text, make sure to block any possible xss attacks
 108 	 *
 109 	 * @param string  $p_string    Raw text to process.
 110 	 * @param boolean $p_multiline True for multiline text (default), false for single-line.
 111 	 *                             Determines which html tags are used.
 112 	 *
 113 	 * @return string valid formatted text
 114 	 */
 115 	private function processText( $p_string, $p_multiline = true ) {
 116 		$t_string = string_strip_hrefs( $p_string );
 117 		$t_string = string_html_specialchars( $t_string );
 118 
 119 		return string_restore_valid_html_tags( $t_string, $p_multiline );
 120 	}
 121 
 122 	/**
 123 	 * Process Bug and Note links
 124 	 * @param string  $p_string    Raw text to process.
 125 	 *
 126 	 * @return string Formatted text
 127 	 */
 128 	private function processBugAndNoteLinks( $p_string ) {
 129 		$t_string = string_process_bug_link( $p_string );
 130 
 131 		return string_process_bugnote_link( $t_string );
 132 	}
 133 
 134 	/**
 135 	 * Plain text processing.
 136 	 *
 137 	 * @param string  $p_event     Event name.
 138 	 * @param string  $p_string    Raw text to process.
 139 	 * @param boolean $p_multiline True for multiline text (default), false for single-line.
 140 	 *                             Determines which html tags are used.
 141 	 *
 142 	 * @return string Formatted text
 143 	 *
 144 	 * @see $g_html_valid_tags
 145 	 * @see $g_html_valid_tags_single_line
 146 	 */
 147 	function text( $p_event, $p_string, $p_multiline = true ) {
 148 		static $s_text;
 149 
 150 		if( null === $s_text ) {
 151 			$s_text = plugin_config_get( 'process_text' );
 152 		}
 153 
 154 		if( ON == $s_text ) {
 155 			$t_string = $this->processText( $p_string, $p_multiline );
 156 
 157 			if( $p_multiline ) {
 158 				$t_string = string_preserve_spaces_at_bol( $t_string );
 159 				$t_string = string_nl2br( $t_string );
 160 			}
 161 			return $t_string;
 162 		} else {
 163 			return $p_string;
 164 		}
 165 	}
 166 
 167 	/**
 168 	 * Formatted text processing.
 169 	 *
 170 	 * Performs plain text, URLs, bug links, markdown processing
 171 	 *
 172 	 * @param string  $p_event     Event name.
 173 	 * @param string  $p_string    Raw text to process.
 174 	 * @param boolean $p_multiline True for multiline text (default), false for single-line.
 175 	 *                             Determines which html tags are used.
 176 	 *
 177 	 * @return string Formatted text
 178 	 */
 179 	function formatted( $p_event, $p_string, $p_multiline = true ) {
 180 		static $s_text, $s_urls, $s_buglinks, $s_markdown;
 181 
 182 		$t_string = $p_string;
 183 
 184 		if( null === $s_urls ) {
 185 			$s_urls = plugin_config_get( 'process_urls' );
 186 			$s_buglinks = plugin_config_get( 'process_buglinks' );
 187 		}
 188 
 189 		if( null === $s_markdown ) {
 190 			$s_markdown = plugin_config_get( 'process_markdown' );
 191 		}
 192 
 193 		# Parse input and return finished HTML markup, no further processing.
 194 		if( ON == $s_markdown ) {
 195 			return MantisMarkdown::getInstance( $s_urls, $s_buglinks )->convert( $t_string, $p_multiline );
 196 		}
 197 
 198 		if( null === $s_text ) {
 199 			$s_text = plugin_config_get( 'process_text' );
 200 		}
 201 
 202 		if( ON == $s_text ) {
 203 			$t_string = $this->processText( $t_string );
 204 
 205 			if( $p_multiline ) {
 206 				$t_string = string_preserve_spaces_at_bol( $t_string );
 207 				$t_string = string_nl2br( $t_string );
 208 			}
 209 		}
 210 
 211 		if( ON == $s_urls ) {
 212 			$t_string = string_insert_hrefs( $t_string );
 213 		}
 214 
 215 		if ( ON == $s_buglinks ) {
 216 			$t_string = $this->processBugAndNoteLinks( $t_string );
 217 		}
 218 
 219 		return mention_format_text( $t_string, /* html */ true );
 220 	}
 221 
 222 	/**
 223 	 * RSS text processing.
 224 	 * @param string $p_event  Event name.
 225 	 * @param string $p_string Unformatted text.
 226 	 * @return string Formatted text
 227 	 */
 228 	function rss( $p_event, $p_string ) {
 229 		static $s_text, $s_urls, $s_buglinks;
 230 
 231 		$t_string = $p_string;
 232 
 233 		if( null === $s_text ) {
 234 			$s_text = plugin_config_get( 'process_text' );
 235 			$s_urls = plugin_config_get( 'process_urls' );
 236 			$s_buglinks = plugin_config_get( 'process_buglinks' );
 237 		}
 238 
 239 		if( ON == $s_text ) {
 240 			$t_string = string_strip_hrefs( $t_string );
 241 			$t_string = string_html_specialchars( $t_string );
 242 			$t_string = string_restore_valid_html_tags( $t_string );
 243 			$t_string = string_nl2br( $t_string );
 244 		}
 245 
 246 		if( ON == $s_urls ) {
 247 			$t_string = string_insert_hrefs( $t_string );
 248 		}
 249 
 250 		if( ON == $s_buglinks ) {
 251 			$t_string = string_process_bug_link( $t_string, true, false, true );
 252 			$t_string = string_process_bugnote_link( $t_string, true, false, true );
 253 		}
 254 
 255 		$t_string = mention_format_text( $t_string, /* html */ true );
 256 
 257 		return $t_string;
 258 	}
 259 
 260 	/**
 261 	 * Email text processing.
 262 	 * @param string $p_event  Event name.
 263 	 * @param string $p_string Unformatted text.
 264 	 * @return string Formatted text
 265 	 */
 266 	function email( $p_event, $p_string ) {
 267 		static $s_text, $s_buglinks;
 268 
 269 		$t_string = $p_string;
 270 
 271 		if( null === $s_text ) {
 272 			$s_text = plugin_config_get( 'process_text' );
 273 			$s_buglinks = plugin_config_get( 'process_buglinks' );
 274 		}
 275 
 276 		if( ON == $s_text ) {
 277 			$t_string = string_strip_hrefs( $t_string );
 278 		}
 279 
 280 		if( ON == $s_buglinks ) {
 281 			$t_string = string_process_bug_link( $t_string, false );
 282 			$t_string = string_process_bugnote_link( $t_string, false );
 283 		}
 284 
 285 		$t_string = mention_format_text( $t_string, /* html */ false );
 286 
 287 		return $t_string;
 288 	}
 289 }

  17 /**
  18  * MantisMarkdown class
  19  * @copyright Copyright 2016 MantisBT Team - mantisbt-dev@lists.sourceforge.net
  20  * @link https://www.mantisbt.org
  21  * @package MantisBT
  22  * @subpackage parsedown
  23  */
  24 
  25 /**
  26  * MantisMarkdown Extension class, extending Parsedown library
  27  * This class serves which functions needs to customize and methods to override from Parsedown library
  28  *
  29  * To meet and match the MantisBT styles and logic requirements, we have to override and control with it
  30  * For example: #2 is treated as header Markdown
  31  * So, to make sure #2 treated as bug link (not a header), then we have to change the logic in blockHeader method
  32  *
  33  * @package MantisBT
  34  * @subpackage parsedown
  35  *
  36  * @uses Parsedown Library
  37  */
  38 
  39 
  40 /**
  41  * A class that overrides default Markdown parsing for Mantis specific scenarios.
  42  */
  43 class MantisMarkdown extends Parsedown
  44 {
  45 	/**
  46 	 * Singleton instance for MantisMarkdown class.
  47 	 */
  48 	private static ?MantisMarkdown $instance = null;
  49 
  50 	/**
  51 	 * CSS class for tables.
  52 	 */
  53 	private string $table_class = 'table table-nonfluid';
  54 
  55 	/**
  56 	 * Plugin configuration
  57 	 * The value of the constant "ON" (1) or "OFF" (0).
  58 	 */
  59 	private int $config_process_buglinks = OFF;
  60 
  61 	/**
  62 	 * Plugin configuration
  63 	 * The value of the constant "ON" (1) or "OFF" (0).
  64 	 */
  65 	private int $config_process_urls = OFF;
  66 
  67 	/**
  68 	 * Collection of the captured code blocks.
  69 	 *
  70 	 * @var array<string, string>
  71 	 */
  72 	private array $codeblocks = [];
  73 
  74 	public function __construct( ?int $p_process_urls = OFF, ?int $p_process_buglinks = OFF ) {
  75 		# Plugin configuration
  76 		if( in_array( $p_process_urls, [OFF, ON], true ) ) {
  77 			$this->config_process_urls = $p_process_urls;
  78 		}
  79 
  80 		if( in_array( $p_process_buglinks, [OFF, ON], true ) ) {
  81 			$this->config_process_buglinks = $p_process_buglinks;
  82 		}
  83 
  84 		# Parser configuration
  85 		# Enable line break by default
  86 		$this->breaksEnabled = true;
  87 		# XSS protection
  88 		$this->setSafeMode( true );
  89 		# Only turn URLs into links if config says so
  90 		$this->setUrlsLinked( (bool) $this->config_process_urls );
  91 
  92 		$this->InlineTypes['@'][] = 'EmailText';
  93 		$this->inlineMarkerList .= '@';
  94 	}
  95 
  96 	public static function getInstance( ?int $p_process_urls = OFF, ?int $p_process_buglinks = OFF ): self {
  97 		if ( null === static::$instance ) {
  98 			static::$instance = new MantisMarkdown( $p_process_urls, $p_process_buglinks );
  99 		}
 100 
 101 		return static::$instance;
 102 	}
 103 
 104 	/**
 105 	 * Convert text input form Markdown to HTML.
 106 	 *
 107 	 * @param string $p_string The input to convert
 108 	 * @param bool $p_multiline Determines the method for parsing.
 109 	 * @return string HTML markup
 110 	 */
 111 	public function convert( string $p_string, bool $p_multiline = false ): string {
 112 		return $this->finalizeMarkup($p_multiline
 113 			? parent::text( $p_string )
 114 			: parent::line( $p_string )
 115 		);
 116 	}
 117 
 118 	/**
 119 	 * Hash value of a piece of code that is used as the
 120 	 * key for $this->codeblocks collection.
 121 	 */
 122 	public function hash( string $p_string ): string {
 123 		return md5( $p_string );
 124 	}
 125 
 126 	/**
 127 	 * @return int Value of constant "ON" (1) or "OFF" (0)
 128 	 */
 129 	public function getConfigProcessUrls(): int {
 130 		return $this->config_process_urls;
 131 	}
 132 
 133 	/**
 134 	 * @return int Value of constant "ON" (1) or "OFF" (0)
 135 	 */
 136 	public function getConfigProcessBugLinks(): int {
 137 		return $this->config_process_buglinks;
 138 	}
 139 
 140 	/**
 141 	 * @return array<string, string>
 142 	 */
 143 	public function getCodeblocks(): array {
 144 		return $this->codeblocks;
 145 	}
 146 
 147 	/**
 148 	 * Convert an array of element data into the HTML markup.
 149 	 *
 150 	 * @param array $Element Data for an element
 151 	 * @return string HTML markup for an element
 152 	 */
 153 	protected function element( array $Element ): string {
 154 		# Capture the code blocks to prevent them from being processed further.
 155 		if( isset( $Element['name'] ) && $Element['name'] === 'code' ) {
 156 			$t_hash = $this->hash( $Element['text'] );
 157 			$this->codeblocks[$t_hash] = $Element['text'];
 158 			$Element['text'] = $t_hash;
 159 		}
 160 
 161 		# Adding CSS classes to tables.
 162 		if( isset( $Element['name'] ) && $Element['name'] === 'table' ) {
 163 			$Element['attributes']['class'] = $this->table_class;
 164 		}
 165 
 166 		return parent::element( $Element );
 167 	}
 168 
 169 	/**
 170 	 * Convert an email addresses into a link.
 171 	 *
 172 	 * Original Parsedown only converts emails marked with < and >.
 173 	 *
 174 	 * @param array Data for the inline element
 175 	 *
 176 	 * @return array|void The email element data or nothing
 177 	 */
 178 	protected function inlineEmailText( $p_excerpt ) {
 179 		if( ON == $this->config_process_urls
 180 			&& preg_match( email_regex_simple(), $p_excerpt['context'],
 181 				$t_matches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE ) ) {
 182 			return [
 183 				'extent' => strlen( $t_matches[0][0] ),
 184 				'position' => $t_matches[0][1],
 185 				'element' => [
 186 					'name' => 'a',
 187 					'text' => $t_matches[0][0],
 188 					'attributes' => [
 189 						'href' => 'mailto:' . $t_matches[0][0],
 190 					],
 191 				],
 192 			];
 193 		}
 194 	}
 195 
 196 	/**
 197 	 * Implementation of the CommonMark specification for headers,
 198 	 * as Parsedown does not follow the specifications.
 199 	 *
 200 	 * @see https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#example-62
 201 	 * @see https://parsedown.org/demo
 202 	 *
 203 	 * @param array $Line Data for the block element
 204 	 * @return array|void Only return data for the header element if it matches
 205 	 *                    the specification
 206 	 */
 207 	protected function blockHeader( $Line ) {
 208 		# - the opening # may be indented 0-3 spaces
 209 		# - a sequence of 1–6 '#' characters
 210 		# - The #'s must be followed by a space, a tab or a newline
 211 		if ( preg_match( '/^ {0,3}#{1,6}(?:[ \t]|$)/', $Line['text'] ) ) {
 212 			return parent::blockHeader( $Line );
 213 		}
 214 	}
 215 
 216 	/**
 217 	 * Add link attributes to element data.
 218 	 *
 219 	 * - [link](http://example.com)
 220 	 *
 221 	 * @param array $Excerpt Element data
 222 	 * @return array|null Element data or nothing
 223 	 */
 224 	protected function inlineLink( $Excerpt ): ?array
 225 	{
 226 		return $this->processUrl( parent::inlineLink( $Excerpt ) );
 227 	}
 228 
 229 	/**
 230 	 * Add link attributes to element data.
 231 	 *
 232 	 * - <http://example.com>
 233 	 * - <user@example.com>
 234 	 *
 235 	 * @param array $Excerpt Element data
 236 	 * @return array|null Element data or nothing
 237 	 */
 238 	protected function inlineUrlTag( $Excerpt ): ?array
 239 	{
 240 		return $this->processUrl( parent::inlineUrlTag( $Excerpt ) );
 241 	}
 242 
 243 	/**
 244 	 * Add link attributes to element data.
 245 	 *
 246 	 * - Not marked URLs. "https://example.com"
 247 	 *
 248 	 * @param array $Excerpt Element data
 249 	 * @return array|null Element data or nothing
 250 	 */
 251 	protected function inlineUrl( $Excerpt ): ?array
 252 	{
 253 		return $this->processUrl( parent::inlineUrl( $Excerpt ) );
 254 	}
 255 
 256 	/**
 257 	 * Set the attributes "target" and "rel" of a link according to
 258 	 * the configuration of "g_html_make_links".
 259 	 *
 260 	 * @see helper_get_link_attributes()
 261 	 *
 262 	 * @param array|null $Excerpt
 263 	 * @return array|null
 264 	 */
 265 	private function processUrl( ?array $Excerpt = null ): ?array
 266 	{
 267 		if( isset( $Excerpt['element']['attributes'] ) ) {
 268 			# Check if link is external
 269 			$t_is_external_link = helper_is_link_external( $Excerpt['element']['attributes']['href'] );
 270 			$Excerpt['element']['attributes'] = array_replace(
 271 				$Excerpt['element']['attributes'],
 272 				helper_get_link_attributes( true, $t_is_external_link )
 273 			);
 274 		}
 275 
 276 		return $Excerpt;
 277 	}
 278 
 279 	/**
 280 	 * Finalize the HTML markup.
 281 	 *
 282 	 * - process mentions of bugs and bug notes
 283 	 * - restore valid html tags
 284 	 * - process mentions of users
 285 	 * - restore the captured codeblocks
 286 	 *
 287 	 * @param string $p_markup The prepared HTML markup
 288 	 * @return string The finalized HTML markup
 289 	 */
 290 	private function finalizeMarkup( string $p_markup ): string {
 291 		$t_markup = $p_markup;
 292 
 293 		if( ON == $this->config_process_buglinks ) {
 294 			$t_markup = string_process_bugnote_link( $t_markup );
 295 			$t_markup = string_process_bug_link( $t_markup );
 296 		}
 297 
 298 		$t_markup = string_restore_valid_html_tags( $t_markup );
 299 
 300 		$t_markup = mention_format_text( $t_markup );
 301 
 302 		foreach( $this->codeblocks as $t_hash => $t_code ) {
 303 			$t_markup = str_replace( $t_hash, $this->disarmCode( $t_code ), $t_markup );
 304 		}
 305 
 306 		return $t_markup;
 307 	}
 308 
 309 	/**
 310 	 * Encode special chars to their HTML entities.
 311 	 *
 312 	 * @param string $p_markup
 313 	 * @return string The encoded HTML markup
 314 	 */
 315 	public function disarmCode( string $p_markup ): string {
 316 		return htmlspecialchars( $p_markup );
 317 	}
 318 }

   1 <?php
   2 /**
   3  * ADOdb Date Library.
   4  *
   5  * @deprecated 5.22.6 Use 64-bit PHP native functions instead.
   6  *
   7  * PHP native date functions use integer timestamps for computations.
   8  * Because of this, dates are restricted to the years 1901-2038 on Unix
   9  * and 1970-2038 on Windows due to integer overflow for dates beyond
  10  * those years. This library overcomes these limitations by replacing the
  11  * native function's signed integers (normally 32-bits) with PHP floating
  12  * point numbers (normally 64-bits).
  13  *
  14  * Dates from 100 A.D. to 3000 A.D. and later have been tested.
  15  * The minimum is 100 A.D. as <100 will invoke the 2 => 4 digit year
  16  * conversion. The maximum is billions of years in the future, but this
  17  * is a theoretical limit as the computation of that year would take too
  18  * long with the current implementation of adodb_mktime().
  19  *
  20  * Replaces native functions as follows:
  21  * - getdate()  with  adodb_getdate()
  22  * - date()     with  adodb_date()
  23  * - gmdate()   with  adodb_gmdate()
  24  * - mktime()   with  adodb_mktime()
  25  * - gmmktime() with  adodb_gmmktime()
  26  * - strftime() with  adodb_strftime()
  27  * - strftime() with  adodb_gmstrftime()
  28  *
  29  * The parameters are identical, except that adodb_date() accepts a subset
  30  * of date()'s field formats. Mktime() will convert from local time to GMT,
  31  * and date() will convert from GMT to local time, but daylight savings is
  32  * not handled currently.
  33  *
  34  * To improve performance, the native date functions are used whenever
  35  * possible, the library only switches to PHP code when the dates fall outside
  36  * of the 32-bit signed integer range.
  37  *
  38  * This library is independent of the rest of ADOdb, and can be used
  39  * as standalone code.
  40  *
  41  * GREGORIAN CORRECTION
  42  *
  43  * Pope Gregory shortened October of A.D. 1582 by ten days. Thursday,
  44  * October 4, 1582 (Julian) was followed immediately by Friday, October 15,
  45  * 1582 (Gregorian). We handle this correctly, so:
  46  * adodb_mktime(0, 0, 0, 10, 15, 1582) - adodb_mktime(0, 0, 0, 10, 4, 1582)
  47  * == 24 * 3600 (1 day)
  48  *
  49  * This file is part of ADOdb, a Database Abstraction Layer library for PHP.
  50  *
  51  * @package ADOdb
  52  * @link https://adodb.org Project's web site and documentation
  53  * @link https://github.com/ADOdb/ADOdb Source code and issue tracker
  54  *
  55  * The ADOdb Library is dual-licensed, released under both the BSD 3-Clause
  56  * and the GNU Lesser General Public Licence (LGPL) v2.1 or, at your option,
  57  * any later version. This means you can use it in proprietary products.
  58  * See the LICENSE.md file distributed with this source code for details.
  59  * @license BSD-3-Clause
  60  * @license LGPL-2.1-or-later
  61  *
  62  * @copyright 2003-2013 John Lim
  63  * @copyright 2014 Damien Regad, Mark Newnham and the ADOdb community
  64  */
  65 
  66 /*
  67 =============================================================================
  68 
  69 FUNCTION DESCRIPTIONS
  70 
  71 ** FUNCTION adodb_time()
  72 
  73 Returns the current time measured in the number of seconds since the Unix Epoch (January 1 1970 00:00:00 GMT) as an unsigned integer.
  74 
  75 ** FUNCTION adodb_getdate($date=false)
  76 
  77 Returns an array containing date information, as getdate(), but supports
  78 dates greater than 1901 to 2038. The local date/time format is derived from a
  79 heuristic the first time adodb_getdate is called.
  80 
  81 
  82 ** FUNCTION adodb_date($fmt, $timestamp = false)
  83 
  84 Convert a timestamp to a formatted local date. If $timestamp is not defined, the
  85 current timestamp is used. Unlike the function date(), it supports dates
  86 outside the 1901 to 2038 range.
  87 
  88 The format fields that adodb_date supports:
  89 
  90 <pre>
  91 	a - "am" or "pm"
  92 	A - "AM" or "PM"
  93 	d - day of the month, 2 digits with leading zeros; i.e. "01" to "31"
  94 	D - day of the week, textual, 3 letters; e.g. "Fri"
  95 	F - month, textual, long; e.g. "January"
  96 	g - hour, 12-hour format without leading zeros; i.e. "1" to "12"
  97 	G - hour, 24-hour format without leading zeros; i.e. "0" to "23"
  98 	h - hour, 12-hour format; i.e. "01" to "12"
  99 	H - hour, 24-hour format; i.e. "00" to "23"
 100 	i - minutes; i.e. "00" to "59"
 101 	j - day of the month without leading zeros; i.e. "1" to "31"
 102 	l (lowercase 'L') - day of the week, textual, long; e.g. "Friday"
 103 	L - boolean for whether it is a leap year; i.e. "0" or "1"
 104 	m - month; i.e. "01" to "12"
 105 	M - month, textual, 3 letters; e.g. "Jan"
 106 	n - month without leading zeros; i.e. "1" to "12"
 107 	O - Difference to Greenwich time in hours; e.g. "+0200"
 108 	Q - Quarter, as in 1, 2, 3, 4
 109 	r - RFC 2822 formatted date; e.g. "Thu, 21 Dec 2000 16:01:07 +0200"
 110 	s - seconds; i.e. "00" to "59"
 111 	S - English ordinal suffix for the day of the month, 2 characters;
 112 	   			i.e. "st", "nd", "rd" or "th"
 113 	t - number of days in the given month; i.e. "28" to "31"
 114 	T - Timezone setting of this machine; e.g. "EST" or "MDT"
 115 	U - seconds since the Unix Epoch (January 1 1970 00:00:00 GMT)
 116 	w - day of the week, numeric, i.e. "0" (Sunday) to "6" (Saturday)
 117 	Y - year, 4 digits; e.g. "1999"
 118 	y - year, 2 digits; e.g. "99"
 119 	z - day of the year; i.e. "0" to "365"
 120 	Z - timezone offset in seconds (i.e. "-43200" to "43200").
 121 	   			The offset for timezones west of UTC is always negative,
 122 				and for those east of UTC is always positive.
 123 </pre>
 124 
 125 Unsupported:
 126 <pre>
 127 	B - Swatch Internet time
 128 	I (capital i) - "1" if Daylight Savings Time, "0" otherwise.
 129 	W - ISO-8601 week number of year, weeks starting on Monday
 130 
 131 </pre>
 132 
 133 
 134 ** FUNCTION adodb_date2($fmt, $isoDateString = false)
 135 Same as adodb_date, but 2nd parameter accepts iso date, eg.
 136 
 137   adodb_date2('d-M-Y H:i','2003-12-25 13:01:34');
 138 
 139 
 140 ** FUNCTION adodb_gmdate($fmt, $timestamp = false)
 141 
 142 Convert a timestamp to a formatted GMT date. If $timestamp is not defined, the
 143 current timestamp is used. Unlike the function date(), it supports dates
 144 outside the 1901 to 2038 range.
 145 
 146 
 147 ** FUNCTION adodb_mktime($hr, $min, $sec[, $month, $day, $year])
 148 
 149 Converts a local date to a unix timestamp.  Unlike the function mktime(), it supports
 150 dates outside the 1901 to 2038 range. All parameters are optional.
 151 
 152 
 153 ** FUNCTION adodb_gmmktime($hr, $min, $sec [, $month, $day, $year])
 154 
 155 Converts a gmt date to a unix timestamp.  Unlike the function gmmktime(), it supports
 156 dates outside the 1901 to 2038 range. Differs from gmmktime() in that all parameters
 157 are currently compulsory.
 158 
 159 ** FUNCTION adodb_gmstrftime($fmt, $timestamp = false)
 160 Convert a timestamp to a formatted GMT date.
 161 
 162 ** FUNCTION adodb_strftime($fmt, $timestamp = false)
 163 
 164 Convert a timestamp to a formatted local date. Internally converts $fmt into
 165 adodb_date format, then echo result.
 166 
 167 For best results, you can define the local date format yourself. Define a global
 168 variable $ADODB_DATE_LOCALE which is an array, 1st element is date format using
 169 adodb_date syntax, and 2nd element is the time format, also in adodb_date syntax.
 170 
 171     eg. $ADODB_DATE_LOCALE = array('d/m/Y','H:i:s');
 172 
 173 	Supported format codes:
 174 
 175 <pre>
 176 	%a - abbreviated weekday name according to the current locale
 177 	%A - full weekday name according to the current locale
 178 	%b - abbreviated month name according to the current locale
 179 	%B - full month name according to the current locale
 180 	%c - preferred date and time representation for the current locale
 181 	%d - day of the month as a decimal number (range 01 to 31)
 182 	%D - same as %m/%d/%y
 183 	%e - day of the month as a decimal number, a single digit is preceded by a space (range ' 1' to '31')
 184 	%h - same as %b
 185 	%H - hour as a decimal number using a 24-hour clock (range 00 to 23)
 186 	%I - hour as a decimal number using a 12-hour clock (range 01 to 12)
 187 	%m - month as a decimal number (range 01 to 12)
 188 	%M - minute as a decimal number
 189 	%n - newline character
 190 	%p - either `am' or `pm' according to the given time value, or the corresponding strings for the current locale
 191 	%r - time in a.m. and p.m. notation
 192 	%R - time in 24 hour notation
 193 	%S - second as a decimal number
 194 	%t - tab character
 195 	%T - current time, equal to %H:%M:%S
 196 	%x - preferred date representation for the current locale without the time
 197 	%X - preferred time representation for the current locale without the date
 198 	%y - year as a decimal number without a century (range 00 to 99)
 199 	%Y - year as a decimal number including the century
 200 	%Z - time zone or name or abbreviation
 201 	%% - a literal `%' character
 202 </pre>
 203 
 204 	Unsupported codes:
 205 <pre>
 206 	%C - century number (the year divided by 100 and truncated to an integer, range 00 to 99)
 207 	%g - like %G, but without the century.
 208 	%G - The 4-digit year corresponding to the ISO week number (see %V).
 209 	     This has the same format and value as %Y, except that if the ISO week number belongs
 210 		 to the previous or next year, that year is used instead.
 211 	%j - day of the year as a decimal number (range 001 to 366)
 212 	%u - weekday as a decimal number [1,7], with 1 representing Monday
 213 	%U - week number of the current year as a decimal number, starting
 214 	    with the first Sunday as the first day of the first week
 215 	%V - The ISO 8601:1988 week number of the current year as a decimal number,
 216 	     range 01 to 53, where week 1 is the first week that has at least 4 days in the
 217 		 current year, and with Monday as the first day of the week. (Use %G or %g for
 218 		 the year component that corresponds to the week number for the specified timestamp.)
 219 	%w - day of the week as a decimal, Sunday being 0
 220 	%W - week number of the current year as a decimal number, starting with the
 221 	     first Monday as the first day of the first week
 222 </pre>
 223

 303 In this example, we apply daylights savings in June or July, adding one hour. This is extremely
 304 unrealistic as it does not take into account time-zone, geographic location, current year.

 306 function adodb_daylight_sv(&$arr, $is_gmt)
 307 {
 308 	if ($is_gmt) return;
 309 	$m = $arr['mon'];
 310 	if ($m == 6 || $m == 7) $arr['hours'] += 1;
 311 }
 312 
 313 This is only called by adodb_date() and not by adodb_mktime().
 314 
 315 The format of $arr is
 316 Array (
 317    [seconds] => 0
 318    [minutes] => 0
 319    [hours] => 0
 320    [mday] => 1      # day of month, eg 1st day of the month
 321    [mon] => 2       # month (eg. Feb)
 322    [year] => 2102
 323    [yday] => 31     # days in current year
 324    [leap] =>        # true if leap year
 325    [ndays] => 28    # no of days in current month

 415 function adodb_date_test_date($y1,$m,$d=13)
 416 {
 417 	$h = round(rand()% 24);
 418 	$t = adodb_mktime($h,0,0,$m,$d,$y1);
 419 	$rez = adodb_date('Y-n-j H:i:s',$t);
 420 	if ($h == 0) $h = '00';
 421 	else if ($h < 10) $h = '0'.$h;
 422 	if ("$y1-$m-$d $h:00:00" != $rez) {
 423 		print "<b>$y1 error, expected=$y1-$m-$d $h:00:00, adodb=$rez</b><br>";
 424 		return false;
 425 	}
 426 	return true;
 427 }

 429 function adodb_date_test_strftime($fmt)
 430 {
 431 	$s1 = strftime($fmt);
 432 	$s2 = adodb_strftime($fmt);
 433 
 434 	if ($s1 == $s2) return true;
 435 
 436 	echo "error for $fmt,  strftime=$s1, adodb=$s2<br>";
 437 	return false;
 438 }

 611 function adodb_time()
 612 {
 613 	$d = new DateTime();
 614 	return $d->format('U');
 615 }
 616 
 617 /**
 618 	Returns day of week, 0 = Sunday,... 6=Saturday.
 619 	Algorithm from PEAR::Date_Calc
 620 */
 621 function adodb_dow($year, $month, $day)
 622 {
 623 /*
 624 Pope Gregory removed 10 days - October 5 to October 14 - from the year 1582 and
 625 proclaimed that from that time onwards 3 days would be dropped from the calendar
 626 every 400 years.
 627 
 628 Thursday, October 4, 1582 (Julian) was followed immediately by Friday, October 15, 1582 (Gregorian).
 629 */
 630 	if ($year <= 1582) {
 631 		if ($year < 1582 ||
 632 			($year == 1582 && ($month < 10 || ($month == 10 && $day < 15)))) $greg_correction = 3;
 633 		 else
 634 			$greg_correction = 0;
 635 	} else
 636 		$greg_correction = 0;
 637 
 638 	if($month > 2)
 639 	    $month -= 2;
 640 	else {
 641 	    $month += 10;
 642 	    $year--;
 643 	}
 644 
 645 	$day =  floor((13 * $month - 1) / 5) +
 646 	        $day + ($year % 100) +
 647 	        floor(($year % 100) / 4) +
 648 	        floor(($year / 100) / 4) - 2 *
 649 	        floor($year / 100) + 77 + $greg_correction;
 650 
 651 	return $day - 7 * floor($day / 7);
 652 }
 653 
 654 
 655 /**
 656  Checks for leap year, returns true if it is. No 2-digit year check. Also
 657  handles julian calendar correctly.
 658 */
 659 function _adodb_is_leap_year($year)
 660 {
 661 	if ($year % 4 != 0) return false;
 662 
 663 	if ($year % 400 == 0) {
 664 		return true;
 665 	// if gregorian calendar (>1582), century not-divisible by 400 is not leap
 666 	} else if ($year > 1582 && $year % 100 == 0 ) {
 667 		return false;
 668 	}
 669 
 670 	return true;
 671 }
 672 
 673 
 674 /**
 675  checks for leap year, returns true if it is. Has 2-digit year check
 676 */
 677 function adodb_is_leap_year($year)
 678 {
 679 	return  _adodb_is_leap_year(adodb_year_digit_check($year));
 680 }
 681 
 682 /**
 683 	Fix 2-digit years. Works for any century.
 684  	Assumes that if 2-digit is more than 30 years in future, then previous century.
 685 */
 686 function adodb_year_digit_check($y)
 687 {
 688 	if ($y < 100) {
 689 
 690 		$yr = (int) date("Y");
 691 		$century = (int) ($yr /100);
 692 
 693 		if ($yr%100 > 50) {
 694 			$c1 = $century + 1;
 695 			$c0 = $century;
 696 		} else {
 697 			$c1 = $century;
 698 			$c0 = $century - 1;
 699 		}
 700 		$c1 *= 100;
 701 		// if 2-digit year is less than 30 years in future, set it to this century
 702 		// otherwise if more than 30 years in future, then we set 2-digit year to the prev century.
 703 		if (($y + $c1) < $yr+30) $y = $y + $c1;
 704 		else $y = $y + $c0*100;
 705 	}
 706 	return $y;
 707 }
 708 
 709 function adodb_get_gmt_diff_ts($ts)
 710 {
 711 	if (0 <= $ts && $ts <= 0x7FFFFFFF) { // check if number in 32-bit signed range) {
 712 		$arr = getdate($ts);
 713 		$y = $arr['year'];
 714 		$m = $arr['mon'];
 715 		$d = $arr['mday'];
 716 		return adodb_get_gmt_diff($y,$m,$d);
 717 	} else {
 718 		return adodb_get_gmt_diff(false,false,false);
 719 	}
 720 
 721 }
 722 
 723 /**
 724  get local time zone offset from GMT. Does not handle historical timezones before 1970.
 725 */
 726 function adodb_get_gmt_diff($y,$m,$d)
 727 {
 728 	static $TZ,$tzo;
 729 
 730 	if (!defined('ADODB_TEST_DATES')) $y = false;
 731 	else if ($y < 1970 || $y >= 2038) $y = false;
 732 
 733 	if ($y !== false) {
 734 		$dt = new DateTime();
 735 		$dt->setISODate($y,$m,$d);
 736 		if (empty($tzo)) {
 737 			$tzo = new DateTimeZone(date_default_timezone_get());
 738 		#	$tzt = timezone_transitions_get( $tzo );
 739 		}
 740 		return -$tzo->getOffset($dt);
 741 	} else {
 742 		if (isset($TZ)) return $TZ;
 743 		$y = date('Y');
 744 		/*
 745 		if (function_exists('date_default_timezone_get') && function_exists('timezone_offset_get')) {
 746 			$tzonename = date_default_timezone_get();
 747 			if ($tzonename) {
 748 				$tobj = new DateTimeZone($tzonename);
 749 				$TZ = -timezone_offset_get($tobj,new DateTime("now",$tzo));
 750 			}
 751 		}
 752 		*/
 753 		if (empty($TZ)) $TZ = mktime(0,0,0,12,2,$y) - gmmktime(0,0,0,12,2,$y);
 754 	}
 755 	return $TZ;
 756 }

 758 /**
 759 	Returns an array with date info.
 760 */
 761 function adodb_getdate($d=false,$fast=false)
 762 {
 763 	if ($d === false) return getdate();
 764 	if (!defined('ADODB_TEST_DATES')) {
 765 		if ((abs($d) <= 0x7FFFFFFF)) { // check if number in 32-bit signed range
 766 			if (!defined('ADODB_NO_NEGATIVE_TS') || $d >= 0) // if windows, must be +ve integer
 767 				return @getdate($d);
 768 		}
 769 	}
 770 	return _adodb_getdate($d);
 771 }

 775 function adodb_date_gentable($out=true)

 777 
 778 	for ($i=1970; $i >= 1600; $i-=10) {
 779 		$s = adodb_gmmktime(0,0,0,1,1,$i);
 780 		echo "$i => $s,<br>";
 781 	}
 782 }
 783 adodb_date_gentable();

 785 for ($i=1970; $i > 1500; $i--) {
 786 
 787 echo "<hr />$i ";
 788 	adodb_date_test_date($i,1,1);
 789 }

 794 $_month_table_normal = array("",31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31);
 795 $_month_table_leaf = array("",31,29,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31);

 797 function adodb_validdate($y,$m,$d)
 798 {
 799 global $_month_table_normal,$_month_table_leaf;
 800 
 801 	if (_adodb_is_leap_year($y)) $marr = $_month_table_leaf;
 802 	else $marr = $_month_table_normal;
 803 
 804 	if ($m > 12 || $m < 1) return false;
 805 
 806 	if ($d > 31 || $d < 1) return false;
 807 
 808 	if ($marr[$m] < $d) return false;
 809 
 810 	if ($y < 1000 || $y > 3000) return false;
 811 
 812 	return true;
